text.body:
Explanatory Remarks:
1. Structural elements are enclosed in <>. 2. Editorial notes or additions are enclosed in ().
<1> mahājādhitāja śrībhojadevaviracitaḥ
śṛṅgāraprakāśaḥ
prathamaḥ prakāśaḥ
acchinnamekhalamalavdhadṛḍho maprāptacumbanamavokṣitavaktrakānti| kāntāvimiśravapuṣaḥ kṛtavipralambhasaṃbhogasakhyamiva pātu vapuḥ purāreḥ|| 1 || yatpādapaṅkajarajaḥparimārjiteṣi cetassu darpaṇatalāmalatāṃ gateṣu| śabdārthasaṃpada udāratarāḥ sphuranti vighnacchide'stu bhagavānsa gaṇādhināthaḥ|| 2 || ātmāsthitaṃ guṇaviśeṣamahaṃkṛtasya śrṛṅgāramāhuriha jīvitamātmayoneḥ| tasyātmaśakturasanīyatayā rasatvaṃ yuktasya yena rasiko'yāmiti pravādaḥ|| 3 || sattvātamanāmamaladharmaviśeṣajanmā ḍaḍḍatdhnmāmtarānibhavanirbhitavāsanotthaḥ| sarvātmasaṃpadudayātiśayaikahetu rjagarti ko'pi hṛdi mānamayo vikāraḥ|| 4 || tātparyameva vacasi dhvanireva kāvye saubhāgyameva guṇasaṃpadi vallabhasya| sāvaṇyameva vapuṣi svadate'ṅganāyāḥ śrṛṅgāra eva hṛdi mānavato janasya|| 5 || śrṛṅgāravīrakarūṇādbhutaraudrahāsya bībhatsavatsalabhayānakaśāntanāmnaḥ| āmnāsiṣurdaśa rasānsudhiyo vayaṃ tu śrṛṅgārameva rasanādrasamāmanāmaḥ|| 6 || vīrādbhutādiṣu ca yeha rasaprasiddhiḥ siddhā kuto'pi vaṭayaśakṣavadāvibhāti| loke gatānugatikatvavaśādupetāmetāṃ nivaritayitumeṣa pariśramo naḥ|| 7 || aprātikūlikatayā manaso mudādaryaḥ saṃvido'nubhaheturihābhimānaḥ| jñeyo rasaḥ sa rasanoyatayā''tmaśakte ratyādibhūmani punarvitathā rasoktiḥ|| 8 || ratyādayo'rdhaśatamekavivarajitāni bhāvāḥ pṛthagvividhabhāvaghuvo bhavanti| śrṛṅgāratatvabhitaḥ parivārayantaḥ saptārciṣaṃ dhyuticayā iva vardhayanti|| 9|| ābhāvanodayamananyādhiyā janena yo bhāvyate manasi bhāvanayā sa bhāvaḥ| yo bhāvanāpathamathitya vivartamānaḥ sāhaṃkṛtau hṛdi paraṃ svadate raso'sau|| 10 || ratyādayo yadi rasāḥ syuratiprakarṣe harṣādibhiḥ kimaparāddhibhinnaiḥ| asthāyimasta iti cedbhayabāsaśokakrodhādayoḥ vada kiyañcaramillasanti|| 11 || sthāyitvamatra viṣayātiśayānmataṃ ceñcintādayaḥ kuta uta prakṛtervaśena| tulyaiva sā''tmani bhavedatha vāsanāyāḥ saṃdīpanāttadubhayatra samānameva|| 12 ||
ataḥ siddhametad ratyādayaḥ śṛṅgāraprabhavā eva ekonapañcāśatadbhāvāḥ, vīrādayo mithyārasapravādāḥ, śṛṅgāra evairgaikakāraṇaṃ rasa iti| sa cānubhavaikagamyatvādasaparvaviṣayatvāñca duravaseyaḥ, samyagabhnayeṣu vā vidagdhaśailūṣai pradaśryamānaḥ sāmājikairavadhāryate, pravandheṣu vā mahākavibhiryathāvadāḥ khyāyamāno viduṣāṃ manīṣāvuṣayamavatarati| tatra natathā padārthaḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratīyamānāḥ svadante, yathā vāgmināṃ vacobhirāvedhyamānāḥ| tadāha “atthavisesā ṇa hi taha cittaviasaṃ kuṇānti sañcaviā| jaha uṇa te ummilalanti sukaivaāhiṃ susīsantā||” ato'bhinetṛbhyaḥ kavīnena bahumanyāmahe, abhinayebhyaśrca kāvyameveti | tatpunaḥ śabdārthayoḥ sāhityamāmananti, tadhyathā “śabdārthau sahitau kāvyam” iti | kaḥ punaḥ śabda? yaḥ sabdena pratyāyyate | sa ca dvadaśadhākriyā, kālaḥ, kārakam, purūṣaḥ, upādhiḥ, pradhānam, upaskārārthaḥ, pratipadikārthaḥ, vibhaktyarthaḥ, vṛttyarthaḥ, vākyārthaḥ, iti | kiṃ sāhityam? yaḥ śabdārthayoḥ saṃvandhaḥ | sa ca dvādaśadhābhidhā, vivakṣā, tātparyam, pravibhāgaḥ, vyapekṣā, sāmathrtham, anvayaḥ, ekārthībhāvaḥ, doṣahānam, guṇopādānam, alaṅkārayogaḥ, iti | tatra yadhyapi “na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā na ca kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ” iti prayoganiyamaḥ, tathā'pi dharmaniyamāya śāsamastraprakriyāvyavahāre prakṛtipratyayavibhāgakalpanayā śabdārthabhāvanāyāṃ pratyayātprathamamupādanakāraṇamiva yopadīyate tāṃ prakṛtiriti vyapadiśanti | sā tridhādhāturūpā, pratyayarūpā, pratayayarūpā, prātipadikarūpā ca | tatra dhātavaḥ ṣoḍhāparipaṭhitāḥ, aparipaṭhitāḥ, patipaṭhitāparipaṭhitāḥ, pratyayadhātavaḥ, nāmadhātavaḥ, pratayayanāmadhātavaśrceti | teṣu paripaṭhidā bhūvādayaḥ, yathā bhūyātteṣāṃ kule janma jāyāntāṃ teṣu sampadaḥ| yeṣāṃ svamiti manvānāḥ svīkurvanti svamarthinaḥ|| kaviḥsṛjati kāvyāni hṛdhyādadhati sajjanāḥ| sūte muktāḥ payorāśirvabanti tarūṇīstanāḥ|| na rūṇatsīndriyagrāmaṃ na śrṛṇoṣi gurorvacaḥ| nopārjayasi mitrāṇi kathaṃ gṛhṇāsyariśriyaḥ|| aparipaṭhitā āndalayatyādaya, yathā nopānāndolayanneva preṅkholayati me manaḥ| pavano vījayannāśā mānāāśāmuctulumpati|| taḍiḍḍatdhtkhacayatīvāśā nasante śarma barhiṇaḥ| pānthāsatrīśrvāsaledhauṣṇayaṃ vidhamantyabdavāyavaḥ|| milantyāśāsu jīmūtā viksabante divi grahāḥ| tāpaṃ kṣapayati prāvṛṭ śakṣīyante kābhivigrabaḥ|| ye sūtreṣveva paṭhyante na bhūvādiṣu te paripaṭitāparipaṭitāḥ skṛ ityādayaḥ, yathā anuskunuhi mā mantūn vasanto mānadhasmaraḥ| dūti drutamṛtīyasva jijāvayiṣati smaraḥ|| musalakṣepahuṃkārastebhaiḥ kalamakhaṇḍiḍḍatdhni| kucaviṣkambhamuttabhnanniṣṭabhnātiva te smaraḥ|| patayālūni ceṣṭāsu manāṃsi gṛhayālavaḥ| yūnāmekena rūpeṇa yoṣito dāhṛsātayaḥ|| sanādhyāntāḥ pratyayadhātavaḥ, yathā mīmāṃsase na śāstrāṇi kṛtārthayasi nārthinaḥ| gopāyati na saṃtrastān kimuddhatamaṭāṭhyase|| sūryīṃyati sudhāraśmaṃ narakīyati nandane| kāmaṃ kāmayamānā tvāṃ sā jīvantī mṛtāyate|| kapolau sohitāyete bāṣpāyete visocane| priyapraṇāmakāmyantī kṛśāṅgi kasahāyase|| kaṇḍḍḍatdhvādayo nāmadhātavaḥ, yathā kaṇḍūḍḍatdhyati na yo marma nramaṇāyobṛṇīyate| urūṣyati ruṣaṃ yaḥ sa rājā rājyaṃ bhiṣajyati|| valgūyati na yo'sādhumasūyatu na sādhave| mantūyati na mānyāya mahatsu sa mahīyate|| kamiṣudhyantu yajvānaḥ kaṃ magadhyantu māgadhāḥ| kamarthimaḥ kuṣubhyantu rāme'raṇyaṃ bhuraṇyati|| kathaṃ punaḥ kaḍḍḍatdhvādirnāmadhātuśrca bhavati “dhātuprakaraṇāddhātuḥ kasya cāsañjanādhyaki| āha cāyamimaṃ dīrghaṃ manye dhāturvibhāṣitaḥ||” yebhyaḥ paripaṭhitadhātubhyo nāmatvasiddhaye nāmabhyo vā dhātutvasiddhaye kkibādipratyayā lupyante, te pratyayena nāmāni ca dhātavaśrceti pratyayanāmadhātavo hoḍaḍḍatdhgalbhaklībaprabhṛtayaḥ, yathā giro gībrrahma vāmāśīḥ śriyaḥ pratibhuvau| śatruśirmitrapūrbāhuryidhi te bandhānā sajūḥ|| hoḍaḍḍatdhse nāṅijāteṣu kkībase nābhimāniṣu| vidagdhasi na mugdheṣu nāpragalbheṣu galbhase|| savitā vidhavati vidhurapi savitarati tathā dinanti yāminyaḥ| yāminayanti dinānyapi sukhaduḥkhavaśīkṛte manasi|| evaṃ kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaghātayati, ārātri vivāsamācaṣṭe rātriṃ vivāsayati, puṣyacandrayogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa candraṃ yojayati, ujjayinyāḥ prasthito māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamaṃ prāpnoti māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryamudgamayatīti | atra “ākhyānātkṛtastadācaṣṭe” iti ṇac, “kṛlluk prakṛtipratyāpattiḥ prakṛtivañca kārakam” “āṅlopaśrca kālātyantasaṃyoge maryādāyām” “nakṣatrayoge jñi” “citrīkaraṇe prapi” iti smaryate|| prakṛtiḥ ṣaṭprakāraiṣā dhāturūpā nirūpitā| atha pratyayarūpā'pi ṣaṭprakāraiva kathyate|| pratyayā hi suptiṅakṛttaddhitadhātupratyayastrīpratyayamedāt ṣaṭprakārāḥ, tadandā prakṛtirapi pratyayarūpā ṣaṭprakāraiva bhavati | sā suppratyayāntā yathāhaṃyuḥ, śubhaṃyuḥ sāyamatanam, ciranatanam, tvayakā, mayakā, āmuṣyāṇaḥ, apsavyaḥ, prahṇetarām, pragetarām, pūrvāhṇetanam, samāṃsamānā, iti | tiṅapratyayāntā yathā pacatitarām, gacchatitamām, spṛśati rūpam, jalpatikalpam, jidhratidheśyam, paśyatideśīyam, āstikaḥ, nāstikaḥ, pacataki, bhindhaki, pacatabhṛjjatā, khādatamodatā, iti | kṛtpratyayāntā yathā kṛtrimam, bhṛtramam, sekimam, sāṅakūṭinam, sāṃrāviṇam, vyāvakrośī, vyāvahāsī, śyenaṃpātā, tailaṃpātā, jitvari, āḍhyaṃkaraṇī, iti | taddhitapratyayāntā yathā gāgryāyaṇaḥ, dākṣāyaṇaḥ, vāṣryāyaṇukaḥ, vāṣryayaṇīyaḥ, phāṇṭāhṛtāyaniḥ, ābhidityaḥ, kauñjāyaṇaḥ, kutastyaḥ, , tatratyaḥ, pacatitarām, pacatitamām, iti | dhātusaṃjñāpratyayāntā yathā tikīrṣā, kaṇṅyā, putrūyā, kāraṇā, miśraṇā, mṛdayā, aṭāṭyā, sāsahiḥ, yāyavaraḥ, yāyajūkaḥ, cikīrṣuḥ, caṅkramaṇaḥ, iti | stripratyāntā yathā gāṅgeyaḥ, saudāmeyaḥ, kārīṣagandheyaḥ, draupadeyaḥ, gaureyaḥ, śāṅrgaraveyaḥ, kādraveyaḥ, kāmaṇḍaḍḍatdhleyaḥ, yauvateyaḥ, saurabheyaḥ, bahusetrīkaḥ, suvathadhūkaḥ, iti | atha kathaṃ yauvateyaḥ iti pratyayaprakṛtāvudahṛtam? yāvatā “yūnasti” ityetasya taddhitasaṃjñayā prātipadikatvameva | satyamtat, kuṃ tu satrīsāmānyaparyāyo yuvatiśabdaḥ prakṛtyantaramasti, yathā''ha “dharmārthāṅgavidhyākālānanuparodhayan kāmasūtraṃ tadaṅgavidhyāśrca purūṣo'dhīyīta, prāgyauvanādhyuvatiḥ” iti | tasya, “yūnasti” ityetasyaiva vā “eraktinaḥ” iti vibhāṣitabhīṣo ḍhagutpattiḥ, yathā āditeyaḥ, saurabheyaḥ, iti, atha kādraveyaḥ, kāmaṇḍaḍḍatdhleyaḥ, iti katham? ṅyāporapratipadikatve'pi hi “ṅyāprātipadikāt” iti viśeṣavidhānāt, “yūnasti” ityotasya tu taddhitatvāt astu subutpattiḥ, ūṅastu pratyayatvena sāna sidhyati, samarthāñca taddhitena bhavitavyam | antavadbhāvādbhaviṣyati, tathā hi brahmavandhūrityādau “akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ” iti dvayorekatevaṃ bhavati | yadhyevaṃ “satrūbhyo ḍhak” iti ḍhak na sidhyati, so'pyādivadbhāvādbhavaliṣyati | “sā'sāya devatā” iti jñāpakādūṅutpatteḥ prageva vāsubutpattiḥ iti || uktā ṣoḍhaivameṣā'pi prakṛtiḥ pratyayātmikā| athātaḥ pratipadikarūpā ṣoḍhaiva kathyate|| || pratipadikaprakṛtiḥ|| tatra nāmāvyayānikaraṇakṛttaddhitalamāsāḥ prātipadikāni, yatāha “arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam” “kṛtetaddhisamāsāśrca” iti, tatrārthavahnrahaṇena nāmāvyayānikaraṇāni gṛhyante, kṛttaddhitasamāsāstu kaṇṭhokyā iti | nanvete'pyarthavanta eva | satyametat, kiṃ ti kṛtastaddhitāśrca pratyayāḥ, teṣāmapratyayagrahaṇātprapadikatvaṃ na prāpnotīti kṛttaddhitagrahaṇena tadupasaṃgṛhaṇāti | samāsagrahaṇena tvarthavatsamutāyasya samāsasyaiva pratipatikaśaṃti jñāpayan tathāvidhasya vākyasyaitāṃ nivartayati|| tatrānapeśritaśapadavayutatapattīni sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyāni ca nāmāni | tāni dvidhāviṣṭaliṅāni, anāviṣṭaliṅgāni ceti | teṣu jātidravyaparimāṇābhidhāyīnyāviṣṭaliṅgāni | tatra jātirddhidhākṛtivyaṅgyā, upadeśavyaṅgyā ca, tayorādhyā yathā gauḥ, mṛgaḥ, paśī, sarpaḥ, siṃhaḥ, vṛkṣaḥ, kumārī, kuṇṅam, satrī, pumān, napuṃsakam, iti | dvitīyā yathā brāhmaṇaḥ, gāgryaḥ, kaṭhaḥ, kṣatriyaḥ, baiśyaḥ, śūdraḥ, mūrdhābhiṣiktaḥ, ambaṣṭhaḥ, pāraśavaḥ, sūtaḥ, vaidehakaḥ, caṇḍālaḥ, iti | dravyaṃ dvidhā śāpekṣam, anapekṣaṃ caḥ, tayorādhyaṃ yathā gurūḥ, pitā, putraḥ, bhrātā, jāmānā, mitram, mātā, svasā, duhitā, yātā, nanāndā, bhāryā, iti | dvitīyaṃ yathā caitraḥ, maitraḥ, indraḥ, upendraḥ, sūryaḥ, kālaḥ, ākāśaḥ, prācī, praticī, śacī, laśmīḥ, iti | parimāṇaṃ dvidhāṃ niyatam, aniyataṃ ca, tayorādhyaṃ yathā droṇaḥ, kharī, palam, bhāraḥ, krośaḥ, yojanam, nipartanam, nalvaḥ, paṇaḥ, purāṇaḥ, gaṇaḥ, akṣauhiṇi, iti| dvitīyaṃ yathā śaṃghaḥ, pūgaḥ, sārthaḥ, samājaḥ, vargaḥ, śroṇiḥ, kuṭumbam, pariṣat, paṅāktiḥ, yūtham, vanam, senā, iti | guṇasaṃkhyāvacanasarvanāmānyanāviṣṭaliṅgāni, teṣu guṇo dvidhānurañjakaḥ, ananurañjakaśrca | tatrānurañjakayodāttadaniraktini yathā śrvetaḥ, svāduḥ, śīdhraḥ, mandaḥ, dīrghaḥ, hrasvaḥ, ṛjuḥ, vakraḥ, mṛduḥ, kaṭhinaḥ, yuvā, vṛddhaḥ, iti | ananurañjakayogāttadviparītāni yathā daśaḥ, jihmaḥ, jaḍaḥ, prājñaḥ, khalaḥ, sādhuḥ, snigdhaḥ, krūraḥ, śūraḥ, bhīrūḥ, laghuḥ, gurūḥ, iti | saṃkhyā dvidhā liṅgavatī, aliṅgā ceti, tayorādhyā yathaikaḥ, ekā, ekam, dvau, dve, dve, ubhau, ubhe, ubhe, trayaḥ, tistraḥ, trīṇi, catvāraḥ, catastraḥ, catvāri, iti | dvitīyā yathā pañca prātipadikārthāḥ, pañca vṛttayaḥ, pañca padajātāni, ṣaḍḍḍitdhvaṣayāḥ, ṣaḍḍḍatdhbuddhayaḥ, ṣaḍiḍḍatdhndriyāṇi, aṣṭau, vasavaḥ, aṣṭau mūrtayaḥ, aṣṭau varṇasthānāni, daśa diśaḥ, ṣoḍaḍḍatdhśa padārthāḥ, aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni, iti | sarvanāmāni dvidhā śarvādīni asarvādīni ca, teṣu ādhyāni yathā śarvaḥ, viśrvaḥ, anyaḥ, itaraḥ, katamaḥ, yaḥ, saḥ, eṣaḥ, ayam, tvam, aham, iti | dvitīyāni yathā prathamaḥ, caramaḥ, alpaḥ, katipayaḥ, pūrvaḥ, paraḥ, aparaḥ, dakṣiṇaḥ, uttaraḥ, svaḥ, antaraḥ, sakalaḥ, kṛtstraḥ iti|| prāyeṇāliṅgasaṃkhyāśaktīnyāśaktīnyavyayāni| tāni ṣoḍhāvyayanipātagatyupasargakarmapravacanīyavibhaktipratirūpabhedāt| teṣu prāyeṇa śaktisaṃkhyāyogātsvarādīnyavyayāni, yadāha “sadṛśaṃ triṣu liṅgeṣu sarvāsu ca vibhaktiṣu| vacaneṣu ca sarveṣu yanna vyeti tadavyayam||” iti| tāni dvidhā śattvagandhīni asatvagandhīni ceti | teṣu sattvagandhīni ṣoḍhā dravyarūpāṇi, guṇarūpāṇi, kriyārūpāṇi, jātirūpāṇi, saṃjñārūpāṇi, saṃbandhirīpāṇi ceti| asattvagandhīnyapi ṣoḍhaiva kriyāpokṣīṇi, kriyādravyāpekṣīṇi, kriyāviśeṣaṇāni, kriyāviśeṣaṇāni, kriyādravyaviśeṣaṇāni, kriyāviṣṭarūpāṇi, kriyādravyāviṣṭarūpāṇi ceti | tatra sattvagandhibhedeṣu dravyārūpāṇi yathā śvaḥ, divaḥ, bhuvaḥ, vihāyasā, rodasī, āpaḥ bhūḥ, ṛcaḥ, ṣam, mahaḥ, tapaḥ, hāhā, hūhū iti, giṇarūpāṇi yathā śaśrvat, āvat, nṛvat, kūpat, kuvat, sāmi, sāci, drāk, strāk, jyok, manāk, āṣat, iti, kriyārūpāṇi yathā namaḥ, svasti, svāhā, svadhā, vaṣaṭ, śrauṣaṭ, hanta, accha, vavaṃ, vave, bhāva iti, jātirūpāṇi yathā kam, śam, yoḥ, mayaḥ, sāyam, prataḥ, astam, naktam, divā, doṣā, hyaḥ, śrvaḥ, iti, saṃjñārūpāṇi yathā kkip, saḥ, om, svāhā, hnāṃ, hnīṃ, klīṃ, brūṃ, diṅ, hleṅ, ṛṅ, juṅ, duṅ, itisaṃbandhirūpāṇi yathāntāḥ, antarā, ūdhrvam, bahiḥ, pāre, madhye, samāyā, nikaṣā, ārāt, viṣvak, puraḥ, paśrcat, iti| asattvagāndhibhedeṣu kriyāpekṣīṇiyathā dvandvam, yathāyatham, mithaḥ, anyo'nyam, parasparam, itaretarām, paroparām, uttarādharam, adharottaram, ititae kriyādravyāpeśrīṇi yathā śākam, sārdham, saha, samam, amā, vinā, ṛte, pṛthak, nānā, iti, kriyāviśeṣaṇāni ddaśe viśvāya sūryam vikhye tvā harāmi, se vakṣe rāyaḥ, sen tā vāmeṣe rathānām, ase kratve dakṣāya jīvase, kasemapyevaṃrīpaḥ, svare viśeṣaḥ, adhyai kāmamupācaradhyai adhyainapyevaṃrūpaḥ, svare viśeṣaḥ, kadhyaīndrāgnī āhuvadhāyai, kadhāyain śriyadhyai, śadhyai pibadhyai vae śadhyain saha mādayadhyai, taveṅ daśame māsi sutave, taven somamindrāya pātave? suvardeṣu gantave kartave hartave, kai prayai devebhyaḥ, iṣyay apāmoṣadhīnāṃ rohiṣyai, avyathiṣyai, rohaṇāya cāvyathanāya cetyarthaḥ | tumartha eva “śaki ṇamulkamulau” agna devā vibhājaṃ nāśaknuvam | “īśvare tosunkasunau” yathāsaṃsthātorvedyaṃ sīdamanti, purā sūryasyodetorādheyaḥ, parakā vatsānāmapākartauḥ, purā pravaditoragnau hotavyam, purā pracaritorāgnīdhre hotavyam, āhotorapramattastiṣṭhati, ātamitorīpatiṣṭhate āviḍaḍḍatdhnitoḥ saṃbhavāma purā krūrasya visṛpaḥ, purā jatrubhyaḥ ātṛgaḥ | taddhiteṣvalarvavibhaktiṣu “tasilādayaḥ prākai pāśapaḥ, prāksamāsāntebhyaḥ, māntaḥ, kṛtvo'rthaiḥ, tasivatī nānāñau” iti, yathā yataḥ, tatra, iha, kva, ekadā, etarhi, adhunā, idānīm, sadyaḥ, parut, parāri, aiṣamaḥ, adya, paredyavi, pūrvedyuḥ, sarvathā, itthām, purastāt, prāk, adhaḥ, upari, upariṣṭāt, puraḥ paśrcat, dakṣiṇāt, dakṣiṇā, dakṣiṇāhi, dakṣiṇena, dakṣiṇataḥ, dvidhā, dvaidhā, dvaidham, aikadhyam, bahuśo dehi, vāsudevataḥ prati, śuklībhavati, agnisāt saṃpadyate, devatrāgacchati, paṭapaṭākaroti, paṭatitarām, bahukṛtvo bhiṅkte dvirbhuṅkte, sakṛdbhuṅkte, bahudhā bhiṅkte ādito bhavati, brāhmaṇavadbravīti, vnā devadattam, nānā devadattam iti avyayībhāvo dvidhā śattvabhūtārthaḥ, asattvabhūtārthaśca iti | tayoḥ sattvabhūtārtho yathopakumbham, sumadram, duryavanm, nirmakṣikam, niśītam, sabrahma, bahigrrāmam, supaprati, madhyesamudram, dvimuni, pañcanadam, lohitagaṅgam iti | asattvabhūtārtho yathādhistri, pratyurasam, anuratham, pratyartham, yathāśakti, sacakram, yāvadamatram, paritrigartam, āpāṭaliputram, abhyagni, , dvipari, anugaṅgaṃ vāraṇasī iti || śabdasya tādrapyeṇābhidhānamanukaraṇaṃ | yadāba vyaktāvyaktavarṇapadakyasāddaśyoktayo'nukaraṇāni| tatra vyaktavarṇasāddaśyoktiryathā chinnena patatā vahnau yanmukhena haṭhātkṛte | sveti heti hareṇokte svāhāsīt saiṣa rāvaṇaḥ|| vyaktapadasāddaśyoktiryathā gacchati vakyatumicchāmi matpriya tavatpriyaiṣiṇī | nirgacchati mukhādvām̐i mā gā iti karomi kim || vyaktavākyasāddaśyoktiryathā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ tavamasi me hṛdayaṃ dvitīyaṃ tvaṃ kaumudī nayanayoramṛtaṃ tvamaṅge | ityādibhiḥ priyaśatairanurūdhya mugdhāṃ tāmeva śāntamatha vā kimataḥ pareṇa || avyaktavarṇasāddaśyoktiryathā gate'rdharātre parimandamandaṃ garjanti yatprāvṛṣi kālameghāḥ | apaśyatū vatsamivendubimbaṃ taṃ (tat) śarvarī gauriva huṃkaroti || avyaktapadasāddaśyoktiryathā caṭañcaṭiti carmaṇi ñcimiti coñcalacchoṇite dhagaddhagiti medasi sphuṭaravo'sthiṣu ṣṭhāgiti | punātu bhavato hareramaravairirājorasi kvaṇatkarapañcarakrakacakāṣajanmānalaḥ || avyaktavākyasāddaśyoktiryathā pipipriya sasasvayaṃ mumumukhāsavaṃ dehi me tatatyaja dududrutaṃ bhabhabhabhājamaṃ kāñṭanaṃ kāñcanam | iti skhalitajalpitaṃ madapaśātkuraṅgīddaśaḥ prage hasitahetave sahacarībhiradhyaiyata || etena yāni sādhūnyarthavanti padāni, yāni ca pākyāni, yañcāśaktijamasādhu śabdarūpam, ye cāpabhraṃśāḥ, ye cānarthakā varṇāḥ, yāśrtāvyāktavarṇapadavākyoktiyaḥ, tadanukaraṇānāṃ sādhutvamupapannaṃ bhavati | nanu anukaraṇaṃ śiṣṭasya vā dānādhyayanādeḥ, aśiṣṭāpratiṣiddhasya vā hasitahikkitādeḥ sādhutvaṃ bhavati, na pratiṣiddhasya, yo hyevamasau brāhmaṇaṃ hantīti tasyanukurvana kadalīstambhaṃ chindyānna sa manye patitaḥ syāt iti | na cānukaraṇamapaśabdaḥ, anyo hyasāvapaśabdatvaprasaṅgāt | yaḥ punarevamasāvapaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte, iti tasyānukurvannapaśabdamabhidheyeṣu prayuṅkte, so'paśabdakāryeva bhavati iti || bhāvakārakābhidhāyino dhātipratyayāḥ kṛtaḥ, ṣoḍhā liṅginaḥ, anyaliṅginaḥ, svaliṅginaḥ, aliṅginaḥ, śaktyādpekṣiṇaḥ, anuprayogādyapekṣiṇaśrca | teṣu dravyavacanā aṇādayo liṅginaḥ, yathā kumbhakāraḥ, paṅkajam, dhātrī, dātram, kārūḥ, kṛkavākuḥ, iti | guṇavacanā ṇvulādayo'nyaliṅginaḥ, yathā kārakaḥ, kārikā, kārakam, darśanīyaḥ, darśanīyā, darśanīyam, iti | utpattavapekṣitaniyataliṅgāḥ “striyāṃ ktin” ityevamādayaḥ sbaliṅginaḥ, yathā paktiḥ, pacanam, pākaḥ, vrajaḥ, śayyā, suptam, iti | asattvabhūtārthatvenānupagṛhītaliṅgasaṃkhyāśaktayastumunādayo'liṅginaḥ, yathā kālo bhoktim, alaṃ kṛtvā, khalu prahṛtya, nāvagāhe, īśvaro'bhicatitoḥ, īśvaro vilikhaḥ, iti | śaktihetunallakṣyakriyādyapekṣāḥ śatrādayaḥ śaktyādyapekṣiṇaḥ, yathā vrajatā kṛtam, kriyamāṇaṃ paśya, ārjayam vasati caṅkramyamāṇo'dhīte, pakṣyam vrajati, bhojake vrajati iti apekṣitānuprayogataddhitādyanuṣaṅgāṇalulādayo'nuprayogādyapekṣiṇaḥ, yathā raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, coraṃkāramākrośati, kārayāñcakāra, kṛtrimam, vyāvakrośī, sāṃrāviṇam, iti | bhāvakārakasaṃbandhisvārthābhidhāyino'dhātupratyayāstaddhitāḥ, te ṣoḍhālepinaḥ, lopinaḥ, sarvalopinaḥ, ādeśinaḥ, pradeśinaḥ, apradeśinaśrceti | teṣu miramubandhā alopinaḥ, yathāśvakaḥ, aśvatthāmaḥ, sabhyaḥ, sakhyam, devadattarupyaḥ iti | sānubandhā lopinaḥ yathā brāhmaṇyam, mṛttikā, dākṣiḥ, vaiyākaraṇaḥ, steyam, kaidāryam, iti, yeṣāṃ luglupādibhiḥ kimap nāvatiṣṭhate, te sarvasopinaḥ, yathā gargāḥ, carakāḥ, pañcalāḥ, cañcā, gārgāī, sāmagrī, iti | yeṣāmāyannādaya ādiśyante te ādeśinaḥ, yathāitikāyanaḥ, kāpeyam, ātmanīyam, aśvīyam, kṣatriyaḥ, śāśvatikam, iti | prakṛterādimadhyaviṣṭāḥ pradeśinaḥ, yathā bahutṛṇam, bahurājā, sarvakaḥ, uñcakaiḥ, tvayakā, pacataki, iti | tasyā evāntyāvayavabhūtā apradeśinaḥ, yathā pākyavacam, pratyurasam, keśākeśi, yuvajīniḥ, sarajasam, niṣpravāṇiḥ, iti || pṛthagarthānāmekātarthībhāvaḥ samāsaḥ, sa ṣoḍhā śubantābhyām, suptiṅantābhyām, subdhātubhyām, subantanānabhyam, nāmabhyāṃ ceti | teṣu subantābhyāṃ yathopakumbham, rājapirūṣaḥ, nīlotpalam, aṣṭakapālaḥ, citraguḥ, dhavakhadirai iti | atra “samapthaḥ padavidhiḥ” iti sāmathrye sati samāsaḥ | sāmathrye ca saṃbandhaḥ | sa ca dvayorūpasarjanapradhānabhāvanaśrca dvidhābhidhīyamānaḥ, pratīyamānaśrca | abhidhīyamāno vyatirekavibhaktiḥ, yadā vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ kumbhasya samīpam, rājñaḥ purūṣaḥ, iti | tatatropakumbhamti pūrvapadapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ, rādapurūṣaḥ ityuttarapadapradhānastatpurūṣaḥ | pradhānamavicalitasvārthe prathamayaivābhidhīyate, upasarjanaṃ punaḥ pradhānānugrahāyāśritavyatirekaṃ ṣaṣṭhyādibhiḥ | idaṃ ca subanttatva eva bhavati | pratīyamānastulyavibhaktiḥ yadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nīsaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ca nīlotpalaṃ, aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃsaksṛto'ṣṭākapālaḥ, iti | ayaṃ ca “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa” iti karmadhārayaḥ, “saṃkhyāpūrvaḥ” “taddhitārtha” iti ca dvigutvaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena pratīyamānopasarjanapradhānabhāvayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye smaryate, tañca tulyavibhaktitve syāditi subantatva eva bhavati | yadā ca citrā gāvo'syetyanyapadārthaparatayā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇo bahuvirīhiḥ, tadā'pyabhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃvṛtta iti vṛttayavasthāyāṃ vākyavaiparītyena citrā gāvo'syetyupasarjanaṃ samānārthaśrcitrāṇāṃ gavāmayamiti pradhānabhāvamanubhavati, tañca ṣaṣṭhiprathamāntatavāt subanta eva syāt | yadā ca dhavaśrca khadiraśrceti pradhānayordhavasya khadirasya cetyapradhānayorvā kriyādīn pratītaretarayoge yugapadadhikaraṇavacano dvandvaḥ, tadā'pyubhayatra tulyavibhaktitvamantareṇa prādhānyamaprādhānyaṃ vā na pratīyate, tulyavibhaktitvaṃ tu dvayoḥ suvantatva eva bhavati | ataśrca sarvatra subantena saha subantaṃ samasyate iti smaryate | tiṅantābhyāṃ yathāśrnūtapibatā, khādatamodatā, pacatabhṛjjatā, unmṛjāvamṛjā, āvapanivapā, ehireyāhire, iti | atra “ākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātatye” iti mayūravyaṃsakādipāṭhāt tiṅantānāṃ samāsaḥ smaryate | aśrnīta pibatetyādi yāsu kriyāsu sātatyena vidyate, tā evamucyate | tanmadhyapatitaśrca tahnrahaṇena gṛhyate ityudādīnāṃ re ityetasya cākhyātatvaṃ bhavati |suptiṅantābhyāṃ yathāpacasi, prāvarṣat, anuvyacalat, astikṣīrā, ehivāṇujā, jahistamba, iti | atra “saha supā” ityatra tṛtīyayaiva sahārthasyākṣepe, sahagrahaṇādatiriktidyogavibhāgāśrayaṇena subantatiṅantābhyāṃ samāsaḥ kriyate | saca “naño nalopastiṅyavakṣepe” iti “udāttavatā tiṅā gatimatā ca”iti, “subadhikāre'stikṣīrādivacanam” iti, “ehīḍādayo'nyapadārthe” iti “jahi karmaṇā bahulamābhīkṣṇaye samasyate kartāraṃ cābhidadhāti” ityupapanno bhavati| tenāyamarthaḥ saṃgacchate’vakṣipto'si na pacasi tvamabhihito'pi vṛśala iti, ehi vāṇijetyāmantryamāṇavāṇijaviśiṣṭa kriyeti, jahi jahi stambamiti kartā yo'bhidhīyate sa evamucyate iti, subdhātubhyāṃ yathā śaṃgrāmayate anurīdhyete, śraddhā, antardhiḥ, paramaniyau, pratibhuvau iti | atra “saṃgrāma yuddhe, “ “anurīdha kāme” iti samastayoreva pāṭhaḥ | “ātaśrcopasarge” “upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ” ityaṅkividhāne prādajiṣu śradantarorupasaṅkhyānam, “aci śrnu dhātubhruvāṃ yvoriyaṅuvaṅau” ityādikāryasiddhaye kkibantasya pratyayanā madhātutvāddhātutvamiti sibdhātibhyāṃ samāso bhavati | subantanāmabhyāṃ yathā dadhisek, carmakrīti, dhanakrītā, brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, sarasijam, iti | atra “kagatipradayaḥ” “upapadamatiṅa” ityatrātiṅgraha menobhayasūtraśeṣatayā vyākhyāyamānena subityetasya nivṛttiḥ kriyate, “kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam” ityatra ca kartṛkaraṇayoḥ samāsavidhānāduttarapadasya kṛdantatāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ kṛhgraṇādatiriktāt tadantāvasthāyāmeva samāsābhyanujñāne supetyetadapi nivartate | tataśrca gatikārakopapadānāṃ kṛdbhiḥ saha samāsaḥ subutpatteḥ prāgeva bhavatītyākhyācam, bahulagrahaṇasya ceṣṭaddhyarthatvāt | sa kkacinnamabhyāṃ kkacit subantābhyāṃ niśrcīyate | tatra dadhisegityatrottarapadasya “sātpadādyoḥ” iti padādinibandhanaṣatvapratiṣedhasiddhaye, carmakāra ityatra tu pūrvapadasya padāntalakṣaṇanalopārtha suvantātā kriyate | carmakrītītyatra pūrvapadaṃ nalopārthameva subantam, uttarapadaṃ tu prātipadikaṃ kriyate, tena “krītāt karaṇapūrvāt” akarāntāt iti krītasya akārāntatāṃ hatvā ṅīṣaṃ pratibadhnīyāt | dhanakrītetyatra “sā hi tasya dhanakrītī prāṇebhyopi garīyasī” iti śiṣṭaprayogadarśanāduttarapadasya subutpattau ṭābutpatterākārāntatvānna ṅīṣa utpattiḥ | brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, sarasijamityatra pūrvapadayoḥ sākṣāt sipaḥ śravaṇam, uttarapadayostu prayojanābhāvadvibhakteranutpattiriti | nāmabhyāṃ yathāśvakrītī, dhanakrīti, ityetayoḥ prāgvadeva ṅīṣutpattau vibhaktyutpāttimantareṇāpi pañcakaprātipadikārthapakṣe karaṇatvāvirodhaḥ | pravāpiṇī, māṣavāpiṇī ityatra tu prāke subutpatteḥ samāse prātipadikasyānto nakāra iti “prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca iti ṇatvaṃ bhavati, subantābhyāṃ tu samāse'ntaraṅgāgatvānṅībutpattau ṅībatra nañsūryayodrdaśikriyayā saṃbandhāt parasparamasaṃbandhe sāmathryabhāvādvibhaktyabhāvaḥ, atrala hi sūryamapi na paśyantīti nañ sīryakarmikāṃ ddaśikriyāmapekṣate, na sūryasattām, “asūryalalāṭayodrdaśitapoḥ” iti vacanādasāmathrye'pi nāmnoreva samāso bhavati | etena kṛtapūrvī ityapi vyākhyātam, atrāpi hi kṛtaṃ pūrve kaṭo'neneti kṛtaśabdasya kaāpekṣāyāṃ pūrvaśabdenāsaṃbandhādasāmathryaṣa'pi “pūrvādiniḥ, “ “sapūrvāñca” iti vacanāt kṛtapūrvayorasubantayoreva samāso bhavatīti sthitam | upalakṣaṇaṃ ceha subantābhyāmityādiṣu dvivacanam, tena yathā dvābhyāṃ tathā tribhirbahubhiśrca samāso bhavati | tatrāvyayībhāvaḥ karmadhārayaśrca dvābhyām | yathādhistri, śākaprati, pañcamrāḥ, puruṣavyāghraḥ, iti | ṣaṣṭhilakṣaṇaḥ kālaparimāṇalakṣamaśrca tatpuruṣo dvābhyāṃ tribhiśrca | yathā rājagavīkṣīram, rājagokṣīram, dvyahajātaḥ, dvyahnajātaḥ, ita | atra yadā rājñatro gauḥ rājagavī tasyāḥ kṣīramiti, tadā dvābhyām, yadā tu rājño goḥ kṣīraṃ rājagokṣīramiti, tadā tribhiḥ | taduktam “rājagavīkṣīre dvisamāsaprasaṅgaḥ, dviṣaṣṭhibhāvāt, siddhaṃ tu rājaviśiṣṭāyā goḥ kṣīreṇābhisaṃbandhāt” rājagavīkṣīram, rājagokṣīramiti ca | nanu ca, goḥ kṣīraṃ gokṣīram, rājño gokṣīraṃ rājagokṣīramiti, dvitīyapakṣe bhaviṣyati, naivam, arthabhedāt, yathaivāyaṃ gavi yatate na mahiṣyāderapi kṣīramātreṇa tiṣyati, evaṃ rājanyapi yatate rājño yā gauḥ, tasyā yat kṣīramiti, tañcaivaṃ na sidhyati, evaṃ hi yataḥ kutāśrcidāgataṃ gokṣīramātraṃ rājñaḥ saṃbandhi pratīyate | kathaṃ punargoḥ kṣīramapyapekṣamāṇāyāśrca rājñā rājanamapyapekṣamāṇāyāśrca kṣīreṇa samāsaḥ? ucyate na gauḥ piradhānatvāt tathā rājānamapekṣate, yathā upasarganatvena gāṃ rājāḥ, kṣīramapyavicalitasvārthatvādanautsukyena na tathā gāmapekṣate, yathodbhūtasaṃbandhavayātirekatvādautsukyena gauḥ kṣīram | evaṃ cānukūlye gamakatvāt pradhānasāpekṣatve sati samāso bhavatyeva, yathā devadattagurukulam, rājaruṣabhāryā, iti | taduktam “bhavati vai pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ” iti | evaṃ dve ahanī samāhṛte dvyahaḥ, dvyaho jātasyeti yadā samāsaḥ tadā dvābhyām, yadā tu dve ahamī jātasya dvyahnajāta iti tadā tribhiḥ | “sup supā” iti vacanāddvayoreva samāsa iti cet, na, “kālāḥ parimāṇinā” iti bahuvacananurdiśāt”sup supā” ityesmin guṇapade'pi saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate, tena triṣvapi padeṣu samāsābhyanujñāne, dviśabdasyāpi kālasaṃkhyāyakatvena kālābhidhāyitve dve ahanī jātasyeti vigṛhya jātena parimāṇinā dviśabdāhaḥ śabdau kālābhidhāyinau samasyete | pūrvasya padasyottarapadanimittāyāstatpuruṣasaṃjñāyāḥ pravartanāt “na saṃkhyādeḥ samāhāre” iti pratibedhābāvāt “ahno'hna etebhyaḥ “ iti samāsāntasiddhau dvyahnajāta iti vivakṣitarīpasiddhiḥ | atha rājagokṣīramityatrāpi kathaṃ na samāsāntaḥ? gośabdasya yugapat pūrvottarapadāpekṣāyamasāmathryāt | dvyahnajātaḥ ityatrāpi tulyamiti cet, tanna, ittarapadayoga eva dvigorāmrānāt | api ca, dve abanī iti dve api prathamānte, rājño goriti dve api ṣaṣṭhyente, asati ca prathamāntaṣaṣṭhyāntayorviśeṣaḥ prathamāntaṃ hyanupajātavyatirkatvānnirautsukyaṃ nānyadapekṣate, ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ punarudbhūtavyatirekatvāte paropakārāyautsukayena pravartamānaṃ nānavāpyopakarye viramati | evaṃ ca sāpekṣatvādasāmathryo samāsaḥ kathamiti cet, gamakatvāt, yathā śīryamapi na paśyantyasūryepaśyā rājadārāḥ, na punargīyante apumargeyāḥ śrlokāḥ, kṣādvaṃ na bhuṅkte aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, aśūdrānnabhojī, evamalavaṇabhojī, ekānnaviṃśatiḥ, yathāvatapte nakulasyeva sthitamavataptenakulasthitaṃ tavaitaditi | bahuvrīhidvanddhau dvābhyāṃ tribhirbahubhiśrca yathā citraguḥ kaṇṭhekālaḥ, hlakṣanyagrodhau, pāṇipādam, pañcagavadhanaḥ, mattabahumātaṅgam, śaṅkhadundubhivīṇāḥ? , dhavakhadirapalāśam, iti | atra “anekamanyapadārthe” bahuvrīhiḥ, “cārthe dvandvaḥ” iti ca smṛtiḥ, uktaṃ ca susūśrmajaṭakeśena sunatājinavāsasā| samantaśitirandhreṇa dvayorvṛttau na sidhyati || dvandvo yāvadbhirārabdhāḥ prādhānyaṃ tatra tāvatām | itaretarayoge syāt samāhāre tu saṃhateḥ || nanu ca, śobhanāḥ suśmā jaṭāḥ keśā asya, śobhanam ntamajinaṃ vāso'sya, sañjātānyanteṣu śitirandhrāṇyasyeti karmadhārayādigarbhā ete bahuvrīhayaḥ, tatra susūkṣmajaṭakeśena sunatājinavāsasetyetayormadhyapadasyottarapadena pūrvapadena vā karmadhārayam, antyasya tūttarapadenaiva saptamītatpuruṣaṃ vidhāya dvayerapi vṛttau bahuvrīhiḥ kasmānna kriyate | ucyate pūrvayoḥ pūrvapadena karmadhārayānupapattiḥ, asāmānādhikaraṇyāte, nahi dvayorapi viśeṣaṇayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati | uttareṇa tu “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa” iti sāmānādhikaraṇye bhavati karmadhārayaḥ, kiṃ tu na taduttarakālamanyapadārthe nvakṣitārthasiddhiḥ, tathā hi sati, sūkṣmajaṭāsaṃbandhanibandhanameva keśānāṃ śobhanatvamupalabhyate na tu svābhāvikam, natinimittameva cājinavāsasaśrcārutvaṃ gamyate na tu naisargikam | antye pumaranteṣu ityetasya sāpekṣatvādasāmathrya sati nottarapadena saptamītatpuruṣaḥ, anteṣu śitirandhrāṇi iti hyukte, kasyānteṣvityapekṣyaṃ syāt, tañca śityartha utpadyamāne bahuvrīhāvevavopapannaṃ bhavati sañcātānyanteṣu sūkṣmacchidrāṇysyeti, na pumastatpuruṣe | nanu ca, ddaśyate dvayorapi viśoṣaṇātve ca samāsaḥ, tadyathā khañcaśrcāsau kubjaśrca khañjakubjaḥ, bhrāturbhāryā devadattasyeti | uktamatrācāryaiḥ | kimuktam? kasya cit khañco nijrñātaḥ kasya cit kubja iti pradhāvopalarjanabhāvādbhavatyeva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, api ca saṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ pravartate | svārthavatsā vyapekṣā'sya vṛttāvapu na hīyate || yathā pituḥ pitā pitāmaho devadattasyeti| iha tu sūkṣmajaṭa ityetadnyapadārtha evāmnāyate, natamityedapi kriyābhidhāyitvena guṇavacanatvādaiśritameva bhavati | su ityetatpunarakhyayaṃ śobhanārthe vartamānaṃ samasyate, tasya cāstāṃ dravyavacanatvam, guṇavacanatve'pi vipratitipattiḥ, avyayānāmasattvārthavācitvāt | kecit punastatrāpi vivadante dyotakā hi kilaite na vācakā iti, samāsaśrca “sup supā” it dyotakānāmapi bhavati | mā bhūta pūrvayoḥ karmadhārayaḥ, antye punarantaśabdasya saṃbandhiśabdatvena bhrātṛbhāryadivat kathaṃ na tatpuruṣaḥ? uycate yadyapi saṃvandhiśabdāḥ sāpeśratve'pi samasyante, tathā'pi yatra saṃdehaviparyāsādayo na jāyante tatraiva tadutpattiḥ, atra tvantaśitirandhrāṇītyukte sandehaḥ kimanteṣu śitirandhrāṇyasya, uta antaśitinīrandhrāṇi iti | atha yadā suṣṭhu sūkṣmajaṭāḥ keśāḥ keśāḥ asyeti vigrahaḥ, tadā bhavitavyaṃ pūrvapadayoḥ karmadhārayeṇa | na bhavitavyam | kiṃ kāraṇam? svare doṣaḥ syāt, bahuvrīhau pūrvapadaprakatṛtisvaraṃ bādhitvā samāsasyānta udātta ityantaṅgatvādavayavasamāsasvaraḥ prapnoti, tadāha susūśrmajaṭakeśādau samāsāvayavo yadi | syātsyāttatrāntaraṅgatvādvādhako'vayavasvaraḥ || na ceṣyate | kā punaratra karmadhārayabādhāyāmupapattiḥ? “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam” iti bahulagrahaṇameva, uktaṃ ca yā sāmāyāśrayā saṃjña viśeṣaviṣayā ca yā | bahulagrahaṇānnāsti pravṛttirūbhayostayoḥ || ataśrca yatra dve api viśeṣasaṃjño, tatrottarapade nityameva dvigudrvandvaśrca samāso bhavati, taddayathā pañcadavapriya iti, chatropānahapriya iti | yatra kiñcatsāmānyaṃ kaśrciñca viśeṣaḥ, tatra vikalpena, yathā rājagavīkṣīram, rājagokṣīram iti | yatraikataḥ sāmānyamanyato viśeṣaḥ, tatra na bhavatyeva, yathā śusūkṣmajaṭakeśena sunatājinavāsasā, iti, atra bahuvrīhiriti viśeṣasaṃjñāyāmavayoḥ “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam” iti yā samāsasaṃjñā sā “supsupā” iti tatpuruṣādibhedāparānarśena bhavanti sāmānyasaṃjñotyucyate | nanu “dvandvatatpuruṣayoruttarapade nityasamāsavacanam” iti mabāvārtikakāraḥ, ayamapi ca tatpuruṣa eveti kasmādihāpi samāso na bhavati? uttatarapadopādānāt uttarapada evāmnāyate so'tra tattapuruṣo grahūtavyaḥ, yathā dvyahnajātaḥ, pañcagavadhanaḥ iti | dvandvaḥ puranuttarapada eveti bahuvrīhiviśayeṇottarapadena sarva eva gṛhyate | kimarte punarvamucyate yāvatā bahulagrahaṇenaiva siddham? samudāyavṛttāvavayavāmāṃ mā kadācidavṛttirbhūditi | tathāpi na vaktivyam, iha dvau pakṣau vṛttipakṣaśrca avṛttipakṣaśrca, yadā vṛttiḥ tadā sarveṣāṃ vṛtti, yadā tu na vṛttiḥ tadā sarveṣāmavṛttiḥ iti | naivam, astyatra viśeṣaḥ, tathāhi pañcagavapriya ityādau nāsya pañcasaṃkhyāmātraṃ priyaṃ nāpi gomātram, kiṃ tarhi pañcasaṃkhyopalakṣitāḥ kāśrcideva gāvaḥ, yathā pañcāmrāḥ saptarṣayaḥ, iti | tañca dvigau pūrvamasati durupapādameva bhavati | etena chatropānahapriya ityādau nāsya pañcasaṃkhyāmākṣaṃ priyaṃ nāpi gomātram, kiṃ tarhipañcasaṃkhyopalakṣitāḥ kāśrcideva gāvaḥ, yathā pañcāmrāḥ saptarṣayaḥ, iti | tañca dvigau pūrvamasati durupapādameva bhavati | etena chatropānahapriya ityetadapi vyākhyātam, tatrāpi yugapadadhikaraṇavacanadvandvamantareṇa nābhivāñchitasiddhiḥ | na hyasyo pānanmātrameva priyam, api tu chatramapi, upānacchabdādeva ca paraḥ priyaśabdo niśamyamānaḥ na dvandvaṃ vinā chatramupagrahītuṃ śaknoti | tasmādanākṣepa iti | susūkṣmajaṭakeśādinā ca mattabahumātaṅkaṃ vanam ityadāvapyanekameva padamityiktaṃ bhavati | atrāpi mattabahumātaṅgā ityāpi na bhavati | kiṃ kāraṇam? “bahugaṇavatuḍaḍḍatdhti saṃkhyā” iti bahuśabdasya saṃkhyāvācitvāt, saṃkhyāpūrvasya ca karmadhārayasya dvigutvāt, dvigoḥ punaḥ taddhitārthottarapadasamāhoreṣveva bhāvāt, yathā pañcakapālaḥ, trilokahamryam, pañcapūlī iti | kathaṃ tarhi saptarṣayaḥ, pañcāmrāḥ iti | “diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyām” iti saṃjñāyāmeva tadbhavati | nanu ca nābhūttaddhitārthaḥ uttarapadaṃ vā, tathā'pi bahumātaṅgamiti samāhāre bhaviṣyati bahavo mātaṅgāḥ samāhṛtāḥ bahumātaṅgam, tataśrca mattaṃ bahumātaṅgamasminvane tanmattabahumātaṅgaṃ vanamiti bahuvrīhirbhaviṣyati | ucyatātha samāhāra iti kaḥ śabdārthaḥ? nanu samāṅpūrvāddharateḥ karmaṇi ghañ samāhriyata iti samāhāraḥ | yadyevaṃ pañca kumāryaḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcakumāri, daśakumārīti “gostriyorupasarjanasya “ iti hasvatvaṃ na prāpnoti| samāsārthasyānekatvāt, “dvigurekavacanam” ityetadapi vaktavyaṃ bhavati | evaṃ tarhi bhāvasādhano bhaviṣyati samāharaṇaṃ samāhāra iti | atha bhāvasādhanena kimabhidhīyate? yattadauttarādharyam | kaḥ punaḥ pañcadavaṃ pañcapūlī, ityādau gavādīnāṃ samāhāraḥ? yattadārjanaṃ, krayaṇam, bhīkṣaṇam, avaharaṇam vā | yadyevaṃ vikṣipteṣu pūleṣu carantīṣu goṣu na sidhyati | tarhi samabhyāśīkaraṇaṃ samāhāraḥ | evamapi pañcagrāmī, ṣaṇṇagarī, ityāderanupapattiḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam? abhyāśīkaraṇaṃ samāhāraḥ| śabde samiti samantādityabhividhau vartate, āṅābhimukhye, haratirdaśāntaraprapaṇe iti | nāvaśyaṃ haratirdeśāntaraprāpaṇe eva vartate | kiṃ tarhi? sāddaśye'pi māturamuharati, pituranuparatīti | atha vā pañcagrāmī, ṣaṇṇagarīti nedamiyatyevāvatiṣṭhate, avaśyaṃ hyasau tataḥ kiñcidākāṅkṣati, kriyāṃ guṇaṃ vā, yadākāṅkṣati tadekaṃ samāhāra iti | ayaṃ tarhi, bhāvasādhane sati doṣaḥ pañcapūlī ānīyatāmiti dravyasyānayanaṃ na prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, tadyāthā gauranubandhyo'jo'grnīṣomīya iti jātau coditāyāṃ tatrāsaṃbhavādālambhanaprokṣaṇaviśasanādīna dravye bhavanti, ihāpi bhāvāvayanasyāsaṃbhavāddravyasyānayanaṃ bhaviśyati, avyatirekādvā na hi samūhibhyaḥ samāhāralakṣaṇaḥ samūho vyatirikto bhavati| evaṃ tarhi bahumātaṅgamiti samāhāre, eṣa doṣo bhavati “akārāntottarapado daviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyete” iti pañcapūlīvadūkārāntatvaṃ prāpnoti, na vā'yaṃ pātrādiṣu paṭhyate, yena cakuspātratribhuvanādivattanniṣedho bhaviṣyati, nāpyāhantaḥ, yena pañcakhaṭvī pañcakhaṭvam ityādivādvikalpo'vakalpeta | nanu ca dvigāvapīkāro na ddaśyate, yathā ekaputraḥ ekabhikṣeti | nāyaṃ dvigūḥ | kiṃ tarhi? “pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇa” ityādinā karmadhārayaḥ | kiṃ ca boḥ saṃkhyāpūrvo'pi dvigurna bhavati? bāḍham, tasya tadvitārthottarapadasamāhāreṣveva bhāvāt | na ceha tadvitārtha uttarapadaṃ vā vigadyate, na caikasya samāhāraḥ saṃbhavati | yadā tu sāmathryatiśayādekasminnapi samūhāropaṇaṃ, tadā bhavatyeva, yathā ekāpūpī ekaśācīti | kiṃ punardvigusaṃjñā pratyayottarapadayorbhavati? evaṃ tāvat | etarhītaretarāśrayatvādaprasiddhiḥ | kathamitaretarāśrayatvam? dvigunimitte pratyayottarapade pratyayotarapadanimittā ca dvigusaṃjñeti | evaṃ tarhi, artha iti vakṣyāmi | arthe cettaddhitānutpattiḥ vahuvrīhivat, tatra yathā citraguḥ śabalaguḥ iti bahuvrūhiṇoktatvānmatvāttakaddhitotpattirna prāpnoti | yatheṭacchasi tathā'stu, astu tāvat prayayottarapadoriti | nanuktamitaretarāśrayatvādaprasiddhiriti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, nedaṃ tulyamanyairitaretarāśrayaiḥ, śabdānityatvāt | nanu ca na saṃjñā nityā, kiṃ tarhi? śabdāḥ | yadyevaṃ bhāvinī saṃjñāvijñāsyate, tadyathā kaśrcittantuvāyamāha, asya sūtrasya śāṭakaṃ vayeti, sa paṣyati yadi śāṭako na vātavyaḥ, atha vātavyo na śāṭakaḥ, śāṭako vātavyaśrceti vipratiṣiddham, bhāvini tu khalvasya saṃjñābhipretā, sa manyate vātavyaṃ yasminnate śāṭaka ityetadbhanatīti | evamihāpi tasmin dvigurbhavati yasyābhinirvṛttasya pratyayaḥ uttarapadamityete saṃjñe bhaviṣyata iti | athavā punarastvartha iti | nanu coktamarthe cettaddhitānutpattiḥ bahuvrīhiditi | naiṣa doṣaḥ, nāvasyamarthaśabdo'bhidheya eva vartate, kiṃ tarhi? syādarthe'pi, tadyathā dārārthe dvigurbhavati, taddhitaḥ syāditi | dvigorvā lugvacanaṃ jñapakam, yadayaṃ “dvigorluganapatye” iti dvigostaddhitasya lukaṃ śāsti, tajjñāpayaty utpadyate dvigostaddhita iti | yadyevaṃ samāhārasamūhayoraviśeṣāt samāhāragrahaṇamanarthakam, “tasya samūhaḥ” iti taddhitārthenaivakṛtatvāt, tathā hi samāhāraḥ samuha ityāviśiṣṭāvetāvarthau, tatra samūha iva samāhāro'pi taddhitārthe dviguḥ ityeva bhaviṣyati | yadi taddhitārthe dvigurbhavatītyucyate, taddhitotpattiḥ prāpnoti | utpadyatām lugbhaviṣyati | lukkṛtāni prāpnuvanti | kāni punakastāni? pañcapūlī daśapūlī iti, , “na taddhitaluki” iti ṅīppratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti, pañcagavaṃ daśagavamiti “gorataddhitaluki” iti ṭac na prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, aviśeṣeṇa dvigoḥ ṅīp bhavatītyuktvā aparimāṇabiktācitakambalyebhyaḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi, aviśeṣeṇa ca goṣṭac bhavatītyuktvā dvigoḥ samāhāre iti vakṣyāmi, tadubhayamapi niyamārthe bhaviṣyati samāhāra eva nānyatreti | evaṃ tarhi, abhidhānārthe samāhāragerahaṇam, samāhoreṇābhidhānaṃ yathā syāte na taddhitārthena | yadi syāt ko doṣaḥ syāt? taddhitotpattiḥ prasaḍaḍḍatdhjyeta | prasajyatām, lugbhaviṣyati | lukkṛtāni prāpnruvanati |sarvāṇi parihṛtāni | na sarvāṇi parihatāni, pañcakumāri daśakumārīti “luk taddhitaluki” iti ṅīpo luk pralajyata iti | nanu ca yadi taddhitārthe dviguḥ ityucyate pañcakhaṭvaḥ daśakhaṭvaḥ iti matvarthe'pi dvigusaṃjñāyāṃ “dvigoḥ” itīkāraḥ prāpnoti | bahuvrīhisaṃjñayā dvigusaṃjñāyā bādhitatvānna bhaviṣyati, samānādhikaraṇānāṃ matvarthe bahuvrīhirbhavati | yadyuttarapade dvigurityicyate, uttarapadoktirvaktavyā | iyamucyate “uttarapadena parimāṇinā dvigoḥ samāsavacanam”, dovau māsau ḍātasya dvimāsajātaḥ, dve ahanī jātasya dvyahnajāta iti | kimucyate parimāṇinaiveti, na punaranyatrāpi, tadyathā pañcagavapriyaḥ pañcagavadhana iti | anyatra samudāyasya bahuvrūhitvādittarapadaṃ prasiddhameva, tathā hi “anekamanyapadārthe” samasyate, bahuvrīhiśrca samāso bhavati | atha dvandvasya kā vārtā? dvandvo'grato viśeṣeṇa vyākariṣyata iti | atha bahubhirbahuvrīhiḥ “cañcadbhujabhramiticaṇḍaḍḍatdhgadābhighātasaṃcūrṇitoruyugalasya” iti| tatra cañcadbhyāṃ bhūjābhyāṃ bhramitāyāśrcaṇḍāyā gadāyāḥ abhighātena saṃmacūrṇitamūsyugalamasyeti vigrahaḥ | na caitadvācyaṃ samānādhikaraṇānāmeva bahuvrīhiḥ, “saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau” iti jñāpakena vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi bahuvrīheḥ smaraṇāt | etena sarvapadapradhāno dvandvo'pi vyākhyātaḥ, yathā “sūryānalānilahimāṃśudhaneśaśakrapretādhināthāvaruṇaāḥ karuṇāspadaṃ naḥ |” iti || nanu ca anyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ smaryatte, tatra citragurdevadattaḥ iti devadattāderanuprayogo na prāpnoti, na hi caitrādiśabdaprayogādavadhṛteṣu caitrādiṣu punaśrcaitrādiśrutayaḥ prayujyante | naivam, citraguśabdaḥ citragamīnāṃ svāmisāmānyamabhidhatte, tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣārthinā viśeṣo'nuprayoktavyaḥ | citraguḥ kaḥ? denadatta iti, yatra tvasādhāraṇaviśeṣaṇādibhirviśeṣa eva samāsaḥ tatrānuprayogo na bhavatyeva, yathā citragu sarvam, citragu viśvam, iti | sāmānyamapi yathā viśeṣaḥ, tathā hi yathā citrā gāvo'sya devadattasyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthasya samāsenādhināt ṣaṣṭhī nānuprayujyate, saṃbandhī tu na samāsopādāna ityanuprayujyate | evaṃ tarhi, vibhaktyarthābhidhāyino bahuvrīhipadasya devadattādibhipdravyavacanaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti | matublopādbhaviṣyati | maivam, matipo'pi saṃbandharthatvāt dravyavacanairasāmānādhikaraṇyameva | na ca bahuvrīheḥ vibhaktyarthābhidhāyino matupo'pi vidhātuṃ śakyate, sa hi prathamāsamarthādastyupādhirvidhāyate, na ca vibhaktayarthavṛttepbahuvrūhipadasyāstyādikriyābhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃbandho bhavati| atha, abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapatsyate | tanna, abhihito'pyasau yato yatretyādivanna svarūpaṃ hāsyati | evaṃ tarhi, yathā jātau padārthe jāteḥ kāryamucyamānamasaṃbhavāc tatsahacaritāsu vyaktiṣu niviśate, tathā bahuvrīhyarthe saṃbandhe sāmānādhikaraṇyākriyāyogādikārye prayujyamānaṃ tadāśraye bhavipyati, evaṃ ca so'yamityupacaritasaṃbandheṣu saṃbandhiṣu bahuvrīhipadairabhidhīyamāneṣu, śuklādiviśeṣaṇānāmivāśrrayato liṅgavacanānyapi na virotsyante | yadi vā, avanyapadārtha ityarthagrahaṇasāmatharthāt sadravyasya saliṅgasya sasabhkhyasya copādānaṃ bhaviṣyati, na vibhaktyarthamātrasya | kathaṃ punararthaśabdopādānādayamartho labhyate? śrūyatām anyapada itiyatyucyamāne pade vṛttyasaṃbhavāt padasahataritāṃ yāṃ kāṃcirthamātrāṃ padaśabdo laśayet, padatvasya vā nimittatavena pratyāsannopakariṇaṃ vibhaktyarthe pratyāyayet, so'yamevaṃ sicajaddhe samīhite, yadarthagrahaṇaṃ karoti tenaitat jñāpayati yāvānarthaśruteḥ padaviṣayo'rthaḥ paricchedāyopādīyate, arthā hi prakṛtyādīnāṃ sāmānyena prasaktāḥ padenāvacchidyante padāvadhiko'rtha upādeya iti, tatrayathā vākyārthasyānāśrayaṇamādhikyāt tathā padārthaikadeśasyāpi, nyunatvāt | tadevamarthagrahaṇasāmathryāt saliṅgaḥ sasaṅkhyaḥ sadravyaśrca samarthaḥ padārthaḥ upādīyate, tathā saṃkhyābhidhāyinaḥ svādayaḥ liṅgābhidhāyinaṣṭābādayo vā na prayujyet, tathā saṃkhyābhidhāyinaḥ svādayaḥ liṅgābhidhāyinaṣṭābādayo vāna pratyajyen | ucyata ekādipadairiva vṛttipadairabhihitā'pi na saṃkhyā saṃkhyākārye kavighnayiṣyati, na hi ṣaṣṭhyadividhāna iva vacanavidhāvanabhihitādhikāro vidyate, karmādayaśrca kārakaviśeṣāḥ pratyayayitavya ityavaśyavidheyā dvitīyādayaḥ, prathamā tu vacanagrahaṇasāmarthayāt na kevalā prakṛtḥ prayoktavyā iti samayādvā prāthamkakalpikī bhaviṣyati | syādetat, yathā abhihitā ekātvādayo vacanavyavasthānimittaṃ tathaā'bhihitaḥ saṃbandho'pi ṣaṣṭhinimittaṃ bhavati | tadayuktam, anabhihitādhikarāt | api ca, saṃbandhopasarjanaṃ prātipadikārthovṛttiśabdenābhidhīyate, na cāyaṃ ṣaṣṭhīviṣayaḥ, tasyāḥ prātipadikārthopalarjane saṃbandhe vidhānāt| ṭābādayastu svārthikatvādabhihite'pi liṅge bhavanti, taduktam “siddhaṃ tu striyāḥ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇatvāt svārthe ṭābadayaḥ” iti | yadi vānya eva vākyārtho vṛttayarthāt, tathā hi citrā gāvo'syetyanyapadārthopasarjanāśrcitragavyo vakyenābhidhīyante, citraguriti punarvṛttau gavārthopasarjanasvāmīpratīyate, tatrala yadā nijrñātaparādhīnatānāṃ svāmiviśeṣāvacchedāyānyapadārtha upādīyate asyaitā gāva iti, tadā bahuvrīhirna bhavati, yadā tu tāśrcitrā gāvaḥ svāmino viśeṣābhidhānāya pratyavamṛśyante titragavīnāmāsāmayaṃ svamīti, tadā bahuvrīhirbhavaticitraguḥ śabalaguriti, tāmeva ca svāmiviśeṣaṇatāṃ sphaṭamudarśayanto nidarśayanti yasya citrā gāvaḥ sa citraguḥ, yasya śabalāḥ sa śabalaguriti | upalakṣaṇaṃ cātra ṣaṣṭhī, tena karmakartṛparavacanenāprathamāyā api bahuvrīhirvaktavya ūḍho ratho'nena ūḍharatho'naḍḍḍatdhvān, uddhṛtaḥ odanaḥ asyāḥ uddhṛtaudanā sathālī, upahṛtaḥ paśuḥ asmai upahṛtapaśū rūddhaḥ sādhako'nayā siddhāsādhakā vidyeti | atha aprathamāyā iti kimartham? iha mābhūd vṛṣṭe deve gata iti | atheha kasmānna bhavati vṛṣṭe deve gataṃ paśyeti? bahiraṅgā'trāprathamā | yadyevaṃ ṣaṣṭhyādyantaraṅgatve citragordevadattasyetyādau punaḥ ṣaṣṭhyādayaḥ, tathā yato yatretyādibhyaḥ pañcamīsaptamyadayo'pi kasmānna bhavanti? utyate tasiltralādibhiḥ pañcamīsaptamyādīnāmabhihito'rtho'nantarbhūtaḥ | citraguprabhṛtiṣu tu bahuvrīhiṇābhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti | atheha bahuvrūhiḥ kasmānna bhavati pañcabirbhuktamasya? bahuvrīhiḥ samānādhikaraṇānāmeveti smaraṇāt | yadyavam, astikṣīrā, uñṭairmukhaḥ, abhāryaḥ, praparṇaḥ, uṣṭgramukhaḥ, candravadanā, keśacūḍaḍḍatdhḥ, suvarṇālaṅkāraḥ, candraśeśaraḥ, śūlapāṇiḥ, kaṇṭhekālaḥ, urasilomti bahuvriīhisaṃjñā na prāpnoti, tathā hy ādyeṣu caturṣu pūrvapadamavyayam, tasyāstatvacitvāt sattvabhūtaiḥ kṣīrādibhiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāsti, madhyeṣvapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabāvānupapatterna sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ghaṭate, antyeṣu tu saptamyantaprathamāntayorasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyaktameveti | naivam, eteṣvapi sāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ | tatrāstīti nipāto vibhaktipratirūpa iti kālaṃ puruṣaṃ saṃkhyāṃ sādhanaṃ ca na vyabhicarati, uñcaiḥśabdasyāpi sattvavacatvaṃ ddaśyate “kiṃ punaryastathoñcaiḥ” iti, ata eva etābhyāmasthitavibhāṣayā vṛttiviṣaye draṣṭavyaḥ, tenāyamarthaḥ saṃpadyate’sti kṣīramasyāḥ astikṣīrā gauḥ, uñcramukhamasya iñcairmukho maitreyaḥ, avidyamānā bhārya asya abhāryaḥ avidyamānabhāryo vā, prapatitāni parṇāni asya praparṇaḥ, prapatitaparṇo vā| uṣṭramukhaḥ candravadanā ityetayostu uṣṭracandraśabdau bhūyo'vayavasāmānyayogātiśayādabhedopacareṇa mukhaviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavantau gauṇīṃ vṛttimanubhavataḥ| nanu kimuṣṭramukhayormithaḥ sāddaśyam? uṣṭraśabdenehoṣṭramukhabhidhīyate, avayave'pyavayavivadupacāro draṣṭavyaḥ iti | keśacūḍaḍḍatdhḥ suvarṇālaṅkāraḥ ityetayostu keśaśabdo vartate, suvarṇavikāre tu suvarṇaśabdaḥ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | candraśekharaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ ityatra candraśūlopalakṣitau śekharapāṇī candraśūlaśabdābhidheyau, yathā kuntāni praveśaya, yaṣṭīḥ praveśayeti | kaṇṭhekālaḥ urasilomā ityatayostu kaṇṭhe sthitāḥ kālāḥ asyaḥ, urasi jātānu lomānyasyeti padāntaramadhyāhriyate, yathā dvāraṃ dvāram ityakte apāvriyatāṃ saṃvriyatāṃveti | etena “subadhikāre astikṣīretyupasaṃkhyānam” “avyayānāṃ bahuvrīhirvaktavyaḥ” “saptamyupamānapūrvapadasyottarapadalopaśrca” “samudāyavikāraṣaṣṭhyaśrca” “prādibhyo dhātujasya vā” ityapi na vaktavyaṃ bhavati | nanu parigaṇanārthamapyetadavaśyaṃ vaktavyam, naivam, kriyamāṇe'pi bi parigaṇane yatrābhidhānaṃ nāsti na tatra samānādhikaraṇānāmapi bahuvrīhiḥ, tadyathā pañca bhuktavanto'syeti | evaṃ tarhi matvarthagrahaṇaṃ kariṣyate samānādhikaraṇānāṃ matnarthe bahuvrīhirbhavatīti, tathā'pi, ūḍho ratho'nena ūḍharatho'naṅvān, dakṣiṇasyaśrca pūrvasyāśrca diśo yadantarālaṃ sā dakṣiṇapūrvā, putreṇa saha saputraḥ, keśeṣu keśeṣu ca gṛhītvā pravṛttaṃ yuddhaṃ keśākeśi, daṇḍaiḍḍatdhśrca daṇḍaiḍḍatdhśrca prahṛtya daṇḍādaṇḍi, trirdaśaite tridaśāḥ, ityevamādibhivyāptireva | tasmātsudūramapi gatvā'bhidhānamevāśrayitavyam, abhidhānalakṣaṇā hi kṛttaddhitasamāsā iti kṛtaṃ parigaṇanena | atha tridaśā iti ko'sya vigrahaḥ? trirdaśaite tridaśā iti | “saṃkhyāsamāse sujantasya saṃkhyetyparasiddhiḥ iti, na hi sujantā saṃkhyā'sti | astu tahryavaṃ vigrahas trayo daśata ete tridaśā iti | evamapyatkārāntasya saṃkhyetyaprasiddhiḥ, na cātra samāse sucaṃ paśyāmaḥ | kiṃ tarhi? vākye | kutaḥ punaretadvākye suc ddaśyate? abhihitatvāt, abhihitaḥ sujarthaḥ | kena? samāsena | kiṃ ca bhoḥ khujarthe samāsa ucyate? naivam, sāmathryādiha sujartho gamyate | katham? yāvatā saṃkhyayate, sa ca kriyābhyavṛttyartha uktaḥ samāseneti kṛtvā suj na bhaviṣyati “|| prakṛtiḥ prātipadikarūpā'pyeṣopavarṇitā| svarūpaṃ pratyayādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthagathocyate|| tatra pratīyate anenārtha iti pratyayaḥ, sa tridhā dhātupratyayaḥ, pratyayapratyayaḥ, prātipadikapratyaya iti | teṣu sanādayaḥ, tununādaya, tavyādayaḥ, ṇvulādayaḥ, uṇādayaśrceti dhātupratyayabhedāḥ | tatra icchāpratyajakavyapārādajikriyāsu kriyāsamabhihārādiṣu ca ye vidhiyamānāḥ kriyāvacanatvāt bhūvādivadeva pratyayāntaramapekṣante te sanādayaḥ, yathā cikīrṣati, adhyāpayati, pāpacyate, gopāyati, ṛtīyate, kāmayate, iti | kriyāpradhānāḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kriyāyāṃ ca ye vihitāḥ sādyarūpāpannakriyābhidhiyitvena pratyayāntaraṃ nāpekṣante te tibādayaḥ, yathā vrajati devadattaḥ, pacyate odanaḥ, rajyati vastram, sūyeta kedāraḥ, corasya rujati, āsyate yuṣamābhiḥ iti | anupāttakramakriyābhidhāyino'sattvabhūtārthāḥ sādhyabhāve ye vidhīyante te tumunādayaḥ, yathā paktumicchati, bhaktvā vrajati, adhītya strnāti, pāyaṃpāyamāste, coraṃkāramākreśati, cakāsāñcakāra iti | prayeṇa bhāvakarmaṇoḥ katrrādiṣu ca ye vidhīyante te tavyādaya, yathā gantavyaṃ bhavatā, karaṇīyaḥ kaṭaḥ, kato bhavatā, lūyamānaḥ kedāraḥ, durgamo mārgaḥ, vāstavyo loka iti | prayeṇa kartari karmādiṣu ca ye vidhīyante te ṇvulādayaḥ, yathā pācakaḥ pumān, somaṃ pavamānaḥ, pacanyavāgūm, kanyāmalaṅkariṣṇuḥ, pādahārakaḥ paṅkaḥ, priyaṃkaraṇaṃ śīlam, iti | sarvakārakeṣu siddhabhāve ca ye vidhīyamānāḥ prayeṇa dravyavacanatvaṃ labhyate te uṇādayaḥ, yathā śīto vāyuḥ vatsalā dhātrī, tīśrṇaṃ dātram, vṛddha upādhyāyāḥ, ramyaḥ prāsādaḥ, pāko vartate iti | yadādayaḥ, ghādayaḥ, mabādayaḥ, phagādayaḥ, yujādayaḥ, ḍhagādayaśrceti pratyayapratayayabhedāḥ | teṣu bhavāpatyasvārthamatvarthādiṣu subantobhyo ya utpadyante te yadādayaḥ, yathāpsavyaḥ, pūrvāhṇotanam, ciraṃtanam, āmuṣyāyaṇaḥ, tvayakā, grāmo mā rakṣat, haiyaṅgavīnam, mātulaḥ, kṣatrayaḥ, śrotriyaḥ iti | yatnarūpā anuprayogādayaḥ, yathāgnisāt saṃpadyate, bhasmasādṅavati, brāhmaṇasāt syāt, devatrā karoti, matryatrā gacchati, manuṣyatrā vasati, śuklībhavati, paṭapaṭātaroti, cakāsāṃcakāra, kārayāmāsa, bibhaṃbabhūva, vidāṃkurvantu iti | pratiyatnarūpā vidhyanuprayogādayaḥ, yathā raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, samūlakāṣaṃ kaṣati, jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhṇāti, purūṣavāhaṃ vahati, ūdhrvaśoṣaṃ śuṣkaḥ, cūḍaḍḍatdhkanāśaṃ naṣṭaḥ, odanapākaṃ pakvaḥ, suvarṇanidhāyaṃ nihitaḥ, lunīhi lunīhityevāyaṃ lunāti, adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevāyamadhīte, rāṣṭramaṭa maṭhamaṭa dūramaṭetyevāyamaṭati, sakatūn pibha dhānāḥ svāda odanaṃ bhuṅkṣvetyevāyamabhyavaharati, iti | upaskāraviṣaśeṣa evaprakṛtisamīpoñcāritaṃ padamupapadam, tat tridhā tiṅupapadam, kṛdupapadam, suhupapadaṃ ca | teṣu prathamaṃ kriyārūpam, kārakarūpam, nāmarūpam, avyayarūpam, nipātarūpam, upasargarūpaṃ ca | teṣu kriyārūpaṃ yathaihi manye rathena yāsyasi, na marṣayāmi yattatrabhavān, vṛṣalaṃ yājayet | kārakarūpaṃ yathāśvena saṃcarate, dāsyā saṃprayacchate | nāmarūpaṃ yathā kālo yadbhuñjīta bhavān, samayo yadbhuñjīta bhavān, velā yadbhuñjīta bhavān | avyayarūpaṃ yathā kathaṃ nāma tatrabhavān lṛṣalaṃ yājayet, namate daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ svayameva | nipātarūpaṃ yathā yadbhuṅkte, purā vrajati, bhocako vrajati, godāyo vrajati, kartumacchati iti | kārakarūpaṃ yathā kumbhakāraḥ, uttanaśayaḥ, śayyotthāyam, mūlakopadaṃśam, iti | nāmarūpaṃ yathā kālo bhoktum, samaye bhoktum, brahmabhūyam, brahmodyam iti | avyayarūpaṃ yathā divākaraḥ, doṣākara, mṛṣodyam, īṣatpānaḥ, iti | nipātarūpaṃ yathālaṃ kṛtvā, khalu kṛtvā, yāvadvedam, anyathākāram, kārakarūpam, nāmarūpam, avyayarūpam, nipātarūpam, goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ, krośataḥ prāvrājīditi | kārakarūpaṃ yathā carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayorhanti kuñjaram| keśeṣu camarīṃ hanti sīmni puṣkalako hataḥ|| keśeṣu prasitaḥ, brāhmaṇeṣu bhuñjāneṣu vṛṣalā āsate, vṛṣaleṣvāsīneṣu brāhmaṇā bhujate, iti | nāmarūpaṃ yathā gavāṃ svāmī, annasya hetorvasati, pitrā saddaśaḥ, śivaṃ prajābhyaḥ iti | avyayarūpaṃ yathā śamayā grāmam, saha cchātreṇa, namo devebhyaḥ, dakṣiṇāhi grāmāt iti | nipātarūpaṃ yathā he devadatta, hā devadattam, vinā viṣṇumitreṇa, ṛte yajñadattāt iti | karmapravacanīyarūpaṃ yathā vṛkṣamanu vidyotato, upārjunaṃ yoddhāraḥ, adhi brahmadattepañcālāḥ, adhi pañcaleṣu brahyadatta iti | prakṛtipratyayovevamupaskāraśrca darśitaḥ| kramādupapadasyāpi svarūpamuvarṇitam|| avyayāni nipātāśrca gatayaśrca nirīpitāḥ| karmapravacanīyāśrca sopasargāḥ prakāśitāḥ|| na kevaleha prakṛtiḥ prayijyate na kevalāḥ suptiṅajaṇkyajāgadayaḥ| bhavatyupaskāra ihāpṛgdvayo drvayārthamevopapadaṃ prayujyate|| || iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe prakṛtyādiprakāśo nāma prathamaḥ prakāśaḥ||
<2> dvitāyaḥ prātipadikādiprakāśaḥ
prātipadikaṃ tridhā vibhaktāvayavam, avibhaktāvayavam, anukaraṇaṃ ca | tatra vibhaktāvayavaṃ tridhā kṛdrūpam, taddhitarūpam, samāsarūpaṃ ca | teṣu bhāvakārakābhidhāyino dhātupratyāyāḥ kṛtaḥ | tatra dhātvartha evāpūrvāparībhūto bhāvaḥ, yadāha kālānupāti yadrūpaṃ dhātvarthasya kriyeti tat| parito yat paricchinnaṃ tadbhāva iti kathyate|| sa iha ṣoḍhā samabhavati siddhaḥ, sādhyaḥ, siddhāsamāptaḥ, sādhyāsamāptaḥ, siddhasādhyaḥ, sādhyasiddhaśrceti | teṣu udbhutapratyayāṃśatvena kriyānudrekāt sattvabhūtatve liṅgasaṃkhyādyupagrāhī “kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti” iti saṃbandhavibhakternimittaṃ sidhdaḥ, yathāśrcāryamidamodansya ca pāko brāhmaṇānāṃ ca prādurbhāvaḥ, bhedikā kāṣṭhānāṃ devadattasya, cikīrṣā yajñadattasya kaṭasya iti | atra ubhayaprāptau karmaṇyeva iti niyame ubhayoḥ praptiryasmin kṛti iti vyākhyānāt, akākārayośrca niyamapratiṣedhāt, kartaryapi ṣaṣṭhyeva bhavantī bhāvasya siddhatāṃ dyotayati | udbhataprakṛtyaṃśatvena kriyodrekādasattvabhūtatve liṅgasaṃkhyādyanupagrāhī kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kārakavibhaktereva nimittaṃ sādhyaḥ, yathā odanaṃ bhoktuṃ yāti, svādhāyamadhīteya snāpayati, payaḥ pāyaṃ pāyamāste iti | ata eva “na loka” ityādinā ṣaṣṭhī niṣidhyate | siddha eva taddhitānubandhī siddhāsamāptaḥ, yathā vyāvarakrośī, sāṅkūṭinam, kṛtrimam iti | atra yathā ābhijityaḥ, kauñjāyanyaḥ ityādāvaṇādyabhihito'pyapatyārthaḥ, tauttirīyāḥ chāgaleyinaḥ ityādau thaṇadyabhihito'pi proktarthaḥ, svāpthikrādhyetṛveditṛviṣayataddhitotpattimantareṇa na samāpyate, tathā vyatihārābhividhyupādhiko ṇajinuṇuktaḥ śuddhaśrca ktryabhihitaḥ siddho'pi bhāvaḥ svārthikavanivṛttārthīyataddhitotpattimantareṇa na samāpyata iti siddhāsamāpto bhavati | sādhya evānuprayogānubandhī sādhyāsamāptaḥ, yathā cakāsāñcakāra, vidāṅkurvantu, raipoṣaṃ puṣyati iti | atra yathā śuklībhavati, paṭapaṭākaroti, itāyadāvabhūtatadbhāvādiṣu cvyādyantam, lunīhi lunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti, rāṣṭramaṭa aṭhamaṭa dūramaṭetyevāyamaṭati, ityādiṣu kriyāsamabhihārādiṣu soḍaḍḍatdhntam anabhivyaktapadārthakatvādasamāptaṃ svārthābhivyakteye kṛbhvādyanuprayogaṃ yathāvidhyanuprayogaṃ cāpekṣate, tathā āmantaṃ ṇamulantaṃ cānabhivyaktapadārthakatvādasamāptaṃ sādhyarūpameva svārthāvyaktaye kṛbhvādyanuprayogaṃ yatāvidhyanuprayogaṃ cāpekṣata ityetadukto bhāvaḥ sādhyāsamāpto bhavati | tadāha “āma iva ṇamulo'pyasamāptārthatvāñcadivadanuprayogaḥ siddha eva yathāvidyarthe tu vacanaṃ kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ” iti | tena cakāsāṃcakāra ityādinā'yamarthe bhavati cakāsti sma, vidantu, rāyaḥ puṣyannamuṃ phuṣyati, iti | ata eva kriyāviśeṣaṇenaiva sidadhāmiti na kecit ṇamulprakaraṇamārabhante | nanu ca kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ karmatā napuṃsakatā ca, kathaṃ ca puṣereva puṣiḥ karma bhavati? na hyātmanaivātmā vyāpyate, na hi suśikṣito'pi vaṭuḥ svaṃ skandhamāroḍhuṃ śaknoti| naivam, nāgarakaṃ vṛttaṃ varteta, viśvajitā yajeta, ityādau sāmānyaviśeṣayoranaikātmyena vyāptyavacchedayorupalambhāt sāmānyapuṣerevāvayavapuṣiḥ karma bhavati | na ca kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ karmataiveti niyamaḥ, kriyā hi yathā sādhyamānatvāte karma, tathotpadyamānatvāt katrryapi bhavati, tataśrcobhayathā'pi kriyāviśeṣaṇāni yojyante raipoṣaṃkṛtvā puśyati, raipoṣaṃ yathā bhavatyevaṃ puṣyatīti | siddha eva sādhyadharmayogū siddhasādhyaḥ, yathāśrcaryo gavāṃ doho'śikṣitenāgopālena, sādhu khalu payasaḥ pānaṃ yajñadattena, vicitra hi sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇininā, iti, atra ubhayaprāptai karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhīti kartari tṛtīyāmnānāt siddho'pyayaṃ vivakṣātaḥ sādhyo'pi bhavatīti jñāyate | anye tvanyathā siddhasādhyaṃ varṇayanty uṣṭrāsikāmāste, pañca vārān bhuṅkte, pañca prayogān pacati iti | atroṣṭrāsikāvāraprayogāṇāṃ kriyāviśeṣāvṛttyanuṣṭhanarūptavenāpṛthagbhāvāt kriyābhikhyāpyānāṃ dvitīyādarśanādabhedavivakṣātaḥ siddhānāmapi kriyāvadeva sādhyatvamavagamayte, tadāha tatsvabhāvaviśeṣatvādavyāpyā noṣṭrāsikā'nyā| sādhyatve tvāsanaikātmyat phalataḥ karma kathyate|| so'yamityabhisaṃbandhādabhede dharmadharmiṇoḥ| kriyāya iva sādhyatvaṃ vārādīnāṃ na duṣyati|| tena uṣṭrāsikāmāste ityādīnāmayartho bhavaty uṣṭravadāste, pañcāvṛttiṃ bhujikriyāṃ karoti, pañca pākānnirvartayati iti | sādhya eva siddhadharmayogī sādhyasiddhaḥ, yathā kartavyaṃ bhavataḥ, kārye bhavataḥ iti | atra “na lokālyayaniṣṭhāthalarthatṛnām” iti lādīnāṃ sādhyārthābhidhāyitvāt kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhe, “kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā” “ktasya ca vartamāne”, napuṃsake bhāve upasaṃkhyānam ityādibhiḥ punaḥ ṣaṣṭhīvidhānāt pakṣe vivakṣātaḥ siddhārthābhidhāyitvamavagamyata itayetadukto bhāvaḥ sādhyasiddho bhavati | na cātra kṛtyānāṃ niṣedho na śrūyate, yataḥ khasarthatṛnāmityatra khalarthetyanena kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ śatṛśānañcanaśaśrca saṃgṛhyante, tṛnnityanena punastṛnneveti | ata eva niṣṭhādibhāvasyeva kṛtyabhāvasya karmaṇyapi ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati, yathā gatamastaṃ yathā'rkeṇa yathā'bhyuditamindunā| tatā manina śaithilyamāgantavyaṃ mṛgīddaśaḥ|| kathaṃ punaḥ sakarmakāt bhāvapratyayaḥ? tena hyakatmakādbhavivyam, yadāha “laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ” “tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ”, na hi bhavati kṛtaṃ kaṭaṃ devadatteneti | ucyate naitadantarabhgaṃ dravyakarma, api tu “kālādhvabhāvagantavyāḥ karmaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām” iti bahiraṅgeṣu kālādikarmasu gantavyalakṣaṇaṃ gatyarthakarma, bahiraṅgatā ca “kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge” iti punardvitīyāgrahaṇena jñāyate, anyāthā bi karmaṇi dvitīyāyāḥ siddhātvāt gatyarthakarmaṇi caturthīcetyeva brūyāt | yasyaiva ca dravyakarmaṇo'ntaraṅgasyābāvenākarmakaḥ, tasyaiva bhāvena sakarmako bhavati, ato vidyamānamapi kālādikarma nākarmakavyapadeśaṃ vighnayati | anye tvanyathā sādhyasiddhaṃ varṇayanty uṣṭrāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāḥ śayyante, yavāgvāḥ pākāya vrajati iti | atra āsikāśāyikayorākhyātābhihitakriyātmakatvāt pākasya vrajikriyāsādhyatvāt, satyapi sādhyatve libhgasaṃkhyāsaṃbandhivibhaktiyogādvivakṣātaḥ sidvatvamapi gamyata ityathaṃ sādhyasiddho bhavati | tathā'pi uṣṭarāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāḥ śayyante, ityamūbhyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣopacaritarūpo bhāvātmaiva pratyāyyate, sa ākhyātābhyāṃ sāmānyarūpeṇa, ṇvulantābhyāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa | bahuvacanaṃ tu kutsātiśayārtham, yāhi nāmoṣṭrasya kutsāvatyo bahuprakārajuṣo bahvyaḥ āsikāḥ, yāśrca hatānāmatiśayavatyastathābhūtā eva bhūyasyaḥ śāyikāḥ pratītāḥ, tābhiḥ viśeṣarūpābhirimāsikā śāyikā ca upāmānopameyasaṃbandhajanitabhedābhedaparigrahāllakāreṇāpi sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena kutsātiśayārthe bahutvenaiva pratyāyyate, bahutvena vinā sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvānupapatteḥ, tenoṣṭrāsikā ivāsanāni hataśāyikā iva śayanāni kriyante bhavantīti vā vākyārtho bhavati | nanvevamuṣṭāsikādīnāṃ vāraprayogādīnāṃ ca karmateva napuṃsakatā'pi prāpnoti, yathā mṛdi pacati, praśastaṃ pacatīti | ucyate tridhā khalu kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati bāhyam, ābyantaram, bāhyabhyantaraṃ ca, tatra bāhyaṃ dharmarūpaṃ vārādi, ābhyantaraṃ tu viśeṣarūpamuṣṭrāsikādi, bāhyābhyantaraṃ guṇarūpaṃ mṛdvādi | teṣu bāhyaṃ so'yamityabhisaṃbandhādabhedopacāreṇāvicalitasvarūpameva pradhānaṃ viśiṃṣat kathamiva svaliṅga jahyat? ābhyantaraṃ tu viśeṣāṃśaparigrahādāviṣṭaliṅgasaṃkhyaṃ kathamiva pā'nyaliṅgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt? bāhyābhyantaraṃ tu guṇatvāt svakaliṅgavirahe “guṇavacanānamāśrayato liṅgavacanāni” iti viśeṣyaliṅgagrāhyeva bhavati, tatra sadhyaikasvabāvatvādaliṅgasaṃkhyāyāḥ kriyāyā viśeṣaṇatve mṛdvādīnāṃ napuṃsakatvameva nyāyyam | uṣṭānākāvārādīnāṃ tu nityamāviṣyaliṅgatvādviśeṣāṃśaparigrahāt kriyāviśeṣaṇatve'pi na napuṃsakaliṅgata | atha pākāya vracati, edhebhyo vrajati, iti kriyā randhanāya sthālītivāt tādathryacatuthryantaḥ liddha eva kasmānna vijñāyate? naivam, “bhāvavacanāśrca” iti tāpathrya eva pratyayotpatteḥ, “tumarthāñca bhāvavacanāt” iti svārtha eva catirthāvidhānāt | kimarthe punaridam? bhāve hi ghañādayaḥ siddhā eva, tādathrye catirthī | kriyārthopapadena tumunā'smin viṣaye ghañādayo mā bādhiṣataḥ, vāsarūpavidhiśrcātra tumunṇavulāviti ṇvusgrahaṇānnāvarati | atha yathaidānāhartetu vrajati edhebhyo vrajatīti “kriyārthoppadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ” iti caturthī, tathā pākaṃ kartuṃ vrajati pākāya vracatīti yadi bhavet, ko doṣaḥ syat? na kaśrcit, kiṃ tvetat pṛcchāmi sa pākaḥ siddhaḥ sādhyo vā? yadi saddhaḥ kiṃ kartuṃ vrajati? atha sādhyaḥ, kriyārthopapadeṣu tumunā ghaḍhādayo bādhyante | atha tumarthatvena sādhyābhinadhāśrcatithryantatvena cāsattvabhūtārthāḥ pākayetyādiṣu dhañādayaḥ, kathaṃ yavāgvā ityādeḥ saṃbandhavibhakternimitaṃ bhavati? śabdāśaktireṣā yat kasyacideva kenacit, kenacideva kasyacitsaṃbandhaḥ, tadyathābhinne'pyarthe prajāgaritā'pararātrāniti tṛnobāhyakarmopasargakarmayodāt jāyate, na jāgarūka ityuktasya, ūrīkaroti pākādikamityūryādināmekānekānekaviśeṣasthāyā karotikriyayā bhavati saṃbandhaḥ, na tadarthaviṣayaiḥ pacādebhiḥ, sūryamapi na paśyanti asūryaṃpaśyā rājadārā iti vyavahitāmapi sūryakarmikāṃ ddaśikriyāṃ nañ niṣedhati, na sūryattam, evaṃ na punargīyante apunārgeyāḥ śrlokāḥ, śrāddhaṃ na bhūṅkte aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇa iti | tathā lavaṇaṃ na bhuṅkte alavaṇabhojī bhikṣuḥ ityasūryepaśyādivadasāmathrye'pi nañsamāso ddaśyate, na tvakiṃcitkurvāṇa iti, evaṃ māṣaṃ haramāṇaḥ, agādhādutsṛpta iti | api ca, payaḥ pāyaṃ pāyaṃ, payaḥ pītvā pītvā, gehamanupraveśamanupraveśam, gehamanupraviṣyānupraviśyānupraviśya, ityābhīkṣṇyavīpsayoḥ padadvirvacanaṃ prayojayanti ṇamulādayaḥ, na pāpacyate, doviśotatadehīti yaṅśasādayaḥ, lolūyata iti dvirvacanamantereṇāpi kriyālamabhihāramavagamayati yaṅantam, na sunīhi lunīhīti lolūyata loḍaḍḍatdhntam, kṛtapūrvī kaṭam, adhīti vyākaraṇam, iti vṛttivaśenojjhitakarmābhidhānaśaktayaḥ karmavibhaktiṃ na vidhnayanti niṣṭhadayaḥ, grāmaṃ gantumanāḥ, kaṭaṃ kartukāma iti nivṛtticchinnā api karmaṇi dvitīyāmeva prayojayanti tumunādayaḥ, ubhayaprāptau karmaṇayeveti niyame'pi vicitrā sūtrasya kṛtiḥ pāṇineḥ iti, śabdānāmanuśāsanamācāryasya iti, samāsāya kartari saṃbandhavibhaktimapyupādadate ktinādayaḥ, sādhyārthābhidhaāyino'sattvabhūtārthā api yavāgvāḥ pākāyeti karmaṇi saṃbandhavibhaktyaiva samabadhyante ghañādaya iti taduktabhāvaḥ sādhyasiddho bhavati|| kriyānimittaṃ kārakam, tadapi ṣoḍhā kartā, karma, karaṇam, saṃpradānam, apādānam, adhikaraṇaṃ ceti | tatra kartā śvatantraḥ, hetuḥ, karmakartā ca, teṣu kriyāyāḥ svecchayā karaṇādīni yaḥ prayuṅkte na tu taiḥ prayujyate, sa svatantraḥ, yathā putrapautrasya darśakaḥ, purāṃ bhetteti | tameva kriyāpravṛttaṃ yaḥ prayuṅkte sa hetuḥ, yathā rājānaṃ yodhitavān rājayudhvā dhanuṣamān, nakhāni mocayanti nakhamujāni dhanūṃṣīti | karmaiva svātantryeṇa vivakṣitaṃ karmakartāḥ, yathā śvayameva pacyante pacelimā māṣāḥ, svayameva bhajyante bhaṅgurāṇi kāṣṭhāni iti | karmanirvatryai, vikārye, prāpyaṃ ca, teṣu yadasajjanyate, sadvā prakāśyate, tannirvatryam, yathā kartavyaḥ kaṭaḥ, iñcāryaḥ śabdaḥ, iti | yasya prakṛtyucchedo guṇāntaraṃ votpadyate tadvikāryam, yathā bhukta odanaḥ, lūyamānaḥ kedāraḥ, iti | kriyākṛtaviśeṣānavagatau kartuḥ kriyayā'nāsthitamāsthitaṃ vā yadāpyate tat prapyam, yathā durdarśaḥ prabhuḥ, suyāno mārga iti | karaṇaṃ bāham, ābhyantaraṃ, bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca, teṣu kartuḥ śarīrādvahirupalabhyamānaṃ bāhyam, yathāśitaṃbhavaṃ bhaktam, dhṛtodakaḥ karakaḥ, iti | tadviparītamābhyantaram, yathā priyaṃkaraṇaṃ śīlam, vaśīkaraṇaṃ prema, iti | ubhayaguṇayogi bāhyabhyantaram, yathā dīyate'smai dānīyo brāhmaṇaḥ, devā deyāsurasmai devadāyo ḍiḍḍatdhmbhaḥ, iti | “karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam” iti pāribhāṣikasaṃjñāviṣayaḥ karmamātrāpyaṃ, yathā dāśyateṣasmai deyamiti dāśaḥ kaivartaḥ, gāṃ hanti āgatoyeti gaughnaḥ atithiḥ iti | karmaśabdena kriyāyā apyipādānāt kriyāyā yadāpyate tat kriyāpyam, yathā śrlāghante'smai janā iti śrvāghyo rājā, spahayantyasmai lokāḥspṛhaṇīyo vibhava iti | apādānaṃ nirdhiṣṭaviṣayam, upāttaviṣayam, yathā prapatano giriḥ, prastravaṇaḥ śailaḥ iita | bhūtrārthādiyogoktamupāttaviṣayam, yathāvadhiḥ parnataḥ, maryādā samudraḥ iti | adhikakaraṇaṃ vaiṣayikam, aipaśrleṣikam, naimittikaṃ ca, teṣu vividhamanekaprakāraṃ jātigiṇakriyādravyādibhaṅiḥ sinotīti viṣayo dāśakālādiḥ, viṣaya eva vaiṣayikam, yathā nipibantyasmin gavādaya iita nipānaṃ jalāśayaḥ, rājāno dhīyante'syāṃ rājadhānī nagarap iti | upaśrleṣo'vaṣṭambhaḥ, tasmai prabhavatyaupaśrloṣikam, yatheṣavo dhīyante iṣudhiḥ upāsaṅgamā, śerate'syāṃ śayyā prayaṅkaḥ| nimittameva naimittikam, yathā rajyante'smin sāmājikamanāṃsi iti raṅgaḥ prekṣā, prasīdanti asmin nayanamanāṃsi iti prāsādaḥ saudham iita | tadaitadubhayamapu śuddham, saṅkīrṇam, upādhimat, rūḍhimat, samabandhi, anubandhi ceti ṣoḍhā viprathate| tatra arthāntarairasamaṃsparśaḥ śuddhiḥ, sā bhāvānāṃ yathā odanatya pākaḥ alaṃ kṛtvā, khalu sthitvā iti, kārakāṇāṃ yathāpāṃ straṣṭā, varṣaśatasya pūrakaḥ, somaṃ pavamāna iti | saṃparkaḥ, saṅkaraḥ, sa bhāvānāṃ yathā kālo bhoktam, alaṃ bhoktam, bhojaṃ bhojaṃ vrajatīti, kārakāṇāṃ yathā gamanamarhati gamyā yoṣit, jetiṃ śakyate jayyaḥ śatruḥ, paktuṃ vrajati, pācako vrajatīti | bāhyamābhyantaramubhayaṃ vā śāstropāttaṃ viśeṣaṇamupādhiḥ, la bhāvānāṃ yathā bhavataḥ śāyikā, upasaro gavām, samajaḥ paśūmāmiti | kārakāṇāṃ yathā tundaparimṛjoṣalasaḥ, stamberamo hastī, ddatihariḥ paśuḥ iti | guṇavacanatve dravyavacanatvarūḍhiḥ, sā bhāvānāṃ yathā mṛgayā, vāsanā, parivrajyeti, karakāṇāṃ yathā kumbhakāraḥ, paṅkajamu amāvāsyeti | niyodataḥ pratiyogyapekṣaḥ samabandhaḥ, sa bhāvānāṃ yathā bhuktvā vrajati, bhoktumicchit, aprapya nadīṃ parvata iti, kārakāṇāṃ yathā caṅakramyamāṇo'dhīte, adhīyāno vasati, godāyo vrajati | anuṣaṅgogyapekṣaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, sa bhāvānāṃ yathā śāṃrāviṇaṃ vartate, raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, cakāsāṃcakāra iti, kārakaṇāṃ yathāgniṣṭo'mayājī, uṣṭrakośaśataṃ dāyī iti | athaitadabhidhāne triprakārāḥ kṛte bhavanti bhāvavacanāḥ, kārakavacanā, bhāvakārakavacanāśrca | teṣu athujādayaḥ, ṇvulādayaḥ, ṇajādayaḥ, tumunādayaḥ, sayādayaḥ, ṇamulādayaśrca bhāvavacanāḥ, ṇvulādayaḥ, aṇādayaḥ, uṇādayaḥ, kkinādayaḥ, śātrādayaḥ, tṛnādayaśrca kārakavacanāḥ, tavyādayaḥ, tavāyādayaḥ, ktādayaḥ, khalādayaḥ, sughādayaḥ, ghañādayaśrca bhāvakārakavacanāḥ| tatra bhāvavacaneṣvanupādhau siddhabhāve athujādayaḥ, yathā nandathuḥ, yajñaḥ, svapnaḥ, kriyā, kaṇḍūḍḍatdhyā, vyajyā iti | atreva rogādyupādhimati ṇvulādayaḥ, yatārocake bādhate, pravāhikātaḥ karoti, bhavata āsikā, ikṣubhakṣukāṃ me dhārayasi, kāṃ tvaṃ kārikakārṣīḥ, akaraṇiste vṛśla iti | siddhāsamāpte ṇajādayaḥ, yathā vyāvakreśī vartate, vyāvahāsūṃ kurvanti, karaṇena nirvṛttaṃ kṛtrimam, bhuktvā vrajati, apamityayājate, svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte, coraṅkāramākrośati| tumatha eva dhandoviṣaye sayādayaḥ, yathā vakṣe rāyastvā, ddaśe viśvaya sūryam, agna devā vibhājaṃ nāśaknuvan, īśvaro'bhicaritoḥ, īśvaro vilikhaḥ iti | svādhyāsamāpte ṇamulādayaḥ, yathā kārakaḥ, straṣṭā, nandanaḥ, priyaḥ, yajvā, jaranniti | sopapadāḥ katrrādiṣvaṇādayaḥ, yathā kāṇḍaḍḍatdhlāvaḥ, pādahārakaḥ, subhagaṃkaraṇam, goghnaḥ, śamabhuḥ, goṣṭhaḥ iti| niripapadā rūḍhimanta uṇādayaḥ, yathā kāruḥ, dātram, dhātrī, dāsaḥ, bhīṣmaḥiti | ubhaye'pi lopavantaḥ kkinādayaḥ, yathā ghatṛspṛka, saddak, arthabhāk, śubhaṃyuḥ, prāṅ, yuṅ iti | kartaryevodriktakriyāṃśāḥ śātrādayaḥ, yatā yavāgūṃ pacan, somaṃ pavamānaḥ, āśitaṃ dāśvan, vedamanūcānaḥ, bhuktavānodanam, grāmaṃ gamī iti | ta eva tācchīlyādyupādhimantastṛnādayaḥ, yathā jāgaritāpararatrāḥ, muṇḍaḍḍatdhyitāraḥ śrāviṣṭhāyanāḥ, vadhūmūḍhām, alaṃkariṣṇuḥ, katīha kavacamudvahamānāḥ, śataṃ dāyī, edhānāhārako vrajati iti | bhāvakārakavacaneṣūdriktānudriktakriyāmaśāḥ tavyādayaḥ, yathā kartavyaṃ bhavatā, karaṇīyaṃ bhavatā, kāryaḥ kaṭo bhavataḥ, kṛtyaḥ kaṭo bhavataḥ, vāstavyo bhavān, brahmabhūyaṃ bhavataḥ iti| ta eva dhandoviṣayāstavāyādayaḥ, yathā paridhātavai, paristaritavai, avacakṣe, avagāhe, diddakṣeṇyaḥ, kartuṃ haviḥ iti | udriktakriyāśāḥ ktādayaḥ, yathā bhuktaṃ bhavatā, bhujāyamānaṃ bhavatā, bhokṣyamāṇaṃ bhavatā, bhuktamodanam, bhakta audano bhavatā, evaṃ bhokṣyamāṇaḥ iti | ta eva vyaktakālāḥ khalādayaḥ, yakhā śvaḍhyaṃbhavaṃ bhavatā, sūtthānaṃ bhavatā, prāśitaṃbhavaṃ bhavatā, durāḍhyaṃbhavaṃ bhavatā, iṣatpānaḥ somo bhavatā, āitaṃbhavaṃ bhaktam iti | anudriktakriyāśāḥ prāyo guṇavatanā liyuḍādayaḥ, yathā vyāsasya vacanaṃ, pāṇineruktiḥ, dhātrasya hasitaṃ, idhmānāṃ vraśrcanaṃ, janānāṃ bhaktiḥ, rājñāṃ mata iti| ta eva prāyo dravyavacanā ghañādayaḥ, yathā paryāyaḥ kriyāṇāṃ, viparyāyaḥ kālasya, saṃgrahaḥ śāstraṇāṃ, adhītaḥ svādhyāyaḥ, adhigata upāyaḥ, śreyānupādhyāyaḥ iti|| bhāvakārakasaṃbandhisvārthābhidhāyino'dhātupratyayāstaddhitāḥ | tatra bhāvo dvidhāntaraṅgaḥ, bahuraṅgaśrceti | tayoḥ śabdasyārthe pravṛttinimittamantaraṅgaḥ, yadāha “yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśaḥ, sa tasya bhāvaḥ, tadabhidhāne tvatalau|” tasyopalaṃgrahāya saṃgrahakāraḥ paṭhati “śabde tāṃ jātiṃ śabdamevārthajātau jātiḥ śuklādau dravyaśabde guṇaṃ tam| kṛttatsaṃyodaṃ yogi cābhinnarūpaṃ vācyaṃ vācyeṣu tvādayo bodhayanti||” tataḥ sa ṣoḍhā bhidyate jātiḥ, guṇaḥ, svarūpaṃ, saṃbandhaḥ, saṃhatiḥ, abhinnarūpaṃ iti | teṣu jātiryachā gotvaṃ, śuklatvaṃ, mānuṣyakaṃ, straiṇaṃ, pauṃsnaṃ, brāhmaṇyaṃ iti| guṇo yathā śuklatvaṃ, śīdhratvaṃ, sūryatvaṃ, diktvaṃ, tadātvaṃ iti | saṃbandho yathā pācakatvaṃ, kāṇḍaḍḍatdhlāvatvaṃ, daṇḍiḍḍatdhtvaṃ, aupagavatvaṃ, rājapuruṣatvaṃ, nīlotpalatvaṃ, gaurakhādiratvaṃ iti | abhinnarūpaṃ yathā śattvaṃ, vidyamānatvaṃ, gargatvaṃ, pañcālatvaṃ, padārthatvaṃ, paṅkajatvaṃ iti || nanu ca, jātiguṇājjatiguṇo dhavakhādirādeḥ svajātisaṃghāte| ḍiḍḍatdhttādau ca svarūpe kṛttatsaṃyoge tu saṃbandhe|| tvādayaḥ iti smṛtiḥ, kathamabhinnarūpādavapi bhavati? ucyate “kṛttaddhitasamāseṣu saṃbandhābhidhānamanyatra rūḍhyabhinnarūpāvyabhicaritasaṃbandhebhyaḥ” | ata evoktaṃ “kṛttatsaṃyogaṃ yoginā bhinnarīpaṃ” iti|| avadherapi vācyatvaṃ tvādīnāmiṣyate budhaiḥ| gotvāddhi gauriti jñānamabhidhānaṃca jāyate|| te hyevamāhuḥ “tasya bāvasttvatalau” bhavato'smābhidhānaprayayāmiti bhāvaḥ| tadasat, na hi gotvaṃ gauriti jñānasyotpattānapādānatāṃ janayat “janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ” “bhuvaḥ prabhavo vā” bhavati, yathā śṛṅgāccharo jāyate, himavato gaṅgā prabhanatīti | jñānaṃ tvātmana eva jāyate, manasaivodbhavati, tadāha “vyāpakādapyātmano yugapat jñānānutpattirmanaso liṅgam, nāhamadrākṣaṃ, nāhamaśrauṣaṃ, nāhamajñāsiṣaṃ, anyatra me mano'bhūditi “ | nimittatvaṃ tu gauriti jñānotpattau śabdasyeva gotvāderapīṣyata eva | tatra yathā samavāyinaḥ śvaityat śvaityabuddhaiḥ śvete śvaityabuddhiḥ, tathā samavāyino gotvādgotivabuddheḥ gavi gotvabuddhiḥ, te parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhūte iti | abhidhānaṃ tu śabdaḥ, sa ca ye noñcāritenārthaḥ pratīyate | tasyāpi na gotvamavadhirbhavati | śabdo hyākāśādeva jāyate, mukhādeva prabhanati, na gotvādaiḥ | tadāhuḥ “mukhe hi śabdamupalābhāmahe bhūmāvartham” iti | yadā'pi nityaḥ śabda iti mataṃ tadā'pi śabdasya gotvādayo vācyāḥ viśeṣyāḥ pratyāyyatve tu vipariṇāmaviparivartapakṣayorvakṣyamāṇanyāyena pratyuta śabdasyaivāvadhitvam| adhāyasastu sāddaśyādupādherupādhisāddaśyābhyāṃ vā saṃbhavati, yathā śuktikādau rajatādeḥ, sphaṭikādau raktādeḥ, pratibimbādau nukhāderiti | tatra yo yadadhyāsyate, yo yadadhyāste vā, sa tasyādhikaraṇaṃ karma vāsyāt, na tvevāvadhiḥ, gotvaṃ nimuttamupādāya gośabdo gāmadhyāste gavi vā'dhyāsyate | tadiṣyata eva “yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt dravyaṃ śabdaniveśaḥ tadabhidhāvane tvatalau” iti || dhātvartharūpaḥ kṛdabhigadheyo bahuraṅgaḥ, soṣapi ṣoḍhā bhāvarūpaḥ, kārakarūpaḥ, saṃbandhirūpaḥ, bhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ, saṃbandhiviśiṣṭaśrceti | tatra pravṛttinimuttatulyo bhāvarūpo brāhmaṇasya karma brāhmaṇyaṃ, purohitasya karma paurohityaṃ, stenasya steyaṃ, sakhyuḥ sakhyaṃ, dūtasya dūtyaṃ, vaṇijo vāṇijyamiti | kārakaistulyakakṣyaḥ kārakarūpaḥ, yathā rājānamarhati rājavadvṛttaṃ, āprayojanakālaṃ bhavati ākālikī pravṛttiḥ, śyenasyeva pāto'syāṃ vartateśyenaṃpātā kriyā, daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ kriḍāyāṃ dāṇḍā, mahimā astyasyāṃ mahiminī samasyā, vaṭakaṃ prakṛtamasyāṃ vaṭakamayī yātreti| rūḍhe dravyabhūtaḥ saṃbhandhirūpaḥ, yathā cāṣāṇāṃ samūhaḥ cāṣaṃ, nāṭyānāmāmnāyo nāṭyaṃ, bhṛgvaṅgirasāṃ vivāho bhṛgvaṅgirasikā, kākolūkasya vairaṃ kākolūkikā, avīnāṃ saṃghāto avikaṭaḥ, teṣāmeva vistāro'vipaṭaḥ iti | atarkitopanatacitrīkaraṇādisaddaśo bhāvaviśṣṭaḥ, yathā kākasya cāgamanaṃ yāddacchikaṃ, tālasya ca pātaḥ, tena tālena patatā kākasya vadhaḥ, evameva devadattasya cāgamanaṃ dasyunāṃ cepanipātaḥ, taiśrca tasya vadhaḥ, tatra yo devadattasya dasyūnāṃ ca samāgamaḥ sa kākatālasamāgama ivetyeka upamārthaḥ, yaśrca devadattavadhaḥ sa kākavadha iveti dvitīya upamārthaḥ, tatra prathamaḥ samāsārthaḥ kākatālamiti, dvitīyaḥ pratyayārthaḥ kākatālīyamiti, samāsaśrcāyamasmādeva jñāpakāt, yadāha samāsāñca tadviṣayādākasmika ivārthe ccho bhavati, tadviṣayādityatra hi tadityanena “ive pratikṛtau” itīvārthaḥ paramṛśyate| evamajākṛpāṇīyaṃ, andhakavartakāyaṃ, ghuṇākṣarīraṃ, ardhajaratīyaṃ, gomayapāyasīyaṃ iti | saṃbandhinā'vacchinnaḥ saṃbandhiviśiṣaṭaḥ, yathā halyaḥ kāṣaḥ, saudhaḥ samakocaḥ, pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ, atharvaṇa āmnāyaḥ, vaido ghoṣaḥ, chāndosagyo dharmaḥ iti | upādhirapi saṃbandhyeva bhavati, yathā gārgikayā vikatthate, kāṭhikayā'dhikṣipati, gārgikāmanvavetaḥ, gārgikāmavagavān, kāṭhikāmāvagatavān iti| dhātvarthopi bhāva eva, kriyā'pi hyupamānena parītā paricchinnā sādhyasiddhabhāvo bhavati| sa tridhā bhāvakārakaḥ, rājñā saddaśaṃ vartate rājavat, jaḍhasya tulyaṃ brāhmaṇādisthāsvadhyayanādikriyāsu sāhacaryādvṛttiḥ, jātidravyayoranyatareṇa kriyāyāḥ sāddaśyānupapatteḥ| yadāha “tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvattiḥ, teneti tṛtīyāsamarthāt tulyamityetasminnarthe vatipratyayo bhavati | kārakaviśiṣṭo yathā rājñeva vyavahṛtamanena rājavat, devamva bhavantaṃ paśyāmi devavat, asineva dātreṇa cchinacci asivat, brāhmaṇayeva yadā devadttaya dadāti brāhmaṇavat, parvatādivāsanādavarohati pravatavat, pitarīva gurāvacarati pitṛvat| atra punaridameva sūtramanyathā vyākhyāyate tena kārakaviśeṣeṇa tulyaṃ yathā bhavati| evaṃ cet kriyā bhavati bhāvotpanne vihitapratyaye kadācit pratyayamukhona kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati, kadācit prakṛtimukhena, yathā tīvraḥ pākaḥ, tīvraṃ pākaṃ iti | saṃbandhiviśiṣṭo yathā brāhmaṇasyovādhyanamasya brāhmaṇavat, rājña iva raudraṃ vṛttamasya pājavat, jaḍaḍḍatdhsya saddasaṃ vacanamasya jaḍaḍḍatdhvat, sūryasyeva prakāśo'sya sūryavat, puturyathā pālanamasya pitṛvat, gurostulyamanuśāsanamasya guruvate, iti | atratu “tatra tasyeva” ityanena vatiḥ | nanu ca “tena tulyaṃ” ityanenaiva siddhe kimarthe “tatra tasyeva” iti sūtrārambhaḥ? dravyaguṇayostulyayoḥ pratyayo na labhyaḥ iti, yathā madhurāyāmiva pāṭaliputre prāsādāḥ madhurākt, brāhmaṇasyeva kṣatriyasya śuklā dantāḥ bāhmaṇavat iti | yadyeva pūrvasūtre kriyāgrahaṇaṃ na kariṣyate, sāhacaryāñca kriyāyāmiva dravyaguṇayoḥ prātipadikaṃ vartiṣyate, tataśrca maitreyatulyā gāvaśrcaitrasya, brāhmaṇena tulyā dantā kṣatriyasya iti vigṛhya pūrvasūtreṇaiva vatiḥ setsyatīti | tadasat, evaṃ hi gavayena tulyoṣanaḍḍḍatdhvān ityatrāpi pratyayaḥ prasajet, ivārthe tu pratyaye saptamīṣaṣṭhyantābhyāṃmeva vidhīyamāne gavaya ivānaḍḍḍatdhvān ityatra pratyayapraṅgo na syāt, saptamīṣaṣṭhyantāyorhi bāhyaṃ saṃbandhinamapekṣya ivaśabdaprayogo bhavati, na punarivārthāpekṣayaiva, ivaśabdo hi upamānopameyabhāvalakṣaṇasaṃbandhadyotakaḥ, na tu saṃbandhirūpābhidhāyī | tasmādgavayena tulyo'naḍḍḍatdhvān ityatra mā bhūt pratyayaprasaṅga iti pūrvasūtre kriyāgrahagaṇam | tasmaśrca kṛte dravyagiṇayostulyayoḥ pratyayo na syāditi saptamīṣaṣṭhyantābhyāmivārthe “tatra tasyeva” iti vatirvidhāyate | atha “tadarham” iti kimartham? arhato yā kriyā kartṛstatrāpi vatiriṣyate| upamānāvivakṣāyāṃ tadvidhānaṃ na labhyate|| upāmānopameyatvamanyasyānyeva vā saha| avasthābhedabhinnatvādekasyāpyātmanaiva vā|| tatrānyasyānyena yathāvaiyākaraṇo'pyayaṃ vaiyākaraṇavahrṛte, yoṣidapyeṣā puṃvadvaktīti, avasthābhdabhinnatvādekasyāpyātmāno yathā vaiyākaraṇo'pyayavajñayā kadācidavaiyākaraṇavadbrūhīte, yoṣidapyucyate satrīvadvadeti | vāyākaraṇo'pyavajñayā kadāṭacidavaiyākaraṇavadbrūte, śrūyate hi yarvāṇastarvāṇā nāma sākṣātakṛtadharmāṇa ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ | te hi “antarvedyāmeva na mlecchitavyam, ato'nyatrāvajñayā” iti yadvā nastadvā na iti vaktavye yarvāṇastaparvāṇa ityūcuḥ | yoṣudapi kadācidāśritāprāgalbhyāt puṃvadvakti, yathocyate sarasvatīva karṇāṭī vijayāṅkā jayatyasau| yā vaidarbhagirāṃ bhūmiḥ kālidāsādanantaram|| asyaipamyadvayasyāpi vivakṣāto'parigrahe| vatiḥ kathamivārthīya iti (matvā) yamucyate|| tatra rājavadvṛttamityatra yadaivaṃvidhārthavivakṣā pṛthvādinā rājñā tulyaṃ vṛttamanena rājñā rājavadvṛttaṃ rājñeti, tadādyenaiva sūtreṇa siddhaḥ pratyayaḥ | yadā tvetāddaśī vivakṣārājña iva pṛthorasya vṛttaṃ rājavadvṛttaṃ rājña iti, tāda dvitīyasūtreṇa | yadā tvidaṃ vṛttaṃ rājānamevārhati nānyamityupamānopameyabhāvābhāve rājavadvṛttamiti prayogaḥ, tadā “tadarham” ityanena vatirvidhīyata iti nānarthakaḥ sūtrārambhaḥ || anye tu “tena tulyaṃ kriyā cedvatiḥ” ityatra dvitīyavyānapakṣe kriyāyāḥ kriyā viśeṣaṇaṃ na saṃbhavatīti kārakaviśiṣṭabhāvapakṣaṃ “tadarham” ityanena samavāhayati, rājānamarhati yadvyavaharaṇaṃ, devamarhati yaddarśanaṃ, asimarhati yacchedanaṃ, brāhmaṇamarhati yaddānaṃ, parvamarhati yadavarohaṇaṃ, pitaramarhati yat pāratantrayam, taducyate rājavat, devavat, asivat, brāhmaṇavat, parvatavat, iti | rājñeva vyavahṛtamityādibhistu tasyārthaḥ pradarśita iti || kārakamapi bhāvavadevāntaraṅgaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ ca, toyarākhyātābhidheyamantaraṅgaṃ, anākhyātābhidheyaṃ bahiraṅgaṃm, kartā hetukartā, karma ceti, karaṇaṃ saṃpradānapadānamadhikaraṇaṃ ceti tatrāntaraṅgabhedeṣu kartā śuddhaḥ, miśraḥ, saṃkīrṇaśrca | teṣu kriyākarakāntarāsaṃpṛktaḥ śuddhaḥ, yatheṣṭamanena iṣṭī yajñī, kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kaṭo'nena katapūrvī kaṭamiti | kriyāntarasaṃpṛkto miśraḥ, yathā vyākaraṇaṃ vetti adhīte vā vaiyākaraṇaḥ, śaśvadbhavaḥ śāśvatikaḥ iti | kriyākārakāntarasaṃpṛktaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ, yathā śālāyāṃ praveśamarhati, śālīnaḥ adhṛṣyaḥ, teṣu ātmāsthakriyo yathā pārāyaṇaṃ vartayati pārāyaṇikaḥ, cāndrāyaṇaṃ vartayati cāndirayaṇika iti | parasthakriyo yathā vātaṃ śamayati vātikaṃ tailaṃ, pittaṃ śamayati pauttikamiti | parātmasthakriyo yathā yathākṣadyūtena nirvṛttamākṣadyūtikaṃ dhanaṃ, pākena nirvṛttaṃ pākimaṃ, māṇikaṃ iti | udriktakarmāśo yathā vasante pacyante vāsantyaḥ kundalatāḥ, ṣaṣṭirātreṇa pacyante ṣāṣṭikāḥ śālaya iti| anudriktodriktakrarmośo yathā vaṃśaṃ gato vaśyaḥ, śārṣacchedamarhati śārṣacchedya iti | karma nirvatryaṃ, prāpyaṃ ca | teṣu yadasajjanyate, sadvāprakāśyate, tannirvatryam, yathorasā nirmitaḥ aurasaḥ putraḥ, pāṇininā proktaṃ pāṇinīyaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ iti | yasya prakṛtyucchedo guṇāntaraṃ vā vidhīyate tadvikāryam, yathā viṣeṇa vadhyaḥ viṣyaḥ śatruḥ, kusumbhena raktaṃ kausumbhaṃ vastramiti | āsthitamanāsthitaṃ vākriyayā yadāptumiṣyate tat prāpyam, yathā nāvā tāryaḥ nāvyo hradaḥ, ayānayaṃ neyaḥ ayānayīnaḥ śāra iti | nanu ca śāropyāsthitaḥ kasmānna bhavati? tyāgarūpaṃ prahātavye'pyarthe (prāpye) saṃsargadarśanam| āsthitaṃ karma yattatra ddairūpyaṃ bhajate kriyā|| yathāṃ panthānaṃ gacchati, gartamuttaratīti | śārastu prāpya eva, yathājāṃ nayati grāmaṃ, (grāmaṃ) vahati bhāram iti | nanvevaṃ grāmasya prāpyatā prāpnoti, nājādeḥ, kaḥ punarāha na prāpnotīti, kiṃntu akathitatvena tatra kriyāvyāpyatvenāddvitāyaiva, na pratyayāntaraṃ gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ, pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate iti | bahiraṅgabhedeṣu karaṇaṃ bāhyaṃ, ābhyantaraṃ, bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca | teṣu bāhyaṃ yathā śupāṃ vyākhyānaḥ saupaḥ, sasāṭasya bhūṣaṇaṃ lalāṭikā | ābhyantaraṃ yathā matasya karaṇaṃ matyaṃ, caturṇāṃ pūrāṇaścaturthaḥ iti| bāhyābhyantaraṃ yaātha samidha ādhīyante'nena sāmidhenyo mantraḥ, (sa eva) hṛdayasya bandhanaḥ hṛdya iiti| saṃpradānaṃ dādatikarmāpyaṃ, karmamātrāpyaṃ, kriyāpyaṃ ca | samapradīyate bhojanādikakamasmai ityānvarthasaṃjñakaṃ dadātikarmāpyaṃ, yathāgrabhojanaṃ niyuktamasmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ, pañcāsmai vṛddhirvā, āyo vā, śulkaṃvā, upadā vā dīyante pañcakaḥ puruṣaḥ iti| “karmaṇā yamabhaipraiti sa saṃpradhānām” iti pāribhāṣikasaṃtrakaṃ karmamātrāpyaṃ, yathā rāṣṭriyo rājanyaḥ, kaliṃ kurvantayasmai kāleyaṃ gandhadravyaṃ iti | karmaśabdena kriyāyā apyabhidhānāt kriyayā'pi yamabhipraiti sa samapradatānamiti kriyāpyam, yathālaṅkarmāsmai nirdiśyate alaṅkarmīṇaḥ anyūnaḥ, na ṣaḍaḍḍatdhkṣātakriyaṃ ca | teṣu “dhruvamapāye'pādānam” iti nirdriṣṭaviṣayam, yathāgriḥ patati asmāt āgneyaḥ grāvā, nadyaḥ syandante asmāti nādeyaḥ śaila iti | bhūtrārthādiyogoktamupāttaviṣayam, yathā kukṣiṃ rakṣanti asamāti kaikṣeyakaḥ kṛpāṇaḥ, mudgā bhavantyasmāt maudgīnaṃ kṣetraṃ iiti | avadhimātrārthamapekṣitākriyam, yathā karṇasya mūlaṃ karṇajāhaṃ, pakṣasya mūlaṃ baśratiḥ iti | adhikaraṇaṃ vaiṣayikaṃ, aupaśloṣikaṃ, naimittikaṃ ca | teṣu vividhamanekaprakāraṃ jātikriyāgiṇadravyādibhiḥ sinotīti viṣayaḥ deśakālādiḥ, viṣaya eva vaiṣayikaḥ, yathā gāvaḥ santyasmin gomāne deśaḥ, pauṣī paurṇamāsyasmin pauṣo māsa iti | upaśloṣo'vaṣṭambhaḥ, tasmai prabhavati aupaśloṣikaṃ, yathā daṇḍiḍḍatdhno'syāṃ santi daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā, viṃśatirihādhikā viṃśaṃ śatamiti | nimittameva naimittikaṃ, yathā pūrṇo māso'syāṃ paurṇamāsī(ti), parisvatrasyāt parikheyo deśa iti | kārakaṃ ca antaraṅgabahiraṅgabhodād dvirūpamapi prakṛtyacupādheḥ kārakaviśiṣṭaṃ yathāyānayaṃ neya ayānayīnaḥ śāraḥ karaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyate caikṣuṣaṃ rūpaṃ, adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā śtrughne kṛto vā, labhyo vā, krīto vā satraughnaḥ, apādānaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā tantrādacirāhṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭa iti, kartṛviśiṣṭaṃ yathāśvairuhyate āśvo rathaḥ, kartṛrviśṣṭaṃ yathāśvairuhyate āśvo rathaḥ, kartṛviśeṣaṇamapi kartaiva, caturbhiruhyate cāturaṃ śakaṭaṃ, apica kaumārī sā bhavedbhāryā yāṃ kumāraḥ prapatsyate| prapadyate kumāri yaṃ sa kaumāro mataḥ patiḥ|| saṃpradānaviśiṣṭaṃ tu kārakaṃ nāsti | kartā karmaviśiṣṭo yathā śrāddhamanenādya bhuktaṃ śrāddhikaḥ, kriyāviśeṇabhitiśabdopasaṃhāraṃ ca karmaivaṃ, tiddhiśiṣṭo yathā pratikūlaṃ vartate pratikūlikaṃ, māśabda ityāha māśabdika iti, karaṇaviśiṣṭo yathākṣairdīvyati ākṣikaḥ adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭo yathā prāvṛṣikaḥ, prāvṛṣi bhavaḥ pravṛṣeṇyaḥ, apādānāviśiṣṭo yathā pituṃrāgataṃ pitryaṃ dhanaṃ iti | kratṛviśiṣṭaḥ kartā nāsti| karaṇaṃ karmaviśiṣṭaṃ yathā grīvāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ grīvāyā bhūṣaṇaṃ graiveyaṃ rukmadāma| evaṃ saṃpradānamapi yathā māṃsamebhyo niyuktaṃ dīyate māṃsikāḥ pitaraḥ | apādānaṃ kratṛviśiṣṭaṃ yathā vrīhayo bhavtyasmāt vraiheyaṃ kṣetram| evamadhikaraṇamapi yatā śarkarāḥ santi asmin śarkarilo deśaḥ | tadeva karmaviṣṭaṃ yathā padamasmin ddaśyaṃ padyaḥ kardamaḥ, karaṇāviśiṣṭamapi yathā daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ dāṇḍā krīḍā iti | karaṇādayo'sya viśiṣṭā na vidyante | karmakatrraurevākarakasaṃbandhinipātairviśeṣaṇayogaḥ | sa karmaṇo'kārakeṇa yathā māsāya bhūto māsikaḥ, samavatsaramadhīṣṭaḥ sāṃvatsarika iti, kartiryathā śaṃtāpāya prabhanati sāṃtāpikaḥ, varṣe bhūto bhāvī vā vārṣika iti | kramaṇaḥ saṃbandhinā yathā vākyapade adhikṛtyt tittiriṇā proktaṃ vidanti adhīyate vā taittirīyāḥ, pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhuktaṃ pītaṃ vā ebhiḥ pūrniṇā iti | kramaṇo nipāte na yathā yathākathāca kriyate yāthākathyamidaṃ, bahiḥ ddaśyate bāhyaṃ iti, karturyathārādṅavaḥ ārādīyaḥ sākṣāddraṣṭā sākṣī iti | nanu kriyayā'pi karmaṇaḥ karturvā viśeṣaṇayoghaḥ saṃbhavati, tadyathā pākena nirvṛttaṃ pākim, apamityāpamityakaṃ, yācitena yācitakaṃ iti, yathā ca susnnātaṃ pṛcchati sausnnātikaḥ, prabhatamāha prābhūtikaḥ, kṛtaḥ (taṃ)
