pūrvamanena kaṭaḥ kṛtapūrvī kaṭaṃ iti | ucyate kriyā'pi prākṛtaṃ karmaiva, atastadviśiṣṭayorapi karmakatrrauḥ karma(kartṛ)viśiṣṭatvameva bhavati| nanu ca nirvṛttamityetasya kathaṃ karmatā? idaṃ hyanudriktakarmośe karti (kartari vā) prayujyamānaṃ ddaśyate | naivam, antarbhūtaṇyarthatvenāsyā sakarmakatvamapi manyante, tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ “uttāraṇāya jagataḥ prapitāmahena tasmātpadāttvamasi rajjuriva pravṛttā|” mallanāgo'pyāha “nāgarakavṛttaṃ varteta” iti | atha kṛtapūrvī kaṭaṃ iti katham? na hyanena prayogeṇāpi bhavitavyam | kiṃ kāraṇam? dvitīyayā tāvat votpattavyam | tat kutaḥ? ktenābhihitam | pratyayonāpi notpattavyam | kiṃ kāraṇam? asāmathryat | kathamasāmathryam? sāpekṣamasamarthe bhavatīti| ucyate nāyaṃ karmaṇi ktaḥ, api tu bhāve | bhāvasādhanena ca kṛtaśabdena yocyate kriyā tayepsitaṃ kaṭādi karmānabhihitameveti | tatrala yathā grāmaṃ gato devadatta iti dhātuniṣṭhābhyāmabhidhīyamānayoḥ kriyākatrroḥ grāmādikarmabhirabhisaṃbandho bhavati, evaṃ kṛtapūrvīti kṛtaśabdena taddhitena vā'bhidhīyamānayoḥ kriyākatrroḥ kaṭādikarmabhirabhisaṃbandho bhavati, tathā hi kṛtaṃ pūrvamanenetyasminnarthe kṛtapūrvīśabdastaddhitānto vartate, tevana ca pūrvaṃ kṛtavānityayamarthaḥ saṃpadyate, evaṃ ca sāpekṣatvābhāvānnāstyasāmathryam, asti ca karotivācyakriyāpekṣaṃ kaṭasya karmatvamiti taddhitadvitīyotpattyornānutpattiḥ | taduktam avigrahā gatādisthā yathā grāmādikarmabhiḥ| saṃbadhyate kriyā tadvat kṛtapūrvādiṣu sthitā || iti || yadā tu kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kaṭo'neneti vigrahaḥ, tadā'pi na doṣaḥ, yataḥ yadyapi kṛtādiśabdāḥ karmaṇi vyutpādyamānāḥ māmānādhikaraṇyāte kaṭādikarmaviśeṣaṃ nirbhuñjate, tathā'pi netthaṃbhūtā eva pratyayamutpādayanti, vṛttīnāṃ viśeṣapratyāyanāsāmathryāte, ato vṛttiviṣayo'napekṣitaviśeṣakarmāvantarabhūtakarmasāmānyo'nya eva kṛtaśabdo bhavati| avivabhitakarmāṇo'ntarbhītakarmāṇaśrcākarmakā eva jāyante, yathā “tasmāddīkṣito na dadāti na pacati na jihoti “ iti | evamakarmakatve'ntarbhāvābhidhāyyeva, tañcanapekṣatvāt sāmathrye sati pratyayamutpādayati | pratyayārthaśca kartā kriyāyā prakṛtyarthena yadīpsati tat karmānabhihitaṃ pratyayena, tato dvitīyā bhavati| taduktaṃ bhāṣye “yo'sau kṛtakaṭayorabhisaṃbandhaḥ sa utpanne nivartate, asti ca karoteḥ kaṭena sāmathryamiti dvitīyā bhaviṣyati kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti “ | harirapyāha viśeṣakarmasaṃbandhe vinirbhukte kaṭā (kṛtā) dibhiḥ| viśeṣanirapekṣo'nyaḥ kaṭa (kṛta) śabdo'vakalpate|| akarmakatve satyevaṃ ktāntaṃ bhāvābhidhāyi yat| tena kriyāvatā katrrā yogo bhavati karmaṇām || iti| yadi vā śāstraprakriyābhyāsabādhitamatīnāmevāyamabhimāno vākyārthe vattayo bhavantīti | paramārthatastu vṛttivākyayoranyatvameva manyante, arthaviprakarṣāt | yathā hi vākye yaḥ kaṭādikarmasaṃbandhaḥ sa vṛttau nāsti, tasāyantarbhūtakarmaṇaḥ kṛtaśabdasaya bhāvābhidhāyitvāt, taduktaṃ viśeṣaḥ śrūyamāṇo'pi pradhānoṣu guṇoṣu vā| śabdāntaratvādvākyeṣu vṛttau nityaṃ na vidyate|| bhāṣyakāropyāha “nedamubhayaṃ yugapadṅavati vākyaṃ ca pratyayaśrca, yadā vākyaṃ na tadā pratyayaḥ, yadā pratyayaḥ sāmānyena tadā vṛttiḥ, tatrāvaśyaṃ viśeṣārthinā viśeṣaṇo'nuprayoktavyaḥ kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti” evamadhītamanena, adhītaṃ vyākaraṇamanena iti vā adhīti vyakaraṇe ityapi vyakhyātam| saṃbandhī dvidhā pradhānaṃ guṇabhūtaśrca | tayoḥ prathamāntabhidheyaḥ pradhānam, sa tridhādravyarūpaḥ, guṇarūpaḥ, abhinnarūpaśca | teṣu “tasyāpatyam” ityādirāśrayavacano dravyarupaḥ, sa dvidhā nirapekṣaḥ, sāpekṣarūpaśrca| tayoḥ nirāpekṣo yathā vasiṣṭhasyāpatyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaḥ, pāṇineḥ śiṣyaḥ pāṇinīyaḥ, pañcālānāṃ rāja pāñcālaḥ, pṛthivyāḥ īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ, pāṭalāyāḥ puṣpaṃ pāṭalaṃ, jambvāḥ phalaṃ jāmbavam iti| sāpekṣo yathā pituḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ, pitubhrrātā pitṛvyaḥ, mātubhrrātā mātulaḥ, bhrāturapatyaṃ bhrātṛvyaḥ, svasuḥ svastrīya iti | “tasyedaṃ” ityādirāśritaguṇavacano guṇarūpaḥ, sa dvidhā ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣyaḥ aṣaṣṭhīviśeṣyaśca | tayoḥ ṣaṣṭhīviśeṣyo yathā yuṣmākamiyaṃ gauḥ yauṣmākī gauḥ, devadattasya bhūtapūrvo devadattarūpyaḥ rājā, putrasya nimittaṃ putrīyaḥ saṃyogaḥ, vidiśāyā adūrabhavaṃ vaidiśaṃ nagaraṃ, mūrvāyāḥ vikāraḥ maurvaṃ bhasma, dūrvāyā avayavaḥ daurvaḥ kāṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ iti | aṣaṣṭhīviśeṣyo yāthā vatsebhyo hito vatsebhyo hito vatsīyo godhuk, aṅgārebhya imāni aṅgārīyāṇi kāṣṭhāni, śaraṇe sādhuḥ śaraṇyo rājā, ākarṣe kuśalaḥākarṣako dhūrtaḥ, puṣpaiḥ vittaḥ puṣpacaṇaḥ campakaḥ, sūryeṇaikadik saurī balākā iti | prakṛtyaikacchāyo'bhinnarūpaḥ, sa dvidhā liṅgasaṃkhyānupagrahī, liṅgasaṃkhyopagrāhī ca | tayorlugabhidheyo liṅgasaṃkhyopagrīhī, yathā gargasyāpatyāni gargāḥ, pañcālasya rājānaḥ pañcālāḥ, atreḥ apatyāni atrayaḥ, kusumbhyāḥ puṣpaṃ kusumbhaṃ, badaryaḥ phalaṃ badaraṃ, lavaṇena saṃsaṣṭaḥ lavaṇaḥ sūpaḥ iti | lubabhadheyo liṅgasaṃkhyopagrāhī, yathā pañcālānāṃ nivāsaḥ pañcālā ḍaḍḍatdhnapadaḥ, varaṇāḥ santyasmin varaṇa nagarī, śiriṣāṇāmadūrabhavaḥ vopagṛhṇāti, na vacanaṃ harītakyāḥ phalāni harītakyaḥ, khalatikādiṣu vacanameva, na vyaktiṃ bhinnādhikaraṇatvāt dvayamevāśrayate pitaraṃ putraṃ ca, tathāhy ubhayamapi saṃbandhādabhyadhikaṃ pratīyate karaṇaḥ, tathā'pyeka eva, bhede hi nobhayādhikaraṇa ekaḥ syāt, saṃbandhadvayaprasaṅgāt | so'yameko'nekāśrayaḥ, ekaścaiva vibhaktyocyate, ekasmādeva taddhitotpattirbhavati| evamapi pitureva ṣaṣṭhīti niyamo na syāt| kaḥ punarāha niyama iti, yāvatā mātuḥ pitā mātāmaha ityāpi bhavati| kutaḥ punaridaṃ yadekadā tu svāmino'nyadā tu svasmādvibhaktiḥ taddhito veti? saṃbandhasya padanyāsātirekāt | niyogato hi pitāputrayorekasya prādhānyamanyasyopasarjanatvaṃ, tulyatve saṃbandhābhāvāt| tatra na pradhānaṃ putrādi guṇanurodhena pravartitumarhati, upasarjanaṃ tu pitrādi yathā pradhānānugrahaḥ tathā''tmānaṃ nirvartayati, svarūpāvasthitau pradhānārthāsiddheḥ | ato'pradhāne saṃbandhasyādhikaḥ padanyāsaḥ | tatra ṣaṣṭhī taddhitotpattirvā bhavati| sā caikatvāt saṃbandhasya putragatamapyenamabhidhatte | yadā tu mātuḥ pitā mātāmahaḥ iti vivakṣātaḥ prādhānyaviparyayaḥ, tadā apatyādutpannayā ṣaṣṭhyā dviṣṭho'pyasāvabhihita iti na sā taddhito vā pitṛśabdāt, taduktaṃ dviṣṭhopyasau parārthatvādguṇeṣu vyatiricyate| tatrābhidhīyamānaśca pradhāne'pyupayucyate|| iti || evaṃ “tenaikadik” “tadartha vikṛteḥ prakṛtau” “tasya nimittam” “tena vittaścuñcupcayaṇapau” “tasmai hitam” vatupprakaraṇe “yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ dhandasi sāddaśya upasaṃkhyānam” ityādiṣu sahārthatādathryavittahitalakṣaṇopapadapariśeṣādayaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣāḥ ṣaṣṭhyantā api dviṣṭhatvādekavibhaktivācyatvenāvagantavyāḥ | nanu ca tṛtīyādīnāṃ vyatirekavibhaktitvāt ṣaṣṭhīvadeva bhavati, saṃbandhābhidhānasāmathryate, prathamāyāḥ punaravyatiriktaprātipadikārthābhidāyinyāḥ kathamivaitadupapadyate tvāmiva tvāvān, ahamivamavān iti| atraike varṇayanti tvāvataḥ puruvaso, yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ, na tvāvānanyo divyo na pārthiva iti prathamāntāyāḥ prakṛteḥ pradhānabhūte'pi saṃbāndhini prayogadarśanāt pratyayo'vagamyate | anye tvāhur tvamiva tvāvān, ahamiva māvān ityupamānamatra prathamāntaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ, upameyaṃ pratyayārthaḥ| na tatra tāvadavacdhedakatvādupamānaṃ pradhānam | avacchedakādapyupamānāt ṣaṣṭhī notpadyate, vyatirekahetorasaṃbhavāt, ivaśabdo hyasattvabhūtābhidhāyitvānna vyatirkābhidhāyakaḥ, sāddaśyadyotako hyasau| anyaśca na kaścidiha vyati rkahetuḥ śrūyate | ataśca gauriva gavayaḥ ityādāvivatra ṣaṣṭhyā abhāvaḥ, vyatirekahetau tu satīvaśabdaprayoge upamānāt ṣaṣṭhyatpadyate devadattasyeva yajñadattasya dantā iti | taduraktam ivaśabdaprayoge tu bāhyāt saṃbandhino vinā | nādhikyamupamāne'sti dyotakaḥ sa prayajyate|| mā bhūt ṣaṣṭhī, prathamayā'pi na bhavitavyameva, upamānasyāvacchedakatvenāpyādhikyāt | kaḥ punarāhānadhika eva prātipadikārthe prathameti, pāṭaliputrādrājakaṃ sapta yojanāni, saptasu vā yojaneṣu ityadhvanaḥ prathamā saptamī ca smaryate, saṃbodhane ca prathamaiva vidhīyate, dhik devadattaṃ, hā devadattaṃ, iti ca dvitīyāviṣaye prathamāprayogo ddaśyate, yathā “hā dhikkaṣṭaniṣṭamastakaruṇaḥ ko'yaṃ vidheḥ prakramaḥ |” “kanyāntaḥpurameva hā praviśati kruddho munirbhārgavaḥ ||” iti|| ṣaṣṭhyantābhidheyo guṇabhūtaḥ, sa tridhā bhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ, kārakaviśiṣṭaḥ, samavandhiviśiṣṭaśca | teṣu bhāvenāvacchinno bhāvaviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā mukhyena, upādhinā ca | tayormukhyena yathā kṛṣirasyāstīti kṛṣīvalaḥ, māyāvī, āmayāvī, dayāluḥ, śraddhāluḥ iti| upādhinā yathā mṛdaṅgo vādyata iti śilpamasya mārdaṅgikaḥ, apūpāḥ kriyanta iti śilpamasya āpūpikaḥ, māsaṃ brahmacaryamasya bhikṣoḥ māsikaḥ, asti paraloka iti matirasya sādhoḥ āstikaḥ, nāsti narakādikamiti matirasyāsādhoḥ sa nāstikaḥ, diṣṭameva prabhanatīti matirasya jigīṣoḥ daiṣṭikaḥ iti | kārakeṇāvacchinnaḥ kārakaviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā śvatantreṇa ca | tayoḥ svatantreṇa yathā dhanamasyāstīti dhanavān vadānyaḥ, pañcamo'sya māso jātasya vartate pañcamo bālakaḥ, prāsādo'sya syāt prāsādīyaṃ dāru, tārakaḥ saṃjātā asya tārakitaṃ nabhaḥ, samayaḥ prāpto'sya sāmayikaṃ karma, ekamanyat karmādhyayane vṛttamasya aikānyikaḥ iti | asvatantreṇa yathā lavaṇaṃ paṇyamasya prāsthikaḥ, vāsudeve bhaktirasya vāsudevakaḥ, dhanuḥ praharaṇamasya dhānuṣkaḥ, prasthaḥ parimāṇamasya prasthikaḥ, salāturo'syābhijanaḥ sālāturīyaḥ, grāmo nivāso'sya grāmāṇaḥ iti | saṃbandhināvacchinnaḥ saṃbandhiviśiṣṭaḥ, sa dvidhā viśeṣyeṇa, viśeṣaṇena ca | tayoḥ viśeṣyeṇa yathāpūpā hitā eṣāṃ āpūpikāḥ avantayaḥ, mīlamābarhi eṣāṃ mūlyā māṣāḥ, bṛhatyādirasya bārhataḥ pragāthaḥ, kālaḥ prakṛṣṭo'sya kākalikamṛṇam, kiṃca niśāsaṃbavdhādhyayanamapi niśā, tadasya soḍhaṃ naiśaḥ, evaṃ praidoṣikaḥ iti | viśeṣaṇena yathendro devatā asya aindraṃ haviḥ, saṃśaptakāḥ yoddhāro'sya sāṃśaptakaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ, vinayaḥ prayojanamasyāṃ vainayikī vidyā, devadatto grāmaṇīrasya daivadattakaḥ saṅgaḥ, pañca avayavāḥ asyāṃ pañcatayī gatiḥ, pañca asya bhṛtirvasnne vā pcakaḥ padārthaḥ iti | nanu ca “tasyāpatyam” ityādau upagorapatyaṃ aupagavaḥ iti “samarthānāṃ pratamādvā” ityadhikārāt ṣaṣṭhyantā prakṛtirapatyāvato guṇabhūtasya vācikā, prathamāntaṃ tu pradhānabhūtamapatyaṃ pratyayārtha eva | “tasyedam” ityādāvapi pradhānaṃ saṃbandhi taddhitavācyamityupapadyate | “sā'sya devatā” ityādau tu indro devatā asya endraṃ haviḥ iti pūrvoḍāśādirasayetyanenādhānabhūtasaṃbandhivācakatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ pratyāyārthaḥ | tatkathamivāyaṃ viprayastaḥ pradhānaguṇaṅāva upapanno bhavati? ucyate guṇabhūto'pi saṃbandhī buddhyantareṇāpradhānābhāvāt pracyāvyāsāditapradhānabhāvaḥ pratyayārthatvena pradaśryate| ata eva indro devatā asyetyetāvāneva vigraho na kāryaḥ, vṛttisamānārthena hi tena bhavitavyam| na caitāvato vṛttisamānārthatā, vṛttau hi indrādidevatāvacchinnaṃ puroḍāśādyavagamyate, vākye tu puroḍāśādyavacchinnendrādidevateti| ayaṃ tu vigraho vṛttyā samānārtha indro devatā asya tadidamindrasvāmyavacchinnamaindraṃ haviḥ iti | tadidamuktam anantaroktaḥ sabandhī pratipadya pradhānatām| buddhyantarapāramarśādvācyatāṃ pratipadyate|| prakṛtyarthāviśiṣṭo hi pratyayārtho'bhidhānabhāk| nyāyaḥ sa nataḥ sāsyetyadhikārasāmāśrayāt|| evaṃ “so'syadiriti chandasaḥ pragātheṣu” ityādāvapi guṇabhūtaḥ saṃbandhī taddhitābhidheyo boddhavyaḥ | yatra tu guṇabhūtaḥ saṃbandhī pratyayārthaḥ tatra na pradhānam, yatra pradhānaṃ tatra na guṇabhūtaḥ, kutaḥ punaridaṃ jñāyate? ācāryapravṛtijrñāpayati yadayaṃ nivāsanivāsavatsaṃbandhe ubayamāha “tasya nivāsaḥ” “so'sya nivāsaḥ” iti| nanu ca apatyāpatyavatsaṃbandhe'pyubhayaṃ saṃbhāvyate mātā apatyamasya mātāmahaḥ, pitā'patyamasya pitāmahaḥ iti| naivam, pituḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ, mātuḥ pitā mātāmahaḥ iti kariṣyate| tathā'pi hṛdayasya bandhanaṃ śṛṅkhalamasya bandhanaṃ karabhe, iti katham? nānyotra bandhanaśabdaḥ sabāndhivacano yathā hi bandhanamityanenadāmocyate | naivam bandhanamityanena saṃjñāśabdopāśrayaḥ śṛṅkhalakaḥkarabha iti| evaṃ ca nivāsatadvatorapi śeṣaṣaṣṭhyabhyupagamatve kartṛviśiṣṭamadhikaraṇaṃ vācyaṃ śibīnāṃ nivāsaḥ śaibaḥ iti, aparatra adhikaraṇaviśiṣṭaḥ kartā grāmo nivāso'sya so'yaṃ grāmyaḥ iti | nanu ca grāmaśabdo'yaṃ samūhavacanaḥ, tadyathā “aśvagrāmavidhau kṛti na samareṣvasyāsti tulyaḥ pumān” “na rūṇātsīndriyagrāmam” iti | kiṃ cātaḥ? samūhaśca samūhyapekṣa iti sāpekṣatvādasāmathrye taddhitotpattirna bhavati| na ca sāmānyena samūhādbhaviṣyatīti vācyam, tāvatyevārthe tasyāparisamāpterduradhigamābhidhāne ca sāmathryabhāvāt | na ca yatā devadattasya mātuḥ pitā mātāmaho devadattasya, viṣṇumitrasya guroḥ kulaṃ gurukulaṃ viṣṇumitrasyeti taddhitaḥ samāso vā bhavati, evamasyāpi bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, na hyayaṃ saṃbandhuśabdānāmeva ca sāpekṣāṇāṃ vṛttayo bhavanti, yadāha saṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ pravartate| svārthavat sā vyapekṣā'sya vṛttāvapi na hīyate|| anyeṣāṃ tu saviśeṣaṇānāṃ na vṛttiḥ, vṛttānāṃ vā na viśeṣaṇamityeva, na hi bhavati ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ṛddharājapuruṣa iti, nāpi brāhmaṇānāṃ grāmo nivāso'sya brāhmaṇānāṃ grāmyo'yamiti | kathaṃ tarhi rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ śobhano rājapuriṣaḥ śobhanaḥ iti? bhavati vai pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi vṛttiḥ | kathaṃ tarhi grāmo nivāso'syoti grāmasya viśeṣyatvāt prādhānye sāpekṣsayāpi vṛttirna bhavati? anantaroktanyayenātra ṣaṣṭhyarthasya prādhānyāt | nanu, ayamapi saṃbandhiśabdaḥ kasmānna bhavati? samūhārthamātra eva vṛttyaparisamāpteḥ | tarhi na bhavitavyameva grāmaśabdānnivāsanivāsavtasaṃbandhe taddhitena? na bhavitavyam, yathāvyutpannajanasamūhāspadārtho'yamupacāravṛttyā bhavati, ddaśyate tātsthyāt tadvadupacāraḥ, yathā mañcāḥ krośantīti, yadi vā grāmaśabdoyaṃ bahvarthaḥ, yathāsti śālāsamudāye grāmo dagdha iti, janapadasamudāye grāma āgata iti, asti vāṭaparikṣepe grāmaṃ praviṣṭa iti, sāraṇyake sasīmake sasthaṇḍiḍḍatdhlake ca bhūpradeśe grāmo labdha iti, asti avyutpannajanasamūhāspade “śūdrakarṣakapraye janapadaṃ niveśayet, tatra aṣṭaśagrāmamadhye pradhānaṃ sthāpanīyam, sa nāgarāṇāṃ nivāso nagaramiti |” tatra avyutpannajanasamūhāspade yo grāmaśabdo vartate, tato bhavitavyaṃ taddhitena grāmo nivāsaḥ asyeti so'yaṃ grāmyaḥ grāmyaḥ grāmīṇaḥ iti || atha svārthikāḥ | te'pi dvidhāsattvabhītārthāḥ, sattvabhūtārthāśca | ubhaye'pi pratyekaṃ ṣoḍhāvācakāḥ, dyotakāḥ, viśeṣakāḥ, sabābhidhāyakāḥ, sārthakāḥ, nirarthakāśrceti| tatra asattvabhūtārtheṣu śaktimātrābhīdhāyino vācakāḥ, yathā tata āgataḥ, tatra vasati, purastādāgataḥ, purastadvasati, devatrā gacchati, manuṣyatrā tiṣṭhati iti | padārthagatakutsāpraśaṃsādyabhivyañjakāḥ dyotakāḥ, yathā kutsitaṃ pacati pacataki, praśastaṃ pacati pacatirūpaṃ, īṣadasamāptaṃ pacati pacatikalpaṃ, prakṛṣṭaṃ pacati pacatitarām, evaṃ nitārāṃ, atīvatarāṃ iti | vācakatve dyotakatve vā maṅgalavīpsādyadhikārthābhidhāyino viśeṣakāḥ, yatā bahubhyo dehi bahuśo dehi iti | alpaṃ dehi alpaśo dehi iti, dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dehi, māṣaṃ māṣaṃ dehi māṣaśo dehi, evaṃ kasmin kāle kadā, kena prakāreṇa kathamiti | anuprayogādyapekṣiṇaḥ sahābhidhāyakāḥ, yathānagniragniḥ saṃpadyate agnisātsaṃpadyate, devāya deyaṃ karoti devatrākaroti | evaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ tato bhavantaṃ, etena dīrghāyuṣā atra dīrghāyuṣā, asmai āyuṣmate ihāyuṣmate, kasya devānāṃ priyasya kka devānāṃ priyasya iti | gatisaṃjñādikāryanimittabhūtāḥ sārthakāḥ, yathā śuklīkṛtya, paṭapaṭāyate, dvedhākāraṃ, abhito grāmaṃ, vinā devadattena, dakṣiṇāhi grāmāt iti | śabdopacayādimātrahetavo nirarthakāḥ, yathorasi pratyeva pratyurasaṃ, ātmanyadhyeva ādhyātmaṃ, girimanveva anugiraṃ, uñcaireva uñcakaiḥ, tvayaiva tvayakā, asmābhireva asmākābhiḥ iti | evamanye'pi devā arjunato'bhavan, pūrvāto grāmasya, grāmaṃpūrveṇa, purastādramaṇīyaṃ, ekadhyaṃ karoti, pañcakṛtvaḥ pacati ityādayaḥ asattvabhūtārthāḥ svārthikeṣu yathāyogamavagantavyāḥ | anye tu vatimapi śaktyabhidhāyiṣu viśeṣakasvārthikeṣu varṇayanti, yathā rājñeva vyavahṛtamanena rājavat, devamiva bhavantaṃ paśyāmi devadat ityādyudāhṛtaṃ purastāt | evaṃ ca sūtre vyācakṣatetena tulyam ityetasminnarthe vatirbhavati yattulyaṃ kriyā cet sā bhavati | kriyetyanena kriyānimittabhūtāḥ śaktayaṃ ucyante | na caitadvācyam evaṃ sati kriyā na saṃgṛhītā bhavati, yataḥ kriyā'pi kārakameva, yathocyate kriyāmanye tu manyante kkacidapyanapāśritām| sādhanaikārthabhāvitve pravṛttimanapāyinīm|| sāmānyabhūtā sā pūrvaṃ dhātvarthaiḥ pravibhajyate| tato vyāpārarūpeṇa sādhye ca vyavatiṣṭhete|| prakṛtiḥ sādhanānāṃ sā prathamaṃ tañca kārakam| śaktirevādhikaraṇe strotovadupakarṣati|| apūrvaṃ kālaśaktiṃ vā kriyāṃ vā kālameva vā| tamaivaṃlakṣaṇaṃ bhāvaṃ kecidāhuḥ kathaṃcana|| iti|| tatra tasyevetyasya ca prayojanamupanyastaṃ purastād ravyaguṇayostulyayoḥ pratyayo na labhyata iti| nanvevaṃ sati devadatta iva sthūlaḥ, yajñadatta iva gomān, ityatra pratyayo na prāpnoti, saptimī ṣaṣṭhyantatvayorabhāvāt| atrāpi kriyāgrahaṇādbhaviṣyati | kathaṃ punaḥ kriyāśabdena guṇa ucyate? kriyāpūrvaṃkatvāt, sthūlaguṇayogāddhi sthūlo bhavati, gausaṃbandhāñca gomān iti | nanvevaṃ sati kriyāgrahaṇamapi na kartavyam, prarvatāmaviśeṣeṇaiva tena tulyaṃ ityetasminnarthe vatiḥ | “tatra tasyeva” ityanena ca nārthaḥ sūtrārambheṇa | “tadarham” ityetadapyupamānānna vyatiricyate, yaddhi vṛttaṃ rājānamarhati tadrājasaddaṣameva bhavati| evaṃ ca tena tulyamityevāvatiṣṭhate | tathā cāha canādragomī “ive vatiḥ” iti | nanveva sati gauriva gavaya ityātrāpi vatiḥ prānpoti | naivam, upamāyāṃ vatiḥ, naipamāne | yadyapi vatiśabdenobhayamapi dyotyate, tathā'pyanyadevaupamyam, anyadevopamānam, bhūyo'vayavasāddaśyasya yogo hyupamā, yathā candra iva mukham| saddaśāt saddaśapratipattirupamānam, yathā gauriva gavaya iti|| sattvabhītārthabhedeṣu liṅgaviśeṣādyabhidhāyino vācakāḥ, yathā deva eva devatā, devataiva daivataṃ, upadhireva aupadheyaṃ, bhāga eva bhāgadheyaṃ, upāya eva aupayikaṃ, catvā ra eva varṇāḥ cāturvaṇryaṃ iti | kutsāpraśaṃsādyabhivyaṃjakā dyotakāḥ, yathā kutsito vaiyākaraṇaḥ vaiyākaraṇapāśaḥ, praśastā mṛt mṛtsnnā, tanuḥ ukṣā ukṣataraḥ, laghuḥ kuṭī kuṭūrakaḥ, īṣadasamāptaḥ āḍhyaḥ āḍhyakalpaḥ, bhūtāpūrvo rājā rājacaraḥ iti | vācakatve dyotakatve vāvyāhṛtatvādyarthaviśeṣavyaktihetavaḥ viśeṣakāḥ, yathā vyāhṛtārthā vāgeva vācikam, upadeśarūpaṃ karmaiva kārmāṇam, asahāya eka evaṃ ekākī, aśva ivāyamaśvakaḥ, kuśāgramiva kuśāgrīyā buddhiḥ, śileva śaileyaṃ dadhi iti | prakṛtiviśeṣebhyo nityamupajāyamānāḥ sahābhidhāyakāḥ, yathā karīṣagandherapatyaṃ karūṣagandhyā, abhijīto'patyāmābhijityaḥ, kuñjasyāpatyaṃ kauñjāyanyaḥ, parasparaṃ vividha ākrośovyākrośī, samantādravaḥ sāṃrāviṇaṃ, rājñāmāyāttaṃ rājādhīnam iti | “lupi yuktavadvyaktivacane” iti kāryārthāḥ sārthakāḥ, yathā cañcā ramaṇīyam, vardhikā draśanīyaḥ, vāsudevaḥ pratimā, baladevaścitraṃ, devapathaḥ ākāśarekhā, haṃsapathaḥ krauñcaṃ iti | śabdopacayādimātrahetavaḥ nirarthakāḥ, yathā prajña eva prājñaḥ, vinaya eva vainayikaḥ, mṛttikā, sūra eva sūryaḥ, nāmaiva nāmadheyaṃ, devānāṃ rājaiva devarājaḥ iti | evaṃ kataraḥ, katamaḥ paṭutaraḥ, paṭutamaḥ, . paṭiṣṭhaḥ, paṭīyān ityādayo'pi sattatavabhūtāḥ svārthāḥ svārthikeṣu yathāyogamavagantavyāḥ | kiṃ punaramī padaprakṛtayaḥ prātipadikapratṛyo vā? kutaste saṃśayaḥ? ubhayathopalambhāt, tathā hyeṣāṃ yuṣmakābhiḥ, kadā, tarhityādau prātipadikaprakṛtitvam, bhindaki, tvayaka, mayaki ityādau padaprakṛtitvamupalabhyate | tataśca yāvakaḥ, aśvakaḥ, uccakaiḥ ityādau saṃdehaḥ, na saṃdehaḥ, svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyāśaktimātrābhidhānena prātipadikāt svārthādinimittakutsāpraśaṃsānukampātiśayaparisamāptyadhikārthadyotanena padāgadeva svārthikotpattirabhanatīti| svārthadyabhidhānena hi parisamāptārthe padaṃ svārthadinimittakaiḥ kutsādibhiḥ saṃbandhamutsahate, tadāha kutsāpraśaṃsātiśayaiḥ samāptārtha tu yujyate| padaṃ svārthādayaḥ sarve yasmāktutsādihetavaḥ|| yadyapi svārthādyanyatamanibandhanāḥ kkacit kutsādayo bhaveyuḥ, tathā'pi tatsākalyārthaṃ padādeva kādayaḥ utpādyāḥ | tatra anyatamanibandhanāḥ kutsādayo yathā kiṃ dvāri daivahatike sahakārakeṇa saṃvradhitena viṣavṛkṣaka eṣa pāpaḥ| yasminmanāgapi vikāsavikārabhāji bhīmā bhavanti madanajvasaṃnipātāḥ|| atra hi daivahataśabdena labdhāyāṃ nītyupādhau sarvathaivānukampyamānatāyāṃ, sahakārakaṃvardhananibandhanatvamevāsyāḥ kapā dyotyata evaṃ nāma tvaṃ daivopahatā'si, yat sahakāracchadmānāṃ viṣapādapaṃ dvāri saṃpardhayasi iti | viṣapādapaśabdena labdhāyāṃ sahakārasya sarvathaiva kutsāyāṃ, pādapavikāsakāle kāmināmasahyasmarajvarasaṃnipātahetukatvamaivāsyāḥ kapratyayena pratyāyyate | taduktaṃ kutsitatvena kutsyo vā na samyagvā vikutsitaḥ| svaśabdābhihite kena viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ pratīyate|| na ca sāṃpratikī kutsā śabdābhede pratīyate| pūjyate kutsitatvepi praśastatve'pi kutsyate|| tadyathaika iha jīvaloke jīvatirūpaṃ nṛrūpapaśurūpaḥ| yaḥ premapāśapāśe mṛga iva na mṛgīddaśāṃ patati|| evamanukampāpraśaṃsayorapi vācyamiti | anukābhikābhīkādayo'pi svārthikapratyāntā eva | teṣāmanvādibhirhi kriyāviśeṣaḥ kaścidākṣipyate, tatra ca kāmayate ityādau pratyayo bhavan svārthe eva bhavati| nanu ca “anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamitā” ityatra anukāmāyate'sau ityanukaḥ, abhikāmayate'sau ityabhikaḥ, abhīko veti vṛttisamānārthavākyakalpanāyāṃ dhātoḥ pūrvamuparasargeṇa saṃbandhaḥ, sādhanena vā? kiṃ cātaḥ? yadyupasargeṇa, prakṛtyartho vaktavyaḥ, anukāmayate, abhikāmayate ityarthe pratyayasyaivetpādāt | atha sādhanena, paścādupasargayogo na ghaṭate, na hyasattvavacanā anvādayaḥ sattvabhūtārthavacanaiḥ saha saṃbandhamutsahante | yathecchasi tathā'stu| astu tāvat kamaḥ prathamamupasarherṇaiva saṃbandhaḥ | nanu coktaṃ prakṛtyarthe vāktavyaṃ iti | sa nāsti pṛthak, pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇabhūtasyaivānvādeḥ prakṛtibhāvāt, yathā “bhṛśādibhyo bhuvyacveḥ” ityatra manasvī suṣṭu bhavati sumanayate, durmanāyate, abhi-abhimanāyate iti sudurabhīnāṃ pratyayārthabhavamane viśeṣaṇatve'pi prakṛtibhāvaḥ | nanu asumanāḥ sumanā bhavatīti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇatvamapi sudurabhīnāṃ kasmānna bhavati? tathā sati svamanāyata, duramanāyata, ityaḍāgamaḥ svādīnāṃ pūrvataḥ prāpnoti, yathāsaṃgrāmayateti | tatra saṃgrāmayateḥ sopasargasyaiva curādiṣu pāṭha iti cet, ihāpi tat samānam, bhṛśādiṣu hi sumanasaṃ, durmanas, abhimas iti prakṛtayaḥ paṭhyante| yadyevaṃ, anvarudhyatetivat sa bhaviṣṭati | naivam, yadyapi “ano rudha kāme” iti divādiṣu paṭhyate, tathā'pi yathā arudhyateti ddaśyate naivamamanāyateti | tarhi pratyayārthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe, yathā śyena ivācarati śyenāyate ityatra āṅaḥ prayoga uktārthatvānna bhavati, evaṃ sumavāyata ityādau svādīnāmapi na bhavet | naivam, tatra hi āṅartha eva pratyayārthaviśeśaṇam, iha tu tatra svādīnāmarthāḥ, tataśca manāyata ityukte na jñāyate suṣṭhu duṣṭhu abhi vā manasvī bhavatīti svādayaḥ prayujyante, yathā “pucchabhāṇḍaḍḍatdhcīvarāṇṇiṅ” ityatra “pucchādudasane vyasane paryasane ca” iti pucchamudasyati utpucchayate, vyasyati vipucchayate, paryasyati piripucchayate iti, evaṃ anukāmayate anukaḥ, abhikāmayate abhikaḥ, abhīke veti| astu vā pūrvaṃ kameḥ sādhanena saṃbandhaḥ| nanu coktaṃ paścadupasargayogo na ghaṭata iti | nipātā anvadayo bhaviṣyaty anurūpaḥ kamitā anukaḥ, abirūpaḥ abhikaḥ, abhāko veti | tathā'pi, anuko'nukamitā, abhiko'bhikamitā iti vaktavyaṃ syāte, yathā “utka unmanāḥ” iti| naivam, sāmānyenāpi viśeṣabhidhānaṃ ddaśyate, tadyathā “gamlṛ sṛplṛ gatau” ityatra hi gacchatītigauḥ, sarpatīti sarpaḥ iti gamanasarpaṇoyaryadyapi mahān viśeṣaḥ tathā'pi gatāvityaviśeṣeṇa nirdiśyate etena “nat nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṭūṭañnāṭajbhraṭacaḥ” ityadyapi vyākhyātam, atra hi nāsikāyāḥ avaṭīṭanaṃ, avanamanaṃ, avabhraṃśaḥ iti nativiśeṣā nate ityānenasāmānyaśabdenābhidhīyanta iti | upasargato vā na doṣaḥ, anurūpaṃ kāmayate, abhirūpaṃ kāmayata iti kriyābhāgamātreṇaiva saṃbandhādanvādayaḥ pratyayārthe viśiṃṣantaḥ prakṛtibhāvaṃ lapsyante, yathā śumanāyate, vipucchayate iti | viṣama upanyāsaḥ, tatra hi manaḥpucchādikāyāḥ parakṛteḥ śravaṇaṃ vidyate, iha tu tadrandho'pi nāsti, yataḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ utpadyeta | naivam, iyān, iyat, adhunā ityādāvapiprakṛteraśravaṇāt | tatra pratyayanimittā prakṛternivṛttiḥ iti cet, ihāpi nipātananimittā bhaviṣyati | kaścaivamāha prakṛteḥ para eva pratyayobhavatīti? “avyayasarvanāmnāmakac prak ṭeṛḥ” “vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāttu pūrvasya” samāsāntāśca sarve ṭajādayaḥ bhavanti | api ca, prakṛtiḥ pratyayaḥ iti rūpasiddhimātrametat | idaṃ tu arthavattvam ayaṃ śabdo'sminnarthe sādhirbhavatīti | sa cakkacidevamucyate “anukābhikābhīkaḥ kamītā” iti, kkacidvā “nate nāsikāyāḥ saṃjñāyāṃ ṭīṭaḍhnāṭajbhraṭacaḥ” iti, kkacidutkarṣaḥ “anupadyanveṣṭā” iti, kkacat “śrotriyaśchanando'dhīte” “kṣetriyace parakṣetre cikitsayate (syaḥ)” iti kkacat “upādhibhyāṃ tyaktrāsannārūḍhayoḥ” “atyabhūtilomābhaṅgābhyo rajasi kaṭac” iti, kkacat “avaiḥ saṃghāte kaṭac” “dugdhe soḍhajūḍhamarīsacaḥ” iiti, kkacat “paśunāmabhyaḥ sthāne goṣṭhac” “dvitvai nauyugac, “ “ṣaṭtve ṣaṅgavac” iti, bhavane kṣetre śākaṭaśākinau, “snehe tailac” iti, kkacit “niṣphalatilātpiñjapaijau” “vāco vyāhṛtārthāyāṃ ṭhak” iti, kkacat, rūḍhito'rthamanirdiśyaiva “veḥ śālacchaṅkaṭacau” “saṃprodaśca kaṭat” “avātkuṭārañca” “nerbiḍaḍḍatdhjvirīsacau” “inacpiḍāñcikaci ca” kacikādeśaśca, iti | nanu ca dhātuḥ prathamaṃ sādhanena saṃbadhyate, paścādupasargeṇa, tatkathamucyate? yathecchasi tathā'stu, viśeṣyaṃ hi pūrvasuddhaṃ viśeṣaṇasaṃbanavdhamanubhavati, viśeṣyaśca dhātvarthaḥ, kriyārūpa upasargāṇāṃ, uktaṃ ca “kriyāvacano dhītuḥ” iti, kriyā ca sādhyamucyate, sādhyaṃ ca sādhanasaṃbandhamantareṇa na syāt| taduktaṃ prayogārheṣu siddhassanbhettavyo'rtho viśiṣyate | prāk ca sādhanasaṃbandhātkriyā naivopajāyate|| tanna, bhāvisaṃbandhayogyatāsamāśrayaṇāt | idaṃ cāvaśyamabhyupagantavyam, anyathā hi kriyāvacano dhātuḥ ityapi na syāt| na ca “dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ sāmānakartṛtādicchāyāṃ vā” iti sana utpattiḥ, tadāha dhātossādhanayogasya bhāvinaḥ prakramādyathā | dhātutvaṃ karmabhāvaśrca tathā'nyadapi ddaśyatām|| yadi ca dhātoḥ pūrvapasargeṇa saṃbandho na syāt, kathamucyate “viparābhyāṃ jeḥ” “adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma” iti? nanu pūrvamupasargasaṃbandhaḥ kkopayujyate? sādhanasaṃbandhamantareṇa tadviśeṣanabhivyakteḥ | naivam, phalakāle bījasaṃskārasyeva tasyopayogāt, taduktaṃ bījakāleṣu saṃbaddhā yathā lākṣārasādayaḥ | varṇādipariṇāmena phalānāmupakurvate || buddhisyādabhisaṃbandhāttathā dhātūpasargayoḥ | ambhantarīkṛto bhaidaḥ padakāle prakāśate || aḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaktvena prakalpanam | dhātūpasargayoḥ śāstre dhātureva hi tāddaśaḥ|| kriyāviśeṣāḥ saṃghātauḥ prakramyante kkacittayoḥ | tathā hi saṃgrāmayateḥ sopasargādaṭo vidhiḥ|| ataḥ anukāmayate ityādau dhātoḥ prathamamupasargeṇa sādhanena vā saṃbandhe na doṣa iti| upasargāṇāṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇatve trayī gatir vācakatvaṃ, dyotakatvaṃ, sahābhidhāyakatvaṃ ca, yathocyate sa vācako viśeṣaṇāṃ saṃbhavāt dyotako'pi vā| śktyādhānāya dhatorvā sahakārī prayujyate|| tatra yadā vācakatvaṃ tadā dhātoḥ prathamamupasargeṇa saṃbandhaḥ, yathā pratiṣṭhate, nirākareti iti | yadā dyotakatvaṃ tadā sādhanena, yachā prapacati, nikarṣati iti | yadā sahābhidhāyakatvaṃ tadā dhātūpasargayostulyakālaṃ sādhanena saṃbandhaḥ, yathādhūte, adhyeti iti | taduktaṃ svādibhiḥ kaivasairyatra gamanādi na gamyate | tatrānumānāt dvividhāttaddharmā pradirucyate || kkacitsaṃbhāvino bhedāḥ kaivalairabhidarśitāḥ | upargeṇa saṃbandhe vyajyante praparādinā || yadā'bhidhānasāmathryaṃ dhātornaikākinastadā | dhātūpasargau saṃbhūya samarthāvarthamāhatuḥ|| iti| nanu ca, prathamataḥ sādhanasaṃbandhe prapacatītyatra prakṛṣṭaḥ pacatīti syāt, na tu prakṛṣṭaṃ pacatīti| tanna, sādhu pacatītyādāvapi samānadoṣatvāt tatra kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt kriyāmātreṇaiva saṃbandha iti cet, ihāpi sa evārthaḥ | kathaṃ ca prādayaścadivasattvavacanāḥ kriyāviśeṣakāḥ kartṛviśeṣaṇaṃ bhaveyuḥ? “upasārgāḥ kriyāyoge” iti vacanāt | kathaṃ punasattvavacanāścādayo bhavanti? ucyate teṣāmuñcavacārthatvāt sarvasaṃbandhadarśanāt | anyatantratayodbhūterasattvārthatvamucyate|| atha kimati vācakāḥ, uta dyatakāḥ iti | tatraike varṇayanti “tatprayogāvaseyatvādvācyasteṣāṃ sa gamyate | samuñcayādirarthātmā yathā'nyeṣāṃ gavādikaḥ||” anye tvāhuḥ “ṣaṣṭhyabhāvāsattvokterekānukteḥ parasthiteḥ | guṇabhāvātsmṛteścaiṣāṃ dyotakatvaṃ suniścitam||” iti || tadetadagrataḥ prātipadikārthanirṇaye niśceṣyata iti neha pratnayate|| atha pṛthagrathānāmekārthībhāvaḥ samāsaḥ| sa tridhā prākṛtaḥ, vaikṛtaḥ, śeṣaśca | teṣu samastapadānāptavyayībhāvadisaṃjñānimittaṃ pūrvapadapradhānādikā prakṛtiḥ, tatra bhavaḥ prākṛtaḥ | sa caturdhāavyayībhāvaḥ, tatpuruṣaḥ, bahuvrīhiḥ, dvandvaḥ iti| teṣu pūrvapadapradhāno'vyayībhāvaḥ | sa tridhāvyayānāṃ, anavyayānāṃ, karmapravacanīyānāṃ ca | tatra avyayānāṃ yathādhistri, upakumbham, atitaisṛkaṃ, sasakhi, yāvadamatraṃ, bahurgāmaṃ iti | karmapravatanīyānāṃ yathāpatrigartaṃ, paritrigarte, āprapadaṃ, āpāṭaliputraṃ, anuvanaṃ, anuvanaṃ, anugaṅgaṃ iti| uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ | so'pi tridhā vyadhikaraṇaḥ, samānādhikaraṇaḥ, dviguśca, tatra vyadhukaraṇo yathā rājapuruṣaḥ, kaṣṭaśritaḥ, śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, dhānyārthaḥ, yūpadāru, vṛkabhayam, kumbhīpākaḥ iti, samānādhikaraṇo yathā nīlotpalaṃ, ekapuruṣaḥ, kevalānnam, trilokaharmyaṃ, pañcapūlī, catuḥpātraṃ iti | anyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiḥ, sa tridhā pradhānasaṃndhyarthaḥ, apradhānasaṃbandhyarthaḥ, kārakārthaśca, teṣu pradhānasaṃbandhyartho yathā dakṣiṇasyāśca pūrvasyāśca diśoryadntarālaṃ sā dakṣiṇapūrvā, evaṃ dakṣiṇāparā, sahāgniyā vartate sāgniḥ, savaṃśaputraḥ, keśeṣu keśeṣu gṛhūtvedaṃ yuddhaṃ pravartate keśākeśi, daṇḍaiḍḍatdhśca daṇḍaiḍḍatdhśca prahṛtya daṇḍādaṇḍi, iti | prathamāntamiha pradhānamanyapadārthaḥ | apradhānasaṃbandhyartho yathā citrā gāvaḥ asya citraguḥ, ardhaṃ tṛtīyameṣāṃ ardhatṛtīyāḥ, avidyamānā bhāryā asya abhāryaḥ, uṣṭrasyeva mukhamasya uṣṭramukhaḥ, kaṇṭhe sthitāḥ kālāḥ asya kaṇṭhekālaḥ, keśasaṃhāraḥ cūḍā asya keśacūḍaḍḍatdhḥ iti| ṣaṣṭhyantamihāpradhānamanyapadārthaḥ | kārakārtho yathārūḍho vānaro yaṃ sa ārūḍhavānaro vṛkṣaḥ, ūḍho ratho'nena ūḍharatho'naṅvāmān, evaṃ kṣuṇṇavrīhi musalam, upahṛtapaśū rudraḥ, uddhṛtaudanā sthālī, mattabahumātaṅgaṃ vanaṃ iti | atra dvitīyādivācyaṃ karmādikārakaṃ sāmāsārthaḥ| ubhayapadārthapradhāno dvandvaḥ, sa tridhetaretaraviṣayaḥ, samāhāraviṣayaḥ, ubhayaviṣayaśca, tatra bhādavikṣāyāmutaretarayogaḥ, yathā dhavasvadirau, mātāpitarau, dadhipayasī, śivavaiśraṇau, go'śvau, daśeme mārdaṅgikapāvikāḥ iti | abhedāvikṣāyāṃ samāhāraḥ, yathā pāṇipādaṃ, rathikāśvārohaṃ, takṣāyaskāraṃ, gavāśvaṃ pratyaṣṭhāt kaṭhakauthumaṃ, udagāt kaṭhakālāpāṃ iti| vibhāṣitaikavadbhāva ubhayaviṣayaḥ, yathāśvabaḍaḍḍatdhbau, aśvabaḍaḍḍatdhbaṃ, haṃsacakravākāḥ, haṃsacakravākam| dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ, dhavakhadirapalāśaṃ iti | prakṛteranyathātvaṃ vikṛtiḥ, tatra bhavaḥ vaikṛtaḥ | so'pi caturdhā prādhāvanyaviparītaḥ, sāmathryaviparītaḥ, vākyādhikārārthaḥ, arthāntaragāmī ca | teṣu prādhānyaviparyayastridhā pūrvapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayaḥ, uttarapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayaḥ, anyapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayaśceti | tatra pūrvapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayo'vyayībhāvo yathā śākaprati, akṣapari, tiṣṭhadru, unmattagaṅga, pañcanadaṃ, saptadodāvaraṃ iti | uttarapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayastatpuruṣo yathā rājadantaḥ, pūrvakāyaḥ, prāptajīvikaḥ, gogarbhiṇī, aśvamatāllikā, gobṛndārakaḥ iti| anyapadārthaprādhānyaviparyayo bahuvrūhiryathā dvau vā trayo vā dvitrāḥ, evaṃ pañcaṣāḥ, āsanno daśānāṃ āsannadaśaḥ, evamadūradaśaḥ, evaṃ dvirdaśa dvidaśāḥ, evaṃ tridaśā iti | sāmathryaviparyastridhā padāsāmathryāt, vākyāsāmathryat, tatra padāsāmathrye sāpekṣatve yathā devadattasya gurūkulaṃ, grāmaṃ gantukāmaḥ, jñātacittaḥ kāntayā, nivedtātmā gurūbhyaḥ, kṛtapasrthāno nagarāt, niṣpannabuddhiḥ śāstreṣu iti, vākyāsāmathryayamasvapadavigrahe yathā brāhmaṇebhyo'yaṃ brāhmaṇārthaḥ sūpaḥ, brāhmaṇārthā yavāgūḥ, māso jātasyamāsajātaḥ, evaṃ saṃvatsarajātaḥ, dve ahanī jātasya dyvahajātaḥ, evaṃ dvyahnajātaḥ iti, vṛttayasāmathryaṃ saṃbandhe yathā lūryamapi vana paśyanti asūryaṃpaśyā rājadārāḥ, punarna gīyante apunargeyāḥ ślokāḥ, śrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte aśrāddhabhojī brāhmamaḥ, evamalavaṇabhojī bhikṣuḥ iti, tīrthe ghvāṃkṣa iva tīrthadhvāṃkṣaḥ, evaṃ tīrthekākaḥ iti| arthādhikyaṃ tridhā viśeṣaṇasya, viśeṣyasya, samudāyasya ca, viśeṣaṇasya yathā varṣaśatamāyurasya śatāyuḥ, janasahastraṃ vibharti sahastraṃbharaḥ, aśreṇayaḥ śreṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ śreṇīkṛtāḥ, apaṇḍiḍḍatdhtaḥ paṇḍiḍḍatdhta uktaḥ paṇḍiḍḍatdhtoktaḥ, śastrīva śyāmā śastrīśyāmā, puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva puruṣavyaghraḥ iti, viśeṣyasya yathā ghṛtena pūrṇo ghaṭaḥ ghatṛghaṭāḥ, aśvairyukto rathaḥ aśvarathaḥ, dadhnopasikta audanaḥ dadhyodanaḥ, guḍeḍḍatdhna miśrā dhānāḥ guḍaḍḍatdhdhānāḥ, akṣeṣu prasakto dhūrtaḥ akṣadhūrtaḥ, śākapradhānaḥ pārthivaḥ śākapārthivaḥ iti, samudāyasya yathā śvabhiḥ lehyaḥ kūpaḥ, kākaiḥ peyā nadī kākapeyā nadī, khaṭvāyāmārūḍhaḥ khaṭvārūḍho jālmaḥ, pātra eva samitāḥ pātresamitāḥ, evaṃ kiṃrājā yo na rakṣati, kiṃgauḥ yo na vahati iti, atra pūrvayoratiśayaḥ, śeṣeṣu kṣepaḥ samudāyasya pratīyate | arthāntaragamanaṃ tridhā pūrvārthasya tyāgāt, atyāgāt, tyāgātyāgābhyāṃ ca, tatra pūrvārthasya tyāgo yathā tailapāyikā, śakragopaḥ, aśvakarṇaḥ, pañcā ṅgulaḥ, karavīraḥ, puṃnāgaḥ iti, atyāgo yathā kṛṣṇasarpaḥ, lohitaśālī, kālaśākaḥ, gaurasvaraḥ, narāsiṃhaḥ, dantalekhaḥ iti, tyāgātyāgau yathā śapta parṇānyasya parvaṇi iti saptaparṇaḥ, aṣṭa padāni asya paṅktau paṅktau iti aṣṭāpadam, śataṃ patrāṇāmasyāḥ puṣpe puṣpe iti śātapatrikā, darśane navaiva mālikā asyā navamālikā, naktamuva mālāyāmasya naktamālaḥ, kṛtā mālā asya puṣpaiḥ iti kṛtamālaḥ iti | udāhṛtaprakarābhyāmanyaḥ śeṣaḥ, sa caturdhā śūtraśeṣaḥ, asūtraśeṣaḥ, jñāpakaseṣaḥ, ekaśeṣaśceti| teṣu sūtraseṣastridhā gaṇoktaḥ, vārtikoktaḥ, sāmānyoktaśca, tatra “tiṣṭhadruprabhṛtīni” “pātre samitādayaḥ” “mayūvyaṃsakādayaḥ” iti gaṇoktaḥ, yathāyatīgavaṃ, samabhūmi, udumbaramaśakam, piṇḍīsūraḥ, ahaṃpūrvīkā, āhopuruṣikā iti, “nirādayaḥ krāntagyalarthe pañcamyā” gamigāmyādikṛtāpakṛtānāmupasaṃkhyānam” “avyayānāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ vaktvyaḥ” iti vārtikoktaḥ, yathā niṣkauśāmbiḥ, odanabubhukṣuḥ, kriyākrayikā, puṭāpuṭikā, uñcairmukhaḥ, astikṣīrā iti, “supsupā” “iepūrvādiniḥ” “sapūrvāñca” “kuśāgrācchaḥ” “samāsāñca tadviṣayāt” iti sāmānyoktaḥ, yathā paraśśatā rāānaḥ, parassahastrā śaradaḥ, punarutsyūtaṃ vāsaḥ, punarnavaṃ payaḥ, kṛtapūrvā kaṭaṃ, kākatālīyo nyāyo'yaṃ iti | asūtraśeṣastridhā nāmaviṣayaḥ, kṛdviṣayaḥ, taddhitaviṣayaśca, “aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye”, “pāraskaraprabhṛtīni ca saṃjñāyām” “pṛṣodarādīni yathopadiṣṭam” ityādirnāmaviṣayaḥ, yathāparasparāḥ sārthā gacchanti, āścarye vartate, pāraskaro muniḥ, kāstīraṃ nagaraṃ, pṛṣodaraḥ kaścinmayūraḥ pakṣī iti, “upapadamatiṅ” “kugatiprādayaḥ” “kartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam” ityādiḥ kṛdviṣayaḥ, yathā kumbhakāraḥ, paṅkajaṃ, ūrīkṛtya, prajavū, aśvakrīti, “dvigorluganapatye” “tkakitavādibhyo dvandve” “samāsāntāḥ” ityādistaddhitaviṣayaḥ, yathā pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapāsaḥ, taikāyanayaśca kaitavānayaśca tikakitavāḥ, upaśaradam, devarājaḥ, mahokṣaḥ, mṛganetrā rātrayaḥ iti | jñāpakaśeṣastridhā vidhijñāpitaḥ, niṣedhajñāpitaḥ, prayogajñāpitaśca | tatra “koḥ kattatpuruṣe”, “īṣadarthe'pi” “naño nalopastiṅyavakṣepe ca” “kārake'nyasya duk” “vyatihāre sarvādīnāṃ lubbahulam” saṃkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasyāhannanyatarasyāṃ ṅau” “dāyādyaṃ dāyade” ityādiko vidhijñāpitaḥ, yathā kaduṣṇaṃ, apacasi, anyatkārakaḥ, anyo'nyam, sāyahnaḥ, vidyadāyādaḥ iti| “aluguttarapade”, “pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ”, “ātmānaḥ pūraṇe tṛtīyāyāḥ” “vaiyākaraṇākhyāyāṃ parāñcatuthryāḥ” “vāgdikpaśyadbhyo yuktidaṇḍaḍḍatdhhareṣu yakṣāsaṃkhyamalugvaktavyaḥ”, “ṣaṣṭhyāḥ adasaḥ phakphiñoḥ”, “apoyoniyanmatuṣu saptamyāḥ” ityādiḥ niṣedhajñāpitaḥ, yathā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, ātmānātṛtīyaḥ, parasmaipadam, paśyatoharaḥ, āmuṣyakulikā, apsuyoniḥ iti | “janikartṛḥ prakṛtiḥ” “tatprayojako hetuḥ” “aponaptrapānnpatṛbhyāṃ ghaḥ” “yathātathācāntaḥ”, “vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā” “aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye” ityādiḥ prayogarāpitaḥ, yathā bhūtahartā, daṇḍaḍḍatdhnāyakaḥ, tanūnapāt, yāthātathyaṃ, yatnagauravaṃ, kriyāsāphasalyaṃ iti | ekaśoṣastridhā śarūpāṇāṃ, asarūpāṇāṃ, sarūpāsarūpāṇāṃ ca | tatra sarūpāṇāṃ bhinnārthānāmabhinnrathānāṃ bhinnabhinnārthānanāṃ ca, bhinnarthānāṃ yathākṣau, māṣau, pakṣau, pādau, govau, abhinnārthānāṃyathā vṛkṣau, plakṣau iti, bhinnābhinnārthānāṃ yathāśvinau, puṣpavantau, gāvau, sārasvatau, yuvāṃ, yūyaṃ, iti | asarūpāṇāṃ sarvanāmnāṃ, saṃbandhināṃ, sahacāriṇāṃ ca, sarvanāmnāṃ yathā sa ṭa devadattaśca tau, etau ca yajñadattaśrca ete, ayaṃ ca tvaṃ ca yuvām, amū ca tvaṃ ca yūyaṃ, tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca āvāṃ, sa ca āvāṃ ca layaṃ iti, saṃbandhināṃ yathā dastraśca nāsatyaśca dastrau, devadattaśca viṣṇumitraśca viṣṇumitrau, śauṇḍaḍḍatdhśṭaca dhūrtādayaśca śauṇḍāḥ, ardharcaśca gomayādayaśca ardharcāḥ, puroḍāśaśca puroḍāśāḥ, chatrī ca padātyādayaśca chatriṇāḥ, sarūpārūpāṇāṃ bhinnaśabdānāṃ, bhinnavacanānāṃ, bhinnaliṅgānāṃ ca, bhinnaśabdānāṃ yathā gāgyaśca gāgryāyaṇī ca gāgryau, vātsyaśca vātsyāyanaśca vātsyau, parthamaśca prathamānantaraśca prathamau, bhūmaśca bhīmaśca bhīmasenaśca bhīmau, vakradaṇḍaḍḍatdhścakuṭiladaṇḍaḍḍatdhśca vakradaṇḍau, śrīmāṃśca lakṣmīvāṃśca śrīmantau iti, bhinnaṃvacanānāṃ yathā devaśca dattaśca devadattau, tau ca devadattaśca devadattāḥ, evaṃ viṣṇumitrāḥ, kṛṣṇasārau, tau ca sāraśca kṛṣṇasārāḥ, evaṃ nīlalohitāḥ, apāraśca pāraśca apārapārau, tau ca pārapāraśca pārapārāḥ, evamapārapārāḥ iti, bhinnaliṅgānāṃ yathā kukkuṭaśca kukkuṭī ca kukkuṭau, śvaśuraśca śvaśraśca śvaśurau, gāvaśca gāvaśca gāvaḥ imāḥ, vatsakāśca vatsikāśca vatsikā ime, aśvaśca aśvaśca aśvā ete, śuklaśca śuklāca śuklaṃ ca tadidaṃ śiklam, tānīmāni śuklāni iti | kathaṃ punarekaśeṣaḥ samāsaviśeṣo bhavati? saṃkṣepābhidhāne sati dvandvasamānārthatvāt, tathā hy asarūpāṇāṃ dvandvaḥ, sarūpāsarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa iti | ko'nayoḥ samāno'rthaḥ? yeyaṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatā padārthānāṃ sahavivakṣetyarthaḥ, tadāhānusyūteva bhedābhyāmekā prakhyopajāyate | yasyāṃ sahavivakṣāṃ tāmāhudrvandvaikaśeṣayoḥ || iti | tatrā yadā prayogaikatayā buddhyā'nekamarthamavagatya yathāvagatamevābhidhātumadhyavasyate, tadaikajñānavacchedānirūpitabhedasyāsya bhāgaśo'bhidhānāsaṃbhavādavayavaśabdāḥ saṃghātaviṣyā vijñāyante, tadyathā dhavakhadirau vṛkṣau iti | yadyevam, yathā dhavakhadirapalāśamiti dvandvasya samūhārthatvādekavacanam, evamekaśeṣasyāpi prāpnoti | naivam, dvandvaḥ samāhāretaretarayogayoḥ, ekaśeṣaḥ punaritaretarayoga eva, tasya hi samāhārapakṣe bhinnārthapratipādakānekaśabdanivṛttau vacanamapi ydayanekārthe na bhavet kenānekārthaḥ pratīyeta? na hi vṛkṣa ityukte vṛkṣaśrca vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣaśceti kaścidapyavaiti, tasmādāmnāto'pi dvandvasamānārthatayā samāhāra ekaśeṣo'nabhidhānādaprayogārha eveti vijñāyate | dvandve tu yadyapi ekavacanānnānekārthāvagatiḥ, tathā'pi anekaśabdaśrutinibandhanā'sau bhaviṣyatīti samāhāre'pi na doṣaḥ | ekaśeṣo'pi yatrānekābhidhānasāmathrya kathaṃcidbhavati, bhavatyeva tatra samāhāraikavacanam, yathā śuklaṃ laśtraṃ śuklā śāṭī śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti tadidaṃ śiklamiti | yathā tahryokasyaiva śabdasyānekārthābhidhānasāmāthryādekaśeṣe śahdāntaraṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ, evaṃ dvandve'pi kasmānna bhavati? yadi bhavet, ekaśoṣādaviśeṣaḥ prasajyeta | samāhāra ekavacanaṃ viśeṣa iti cet anekārtho na gamyeta, na hi palāṣāmityukte dhavaśca khadiraśca palāśaśceti kaścidapyavaiti | atha, yathā patarau bhrātarāvityādiṣu śabdāntaranivṛttāvapi tadartho'vagamyate tathā plakṣanyagrodhau dhavakhadirāvityādiṣu dvandveṣvapi kasmānna bhavati? ucyate śabdaśaktireṣā bhavati hi kaścideko'pi śabdo dvayorabhidhāyakaḥ, yathā rodasīśabdo dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ, kaucit punadrvāvevaikamarthamabhidadhāte, yathādhīte, adhyeti iti | atra eva śabdaśaktidarśī muniḥ keṣutidevaṃ virūpeṣvekaśeṣamārabhate “bhrātṛputrau svasṛduhitṛbhyām” “pitā mātrā” iti, anyeṣu tu dvandvamaivābhyanujānāti|| nanu ca, “cārthe dvandvaḥ” smaryate, sa yathā samāhāretaretarayogayoḥ, tathā samuñcayānvācayayorapi prāpnoti| naivam, samuñcayānvācayayoḥ padānāmasāmathryāt | kathamasāmathryam? sāpekṣamasamarthe bhavatīti, tathāhi gauśrcāśvaśrca gacchatītyādirekakriyāpekṣaḥ samuñcayaḥ, bhikṣāmaṭa gāṃ cānayetyādikaranekakriyāpekṣaḥ anvācayaḥ, evaṃ ca bāhyarthāpekṣāyā padānāṃ parasparamasāmathryam, samarthaśca padavidhirbhavati | samāhāretaretarayogayostu samūhatvāt samūhasya ca samūhasya ca samūhirūpatvādavayavānāṃ sati sāmathrye samāso bhavatyeva, yathā dhavakhadirapalāśaṃ, dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ iti | evaṃ tarhi samūhasyaikatvāt samāhāravaditaretarayoge'ṣyekavacanameva prāpneti| naivam, samāhāra eva parasparānupraveśādiva samadhigatābhedānāmupasarganūkṛtāvayavaḥ samudāyo'bhyanujñāyate, yasyānabhivyaktāvayavatvādekavartipadairabhidhiyamānatvāt samudāyasaṃkhyānibandhanaikavacanamavayavebhyaḥ prastūyate | tatra yathā pacatītyādau adhiśrayaṇādikriyākalāpaḥ pratyavayavaṃ parisamāpyate, tathā samudāyārtho'pi pratipadaṃ sākalyena parisamāpyate | tataḥ ekaikasya padasya samudāyanibandhanaḥ saṃskāro bhavati | kathaṃ punaḥ dhavādayo nirdhāritārthabhedāḥ padāntarasyārthamabhidhātuṃ kṣamante? pravṛttinivṛttisamāropāt, yathoktaṃ “yadi prakṣaratīti plakṣaḥ, nyagrodho'pyevam, yadi nyagrohatacīti nyagraudhaplakṣo'pyevaṃ” iti | māhacaryādivaśena vā paraspararūpāpattiḥ, yathā “saptamī śauṇḍauḥ”, “ardharcāḥ puṃsi”, te viṣṇumitrāḥ, chatriṇo gacchantīti | tatra yathā śauṇḍārdharcādayaḥ bahuvacanānyathānupapattisamabhigamyān sahacāriṇo bhinnarūpān dhūrtagomayādīnupādadate, tathā dhavādiśabdāḥ pratītārthabhedāḥ sāhacaryādinimittanurodhena khadirādīnupādadate| tathā hy ekavṛttivadāvārodhapratītasāhacaryau dhavakhadirau, ata eva tayoreva pratyavayavaniśādvahuvacanaṃ na bhavati | kathaṃ punardhavādīnāmarthāntarābhidhānaṃ śakhyamadhyavanātum? yāvatā lokaḥ padasamudāyādarthasamudāyamavaiti, nāvayavāt | yadpyuktaṃ pravṛttinivṛttisamāropāditi, tadapyasāram, na hi prakṣaratīti vyutpattyā nyagrodhaḥ plakṣaḥ, nāpi nyagrohatīti vyutpāttyā plakṣo nyāgrodho bhavati, rūḍhānāṃ hi dharmaniyamāya yathākataṃcit vyutpattiḥ kriyate, na tu vyutpattivaśena rūḍhayo'vatiśaṣṭhante | nāpi prakṛtipratyayavadanvayavyatirekasamadhadhigamyā dhavādīnāṃ samudāyārthatā| yadapyucyate śauṇḍārdharcādivat dhavaśabdaḥ sāhacaryādilakṣaṇayā khadiramupādatte iti, tadapi na samyak, sati śrutyarthasaṃbhave lakṣaṇāyā ayogāt, na ca khadirārtho dhūrtagomayādivallakṣayitavyaḥ, tasya khadiraśabderanaiva sākṣādabhidhānāt | evaṃ tarhi, yadā dhavakhadirādayaḥ samudāyāḥ pravibhāgenānvācikhyāsitāḥ, tadā tameva samudāyaṃ pratyāyyatayā'bhisaṃdhāyāvayāvā upādīyante, na tvavayavārthapratipādanābhiprāyeṇa | atastasyāṃ yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ samīhitāyāṃ samudāyaparatvādavayavaprayogasya, teṣāmavayavānāṃ pratyekamanekārthatvamucyate | kiṃ punaḥ prayokturabhiprāyaparatvādavayavaprayogasya, teṣāmavayavānāṃ pratyekamanekārthatvamucyate | kiṃ punaḥ prayokturabhiprāyamanurudhyante śabdāḥ? yena tadabhisaṃdhānāt samudāyamābhidadhyuḥ | netyāha, anyatrāpyavayavābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāmavayavamukhena samudāyābhidānasāmathrye ddaśyate, yathā śurabhi kuvalayaṃ, yanmadhuraṃ rājatanaṃ iti, yadi hi sirabhidhuraśbadau gandharamamātrabhidhāyināvapi gandharasādisamudāyān kusumaphalaviśeṣādīnavayavamukhena nācakṣate, ku valayādibhiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ virudhyeta | satyametat, asti samudāyābhidhānasāmathryamavayavaśabdānām, kiṃ tu surabhi kuvalayaṃ ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyena tadavadhāryate, dvendve tu nibandhanamaśakyamavadhārayutumiti tasyānupapattiḥ | naivam, samudāyābhidhānasya prakāntatvāt | yadyevaṃ paṭvīmṛdyyāviti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhāvaḥ prāpnoti | ucyate, kasmānna bhavati darśanīyāyā mātā darśanāyāmātā? atha matametat prāk samāsādyatra sāmānādhikaraṇyam, ihāpi na doṣo bhavati, na hi prāk samāsāt sāmānādhikaraṇyamatra vidyate | nanu ca vākye'pi samudāyaprakramaiṇaivāvayavapadānāṃ prayogāt, kathamucyate prāk samāsāt sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nāstīti? samudāyaprakramasya nirvibandhanatvenāpratīyamānatvāt, kuvalāyādiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi surabhiprabhṛtīnāmasamāse'pi samudāyatānubandhanam, iha tvekārthībhāvaḥ samudāyābhidhāne nimittamiti vākye sāmānādhikaraṇyāprasiddhaḥ | evamapi, vipratiṣiddheṣu yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyā anupapattiḥ, yathā śukhaduḥkhe, jananamaraṇe, śītoṣṇo iti, sukhādipratighātena hi duḥkhādayaḥ, duḥkhādipratighātena ca sukhādaya iti| naivam, sarva eva śabdā vipratiṣiddhā, plakṣanyagrodhāvityātrāpi hi plakṣaśabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ plakṣārthe saṃpratyāyayati, nyagrodhārthe nivartayati, nyagerodhaśabdaḥ prayujyamāno nyagrodhārthe pratyāyat, plakṣārthe nivartayati | tatra cedyuktā yugapadadhkaraṇavacanatā ddaśyate, ihāpi yuktaṃ ddaśyatām | evamapi śabdapaurvāparyaprayogādarthapaurvāparyādhānaṃ prāpnoti | tataḥ kim? yugapadadhikaraṇavatamatāyā anupapattir phlakṣanyagrodhau plakṣanyagrodhā iti, yathaiva hi śabdānāṃ paurvāparyaṃ tadvadarthānāmapi syāt | naivama, evaṃ sati, dvivacavanabahuvacanayorapyanupapattiḥ, plakṣaśabdo hi sārthako nivṛttaḥ, nyagrodhaśabdaḥ upasthitaḥ, , caika ekārtha iti tasmādekavacanameva prāpnoti | vigrahe khalvapi yugapadadhikaraṇavatanatā ddaśyate, kiṃ punaḥ samāse, tadyathā “dyāvā ha kṣāmāḥ”, “dyāvā cidasmai pṛthivī sannamete” iti | samudāyāt siddhamiti cet, tanna, samudāyasyaikārthatvāt | ekārthā hi samudāyā bhavanti, tadyathā śataṃ yūthaṃ vanamiti nāyamekārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? dvyartho bahvarthaśca, plakṣo'pi dyvarthaḥ, nyagrodho'pi dyvarthaḥ | yadyevamanekārthatvāt “bahuṣu bahuvacanam” iti bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti | tanna, bahutvābhāvāt, yābhyābhevātraiko dyvarthastābhyāmevāparo'pi | yadyevamanyevācakena śabdenānyasya vacanaṃ nopapadyate | evaṃ tarhi plakṣo'pi nyagroghaḥ, nyagrodhasya ca plakṣatvāt svaśabdenaivābhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | kathaṃ punaḥ plakṣo'pi nyagroghaḥ, nyagrodho'pi plakṣaḥ syāt? yāvatā kāraṇāddravye śabdāsaṃniveśo bhavati | kāraṇāddravye śabdasaṃnveśa iti cet, kāraṇanuktaṃ purastād yadi prakṣaratīti plakṣaḥ nyagrodhe'pyetadbhaviti, yadi nyaṅrohatīti nyagarodhaḥ, plakṣepyetadbhaviṣyatīti | darśanaṃ vai hetuḥ na ca nyagrodhe plakṣaśabdo ddaśyate | draśanaṃ heturiti cet, tusyametadbhavati, plakṣe'pi nyagrodhaśabdo ddaśyate | nanvetahbravīmi naiṣa loke saṃpratyayo'sti, na hi plakṣa ānīyatāmityikte nyagrodhe ānīyate | dvandvaviṣayamevaitaddraṣṭavyam, yuktaṃ punaryanniyataviṣayā nāma śabdāḥ syuḥ? bāḍhaṃ yuktam, anyatrāpi darśanāt, tadyathā samāne'pi rakte varṇe gaurlohita iita bhavati, aśvaḥ śoṇa iti, samāne śukle varṇe gauḥ śveta iti bhavati, aśvaḥ karka iti | yadi tarhi plakṣo'pi nyagrodhaḥ nyagrodho'pi plakṣaḥ, ekenaivoktatvādaparasya prayogo'nupapannaḥ| anuktaḥ plakṣeṇa nyagrodha iti kṛtvā nyagrodhaśabdaḥ prayujyate | phathamanuktaḥ? yadidāmīmevoktaṃ plakṣo'pi nyagarodhaḥ nyagrodho'pi plakṣa iti | sahabhūtāvanyo'nyasyārthamāhatuḥ, na pṛthagbhūtau | kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇam? śabdaśakteḥ svabhāvaḥ, pratiniyatā hi vṛttivākyayoḥ śabdānāmabhidhānaśaktiḥ, tadyathā śsatrīśyamā devadatteti | “upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ” iti samāse śastrīśabdenāvācchidyamānāviśeṣāvaruddhaḥ śyāmāśabdo yadyapi na sāmānyavacanaḥ, tathā'pyasau devadattāyāmupamīyamānāyāṃ vartate śastrīva śyāmā devadatteti, tadidamuktam “prāgabhisaṃbandhādyaḥ sāmānyavacanaḥ” iti samāsamabhisaṃbandhaśabdena darśayati, yatastatra vinivṛttaviśeṣāntarākāṃkṣāṇi yathāsamīhitaviśeṣāvarūddhāni padāni | so'yaṃ vṛttivākyayorviśeṣaḥ | kiṃ ca, niṣkauśāmbuḥ, nirvārāṇasiriti bhede sati nirādīnāṃ na krāntādyarthasaṃbhavaḥ | api ca, gaurakharavadaraṇyam, lohitaśālimān grāma iti | “prāgvṛtterjātivācitvaṃ na ca gaurakharādiṣu |” yathā śnnigdhakisalayamaraṇyaṃ, mattamātaṅgaṃ vanamiti | “vṛttiranyapadārthe yā tasyā vākyeṣvasaṃbhavaḥ||” evaṃ ca plakṣanyagrodhau plakṣanyagrodhāḥ iti dvadve'pi sahabhūtayorevānyārthābhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati, na pṛthagbhūtayoriti | athavā, iha kaucit palakṣanyagrodhau prāthamakalpikau, kaucit kriyāya guṇena vā plakṣaṃ ivāyaṃ plakṣaḥ, nyagrodhāveva, athavā plakṣanyagrodhāviti | tatrāsaṃdehārtho nyagrodhaśabdaḥ prayujyate | seyaṃ yūgapadadhikaraṇavacanatā duḥkhā durupapādadā ca | yadapi cāsyā jñāpakaṃ “dyāvā ha kṣāmā” iti, tadapi chāndasam| idaṃ tarhi jñapakamastu “paravalliṅgatātideśo'narathakaḥ | nānarthakaḥ, tatpuruṣasya kkacit pūrvapadārthapradhānatvāt, yathārdhaṃ pippalyāḥ ardhapippalī, pūrvaṃ kāyasya pūrvaṃkāyaḥ, uttaraṃ śarūrasya uttaraśarīraṃ iita | yadyovaṃ, prāptajīvikaḥ, niṣkrāntaḥ kauśāmbyāḥ niṣkauśāmbyāḥ niṣkauśāmbiḥ, alaṃ kumāryo alaṃkumāriḥ ityatrāpi paravalliṅgatā prāpneti| evaṃ tarhi, dvandvena saha nirdiśāñcārthaviṣayo'tra tatpuruṣo gṛhyate, yathā krayākrayikā, puṭāpuṭikā, phalāphaliketi, aśvamatallikā, kumārītallajakaḥ, goprakāṇḍaṃ, iti | atra hi, yathā dhavaśca khadiraśceti yugapadadhikaraṇavacanatāyāṃ, tathā samānādhikaraṇatāyāpi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena saṃmūrthantāvivānyonyamarthau bhavataḥ | tathā hi prayojattyā mahattvāśrayaśrcāsāvalpamūlyatvena laghutvāt krayikā cetyupapadyate, nīsotpalādivādviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | evaṃ phalāphalikā, puṭāpuṭiketi | aśvamatalliketyatrāśvaśabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ sarvāśvāvagraharupeṇa pravartate, matāllikāśabdaḥ praśaṃsāvacanaḥ pravartamāno viśiṣṭāvagraharupeṇāvācchinatti “ | yadi vā, matalliketyetat praśaṃsāvacanaṃ nyunādhikabhāvamanapekṣyapravartamānamanenaiva dharmeṇa sarvayogyaṃ sat aśva ityanena viśiṣṭāyāṃ yogyatāyāṃ niyamyate | tato yathā śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaścayaṃ mṛgaḥ sāraṅgaḥ śabalaiti vā, tathā aśvamatalliketyetadubhayarūpo'rtha ityubhayamubhayena saṃniveśyate | evaṃ kumārītallajakaḥ, goprakāṇḍaṃ, iti | yadyevaṃ, ardhapippalītyādiṣu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādeṣu paravālliṅgatā na prāpneti | naivam, tatrāpi ardha ca tat pippalī cārdhapipaplīti, pūrvaśrcāsau kāyaśrca pūrvakāya iti sāmānādhikaraṇyamaiva paramārthaḥ | ata eva yatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasyāsaṃbhavaḥ, tatra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa eva bhavati, yathā vedyartha dakṣiṇaṃ meroḥ, svarārdhe, cūḍiḍḍatdhkārdhaṃ, paṇārdhe iti | na ca ardhādīnāmevaiṣa niyamaḥ, yato'nyatrāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyasya vivakṣā'vivakṣābabhyāmubhayathā tatpuruṣo bhavati, tadyathāgrahastaḥ, hastāgraṃ, talapādaḥ, pādatalaṃ iti || nanu ca, “cārthe dvandvaḥ” ityucyate, caśrcāvyayam tena samāsasyāvyayasaṃjñā prāpnoti, naiṣa deṣaḥ, pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñā kriyate, na ca samāsastatra paṭhyate | mā bhūdapāṭhe saṃjñā, tathā'pyubhidheyavalliṅgavacanāni bhavanti, yaśrcehārtho'bhidhīyate, na tsaya liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo'sti | nedaṃ vācanikam aliṅgatā, asamakhyatā ca | kiṃ tarhi? svābhāvikametat | tadyathā śamānamīhamānānāmadhīyānānāṃ ca kecidarthena yujyante, apare na, na cedānīṃ kaścidarthavāniti kṛtvā sarvairarthavadbhiśśakyaṃ bhavitum, kaśrcidvā'narthaka iti sarvairanarthakaiḥ | tatra kimasmābhiḥ śakyaṃ kartum, yatprāk samāsāñcarthasya liṅgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yogo nāsti, samāre ca bhavati, svabhāvikametat | athavā, āśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhaviṣyanti, yathā guṇavacaneṣu | guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti | tadyathā, śuklaṃ vastraṃ, śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kambalaḥ, śuklau kambalau, śuklāḥ kambalaḥ iti | yadasau dravyaṃ śrito bhavati samāsastasya yalliṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca tatsamāsasyāpi bhaviṣyati | atheha kasmānna bhavati yājñikaścāyaṃ vaiyākaraṇaśca, kaṭhaścāyaṃ bahvṛcaśca, aukthikaścayaṃ mīmāṃsakaśceti? śeṣa iti vartate, aśeṣatvānna bhaviṣyati | yadi śeṣa iiti vartate “upāsnnātaṃ sthūlasiktaṃ tūṣṇīṃgaṅgaṃ mahāhadam | droṇaṃ cedaśako gantuṃ mā tvā tāptāṃ kṛtākṛte||” ityetanna sidhyati | naiṣa doṣaḥ, anyaddhi kṛtamanyadakṛtam | cārthe dvandvavacane asamāse'pi cārthasaṃprakyayādaniṣṭaṃ prāpneti “aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ paśum | vaivasvato na tṛpyati surāyā iva dirmadī ||” “indrastvaṣṭā varūṇo vāyurādityaḥ” iti | naiṣa doṣaḥ, iha “ce dvandvaḥ” itīyatā siddham, kathaṃ punaśrce nāyaṃ vṛttiḥ syāt? śabdo hyeṣa, śabde'saṃbhavādarthe kāryaṃ vijñāsyate | so'yamevaṃ siddhaṃ sati yadrathagrahaṇaṃ karoti, tasyaitatprayojanam, yathaivaṃ vijñāyeta cakṛte'rthe cārtha iti | kaḥ punaḥ cakṛto'rthaḥ? samūñcayaḥ, anvācayaḥ, itaretarayogaḥ, samāhāra iti | tatradvayoḥ sāpekṣatvāt samāso na bhavati, dvayostu bhavatīti pratipāditaṃ pustātā| nanu caivam, cakṛto'rthaśrcārtha iti paśre plakṣanyagrodhāvityatra plakṣaśrca nyagrodhaśrceti vigrahaḥ prāpnoti, yāvatā plakṣaśrca nyagrodhaśrcedapyukte gamyata etat plakṣo'pi nyagrodhasahāyaḥ, nyagrodho'pi plakṣasahāya iti| tatra ko doṣaḥ syāt? plakṣau ca nyagrodhau ceti yadaktaṃ tanna ghacate | yugapadadhikaraṇavatacanāpradarśanamātraparametat, na tvayameva paramārthaḥ | evaṃ hi kriyamāṇe ekaśrca viṃśatiśrca ekaviṃśatiḥ, dvau ca viṃśatiśrca dvāviṃśatiriti dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca prāpnoti | kiṃ punarekaviṃśatirityādayo dvandvaḥ? bāḍham| ekādhikā viṃśatiriti pakṣe hi saṃkhyāsvaro na prāpnoti, sa hi śatasahastramiti ṣaṣṭhīsamāse mā bhūditi dvandvaḥ evābhyanujñāyate | yadyevamitaretarayogapakṣe dvivatanam, samāhārapakṣe napuṃsakatvaṃ prāpnoti | naivam, “liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvāt” iti samāhare'pi napiṃsakatvaṃ na bhavaṣyati | atha dvādaśetyatrāpi samāhāraḥ kasamānna bhavati? ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyāḥ saṃkhyeya eva vartante, ataḥ udbhatāvayavasamudāyatāyāmitaretarayoga eva prāpnoti, yathā “adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca” daśeme mārdaṅgikapāṇavikā iti || tadetat kṛttaddhitasamāsabhedādvibhaktāvayavaṃ tridhā prātipadikabhihitam | athāvibhāktāvayavanucyate | tadapi tridhā nāmarūpaṃ, avyarūpaṃ, nipātarūpaṃ ca | tatrānapekṣitaśabdavyutpattatīni sattvabhūtārthābhidhāyīni ca nāmāni | tāni tridhaikārthāni, anekārthāni, ekānekārthāni ceti, tatra, ekārthāni yathā vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇm, kumārī, ḍiḍḍatdhtthaḥ, śuklaḥ, śīghraḥ, indraḥ, śukraḥ, purandaraḥ, koṣṭhaḥ, kusūlaḥ iti | anekārthāni yathākṣāḥ, māṣāḥ, pādāḥ, avayaḥ, harayaḥ, gāvaḥ, bhūtayaḥ, puṇḍaḍḍatdhrūkaṃ, puṣkaraṃ, sāma, lalāma iti | ekānekārtāni yathā dastrauḥ, nāsatyau, puṣpavantau, ubhau, rodasī, rodasyai, dārāḥ, varṣāḥ, āpaḥ, vanaṃ, sonā, iti| prāyoṇāliṅgasekhyāśaktinyavyayāni, teṣu dravyavacanāni yathā śvaḥ, prātar, divā, doṣā, naktaṃ, sāyaṃ, vihāyasā, bhūḥ, śam, saṃyoḥ, mayaḥ iti, guṇavacanāni yathoñcaiḥ, nīñcaiḥ, suṣṭhu, apaṣṭhu, mudhā, addhā, mṛṣā, mithyā, alaṃ, balalat, pṛthak, viṣvak iiti | saṃbandhavacanāni yathā śamayā, nikaṣā, bahiḥ, antaḥ, antareṇa, ṛte, ārāt, yugapat sākaṃ, sārdhaṃ, amā, saha iti | asattvavacanāśrcādayo nipātāḥ| te'pi tridheva svatantrāḥ, paratacantrāḥ, viśeṣaparatantrāśrca, teṣvastyādayaḥ svatantrāḥ, yathāsti, asi, asmi, ehi, brūhi, mṛduhi, manye, jāne, paśya, paśyat, syāt iti| karmapravacanīyāśrcādayaḥ paratantrā vṛśramanu vidyotate, upārjunaṃ yodrāraḥ, apa tridartebhyo vṛṣṭo dvaḥ, abhimanyurarjunataḥ prati, yadatra māṃ prati syāt, adhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ, ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan, “vāyurvā tvā manurvā tvā” “ahameva paśūnāmīśe”, sarojamiva te mikham, “na nūnamati no śvaḥ” “kasvidekākī carati” iti | gatiprādayo viśeṣaparatantrā, yathā prakaroti, parākaroti, ūrīkaroti, gulugudhākaroti, kārikākareti, khāṭkaroti, paṭapaṭākaroti, tiraskaroti, pulaskaroti, śraddhā, antārdhiḥ iti || athānukaraṇam | tadapi tridhaiva sādhvanukaraṇaṃ, asādhvanukaraṇaṃ, avyaktānukaraṇaṃ ca | tatra prathamaṃ pārthakaḥ, nirarthakaṃ ca | tayoḥ sārthakaṃ yathā dviḥ pacatvityāha, agni itāyaha, pacatītyāha, atra sārthakatvāt “tiṅṅatiṅaḥ”, iti nighātaḥ “īdūdeddvacanam” iti pragṛhyatvam, “tiṅantātvādaprātipadikatve subutpāttiśrca na bhavatīti | nirarthakaṃ yathā “suḥ pūjāyām”“ “apiḥ padārthasaṃbhāvanā'nvavasargagarhāsamuñcayeṣu”, “caḥ samuñcaye”, atrārthasyānukaraṇāt svasvarūpatvāñca prātipadikatve supaḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavatīti | dvitīyam aśaktijaṃ, apabhraṃśaśrca, tatrāśaktijaṃ yathāho ṛtaka iti vaktavye, asurā helayo helaya iiti vadantaḥ parābabhūvuḥ | tṛtīyaṃ nirullekhaṃ, sollekhaṃ ca, tayoḥ nirullekhaṃ yathā paṭatpaṭaditi karoti, paṭapaṭāyate | sollakhaṃ yathā tadetadevaiṣā dauvī vāganuvadati stamayitnurdāda iti, dāsyata, datta, dayadhvamiti tadetatrnayaṃ śikṣed damaṃ dānaṃ dayāmiti|| pratyayaviśeṣa eva śaktisaṃkhyāvibhāgakṛdvibhaktiḥ | sā tridhā tiṅvibhaktiḥ, subvibhaktiḥ, avyayavibhaktiśrca | tāsu tiṅvibhaktiḥ ṣoḍhāpasmaipadavibhaktiḥ, ātmāpadavibhaktiḥ, sārvadhātukavibhaktiḥ, ārdhadātukavibhaktiḥ, vyaktakālavibhakti, avyaktakālavibhaktiśca, etāsu parasmaipadavibhaktiḥ yathā pacati, pacataḥ, pacanti, ātmanepadavibhaktiryathā pacyate, pacyete, pacyate, sārvādhātukavibhaktiryathā vyapacyata, vyacyetāṃ, vyapacyanta, ārdhadhātukavibhaktiryathā papāca, paktā, pakṣāṣṭa, vyaktakālavibhaktiryathāpākṣīt, apacat, pakṣyate, avyaktakālavibhaktiryathā pacatu, pacat, apakṣyata iti | subvibhaktirapi ṣoḍhā kārakavibhaktiḥ, śeṣavibharaktiḥ, upapadavibhaktiḥ, pradhānavibhaktiḥ, saṃbodhavibhaktiśrca, tāsu kārakavibhaktiryathī kaṭaṃ karoti, dātreṇa lunāti, brāhmaṇāya dadāti, saṃbandhanavibhaktiryathā vidyayā yajñaḥ, yayūpa dāru, gavāṃ kṛṣṇā saṃpannakṣītamā iti, śeṣavibhaktiryathā mātuḥ smarati, vṛkṣasya parṇaṃ patati, māṇavakasya pitaraṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati, upapadavibhaktiryathā vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyut, namo devebhyaḥ, ṛte devadattat, pradhānavibhaktiryathā devadattaḥ pacati, caitreṇa pacyate, vīraḥ puruṣaḥ iti, saṃbodhanavibhaktiryathā he devadatta, vrajāmi devadatta, āgactha devadatta iti | taddhitapratyayaviśeṣo'vyayavibhaktiḥ| sā dvidhā vibhaktikāryavatī, avibhaktikāryavatī ca | vibhaktikāryavatī “prāgdiśo vibhaktiḥ” iti | sā tridhā vibhaktyādeśarūpā, pratyayādeśarūpā, pratyayādeśarūpā, pratyayarūpā ca, tāsu vibhakttyādeśarūpā yathā “pañcamyāstasil” “saptamyāstral”, “idamo haḥ”, “kimo't”, bhavāndīrghāyurāyuṣmāndevānāṃpriya etairyoge te'nyāsāṃ ceti, yathā śarvasmāt, sarvataḥ, yasmin, yatra, taṃ bhavantam, tato bhavantaṃ, etena dūrghāyuṣā atra dīrghāyaṣā, ihāyuṣmate asmai āyuṣmate, kasya devānāṃ priyasya kka devānāṃ priyasya iti, pratyayadeśarūpā “teseśrca” tasiḥ| sa ca “gaepratiyoge pañcamyāstasiḥ” “apādāne cāhīyaruhoḥ”, “atigrahavyathanakṣepeṣvakartari tṛtīyāyaḥ”, “ṣaṣṭhyā vyāśraye” ādyadibhyaśca sarvavubhaktiḥ, iti, yathābhimanyurarjanataḥ prati, śailato'vatarati, śīlato'tigṛhyate, devā arjunato'bhavan, ādau āditaḥ, pramāṇena pramāṇataḥ iti, pratyayarūpā “thā hetau ca cchandasi”, “idamasthamuḥ”, “imorhil”, , “prakāravacane thāl” “thā hetau ca cchandasi”, “idamasthamuḥ”, “kimaśca” iti, yathā śarvadā, etarhi, sarvathā, prakathā, itthaṃ, kathaṃ iti| avibhaktikāryā'pi tridhā śabdoktā, arthoktā, prayogoktā ca, tāsu śabdokta yathā “saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyostātiḥ”, “devamanuṣyapuruṣapurumatryebhyo dvitīyāsaptabyorbahulam” iti, yathā purastādvasati, purastādāgataḥ, purastādramaṇīyaṃ, devatrā gacchati, manuṣyatrā vasati, puruṣatrābhiniviśete iti, yathāgninā tulyamayaṃ vartate agnivat, devamiva bhavantaṃ paśyāmi devavat, brahmaṇena tulyamasmai dīyate brahmaṇavat, vyāghreṇa tulyamasmādvibheti vyāghravat, madhurāyāmiva pāṭalipuktre prāsādāḥ madhurāvat, śrotriyasyevāsya śuklā dantā śrotriyavat| taddhitavibhaktiriti vaktavye avyayagrahaṇam, adhistri, pratyurasaṃ, pāregaṅgaṃ, purā, sākṣāt ityevamādīnāmupasaṃgraṇārthamiti|| “prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam” “ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte” | tat tridhā viśeṣyarūpaṃ, viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ, tulyarūpaṃ ca, tatra vieśyarūpaṃ yathā puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva puruṣāvyāghraḥ, pūjito'śvaḥ aśvakuñjaraḥ, garbhiṇī gauḥ gogarbhiṇī, stoko'gniḥ agnistokaḥ, kāyasya pūrvaḥ pūrvakāyaḥ, ardhaṃ puppalyāḥ ardhapippalī iti, viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ yathā rājñaḥ purūṣaḥ rājapurūṣaḥ, dantānāṃ rājā rājadantaḥ, kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ kaṣṭaśritaḥ, jīvikāmāpannaḥ āpannajīvikaḥ, nīsamutpalaṃ nīlotpalaṃ, uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ iti, tulyarūpaṃ yathā śaśtrīva śyāmā śastrīśyāmā, khañjaścāsau kubjaśceti khañjakubjaḥ, nirgataḥ kauśāmbyāḥ niṣkauśāmbiḥ, cātrā govo'sya citraguḥ, ardhaṃ tṛtīyameṣāṃ ardhatṛtīyāḥ, ke sabrahmacāriṇo'sya kiṃsabrahmacārī iti | nanu ca, ardhaṃ tṛtīyameṣāmiti anyapadārtho nopapadyate | sa hi tatra syāt, yatra yeṣāṃ padānāṃ samāsaḥ, tato'nyasya padasyārtho bhavati| naiṣa doṣaḥ | avayavena vigrahaḥ, samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ | nanvevaṃ sati, “asudvitīya'nusasāra pāṇḍaḍḍatdhvam” “saṅkarṣaṇādvitīyasya balaṃ kṛṣṇasya vardhatām” | idityādiṣu dvayodrvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | naivam, alirdvitīyo yasyatyanyapadārthenaika evocyate | yathā “janārdanastvātmacaturtha eva” iti | yadi vā, dvitīyaśabdo'yamasti tīyāntaḥ saṃkhyāpūraṇaḥ, asti cāvyutpannaḥ sahayavācī, tasyeha grahaṇam asudvitīyaḥ asisahāya ityarthaḥ | ātmacaturtha iti ko'yaṃ samāsaḥ? nanvanyapadārtha ātmā caturthaḥ asyeti | ātmānā caturtha iti tatpuruṣaḥ kasmānna bhavati? “ātmanaśrca pūraṇe” iti tṛtīyāyā alukprasaṅgāt | yadyevam, aluk na vaktavyaḥ, ātmānā caturtha iti vākyaṃ bhaviṣyati, ātmacaturtha iti ca vṛttiḥ, na cātmaṭaturtha ityukte bahuvrīhau tatpuruṣe vā'rthabhedo vidyate, ubhayathā'pi catussaṃkhyopalakṣitasamudāyapratīteḥ | naivam, evaṃ sati, rājñaḥ sakhā rājasakhaḥ ityapyukte saṃbandhādetadnantavyaṃ nūnaṃ rājā'sya sakhā, rājasakheti cokte gantavyametad rājñassakhā'yamiti | tataśrca bahuvrīhitatpuruṣayoranyataro na prāpnoti | maivam, astyatra viśeṣas tatpuruṣe samāsānto bhavati, yathā “svasti somasakhāya te” bahuvrīhau na bhavati, yathā “vṛtraṃ jahi marutsakhe” iti | ihāpi tahryasti viśeṣas tatpuruṣe ātmānācaturthasādhyametat, bahuvrīhāvātmacaturthasādhyametaditi| api ca, anyathājātīyaḥ pratyakṣeṇārthasaṃpratyayaḥ, anyathājātīyaḥ khalvanumānena bhavati, tatrāyaṃ rājñassakhā, ātmānā caturtha iti pratyakṣeṇa, saṃbandhasyobhayaniṣṭhatvāt nūnaṃ rājā'pyasya samudāyasyaikārthatvādekavacanam, evamardhatṛtīyā ityatrāpi kasmānna bhavati? anye'pi hyekārthā eva samudāyā bhavanti, tadyathā śataṃ, yūthaṃ, vanamiti | viṣama upanyāsaḥ, ātmacaturtha ityatra hi bahuvrīhiṇopasarjanīkṛtapratīyamānaparasaṃkhyeyasamānādhikaraṇātmacaturthaśahdaśaktyabhidheyo janārdana eko'syetyanyapadasyārthaḥ pratipādyate, iha tu ardhatṛtīyaśabdaśaktyabhidheyāstrayaḥ sekheyeyāḥ | tatra yadyekavacanaṃ vākye vṛttau vā bhavati, keṣāṃ tadardhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhavati? nanvevamapi, ardhatṛtīyā droṇā iti droṇaśabdaḥ samudāye vṛtto nārdhe vartate | naiṣa doṣaḥ, samudāyeṣu vṛttāḥ śabdāḥ avayaveṣvapi vartante, tadyathā pūrve pañcālāḥ, uttarāḥ kuravaḥ iti | atha, dvau droṇāvardhāḍhakaṃ ca kartavyamardhatṛtīyā droṇā iti | na kartavyam | samudāye śabdāḥ pravṛttāḥ teṣvavayaveṣu vartante, tṛtīyamanayoriti vigrahaḥ kriyate, ko doṣaḥ syāt? ṣaṣṭhyartho nopapadyate, kiṃ hi dvayostṛtīyamardhaṃ bhavati? bhavānapi pṛṣṭo vyācaṣṭām | atheha devadattasya bhrāteti kaḥ saṃbdhārtha? ekasmāt prādurbhāva iti cet, vātrtaṃ tat, tadyathā śārtikānāmekapratiśrayadvijānāṃ prātarutthāya vipratiṣṭhamānānāṃ na kaśrcitparasparabhisaṃbandho bhavati evaṃjātīyakaṃ bhrātṛtvaṃ nāma, tatra cedyuktaḥ ṣaṣṭhyartho ddaśyate, iiihāpi yukto ddaśyatām, dvayohryanujanmā tṛtīyo bhavati | ddaśyate cānyatrāpi dvayostṛtīyena saṃbandhaḥ, tadyathā nisargabhinnāspadamekasaṃsthamasmindvayaṃ śrīśrca sarasvatī ca | kāntyā girā sūnatayā ca yogyā tvameva kalyāṇi tayostṛtīyā|| iti || nanvevam, ardhatṛtīyā ānīyantāmityardhānayanaṃ na prāpnoti, bahuvacanaṃ ca nopapadyate| naiṣa doṣaḥ, bhavati hi bahaguvrīhau tadguṇasaṃvijñānamapi, tadyathā śuklavāsasamānaya, lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ pracarantīti tadguṇa ānīyate, tadguṇāśrca pracaranti | bahuvacanaṃ tu dvitrādivadupapadyata iti, tatra yathā ānīyantāmiti trayāṇāmiva dvayorapyānayanapakṣe bahuvacanamupapannaṃ bhavati, tathehāpi bhaviṣyati| viṣama upanyāsaḥ, tatra hi dvau vetyukte trayo veti gamyate, trayo vetyukte dvau veti gamyate, saiṣā samānādhikaraṇapadārthapañcakādhiṣṭhānā vāk, tatra yuktaṃ bahuvacanam, iha tvardhaṃ tṛtīyamanayorityukte yadyapi gamyate trayāṇaṃ pūraṇastṛtīyo bhavatīti, tathā'pi samāse'nyapadārthaparatayā dvayorevābhidhānādbahuvacanasya notpattiḥ | tadguṇasaṃvijñānamapi samāsābhidhānapakṣaevopapadyate, samāsaśrca sāmathrye sati bhavati, sāmathryaṃ ca vṛttivākyayoraikāthryam, tañca tadopajāyate, yadi vṛttāviva vākyeṣa'pi samāsārthasya bahuvacanaṃ bhavati| atha kiṃsabrahmacārīti ko'yaṃ samāsaḥ? ke sabrahmacāriṇo'syeti | kaḥ sabrahmacārītī karmadhārayaḥ kasmānna bhavati? bhavati, yadi kṣepo gamyate, yathā kiṃrājā yo narakṣati, kiṃgauḥ yo na vahati | keṣāṃ sabrahmacārīti tatpuruṣastarhi bhavatu | kaṭha iti prativacanaṃ nopapadyate, na hyanyat pṛṣṭenānyadākhyeyam, ataḥ kaṭhānāmiti prativaktavyaṃ bhavati | bahuvrīhāvapyetattulyameva, tatrāpi ke sabrahmacāriṇo'syeti bahuvacanapraśrne kaṭha iti naikavacanenottaraṃ bhavati | naiṣa doṣaḥ, agnau karavāṇīti nyāyena bhaviṣyati, tadyathā kiśrcidāhāgnau karavāṇīti, tatra kurviti tatkartaryanujñāte karmāpyanujñānaṃ bhavati| evaṃ tathaiva ke sabrahmacāriṇo'syetyukte kaṭhā iti pratyukte saṃbandhādetadegamyate ayamapi kaṭhaḥ, tathā kaṭha ityapyukte saṃbandhādetadavagantavyam te'pi kaṭhāḥ | samāsena tu pratinirdeṣṭumaśakyam, upasarjanaṃ hi tatra de bhavantīti|| aikapadyaṃ samāsaḥ| sa tridhopaśrliṣṭākriyaḥ, gamitakriyaḥ, akriyaśrca | teṣūpaśliṣṭākriyo dvidhobhayasthakriyaḥ, anyatarasthakriyaśca, tayorubhayasthakriyo yathāī kṛtākṛtaṃ, kliṣṭākliśitaṃ, snnātānuliptaḥ, bhraṣṭaluñcitaḥ, kṛṣṭātikṛṣṭaṃ, krayākrayikā iti, anyatarasthakriyo yathā bhojyeṣṇaṃ, prāptajīvukaḥ, āhitāgniḥ, kaṣṭaśrataḥ, kākapeyā, idhmapravraśrcanaḥ iti | gamitakriyo dvidhobhayakārakaḥ, anyatarakāraraśrca | tayorubhayakārako yathā dadhnopasṛṣṭa odanaḥ dadhyodanaḥ, guḍeḍḍatdhna miśrā dhānā guḍaḍḍatdhdhānāḥ, śaṅkulayā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, akṣeṣu prasaktaḥ rśauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ akṣarśauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, kaṇṭhe sthitaḥ kālo yasya kaṇṭhekālaḥ, pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapālaḥ iti | anyatarakārako yathā pragata ācāryaḥ prācāryaḥ, atikrānto mālāmatimālaḥ, avakraṣṭhaḥ kokilayā avakesilaḥ, pariglāno'dhyayanāya paryadhyayanaḥ, niśkrāntaḥ kauśāmbyāḥ niṣkauśāmabiḥ, prapatitāni palāśānyasya prapasāśaḥ iti | akrayodvidhā vasturūpaḥ, avasturūpaśrca | tayorvasturūpo yathopakumbhaṃ, tribhuvanaṃ, nālotpalaṃ, rājapuruṣaḥ, citraguḥ, dhavakhadirau iti | avasturūpo yathādhistri, pratyurasaṃ, yathā śakti, yāvadamatraṃ, pārogaṅgaṃ, madhyesamudraṃ iti | ayaṃ tu upaśliṣṭakriyo gamitakriyaśca bhavati| yathāyatīgavamāgacchatyātiṣṭhadgūpatiṣṭhate | nikucya karṇe śārdūlo'pohya pucchī pradhāvati|| yathā ca śalākāparyabhidyūtaṃ catuṣparyakṣuryapi | viparyaste vidhau paśya talāderapi jāyate || keśākeśi, bāhūbāhavi, daṇḍādaṇḍi, muṣṭīmuṣṭi ityāpi gamitakriyamasattvarūpaṃ kecit | yathā roṣāveśādābhimukhyena kaucinnāmagrāhaṃ raṃhasaivopajātau | bhitvā hetī mallavanmuṣyaṭighātaighrgantau bāhūbāhavi vyāsajetām || kaicitpunarasya vasturūpatvaṃ bruvate | yathā daṇḍādaṇḍi, na kurvanti na kacākaci kokilāḥ | tathā'pi jitamevābhirvāgbhireva jagatrayam || iti | kutaḥ punaretat yadekadā daṇḍyādaṇḍyādayaḥ sattvarūpāḥ, anyadā tvasattvarūpā iti? “tatra tenedamiti sarūpe” sūtrasya vyākhyānabhedāt | tatrāsya sūtrasyāyamartho dve samānākṛtī śabdarūpe anyapadārthe samasyete tatreti teneti ca | kaḥ punarihānyapadārthaḥ? kecidāhur itiśabdaprakāravācitvācitvāt, uttarasmin sattvarūpatā, idamiti sarvanāmnā vasturūpaparāmarśāt | kaḥjha punaḥ ihetiśabdārthaḥ? yo'sau tatretyadhikaraṇe teneti karaṇe vā idamarthānuyāyinī itikartavyatārūpā kriyā, tatra gṛhūtvā tena prahṛtya itāyadikaḥ, sarvanāmārtho yattaditi taditi vyapadeśārhagrahaṇapraharaṇādikāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sādhyaṃ yuddhādi | tadāha candragomī “tatra gṛhītvā tena prahṛtya yuddhe sarūpaṃ supsupaikārthe bhavati” iti | kimetadvaktavyam? na vaktavyam | kathamanucyamānaṃ gamyate? “sarūpa” ityekaśeṣāpavādena dvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ karaṇayośrca tulyakālanirdaśāt| na hi dvayosatulyabalayoḥ pratiyoginovryāpāramantareṇa dvayoradhikaraṇayoḥ karaṇayorvā tulyakālanirdeśo bhavati | tathā'pi yuddhādiniyamo na labhyate | kaḥ punarāha niyam iti? yuddhagrahaṇāderanyatrāpi prayogāt | haste haste ca gṛhītvā mītrāya putraṃ samarpayati hastāhasti, gālibhiśrca gālibhiśrca nirbhatsrya pravṛttaḥ parihāso gālīgāli iti|| nanu ca, anyapadārthe bahuvrahirityucyamāne vispaṣṭapaṭurvaṭuḥ, punarutsyūtaṃ vāsaḥ, paraśśatāḥ śaradaḥ, iti sāmānyasamāsānām, svayaṃdhautau pādau, sāmibhuktamannaṃ, śreṇīkṛtāḥ pattayaḥ, iti viśeṣasamāsānām, vinirṛttaprarūḍho vṛkṣaḥ, kṛṣṇapiṅgalo grāvā, īṣatkaḍāro'śmeti viśeṣaṇasamāsānāṃ, avakokisaṃ vanaṃ, paryadhyayanaśchātraḥ, niṣkauśāmbiḥ sārthaḥ iti pradisamāsānāma, śastrīśyāmā devadattā, avataptenakulasthitaṃ tavaitat, kūpamaṇḍūḍḍatdhko māṇavakaḥ ityupamānasamāsānām, rājavallabhā vallabhī, varapradeyā kanyā, māso jāto'syeti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsānām, kaṣṭaśrito ripuḥ, vṛkabhīto nyaṅkuḥ, śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ pogaṃḍaḍḍatdhḥ iti kārakasamāsānām, aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, pumānanekaḥ padārthaḥ iti nañsamāsānāṃ ca bahuvrīhisaṃjñā prāpneti | naivam, naiṣāmanyapadārthatvaṃ samāsena kriyate, api tu guṇavacanatvena | yadasau dravyaṃ śrato bhavati guṇaḥ, tasya yalliṅgaṃ vacanamārtho vā sa tasyāpi bhavati, tadyathā śuklaṃ vastraṃ, śuklā śāṭī, śuklaḥ kebalaḥ, śuklau paṭau, śukla paṭāḥ iti | kathaṃ punaḥ vispaṣṭapaṭuprabhṛtīnāṃ sāmānyasasaṃtā? “vispaṣcādīni guṇavacaneṣu” iti jñāpakaiḥ samāsāvagame viśeṣasamāsasaṃjñābhāve, “saha supā” iti samāsābhyupagame ca “prākḍārātsamāsaḥ” iti samāsasaṃjñāśrayaṇāt| kathaṃ svayaṃdhautādīnāṃ viśeṣasamāsatā? “svayaṃ ktena” “sāmi” iti svayaṃsāmītiśabdayorvṛttivākyaviśeṣe'pi svaraikapadyārthamaiva samāsārambhāt|” “śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ” “cvyarthe” iti ca vṛttāvarthaviśeṣyabhāvāt| nanu ca, yadā chinno na tadā prarūḍhaḥ, yadā prarūḍho na tadā chinnaḥ, tatkathamarthayoḥ parasparamasaṃmūrchanāyāṃ samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇo viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati? ya eva chinnaḥ sa evāyaṃ prarūḍhaḥ ityanusaṃdhānāt| atheha kathaṃ kṛṣṇapuṅgala iti? yo hyasya kṛṣṇo bhāgaḥ na sa piṅgalāḥ, yastu puṅgalaḥ sa na kṛṣṇa iti | samudāyeṣu vṛttāḥ śabdā avaveṣu vartante, yathā pūrve pañcālāḥ, uttarāḥ kurava iti | yadi vā, kṛṣṇāvayavayogātsa eva kṛṣṇaḥ, puṅgalāvayavayogātsa eva puṅgalaḥ itiyupapadyate sāmānādhikaraṇayam | atha, īṣadityanena kiṃ viśeṣyam? kaḍāraguṣayuktaḥ padārthaḥ| kathaṃ punavyayānāmasattavavacanatve sattvabhūtārthaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhavati? kriyāviśeṣaṇatvāt| kā punaratra kriyā? kaḍāreṇa guṇenayogaḥ| yadi vā avyayānāṃ keṣāṃcit sattvagandhitvena śaktiyogādiḥ sattvadharmo ddaśyate, tadyathā doṣāmanyamahaḥ, divāmanyā rātriḥ| “divākāradrakṣati yo guhāsu lūnaṃ divā bhītamivāndhakāram” iti | “grahavati mitrahāriṇi na tvaṃ yoṣā'si doṣa'si” iti | evamayamapi sattvagandhitvena guṇaṃ viśiṃṣan dravyaṃ viśeṣayiṣyati | nanu, kaḍāraṃ, dravyameva kasmānna viśeṣayate? yatheṣattantraṃ kātantraṃ iti | tathā sati guṇasyeṣadbhāvo na labhyate, taduktam “īṣadbhaṇavatacanena” iti | atha kathaṃ prādīnāṃ dravyavacanaiḥ samāsaḥ? yatra hi kaśrcit kriyāvācī śabdaḥ prayujyate, tatraiva prādīnāṃ prayogo bhavati| ucyate, prayogādevaitadgantavayṃ nūnamatra prayogārhaḥ śabdo na prayujyate, yena prādeḥ sāmathryamiti | tadyathā dhūmaṃ ddaṣṭvā'gniratreti gamyate, triviṣṭabdhakaṃ ca ddaṣṭvā, parivrājaka iti | ke punaratra prayogārhāḥ śabdāḥ? ye kṛdantāḥ karmakartṛvācinaḥ, tadyathāvakruṣṭaṃ kokilayā avakokilaṃ, pariglāno'dhyayanāya prayadhyayanaḥ, niṣkrantaḥ kauśāmbyā niṣkauśāmbiḥ iti | atha kathaṃ śāstrīśyāmādaya upapannasamāsā upapadyante? “upamānāni sāmānya vacanaiḥ” ityādibhiḥ| yadyaivam, “ivena vibhaktyalopaḥ pūpvadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ ca” iti na vaktavyam vāsasī iva, kanye iva, ityādiprayogāṇāṃ “upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ” ityanenaiva siddheḥ, vibhaktyalopamātre punaralukprakaraṇe vaktavyaṃ bhavati| ucyate nāyamiva śabdaḥ sāmānyavācī, api tu sāmānyadyotakaḥ, tadyāthā netre nīlotpale ityukte tadākākatāntyādayaḥ pratīyante| śastriśyāmetyādiṣu sākṣāt sāmānyacavacanaḥ śyāmāśabdaḥ prayujyate| atha, avataptenakulasthitamityatra katham? na hyayamupamāyāṃ, api tu kṣepe | upāmānenātra kṣepo gamyate’vatapte nakulasyeva sthitaṃ tavaitañcāpalamiti, yathā'vatapte nakulaśrcirasthātā na bhavati, tadvat kāryamārabhya yaśrciraṃ tatra nāvatiṣṭhate sa evamucyate’vatapte nakulasthitaṃ tavaitaditi | etena kūpamaṇḍuḍḍatdhka ityāpi vyākhyātama, yathā kūpamaṇḍūḍḍatdhkaḥ kūpādbahiranissaran deśāntaravyavāhāraṃ na jānāti, tathā'yaṃ svagehādvahiraniḥsaran na deśāntaparavyavahāravedī, sa evamucyate kūpamaṇḍūḍḍatdhko'yamiti | atha rājavallabhetyādayaḥ kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāḥ? yato rājavallabhetyavaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ kasmānna bhavati rājā vallabho'syāḥ iti? acetanatvena vallabhyā vāllabyāyogāt | rājñastu vallabheti bhavati| tatra rājā nijrñatasyārthaḥ, svabāvataḥ sāmānyāt pracyutaḥ, sāmānye vyavasthitasyopakartumaśakteḥ, saṃbandhisāmānyāpekṣaḥ, saṃbandhisāmānyāpekṣo vā, saṃbandhantarasya vyavacchedārthe pravṛtteḥ, ubhayādhiṣṭhānatve satyāpi saṃbandhasya parārthamupādānādudbhūtasaṃbandhaṣaṣṭhyanta upādīyate | pradhānāni cānijrñātārthāni prathamayaiva vibhaktyā yujyante, tadyathā “kka punaridaṃ paṭhitam? bhrājā nāmaślokāḥ “ iti | tataśca vallabāśabdo'nijrñātārthatvādātmavyapadeśāya svārthādpracyutaḥ svabhāvato viśeṣavṛttiḥ, satyapyarthitve guṇānāmevopalambhāt, parata idaṃkāraṃ lipsamāno nijrñātārthena saṃbandhinā svārthaviśeṣe niyamyamāna upatautsukyaḥ audāsīnyena pravartate| tatra bhedādhiṣṭhānasya saṃbandhasya vācikā ṣaṣṭhī, padāntarābhidheye saṃbandhikāṃkṣāvatā guṇapadena viśeṣyamāṇā guṇapadasthā śrūyate, viśeṣaviṣaytavātsamāsasya| guṇāśrca svārthopasarjanapradhānārthopapādino bhede vinivartamāne bhedādhiṣṭhānaṃ saṃbandhaṃmabhyantarīkṛtya pravartante | tatra rājavallabheti saṃbandhe prātipadikārthatāmāpādyamāne tadviṣayā ṣaṣṭhī, svabhāvato nivṛttā kāryārthe sāmānyena prasaktā “supo dhātuprātipadikayoḥ” iti śāstrādvinivartamāne vā'nvākhyāyate| atha varapradeyā kanyeti ko'yaṃ samāsaḥ? ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa eva, yathā devadeyaṃ puṣpaṃ, brāhmaṇadeyaṃ dhanamiti| nanvevam, , ete caturthīsamāsāḥ kasmānna bhavanti? “caturthī tadarthārthabalihitasukharakṣitaiḥ” iti tadarthādiṣveva tatsamāmnānāt| tādathrya eva hi tarhi samāsā bhavantu, yaddhi yasmai pradīyate tadarthameva tadbhavati| naivam| na tādathryamātre caturthī samāsyate| yathāvahananāyolūkhrasama| api tu prakṛtivikāratādathrye |yathā yūparūpāyā vikṛteḥ prakṛtibhūtaṃ dāru yūpādārviti| nanu ca nātra prakṛtivikāragrahaṇamasti, ddaśyate cāprakṛtivikārabāve'pi, aśvaghāsaḥ, śvaśrūsuraṃ, “athāto dharmajijñāsā” iti caturthīsamāsaḥ, tatkathamucyate prakṛtivikāratādathrye eva catuthryāssāmathryamiti? ācāryaparvṛttijrñāpayati yadayaṃ balirakṣitagrahaṇaṃ karoti yathājātīyatakānāṃ ca samāse balirakṣigrahaṇamanurūktaṃ bhavati, tathājātīyakānāṃ samāsaḥ| vikṛtīnāṃmeva catuthryantānāṃ prakṛtibhissaha samāse valirakṣitagrahaṇamapuruktaṃ bhavati, na tādathryamātre| aśvaghāsādayastu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā bhaviṣyanti | yaddhiyadarthe bhavati, ayamapi tatrābhisaṃbandhas tasyedamiti | tadyathā guroridaṃ yadbharvarthamiti| tādathryamapi saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ, viśeṣe cāvaśyameva sāmānyaṃ saṃbhavati| na caitatkrarmādiṣvapi na ddaśyate māṣāṇāmaśrnīyāt, śrutaṃ te sarvamevaitat iti | nanu ca varapradeyā kanyeti yadi dadātiprayoge'pi na saṃpradānam, saṃpradāneṣaḍaḍḍatdhpi na caturthī, ko'nyaḥ tayorviśeṣo bhaviṣyati? kaḥ punarāha nātra saṃpradānam, saṃpradāna evaiṣā catuthryarthe ṣaṣṭhū, ddaśyate hi saṃpradānādau ṣaṣṭhīcaturthayoraviśeṣeṇa prayogaḥ, tadyāthā “himavato hastī” “puruṣamṛkaścandramase “ “na vā are jāyāyai kāmaya jāyā priyā bhavatyatmanastu kāmāya jāyā priyā bhavati” cirāya ddaṣṭaḥ, cirarātrāya ddaṣṭaḥ, “rocate mama ghṛtaṃ saha nudgaiḥ śālayo dadhiśaraṃ kramakāśrca” “śṛtameva mamāpi rocate śṛtaśītaṃ ca saśarkaraṃ payaḥ” iti| atha māsajāto'yamiti kiṃpradhāno'yaṃ samāsaḥ? uttarapadārthapradhāvanaḥ | sadharmaṇā'nenānyairuttarapadārthapradhānairbhavitavyam| anyeṣu cettarapadārthapradhāneṣu yaivāsāvanvarvartinī vibhaktistayāḥ samāse'pi śravaṇaṃ bhavati, tadyathā rājñaḥ puruṣo puruṣo rājuruṣaḥ iti | iha punarvākye ṣaṣṭhī, samāse prathamā| kainaitadevaṃ bhavati? yo'sau māsajātayorabhisaṃbandhaḥ sa samāse nirvantate, abhihitaḥ so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti, tatra “prātipadikārtheprathamā” iti prathamā bhavati| na tarhidānīmidaṃ bhavati māsajātasyeti| bāhyaṃ saṃbandhinamapeśrya bhaviṣyati| nanu ca “kālāḥ parimāṇinā” ityanenāyaṃ samāsaḥ| na ca jātasya māsaḥ parimāṇaṃ, api tu triṃśadrātrasya, yathā droṇo badarāṇāṃ devadattasyeti na devadattasyadroṇaḥ parimāṇaṃ, api tu badarāṇam, tadāha “kālasya yena samāsastasyāparimāṇitvādanirdeśaḥ” iti| kiṃ punarbhavān kālaṃ manyate? yena mūrtīnāmupacayā apacayāśrca lakṣyante | tasyaivaṃ tarhi kayācit kriyāyā yuktasyāhariti bhavati, saṃvatsara iti ca rātririti ca | kayā kriyayā? ādityagatyā| tayaivā'sakṛdāvṛttayā māsa iti ca bhavati, saṃvatsara iti ca bhavati| yadyevaṃ bhavati jātasya māsaḥ parimāṇaṃ, kiṃ tu māso jātasyetivat māsau jātasyaya māsā jātasyeti prāpnoti | naivaṃ, māsajātaḥ ityukte dvitvādisaṃkhyāviśeṣasyānupalambhāt | yatra tūpalabdhernimittamasti tatra bhavatyeva, yathā dvau māsau jātasya dvimāsajātaḥ, evaṃ trimāsajātaḥ iti| kathaṃ punaḥ kārakāṇaṃ samāsa ityupapannaṃ bhavati? teṣāṃ hi kriyayaivābhusaṃbandha, na ca kriyāvācinaḥ subantatvamasti | subantayorevāntarbhūtakriyāviśeṣayorbhaviṣyatīti cet, naivam, dravyāṇāṃ kriyopṛnissaṃbandhaṃ śeṣaviṣayo bhavati, na kārakaviṣayaḥ | svabhāvasiddhaṃ hi dravyaṃ siddhavadabhidhīyamānaṃ dravyāntaraṃ pratyatmapratilambhe nirākāṃkṣaṃ na karmādibhāvaṃ bhajate| na ca samāsaprakaraṇe kārakāṇi samasyante iti vacanamasti| ucyate mā bhūdvacanam, arthatastu gamyate, yadāha dvitīyā śritādibhiḥ samasyate, kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ kaṣṭaśritaḥ iti | tatra śrita ityupāttakriyāviśeṣaparicchinnaḥ kartā, abhyantarīkatasādhyasādhanasaṃbandhakriyāntarasaṃbanadhārhaḥ svaśrayāviṣayāsu bāhyāsu śaktyantarairapi viruddhaikārthasamavāyaḥ kaṣṭādīnyupasarjanībhūtayā śrayatikriyayā'pekṣate| tataśrca śrayatikriyayā saṃbandhāt kaṣṭe karmatvamiti śrayaṇakriyāpūrvakaḥ kaṣṭaśritayorabhisaṃbandho bhavati| tasminsvavṛttyavayavārthaśaktyanugṛhīte'rthāntare prādurbhūte tadabhidhāyī śabdassamāsasaṃjñāṃ labhate| evaṃ vṛkādbhīto vṛkabhīta ityatrāpi “pañcamī bhayena” iti vṛkasya bhaye “bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ” ityapādānatvāt sati, sāmathrye, abhyantarīkṛtakriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsasaṃjñāṃ labhate| nanu ca, na vṛkasya bhūtaṃ pratyapādānatvaṃ, apitu bhayaṃ bhītirityetāni| ucyate yathā māso jātasyeti māsākhyaḥ kriyākalāpaḥ prathamakukṣigarbhaviyogākhyasya janmano'vadhibhāvena paricchedako bhavati, janmapratilabdhāṃ vā sattāṃ samāvṛtya jātamapekṣate, tathehāpi vṛkādityayamapādānaśabdo bhayamātrasyaivāvacchedako bhaviṣyati, na bhūtasya| yadi, vā, yathā kaṣṭaśrita ityatropāttaśrayatikriyāsaṃbandhāt kaṣṭe karmatvamiti śrayaṇakriyāpūrvakaṃ kaṣṭena saṃbanyate, tathehāpyupāttabhayakriyāvavacchinnaḥ kartā bhayakriyāsaṃbandhāddhṛkasyāpādānatvamiti bhayakriyāpūrvakaṃ vṛkena saṃbhatsta iti| bhavatu yatropasarjanībhūtāyā api kriyayāḥ śravaṇam, yatra tu kriyā na śrūyate tatra kathaṃ śaṅkulākhaṇḍa, iti? pratīyamānā bhaviśaṣyati, tathā hi śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ ityukte kṛta iti pratīyate, tadetaddyotayannaha “tṛtīyā tatkṛtena guṇavacanena” iti| nyāyasiddhatvādvacanānārthakyamiti cet, na, vacanasya niyamārthatvād yatraiva kṛta ityādi gamyate tatraiva samāsaḥ, anyatra mā bhūditi| evaṃ ca gamyamānakarotikriyopagṛhītakaraṇakartṛtṛtīyāntena śaṅkulādinā khaṇḍādīnāṃ guṇamuktavatāṃ matublopādinā dravyavacanānāṃ tṛtīyāntārthakṛtatve sati sāmathryamavasīyate, yathākṣaṇā kāṇaḥ, pādena khañjaḥ iti| tadevamākṣiptakarotikriyāvacchinnaḥ kriyāntarasaṃbandhārhaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdārtho gamyamānopasarjanībhūtayā karotikriyayā śaṅkulādīnapekṣamāṇaḥ karaṇabhūkauḥ kartṛbhūtairvā śaṅkulādibhissaṃbadhyate| tadvacanaśrca samudāyo'bhyantarūbhūtakriyākārakasaṃbandhaḥ samāsasaṃtro bhavati| atheha kasmānna bhavati dadhnā paṭuḥ ghṛtena paṭuriti? asāmathryāte| kathamasāmathryam? sāpekṣamasamarthaṃ bhavati, na hi dadhnaḥ paṭunā sāmathryam| kiṃ tarhi? bhujinā dadhnā bhuṅktepaṭariti | ihāpi tarhi na prāpnoti śaṅkulāyā khaṇḍa, iti, atrāpi na śaṅkulāyāḥ khaṇḍeḍḍatdhna sāmathryam? kiṃ tarhi? karotinā śaṅkulayā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍa, iti | tatkṛteneti vacanādbhaviṣyati| vacanāditi cet, atheha giṇavacanenetyucayamāne kathaṃ matublopāddravyavacanena khaṇḍādineti pratīyate? vacanagrahaṇāt, iha tṛtīyā tatkṛtena guṇeneti siddhe yadvacanagrahaṇaṃ karoti tsayaitat prayojanam, evaṃ yathā vijñāyeta guṇamuktavān guṇavacanaḥ, khaṇḍaḍḍatdhgiṇavān khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, pāṇḍuḍḍatdhguṇavān pāṇḍuḍḍatdhḥ iti | yadyevaṃ, nārthastatkṛtagrahaṇevana bhavati, bhavati hi śaṅkulāyāḥ khaṇḍeḍḍatdhna sāmathryam, asāmathryādiha na bhaviṣyati dadhnā paṭuriti| idaṃ tarhi tatkṛtasya prayojanaṃ dravyavacanaiḥ kārakasamāse tatadanurūpā kriyā adhyāhartavyeti, tadyathākṣeṣu prasaktaḥ śauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ akṣaśauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ iti | atha dravyavacanastatkṛtasamāse giṇavacanenetyapi kmartham? iha mābhūd dhānyena dhanavān, gobhirvapāvān iti || atha, aśraddhabhojīte ko'yaṃ samāsaḥ? asamarthanañatatpuruṣaḥ| kiṃ punarihāsāmathryam? pūrvottarapadayormitho'napekṣā, tathā hy aśrāddhabhojīti bhujikriyayā nañaḥ saṃvandhaḥ, na śraddhena, na hi tasyāyaṃ niyamo naśraddhaṃ bhoktavyamiti | api tu śraddhaṃ na bhoktavyamiti | yatra hi vartipadārthasamavāyini kriyā'bhidhīmānā pratīyamānā vā svabhāvato vivṛtā nañā dyotyate’pācakaḥ, abrāhmaṇaḥ iti, tatraiva sāmathryam| yatra tu bāhyakriyāyā nañaḥ saṃbandhastatrāsāmathryaṃmeva, yathā śūryamapi na paśyanti asūryaṃpaśyā rājadārāḥ, na punargīyante apunargeyaḥ ślokāḥ, lavaṇaṃ na bhuṅkte alavaṇabhojī bhukṣuriti | nanvevaṃ, avayavārthavyatiriktasamudāyārthābhāve'rthavattvābhāvāt kathaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā? samāsagrahaṇaditi cet, anarthake kṛtārthatvānniyamānupapattiḥ, tataśrcārthavato vakyasyāpi prātipadikatvaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu ca, “asūryalalācayodrdaśitapoḥ” ityanenāsamarthanañsamāsānāṃ sādhutve jñāpite, a kiṃcitkurvāṇaḥ, a māṣaṃ haramāṇaḥ, a gādhādutsṛptaḥ ityādīnāmapi mā bhūt samāsa ityasūryaṃpaśyādayaśrcatvāra evāsamarthasamāsāḥ parigaṇyate, parigaṇanasāmathryādeva prātipadikasaṃjñā'pi bhaviṣyati, tathā'pyanarthakatvādāśrayābhāve saṃkhyākarmādyabhāve teṣāṃ vācikā dyotikā vā'pi vibhaktayo notpadyeran| naivam, samudāyastāvadānarthakye'pi “na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā” iti niyamādavaśayamaivāvyayādivādviktimātrapekṣete, avayavastvarthavattvāt saṃkhyākarmāderāśrayatvena tāṃ viśiṣṭāmevāṅgīkaroti, tataśrca yathā''turānāturayorekabojanapratipattāvāturāṇāṃ bhojanamanāturo'pi pratipadyate, tathāvayavārthānugarahārthako'pi samudāyo viṅaktiviśeṣameva pratipatsyata iti na kaśrcaddoṣaḥ| nanu, asatyekārthībhāve vyapekṣādharmāḥ kathaṃ na nivartante? ke punaste? viśeṣaṇayogaḥ, śrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte bavimāmantraṇaṃ ceti samuñcayaḥ, śrāddhaṃ śrāddhāni vā bhuṅkte iti saṃkhyāviśeṣayogaḥ| te ca vākya evopalabhyante, na tvaśrāddhabhojīti vṛtau, nabyaśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇasya śobhanamityādi| tatkachamucyate nāstyatraikārthībhāva iti? naivam, aśrāddhabdo hyatrāsamarthaḥ, na tvaśrāddhabhojiśabdaḥ, aśrāddhabhojiviṣayāśrcaite viśeṣaṇaiyogādayaḥ pratīyante, nāśrāddhaviṣayā iti| nanu ca, yadyaśrāddhabdaḥ samudāyārthābhāvānarthakaḥ, aśrāddhabhojiśabdo'pyarthavadanarthakasaṃghātatvādanarthakaḥ prāpnoti| astvānarthakyam| vākyaviṣayāstu dharmā bhaviṣyanti tañcānarthakyamapi parihartanyam, idaṃ ca parihiyate śabdaśaktireṣā
