yadabhinna'pyarthe kevacicchabdenābhidhīyamāne viśeṣaṇādiyogo bhavati kenatinna bhavati, tatra vakye'samarthasamāsapatāmanāmavidyamānamapi vṛttau śabdāntaratvādastyekārthābhidāyitvamiti | nanu, ca yadyasāmathrya'pi vacanātsamāsaḥ kimadya te vastraṃ nīlaṃ utpalamāli karṇe, neha kaśrcitpuruṣaḥ vyāgrassarati pallīm, paśya sakhi kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ priyo megurukusam, kiṃ te śaṅkulayā khaṇḍo devadatta upalena, gaccha tvaṃ yūpāya dāru śobhanaṃ śaile, nivartasvavṛkāt bhayaṃ devadattasya yajñadattāt, bhāryā rājñaḥ puruṣo devadattsaya, saktaḥ tvamakṣeṣu śauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ pibati pānāgāre ityādāvapi samāsaḥ prāpnoti, sa tahryatrāpi vacanāt “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa”, “dvitīyā śritādibhiḥ”, “tṛtīyā tatkṛtena”, “caturthī tadarthena”, “pañcamī bhayena” “ṣaṣṭhī subantena”, “saptamī śauṇḍādibhiḥ” samasyata iti | viṣama upanyāsaḥ, parigaṇanādīnyasāmathrya eva samāsārthamārabhyante| yathā kṛtapūrvī kaṭamutyādyarthe “pūrvadiniḥ” “sapūrvāñca” iti | “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa” ityevāmādīni tu “, marthaḥ padavidhiḥ” iti sāmathrya satiyurādīyante | sāmathryaviṣayapradarśanārthameva ca “viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa” iti prathamāyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam, dvitīyāyāṃ śratādinimathamaḥ, kṛtīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tatkṛtādivacanaṃ, catuthryaṃ prakṛtivikārabhāvaḥ, pañcamyāṃbhayādiparigaṇanaṃ, ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūraṇādiniṣedhaḥṛ, saptamyāṃ śauṇḍādinirdeśaḥ ityupapadyate | tena yatra viśeṣaṇādiṣu sāmānadhikaraṇyāderabhāvaḥ, tatrāsāmathryāt samāso na bhavati|| ābrāhmaṇo'yamiti ko'yaṃ samāsaḥ? samarthanañtatpuruṣaḥ| kiṃpradhāno'yam? uttarapadārthapradhānaḥ| abrāhmaṇamānayetyukte brāhmaṇamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti | naiṣa deṣaḥ, idaṃ tāvadayaṃ praṣṭavyo’atheha rājapurūṣamānayetyukte purīṣamātrasyānayanaṃ kasmānna bhavati? rājā'tra viśeṣakaḥ prayujyate, tena rājaviśiṣṭasyānayanaṃ bhaviṣyati | kaḥ punarasau? nivṛttapadārthakaḥ| yadā punarasya padārtho nivartate, tadā kiṃ svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ? āhosvidvācanikī? kiṃ cātaḥ? yadi svābhāvīkī, kiṃ nañ prayujyamānaḥ karoti| tarhi vācanikī bhaviṣyati, kiṃca pratikīlavāt| catra yathā kīla āhanyamānaḥ pratikīlaṃ nivartayati, evaṃ nañ prayujyamānaḥ padārthaṃ nivartayat| yadyetannaño māhātmyaṃ syāt, na jātucidrājāno hastyaśvaṃ bubhṛyuḥ, netyeva brūyuḥ| evaṃ tarhi svābhāvikī nivṛttiḥ, nañnimittā tūpalabdhiḥ| tadyathā śaṃtamasāndhakāre dravyaṇāṃ pradīpanimittaṃ darśanaṃ, na ca teṣāṃ pradīpo nivartako bhavati| yadi punarayaṃ nivṛttapadārthako nañ, kimarthaṃ brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyante? evaṃ yathā vijñāyetāsya padasyārtho nivṛtta iti | neti hyukte saṃdhaḥ syāt kasya padārtho nivartata iti, tatrāsamadehārthe brāhmaṇaśabdaḥ prayujyate | yadi vā, sarva ete śabdā avaveṣvapi vartante brāhmaṇaḥ, kṣatriyaḥ, vaiśyaḥ, śūdraḥ iti || “tapaḥ śrutaṃ ca yoniśca tatra brāhmaṇakāraṇam| tapaḥśrutābhyāṃ yo hīno jātibrāhmaṇa eva saḥ|| “ tathā gauraḥ kapalaḥ piṅgalakeśa ityetānapyāntarāni brāhmaṇye guṇān bravati| samudāyeṣu ca vṛttaḥ śabdaḥ avayaveṣvapi vartante, tadyāthā pūrve pañcālāḥ, uttarāḥ kurava iti | evamayaṃ samudāye brāhmaṇaśabdo vṛtto'vayave'pi vartate guṇo jātau ca| guṇe tāvad abrāhmaṇo'yaṃ yastiṣṭhan mūtrayatīti, abrāhmaṇo'yaṃ gacchan bhakṣayatīti | api ca, kālaṃ kalmāṣaṃ māṣārāśivarṇamāpaṇa āsīnaṃ ddaṣṭā'dhyavasyati nāyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, ābrāhmaṇo'yamiti nijrñātaṃ tasya bhavati, guṇakṛtā cārthasya nivṛttiḥ| atha jātau jātihūne saṃdehāddurupadośādvāṣa'nyo brāhmaṇaśabdāḥ pravartate| saṃdehāttāvad gauramayaṃ śucyācāraṃ piṅgalaṃ kapalakeśaṃ ddaṣṭā'dhyavasyati brāhmaṇo'miti, tataḥ paścādupaṃlabhate nāyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ, ābrāhmaṇo'yamiti nijrñātaṃ tasya bhavati | atra saṃdehāñca brāhmaṇaśabdo vartate, jātikṛtā cārthasya nivṛttiḥ| atha dupudeśād durupadiṣṭamasya bhavaty amuṣminnavakāśe brāhmaṇamānayeti| sa tatra gatvā yaṃ paśyati tamadhyavasyapi brāhmaṇo'miti | tataḥ paścādipalabhate nāyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ, ābrāhmaṇo'yamiti | tatra durupadeśāñca brāhmaṇaśabdo vartate, jātikṛtā cārthasya nivṛttiḥ| nanu ca, nañvyavacchedāya brāhmaṇādiśabdaprayoge samāsasya pūrvapadapradhānatā prāpnoti, naivam, avyayasaṃjñāprasaṅāt, avyayaṃ hyasya pūrvapadam| naiṣa doṣaḥ, pāṭhenāvyayasaṃjñā kriyate| na ca nañsamāsastatra paṭhyate| mā bhūdavyayeṣu pāṭhaḥ| tathā'pyabhidheyavalliṅgavacavanāni bhavanti, yaścehārthe'bhidhīyate na tasya liṅgasaṅakhyābhyāṃ yogo'sti| nedaṃ vācanikam aliṅgatā, asaṅkhyatā vā| kiṃ tarhi? svābhāvikametat| tatra kimasmābhiśśakyaṃ vaktuṃ yannañaḥ prāksamāsālliṅgasaṅkhyābhyāṃ yogo nāsti, samāse ca bhavati| yadi vā, tasya yalliṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca tat guṇasyeva samāsasyāpi bhavati| ucyate’tyantābhavaḥ, anatyantābhāvaḥ, anyatarābhāvaḥ, tādātmyābhāvaḥ, saṃbandhābhāvaḥ, pradhvaṃsābhāvaśceti| yathārūpo vāyuḥ, anudarā kanyā, akiṃyanaḥ pumān, apiśācaḥ kuḍyaḥ, aghaṭaṃ bhūtalaṃ, anaṅgaḥ kāmaḥ, iti | yadā tūttarapadārthena nañartho viśeṣyate, tadā pūrvapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ, nañarthopādheśca ṣaṭ samāsārthabhedā jāyante prāgabhāvaḥ, sāmathryābhāvaḥ, āvaśyakatābhāvaḥ, itaretarābhāvaḥ, sattābhāvaḥ, bhāvābhāvaḥ, iti, yathānutpanno ghaṭaḥ apradhṛṣyassubhaṭaḥ, abhūṣitaḥ kāntaḥ, avarṣāḥ hemantaḥ, asat śaśaviṣāṇam, anudbhinnaḥ pravālaḥ, iti | yadā tu nañarthenottarapādārtho viśeṣyate, tadā uttarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣaḥ| padārthasya ca nañarthopādheḥ ṣaṭ samāsabhedā jāyante| yathā tadabhāvaḥ, tadanyaḥ, tatsaddaśaḥ, tadvirūddhaḥ, tadapakṛṣṭaḥ, tadutkṛṭaḥ, iti | yathānanayaḥ, anatriḥ, abrāhmaṇaḥ, asitaḥ, amanuṣyaḥ, amānuṣaḥ, iti| nanu ca, anyapadārthatatpuruṣayoranyatrāpi nañsamāso ddaśyate, yathā makṣikāṇābhāvaḥ abhakṣikamiti | nāyaṃ nañsamāśaḥ, kiṃ tarhi? “avyayaṃ vibhakti” ityādinā'vyāyamabhāvārthe samasyate, avyayībhāvaśrca samāso bhavati, yathā nivātaṃ, niśītaṃ, iti| kiṃ punaramī nañsamāsārthā anyapadārthādiṣu vyavatiṣṭhante uta saṃplavante? kecidvyavatiśṭhante pradhvaṃsābhāvādayaḥ, tadyathā bhavedabhīṣmadroṇaṃ ghṛtarāṣṭrabalaṃ katham| yadi tattulyakakṣyo'tra bhavān dhuryo na yujyate|| yathā ca anudarā kanyā, alomikā eḍaḍḍatdhketi| kecuttu saṃplavante prāgabhāvādayaḥ, tadyāthājanmā puruṣastāvadapumān paśureva vā| yāvallovatīkravīkṣitārthaṃ na budhyate|| yathā cāneke, anekaḥ iti | nanu ca, eśabedo bahvarthaḥ, tadyathā “ekaḥ ko'pi sa kumbhasaṃbhavamuniḥ” itayuktarṣārtha, tatraike tāvadāhuriti pakṣāntarārtha, eka evāyamāvayoḥ svabhāvaḥ iti tulyārthaḥ| naikaḥ śayītetyasahāyārthaḥ| ekamevedaṃ śabdabrahmetyabhedārthaḥ| ekaḥ, dvau, bahavaḥ iti saṃkhyārthaḥ| taktasyeha grahaṇam? saṃkhyārthasya| uktarṣādīnāṃ kasmanna bhavatiḥ? anabhidhānāt, tadyathāmitra ityukte pūrvapadārthapradhānatatpuruṣe śatrureva pratīyate, na tvasūryaḥ| evaṃ aneke ityukta bahava eva pratīyante, na punaranutkarṣādimantaḥ| etena tatpuruṣasyottarapadaprādhānye satyaneka ityupi vyakhyātam| kathaṃ punarekasya pratiṣedhe bahūnāṃ saṃpratyayaḥ syāt? prasajyayāyaṃ kriyāguṇau tataḥ paścānnivṛttiṃ karoti, tadyathāsaya bhojaya śāyaya anekaṃ iti | syādetat, yatra kriyāguṇau prasajyete, yatra tu khalu na prasajyete tatra tu katham anekastiṣṭhatīti? bhavatyevaṃjātīyakeṣvapi ekasya pratiṣedhe bahūnāṃ saṃpratyayaḥ, tagyathā na na ekaṃ priyam, na na ekaṃ sukham iti |. prakṛtipratyayau tredhā tridhopaskārabhaktayaḥ| tridhauvopapadaprtipadikānāṃ vibhaktayaḥ|| tridhopasarjanaṃ tredhā samāsa iti kīrtitaḥ| pratipādakaśabdo'yamathānvākhyeya ucyate|| padamiha trividhaṃ pratipādyate trividhāmeva hi vākyamatha tridhā| vyavahṛtiḥ khalu śabdanibandhanā yadanayorubhayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati|| iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgaraprakāśe prātipadikādiprakāśo nāma dvitīyaḥ prakāśaḥ|| <3> śṛṅgāraprakāśaḥ/tṛtīya tṛtīyaḥ prakṛtyādiśabdaprakāśaḥ tatra padyate'nenārtha iti padam| tatrtridhā kriyārūpaṃ, kārakarūpaṃ, upaskārarūpaṃ ca | teṣu sādhyārthabhidhāyu kriyārūpaṃ, sādhanārthabhudhāyi kārakarūpaṃ, samarthayāmi bhokṣyate bhavān, śraddhade nābhukta bhavān, avakalyayāmi nābhokṣyate bhavān, na śraddhade nanu bhavān vṛṣalaṃ yājayet, nāvakalpayāmi tatrabhavān lṛṣlaṃ yājayiṣyati, na marṣayāmi vatsyāmastatraudanaṃ bhokṣyāmahe, abhijānāsi kaliṅgeṣvavasāma tatraudanabhuñjamahi, ehi manye rathena yāsyasi jāne supto vihāya, gacchāmi, paśya mṛgo dhāvati, iha paśyāmaḥ, karmaṇi dvivacanabahuvatanānyudāhnayante iti | bhāvakartapadaṃ yathā corasya rujati, corasyamayati, corasya bādhate, corasya pīḍaḍḍatdhyati, corasya dahati, corasyātabhkayati, corasya spṛśati, corasya śoṣayati, corasya mardayati, corasya moṭyati, coraṃ jvarayati, coraṃ saṃtāpayati| tathā bharati pacati pakṣyati, bhapatyapākṣāt, bhavedapi bhavet, syāt api syāt, nāsti rame, ayūyujastvamasi, asitnamīśiṣe, asti gacchāmo vayam, astyatra kāṃcidgāṃ paśyati, si bhavati gamyate, bhavatu sādha yāma iti | karmakartṛpadaṃ yathā rajyati vastraṃ svayameva, kukṣyati pādassvayameva, avakirate hasti, avākūṣrṭa vā svayameva, granthīte mālā, agrathiṣṭa vā svayameva, cikīrṣat kaṭaḥ, acikīrṣata vā svayameva, ucchrayate daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, udaśiśrayata vā svayameva, anuruddha gaussvayameva, akṛtakaṭaḥ svayameveti| anye puramīṣāmapi karmakartṛtvaṃ manyante | bhidyate kusūlaṃ svayameva, bhidyate rajjussvayameva, lūyate kedārassvayameva, pacyate phalaṃ svayameva, bhajyate kāṣṭhaṃ svayameva, kukṣyate pādassvayameva, adohi gaissvayamaiva, arodhi gaussvayameva, ahāvi havissvayameva | tathā, bhūṣayate kanyā svayameva, maṇḍaḍḍatdhyate kanyā svayameva, dohayate gaussvayameva, ārohayate haltī svayameva, dadhayate rājā svayameva, maṇḍaḍḍatdhyate kanyā svayameva, dohayate gaussvayameva, ārohayate hastī svayameva, dadhayate rājā svayameva, abhivādaye guruḥ svayameva, lāvayate kedāraḥ svayameva, pācayate odanassvayameva, bhedayate kusūlaḥ svayameva, gaṇayati gaṇaḥ svayameva, smayati vanagusmaḥ svayameva, iti| āhuśrca “karmavat karmaṇā tulyakyyaḥ”, kramavadbhāve yadātmanepadaciṇ bhāvāḥ prayojanaṃ acaḥ karmakartari ciṇvadāhuśca “narudhaḥ”, “naduhasnu nāmāṃ yak ciṇau” “yak ciṇoḥ pratiśedhe hatumaṇṇiśribruñāmupasaṃkhyānam” “bhūṣākarmakirādīti ṇiśranthigranthibruātmanepadākarmakāṇāmupasaṃkhyānam” | tattu samyake tathā hi bhudyate kusūlaḥ svayameva, akāri kaṭaḥ svayamevetyādiṣu karmaṇyeva yak ciṇau svayaṃ śabdāttu karmakartṛkatvapratītiḥ, arodhi gauḥ svayameveti | rūdherapi kramavivakṣāyāṃ ciṇ bhavatyeva, arodhi gaurātmanaiveti bhavati| ya evārtha ātmanaiveti sa eva svayameveti| arodhīti cokte nāśrute kartṛvātini pagadāntare karmakartṛtvaṃ gamyate | tasmādihāpi karmaṇyeva ṇic | bhūṣayate kanyā svayamevetyadiṣu tu “ṇeraṇau yatkarmaṇau cet sa kartā nādhyane” iti phalavati kartaryevātmanepadam| kutastyā tarheteṣu karmakartṛtāprasiddhaḥ| śrūyatāṃ kramapadeṣu tāvat, kriyāmāṇaṃ tu yatkarma svayameva prasidhyati| sukaraṃ svairguṇaiḥ kartuḥ kramakarteti taṃ viduḥ|| kartṛpadeṣu bhūtapūrvakatvāt tadvadupacāra iti | tathāhi, kanyādayo lāvaṇyatiśayādibhiḥ ātmabhūṣāyai prasādhanādīn prayuñcate ca | māghādayo mahākavayaḥ “akuñcitapremanirūpitakramaṃ kareṇurārohayate niṣādinam| sasaṃtataṃ darśayate gatasmayaḥ kṛtādhipatyāmiva sādhubandhutām||” iti phalamanayoḥ sukhasikālokarañjanaṃ ca| anyathaiko hālastipakaiḥ pīḍyeta, dvitīyo durdarśa iti nābhigamyena atetaneṣvapi, kriyāphalavivakṣāyāṃ tu ddaśyate parivārayante vṛkṣaṃ kaṇṭākāḥ, śoṣyate brīhīnātapa iti | etena karaṇena tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavadbhavatītyāpi na vaktavayaṃ bhavati| parivārayanti kaṇṭakairvṛkṣaṃ manuṣyāḥ, parivārayante kaṇṭakāḥ svayameveti | tathā duhipacyoḥ sakarmakayoḥ kartā bahulaṃ karmavadbhavatātyāpi na daivādikatvam na setsyati| karmaṇyavivakṣāyāṃ tu karmatvaṃ, yathā kartṛtvaṃ tu svayaṃ śabdena gamyate| ityalamatiprasaṅgena| kṛdantamati khalu kriyārūpaṃ vidyate tatra bhāvo yatheha taiḥ yātaṃ, panthānaṃ bhavatā, āsīno māsaṃ bhavān āsīno māso bhavatā, bhuṅkte odanaṃ bhavān bhuṅkta odano vṛkṣo bhavatā, adhiśayīta khaṭvāṃ bhavān adhiśayitā khaṭvā bhavatā, āruḍho vṛkṣaṃ bhavān ārūḍho vṛkṣo māṇavako māṇavikāṃ anujātā māṇāvikā māṇavikena, anujīrṇo vṛṣalaṃ devadattaḥ anujīrṇā vṛṣalī devadattena iti tanna samyagvākyabhedajāt| nanu ca bhavān ākṣepalabdhaḥ kartā na tiṅ vāccaḥ, tatkathamucyate yathā jātyākṣepeṇa vyakteḥ pratītau na tāṃ prati śabdasya vācataśaktikalpanopapattimatī| kathaṃ punaḥ karturanabhidhāne pratyayasya vacanapuruṣabhedo yujyata? yathaiva nātmanepadeṣu, jātyabhidhānapakṣe jāteraliṅgasaṅkhyāyā api tadādhāravyaktyāśrayāṇi liṅgavacanāni pravartante tathaiva bhāvanāyāḥ abhede'pi tathā katrrāśrayo vacanapuruṣabhedaḥ prapatsyakatīti| na ca kartari lakāraḥ smaryate iti vācyam, yataḥ “kartari kṛt” “laḥ karmami ca bhāve'cākarmakebhyaḥ” “vartamāne laṭ” | lasya tibādayaḥ| “tiṅastroṇi trīṇa prathamamadhyamottamāḥ”, “tānyekavacanadvivacamabahuvacanānyekaśaḥ”, “yumaṣdi.... ... .... madhyamaḥ”, “asmadyuttamaḥ”, “śeṇe prathamaḥ” “bhāvarmaṇorātmanepadam”, “śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam” ityādivākyānāṃ “dvyekayordvivacanaikavacane”, “bahuṣu bahuvacanam” iti saṃkhyāvidhānena sahaikārthavivakṣayātvekavākyā vyākhyātā | eko hi pacatītyādiśabdastaivryākriyate| tatraiva vākyārtho bhavati| kartaparekavacanatve ekavacanaṃ kkipityādi, kartṛvacanaṃ tibityādi, karturbahuvacanatve bahuvacanaṃ jhītyādi, evaṃ ca bhāvanākṣiptakartṛsaṃkhyāyāmeva lakāraḥ smaryate, na kartari | ucyate, yadi bhāvanākṣiptarkṛsaṃkhyāyāmeva lakāreṇocyate, devadattevanāsyate iita bhāvābhidhāyino'pi kartṛsaṃkhyāmevābhidhānaṃ prāpnoti, ubhayatrāpikartṛsadāvāt| yenaiva hi nimittena pacatītyādau karmasaṃkhyāyamevābhidheyamāsādati tainaiva prayogāntare'pyāsādayet| kathaṃ ca kartaryabhidhīyamāne tadviśiṣṭasaṃkhyābhidhānaṃ yuktam| atha saṃkhyāmātrabhidhīyate na viśeṣaḥ, tarhi puruṣādibhedapratīteranupapattiḥ tadviśiṣṭabhidhānaṃ ca tadabhidhānuparassarameva nyāyyaṃ, nāgṛhūtaviśeṣaṇe viśeṣyabuddhirvartata iti nyāyāt| na ca śabdenāsaṃspṛśyamāno'pari kartā sannidhimātreṇa saṃkhyāṃ viśeṣayitumutsahate saṃkhyāyā dharmarūpatvāddhamrṇā karturavacchedakatvena saṃsparśā yujyate | karaṇādīnāmapi sānnidhyadharmitvāt tathātvopapatteḥ| kiñca lakāreṇābhihitayorbhāvānasaṃkhyayoruttaraḥ, kālaḥ bhāvanākṣiptaḥ kartā labhyate| tato'sya pūrvabhāvāt bhāvanāsamakālamabhihitāṃ sakhyāyā aviṣeṣāt sarvakārakāṇāmavacchedaḥ prāpnoti| paścāñca kartākṣiptaḥ kathaṃ bhāvanāsamakālamabhihitāṃ saṃkhyāmātmani nirundhyat| atha saṃkhyāvadbhāvanāpratītisamakālameva kartā pratīyate, na tahryākṣepalabhyaḥ | api tu saṃkhyāvallakoreṇābhidhīyata eveti | kiñcasa devadattadipadena pacatītyāde ssāmāndhikaraṇyadarśanāt | saṃkhyāvāni kartaiva lakāreṇaābhidhīyate| yadi punaḥ kartussaṃkhyānamekatvādikaṃ lakāro brayāt tadā devadattasya pacatītyevaṃ prayogaḥ syāt yatā devadattasyaikatvamiti | atha na saṃkhyānamucyate lakāreṇa, kintu, saṃkhyeya eva devadattādirabhidhīyate| devadattaḥ pacatītyekatvasaṃkhyāvacchinnaḥ pākaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca, saṃkhyeye'bhidhīyamāne kartaivābhihito bhavati| na ca katrrabhudhāne'pi śakteḥ kārakatvāt samānādhikaraṇanupapattiriti vācyam| śaktirhi lakāreṇāpyabhidhīyamānā guṇadravyaparantraivābhidhīyate| yathā śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, śuklā śāṭīti | apica bhavanto'pi karmasakāravācyatvaṃ manyante | tadanupapannam| yathaiva dvibhāvanākṣepalabhyatvāt karturavācyatvaṃ yathā karmaṇo'pi bhavitumarhati| athānākṣepātkarmaṇo vācyatvam| evaṃ ca sati karturapi tathātvopapattiḥ | na hi kriyākṣepe kartṛkarmaṇorviśeṣamupalabhāmahe| yathaiva hi katrrā vinā kriyā na pratīyate evaṃ karmaṇā'pi | na sarvatra karmasaṃbandha iti cet, tatrāsti| tatra katham| atha karmaṇo'pi kriyākṣepalabhyatvāt tadgatā'pi saṃkhyaivocyate sakāreṇa| kathamidānīṃ kartṛkarmānabhidhāyako lakāraḥ kkacit kartṛgatāṃ saṃkhyāmabhidhatteḥ kkacitkarmagatāmiti viśoṣo bhaviti| na ca viśeṣaṇaṃ nāstīti vācyam| yataḥ pacatītyatra ullasitena kartṛrūpatvena pacyata ityatra rūpagṛhītakarmaniṣṭhatvena pratītirutpadyate| kiñca lakāreṇa kartṛkarmaṇoranabhidhāne devadattaḥ pacatītyabhihite kartari tṛtīyā| odanaḥ pacyata iita karmaṇi dvitīyacā prāpnoti| athaivamucyate kartṛkarmasaṃkhyāyoparabhihitattvānna bhaviṣyato| vibhakti kṛdanteṣu tarhiniṣṭaprāptiḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ kṛtyābhidhānāt| tatra pakka odana iti dvitīyā, iti tṛtīyā prāpnoti| nanu cobhayaṃvibhaktyarthaḥ saṃkhyākarmādayaśca | tatra yathā ākhyāteṣu saṅkhyāyāḥ abhihitatvāt kartṛkarmaṇordvitīyātṛtīye na bhavataḥ, tathā kṛdanteṣu kārakasyābhihitatvāt saṅkhyā saṅkhyāyā dvitīyādayo na bhaviṣyanti| syādetat | yadyabhihite pratiṣedhassyāt, anabhihite tvayaṃ vidhiḥ sāmathryaikavākyatābhyāṃ paryudāsaśrayaṇāt | tatra tiṅanteṣu saṃkhyābhidhāne'pyanabhihitatvāt saṅkhyāyāḥ kārkavanibhaktayaḥ prāpnuvanti | apica devadattaḥ pacan, devadattaḥ pacamānaḥ iti śatṛśānacoḥ kartari ca saṅkhayāyā apyanabhidhānāt tṛtīyā na prāpnoti| atha śatṛśānajyaṃ karturanabhidhānamāśriyate tiṅaḥ kimaparāddham? tasyā'pilādeśatvācchatṛśānacoḥ kṛtvātkartarikṛditi vacanāt karturabhidhānāditi cet karmaṇaḥ kathamodanaṃ pacyamāna iti | atha sthānino lakārasya karmaṇi vidhānāt tadādeśatvāñca śānacaḥ karmābhidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati| tathāhi | “laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ” iti “bhāvakarmaṇorātmanepadaṃ” itivā karmaṇi lakāro vidhīyate| evaṃ sati yatrāpi tiṅo'pi vidhīyate tatrāpi karmaṇi prāpnoti | tataśca kartaryapi kenāpavāryate tatrā'pi kartari kṛt| “śeṣāt kartari parasmaipadaṃ” iti kartari lakāro'pi vidhīyate taduktam ātmanepadarūpeṇa sarvatraiva hi karmaṇi | lakārassyāt tathaivā'yaṃ kartaryapi bhavennakim|| naca kartari yā karmaṇi yā saṅkhyā tatra tiṅo bhavantītyāśratumucitam| na hi “laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cākarmakebhyaḥ” ityasya “dvyokayordvivacanaikavacane”, “bahuṣu bahuvacanaṃ” ityānenaikavākyatvaṃ vidyate, bhāve'pi lakārasya vidhānāt |na ca bhāvasya sādhyatvena saṃkhyāyogo'sti | nāpi svaijasityādervibhaktividhānasya saṃkhyāvidhānena sahaikavākyatnavaṃ asaṃkhyebhyo'pyavyayebhyassuvutpatteḥ| āha ca mahāvārtikakāraḥ suptiṅoraviśeṣavidhānāt ddaṣṭaviprayogatvāñca niyamārthe vacanam| mahābhāṣyakāro'pyāha suptiṅo'viṣeṇotpadyante, utpannanāṃ niyam iti | tasmānna kartṛkarmasaṃkhyāyāṃ lakāravidhiḥ, apitu kartṛkarmaṇorevetyabhyupagantavyam| kathaṃ punassarvakārakasannidhāne lakāreṇa kartṛkarmaṇorevābhidhānam| ucyate, tayoreva prādhānyāt tatra kartuḥ prādhānyaṃ karaṇādīnāṃ tadadhīnavṛttitvāt karmaṇastu tadarthatvameva tatpravṛtteḥ | yadivā kartṛkarmavyāpārabhidhāyino dhātoḥ para upajāyamāno lakāraḥ kartṛkarmaṇī evābhidhādati | atha kathaṃ kartṛkarmavat kālādikamapi nābhidadhāti viṣayabhedāt | tathāhi, ṣaḍaḍḍatdhrthāḥ tuṅantena pratīyante kriyā, kālaḥ, upagrahaḥ, kārakaṃ, puruṣaḥ, saṃkhyeti| teṣu kriyākālātmanepadanimittāni prakṛtirabhidhatte, pratyayaḥ sādhanaṃ saṃkhyā puruṣaṃ ca | tatra prakṛtyabhidheyeṣu kriyā pradhāne, kālopagrahau viśeṣaṇam| pratyayābhidheyeṣu sādhanaṃ pradhānaṃ, kālopagrahau viśeṣaṇam| pratyayabhidheyeṣu, sādhanaṃ pradhānaṃ, saṃkhyāpuruṣau viśeṣaṇam| kathaṃ punaḥ saṃkhyā kārakasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ, na kriyākālopagrahapuruṣāṇām| ucyate kriyāyāssādhyatvenāpariniṣrannatvāt kāsasya ca kriyāto vyatirekāt vyatireke'pi vā kriyāvacchedakatvenopasarjanatvāt| upagrahasyāpi gandhanādeḥ kriyākarmatvenāpariniṣṭhitatve anidantārdeśyatvādasaṃbandhassaṃkhyāyāḥ puruṣastu prathamādisādhanameva, nānyaḥ kaścit | ataḥ kārakeṇaiva saṃkhyābhisaṃbadhyate, na kriyādibhiriti | tadevaṃ tiṅavācyatvena kartuḥ kartṛpadaṃ, bhāvakartṛpadaṃ, karmakartṛpadaṃ ceti yaduktaṃ, tadanupapannameveti| kartṛpadaṃ, karmapadaṃ, karaṇapadaṃ, saṃpradānapadaṃ, apādānapadaṃ, adhikaraṇapadañceti kārakarūpabhedāḥ | tatra katrrādayaḥ kārakaprastāve'grataḥ prapañcayiṣyante, iha tu saṃbandhāvicchedāya leśata udāhiyante| teṣāṃ kartā tridhā śvatantro'svatantraḥ karmakartāceti | tatra kriyāyāṃ svecchayā yaḥ karaṇādikārakāṇi prayuṅkte natu taiḥ prayujyate saḥ svatantraḥ| sa dvidhā śvavibhaktivācyaḥ, paravibhaktivācyaśceti| tayossvavibhaktivācyo yathā mānabhaṅgapaṭunā suratecchāṃ tanvatā prathayatā ddaśi rāgam| lebhire sapadi bāvayatāntaryoṣitaḥ praṇayineva madena|| paravibhaktivācyo yathā cārutā vapurabhūṣayadāsāṃ tāmanūnanavayauvanayogaḥ| taṃ punarmakaraketanalakṣmīstāṃ mado dayitasaṅgamabhūṣaḥ|| yo'nyaprayuktaḥ kriyāsu vyāpriyate so'svatantraḥ | so'pi dvidhodbhatavyāpāro'nudbhūtavyāpāraśca| tayorudbhūtavyāpāro yathā guṇānuraktāmanuraktasādhanaḥ kulābhimānī kulajāṃ janādhipaḥ| paraistvadanyaḥ ka ivāpahārayenmanoramāmātmavadhūmiva śriyam|| anudbhūtavyāpāro yathā cittanirvṛti vidhāyi viviktaṃ manmatho madhumadaśśaśibhāsaḥ| saṅgataṃ ca dayitai ssama nayanti praima nyanti prema kāmapi bhuvaṃ pramadānām|| karmakartā'pi dvidhaiva | udriktakarmaṃśaḥ, anudriktakarmāṃśaśca| tayorudraktakarmāṃśo yathā tattaducchavasutapītabhaindavaṃ soḍuḍḍatdhmakṣamamiva prabhārasam| miktaṣaṭpadavirāvamañjanusā bhadyate kumudamānibandhanāt|| anudriktakarmāṃśo yathodārakīrterudayaṃ dayāvataḥ praśāntabādhaṃ diśato'bhirakṣayā| svayaṃ pradugdhe'sya guṇairupasnutā vasūpamānasya vasūni medinī|| kartuḥ kriyayā'nanyārthayā yadāpyate tatkarma| tadapi tridhā nirvatryaṃ, vikāryaṃ, prāpyañca | teṣu nirvaryaṃ dvidhā “yadasajjāyate sadvā janmanā tatprakaśyate||” tayoḥ prathamaṃ yathāyamāndolitaprauḍhacandanadrumapallavaḥ| utpādayati lokasya prītiṃ malayamārutaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā santameva ciramaprakṛtatvādaprakāśitamadidyutadaṅge| vibhrāmo madhumadaḥ pramadānāṃ dhātulīnamupasarga ivārtham|| vikāryamapi dvidhā| prakṛtyucchedāt guṇāntarādhānañca | ta prathamaṃ yathā krodhaṃ prabho saṃhara saṃhareti yāvadgiraḥ khe marutāṃ caranti| tāvat sa bahniḥ bhavanetrajanmā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ madanaṃ cakāra|| dvitīyaṃ yathā tāṃ pulomatanayālakocitaiḥ pāriḍātakusumaiḥ prasādhayan| nandane ciramayugmalocana ssaspṛhaṃ suravadhūbhiraikṣyata|| prāpyamapi dvidhaiva| kathitamakathitañca| tatra yatkṛtyaktakhalarthādibhirabhidhīyate tatkathitaṃ, yattairnābhidhīyate tadakathitaṃ | tayorādyaṃ yathā nipīyamānastabakā śilīmukhairaśokayaṣṭiścalabālapallavā| viḍaḍḍatdhmbayantī daddaśe vadhūjanairamandaṣṭoṣṭakarāvadhūnanam|| dvitīyaṃ yathā tāmasmadarthe yuṣmābhiryācitavyo himācalaḥ| vikriyāyai na kalpante sambandhāssadanuṣṭhitāḥ|| kriyāsiddhai sādhakatamatvena yadavyavahitaṃ vyāpriyate tatkaraṇam| tadapi tridhā brāhmamābhyantaraṃ bāhyābhyantarañca | teṣu bāhyaṃ dvidhā vyavadhāyakamavyavadhāyakañca| tayorādyaṃ yathā dhūpoṣmaṇā tyājitamādrrabhāvaṃ keśāntamantaḥkusubhaṃ tadīyam| paryakṣapatkācidudārabandhaṃ dūrvāvatā pāṇḍuḍḍatdhmadhūkadāmnā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā vaidarbhanirdiṣṭamasau kumāraḥ klṛptena sopānapathena mañcam| śilavibhaṅgau rmṛgarājaśāba stuṅgaṃ nagotsaṅgamivāruroha|| ābhyantaramapi dvidhā kartṛrbhinnamabhinnañca | tayorbhinnaṃ yathā śilāghanai rnākasadāmurasthalaiḥ bṛhanniveśaiśca vadhūpayodharaiḥ| taṭāntanītena vibhinnavīcinā ruṣeva bheje kaluṣatvamambhasā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā prayuktasatkāraviśeṣamātmanā namā paraṃ saṃpratipattumarhasi| yatasstāṃ sannatagātri saṅgataṃ manīṣibhi ssāptapadīnamucyate|| bāhyābhvantaramapi dvidhā bahirmukhamantarmupakhañca | tayorādyaṃ yathā gatayā punaḥ pratigavākṣagavaṃ dadhatī ratena bhṛśamutsukatām| muhurantarālabhavastagire ssavituśca yoṣidamimīta ddaśā|| dvitīyaṃ yathā bibhratau madhuratāmatimātraṃ rāgibhiryugapadeva papāte | ānanarmadhiraso vikasadbhi rnāsikābhirasitotpalagandhaḥ|| kriyākāryatvenāvadhīritaṃ karmaṇā kiyayā vā saṃyogaḥ yadanubhavati tatsaṃpradānam| titrtridhā dadātikarmavyāpyaṃ, karmamātravyāpyaṃ, kriyāvyāpyaṃ ceti| teṣu dadātikarmavyāpyaṃ dvidhā śvatvasyā'nivṛttau nivṛttau ca | tayorādyaṃ yathā cumbanādalakacūrṇārūṣitaṃ śaṃkaropi nayanaṃ lalāṭajam| ucchavasatkamalagandhaye dadau pārvatīvadanagandhavāhine|| dvitīyaṃ yathā dātuṃ va prabhavasi māmanyasmai hartumeva vā dāsam| nā'haṃ puvanastathātvaṃ yathābi māṃ śaṅkase bhūru|| kriyākarmavyāpyaṃ dvidhā dadātyarthaviṣayaṃ ca | tatra prathamaṃ yathā śrīmallatābhavanamoṣadhayaḥ pradīpā śśayyā navāti haricandanapallavāni| asminnatiśramanudaśca sarojavātārasmartuṃ diśanti na divassurasundarūbhyaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā śaśaṃsa tasmai praṇipatya nandī śuśruṣayā śailasutāmupetām| praveśayamāsa ca bharturenāṃ bhrūkṣepamātrānumatapraveśām|| kriyāvyāpyamapi dvidhaiva| pāribhāṣikamapāribhāṣikañca| tayoḥ prathamaṃ yathā na strajo rurucire lamaṇībhyaścandanāni virahe madirā vā| sādhaneṣvabhiraterupadhatte ramyatāṃ prayasamāgama eva|| dvitīyaṃ yathetthaṃ vithadhijñena purohitena prayuktaparāṇigrahaṇopacārau| praṇematustau pitarau prajānāṃ padmāsanasthāya pitāmahāya|| tatra katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyājanyameva dhrauvyeṇa yadvigāhamavagāhate tadapādanam| tatrtridhā nirdiṣṭaviṣayamupāttaviṣayamapeśritakriyañca | teṣu nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ yathojjhitaṃ anujjhataṃ ca| tayorādyaṃ yathā svedānuviddhādrranakhakṣatāṅke samdaṣṭabhūyiṣṭhaśikhākapole | cyutaṃ na karṇādapi kāminīnāṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ sahāsā papāta|| dvitīyaṃ yathāuṣasātapabhayādapalīnaṃ vāsaracchavivirāmapaṭīyaḥ| sannipatya śanakairiva nimnādandhakāramudavāpa samāni|| upāttaviṣayamapi dvidhā| heyamupādeyañca| tayorādyaṃ yathā karau dhunānā navapallavākṛtī vṛthā kṛthā mānini māpariśramam| upeyuṣī kalpalatābhiśaṅkayā kathaṃ nu vivasyati ṣaṭpadāvalī|| dvitīyaṃ yathātithiṃ nāma kākutsthāt putramāpa kumudvatī | paścimādyaminīyāmāt prasādamiva cetanā|| apeśrtakriyamapi dvidhaiva| sāmānyāpekṣaṃ viśeṣepekṣaṃ ca tayorādyaṃ yathā mā punastamabhisīsaramāgaskiriṇaṃ madavimohitacetāḥ| yoṣidityābhilalāṣa na hālāṃ dustyajaḥ khalu sukhādapi mānaḥ|| dvitīyaṃ yathā kuto bhavānadhvani citrakūṭāt ddaṣṭastvayā śrīlalitaprabhāvaḥ| kiṃ tena mugdhe madanotsave'smin kāmaṃ tvayā veśmani lekhayāmi|| katrrā karmaṃṇā vyavahitaṃ kriyādhāro'dhikaraṇam | tattridhā vaiṣayukaṃ, aupaśleṣikaṃ naimittikaṃ ca | teṣu vaiṣayikaṃ dvidhā | tayorādyaṃ yathā kadalīprakāṇḍaḍḍatdhruciroru tarau jaghanasthalīrisare mahatī| raśanākalāpaguṇena vadhū rmakaradhvadviradamākalayan|| dvitīyaṃ yathā vipadi dhairyamathābhyudaye kṣamā sadasi vākyapaṭunā yudhi vikramaḥ| yaśasi cābhiruciḥ vyasanaṃ śruteḥ prakṛtisiddhamidaṃ hi mahātmanām|| aupaśloṣikamapi dvidhaikadeśikamabhivyāpakaṃ ca| tayorādyaṃ yathā sparśabhāji vigadacchavicārau kalpite mṛgaddaśāṃ suratāya| sannatiṃ dadhati peturajastraṃ ddaṣṭayaḥ priyatame śayane ca|| dvitīyaṃ yathā rāgakāntanayaneṣu nitāntaṃ vidrumāruṇākapolataleṣu | sarvathā'pi daddaśe vanitānāṃ darpaṇeṣviva mukheṣu madaśrīḥ|| naimittikamapi dvidhaiva śuddhaṃ saṅkīrṇaṃ ca | tayorādyaṃ yathā ka....edhūmaṃdhāre are abbuttaṇamaggiṇo samappihii| muhakamala cubbaṇāleha dhammi pāsaṃṭhiedi are|| dvitīyaṃ yathehādhītī pūrvaṃ dhṛtadharaṇibhāraḥ kamaṭharāḍaḍḍatdhpāṃnāthenāsmādgiraśitaśaraṇyena paṭhitāḥ| tataḥ prāptā dūrīkṛtatanatāpairjaladharairassatāṃ duḥkhopajñaṃ satatamukāropaniṣadaḥ|| pravṛttaprayojakastu nimittaviśeṣo hetuḥ kartā ca bhavati| so'pi tridhā prerako'nukakūlaḥ pratyayakaśca | tatra prerako dvidhā vyavahito'vyavahitaśca | tayovryavahito yathā sā cūrṇagauraṃ raghunandanasya dhātrīkarābhyāṃ karabhopamorūḥ| āsañjayāmāsa yathāpradeśaṃ kaṇṭhe guṇaṃ mūrtamivānurāgam|| avyavahito yathā sāvaśeṣapadamuktamupekṣā strastamālyavasanābharaṇeṣu| gantumutthitamakāraṇatassma dyotayanti madavibhramamāsam|| anukakīlo'pi dvidhā śiddhaḥ sādhyaśca| siddho yathā gehaijireṣu navaśālikaṇāvapātagandhānubhāvasubhageṣu kṛṣīvalānām| ānandayanti musalollasanāvadhūtapāṇiskhaladvalayapaddhatayo vadhūṭyaḥ|| sādhyo yathā suṇṇammi giriṃ gāme vaṇamahi savitā abhaṅga vaiveḍhe | gahavai dhūādaṃ saṇa maṇoharo maṃpa sā vei|| pratyāyako dvidhāddaṣṭayojyakriyo ddaṣyaprayojyakriyaśca | tayoḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, puṣpeṇa candraṃ yojayatītyādiddaṣṭaprayojanakriyaḥ | sa yathā śailaissandhayati sma vānarahatairvālmīkirambhonidhiṃ | vyāsaḥ pārthaśaraistathāpi na tayoratyuktirudbhāvyate|| vāgarthau ca tulādhṛtāviva tathaāpyasmatprabandhānayaṃ | leko dūṣayituṃ prasāritamukhastumbhaṃ pratiṣṭhe namaḥ|| vārāṇasyāṃ rātrīḥ vivāsayati, māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryamudgamayati, ityādidrdaṣṭayojyakirayaḥ| sa yathā vipuṃlataranitambābhogaruddheramaṇyā śśāyitumanādhigacchañjīviteśo'vakāśam| ratiparicayanaśyannaidratandraḥ kathaṃcidgamayati śayanīye śarvarīṃ kiṃ karotu|| kathaṃ punaḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayati kathakaḥ, baliṃ bandhayati gāthaka ityādau prayojakavyāpāreṇa ṇijutpattirucyate| śabdopahitalūpāṃstān buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān| pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhakatvena manyate|| teṣāṃ cotapāttiprabhṛtyāvināśāt samṛddhimācakṣāṇaḥ parānapi tathaiva pratyāyayati| tathā hi| vaktāre bhavinti, gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ, kiṃ gatena hataḥ kaṃsa iti | evaṃ rātriṃ vivāsayatītyādāvapi tathā pratyāyanamavagantavyam| ayaṃ ca sūtrāṇāmārambhapakṣe nyāyaḥ, sūtrārambhapakṣe tu ākhyānāt kṛtsatadācaṣṭe kṛlluk prakṛtipratyāpattiḥ prakṛtivañca kārakamityādāhṛtaṃ purastāt| athāyaṃ ṇijartho dhātvarthatvenāvācchidyamānaḥ kiṃ sākṣādavacchidyate? evaṃ bhavitumarhati | na dyanyatiholabhyate tadanupapannam| kriyo'sādhyatvena svasādhanāpekṣayā paraspareṇa sambandhaḥ| astu tarhi kartṛvryavadhānenāyuktaṃ caitat| dhātvartho hi kartṛvyāpārarūpaḥ, so'nupalabhyamānamapi kartāramākṣipya taddavāreṇa pratyayārthaṃ viśeṣyati| na caivaṃ sati praraṇānarthakyaṃ yato vicchedamāśaṅkamānaḥ kriyāyaṃ pravṛttamapi prerayati| yatrāpyapravṛtta eva pravatryate tatrāpi yogyatvādvuddhisathaṃ kriyāsambandhaṃ gṛhītvā prayuṅkte| abuddhinibandhano'pi kriyākatrrossamabandha upapadyate | tadāpyākhyānātkṛtastadāṣṭa ityādyupasaṃkhyānena vā sāmānyam| kṛtatvāddhetutohyaviśiṣṭamiti buddhinivandhanatvenaiva pratyākhyātaḥ| tadā ca burddhi sobuddhi vāsudevena hanyata ityevaṃbhūtabuddhiviṣayaṃ prayojakavyāpāramāśritya punarbauddha eva prayojakavyāpāro'ṅgīkṛtaḥ| atho'rthākṣiptakartṛsaṅgatāyā dhātvabhihitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratyayārthatvena preraṇādinā sambandha iti | ata eva pravṛtto'pi preṣyamāṇe loḍādipratyayotpatteḥ kartṛtvasyāpāyāt| nanu kathamapravṛttabāhyayogaḥ kartṛtvamuṣeyāt| praiṣasādhyaṃ ca kartṛtvaṃ kathaṃ nāma? prāgeva bhavet| ucyate, nedaṃ bāhyaprayogapravṛttyadhīnaṃ kartṛtvamabhidhīyate| kriyāyaṃ tu sambadhyamānatvena vivakṣatāyāṃ tatsādhyatā| nāntarīyakaḥ sāmathryaprātitasannidhānaḥ kartā sthita eva prayojakavyāpāreṇa bāhyaprayogasibdyarthameva viṣayīkriyate | anyathā prayojakavyāpārāpekṣakartṛtve prayojakottarakālamevāsya kartṛtvaṃ bhavediti na saṃprati kartṛtvābhāve tannibandhano loḍādirupapadyate | tasmātpacatītyādinā yaḥ pacati saḥ pākaṃ prati pravartayatviti kathitaṃ bhavati| kriyāsāmathryadenaṃ nijrñātaṃ kartāraṃ praiṣyatayābhidheyabhāvena lakārobhiniviśate | tathāhi, so'yaṃ pākādidhātvarthasāmathryadavagataḥ kartā sādhanatvārthasya bāhyaprayogasaṃpatyarthapreṣaṇādivyāpāraviṣayīkṛtaḥ pratyanābhidhīyata ityāmananti| bhavatu nāma kriyāprāpitasannidhānaḥ kartā | satu niyata eva puruṣaḥ kathaṃ jñāyate? yenaivamucyate yastavaṃ pacasi sa pākaṃ pravartayeti| ata eva bhāṣye satkriyasya kartuḥ prayoge ṇicamabhidhāya dravyamātrasya prayoge, loṭa utpattirabhihitā pṛcchatu mā bhavān, anuyuṅktaṃ mā bhavāni iti| ucyate dravyamātramapi prepyamāṇaṃ kriyāsādhanayogyameva preṣyate, na kāṣṭhākuḍyadi| nanvevaṃ ṇico loṭaśca viṣayasaṅkaraḥ prāpnoti, nāsti saṅkaraḥ, yasyāvagatamasakṛt pramāṇāntareṇa kriyākartṛtvamasāveva sambhāvitākriyo ṇijvaṣayaḥ| adṛṣṭakriyāsāmathryaṃtu yogyameva | dravyamātraṃ loḍḍḍitdhvaṣaya iti tena pacetyasamarthaḥ yastvaṃ pacasi pākārhaḥ pāke śaktaḥ sa tvaṃ pravartaya pākamiti| evaṃ ca kriyākartṛtvena yogyatayā jñāyamānasya prayoge pravatryamānatvāt karturevādhikāra ityuktaṃ bhavati| vidvacchūrābhijātakartṛte rājye bhavānadhikṛta ityādivacanabhaṅgibhirayamevārthassamathryate | yadi tarhi na kartādhikriyate nā'yaṃ matimān viśiṣṭameva puriṣamevaṃprakāre'dhikārenurundhīta yameva kañcitpuruṣamupājajīta| athavā ete loḍādiviṣayāḥ praiṣādiviṣayāḥ | te kasya dharmabhūtāḥ, tatraiva te varṇayanti prayoktuḥ, prayoktā hi praiṣaṇādibhirabhihitasiddhaye'bhilāṣān puruṣaṃ pravartayati, satu kkacitpreṣayan, kkacidadhyeṣayan, kkacidāmantramāṇa iti śabdasyaite vyāpārā ityapare | preṣaṇā hi sarvavidhyādisādhāraṇarūpā | sāca śabdavyāpāraḥ nimantraṇādayastu pramāṇādinibandhanāstadviśeṣāḥ| tathāhi, idaṃ nimantraṇaṃ, iyamanujñā, ayaṃ prāptakāla iti prakaraṇāderavagamyate | anyanmataṃ prayojyavyāpāraviśeṣaḥ, te cāsaṃviditāḥ| satu puruṣo liṅādiprayogāt bhojanādikriyāsu nimantraṇādyavasthāntaramātmānaṃ manyate nimantrito'hamadhyeṣito'hamiti| anyetvāhur vidhireka evārthaḥ pratyayasya | sa ca yajetetyāderyathārūpo'vagamyate tathārūpa eva| kaṭaṃ, kuru, iha karotyarthātmake vidhivaddhātvarthānuyāyīti kārakāṇāmabhisaṃbandhaḥ| yataḥ karotyarthātmakavyāpāreṇa kārakāṇāṃ viśeṣa upajāyamāna upalabhyate kurvaddhi kārako bhavati| anyetvāhur yo'yaṃ pākādiko viśeṣa itaretaravailakṣaṇyenopalabhyamānaḥ pratiniyataphalajanakaḥ| yatraiva phalasādhakatvāt karaṇāni pravartante tasyaiva tu vyāpārātamakatvāt kriyārūpatā'pi saṃpannaiveti| aparamataṃ tannavivektuṃ iha kārakāṇi vyāpriyante na vyāprayanta iti | ubhayātmake vastuni viśiṣṭopādhirūpasya nirdhāritatvādekatraā'pi pravṛttimupayat kārakamitaratrāpi pravṛttamivopalabhyate | athāpare bruvate ubhayātmakameva hi kriyārūpaṃ vastu kārakaissaṃpadyate | ata eva kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyetyetadbhāvanāpakṣe'pi saṅgacchate, na cāsmābhissakaladhātvarthānuyāyikarotyartharūpā bhāvanā aṅagīkriyate, yaditthamadhyagīṣata kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavatanāḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ kriyāviśeṣavacanāḥ pacyādayaḥ iti| kiṃtu pratyayavācyatvamasyā anukṛṣyate| nu ca bhāvanāpakṣe kārakāṇāmiti bahuvacanānupapattiḥ kartureva hi vyāpāro bhāvanā, na kāraṇāmucyate| kartaiva kārakaśabdenoktaḥ, na punaritarakaraṇādi | kartṛṇāṃ tu kriyābhedena bahuvacanam| kathaṃ punaridaṃ jñāyate| yato bhujikriyāmūrīkṛtyedamabhidhatte| anyathā kārakāṇi śuṣkaudanepravartante anyathā māṃsaudana iti| kartaiva śuṣkaudane mandaprasthānena pravartate, māṃsaudane saṃrambheṇātaḥ kraturmandatāsaṃraṃbhapradarśanaṃ jñāyate|kartaiva parigṛhītā, yasya buddhyānuṣaṅgāttathāpravṛttiḥ| nanu ca śuṣkaudanamāṃsaudanayoḥ karaṇādhikaraṇadīnāmapi tadbhedanimittaṃ bahuvacanaṃ bhaviṣyati| naivam, vidyamānamapi kārakāntaraṃ kāṃsyāpātrādiśuṣkamāṃsaudanayormandatayā saṃraṃbheṇa vā pravartate| yadāpi sakalakārakavyāpāraḥ kriyati pakṣastadāpi pradhānatvāt kartaiva kārakaśabdenocyate, tasya ca sarvakriyāviśeṣayatvānnakārakāṇāmiti prayogapravṛttihetutvāñca | karma punaḥ yadyapitadarthatvāt pravṛtteḥ pradhānaṃ tathāpi tasmāsravaviṣayatvānnakārakāṇāmiti bahuvacanena saṅgrahaḥ| yadyevaṃ kartṛśabda eva kasmānna kṛtaḥ karmaṇi lakārāṇāṃ tasya vyudāso mābhūt? tena yatra saṃbhavati karma tatrāṅgīkṛtameva tu tadapekṣayā bahuvacanam| nanu ca saṃraṃbhādipradarśanāñcetanāvyāpārasya kriyātvaṃ na prāpnoti| naivam, saṃraṃbhādeḥ kartṛvilakṣaṇatvāt | ataḥ kratṛvyāpāraḥ kriyeti siddham| nanvevaṃ sati bhāṣyaṃ na saṃgacchate kaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ, yā'sau taṇḍuḍḍatdhlānāṃ viklitiriti arthaṃ prādhānyamāśritya tadbhāṣyamityavirodhaḥ| yattadarthaṃ praṣaṇaṃ, adhyeṣaṇaṃ vā sasarvaḥ pacyartha iti| evaṃ ca pacatītyākhyātasya viklityupasarjanaṃ vikledanamarthe bhavati| anye tu kārakāṇāmiti bahuvacanaṃ sarvakārakavyāpāratvena vyācakṣate yasmātsarvakārakavyāpārābhidhāyitvaṃ dhātūnāṃ dṛśyate | tathāca devadattasya kāṣṭhai ssthalyāmodanasya ca pācakaḥ ityādau sarvāṇyeva kārakaṇi dhātvarthasya viśeṣaṇaṃ, nātra kasyācidguṇabhāvaḥ pradhānabhāvovā avagamyate| ākyātāstarhi sarvakārakavyāpārāḥ kimiti nāvagamyante? prādhānyātkartṛkarmaṇoreva lakārotpatteḥ tadvyāpāra evākhyātātpratīyate | kiṃ punassarveṣāṃ kārakāṇāmekā pravṛtiḥ? āhosvit pratikārakaṃ bhinnaḥ pravṛttayaḥ kriyeti| na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣaḥ, sarveṣāmekasyāḥ pravṛtterasaṃbhavāt| na hi yaiva kāṣṭhānāṃ pravṛttissaiva devadattasya sthālyādeśtaca saṃbhavati tasmātpratikārakaṃ bhinnāḥ pravṛttayaḥ dhātunā yugapadabhidhīyamānāḥ kriyetyucyante | athavā purastvekaiva sarvakārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ kriyā| tathāhi, sarvaireva kārakairekā pravṛttirupajanyate | athavā punarastvekaiva sravakārakāṇāṃ pravartante | kiñcittu kenacidrūpeṇa janayatītyavāntarabhedātkaraṇādivyapadeśa ekaścānekatra vṛttirjātivadupapadyate | viśeṣādvāsyāḥ phalajananarūpatvaṃ, na punaradhiśrayaṇādirūpateti viśeṣaṇādirūpateti| viśeṣaṇādirūpaṃ nipātādirūpaṃ, saṃbodhanādirūpaṃ, saṃbandhādirūpaṃ, hetvādirūpaṃ cetyupaskārarūpāḥ| ete cāgrata upaskārarthāprastāve prapañcato varṇayiṣyanta iti neha pratavyante| saṃvandhāvicchedārthaṃ tu leśata udāhiyante| tatra viśeṣaṇaādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, kārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ, upasargaśca| yathā śādhu pacati, bhīṣmamudāraṃ darśanīyaṃ kacaṃ karoti, evamanye rathena yāsyatīti| nipatāḥ karmapravacanīyīḥ avyayāni ca yathāhaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahan asāṃprataṃ jetumityākhyādayaḥ ākhyātāni | kṛtastaddhitāśca yathā śmarasi devadatta kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ, raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, brāhmavahvravīti| sambodhanādayaḥ āmantraṇamavadhi bhāvaliṅgaṃ ca yathā he devadatta bhuktvā vrajatīti, sa iti, saṃbandhādayaśśeṣa iti upapadam| sahārthaśca yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ kuśalaṃ devadattāyeti, putreṇa sahāyāta iti | htvādayo heturlakṣaṇaṃ tārathrya ca yathā vidyayā śaḥṣa kamaṇḍaḍḍatdhlunā chātraḥ, yūpāya dārviti | kathaṃ punarayaṃ hetuḥ kārakādviśiṣyate? “dravyādiviṣayo hetuḥ kārakaṃ niyatakriyam||” yathā bījena sasyaṃ, tapāsā kṛśaḥ, annena valati, vratena brāhmaṇyaṃ, kārakaṃ yathā devadattaḥ śraddhayā tīrthe hemaśataṃ niṣkaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadāti| yadyevaṃ dravyādiviṣayatavena kriyāyāmaniyata eva bhavati| yathā putreṇa sadda brāhmaṇa iti | naivam, na hi sahārthasya dravyādīni pratinivartanabhāvaśśabedanocyate| hetoḥ punarāśritavyāpārasyā'pi tṛtīyādibhissa vidhīyata iti kriyāviṣayaḥ karaṇātkathaṃ bhidyata iti cet, kriyā yaiḥ karaṇaṃ tsaya dṛṣṭaḥ pratinidhistathā | hetvātthopi kriyāheturnaca pratinidhīyate|| tarhi tādathryadabhedaḥ| kimidaṃ tādathryaṃ nāma? kāryasya kāraṇaṃ prati prayojakatvaṃ tādathrye, viśiṣṭaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ iti yāvat | yaddhi yadarthaṃ tanniyogatastasya karaṇam| yathāṅgulīyāya kanakamiti kathaṃ tarhi henerna bhidyate? yataḥ kāraṇsya kāryaprastāvayogyatāhetutvaṃ kāryasya kāraṇaṃ prati prayojakaṃ tādathryamiti| ayaṃ ca viśeṣaḥ kāryavācina eva tādathrye caturthī, kāryavācino nimittavācinaśca hetostu tṛtīyeti| yadyevaṃ hetulakṣaṇayorhetulakṣaṇā tṛtīyā kanakātprapnoti| na ca tādathryabhayamapi saṃvandha utpatsyate, iti| naivam, tasmai tadrathamiti sarvanāmnā yorthaḥ pratipadyate sa eva svakāraṇāpekṣayā prātitavyatirekaścatuthryā saṃbadhyate| yathā yadarthamasya mantraḥ tadanenādhigatamiti sarvanāmārtha eva kāryayogi, tathehāpi tacchabdopātta evārthaḥ prayojanatayā vipariṇataḥ, tadarthaṃ śabdo nābhidhīyate| bhāvapratyayānto'pyasau kāryagatameva rūḍhaviśeṣāṇyācaṣṭe kāryasya kāraṇaṃ prati prayojakatvaṃ tādathryamiti| tatkathaṃ kārakasya tādathryavibhaktirāśaṅkyeta? kāryaṃsthā'pi catuthryobhayagatasyāpi saṃbandhasyāvagatatvāt avyatiriktapratipadikārthābhinnaḥ kāraṇaśabdādbhavati, na tu vyatirekalakṣaṇā tṛtīyeti| ayaṃ ca hetutādathryorviṣayaḥ| vāsenādhīte, adhyayanena vasatīti, yā ca yūpāya dāru, adhyayanāya valatīti | yastu manyate tadarthatāntaviṣayasya pārāthryarūpā kāryaprasavayogyatā hetorananyārthasya tādathryaṃ, tasya tadviśaṣayasyeti ananyārthasyeti viśeṣaṇadvayamapārthaṃ ubhayatrāviśeṣāt| yadi tāvadarthasayānanyārthatā tādathryaṃ tadast| kanakasya valayādāvapi sāmathryaṃ saṅghātādathoktidharmeṇa taddhetāvapi samānam| na hi vidyāyā yaśohetunāṃ muktvā kāryāntarayogyatāṃ brūte, pārārthyarūpetyapi na vacanīyaṃ kāryaprasavayogyatetyanenaiva gatārthatvāt| nanu ca naṭasya śṛṇotītyādau kāryaprasavayogyasyāpi naṭādeḥ pārāthryeṇa, vivakṣāyāṃ mā bhūddhetutvamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ kriyate | naivam, yathā upādhyāyādadhīta iti upādhyāyādeḥ parārthatvena kārakatvaṃ prayojakatvameva tādathryamiti | atha lakṣaṇasya kā vārtā? lakṣaṇamapi tādarthatyavaddhetuviśeṣa eva | siddho hi hetuḥ kārako jñāpakaśca | tatra kārakasya svavyapārānīśrayaṇe heturityākhyā, jñāpaksaya lakṣaṇamiti padārthantaraparicchedahetutā hi lakṣaṇārthaḥ| anāśriteṣu (tu) vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturiṣyate| āśrayāvadhi bhāvaṃtu lakṣaṇe lakṣaṇaṃ viduḥ|| kkacittu heturapi lakṣaṇam| jaṭābhistāpasa iti itthaṃ bhūtalakṣaṇaṃ, akṣṇā kāṇa iti vikāralakṣaṇaṃ, kapilā vidyutyutpātalakṣaṇaṃ, goṣu dūhyamānāsu gata iti bhāvalakṣaṇaṃ, pacannāsta iti kriyālakṣaṇaṃ ca vyākhyātamiti| ekārthaparaḥ padasamūho vākyam| tantridhā śaṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtamapabhraṃśaścā| brāhmaṇaṃ yathā śaṃyo manuṣyāṇāṃ rāgadvassamūḍho bhavati| tatrānyeṣāmadhipattiḥ sarveṣāṃ manuṣyakaiḥ kāmaissaṃpannamataḥ| sa manuṣyāṇāṃ parama ānandaḥ| ārṣe dvidhā| smṛtiḥ purāṇaṃ ca | tayosmṛtiryathā śūdraiva bhāryā śūdrasya sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte| te ca svā caiva rājñastu tāśtaca svā cāgrajanmataḥ|| purāṇaṃ yathā hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo yāṃ yāṃ diśamudaikṣata | bhayabhrāntaissuraiścakre tasyai tasyai diśe namaḥ|| laukikaṃ dvividhaṃ, kāvyaṃ śāstraṃ ca | tayoḥ kāvyaṃ yathā kasya no kurute mugdhe pipāsākulitaṃ manaḥ| ayaṃ te vidrumacchāyo marumārga ivādharaḥ|| śāstraṃ yathā prākāmadhavalaṃ yasyāścakṣuḥ paryantapakṣmalam| navanītopamaṃ tasyā bhavati smaramandiram|| prākṛtaṃ tridhā, sahajaṃ, lakṣitaṃ, śliṣṭaṃ ca| teṣu sahajaṃ dvidhā śaṃskṛtasamaṃ deśyaṃ ca| tayossaṃskṛtasamaṃ yathā sarale sāhasarāgaṃ parihara raṃbhoru muñca saṃrambham| virasaṃ virāyāsaṃ voḍhuṃ tava cittamasahaṃ me|| deśyaṃ yathā vippa api āpu āṇuṇāhaṃ ṣaḍaḍḍatdhrasamaṃ parihasanteī| vāsaara viṇaḍio visaṃ lalaṃsva ṇāvesi || lakṣitaṃ dvidhā, mahārāṣṭraṃ śaurasenaṃ ca| toyarmahārāṣṭraṃ yathā ṇamaha avaḍhḍhaatuṃgaṃ avisāriavitthaaṃ aṇoṇaagahiraṃ | appalahuaparisaṃhṇaṃ aṇāaparamanthapāaḍaṃ, mahumahaṇaṃ|| śaurasenaṃ yathā ........... phanamatha cana appakuvi akādhī caraṇakipaci apaṭi | pippaṃtasu nakhatappanesuṃ etāsatanutataraṃ rutaṃ|| māgadhaṃ yathā hadamāṇuśamaṃbhoyaṇaṃ kuṃbhaśahāśavaśāhiśacchidaṃ| aṇiśaṃa pibāmi śoṇidaṃ valiśaśadaṃ śamaleṇa bhoyadu|| apabhraṃśastridhā| uttamo madhyamaḥ kaniṣṭhaśca | teṣvāvantyalācaṭūyādiruttamaḥ| tatrāvantyoyathaikadū asaloṇī ala āharaṇasusaṃṭhavī acchi upasaṃpaṭaṃ vīvaukahimmalaṃ bhaṭṭaevaṭapi amaie| uṇajāṇaiḍaṃ, virahātuṇujūri aejjha harodāvaṇudiṇṇuvahiṇe viṇṇūri a e|| lāṭīyo yathā hirau haranta ho cerahoe bhujidanduhale jappiupaṇavva sacchile viloi augaṇe| eṃhūpiṇapiṇa gaṇatthaṇi saṃthahauvkapaṇu javcandāṇabhedijjai aharahodantapaṇā|| ābhīragaurjarādirmadhyamaḥ| tayorābhūro yathā laviyavphau bīududvaḍākau hahāṇa gacchasi putahomatthajabhu| jadahiḍāṃ ujaṃ me pi javi āāsi|| gaurjarā yathāva akhkho ñjī samudrutari siladuhi garukāṇi | mando hi e pilahi auujaṃparuñjaiteṃ aṇi|| kāśmīrapaurastyājiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ| tayoḥ kāśmīro yathā kaṃvali āla ekaṃ te kudicchaladantahi viṭhi suddhi emaṃ ivi ālasīlaṃti| sava aṃgāpidusarāsahi khavāci duṃ phalinantekī āāsaṇa aīdasi|| paurastyo yathā mahaṇāhi akuṭuṃbi sāmaindīhirerebhāu japihuri | viṇṇaujāntāṃ vavirivāmevkeredhūje vāsāṃ hāvāthi| āṃkhījaṇukaṇaāṃsahuṃkājāthitehātheñcita udūkarāe | vala ācchaiṇī jīva upātharūpasa aṃṇai bhavaṇahiṃ vāccharaṃ|| tadtat samastamapi vākyajātamākhyatopādherekādaśaprakāraṃ viprathate| tadyathaikākhyātamanekākhyātamāvṛttākhyātamanuvṛttākhyātaṃ vipariṇātākhyātamekārthākhyātaṃ samuñcitākhyātaṃ kṛdamihitākhyātamapekṣitākhyātamekāntarākhyātaṃ nirantarākhyātamiti | teṣvekākhyātaṃ yathā vāgarthāviva saṃpṛktau vāgarthapratipattaye | jagataḥ pitarau vande pārvatīparameśvarau|| anekākhyātaṃ yathā yadeva rocate mahyaṃ tadeva kurute priyā| iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā|| āvṛttākhyātaṃ yathā jayatyamalakaustubhassabakitāṃsapīṭho hari rjayanti mṛgalocanācaladapāṅgadṛṣṭikramāḥ| tato jayati mallikā tadanu sarvasaṃvedanā vināśakaraṇakṣamo jayati pañcamasya dhvaniḥ|| anuvṛttākhyātaṃ yathā caranti caturambhodhivelodyāneṣu dantinaḥ| cakravālādikuñceṣu kundabhāso guṇāśca te|| viparītākhyātaṃ yathā so'smiñjayati jīvātuḥ pañceṣoḥ pañcamadhvaniḥ | teca caitre vikīrṇevā takkilīkelayo'nilāḥ|| ekārthākhyātaṃ yathā vikasanti kadambāni sphuṭanti kuṭajaudgamāḥ| unmīlantica kandalyo dalanti kakubhānica|| samuñcitākhyātaṃ yathā tāmavātārayatpatnīṃ rathādavatatāra ca|| kṛdabhihitākhyātaṃ yathā tataḥkumudanā thena kāminīgaṇḍaḍḍatdhpāṃḍuḍḍatdhnā| netrānandena candreṇa māhendrī digasaṅkṛtā|| adhyahṛtākhyātaṃ yathā yaśca nimbaṃ paraśunā yaścainaṃ madhusarpiṣā| yaścainaṃ gandhamālyābhyāṃ sarvatra kaṭureva saḥ|| anapokṣitākhyātaṃ yathā kiyanmātraṃ jalaṃ vipra jānudadhnaṃ narādhipa | tathāpīyamavasthā te na hi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ|| ekāntarākhyātaṃ yathā tenādribandho vavṛdhe payodhistutoṣa rāmo mumude kapīndraḥ| tatrāsa śatrurdadṛśe suvelaḥ proce jalānto jahṛṣuḥ sudhāśāḥ|| nanu ca nirantarākhyātaṃ samuñcitākhyātamekārthākhyātamāvṛttākhyātamutyādayo vākyavikalpā nopapadyante, vākyakāro hi manyate| nāstyeva tiṅantayossaṃbandhaḥ| tathāca “tiṅṅa tiṅaḥ” ityatrātiṅavacanamanarthakaṃ samānavākyadhikarādityatiṅvacanaṃ pratyācaṣṭe|nahyekatra vākye dve tiṅante sta iti, evaṃlaśraṇaṃ karoti, ākhyātaṃ sāvyayakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyam| tatrākhyātagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, nahyavyayakārakaviśeṣaṇapadāni nibandhanamantereṇāvapadaparigrahārtham| yatraikamākhyātapadamavyayakārakaviśeṣaṇapadīni sannipatanti, tadvākyaṃ yathā syāt? anekākhyātapadaprayoge tu vākyasaṃjñā mābhīdityanāśritaṅkhyākhyātapadāṃśakānirāsātamekatiṅvākyamiti vacanāntaramārabhate | tatredaṃ vicāryate, kimekasmin vākye dvayostiṅantayossaṃbandha eva nāsti, uta satyāpi saṃbandhe dvitīyaṃ na prayujyate? ekatiṅvākyamiti pūrvācāryasamayādanu| kiñcidāha | satyapi tiṅantayossaṃbandhe tibhantāmāntritayuṣmadasmadādeśaplutādikāryavyavasthārthanyavasthārthamekatiṅvākyamiti pāribhāṣikameva vākyalakṣaṇaṃ kriyate| kiṃ kāraṇam? samānavākyārthat padādūttarayostiṅāmantritayornighātassmaryate| “yuṣmadasmado ṣaṣṭhīcaturthidvitīsthayorvaṃ nāvau” vādayaḥ ādeṣā vidhīyante | “vākyasya ṭeḥ plutaḥ utāttaḥ” iti vakyācāmantyasya plutaśśiṣyate iti | tañca tadopapadyate yadekatiṅāvākyamiti pāribhāṣikaṃ vāvayalakṣaṇaṃ kriyate| anythā “samarthaḥ padavidhi” riti padānāṃ parasparāsāmathrye vākyasya cāparisamāptai sarvathā na prāpnoti| tathāhi, nadyāstiṣṭhinti kūle vṛkṣasya lambate śākhāyāṃ, kaḥ priye mayi kopaḥ? kā subhaga priyā te? śālīnāṃ odanaṃ dāsyāmīti me mātā bravīti| āgaccha bho devadatta kugrāmaṃ gacchāvaḥ| grāmaṃ yadi yāsi re na māmapi pratīkṣasva | atra tiṣṭhati | nākūlamabhisaṃbandhānna nadī, lambanena śākhā na vṛkṣaḥ, ka ityanena kopena priyā, ketyamanena tu priyā na subhagā te iita yuṣmadasmadarthena dānaṃ na śālayaḥ me ityasmadarthe na mātāvacanam| āgaccha devadatta grāmaṃ yadi yāsi re ityetāvati vākyayoḥ parisamāptiḥ| kiṃ tarhigacchāvo māmapi pratīkṣasveti tataśca nighātādikāryāṇāmaprāptiḥ| ekatiṅparasya tu padasamudāyasya vākyatve paraṃparayā yathākathañcidabhisaṃbandhe nighātayuṣmadasmādādeśā yujyante| “yukteyukte copasaṅkhyāna” miti yuktena vaktavyaṃ bhavita| eva sākāṃmakṣasā'yā padakadambakasya ekatiṅavacchedena vākyatvapratītau vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta iti vākyācāmantyasyodāttaḥ plutaḥ iti siddho bhavati| kaścittu brūte nāstyeva tiṅantayossaṃbandhaḥ| sa hi tiṅanteṣūpakalpyamānaḥ ṣoḍhaivāvakalpate| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasaṃbandhaḥ, sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhaḥ, lakṣyalakṣaṇasaṃbandhaḥ, hetuhetumatsaṃbandhaḥ, avadhyavadhisaṃbandhaḥ, samuñcayādisaṃbandhaśceti| tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasaṃbandhassāmānādhikaraṇyena vā syāt vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā| na tāvatsāmānādhikaraṇyena pacati paṭhatītyetayoratyantamarthabhedāt, na hi padārthayopatyantabhede'bhede vā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva upapadyate| na hi bhavati āmraścūto'śvattha iti, yatra tu nātyantabhedho vā tatrepapadyate yathā nīlamutpalamiti| nanu yathā prapacati stokaṃ pacati ityādāvupasargeṇa stokādinā vā''khyātaṃ viśeṣyate, tathā''khyātantareṇāpi kasmānna viśeṣyate? naivam, atra yathā nīlavīraśabdau nīlatvavīratve viśeṣaṇarūpeṇābhidadhātau utpalaṃ puruṣaṃ ca sāmānyenopagṛhṇītaḥ| na rūpapuruṣasāmānyayorvā niyatau bhavataḥ, utpalapuruṣaśabdāvapyutpalapuruṣau viśeṣyarūpeṇābhidadhatau nīlatvaṃ vīpatvaṃ ca sāmānyenopagṛhṇītaḥ, na tu sāmānyayostadviśeṣaṇayorvātmānaṃ niyamayataḥ| parasparopaśloṣakṛtayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣya bhāvo bhavati| nacaitat pacati paṭhatītyetayorupapadyate, na hi nīlotpalādivat pacatiḥ paṭhatiḥ pacati vā paṭhatirupagṛhītaṃ śaknoti| nanu cātyantamabhinnārthaśca dṛśyate viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | abhinnārthayoryathādhīte, adhyati, bhinnārthayoryathā pratiṣṭhate, prasmarati | naivaṃ, adhīte, adhyetītyetayoryadyapi dhāturupasarge na vyabhicarati, vyabhicaratyevepargo dhātum| ataśśakyate'nvayanavyatirekābhyāmarthabhedaḥ kalpayituṃ, yadartho'yamadhiranyatra dṛṣṭastadartha ihāpi bhavitumarhati| ayaṃcādhiranyatroparibhānārtho dṛṣṭaḥ, yathādhyāste, adirohatīti te manyāmahepyasya sa evārthaḥ iti tasmādadhīṅeva śabdakriyo jñānākriyaśceti| adhiśabdastvetamevārthamuparibhāvena viśinaṣṭi viśiṣṭārthakriyaścārthavatāṃ śabdānāṃ vidhipūrvaṃ viśabdanaṃ tathādhītārthaviṣayavijñānamiti etāvānevārtho'dhinā vibhajyate, iha tarhi kathaṃ pratiṣṭhate, prasmarati iti| nahyatra satyapi kevalāprayoge tiṣṭhateḥ smaratervā pacativatsāmānyābhidhāyitvaṃ, kiṃ tarhi virodhinyeva kriyā gamyate? vrajīkriyāsmaraṇanivṛttiśca vyaktaṃca pratiṣṭhata ityanena sthānaprāraṃbho nocyate| kiṃ tarhi gamanameva smaratītyanenāpi smaraṇāt prāraṃbho nocyate, pitussmaraṇāraṃbha eveti naiṣa doṣaḥ|śabdo'yaṃ prapacatītyādikarmavacanatvena nijrñāto'sya viśeṣatodṛṣṭādanumānādādikarmavacanatvamanumīyate| tiṣṭhatiśca devadattastiṣṭhatītyādau kriyāvacanāddhātutvena nijrñātaḥ, ato'sya sāmānyato dṛṣṭādanumānādgamanārthatvamapi vijñāyate| bahvarthā api dhātvo bhavanti, “vapiḥ prakaraṇe dṛṣṭaśchede'pi pravartate” keśānvapatīti| “īhati śca gatau dṛṣṭaḥ preraṇe'pi pravartate | agnirvā itopravamīhe ||” karotirapūrvaprādurbhāve dṛṣṭo nirmalīkaraṇe'pi vartate | pādau kuru, pṛṣṭhaṃ kuru, mā kuru, udaraṃ sneho hīyate, unmṛdāna mṛdonmṛdāneti gamyate| tathā kaṭe kuru, aśmanā namitaḥ kuru, nikṣipāvakṣipeti gamyate| ayamapi cadhātutvādanekārtho bhavitumarhati, etena smaratirapi vyākhyātaḥ| na caitanna dṛṣṭaṃ viruddhārthāvarthau tulyarūpeṇa śabdenābhidhīyete| tadyathā śannikarṣayordṛṣṭamārācchabdenābhidhānam ārācchatrumapabādhasva dūraṃ, dūrāddavīyo apasedha śatrūn | atastiṣṭhatireva gamanārthaḥ, smaratireva smaraṇanivṛttikriyaḥ, tadviśeṣaścopasarga iti yuktamuktaṃ vastunoratyantabhede'bhede vā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva iti yadāba “sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇamarthavadbhavati” iti| nāpi vaiyayadhikaraṇyenākhyātasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati prādhānye satyadhātvarthabhūtārthatvāt | iha rājñaḥ puruṣa iti bharaṇādikriyānimitto vyatireko viśeṣasambandhanam| na ca prādhānyasyaiva rājārthasyopajāyate, na ca tathākhyātārthasya prādhānyaṃ satvābhāve vā saṃbhavati| yatrāpi ca kriyāpadaṃ na śrūyate mātuḥ smarati sarpiṣo jānīte iti tatrāpi sā kriyāsādhyāsyetyanena rupeṇāśrayamāṇaktavabhūtasyāpradhānasya māvāderarthasya vyatirekamupajāyate, śrūyamāṇakriyā viśeṣasaṃbandhanimittaṃ bhavati| na caitadākhyātasyopapadyate, satvabhūtatvādeva nimittānirdiśyatayāsyeti vyapadeśābhāvāt| yatsa khalu pariniṣṭhitasvabhāvamasya tasyeti sarvanāmapratyavamarśayogyaṃ taddhiśeṣaṇatayā kkacidupayujyate vā na vā, yatpunarātmanaivāparisamāptarūpe tadvipūrītaṃ, tatkathamivānyasya viśeṣaṇatvaṃyāyāt| nanvidānīmiva prapacati, stokaṃ pacatītyasattvabhūtayoḥ praśabdastotaśabdayorviśeṣaṇatvamuktam| naivam, anyathā tadupapatteḥ, upasargāṇāṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ vā satvabhūtānāmapyananyaviṣayatvenaiva kriyāṃ prati guṇabhāvo bhavati| tathāhi, yo'sau kriyābhūto dharmaḥ prāraṃbhādiḥ, taṃ kriyārthamiva kriyānupraviṣṭamasatvabhūtamabhidadhātpraśabdobhivyañjayati| yadivā yathākṣinikocādayaḥ anabhidadhataḥ evārthān pradarśayanti, evaṃ kriyāsthan prārambhādīnabhidadhata eva prādayo'vadyotayanti | dṛśyate anadhīyamānasyāpyarthasyātmasthāvadyotanaṃ yathā daṇḍā krīḍaḍḍatdhyati, tadasyāṃ praharaṇamiti krīḍāyāṃṇo vihitaḥ krīḍāmabruvan praharaṇatvaṃ daṇḍaḍḍatdhtvamavadyotayati| tasmātpacatītyatra pacimeva saṃdigdhaṃ viśeṣameva sthāpayannastavārthopi śabdo viśeṣaṇatvaṃ, labhate| evaṃ stokaśabdopi kriyābhūtaṃ dharmamapakarṣādikaṃ kriyātvasatvabhūtaṃ kriyāmupraviṣṭamabhidadhānaḥ kriyānurodhādevāsatvabhāvamāpanaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ bhajate| na caivamākhyātāntarasthaṃ viśeṣaṇamākhyātamabhivyañjayitumabhidhātuṃ vā śaknoti dvayorapi prādhānyena parasparānapekṣatvāt| bhavatu, copasargāderasatvārthasyāpi nīlotpalādivadeva sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, vaiyadhikaraṇye tu vyatirekāpekṣāyāṃ kathamivaitadbhavati? na hi apariṣpannatveṃnātmalābha eva kṣīṇasyāparopakāriṇaḥ karaṇādaṭo vyatirekā yujyante| ato vaiyādhikaraṇyenāpi na tiṅantayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvassaṃbandho bhavati| sādhyasādhanabhāvo'pi nopapadyate, sahi kriyayoḥ kartṛtve karmatve vā syāt, sādhyaṃ hi lastutpadyamānatvena kratā karma ceti | na caitadubhayamapi kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ pratiyujyate| tiṅantena hi kriyātmotpattiṃ prati prayatamānakārakākāṃkṣāpi prakṛtyā prayogeṣu viniveśitasvarūpā'bhidhīyate| ato'pratilabdhātmarūpatvena kriyāyāssādhanaparavaśatvena tadavaruddhatvāditareṇa kriyātmanāsaṃbandhasatvenāsyāḥ kartṛrūpatā vā saṃbhavati, yataḥ pariniṣpannarūpasyātmalābhanirapekṣasya siddhātmanassādhanabhāvo ghaṭate, natūktaviparītātmana iti| kriyāyāścāyameva svabhāvaḥ, yaduta sādhanādhīvanatvena sādhyasvabhāvāyāḥ pratītiḥ yā ca sādhyasvabhāvā sā kathamivānyasmin sādhyesādhanabhāvaṃgacchet yena katrrītyucyate yā ca sādhanādhīnatvena sādhyasvābhāvā sā kathamiva kriyā sādhyeta yena karmetyucyate? yadi ca syāt pariniṣpannarūpadravyavadevedaṃ tayā nirdiśyeta| na ca nirdiśādapi na sādhanam| avasthārūpaśca sādhanadharmo vyāpāraśabdavācyaḥ| kriyā sā kathaminātmasiddhaye tathāvidhameva dharmantaramapekṣeta? anepekṣitayośca kathamiva mithassaṃbandhopapattiḥ? na ca kriyāyāḥ kimapi tadavaśiṣyate yatsādhanairasādhitaṃ kriyāntarasya sādhyaṃ bhaviṣyati| tadevamitaretarānāyattarūpayorasaṃbandha eva kriyayoḥ| na ca nivartamānalabdhātmakaṃ vastunivartakādṛte pareṇa saha saṃbandhamarhet| upakāryopakārakanibandhanasvabhāvānāmitaretareṇa saṃbandhalabdhātmakasya lopakārakatvam? kriyā ca tathārūpatvavirahāt sādhanebhyassvotpattimavekṣamāṇā kathamivanātathābhūtakriyāntareṇa saṃbandhamiyāt? tasmāt svasādhanāvaruddhatvātsādhyamānaikasvabhāvāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ kartṛtve kartṛtve vā na kriyāntareṇa saha saṃbandhaḥ| nanu ca yathā pākaṃ karoti, pāko vartate, iti tiṅkṛdabhihitayoḥ kriyayossādhyasādhanabhāvo dṛśyate, tathāca paṭhati pacatītyetayorapi kasmānna bhavati? naivam, uktamidaṃ bhāṣye, asti khalu tiṅābhihitasya kṛdabhihitasya bhāvasya viśeṣaḥ, kṛdabhihito hi bhāvo dravyavat prakāśamānaḥ kriyayā samavāyaṃ gacchatīti| na hi bhavati, pacati, paṭhati, iita sakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo'pyākhyātābhihitayoḥ kriyayorabhinnasādhanayorvā samabhavati| dvidhā'pi cānupapattiḥ, sādhyamānatvena pravartamānasya sādhavanapantrasya cātmano'nidantānirdaiśasya sādhanavallakṣaṇatvāyogāt| nanu ca mābhūt kriyāyāssādhanam, lakṣaṇaṃ tūbhayathāpi dṛśyate, pācakaḥ paṭhati, rudataḥ prāvrājīditi| tato yaḥ pacati sa paṭhati, sa roditi, ayaṃ pravrajatītyākhyātayorlakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo bhaviṣyati| ciraṃ jīva, tvayaiva smāritosmi, ākhyātayorlakṣyalakṣaṇatvenāsaṃbandhakāraṇasya yadatra lakṣaṇahetvoḥ”kriyāyāḥ” iti śatṛśānacau tiṅaparādau smaryete| ato lakṣaṇatve kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ prati samāśriyamāṇe pacan rudataḥ prāvrājīdityevabhavitavyam| nanu yaḥ pacati sa paṭhati, sa rodityayaṃ pravrajatīti tatkathaṃ saṃbandhaḥ? etena hetugetumadbhāvaḥ ākhyātayoḥ pratyukto bhavati, yato'sāvapi dvidhā heturvā detumatparatvena, hetumato vā hetuparatvena| tatra hetorhetimatparatve śatṛśānajbhyāṃ hetumatassvahetuparatvena, tumunādibhirbhāvyam| yathā pacan bhiṅkte, adhīyamāno vasati, bhoktuṃ pacati, bhojako vrajatīti| nanu pacati, bhukte, vrajatīti tta kasya kena saṃbandhaḥ? avadhyavadhimadbhāvopi tiṅantayornāstyeva, sa hi deśataḥ kālato vā syāt| na tāvaddeśataḥ, tasya mūrtimadviṣayatvāt kālatastu yujyate| kiṃtu tatra pūrvākāle ktavāpratyayavidhānāt paktvā bhiṅakte ityeva syāt| na tu pacati bhiṅkta iti samuñcayenāpi kriyāyāssaṃbandhaḥ| sopi hi dvidhaiva, sādhanānāṃ vā kriyāyāṃ yathā gauraśvaśca gṛhyatām, kriyāṇāṃ vā sādhane yathāsau pacati paṭhati ceti, natu kriyāṇāṃ vā sādhena yathāsau pacati paṭhati ceti, nanu kriyāṇāṃ kriyāyāmeva| nanu caikatvātkriyāyā yadyapi sādhanasamuñcaye kriyābhisaṃbandho nāsti, tathāpyekavastuviṣayatvenakriyāsamuñcayo'sau bhaviṣyati| tathāhi, ya eva pacati sa eva paṭhatītyaikādhikaraṇye bhavatyeva saṃbandhopapattiḥ| naivam, sādhyayossādhanāya tayoralabdhātmanossādhanonmukhatvena parivartamānayoḥ kriyāyāḥ parasparānapekṣatvāt, nahyananvitātmanāmadhikaraṇamupekṣāmupajanayitumalam| atassavyetaragoviṣāṇavat paraspareṇāsamanvitameva kriyādvayaṃ sādhane samuñciyate | na ca samuñcīyamāne vastuni mithassaṃbadhyate, tathā sati samāhāretaretarayoranyatarāpattau samuñcayasyaivābhāvāt|ādigrahaṇādanvādayo'nanvaya eva kriyayoḥ, tasmānnāstyevākhyātayormithassaṃbandha iti| nanu ca asti sa bhe rocate, asti tvamīśiṣe, nāhaṃ ramesminniti sāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo bhavati| pacati, bhavati, pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, bhavedapi bhavet, syādapi syāditi kartṛtvena paśya mṛgo dhāvati, iha paśyāmaḥ, karmaṇi dvivacanabahuvacanānyudāhiyante| ehi manye rathena yāsyāsi, smarasi devadatta kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmastatraudanaṃ bhokṣyāmahe, na marṣayāmi yattatra bhavān vṛṣalaṃ yājayediti karmatvena sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ| yo bhuṅkte sa gṛhyatāṃ, yo'dhīte sa pacatītyabhinnasādhanatvena, sa svapiti, eṣa budhyate, sa udeti, ayamastametīti bhinnasādhanatvena lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ | hantīti palāyate, . varṣatīti dhāvatīti hetorhetumatparatvena, vakṣyāmīti vrajati, bhokṣyate ityāsta iita hetuhetumatorhetuparatvena hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ | yāvadbhuṅkte tato prajati, yadayaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ paṭhati, yadayaṃ bhuktvā vrajatītyadhīta eva, tataḥ paramiti avadhyavadhimadbhāvaḥ| saktūn piba, dhānāḥ svāda, odanaṃ bhuṃkṣvetyevāyamabhyavaharati, pachati cāyaṃ paṭhati ceti samuñcayaḥ, vaṭo bhikṣāmaṭa, gāṃ canayetyanvācayo'pi tiṅanteṣu dṛśyate| tatkathamucyate nākhyātayossaṃbandho'stīti? naivam, vākbhedādinā tadupapatteḥ | asti sa sa me rocate, asi tvaṃ tvamīśiṣe, asmyahamahaṃ rame, astayednacchamo vayaṃ, bhavatvevamtat, payasodhayāmayatvamamithyevāsi, yanmurajitastavamapūpuja ityukteṣu vākyabhedā upapadyante| nipātā vā astyādayaḥ ākhyātasarūpanirarthakā api vākyapūraṇāya kamīmidvādivatprayujyante, na tu kriyābhirviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvamanubhavanti| bhavati pacatītiyādiṣu tu pacatīti pakṣyatīti apākṣīditi ca yo'rtho bhavati asāvastītyarthaḥ| nanu pacatyāderbhavantau kartṛtvena sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ, evaṃ bhavedapi bhavet, syādapi syāditi| nanu cāvaśyameva pacatyādikriyā bhavatikriyākartṛkatvenābhyupeyā | yadi hyeṣā na bhavettena katrrī syāt siddharūpatayā, na lakāreṇābhidhīyate | na ca sā satī siddhabhāvamupaiti| na ca lakārasiddhatadabhidhānena vinā kartṛbhāvenemāṃ pratipādajayitumutsahate | tato yenātmānā katrrī na tena kriyā, yena ca sādhyātmanā kriyā na tena katrrīti vastvantarameva lakāreṇa kartṛtayā kathitamāpadyeta| devadattaḥ pacatīti cānena jñātavatprājñāpyete vidheyatā patyekterbhavatītyatra tu ajñātarūpatayopādīyate bhavanakriyānubhavitṛtvāt| na ca yugapadeva jñātavadajñātavañca samāśrayaṇaṃ yuktam, ato na kriyākartṛtvamupayāti| paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra tu paśyaśabdo na tibhantaḥ| kiṃ tarhi pitā nipā toyamāścaryamityetasminnarthe vartate? paśya bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ| kecidākhyātasarūpau paśya paśyata śabdau na darśanārheyaṃ kriyetyāsminnarthe manyante, athavā paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra nāsāvevāmaha dṛśaṃ mṛgasaraṇe niyuṃkṣva | kiṃ tarhi? cakṣuḥ praṇidhatsva pramatto mābhīriti sato'praṇihitacakṣissan mṛgasaraṇamanyadvā pratipadyate yathā rūpamanyaṃ dṛṣṭvā etadevāha, ālokaya ālokayeti, tasmātpaśyetāvatpyavasyati, parisamāptatvānnāsti dṛśassaraṇena saṃbandhaḥ| ata yo dhāvati mṛgastaṃ paśyeti sravanāmnā yadā so'rthaḥ pratyavamṛṣṭo bhavati tadā kriyā tasyopalakṣaṇāya pravartate| yo dhāvati sartāraṃ paśyati, ayaṃ cārthaḥ paśya dhāvatīti padayorasaṃbandhatvena śrutārthāpattigamyaḥ, na tu śabdasanniveśī, yadi vā śrutārthāpatyeva gamyamāvanetiśabdopasaṃhṛtasya mṛgo dhāvatīti vākyārthasya dṛśau karmatvameva paśyāma udāhiyanta iti | athāvā dve ete vākye, akametāvati vākyamiha paśyāmaḥ yasmāduhāyante prayuḍaḍḍatdhjyata iti dvitīyam| ehi manye rathena yāsyasītyatra “prahāse ca manyopapade manyopapade manyateruttam ekaśceti” vacanādyadvāyamarthaḥ, ehi manye rathena yāsyāmīti | yadā vā sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe svaviṣaya eva madhyamettamau tadā sarvathā gamyānetiśabdopasamahṛtasya bāhyārthasyaiva karmatvam | ehīti ca prahāsaviṣayasaṃbodhanārtha ākhyātasvarūpo nipātaḥ| ākhyātasvarūpāśca puruṣasaṃkhyāṃ ca vyabhicaranti| na hi bhavati tvamasti vyamastīti| kiñcāstirapi nipātaḥ, soḍhaṃ yathāstikṣīrā gauḥ | tatra hyākhyātamiti kṛtvoktaḥ subadhikāre'stikṣīrādivacanamiti, na cāvyaytavānnipāto'yamiti parihāraḥ| nanu ca saṅkhyāmabhicaran kathamekaśabdo bahūnāṃ prahāse bahutvaṃ brūyāt? naivam, bahubhirekaḥ prahasyate, naikena bahavaḥ, nahi bahuṣvekaṃ prahasatsu sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe ehi manye rathena yāsyāmi | yadā vā sūtrapratiṣedhapakṣe astīti kathaṃ na satvabhūtorthassādhsādhyasādhanasaṃbandhamanubhavati| yo bhuṃkte sa gṛhyatāmityatrāpi vākyadvitayameva | na cātra kriyayoḥ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ kārakopalakṣaṇatvāt yo bhuṃkte sa devadatta iti devadattasatvo lakṣaṇameko vākyārthaḥ, sa tathābhūto gṛhyatāmiti tasya grahaṇasaṃbandhaḥ, darśanamaparam| na ca yathāsatvaṃ tadrūpābhidhāyitvena smaraṇāt kartṛprādhānyamabhidadhat kriyāyāḥ kriyāntaraṃ prati lakṣaṇatvamabhidhatte tathā kravanāmābhidhātuṃ śaknoti| tena hi sā kriyāsādhyatvātpracyāvya sādhanopasarjanabhāvanupanītā tatparāmṛṣṭaṃ devadattamupalakṣayati, sa tu tathābhūtaḥ krayāntareṇa saṃbadhyata iti| nahyekasyāḥ pravṛttessādhanopalakṣaṇamaparakriyāsaṃbandhaścopapanne bhavati| nanvidamevāsyāḥ kriyāntareṇānvitatvaṃ yadanyasyāssādhanamupalakṣayati| naivam, eṣā svasādhanalakṣaṇatvena pravartamānā yadadhīnodayā tadevopalakṣayet, nānyasaṃbandhāt| nanu cā'syāḥ api devadatta eva sādhanaṃ sa cānayopalakṣitaḥ, tatkathaṃ bhinnavākyātā? naivam, bhavati nāma denadatto lakṣaṇatvamasyāḥ, kiṃtu na devadattatayopalakṣayati, apitu svasādhanatvena | tatassvasādhaka eva devadatte prathamato'nyaviśrāntiḥ, devadattasya ca tayaiva tadābhisaṃbandho'pyupeyaḥ| na hi yaugapadyena lakṣyamāṇatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca pratipadyeta, kriyāntare guṇabhāvaṃ ca virodhaprasaṅgāt| na ca bhujikriyāvācchinnasyetarakriyābhisaṃbandho'bhimataḥ samuñañciyamānakriyādvayapraṅgāt| yo bhuṃkte saḥ gṛhyatāmityekarasā pravṛttiḥ pratyāsatteḥ tanmātrabhitraṃ satraṃ, tasya tu punaritthaṃbhūta evārtha iti na tatra vākyabhedaḥ | etena yo'dhīte sa pacatītyapi pratyuktam| sa svapityeṣa budhyate, sa udetītyayamastametītyatra tu sādhanatvānnatarāṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ| hantīti palāyata iti atratviti śabdo hetuhetumadbhāvaṃ dyotayannathrsaya svātantryaṃ karoti| dṛṣṭaṃ itiśabdo'rthasya svātantryamupajanayani “tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya” iita atra hi tasminnityadhikaraṇasya kartṛkarmasamavāyinyau kriye pratyupādhitvena pravartamānasyākāṃkṣā yata ādheyastatrasva ātmavanyavasthānābhāvāditi śabdenāsatyavacchede kāryayogo na syāt| tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasyetyukte tasmin ya ādheyo nirdiṣṭaṃ iti saṃpratyayassyāt, tasmāt saptamyarthanirdeśe pūrvasya kāryasya saṃpratyayārthamiti upādīyate evamihāpīti śabdo vā na tasya svātantryamupajanayati, yasmādayaṃ hanti tasmādayaṃ palāyata iti, evaṃ varṣatītyādāvapi yojanīyam, atra ca tiṅantayoriti śabdasāmathryāddhetuhetumadbhāvo'numīyate, na punaśśabdasanniveśīti| yāvadbhakte tato vrajatītyādau tu bhinnavākyatāyāmapi yāvat tataḥ pūrvamityādinipātasāmathryādavadhyavadhimadbhāvo gamyate, na punarākhyātaśabdasanniveśīti| saktan pibetyādāvapi saktan piba, dhānaḥ khādeti audanaṃ bhuṅkta iti viśeṣaṇavākyārthā itiśabdopasaṃhṛtā iti śbadasāmathryadeva tatsāmānyābhidhāyinā ayamabhyavaharatīti vākyāntaraṇocyante | pacati cāyaṃ paṭhati ceti vākyadvayameva, evaṃ bhikṣāmaṭa, gāṃ cānayeti| tadevaṃ kātyāyanamate nāstyevamākhyātayossaṃbandhaḥ, sūtrakārasya tu mate'stevākhyātayoḥ anekavākyātvenābhisaṃbandha iti | yadayaṃ samānavakyādhikāre tiṅantāduttarasya tiṅo nighātaṃ śāsti| abhijñāvacane lṛḍiḍḍatdhti smṛtyuktāvatītakāle'pi lṛṭaṃ smarati, yaditi yatprayoge tānniṣedhati vibhāṣā sākāṃkṣa ityākāṃkṣāyāṃ vibhāṣayābhyanujānāti, “nayadyanākāṃkṣye” iti nirākāṃkṣavākye ktvāṇamulau niṣidhya laḍādīnevānumanyate iti kā punaratropapattiḥ? ucyate ākhyātapadatulyadharmiṇo hi ktvāntasyāneksāpi dṛṣṭastiṅantena saha saṃbandhaḥ| snnātvā pītvā bhiktvā vrajatīti, tathā pūrvaṃ snnāti bhukte pibati tu vrajati, iti | tatra yathaiva ktvāntasya tibhantenaikavākyatvaṃ tathā pūrvakālakriyābhidhāyināmākhyātānāṃ sarveṣāmapi kriyāviśeṣaṇakatvādbhavati| uktaśca yathā'nekamapi ktāntaṃtiṅantasya viśeṣakam| tathā tiṅantaṃ tatrāhuḥ tiṅantasya viśeṣakam||
< kiñca yathākathaṃcidāśriyamāṇo'rthassāmānādhikaraṇyenāvadhibhāvena vā viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na vyatikrāmati| tathāhi, vraḍa, devadattetyāmantritasya viśeṣaṇatvenaikavākyatvādāmantritasya ceti nighāto dṛśyate, kartṛtvādbhaviṣyatīti cet vrajati devadattetyatra katham? nahi devadatto vrajikriyāyāḥ kartā, na khalvapi kārakasya viśeṣakaṃ, nāpi suṣṭhu pacatīti padāntaratvena bāhyaviśeṣaṇamupapadyate | kiṃntu kriyāṃ pratyābhimukhyenāvasthāpyamānaḥ pañcavārān, pacatītivat bāhyaviśeṣaṇatāṃ labhyate| kaḥ punarbāhyāntarayoḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇayorviśeṣaḥ? yamasti āntaraṃ hi kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ karmatvaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca pratilabhate, bāhyasya tu svaliṅgatā na karmatvāniyamaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛtvoktaṃ saṃbodhanapadaṃ yañca tatkrayāyā viśeṣakam | brajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathāsati|| nanu ca saṃbodhanapadasya tiṅantenaikavākyatā yujyate, saṃbodhanaṃ hyākṣiptakriyāpadaṃ vartate | devadatta abhimukho bhavetyābhimukhye hi yujyate| tatra devadattetyetāvatyarthasya parisamāptatvāt saṃbodhanapadamekaṃ vākyam, sobhimukhībhūtaḥ kriyāntaro vyāpāraḥ | anyetvāhur sākāṃkṣāvayavaṃ bhede parānākāṃkṣaśabdakam| karmapradhānaguṇavadekārthaṃ vākyamucyate|| evaṃ ca bruvato yathoktalakṣaṇapadasamūho vākyamityabhiprāyaḥ, na ca devadatteti padasamūhaḥ| athābhimukho bhavetyākṣepādasya samūhabhāvaḥ, tathā'pi sākāṃkṣatvādavākyatvam| na hyabhimukhībāvamātrameva kaścidvidhatte| kiṃ tahryabimukhībhāvaṃ vidhāya kriyāntare niyuṃkte, api cābhimukho bhavetyadhyāhiyamāṇayā'pi kriyāyā saṃbandhaṃ manyase vrajetyapāttayā'pi na manyasa ityaho mādhyasthyam| kiṃcābhimukho bhavetyāmapi niyogaḥ, tatrānabhinukhysya niyoktumaśakyatvāt | abhimukhīkaraṇāya kriyāntarādhyāhāre'navasthā, tadbhayāñcābhimukhīkāragarbhaniyogoṅgīkartavavyaḥ, sa ca prajetyādāvapi tulya evetyalamatiprasaṅagena | yadi cāmantritasya tiṅantenaikavākyā na syāt, “āmāntritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānava” diti sūtrakāro na brūyāt| tatredamavidyamānavatve prayojanamā| nighātādayo mābhūvanniti nighatādayaścāsamānavākyātvādeva na bhaviṣyanti, kimavidyamānavadbhāvena | na caidadvārtikakāro manyate | so'pi hyavidyamānavadbhāvasya prayojanāti paṭhati avidyamanavatve prayojanamāmāntritayuṣmadasmādādeśatiṅanighātā iti| bhavatu nāma sāmānādhikaraṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā yathākathaṃcidāśriyamāṇānāmākhyātānāmākhyātaṃ prati viśeṣaṇtavamupalakṣaṇatvaṃ hetumatvamavadhibhāvo vā samuñcayo'pyevamevopapadyatām | sādhyasādhanabhāvastu nopapadyate, virūddharūpayoparthayorekarūpeṇa śabdenābhidhānāt yathā'yaṃ daṇḍo harānena phalānītyātrāyaṃ daṇḍa, ityanena rūpeṇa daṇḍārthamantarbhītāstikriyamupādātumīṣṭe | anenetyayaṃ ca śabdaḥ karaṇarūpeṇeva vastusāmānyamabhidadhat pratyakṣeṇopādatte, na rūpāntareṇa prakaraṇāttu daṇḍe, pratipattiḥ| tathehāpi pacati dhāvatītyādirākhyātasādhyabhūtāṃ kriyāmabhidhatte, tāmeva ca siddhāṃ sādhantavamāpannāmanenaiva rūpeṇa vakṣyatītyasaṃbhavaḥ| nāsaṃbhavassādyatvenaiva sādhanatvāt, yadevaṃ hi kriyāyāssādhyamānātvamanidantānirdeśyaṃ pariniśṭhitaṃ rūpaṃ tenaiva sādhanabhāvaṃ pratipadyate, na rūpāntareṇa tasyābhāvāllakāro'pi caitāṃ sādhyatayā bhavanti kartṛbhāvenābhidhatte pacati, bhavatīti| nanu kimanyadbhavanaṃ pacatikriyāyāssādhyatāvyatireki, kiṃvā tadatiriktaṃ kartṛtvaṃ, yena sādhyasādhanabhāvo'vakalpeta| ucyate, yo'yamasyāḥ kārakasaṃbandhaḥ, kārakavyāpāraviṣayatā na kārakāṇi śaśaviṣāṇavatparākaroti| śakyate saṃpādayituṃ tebhyassaṃpattimanubhavati, tadasyāḥkārakasaṃbandhalakṣaṇaṃ sādhyamānatvameva rūpaṃ bhavanamabhidhīyate| pacati kriyābhavanaṃ nirvartayati kārakebhyo nivṛttiṃ pratipadyate | kārakāṇi vyāpāravanti karotītyarthaḥ| yatpunarasyāviśeṣaṇarūpaṃ yāgādidharmakaṃ paktirūpaṃ pacatyekaśabdavācyamananyasādhāraṇaṃ, tainaiṣā katrrī saṃpadyate, tadevamananyasādhāraṇena kartrī saṃpadya sādhyatmanā bhavati, kriyārūpatvena bhavati pacati, bhavati, sādhyatvaṃ labhata ityarthaḥ, athavā prayogātmako yo'dhīśrayaṇādivyāpārāstaireṣā bhavanākriyārūpatāmupayāti| phalabhutena vikalityātamanā bhavitṛrūpaṃ kartṛtvaṃ, tena bhavati pacati ityayamarthaḥ paraktirādhiśrayaṇaṇaṇaṇaṇādyātmanā bhavati, adhiśrayaṇādayo'syāḥ pravṛttā iti yāvat adhiśrayaṇādirūpeṇa vā bhavitṛtvaṃ paktirūpeṇa bhavanakriyātvaṃ tenā'yamarthaḥ adiśrayaṇādayaḥ paktirūpatayā bhavanti viklitissañjāteti yāvattt | athavā budhdyātmanā bhavanarūpatvamiti, yadi vā sāmānyātmanā kartṛtvaṃ viśeṣātmanā bhavanarūpetyupapadyate kriyāyāṃ kārakatvam| nanu coktaṃ na lakāraḥ siddhavadabhidhānena vinā kartṛbhāvenemāṃ pratipādayitumutsahate, tataśca siddhatvenābhidhāne punarapi virodhaḥ | naivam, yadeva pacatikriyāyāssvabhāvabhūtamātmīyarūpaṃ sādhyatālakṣaṇaṃ tenaivaṃ rūpeṇa sā kartṛtvamupagatā lakāreṇocyate| siddhatvāvabhāsaḥ kuta iita ṭacet, lakārastāṃ karrṛbhāvena patipādayutuṃ pravṛttassidadhatvenāvagamayati, na tu rujatīti dhātvartha eva rogalakṣaṇaḥ, katrravantarāśrayaṇāt kartṛbhāvamupayāti, sādhyānmana eva cāsya kartṛtvam| na ca siddhatāprāptiḥ kartṛtvena pratīyamānā siddhatayā|vabhāsate tathā kriyā'pi na siddhatayā lakāreṇābhidhīyate nānārūpāśśakteyo viruddhaviruddhasvabhāvā lokayātrāṃ kalpayanti| tato'sya sarvaśabdabhāvasya vācakaśabdaḥ kaścit, sidadhātmikāṃ śaktivṛttimavalambate kaścit, tadevaṃsuddhisādhyatāśaktiyuktaṃ vastu śabdābhyāmabhidhīyamānaṃ na virudhyate| anekaśkatiyaktitvāt pacatītiyanena tadeva sādhyatvenāvagataṃ bhavatīti lakārassādhyatvenavābhidhatte, sarvaśaktivirahitaṃ vā vastu sakalalpollekharahitatvāt| tasya tu śabdā eva svamahimnā nānāvidhabudhyupajananahetavaśśaktiṃ saṃniveśayanti, śaktyāviṣṭamiva vyavahāragovaratāṃ nayanti | tena śabdābhyameva siddhasādhyatāśaktiyādhānādakhilavikalpīkṛtātmakamapi tadvastu siddhasādhyabhāveno padiśyate | bhavati pacatītyekena śabdena sanniveśitasādhyatāktiyuktamabhihitamitareṇa tu tadeva śaktiyāntarāropeṇa prakāśyata iti nāsti virodhaḥ| yadi vā na padasya padarūpādevādhikārthatā kiṃ tarhi vākyarūpāt? tadyathā puruṣa iti padakāle puruṣo vyatirikta ucyate| yadā tu rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti viśeṣasannidhau prayujyate tadā viśiṣṭasya puruṣāṃrthasya gatirna puruṣasyeti vākyakāle'dhikasya dharmasya pradurbhāvaḥ tathā pacatīti naikasmādeva padarūpātkartṛtvam| yadā bhavatīti padāntarasannidhistadāparatve sādhanamadṛṣṭavākyakāle puruṣasyaiva vyatireka upajāyata iti| yathā'pi vyapadeśivadbhāvenābhinnasyāpi dhātoravayava prathamaikājvyapadeśa iyāyetyādau pravurtante, tathā buddhibhedakalpanayā ākhyātavācyasyārthasya bhede'pi kriyākārakādivyapadeśaḥ pravartante | tataśca pacatītyatrāpi kadācidaparā tadatirekiṇī bhavanakriyā kaścidaparo vā kartā virodhaheturasti | api tu saiva vyapadeśivadbhāvena bhavanākriyārūpatā putṛtvaṃ ca darśayantī cakāsti | etena paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādāvapi siddhasādhyatvayorapi caikasyapyarthasya viṣayabhedena dvidharmatvaṃ na virudhyate | yathā rājñaḥ puruṣasya puruṣa iti puruṣaśśeṣī bhavati, śe, śceti rājānaṃ viśeṣo'vacalitāssvārthaśśeśatāmāpadyate | evaṃ ca dhāvatīti mṛge kartari sādhyabhāvaṃ prādhānyenājahat saraṇaṃ dṛśāvaṅgatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ copaitīti na kaścidvirodhaḥ | athāvā'yamarthaḥ, sādhanamidamayaṃ sādhya iti rūpaṃ siddamātrametat, yathā pade ayaṃ prakṛtyartho'yaṃ pratyayārtha ityka evāsāvarthaḥ | aviśiṣṭo viśiṣṭo vā vākyaviśeṣayorgṛhītavyaḥ, yathā muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati, kuṭayati, mūtrayati, carcayatīti| tatra muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati māṇavakaṃ muṇḍiḍḍatdhḥ keśacchedanavacanaḥ | tasya tu vyutapattiḥ muṇḍaṃ, karotīti sāmānyapravṛttiviśeṣaṃ muṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdo'vasthāpayati | karoti viśeṣo yasmin ṇijyutpadyate, na karotimātram | anye punaḥ keśacchedanādivacanānmuṇḍādīnadhyavasyānti yathoktam | athavā muṇḍādayo dhātavaḥ | muṇḍaḍḍatdhyatīti caitasminnarthe kuṭayatīti kuḍaḍḍatdhśabdena hi karoti, viśeṣo va lakṣyate, kiṃtu chidādiviśeṣamavalakṣyamāṇoddeśavibhāgaṃ kūṭirevopādette | evaṃ mūtraṃ karotīti mūtrayati, carcāṃ karotīti carcayati | mūtrema carcayā vā karotau viśeṃṣyamāṇe kṣaraṇaṃ paribhāṣaṇaṃ vā viśeṣeṇopādīyate | sa eva ca kadācit kṣaraṇaviśeṣaḥ paribhāṣaṇāviśeṣo vā naṣṭoddeśavibhāgaḥ upādīyate, yathā mūtrastravaṇe mūtrayati, carcaparibhāṣaṇe carcayatīti | evaṃ paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti idamatra sādhanapadamidamatra sādhyapadamiti utprekṣaiṣā | idaṃ tvathetatvaṃ nātra saraṇaṃ na darśanaṃ na mṛgaḥ | kiṃ tarhi mṛgakartṛko dṛśikarmasaraṇaviśeṣo'yaṃ tatraikārthatvādekamevedaṃ vākyamityasti dvayostiṅantayorekāsmin vākye | tataśca pacati karotītyādāvapi pākaṃ karotītivat sādhyasādhanabhāvena saṃbandho'styeveti na kaścidvirodhaḥ | anye purnana manyante kasyacidapi bāhyasya vasatvātmano'saṃbhavāt| bhāvabhūtavastuśṛnyamevedaṃ jagat, tato buddhīnāmeva tathābhūtavyavahāropajanananibandhantavam | buddhaya eva hi siddhasādhaayatārūpamupadarśayantyaḥ śabdātpravartanti | tataśca snamahimollasitanānāvidhabiddhisamupanītabhedanakālpanikākāraparigato'yaṃ māyendrajālasadṛśo vyavahāraḥ pravartata iti na kaścidaparaṃ vastu yasya siddhasya sādhyalakṣaṇavirodhāpattiḥ | tathāhi, buddhimākārabhedavatīmeke kriyāṃ manyante | te hi svamātrābhiraparyavasitaviṣayanirbhāsābhiḥ antastatvādibhiriva bahirarthanibandhanāmarthakriyāṃ sādhayanti | na tadarthaṃ darśanābhiniveśāvasmākaṃ ārāddanīyasmutsārayanti pratyayavyaktayo hi parākṛtavākyārthasaṃsasparśābāhyārthavat tīsu tāsvarthakriyāsu yathāsāmathryamupajāyamānāḥ pratītāśaṅkāviṣayaparigamanādyavasthāsu tadā sāmathryakriyā sāmathrya kimarthamanyapadārtharūpamabhyupeyata ityatra cūrṇāvirodhaṃ darśayati | idaṃ kiloktaṃ bhāṣyekṛdabhihito bhāvaḥ kriyāya samavāyaṃ gacchati, pāko vartata iti, tiṅabhihitastu na gacchati| na hi bhavati pacati paṭhatīti ātrā'yaṃ samādhiḥ, yathā kriyopanyastā tathābhūtā samavāyaṃ na gacchati, viśeṣayossamavāyo nāsti, sāmānyayorastyeva | asti sa me rocate, asi tvamīśiṣe, nāsti rame, bhavati pacati karotīti | tajñaitacchakyate vaktum| yatrānyā ca kriyā bhavati yatra tu khalu saiva sā kriyā tatra kathaṃ? yathā bhavedapi bhavet, syādapi syāditi | asti ca loke evaṃbhūtaḥ prayogaḥ | api bhavedetaddevadattasyāpi sa divassyādyatredaṃ bhavediti devadattasya ca loke evaṃbhūtaḥ prayogaḥ | api bhavedetaddevadattasyāpi sa divassyādyatredaṃ bhavediti devadattasya ca vartamānakālāṃ sattāmavināśaṃ prārthayamāna etatprayuṅkte, api bhavedetat bhaveddevadatta iti | atrāpyanatvamasti kutassādhanabhedātkālabhedāñca hi kasyātra bhavaterbhavatassādhanassādhavassārvakālaśca pratyayaḥ | api bhavedityatra yo bhavati tatra devadattasattā na prakṛtyarthaḥ| kiṃ tarhi pratyayārthaḥ prārthanaiva liṅiti sravakālatvaṃ kālaviśeṣasyānāśritatvāt | aparasya bāhyasādhanaṃ vartamānakālasya pratyayo bhavati| tasya bāhyaṃ sādhanaṃ dravyaṃ devadattena ityrarthaḥ, devadattasattā tu prakṛtyarthaḥ | kiṃ tarhi pratyayārthaḥ prārthanaiva liṅiti sarvakālatvaṃ kālaviśeṣasyānāṅitatvāt | aparasyā bāhyasādhanaṃ vartamānakālasya pratyayo bhavati| tasya bāhyaṃ sādhanaṃ dravyaṃ devadatta ityrathaḥ, devadattasattā tu prakṛtyarthaḥ, vartamānasattātu devadattatacasya prāthryata ityanupāttakālaviśeṣaḥ | śāstre liṅ svarūpādeva vartamānakāle'vatiṣṭhate, tathā tavyādayo bhaviṣyanti, kartavyaḥ kaṭa iti | svabhāvāñcārthānāṃ vyavastheti bhāṣye kālādhikāraḥ pratyakhyātāḥ | evaṃ syādapi syādityatrāpi svābhāvikaṃ nānātvaṃ sādhanakālabhedena pratipadyata iti| nanvastyādayo'pi nipātāḥ, te cākhyātasvarūpatvāt kārakāṇi viśiṃṣaṃtaḥ kālaṃ puruṣaṃ saṃkhyāṃ na vyabhicariṣyanti, bhavatu gacchāmyabamiti puruṣavyabhicāraḥ | bhavatu tayaiva maṇaḍūḍḍatdhkāḥ pacyantāmiti saṃkhyāvyabhicāraḥ | bhavatu nāma drakṣyasīti kālapuruṣavyabhicāraḥ | bhavatu bhaviṣyanti jīvato dhānānīti kālasaṃkhyāvyabhicāraḥ | astyagamāma ghoṣāditi kālapuruṣasaṃkhyāvyabhicāraḥ | loke caivaṃbhūtā vācoyuktirasti prayuṅakte hi lokaḥ | asti gacchāmo vayamiti evamādiḥ tatrāstītyekavacanamupalabhyate | tena manyāmahe gamerevaikatvāśrayasya kartṛtvaṃ, na vayamiti bahutvāśrayasya | tadevaṃ sāmānyakriyayā viśeṣakriyāṇāṃ kartṛtvenābhisaṃbandhāt astyanayossādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ | viśeśakriyāyāmapi kkacitkarmatvena saṃvangho dṛśyate, paśya dhāvati, paśyāma udāhriyante, manye yāsyasi smarasi vatsyāmaḥ na marṣayāmi yajayiṣyati āśaṃse yukto'dhīyeti| karaṇādibhāvaśca tiṅantānāṃ na vidyate, pacati paṭhatīti, atra tu vidyata eva saṃbandhaḥ, sarvanāmnā parāmarśāt| na ceha vākyabhedaḥ sarvathaiva tadanupalabdheḥ | tatra hi khalu vākyabheda upeyate, tatrāsau parāmṛśyamāno'ndhā buddhirullikhati| na cehollekhavān vākyabhedo buddhāvupalabhyate, tasmādekavākyatvameva | ata evābhijānāsi devadatta yatkāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ, tatraudanaṃ bhokṣyāmahe iti “vibhāṣāsākāṃkṣe” iti sarvanāmnā parāmarśātsākāṃkṣatvopapateḥ | tatretyanenānusaṃdhīyamānatvāllaṭo laṅascha vikalpaḥ pravartate | sa svapityeṣa budhyate, so'stamayate'yamudetītyatra tu parasparaṃ vā ākhyātayorlakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ | saha vā sarvaireva kālaviśeṣādikaṃ lakṣyata ityekaparatvādekavākyataiva | yathā kumudāni prabudhayante śatapatrāṇi śerate| śakaṭaṃ gāhate vyoma mātṛmaṇḍaḍḍatdhlamujjhati || hantīti palāyata ityādau tvavasthita eva hetuhetumadbhāva iti na dyotyate, nanvapūrvaṃ kriyate pacati paṭhatītyatrāpi prasaṅgāt | ete tāvadavadhyavadhimadbhāvo yāvadādau samuñcādau cādayaśca vyākhyātāḥ | tadevaṃ lūtrakārasya bhāṣyakārasya ca darśane astikriyāyāḥ kriyāntareṇa saṃbandhaḥ | vārtikakāsastu yuṣmadasmādādeśanighātādyarthamākhyātaṃ sāvyayakarakaviśaṣaṇaṃ vākyamekatiṅavākyamiti anyadeva laukikātpāribhāśaṣikaṃvākyalakṣaṇamārabhate | na ca tena laukiko vyavahārassidhyatītyupekṣyate | taduktuṃ nighātādivyavasthārthāṃ śāstre yatpāribhāṣikam | sākāṃkṣāvayavaṃ tena na sarvaṃ tulyalakṣaṇam|| etena bhinnābhinnapravṛktiṛkānevākyopakalpitaikavākyasthānāmapi kriyāṇāṃ parasparamatabhisaṃbandho vyākhyātaḥ | sa bhinnapravṛktṛkatve yathā kuśalaṃ tasyā jīvati kuśalaṃ pṛcchāmi jīvatītyuktam| punarapi tadeva kathayasi mṛtāṃ nu kathayāmi yāśvasiti|| abhinnavaktutve yathāsvacache salilātmani pratiphaleddeve triyāmāpatau | pīyūṣākṛti paryavasyati kila jyotsnnoti tatvāntaram|| tigmaṃ dhāma ciraṃ cakāsti divi tattatrāsti divyaḥ pumān| yaṃ vijñātavatāṃ truṭanti nikhilā bhūyo bhavagranthayaḥ|| prabandhāṅgamavāntaravākyaṃ prakaraṇam | tantridhā prastutaṃ, kalpitaṃ, ākāsmikañca | teṣu prastutaṃ dvidhāṅgaṃ varṇakañca tayoraṅgaṃ yathāthajināṣāḍhadharaḥ pragalbavāgjvalanniva brahmamayena tejasā | viveśa kaścijjaṭilastapovanaṃ śarīrabandhaḥ prathamāśramo yathā|| ityata ārabhya, ito gamiṣyāmyathaveti vādinī śramālasā ca stanabhinnavalkalā| svarūpamāsthāya ca tāṃ kṛtasmitassamālalambe vṛṣarājaketanaḥ|| iti yāvat| atrahi tamātitheyībahumānapūrvayā saparyayā pratyudiyayā pārvatī | bhavanti sāmye'pi niviṣṭacetasāṃ niviṣṭatasāṃ vapurviśeṣeṣvatigauvāḥkriyāḥ|| ityādeḥ prakaraṇāntasya kathāśarīratvamavagamyate | varṇako yathāsaṃbhṛtaṃ maṇḍaḍḍatdhnamaṅgayaṣṭeranāsavākhyaṃ karaṇaṃ madasya | kāmasya puṣpavyatiriktamastraṃ bālyātparaṃ sā'tha vayaḥ prapede|| ityata ārabhya, sarvopamādravyasamuñcayena yathāpradeśaṃ viniveśitena| sānirmitā viśvasṛjā prayatnādekasthasaundaryadiddakṣayeva|| iti yāvat| atrahy unmīlitaṃ tūlikayeva citraṃ sūryāṃśubhirbhinnamivāravindam| babhūva tasyāścatuśraśobhi vapurvibhaktaṃ navayauvanena|| ityādeḥ prakaraṇārthasya pārvatīrūpayauvanalāvaṇyavarṇanādyavagamyate | kalpitaṃ dvidhā śābhāsaṃ nirābhāsaṃ ca | tayo ssābhāsaṃ yathābhūdabhūmiḥ pratipakṣajanmanāṃ bhiyāntanūjastapanadyutirditeḥ| yamindraśabdārthaniṣūdanaṃ hare hiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipuṃ pracakṣate|| ityata ārabhya, yathopapatticchalavāparoparāmavāpya śailūṣa ivaiṣa bhūmikām| turohitātmā śisupālasaṃjñayā pratīyate saṃprati so'pyasaḥparaiḥ|| iti yāvat |atrabi vinodamicchannatha darpajanmano raṇena kaṇḍḍḍatdhvāsnnidaśaissamaṃ punaḥ| sarāvaṇo nāma nikāmabhūṣaṇaṃ babhūva rakṣaḥ kṣatarakṣaṇaṃ divaḥ|| ityādiprakaraṇārthaḥ kalpito'pi purāṇeṣūpalambhāsaṃbhavāñca tathātvenāvabhāsate | nirābāsaṃ yathā tataḥ kirātādhipateraladhvīmājikriyāṃ vīkṣya vivṛddhamanyuḥ| sa tarkayāmāsa viviktatarkaściraṃ vicinvanniva kāraṇāni|| ityata ārabhya, iyaṃ ca durvāramahārathānāmākṣipya kīrtiṃ mahātāṃ balānām| śaktirmamāvasyati hīnayuddhe saurīva tārāpatidāmni dīptiḥ|| iti yāvat|| atrahi, madastrutisyāmitagaṇḍaḍḍatdhsekhāḥ krāmantivikrāntanarādhirūḍhāḥ| sahiṣṇavo neha yudhāmabhijñā nāgā nagocchrāyamivotkṣipantaḥ|| ityādiḥ prakaraṇārthaḥ tāpasakirātayuddhavarṇanāyāmanābhāsamānaḥ kāvyakuśalena kavinā podṛdvāreṇopakathyate | ākasmikaṃ dvidhā śabūjaṃ virvījaṃ ca | tayossabūjaṃ yathāthopariṣṭāt bhramaraibhrramadbhiḥ prāksūcitāntaḥsalilapraveśaḥ| nirdhautadānāmalagaṇḍaḍḍatdhbhittirvanyassaritto gaja unmamajja|| ityata ārabhya, ithaṃ tayoradhvani daivayogādāseduṣossakhyamacintyahetu| eko yayau caitrarathapradeśānsaurājyaramyānaparo vidarbhān|| iti yāvat| atrahi gāndharvamastraṃ tadataḥ pratīcchaprayogasaṃhāravibhaktamantram| prasvāpanaṃ nāma yataḥ praharturnacārihiṃsā vijayaśca haste|| iti bījam| yasyāgrataḥ, priyaṃvadānpraptamatha priyārhaḥ prāyuṅkta rājasvadhirājasūnuḥ| gāndharvamastraṃ kusumāstrakāntaḥ prasvāpanaṃ svapnanivṛttasaulyaḥ|| iti phalamupalabhyate | nirbījaṃ yathā sandhyābhrakapiśastatra virādho nāma rākṣasaḥ| atiṣṭhanmārgamāvṛtya rāmasyendoriva grahaḥ || ityābhya, taṃ viniṣpiṣya kākutsthau purā dūṣayati sthalīm| gandhenāśucinā ceti vasudhāyāṃ nicakhnatuḥ|| iti yāvat| atrahi sa jahāra tayormadhye maithilīṃ lokaśoṣaṇaḥ| nabhonabhasyayorvṛṣṭa avagraha ivāntare|| ityādeḥ prakaraṇārthasyāgrataḥ phalānupalambhādākasmikasyāpi nirbījatvamavagamyate| tadidamarthatastridhā | prakaraṇamabhihitam | eta śabdato'pi tridhaivābhidhīyata ekavākyamanekavākyamekānekavākyaṃ ca | tatrekavākyaṃ dvidhā śānubandhaṃ niranubandhaṃ ca | tayossānubandhaṃ yathā sa mārutusamānītamahauṣadhihṛtavyathaḥ | laṅkāstrīṇāṃ punaścakre vilāpācāryakaṃ śaraiḥ|| iti niranubandhaṃ yathā te himālayamāmantrya punaḥ prapya ca śūlinam| siddhaṃ cāsmai nivedyārthaṃ taddhisṛṣyāḥ khamudyayuḥ|| anekavākyaṃ dvidhādyupasaṃhṛtamantopalaṃhṛtaṃ ca | tayorādyupasaṃhṛtaṃ yathā tasminkṣaṇe pauravavilāsinīnāmīśānasaṃdarśanalālasānām| prāsādamālīsu babhūvuritthaṃ tyaktvānyakāryāṇi
