viceṣṭitāni|| ityata ārabhya, tāsāṃ mukhai rāsavagandhagarbhai vryāptavantarāssāndrakutūhasānām| vilolanetrabhramarairgavākṣaśrā ssahastrapatrābharayaṇā ivāsan|| antopasaṃhṛtaṃ yathā sthāne tapo duścarametadarthamaparṇayā pelavayābhitaptam| yā dāsyamapyasya labheta nārī sā syātkṛtārthā kimutāṅkaśayyām|| ityārabhya, ityauṣadhiprasthavilāsinīnāṃ śrṛṇvan kathāḥ śrotrasukhāstrinetraḥ| keyūracūrṇīkṛtalājamūṣiṭa rhimālayasyālayamāsasāda|| iti yāvat| ekānekavākyaṃ dvidhā śarvamanāmayojitaṃ vibhaktiyojitaṃ ca | tayossarvavanāmayojitaṃ yathāstyuttarasyāṃ diśi devatātmā himālayo nāma nagādhirājaḥ| ityarabhya, yajñāhgayonitvamavekṣya yasya sāraṃ dharitrīdharaṇakṣamaṃ ca | prajīpatiḥ kalpitayajñabhāgaśśailādhipatyaṃ svamanvātiṣṭhat|| iti yāvat| vibhaktiyojitaṃ yatā nirvanāṇabhiyiṣṭhamathā'sya vīryaṃ mandhakṣayantīva vapurguṇena| anuprayātā vanadevatābyāmadṛśyata sthāvararājakanyā|| ityata ārabhya, sugandhiniśvāsavivṛddhatṛṣṇaṃ bimbādharāsannacaraṃ devirepham| pracikṣaṇaṃ saṃbhramaloladṛṣṭi līlāravindena nivārayantī|| iti yāvat| etonaitavyatireko'pi vyākhyātaḥ | yathāhape .... tivavagāsaalaja abkamaṇavaṣḍhi amahāsi haraṃ ṇivṭhavi adakhkhiṇadisaṃ sesadi sāmuha pahāvi akhkhasuvalaṃ || ityata ārabya, tubga aḍhobjharamuhale jansa akasaṇigaṃḍa, se| labdhaṃ tīṇaṇapavto tisavaguṇa siḍiḍḍatdhlabtaṇaṃ anurāo|| ityāśvāsakaparisamāptiryāvaditi| nanu varṇasamūhaḥ padaṃ, padasūho vākyaṃ, vākyasūhaḥ prakaraṇamityacakṣate | tatkathamucyate ekavākyaṃ prakaraṇamāntaravākyaṃ prakaraṇamati? ucyate, eva praṣṭavyāḥ uñcaricapradhvaṃ sināmanarthakānāṃ ca varṇāṃnāṃ samūhasya padatvamarthavattayā varṇayanti | vayaṃ tvekārthaparaḥ padasamūho vākyamitayeva pratijānīmahe |tatra padairapi vākyamārabhyate, vākyairapi ca prakaraṇamārabhyate | padairapi ca prakaraṇaiḥ prabandhaṃ ārabhyate| vākyaiḥ padairapi ca taiśca vākyeṣvāpi vākyāni bhavanti| yathā kanyārantamayonijanma bhavatāmāste vayaṃ cārthino | ratnaṃ yatkkacidasti tatparaṇamatyasāmāsu śakrādāpi| | kanyāyāśca parārthataiva hi matā tasyāḥ pradānādahaṃ | bandhurve bhavitī pulastyapulahapraṣṭhāśca saṃbandhinaḥ|| prakaraṇeśvapi prakaraṇāni yathendumatīsvayaṃvare magadheśvarādirājavarṇanādīni | pravandheṣvapi prabandhā yathottaracaritādau garbhanāṭakādīni | yadi vākyameva padasamūhaḥ, kathamāha mahāvārakyepaniṣadācāryo daṇḍī, taiśvarīraṃ ca vākyānāmalaṅkāraśca darśitaḥ| śarīraṃ tāvadiṣṭarthavyavācchinnā padāvalī || iti| vidhiniṣetadhajhāvagatiheturmahāvākyaṃ prabandhaḥ | titrtridhā padyaṃ gadyaṃ ca miśraṃ ca | teṣu cchandogataṃ padyaṃ, dhandastu tridhākṣaracchandomātrācchandogaṇacchandaśceti| tānyapi pratyekaṃ tridhā samārdhasamāviṣamabhedāt| tatrākṣaracchandassamaṃ yathāśuśśiśāno vṛṣabho na ighmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām| sakrandano'nimiṣa eka vīraśśatasenā ajayatsākamindraḥ|| ardhasamaṃ yathā navonavo bhavati jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturūṣasāmetyagre| bhāgaṃ devebhyo vidadhātvayāyan pracandramāstiriti dārghamāyuḥ|| viṣamaṃ yathā na nūnamasti noścaḥ kastadvedayadadbhutam| anyasya cittamabhisaṃvareṇyamutārdhataṃ vinaśyati|| pūrvoktodāharaṇatrayamapi vaidikaviṣayameva| mātrācchandassamaṃ yathā vā onavuvnabupajimu navidavkhiṇuvahaivaṇenakabbunapādhamapādamajhahai| koilamoramārālavhakolanavāharai māenajāṇaṃ imāhahe keva virahiṇī marai|| ardhasamaṃ yathā diṇahadivavṭhaho iti sa uppivjaiu surevo | avaraṇeha mihai gharūmādālavca hi dūre|| viṣamaṃ yathā jaivivgavḍaḍḍatdhhījai vivabḍuḍḍatdhravhu pahuduvgamutaru arahījai vigahaṇesūru| viṇadīsai ito isu purisu vasadi jahīte dhuvavṭhaharahava avṭhadi|| gaṇacchandassamaṃ yathā rajojuṣe janmani stavavṛttaye sthitau prajānāṃ pralaye tamasspṛśate| ajāha sargasthitināśahetave trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ|| ardhasaṃ yathā vapuṣā parameṇa bhūdharāṇāmatha saṃbhāvya parākramaṃ bibhede | ajāya vilokayāñcakāra sthiradaṃṣṭrāṅkamukhaṃ narendrasūnuḥ|| viṣamaṃ yathātha vāsavasya vacanena suciravānastrilocanam| klāntirahitambhirādhayutuṃ vidhivattapāṃsi vidadhe dhanañjayaḥ|| tadetatrtrividhāmapi mahākāvyetihāsaśrutyādiṣu ca ddaśyete| acchandadaḥ padasamatāno gadyam| tatrtridhā vṛttagandhi cūrṇamutkalikāprāyaṃ ca | teṣu padyagandhavaddhṛttagandhi, katrtridhā śamā(rdha)samaviṣamabhedāt | teṣu samāgaṇacchandogandhi yathā patā .... ....... vāsiṣviti|| ardhasamagaṇacchandogandhi yathā kramamāracayya ca mahendraśāsanāt svayamutpapāteti|| evaṃ mātrākṣaracchandopi draṣṭavyaḥ| | na viṣamagaṇacchandogandherūdāharaṇamatra| anāviddhalalitapadaṃ carṇam, tatrtridhā gurubahulaṃ, laghubahulaṃ, miśraṃceti| tatra gurubahulaṃ yathā trailokyaikapradīpasya bhagavatassaraśmerarciśśikhāsnāvaniṣṭyūto'ñcarāśirvi śārvara stomastyāyate| laghubahulaṃ yathā vyapagaghanapaṭalaḍḍḍatdhlanidhajhisadṛśavapurambaratalaṃ vilokyate| miśraṃ yathā mahābhāgasuśliṣṭacaguṇatayā ramaṇīya eṣa sanniveśaḥ | kutūhalinū ca no bhartṛdārikā vartate, yatastasyāmabhinavo vicitraḥ kusumeṣuvyāpāra iti| alalitāviddhaṃ vākyamutkalikāprāyam| tadapi tridā lalitāviddhapadākyaṅedāt| tatra lalitaṃ yathāyaṃ lalāṭataṭaghaṭivikaṭatīnāśatoraṇo triśūlāyamānabhūṣaṇabhrukuṭiḥ kruddho bhīmasena ita evābhivartate| aviddhapadaṃ yathā eso khu vajjanigghādadārūṇacapeḍāmoḍi, pāḍiḍḍatdhdāne aṇaraturagamaja galiggārabhaparidalagihāgaṃbhūra gāṃgirolaṃ ligablūrama saṃdassadaṃbhapaḍiḍḍatdhkhābho ahesavi a ṇaṇṭhā ṇaṇṭhavidā avṇaḍaḍḍatdhṇaṇihā oduṃ sadīlo kaaṃta līlāidaṃ karegai| yasya ca madakalakarikumbhapīṭhapāṭanāmāṭarato lagrasthūlamuktāphalena dṛḍhamuṣṭinipūḍaḍḍatdhnānniṣṭhyūtadhārāḍaḍḍatdhlabindudantureṇeva kṛpāṇena kṛṣyamāṇā subhaṭoraḥ kavāṭapuṭikavacasahamtrāndhakāramadhyavartinī karikaraṭaṭagalimadajalāsāradurdināsvabhisārikeva samaraniśāsu samīpamasakṛdājagāma rājalakṣmīḥ | tadetatrtravidhamapi ākhyāyukāsu kathāsu madhumallikādiṣu dṛśyante| gadyapadyavyāyogo miśram| tatrtrividhamapi ākhyāyukāsu kathāsu madyapradhānaṃ, gadyapradāvanaṃ, tulyarūpaṃ ceti| padyapradhānaṃ tridā, sajātīyena vijātīyenobhābhyāṃ ca | tatra sajātīyenetihāsubhāṣitakośādau, vijātīyena prasthānasetubandhanavivaraṇādau, ubhābhyāṃbhāratīyadaśarūpakalakṣaṇādāvasya prayogo dṛśyate| gadyapradhānamapi tadvadeva tridhā tatra sajātīyena pañcatantra cakeṭa ... dau | (agna mūīlamātṛkākośe granthapātaḥ |) vijātīyena kātyāyanīya pāṇināya prākṛtalakṣaṇādau, ubhābhyāṃ mayūraśukamārjārikādāvasya prayogo dṛśyate| tulyarūpamapi trdaiva sajātīyābhyāṃ vijātīyābhyāṃ sajātīyavijātīyābhyāṃ ceti| tatra sajātīyābhyāṃ campū .. mīkṣāsa...kādau |(atra mūlamātṛkākośe granthapātaḥ|), vijātīyābhyamapi mārasambagovindākhyānākādau sajātīyavijātīyābhyāṃ nāṭakanāṭikādi vidagdhamukhamaṇḍaḍḍatdhnādāvasya prayogo dṛśyate| prakṛtyādivibhāgena saiṣa dvādaśadhā sthitaḥ| arthāvāsāyaprasavanimittaṃ śabda ucyate|| nanu ca varṇasamūhaśśabda iti vaktavye kimarthamucyate prakṛtyādayaśśabdā iti? yadāha kaḥ punasśabda iti gakāraikāravivarjanīyā iti bhagāvānupavarpaḥ| naiṣaṃ, arthamarthāvasāyaprasavanimittaṃ śabdaḥ iṣyate| atha gauriti na prasavādinimitteṣu jātikriyāgum̐dravyādīnāṃ kaḥ śabdaḥ, yenoñcāritena arthaḥ pratīyate, tarhi varṇā eva śabdaḥ| uñcariteṣu hi gakāraukāravisarjanīyeṣu gauriti sāsnādimānarthaḥ pratīyate, satyametat| kintu varṇaḥ pratyayanimittamekaikāśo vā syuḥ, samuditā vā| nutpatteḥ, utpannasya ca kṣaṇādūdhrvamanavasthānāt ḥ abhivyaktipakṣekrameṇaivābhivyakteḥ, abhivyaktyanantarameva ca vāyubhistirodhānāt kathaṃ samudāyaḥ ekasmṛtyupārūḍhānāṃ ca varṇānāṃ vācakatave kramasmaraṇe nyaminimittabhāvāt | uktakrameṇa ca smaraṇadarśanāt sarorasa iti pratīyateraviśeṣaḥ prāpnoti| vaktubhede cārthapratyayaprasaṅgaḥ | ato na varṇāśśabdaḥ, kuntu varṇasamūhābhivyaṅgyasphoṭalakṣaṇoktārthātmā śabda iti | sa eva sphuṭatyasmādartha ityarthāvasāyaprasavanimittamiṣyate| kathaṃ tarhi śabdaṃ kuru, mā śabdaṃ kārṣīḥ, śabdakāryayaṃ māṇavakaṃ iti dhvaniṃ kurvannucyate? abhivyañjakābhivyaṅgyayorabedopacārāt| nanvabhivyañcakatvāt| kiṃ punarvarṇāssarvathaiva nārthavantaḥ? pṛthaktvena tāvannārthavantaḥ, na hi phrativarṇamarthā upaladyante| nanu ca dhātuprātipadikapratyayanipāteṣūpalabhyante dhātuṣu iṇ eti, ṛ iyartīti, prātipadikeṣu a śśārṅī, u brahmeti, pratyayeṣu bhrame dhūḥ bhūḥ, prāgdīvyato'ṇ kāpaṭava iti, nipāteṣu a avehi, u upaskaroti | naite varṇāḥ, apitu śabdābhivyaktiretava ekavarṇā ekadhvanihetavaśśabdavācyāḥ, na tūpacārato'pi varṇasamūhaśśabdaḥ| naivam, arthābhivyāktihetuśśabdaḥ, śabdābhivyāktihetudhrvaniḥ| sa tu kaścidekavarṇaḥ, kaścidanekavarṇaḥ, ekasminneva vā samūhāropaṇaṃ sāmathryātilayāt yathaikāpūpīti | yadi hyekasminnapūpe samūho nāropyatesa samūhābhāvādekāpūpa ityeva syāte, na tvekāpūpīti| kathaṃ punarekasmin samūhāropaṇaṃ? vyapadeśivadbhāvāt | anyathā anupāya aretyādau prathamatvekāctvayorabhāvāt dvivacanābhāvaḥ | yadyevamanye'pi varṇāssamūhāropaṇenaiva dhvanayo bhavitumarhanti? nārhanti, kutaḥ, śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāt| yathā samānāmīhamānānāmadhīvānānāṃ ca kecidarthairyujyante, tathā dhātuprātipadikapratyayanupātā evaikavarṇāssamūhāropaṇenaivārthavattvānānāṃ dhvanivyapadeśaṃ labhyante, na punaranyeḥ| svābhāvikaṃ caitat| na ca svabhāvāḥ paryanuyogamarhanti, itastahryārthavanto varṇāḥ| varṇavyatyaye varṇaviparyaye varṇāpāye varmopajane varṇavikāre vā'rthāntaraṃ gamyate| varṇavyasyaye kūpaḥ, sūpaḥ, yūpaḥ, iti| varṇaviparyaye kamalaṃ, lamakaḥ, malakaḥ, iti| varṇāpāye śamakaḥ maśakaḥ, iti| varṇopajane akṣaḥ, plakṣaḥ, pakṣaḥ, iti| varṇavikāre nīraṃ, nīlaṃ, nīḍaḍḍatdhmiti | tatra kūpa iti kakāreṇa kaścidartho gamyate, sūpa iti sakāravyatyaye'rthāntaraṃ, yūpa iti tu sakārasya kakārasya vā yakārasya vyatyaye kūpāt sūpāñcārthāntaramiti | tena manyāmahe yaḥ kūpe kūpārthassa kakārasya, yassūpe sūpārthassa sakārasya, yo yūpe yūpārthassa yakārasyeti| yadi tu samudāyasyāyamartho bhavate, kūpādisamudāyasya yūpādiṣu bhūyatastvādbhāūyiṣṭhaḥ kūpārthassūpe syāt, sūpārthaśca kūpe, kūpārthaśca yūpe, yūpārthaśca kūpe, sūpārthaśca yūpe, yūpārthaśca sūpa iti, evaṃ vurṇaniparyaye'pi kramotkramayossamudāyāviśeṣāt, kamalaḥ, malakaḥ, lamakaḥ, iti pratyayāviśeṣaḥ prāpnoti| na hi tatra tebhyo daśāntayabhyo vā taṭaparicchede palāśataḥ khadirato vā nā'vadhāraṇe samudāyasya bhedo bhavati, varṇāpāye'pyekādyavayavavirahe samudāyasyānanyatvāt, maśakaḥ, śakaka iti pratyayaviśeṣo na syāt| na hi sūnodbhede keśodgame vā yuvativyakteranyatāyuktimatī, evaṃ varṇavikāre'pi nīraṃ nīlaṃ nīḍaḍḍatdhmiti nārthāntarapratīti rjāyeta| na hyavalite valivati rañjatakeśapāśe vā viṣṇumitrādeḥ svarūpānyatvaṃ bhavati| varṇavyatyayaviparyayāpāyopajanavikāreṣu cārthāntaradarṣanānmanyāmahe arthavanto varṇā iti| varṇārthavatve hi varṇavyatyayaviparyayāpāyopajanavikārāḥ kāraṇamarthāntaropalabdherjāyante| atrāpi brūmaḥ ya etetvayā varṇānārthavattāyāṃ hetava upanyastā varṇavyatyayādayaḥ teṣu kūkapassūpo yūpa iti saṅghātāntarāṇyevaite arthāntare ca vartante| yadi hi varṇavyatyayādikṛtarthāntaragamanaṃ syāt bhūyiṣṭhaḥ kūparthassūpe syāte kakāramātrasyaiva vyatyayāt| sūpārthaśca kūpa iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa| yatastu na kiṃcit kūpādīnāṃ sūpādiṣvato'nvayāvānmanyāmahe saṅghātāntarāṇyevaitāvanyarthantereṣu vartanate iti, etena varṇaviparyayādayo'pi vyākhyatāḥ| tānyapi hi arthāntaravartīni saṅghātāntarāṇyeveti | idaṃ khalvapi bhavatā varṇānāmarthavattāṃ bruvatā sādhīyo'narthakatvaṃ dyotitam| yo hi manyate yaḥ kūpe kūpārthaḥ sa kakārasyopaśabdastasyānarthakatvaṃ syāt| nanu ca samudāyasyārthavatve samudāyasyaikadeśasya vināśe samudāyasya kārayamābhāve kāryābhāvaḥ iti vināśo vā'bhyupeyate, chinnakarṇapucchaśvanyāyādapi vināśo vā kiñcātaḥ, vināśapakṣe samudāyābhāvādarthābhānaprasaṅgaḥ| pakṣāntare'pi sa evārtho na tvarthāntaram, tataśca kathaṃ ślokaḥ śokaḥ, lokaḥ, okaḥ, kaḥ, ityarthāntarapratītiḥ uktamatra | samudāyāntaraṇyevaitānyarthāntareṣu vartante | bhavedetat yatrārthāntaraṃ gamyate| yatra tu sa eva so'rthastatra kathaṃ, yathodakaṃ, dakaṃ, kaṃ, iti | imānyapi saṅghātāntarāṇyevaikārthavṛttīni, yathā kunduḥ, koṣṭhaḥ, kusūlaḥ, iti kramāttasya cārthavattāṃ bruvatā tvayaiva dakārokārāṇyerānarthakyamuktaṃ bhavati| kaścaivamāha varṇavyatyayaviparyayāpāyopajanavikāreṣvarthāntararśanameva, yataḥ śyāmā, rāmā, vāmā, iti varṇavyatyayo nārthavyatyayaḥ| tarkaḥ, sikatā, siṃha iti varṇaviparyayo nārthaviparyayayaḥ| santi, syanti, ghnantīti varṇāpāyo nārthāpāyaḥ| āsthāt, avocat, sañcaskāreti varṇopajano nārthopajanaḥ| ghātāyati, kṣaṇoti, ropayatīti varṇavikāro nārthavikāraḥ| tena manyāmahe varṇavyatyayādiṣvaṣyanarthāntaragamānādanarthakā eva varṇā iti| itastahryarthavanto varṇāḥ, yadeṣāṃ saṅghatā arthavantaḥ| yoṣāṃ hyavayavā arthavantasta eva samudāyādarthavantaḥ, tadyathaikaścakṣiṣamān paśyati, tatsamudāyaśśatamapi paśyati| ekatilastailaṃ prasūte, ttasamudāyaḥ khārīśatamapi prasūte| yeṣāṃ punaravayavāḥ nārthavantastatsamudāyā api nārthavantaḥ | tadyathaiko'ndho na paśyati, śatamapyandhānāṃ na paśyati | ekā sikatā tailaṃ na prasūte, tatsamudāyaḥ khāriśatamapi na prasūta iti| naivam, atadarthenāpyavayavenāvayavino'rthasadbhāvo dṛśyate| yathaikastaṇḍuḍḍatdhlaḥ kṣatpratighāte'samarthaḥ, tatsamudāyaśca vardhitakaṃ samarthamiti | naivaṃ bhavati| tatra pratyokamapi kiyateyapyarthamātrā ime punarvarṇā atyantāyaivānarthakāḥ yathā tarhi yarathāṅgāni vihitāni tāni pratyekaṃ vrajikriyā'samarthāni, tatsamudāyasca rathassamartha iti| evameṣāṃ varṇānāṃ samudāyāśśabdābhivyaktihetavo'rthavantaḥ avayavāstvanarthakā iti| ataḥ sthitametat prakṛtipratyayādivarṇajanitadhvanisamūbo'bhivyaṅgyasphoṭalakṣaṇo|rthātmā'rthāvasāyaprasavanimittaṃ śabdaḥ| tadviśeṣāśca prakṛtyādisphoṭaḥ padasphoṭo vākyasphoṭa iti| yobhūdityādikaśśabdo bhavatītyādikaśca yaḥ| bhūrastītyādiko yaśca sa sphoḍaḍḍatdhṭaṃ nātivartate|| pratipādyo nivatryaśca pratipādaka eva ca | tridhā sphoṭassaphūṭatyamādato'rthāste ghaṭādayaḥ|| uktaḥ kramāt dvādaśabhedabhinnaśśabdaprapañco'yamanādisiddhaḥ| athārthamatryā'sya vivartamādyaṃ tāvatprakāraṃ pratipādayāmaḥ|| iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevavicite śṛṅgāraprakāśe prakṛtyādiśabdaprakāśo nāmā tṛtīyāḥ prakāśaḥ|| <4> cadurthaḥ kriyādyarthacaṭatuṣṭayaprakāśaḥ tatra prakṛtyādiśabdapratyayyāḥ kriyākālakārakapuṣopādhipradhānopaskārārthaprātipadikārthavṛttayarthapadārthavākyārtharūpā dvādaśa bhedāḥ | teṣu kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā, tāṃ dhātvarthaḥ ityāmananatti| dhātavaśca tredhāstyarthāḥ, bhavatyarthāḥ, karotyarthāśca | tatra yeṣāṃ kartāri udāsate te astyārthāḥ, yathāsti vidyate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi| yeṣāṃ vikurvate te bhavatyarthāḥ, yathā bhavati saṃjāyate vardhate dhriyate tiṣṭhati āste vartate ityādi| yeṣāṃ prayuñjate te karotyarthāḥ, yathā karoti vidhatte janayati nirvartayat sādhayati utpādayati| tatra astikarotibhavatīnāṃ sāmyāvāsthānānnirvikāramanādyantaṃ śabdabrahmetyācakṣate | tathaivaṃdhinekārthavācino bhavatinaivomiti vyapadiśanti| tasya yadā astitāheturavidyānibandhano'vidyānibandhano'vipariṇāmarūpaḥ prathamavikāro'stirudayate| tadā asternāstipratiyogitvādistityekamevaitadubhayathāpi prathāmayate| yannāsti tadbhavāmiti cāpekṣāyāṃ, tadbhāvato'sya bhavati nāma dvitīyavikāraḥ pariplavate| tato yadbhavati tasya tasya cānyat bhavato mithyābhiniveśānmithaḥ prayojyaprayojaktavaṃ saṃbhāvayatisaṃjñakaḥ tṛtīyavikāraṃkarotirityākhyāyate| evaṃ cāsmitāpekṣābhiniveśaurdūraviprasṛtāmavidyāyāṃ eṣāmapi viśeṣaviśeṣato dūrīkṛtā vidyā, vidyati, janipacādayaḥ prādurbhavanti| tadāha, kṛbhvastayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ kriyāviśeṣavacanāḥ pacādaya iti | te'mī sarve'pi dhātvarthabhedāḥ saṃbhedate mithassaṅyānamativartante, na tu kṛbhvastirūpatām| nanu ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyāḥ sa ca kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ, kārakeṣu ca svatantraḥ kartā, karturīpsitatamaṃ karma, sādhakatamaṃ karaṇaṃ, ādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ, karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānaṃ, dhruvamapāye'pādānaṃ, tebhyo'nyastadavivanakṣā vā śeṣaḥ, kakartuḥ prayojako heturiti katrādibhyo vyatiriktamarthāntaraṃ nopalabhyate yat kriyeti pratīyate ucyate asti kriyā kintu katrrā kintu katrrādibhyaḥ pṛthāgākhyātumaśakyaṃ, anāpannasatvabhāvāt| anirluṭhitadarbhavat yathā rbho'nāpanna, tvābhavaḥ kalalāvasthaāyāmāśayataḥ pṛthagākhyātuṃ na śakyate, tathā kriyā'pi sādhanebhyassādhyāvasthāyaṃ | tadyatā jayotiḥ prakāśate, labdo dhavanati iti| khathaṃ tarhi asti jñāyate kārakasannidhāne'pi pacatīti prakhyopākhyayorbhāvābhāvābhyāṃ, iha khalu yatsannidāne yasya bāvābhāvau, tasya tato'nyaniīmittāpekṣitatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ | yathā agnighaṭayossanndhāne bhavatāmabhavatāṃ ca tatsanniyogāpekṣitatvaṃ pākajānāṃ, katrrādi ca sannidhāne ca kadācidbhavatītyetadbhavati, kadācinna pacatīti dṛśyate, tena manyāmahe nūnamasti śaktiśaktimadbhayo'nyaśśaktirdharmo yadbhāāvādime prakhyopākhye pravartate, yadabhāvāñca na pravarteteti siddhamastitvaṃ kriyāyāḥ, itaścāstikriyāsādhyamantareṇa sādhanānupapannaḥ | yañaṭhca sādhyaṃ sā kriyā | tadāha saṃhṛtya kārakairya eko'rtho|bhinirvatryate sā kriyā| kriyānimittaṃ kārakamiti, tathā ca kriyāsu svecchayā kārakādīni yaḥ prayuṅkte, na tu taiḥ prayujyate sa kartā, kartuḥ kriyāyā'nyayā yadāpyate tatkarma, kriyāsiddhau sādhakatamatvena yadavyavahitaṃ vyāpriyate tatkaraṇaṃ, katrrā karmaṇā vā vyavahitaḥ kriyādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ, kriyākāryatvenāvadhāritaṃ karmaṇā seyogaṃ yadanubhavati tatsaṃpradānaṃ, katrrā karmaṇā vā kriyājanmeva dhrauvyena yadvibhāgāmavagāhate tadapādānam, śrūyamāṇakriyāpadopakriyākṛtaḥ kārakāṇāmakārakāṇāṃ ca saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ | sa śeṣaḥ kurvantamevājñāpradānādinā yaḥ kriyāyāṃ niyuṅkte, sa tatprayojako hetuḥ kartā ca bhavati| evaṃ ca yathā kāṣṭhādayo lākṣādikamapekṣamāṇā eva mithassaṃvandhayacogyatātāmunubhavanti tathā mithassaṃyogo viyogaśca na syāt| taduktaṃ yāvaddevadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyeti| astu nāma kriyā, kārakebhyastu tasyāḥ kathaṃ vyatirekaḥ? na ca bhavanto'pi kriyākārakayovryatirekaṃ na manyante | tadyathā corasya rujati, corasyāmayati iti| ucyate vyatiriktaiva kārakebhyaḥ kriyā, anekasyaikavyapadeśanimittatvāt| iha yadyasyānekavyapadeśanimittaṃ tattebhyonyat| yathā vyakterjātiḥ kārakamityapadetadvayāpadeśanimittaṃ cānekasya katrrādeḥ kriyā, tasmāttatonyetyanugamyatvāt | iha yairyadanugamyate tattebhyo'nyat, yathā narebhyo rājābhigamyate'nugamyate ca | kriyākārakairatastato'nayeyam, janyatvenopalambhāt | yajjānyatayā yadupalabhyate tattato'nyate | yathā pituḥ putra upalabhyate kriyākārakajanyakatvena tasmāttato'nyā upalabdhāvanupalabdheḥ, iha yasyopalabdhau yasyānupalabdhiḥ tattato'nyāthā, rūpādrasaḥ sūryasya copanagaterupalabdhiḥ tasyāstato'nyathā | asti cāsyāsau deśāntarabrāpteḥ, sā'pi dṛṣṭā tathāvāpaṣyātaḥ parāvṛtyā darśanāt | pramāṇāntaragrahyatvāt | iha yadyasmātpramāṇāntareṇa gṛhyate tattato'nayat, yathā śarīrādātmā | pramāṇāntaragrāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ, tasmāttato'nyā | bahuviviktatvenābhidhānāt, iha yadvahūbhyaḥ praviviktamekatvenābhidhīyate | ttateto'ncat, yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ | abhidhīyate bahvāśritāpi pravivekaikatvena kriyā, yathā hrāhmaṇairāsyata iti tasmāttato'nyā| anāvṛttāvāvṛtteḥ, ihayasminnavartamāne yadāvartate tattato'nyat yathā hastinokterjātiḥ kārakamityekatyāpadeśanimittaṃ cainekasya katrrādeḥ kriyā, tasmāttatonyetyanugamyatvāt | iha yairyadanugamyate tattebhyo'nyat, yathā narebhyo rājābhigamyate'nugamyate ca | kriyā kārakairatastato'nyeyam, jnayatvenopalambhāt | yajjanyatayā yadupalabhyate ttatato'nyat | yatha pituḥ putra upalabhyate kriyākārajanyatvena tasmāttato'nyā upalabdhāvanupalabdheḥ, iha yasyopalabdhau yasyānupalabdhiḥ tattato'nyathā, rūpādrasaḥ sūryasya copanagaterupalabdhas tasyāstato'nyathā | asti cāsyāsaudeśāntaraprapteḥ, sā'pi dṛṣṭā tathaivāpaśyataḥ parāvṛtya darśanāt | pramāṇāntaragrāhyātvāt| iha yadyasmātpramāṇāntarema gṛhyate tattato'nyate, yathā śarīrādātmā | pramāṇāntaragrāhyā ca sadāgatau gatiḥ, tasmāttato'nyā | bahuviviktatvenābhidhānāt, iha yadbahubhyaḥ praviviktamekatvenābhidhīyate| tattato'nyat, yathā tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ | abhidhīyate bahvāśritāpi pravivekaikatvena kriyā, yathā brāhmaṇairāsyata iti tasmāttato'nyā | anāvṛttāvāvṛtteḥ, ihayasminnānāvartamāne yadāvartate tattato'nyāt yathā hastino maśakaḥ | āvartate cānāvartamāne kartatari kriyā pañcakṛtvaḥ pacatīti, tasmāttato'nyā, ihobhayorapi saṃśayanirṇayanimittatvāt, ihobhayossaṃśaye yasya yo nirṇayahetuśca puruṣasya calanādikriyā, tasmāttato'nyā | abhidhāyābhidhānāt, iha yadibhadhāyārthāntarā vivakṣāṃ antareṇa yadabhidhīyate tato'nyate, yathā gauraśvaḥ, abhidhīyate ca adhyetā adhīte gantā gacchatīti kārakamabhidhāya kriyā tasmāttato'nyā, paryāyāprasiddheḥ | iha yeṣāmeva paryāyaprasiddhiḥ, teṣāmeva ca tebhyo na bhedaḥ, yathā nirvartiriti| na ca pacannadhīte pacatyadhīta iti pacanūpacatyoḥ paryāyatvam| api pacannadhīta iti kartuḥ pacatīti kriyāyāḥ paryāyayogyatevaṃ, ato'sau tato'nyaḥ | abhinnaśabdābhithadhāne'pi viśeṣāṇāṃ liṅgavacanabhedāt | iha khalu kriyākatrrerabhinnaśabdābhidheyatve'pi tadviśeṣaṇānāṃ liṅgavacanabhedo dṛśyate, yathā śobhanaṃ pacati śobhanaṃ pacataḥ śobhanaṃ pacantīti sācā'rtho bhede bhinnaśabdopādāna eva dṛśyate| taṭaḥ, taṭī taṭaṃ, puṣyaḥ tārakā nakṣatraṃ, rasaḥ apaḥ jalam, dārāḥ kalatraṃ bhāryā, ityādiviśeṣaṇānām | na tūdāhṛtasadṛśeṣviti kriyā karturanyāḥ | śabdāvṛttibhedeṣudvabhedāt | iṅa khalu kriyākārakayośśabdāvṛttibhede buddhibhedo dṛśyate, adhyetā paṭhati, paṭhati, gantā, gantā gacchatīti pūrvayovarvīpsottarayorābhūkṣṇayam| yasya ca yato buddhibhedastattato vyatiriktaṃ yathā mṛdahghadhevanermeghadhvaniḥ, ghaṭadibhyaḥ paṭādayaḥ iti kriyāyāḥ kārakebhyo vyatirekaḥ | siddhe cāsminnabhedadarśanaṃ bhedanavyatirekaścāvivekata eveti draṣṭavyaṃ dṛśyate ca | pratīpapravāhaśśabdaśarīrassaṃskārajñānasukhadiḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnarūpādibhinneṣu abhinnapratyayaḥ pravartate teṣvabhedenaiva tadanukūlo vyapadeśaḥ | corasya rujatītyatra tu rūksādhakasya kraturabhāvāllakāraḥ kartari vartamānā tāmeva rujātīti | asyāyamarthaḥ corasya rūgutpadyata iti kṛtaḥ punariyaṃ kārakakriyayorviśeṣaḥ, tadekatra vīpsā anyatrābhīkṣṇamiti kriyāyā ekatvena vīpsānadhigamāt | bahūnāṃ hi kriyā guṇadravyaiḥ prayokturyugapadyvāptumicchā vīpsā, sā tvekatve kriyāyā nopapadyate iti | nanu ca kriyāyā ekatvaṃ nopapapadyate kālatrayeṇātyantavirodhinā yugapadabhisaṃbandhavyapadeśāt| iha khalu kriyāyā sā kasminnapi kāle kālatrayābhisaṃbandhahetuvryapadeśo dṛśyate, pacati devadattaḥ, apākṣīdyajñadattaḥ, pakṣayati viṣṇumitra iti| tañcaikatve na ghaṭate ityanekā kriyā bhedanibandhānā | ātiśayikatarabādipratyayayogāt | iha khalu kriyāyāḥ pacatitarāṃ pacatitamāmityātiśāyanikapratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ | sa ca dvayorbahūnāṃ ca prakarṣe siddha ityenekriyā ekena yugapadanekādhikaraṇasya nirdhāraṇāt| iha yadekaikasmin kāle anekādhārasthaṃ pṛthaktvenāvadhāryate tadanekaṃ, yathāṅgilūṣu nakhāni nirdhāryante | nirdhāryate cānekādhārakena yugapadnoṣu gatirityanekā kriyā | pūrvakāle'pi pratyayadarśanāt | iha dvayorekakartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvanakāle ktvāpratyayo dṛśyate, yathā bhuktvā bhuṅkte, paktvā pacatīti dvitvaṃ caikatvaṃ pratyanīkamityanekakriyā, yugapallakṣyalakṣaśraṇayogāt | iha kriyāṇāmabhinnakālaṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇayogo dṛśyate | gavi duhyāmānāyāmapi dogdhi, tayaikatve'nupapannamityanekā kriyā pūrvakāle'pi pratyayadharśanāt | iha dvayorekakartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ pūrvakāle ktvāpratyayo dṛśyate, yathā bhuktvā bhiṅkte, paktvā pacati hetugarbhaphalābhāvāt | iha khlavahetuphalayoḥ prasiddho bhedaḥ | sa ca kriyāsu dṛśyate odanaṃ, pacati, śākaṃ pacati, bhuñcāna odanaṃ bhuṅkta iti bedaścaikatvāvidhītyanekā kriyā kriyārthakriyopapadatumunādipratyayotpatteḥ | iha ye tu kriyārthāyayāmupapade tumunādayassmaryante, te ca bhoktuṃ gacchati, pākāya vrajati bhokṣyāmiti pacatiprabhṛtiṣu yathā bhinnadhātuvācyatve'pi dṛśyante, yathā gantuṃ gacti, bhojanāya bhuṅkte, pakṣyāmīti pacatīti| sacāyaṃ tadarthaphalabhāvenaikatva evopapadyata ityanekārthakriyābhihitānabhibitaśaktiprādurbhāvānmittatvāt | iha dhātrrīṃ dhayati, dātreṇa dāti, dāśāya dāśate, bhīmādvibheti, āsate āste, śayane śete, sthāne tiṣṭhati, prāsāde prasīdatīti pratyayavibhaktyordarśanādabhihitānabhihitaśaktiprādurbhāva upalabhyate| sā cānaikyanimittaṃ kriyābedamantareṇa na saṅgacchata ityanekā kriyā bhāvābhidhāne'pi yantrādibhyo dvivacanabahuvacanopalabdhiḥ | iha khalu śuddhe'pi bhāve yantrādibhyaḥ pākau pākāḥ, uṣṭrāsikā āsyaneta, hataśāyikāśśayyanta iti dvivacanabahuvacanopalabdhiḥ | tañca kriyaikatve na yuktamityanekā kriyā kṛdākhyātābhihitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sarvasaṃkhyābahuvacanopalabdhiḥ | tañca kriyaikatvena yuktamityanaikā kriyā kṛdākhyātābhihitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ sravasaṃkhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyāt| iha kṛdabhihitāyā ākhyātābhihitāyāśca kriyāya bhinnārthānābhidhāyibhissaṃkhyāśābdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇaraṇyaṃ dṛśyate| yathaikaḥ pākaḥ dvau pākau bahavaḥ pākāḥ, ekā uṣṭrāsikā āsyate dve āsyete bahnya āsyante | tañcaikatve kriyāyā na sāṃpratamityanekā kriyā iha bhavati nimtṛprabhṛtīnāmavadhṛtabedaparispandāśrayakāryābhinivṛtteḥ iha yāsāṃ kriyāṇāmavacchedakadhātvarthopādhibedatvādanekatvaṃ pratyavivādaḥ, tāsu ye bhedāśrayā dharmāḥ prasiddhāḥ | tadyathā bhoktumicchati, bhavati pacati, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, āmantrayai samājamutsavāmāntrayai iti samānādhātuvācyāsvapidṛśyate, eṣitumicchati, bhavedapi bhavet, syādapi syāt, nimantraye nimantraṇārthamāmantraye āmantraṇārthamiti | tasmādbhedāśrayakāryasaṃbandhādbhavitavyam | anekatvamanekena dhātunā sarvatra bhedenetyanekā kriyā sādhyasādhanabhāvāt | iha sādhyasādhanayoḥ prasiddho bhedaḥ pradṛśyate ca | sādhyasādhanatā kriyāṇāṃ yathā sa imān poṣānapuṣat, tapyate katapastāpasa iti| tañcaikatve na ghaṭate ityanekā kriyā | tadetadanekatve kriyāyāssarvamasādhānaṃ sādhanabhedādevopaṭaritabhedāyā ekatve vā tadupapatterabhinnānāmapyupāśrayādibhedāt | bhinnākārāt pratītadeśavyapadeśaśca dṛśyate | yathendorjaleṣujyotsnājāleṣu jaladharāśāsu diśo vyavasthāsu pṛthakatvasyārtheṣu buddherviṣayeṣu vidyuto'bdeṣu, yathā ca saṃpanno yavo yaveṣu śukatlasturuṣkeṣu vinaṣṭassurādeṣṭreṣu darśanīyostanendaseneṣu akṣiṇī kaliṅgeṣu paṭurbhavān paṭurāsīt paṭutara eṣa mārge kūpo'bhūt kūpo bhaviṣyati priyo manyuste priyo na vayam, maithilī rāmasya dārāḥ, āḥ pavitraṃ varaṇāṃ nagaraṃ śirūṣāḥ rāmaḥ pāñcalāḥ janapadā ityabhinnasyā'pi jātyāderarthabhedasya bhedato vyapadeśaḥ, tathā kriyāyā api kālayogādayaḥ sādhanabhedādbhaviṣyanti, anekādhārasamavetāyāśca yugāṛpadekena grahaṇaṃ jātivahupapadyate | kṛdabhihitānāṃ tu śuddhabhāvānāṃ ākhyātavadbhiḥ kriyābhiḥ dravyavadvaidhyamryādayuktastaddharmopanayaḥ | kṛdabhihito hi bhāvo dravyavatprakāśamāno liṅgasaṃkhyākarmādiśaktīnāmāśrayo bhavati, na tvākhyātavācyāḥ tasyāḥ pariniṣpannatvanenāśrayatvānupapatteḥ | tathāhi, yathā pāko vartate, pacatīti śaktisaṃkhyādiyogaḥ kṛdanteṣu dṛśyate, naiva tiṅnateṣu | nahi bhavati, pacati vartate, pacati paśyatīti, nanu ca bhavati, paśyati, mṛgo dhāvati, utpaśyāmi karmaṇi dvivacanabahuvacanānyudāhiyanta iti dhāvatīnāṃ dṛśi karmatvaṃ kevalaṃ tvaprātidkatvāt supo'nutpattiḥ | tanna, yathā kriyāyāḥ kriyāmāṇatvādeva naisargikaṃ ca bhavati pacati pakṣyati bhavatyapākṣīditi ca dṛśyate | pacādīnāṃ bhavateḥ kartṛtvaṃ, dṛśyate, bhavati paśyati karmatvaṃ dṛśyate, bhavati paśayati karmatvaṃ kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ kramatayā'vagamyate | tadotpadyamānatvādeva gatau kartṛtvamanapi naisargikameva | mṛgo dhāvatītyādau gamyamānetiśabdopasaṃhṛtasya vākyārthasya karmatvaṃ, na kriyāyāḥ | tasmādaśaṅkanīyaḥ kriyāsakartṛśaktiyogā karaṇādiyogāyogābhyāṃ vyaktameva kṛdākhyātābudheyabhāvayormithovaidhamryamiti | tasmādanekārthaviṣayayā vīpsayā'nabhisandhānāt siddhamekatvaṃ kriyāyāḥ | śabdapratyayayorabhedāñca, yatrābhidhānajñānayoḥ atyantamabhedastasyaikatvaṃ siddham, yathā jateḥ pratyekaṃ ca vyaktiviśeṣāṇāṃ, abhinnau ca deśakālau bhede ca kriyāyāḥ śabdapratyayau dṛśyet, yathā ca pacati pacantīti, tasmācchabdapratyayahetuḥ ekā kriyā | nanu ca, jalacandrādidṛṣṭānte bhedavyavahāre sandehaḥ kiṃ sādhanamabedāśrayāṇi kriyāyāḥ kālatrayayogādīni pratyayavyapadeśāni ca bhedakāryāṇyuta sevabhedāśrayāṇīti | atrocyate kriyāyāḥ abhede'pi sāthadhanabhedāt dvivacanabahuvacanotpattessaṃdeho bhāvayaḥ | iha bhedasyābhedapūrvakatvāt bhedamabhyupagatavatāvaśyamabhedobhyupagantavayaḥ, tasya yasyāḥ kriyāyā ekatvamabhyupagamyate tasyāssādhana bhedādṛṣṭo dvivanabahuvacanayogaḥ | yathā paramāṇuṃ pacatiḥ, parāmāṇuṃ pacanti | anekatvābhyupagame ca sādhanasyābhede dṛṣṭamekavacanameva, bhinatti kusūlamiti vacanabhedaḥ | tasmātsādhanabhedānuvidhānāñca kriyāyāḥ, kriyābhedānuvidhānāñca sādhanānāṃ sādhanāśrayāṇi bhedakāryāṇi, kriyāyāḥ na svāśrayāṇīti | kathaṃ tarhi, pacyete odanau pacyante odanā devadatteneti kartṛbhede vacanabhedaḥ? yasmin sādhane lādayo'bhidhīyante? tadbhedamanu dhīyante kriyāyāḥ kriyābhedaṃ sādhanānītyaśaṅkanīyametat | pratīpādiṣu bhedābhedayoranātyantikatvāt jñānābhidhānayorapi tathātve'sti na taivryabhicāraḥ | itaścānekā kriyāyā abhyāvṛttibhāvāt bahusaṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasujādacassmaryante pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte, catuṣpacatīti tañcābheda evopapadyate | na hi devadatte gate, yajñadatte cāyāte punarāvṛta iti vyapadeśo dṛśyate ca | tatraivāyāta ityekā kriyāsamuñcayābāvātad | iha bhinnānāṃ ekaviṣasaṃpāte samuñcayo dṛṣṭaḥ, devadattaseya gauścāśvaśca puruṣaśca devadattasya yajñadattasya viṣṇumitrasya ca gauriti | na ca vakturabhede guḍaḍḍatdhtilaudanādivākyabedāt kriyābhedābhyupagame'pi kriyāsamuñcayo dṛśyate | devadattaḥ paṭhati pacati ceti tasmādekakriyāstavabāvanāpattau pravivekaḥ, ekatvenābhidhānāt | iha kriyā satvabhāvaṃ pratipannā yadā sādhanebhyaḥ pravivicyate, na bhavati tadā dvivacanādiyogaḥ, brāhmaṇairāsyata iti tasmādekā | nanu ca satvabhāve'pyetadupalabhyate yathā guḍaḍḍatdhtilaudanānāṃ pākaḥ, tāmrāḥ palāśeṣu babhūva rāgaḥ, iti tanna, tasyāvyabhicārāt | “yathā nṛpāṇāṃ praṇayāgradūtyo vilāsaceṣṭā vividhā babhūvaḥ ||” vaybhicāre kinnimittamiti cet kṛdabhidhānameva, “kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate | “ dravyasya ca satyapi nānātve saṃbandhibhedādeva bhedāvagatau kkacidabedābhidhānam| ūrumūlacaralekṣaṇamaghgan yairvataṃsakusumaiḥ priyametāḥ | cakrire sapadi tāni yathārthaṃ manmathasya kumumāyudhanāma || yathā ca vedavākyaṃ “yatpaśurmāmakṛtorovā padbhirāhate | “ iti || kkacitpunastadvivakṣāyāṃ bhedenaiva yathā tāsāṃ mukhaurāsavagandhagarbhaivyāptāvantarāssāndrakutūhalānām || iti || brāhmaṇairāsyata iti sravadaikavacanameveti viśeṣaḥ, sādhyatvāt| siddhasya hi vastunassaṃkhyāyaugo yujyate, na sādhyasyāpariniṣpannatvenāśrayatvānupapatteḥ | sādhyāca kriyā prādhānyatayāsmābhirabhidhīyate tasmānna bhedasaṃkhye ityekā | ekaśeṣāt iha yeṣāṃ sarūpaśabdībhidheyānāmanakatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, tadabhidhānānāmekaśoṣo dṛṣṭaḥ | tadyāthā vyaktipakṣe brāhmaṇāḥ puruṣāḥ, iti | na ca brāhmaṇairāsyate, puruṣairgīyata iti kriyāyabhidhānānāmekaśeṣo dṛśyate | sa cāyamekaśeṣo vyāvartamānastvavyāptamanekatvamapi gṛhītvā vyavartata iti ekā kriyā | nanu ca kathaṃmekaśeṣābhāvaḥ na tiṅntānyekaśeṣaṃ prayojanyatīti kā punaratropapattiḥ? kriyāpradhānatvamākhyātānāṃ, tadeva cintyate, iha khalu kriyākārakayoḥ pradhānoparasarjanābhāvena vṛttisaṃsargeṇa catuṣṭayī gatiḥ | kriyā vā kriyāyā nyagbhavanati yathā pācakaḥ pacanīyaṃ, pacanīyaṃ, kriyāyāṃ vā kārakaṃ yathā putrīyati upaślokayati | ākhyāteṣu caiṣāmanyato'pi na prakāraḥ, tatra hi sādhyakriyā'pi prakṛtātamavatī sādhanatantrā savyāpārasādhanā aparisamāptā pacādibhirucyate siddhāni ca sādhanāni tibādibhirabhidhīyanta iti na kasyācitprādhānyaṃ vā pravṛtyuta prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brītaḥ prādhānyeneti pratyayārthasya prādhānyaṃ syāt | evaṃ ca dvivacanabahunavacane api tannibandhane upapadyete, tanna, siddhaṃ sādhyāyopādīyate | siddhāni ca sādhānāni ca tāni parārthamupādīyamānāni śeṣatāṃ labhante | sādhyaṃ tu parāpākareṣu asamarthamātmalasiddhaye'rthāntaramapekṣamāṇaṃ tadvaidhamryāt pradhānabhāvamanubhavati | nanvevaṃ hyekaśeṣābhāvo na sidhyati, na hyekāśeṣabhāve prādhānyena guṇābāvena vā kiñcidāśrīyate | pacādayo hi kriyāvacanāḥ, teṣāmeka evānekasādhanasamavetānekatvena vivakṣitāṃ kriyāmabhidhāsyati | tanna, yadyapyeko dhātuḥ yathoktāṃ kriyāṃ bravīti tathā lakārasyānekakarmakartṛviṣayatvātpratisādhanamupapattāvanekatvaṃ prāpnoti | tadanurodhāñcārthāḥ pradhānāni pratyayebhyo vyāvartanta ityekaśeṣārambhasssayāt | kriyāprādhānyena ekaśabdatvaṃ, sādhanabhedāttu dvavacanabahuvacanayogaḥ | anye tu bruvate yadyekasyāḥ prakṛtessādhanabhede bhinnālaṅkārāḥ prasajyeran, tathā'pi yathaikasthane ekavacanameva dvayordvivacanaṃ bahūnāṃ bhaviṣyantīti | idameva hi dvivacanābahuvacanayoḥ dvivacanabahuvacanatvaṃ, yattadekaśabdarūpemekaśeṣaśabdavadanekārthābhidhāne samarthamiti vyakhyāyate | itaśca kriyāpradhānamākhyātāḥ karotinā praśne nirṇayārthatvāt | kiṃ devadattaḥ karotīti praśne pacatyāste ityuttaraṃ bhavati, ni tvāsakaḥ pācaka iti | na cāyaṃ kartṛpraśnaḥ kiṃ devadatta iti, viśeṣasyābhyantararīkṛtvāt bhinnaliṅgatvāñca | nāpi kramapraśnaḥ anujñāne vyāpārekramapraśnāsaṃbhāvāt | pacati paṭhatīti kartṛviśeṣamantareṇa prativacane praṣṭuḥ kṛtārthatvāt pacati paṭhatīti cākhyātasya ākhyātenāyogāt | yadi sādhanaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt yathā pācakaḥ pacatīti sāmānādhikaraṇyena na yogo bhavati, yathā pacati paṭhatītyatrāpi syāt | na caitadastyataḥkriyāprādhānatvamevākhyātānāṃ kriyāpradhāntavāñca ekaseṣārambhaḥ, tadanārambhādekatvamekatvena vīpsābhāvaḥ, vīpsābhāvañca gantā gantā gacchati gacchatīti śabdāvṛttibhedaḥ buddhibedāñca kriyāyāḥ kārakebhyo vyatireka iti | nanu ca pacati pacataḥ pacantīti dhātvartha evā'yaṃ, na kriyā | tanna, dhātvarthasya pratyayārthasyaivāvacchedakatvāddhātvarthāttu kriyāyāḥ pṛthaktvaṃ sādhyāmānapradhānavyapadeśyatāyāmevaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate | yathaiva tarhi kārakabhede'pyabhedaḥ kriyāyāstathā dhātvarthabhede'pyabhede evāstu, satyemetat | kiṃtu vastunaḥ sarvathaikatvamanekatvaṃ vāceyamānaṃ bhedābhedanibandhanaṃ lokavyavahāraṃ sarvamatikrāmati | tasmādbhedamabhedaṃ ca abhyupagacchatā vyavahāraprasidhyarthamabhedo bhedaścābhyupagantavayaṃ syacit kiñcinmukhyaṃ kiñcadaupacārikaṃ sarvo hi bhedavādī nirupakāreṣvayaśśalākapadasaṃbandheṣvanyonyavyāvṛtteṣu bhedeṣu tadevedamitipratyayasya abhedādekatvāmāśritya laukikavyavahāramanugacchati | ekatvavādī ca bhedādhiṣṭhānāmiva bhavatāṃ sarvo vṛttiṃ sarveṃ ca viśeṣaśabdavyavāharaṃ dharmāntarasaṃsargapūrvakaṃ loke vyavasthitaṃ manyamāno lokamanugacchan abhinnamapi bhedaireva nidarśayati | tasmādbhinnadhātvarthavacchinnā bhinnā'pi kriyā bhinnaiveti etenaitadapi sagṛtahītaṃ bhavati| vrajatipacateyastīti svetata ityādau pratyayārthadhātvarthayorudvāpāvāpā bhyāmanyatvenāvadhārito dhātvarthavacchinnaḥ, paricchinnakālaḥ kālaparicchinno vā upargādibhirūṣaskṛtaḥ pratyayārtopakāraḥ kārakairasaṃkhyaktibhissaṃkhyopadhyupakagṛtairupakriyāmāṇa upakramaprabhṛtyavamarśaparyantamantaḥ pratibhayā sākalyenollikhya sādhyetvenādhyavasitaḥ tatha sūpabhṛtobahirniṣpannā praprāntakramarūpāvayavavasamudāyātmā'napekṣitāntarālakriyāntaropanistathāvidhāvayavavo vā puruṣavyāpāraḥ kriyā | yathoktaviśeṣaṇotpanndhātvartho vā sādhyaphalaniṣpattipūrvakṣaṇopalabhyamānatadavayavo vā'vayavasamūhopalabhyamānaikākārapratyayanimittajātiviśeṣo vā pūrvāvayavopakṛtānyāvayavapratīyamānajātiprādurbhāvo vā dhātvarthavyāpratiyamāyaṇakartṛkarmaṇossvavyapadeśanimittasattāsaṃbandho vā kartṛkarmasattā vā tadvyāpārāviṣṭādhātvarthāvayavasāmānyaṃ vā tathaivopalabhyamānādhātvarthāvayavavyaktayo vā vyāpriyamāṇeṣu svaparātmanoḥ pūrvasvarūpavilakṣaṇapūpāntarābhimāno vā tatraiva ca tayostathāvidhābhinnasvakāraṇasattāsaṃbandho vā buddhisattabhāveṣu pratyastamitarūpanekatabudhdyanusyūte buddhisāmānyaṃ vā kriyāyaśabdenābhidhīyate | apica yāvatesiddhamasiddhaṃ vā sādhyatvena vivakṣtam | āśritakramarūpatvā ttatkriyetyabhidhīyate|| sa ca kairyānumeyatvāt parokṣa ityeke | gacchaticatyādipratyayeṣu pratyakṣeṇa, devadattādisvarūpe'tiriktakriyātatvānupalabdheḥ | ya eva devadattātmā tiṣṭhan pratyayagocaraḥ calatītyāpi saṃvittau sa eva pratibhāsate | kiṃtu calatīti pratītiḥ saṃyogavibhāgamālambate, seyogavibhāgaḥ kadācidevotpadyamānaḥ paridṛśyamānapadārthasvapātiriktaṃ kāraṇamanumāpayati, yañca kāraṇaṃ sa parispandaprayatnādirūpaḥ puruṣavyāpāro'tīndriyaḥ kriyeti | tadanupapannamityanye, calatītyadipratyayānāṃ pratyakṣatrayāvalambanatvāt | tathā ca na calatīti pratītessaṃyogavibāgāgālambanamavyāptyādiprasaṅgāt | tatrā'kāśe vihaṅgamo gacchatīti pratīti rna syāt, saṃyogavibāgayoragraraṇāt | na ca dvayorviyasossaṃyogavibhāgau pratyakṣau pratyakṣetaravṛttitvāt vāyuvanaspatisaṃyogavibhāgavat | athi vitatolokavayavyākāśaḥ tatsaṃyogagavibhāgau ca pakṣaṇaḥ, pratyakṣau tanna, santamase'pi khadyotavidyutoḥ kriyābuddheḥ | na ca tamo nāma vastusvarūpamasti, bhūkepe ca kaṃpate vasuṃdhareti ca jñānamasti | saṃyogavibāgamastītyativyaptiḥ saṃyogavibhāgopaḍaḍḍatdhnaprabandhe'pi tayorvartāmānayoreva grahaṇaṃ tai ca gattvā'pi sthite gavādau sta iti | tatrāpi gacchatītijñānaprasaṅgaḥ niścale ca śyenasamavāyāpāyaparaṃparāvati vadhyaśūle pravājalajauśeṣaviśeṣamālahāriṇi saritkūle raṅgatumasaṃyogaviphabhāgaśreṇimati ca bāhyalindamahītale calatīti pratyayaḥ prāpnoti | athā kriyājanyatvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgajānāṃ tatraiva calatīti śyenādau pratyayo na niśkriye śūlādāviti tarhi kriyāvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt kriyālaṃbana evā'yaṃ pratyo'yaṃ, na saṃyogaviyogalaṃbanaḥ | kiñca nityaparokṣāyāṃ kriyāyamidamapi na jñāyate? kiṃ śūlakūlamahītalakriyājanyatvaṃ saṃyogavibāgānāṃ, kiṃ vā'nyena jalaturagākriyājanyatvamityativyāptiḥ saṃyogavibhāgālaṃbanatve ca saṃyojyate viyujyata iti ca pratītibhyāṃ na calatīti yathāviṣayaṃ pratyayotpādānijrñānejalasya ālambanatā śyāt | calatīti ca vartamānābhāsaḥ pratyayassaṃyogavibhāgānumeyatvena saṃbhavati| tathāhi saṃyogāntaraṃ karmeti | na ca seyoge vartamānāṃ kriyāmanumāpayati, vibhāgo vikāsyātvādātmanaḥ prāklālīna iva kāraṇaṃ gamayati| kāraṇasya hi satvaṃ prāklālīnameva kāryopayogi na tutalyākālaṃ, tadānīṃ, tasya siddhātvāt | ataḥ kāryātkāraṇabhūtāṃ kriyāmanumimāno bhūtacāmevānumirmīte na vartamānām | tasmātsaṃyogavibhāgābhyāṃ kriyānumāne vartamānābāsaṣṭalatīti pratyayo na saṃbhavatītyasaṃbhavaḥ | na ca nityāparokṣākriyānumānamapi śakyaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇapūrvakamiti saṃbandhagrahaṇānupapatteḥ | na hi dravyamiśraṃ kāraṇaṃ, api tu kriyānumāne kriyāviśeṣṭaṃ kriyāyāśca parokṣatvānnā tadānīmiṣṭavyakāraṇagrahaṇamanughaṭamiti ghaṭādāvapi durghaṭāvyāptipratītiḥ, tasmānna kāryānumeyā kriyā | apitu utkṣepaṇādibedavataḥ parispandarūpasya karmaṇaḥ pratyakṣeṇopalambhāt pratayakṣaiveti | etena pacatīti pratītirapi pratyakṣakriyālaṃbanaiveti vyākhyātam | tatra hi pacatyādikriyābahvyaḥ pratīyante, devadattaścalati, cullī jvalati, sthālī urvāyate, vayasyaḥ kathayati pidhānamapidhatteḥ taṇḍuḍḍatdhlāni viklidyanti, darvyapavidhyati, odanassidhyati, iti | nanu ca pāko nāma dhātvarthaḥ paridṛśyamānedevadattādivyāpāravyatirikta eṣitavyaḥ, tadantareṇa phalanivṛtteparabhāvāt, tadabhāve ca kimadhikṛtya kārakāṇi saṃsṛjyran | atrocyate, yaṃ tamekaṃ pākaṃ nāma dhātvarthaḥ calanādibhyo'tiriktaṃ kriyeti manyase, sa kiṃ vastudharmaḥ? tatkārye vā, tatra vastudharmatve rūpajjātivadvābhyupagamyamāne yāvadvastu sravakālaṃ vā phalaniṣpattiprasaṅgaḥ | tatkāryatve sati sa kiṃ sakalakārakaniṣpādyaḥ, ekaikakārakanirvatyau vā | tatrādyapakṣe ekaikaṃ bhavet kārakamakriyaṃ ekākaniṣkriyatve tu sakalalye'pi kāryatvādvyāpārāvantarakakalpanāyāmanavasthā | pakṣāntare tu kriyāmiva phalamapi niṣkriyāṇyeva kārakāṇi kuryuriti kiṃ kriyayā | nanu karotīti kārakaṃ satyaṃ kakaroti phalamanikriyam | nanu karotīti yahvrūṣe seyamuktaiva kriyā | caitraḥ kaṭaṃ karotīti caitrasyaiva kaṭasyaiva karoterapyartho vācya eva | ucyate paruspanda eva bhautiko vyapārāḥ, karotyarthaḥ | na hi vayaṃ paridṛśyamānaṃ parispandātmakaṃ vyāpāramapahvumahe | pratikārakaṃ vicitrasya calanādevryāpārasya pratyokṣeṇopalambhāt | atīndriyastu tadatriktaḥ karotyartho nāstīti brūmahe | kriyātīndriyatve hitadyogakṛtaṃ kārakatvamadhigacchantaḥ phalārthimastadupādadīran | tāvadeva viniścitya tadupādīyate'rthibhiḥ | tadevopādadānaiśca phalamapyatigamyate || kārakatevaṃ ca pakṣe'sminnāsti kiñcadatīndriyam| kārakatvaṃ svarūpasya sahakāryādisannidhiḥ || nivryāpārasya nanvasya ko giṇassahakāribhiḥ | vyāpārayogino'pyasya ko guṇassahakāribhiḥ || bidhavyāpāra evaiṣa savai saṃbhūya sādhyate | kiṃ phalenāpāraddhaṃ taddhi saṃbhūya sādhyatām || tasmāttakārakacakreṇa calatā janyate phalam | na punaścalavanādanyo vyāpāra upalabhyate || calanto devadattādyāstadanantaramodanam | etāvaddṛśyate tatra na tvanyā kācana kriyā || kriyānimittasaṃsargavādino'pi dvayī gatiḥ | satyāṃ kriyāyāṃ saṃsargassaṃsarge sati vā kriyā || atrā'pi pakṣe pūrvasmin saṃsargaḥ kkopayujyate | tathā sati phalaṃ sidhyetkāṣṭhādeḥ kevalādapi || saṃsargāttu kriyā siddhā purekaikamakriyām| tathā ca sati naidhāṃsi jvaseyuḥ puṭharānvitāḥ || jvalantyedāṃsi na punaḥ pacanti piṭharānvitāḥ | piṭhare satyapīmāni jvalantītyeva me matiḥ || tasmātkriyāntarābhāvātkāṣṭhāmbipiṭharādayaḥ | saṃsṛjyantāṃ phalāyaiva kimadṛṣcaṭena karmaṇā || nanu ca phalaṃ siddhaṃ sādhyaṃ vā, kiñcātaḥ siddhaṃ cet kārakāntarāṇyapi siddhānīti saṃsargābhāvaḥ | atha sādhyaṃ saiva kākarakavyāpārāvyatiriktā kriyeti | tann, phalasya kriyātvānupapatteḥ | odano hi phalaṃ, na cāsau kriyāṇāṃ vipratipattiḥ, pākasta rhi kaḥ? pacervācyaḥ, śūnyataiva yuktā ucyate samuditadevadattadikārakanikaraparispanda eva viśiṣṭaphalāvacchinnaḥ pākaḥ | sa eva ca pacerarthaḥ, devadattādikriyā hi calanajvalanādirūpāḥ pṛthaktathaivāvabhāsante, samuditāsu satyāḥ phalantarāvacchedādrūpāvantareṇa pākādīnāmapasphuranti, vyapadiśyante, samuditāsu satyaḥ phalāntarāvacchedādrūparāntareṇa pākādīnāmapasphuranti, vyapadiśyante ca, tathā devadattaḥ pacatītivat kāṣṭhāni pacanti, sthālī pacatītyapi vyapadeśo bhavati | nanu ca yathā sthālī pacati kāṣṭhani pacantīti dṛśyate | naivam, odanaḥ pacati taṇḍuḍḍatdhlāḥ pacantīti satyametat | kāraṇaṃ tu vācyaṃ kiṃ taditi cet pacerakarmakatvakriyātvameva | nanvodanasya taṇḍiḍḍatdhlānāṃ vā kartṛtvaṃ na tūbhayossaṃbhavati | naivaṃ, taṇḍiḍḍatdhlānodanaṃ, pacatītyapi vyapadiśyate, na cakarmaṇassvatantratā yiktā, tadabhāvāñca na kartṛtvanibandhanaḥ pacativyapadeśaḥ svātantre vā kathaṃ karmakartuḥ karmavat na kartṛpratyayabhāvāt | nanvevaṃ, sati odantaṇḍiḍḍatdhlānāṃ nivṛttivikārayorasvātantryātsidhyati odano'pi klidyanti taṇḍuḍḍatdhlā ityāpi na syāt | tanna, nivṛtyādiṣu tatpūrvamanubhūya svatantratāṃ katrrantaraṇāṃ vyavahāre karma saṃpadyate punaḥ | bhavati nāma, taṇḍuḍḍatdhlānāṃ siddhānāṃ kathañcidetat, odanasya tu sādhyasya nāpapadyate? naivaṃ, bhavatyrarthe sarvasya kartṛtvāt bhavatyarthaśca sidhyatīti na doṣaḥ | yadyodano na paktavyaḥ paktavyo yadi nodanaḥ || yathā śāṭakaścenna vātavyo vātavyaścenna śāṭakaḥ || atrocyate | antasthatvaṃ bahisthatvaṃ niṣpattau dvayamiṣyate | antasthatvaṃ puraskṛtya bahisthatvaṃ prakāśate || dvayī satta pādārthānāṃ bāhyācāmyantarīti ca | āntarī vyavahārārthā bāhyātvarthakriyāṃ prati||. anyathā hyaṅkuro jāyata ityapi na syāt | ata idamuktam, upakramapratyabhṛtyapavargaparyantamantaḥ pratibhayā sākalyenollikhya sādhyatvenenādhyavasatiḥ puruṣavayāpāraḥ kriyeti | na ca puruṣavyāpārasya kriyātvaṃ, ratho gacchati, kūlaṃ patatītyādiprayogābāvaḥ upacāro vā | puruṣaśabdeneha prathamamadhyamottamalādeśaṃ trikābhidheyayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇorabhidhānāt | na caivametadvyāpārāyoreva kriyātvaṃ phalābhidhāyitvena kārakopalakṣaṇatvāt | yathā ca bhāgāḥ pacateścalanjavalanādayaḥ | calanajvalanādīnāṃ jñeyā bhāgāstathā'pare || tathāhi | devadattaścalatītyatra kiṃ pratīyate? yugīmādatte, udamanāsiñciti, taṇḍiḍḍatdhlānāvapatīti | evaṃkākarakāntaravyāpāreṣvapi draṣṭavyaṃma, na tu devadattāderrbhautiko vyāpāraḥ ātmavyāpārapūrvako bhavitumarhati | naitadevam, nahyātmano vyāpāraḥ kiñcidasti icchādveṣapūrvakaprayatnavaśādeva sa bhautikavyāpārakāraṇatāṃ pratipadyate | calatītipratitivat pacatīti pratitirapi pratyakṣakriyālaṃbanaiveti atrānumeyakriyāvādinassamādadhate | astu nāma devadattādikārakanikaraparispandasamudāyaḥ kriyā | kintu pacatītiyādāvadhiśrayaṇāvacanavicaṭanādīnāṃ kimāyuṣmān kriyātvaṃ manyate, kimarthaṃ sravāṇyeveti? omiti brūmaḥ | pṛcchāmi cāyuṣmantaṃ kimadiśrayaṇādayaḥ kriyāvyapadeśamekaśo vā labheran | na tāvadekaśaḥ, kramarūpābhāvāt, etañca tatkriyāyāḥ kriyātvaṃ, yaduta sādhanaissādhyamānatā kramarūpopādānañca | na caikasya kramassaṃbhavati, avaśyābhidheyaścaitadupāttakramassādhyayā'bhidhīyamānapadārthaḥ kriyeti | anyathā hi pākādīnāṃ upasaṃhṛtakrmāṇāmapi kriyātvaprasaṅgaḥ | te hi paryavasitāḥ svarūpatayopasaṃhṛtakramā eva svaśabdairūpādīyante, na sādhyābāvena | pākaṃ karotītyādau hi sādhanaviśeṣanibandhanāvibhaktirupalabhyate, dvitīyānivṛttirūpaṃ ca sādhanamupapadyate | nanvevaṃ, asti vidyate tiṣṭhāntyādīnāmapi na kriyātvaṃ prasajet, yāvatā nohāpi krama upalabhyate | naivam, atrāpi kramasya pratīyamānatvāt | tathāhi kālānipāti yadrūpaṃ tadastītyapadiśyate | paritastu paricchinnā bāva ityeva kathyate || evaṃ vidyate tiṣṭhātītyatrāpi draṣṭavyam, kālādhikāre caitaddhiśeṣato varṇayiṣyamāḥ | nāpi gaṇaśaḥ kramajanmatādhiśrayaṇādīnāmutapannamatra, pradhvaṃsitvādayaugapade samūhānupapatteḥ | tadabāve ca kathamiva bhinneṣu bhinnaśabdo vartatāṃ pacatīti | ucyate, kramopajātāvayavavaparicchedaprāptasaṃskārāntaṃ hi yadā sakalaṃ kriyākalāpatteḥ kalayati, tadā pratyayaḥ parivartisamudāya ekakāryatvādāhitabhedaḥ pacatītyadiśabdavyapadeśaniṃmittaṃ bhavati| tathāhy odanādikāryakriyākalāpastirodhāya bhedamabhedena vyapadiśyate | pacatīti phalasya ca sakalākriyāvayavasādhyatvāt sādhanabhāvenāpi sa eva'pekṣyate | tadanantargatāstnadhiśrayaṇādayaḥ pratyakaṃ phalamabhinirvartayitumaparyāptāḥ paryāptasya samudāyasya rūpasaṃpādananārthatvātsamudāyaṃ prati guṇabhūtā vijñāyante | tadāha guṇabhūtaipavayaissamūbakramajanmanām | buddhyā prakalpito kabhedaḥ kriyeti vyapadisyate || yadyevaṃ pacatīti vyapadeśo nopapadyate dhātūpādānātītā na cānāgatā tadā vartamānakālavihitaḥ pratyayaḥ prayujyate | na cā'sya kriyāpratānasyeyaṃ vyavasthā saṃbhavati, adhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ pūrvāparībhāvaniyamāt, na caikaḥ kriyābhāgaḥ pacatiśabdananibavandhanaḥ śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt | na hiyupāttakriyāvayavārthapratyāyakaśśabdo yathābhūtamarthaṃ pratyayāyati, tataḥ kathamekasya vartamānakālatāṃ pratyayo'nurudhyeta? naitadasti, śabdaśaktiyo bhinnarūpāmabhinnamarthavyaktimupāttābhedāt darśayanti, yataḥ pūrvāparībhūtāvayasamudāyānurūpāḥ buddhiryathāvagṛhītaṃ samudāyākāramavayaveṣu pratyayasyeti te'vayavāḥ pratyayena samāropasamudāyānurūpāḥ pacatiśabdavācyāssantaḥ svarūpasannadhānāttaṃ vartamānādivyapadesamanubhūya pratyayaviseṣotpattinimittaṃ bhavanti | tathā hi, abhisamīhitaphalaḥ kriyāyaṃ phalopajananasādhanabhūtāyāṃ vartamānaḥ pumān samudāyamevādhāya cetasi tāsvavayavakriyāsu pravartate | tato hyasya samudāyābhisandhisamutthāpitāḥ kriyābhāgāḥ samudāyasaṃpādanārthatvāt samudāyarūpeṇādhyavasīyante | tathā'thadhyavasitakriyārūpaistu tasya kriyā kṣaṇasya sannidhānādvartamānakālavihitaḥ pratyayaḥ prayujyate pacatīti | atra cotpannamātraprayuktatvāt srave kriyāvayavā vartamānā na saṃbhavantīti sphuṭamevāvasīyate, kintu pratyekaṃ samudāyiṣu samudāyādhyāsena prayujyate pacatīti | adhiśrayaṇādyavayavākrayāmudāyavacaneśaṣu pacādiṣu yasminnavayave'dhyāropya samudāyo'dhiśrayaṇādiḥ viklityantaḥ pratyāyyate, tatkālapratyayo'nuvartate | tatra yadā vartamānāvayave samudāyādhyāsastadā pacatīti bhavati| yadā tu bhūtabhaviṣyayossamūhoropaṇe tadā'pākṣāt pakṣyatīti | taduktaṃ samūhassa tathābhūtaḥ pratibhedaṃ samūhiṣu | samāpyate tato bhede kālabedasya saṃbhavaḥ || samudāyasya ca samudāyiṣu pratyekaparisamāptau nidarśanaṃ, grāmo dagdhaḥ, paṭo dagdhaḥ, iti | yadi hyesminnaṃśe samudāyo na syāt, pāṇimātrasyāṅgulimātrakya vā caṇḍālatvavirahāt caṇḍālapāṇḍaḍḍatdhṅgulisparśenaivocyeta caṇḍālaspṛṣṭa iti | na cāṅgavikāreṇāṅghino vikṛtirlakṣyate, akṣṇā kāṇa iti | taduktam, avayave hi spṛṣṭe samudāyo'pi spṛṣṭo bhavati, avayave hi kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ samudāyasyāpi viśeṣakaṃ bhavati, yaśca samudāyaḥ so'vayavānna vyabhicarati | tasya viśeṣakaṃ yathā gossakthani kaṇṭhe'pi kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ goreva viśeṣakaṃ na gomaṇḍaḍḍatdhlasyeti | tadevamukte kimuktaṃ bhavati upāttakramādhiśrayaṇādiviklityantānāmavayavānāṃ samudāyaḥ pacatikriyeti? tarhi, ciraṃ jīvatu bhavān bhavanaiva pratijñātā naiva kriyā pratyakṣeti | tasmādipāttakriyāṃ kriyāvayavāstadasya kriyāsaṅghātasya recidavayavā nivṛtāḥ, kecidanivṛttāḥ, kaścideva pratyupasthitaḥ | upasthitaviṣayāḥ cakṣiparādayaḥ, tato'tha kriyākalāpādayaḥ pratyakṣayituṃ cakṣurādibhirabhisaṃbandhāt na vyatītānāmatarūpasyāsataḥ kriyāvayavasya sadāsadānupātinā kakāraṇagrāmeṇa saṃbandho, na vā'nadhigatendriyasaṃbandhasya padārthasya darśanaparicchedyatā saṃbhavati | taduktaṃ kramātsadasatāṃ teṣāmātmano na samūhitāḥ | sadvastaviśayairyānti saṃbandhaṃ cakṣurādibhiḥ || darśanābhimānaḥ kathamiti cet, yathā gauraśva ityevamanādiṣu padeṣu gakārādayo varṇabhāgāḥ kramarūpānanuvidhāyino vyaktāvupajane vā prāptayaugadyāsaṅgātarūpeṇa na pāryānte'vadhārayituṃ, indriyāyattayā budhdyā tasyāḥ pratyupasthitākṣarāvasāyaśakteḥ pūrvottarabhāgayorasaṃsparśāt | samabhihitāvayavaparicchedaprāpitātiśayāstu buddhayaḥ svānurūpaṃ saṃskāraparaṃparāmante samālocitaviśeṣavarṇabhāgāmupajanayanti tasyāmutkīrṇabuddhimiva tatpadaṃ samudāyātmanā nirūpyate | tadāha yathā gauriti saṅghātassarvonendiyagocaraḥ | bhāgaśastūpalabdhasya boddhau rūpaṃ nirūpyate || kālpanikastu yugapadnrahaṇābhimānaḥ pratyakṣabhramanibandhanam| yathā'lātasya viddhaviśvaśate | deśe nairantaryā na parivṛttirūpamapi rāmeṇāvadhārayannayanāvasitakālabhedo yugapatsakaladeśavyāpi paricchinnadhyavasyati, caṃkramiti yathā kramavantaḥ kriyābāgāḥ krameṇaivāvasitā laghutaraṃ parivartitvātadanavadhṛtakālabhedairyugapadevādhyanasīyante, yathā'dhyavasāyaṃ ca darśanābhimānamutrādayantaḥ pratyakṣavyavahāraṃ vartayati | yaduktam indriyairanyathāprāptau bhedāṃśopanipātibhiḥ | alātacakravadrūpaṃ kriyāṇāṃ parivartitam || apratyakṣaiva tu kriyā | yadāha mahābhāṣyakāraḥ kriyāṇāmevamatyantāparidṛṣṭā aśakyā nidarśayituṃ, yathā garbho nirluṭhitasyāsāvanumānagāmyati | nanu pratyakṣapravṛttau saṃbandhagrahaṇābhāvāt kathaṃ kriyāviṣeye'numānaṃ vartate? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dhātuvācyasya samūhasya yugapadasannidhānātpratyakṣatvam | ekākasya tu lakṣaṇasya pratyakṣatve buddhyā saṅkayya paṭacatīti prayujyate, yadāpyekasmin kṣaṇe pacatīti prayogastadā tatra samūhāropaṇam | yadāha pūrvottarairyadā bhāgaissamavasthāpitakramaḥ | ekassopyasadadhyāsādākhyātairabhidhīyate || yaścāpakarṣaparyantamanuprāptaḥ pratīyate | tatraikasmin kriyāśabdaḥ kevalena prayujyate || na tvevamindriyairabhisaṃbandhāt sarūpasannidhānāya vartamānāvyapatadeśāñca kathamapratyakṣatve kriyāyām? ucyate, neha vastavartho nurūpyate, apitu śabdārthaḥ | tatra canvavyatirekābhyāṃ yaḥ kaprakṛtyratho'vasthāpyate, yā kriyāvacanasya dhātusaṃjñā, nāsau śakyā sākṣādupalabdhum | thatra hi ācāryāṇāṃ madabhedaḥ, eke manyante’dhiśraṇādīmanāṃ samudāyo buddhyā nigṛhītaḥ, ekatvena sa pacatītyādīnāṃ vācya iti | na ca samudāyaṃ pacatīti prayuñjānaḥ pratyekamadhiśrayaṇājiṣu pratyasyati, pratyayāśca na samudāya ityevaṃ rūpaṃ pratyasyanti | nāpyayaṃ cāyaṃ ceti saṃbandhino buddhyāvgṛhṇāti | kiṃ tahryāśritakramanirūpamiva pratyekamavayaveṣu pratyasya pacatīti prayuṅakte, tadā tasyaiva samīhitaṃ bhavati, adhiśrayaṇādyanupūrvā phalamodajanādi nirvartayitavyamiti | yathā prathamakhriyāsaṃbhāge pacirityevādhyavasyāti nādhiśrayaṇamiti | itharathā hyevaṃ prayogastasyādhiśrayatīti yadācādhiśrayaṇe nirvṛttenāgate vā bhūtabhaviṣyatkālābhidhāyinaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṅkte, tadā samudāyarūpapratyāsenaiva tamavayavabuddhyā nigṛhya prayuṅkte apākṣīte pakṣyatīti | na tvadhiśrayaṇarūpeṇa, anyathā hyevaṃ prayogassyāt adhyāśiṣyatīti | evāmāpanepi ca ghaṭane vā samūhini samudāyarūpāprāptyā dhātutvādeva vyapadeśāt | pacatyapākṣīt pakṣyatīti, evaṃ bhūtāścārthātmā'dhikṛtassādhanatantrasādhyāvasthaḥ śabdena prakrānto'śakya upalabdhuṃ, yathā gauriti gakāraukāravisarjanīyā evopalabhyante | samudāyastu buddhinigrrāhya eva, tathā pacatītyādiṣvevādhiśrayatītyavayavādiṣu avaya eva hastaprasaraṇasthālīvinyāsādayo'śabdavācya pratyakṣā eva| yāvadapakarṣaparyantāprāptā kriyeti sāpi nāpratyaste kramarūpe samudāye ākhyātaśabdevanābhidhīyate | apakarṣaparyantā cetkramarūpeṇa nā'vagṛhṇādīti avācaka evākhyātaśabdāḥ yathā ślokaśabdaṃ prayuñjano bhādyaṃ padaṃ padarūpeṇāvagṛhṇāti na tadā ślokassamuñcāryata iti prayuṅkte | yadā tvāśritottaraprabandhamavagṛhṇāti tadā ślokaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte | evaṃ kṛtvā niruktetyuktaṃ pūrvāparībhūtaṃ bhāvamākhyāyate nācaṣṭā iti | anyeṣāṃ darśanaṃ yadvicaṭanaṃ taṇḍuḍḍatdhlāvayavānāṃ taṇḍiḍḍatdhlāvayavebhyo vibhāgāḥ, yadanantaraṃ mā bhavādayo niṣpadyante | tadyadā'dhiśrayādiṣu pratyastarūpaṃ bhavati tāda'khyānenābhidhīyate | tatra yadajupalabhyate'dhiśrayaṇaṃ tadaśabdavācyaṃ, kārakanirākāṃkṣaṃ yacchabdenābhidhīyate tadaniṣpannaṃ, sādhanatantramapratyakṣaṃ niṣepannāniṣpannayoścaikāntyātmāyattau pacatyādiśabadaprayogaḥ | sa cāyamevaṃrūpo'rthātmā guṇākriyāṇāṃ paurvāparyātmanāṃ pūrvo na paraśca pūrvāparībhūte vyapadiśyate | anye tu vicaṭanamevādhiśrayaṇādirūpaṃ parratipannāḥ, na rūpaśūvanyādhiśrayaṇādīn pratyastavicaṭanarūpāmanāhuśca kaḥ punaḥ paceḥ pradhānārthaḥ yo'sau? ? taṇḍuḍḍatdhlānāṃ viklittiḥ? athāvā yadabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ praṣaṇamadhyeṣaṇaṃ vā sarvaḥ pacyartha iti sarvasminnapi darśane yathā bhūtākhyatāśabdo na kriyā prakramyate | tathābhūtāyāssiddhamapratyakṣamiti phalenaiva samdhigamo yuktaṃ kathamiti cet, iha sarveṣu sādhaneṣu sannihiteṣu kadācitpacatītyetadbhanati, kadācinna bhavati, yasminnimitte sannihite pacatītyetadbhavati | sā nūnaṃ kriyāyāṃ devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭaliputre bhavati | sā nūnaṃ kriyeti dvitīyahetumatyā so'pyartha iti cennaivam, iha kasyacideṣā buddhiḥ syāt, asatyevā'sminnimitte pacatyādibuddhayaḥ pravartante, yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikādiśaṣviti tadanena nirvartayati | mṛgatṛṣṇikādibhyo hi tṛptimalāpakarṣaṇa dharmāpanodanādi na phalaṃ nivartate, asarvagatayā hi devadattapācaliputrayorgamanakriyāntaranairantaryeṇāvasthānarūpaṃ phalamipalabhyate | athavā etadayaṃ pratipadyeta, śaktikṛtāḥ pacatyādayo viśeṣāḥ satpratyāśca syuḥ, na krayākṛtā iti | tadanena nirvartayati, yāvāṃ devadatta iha bhūtvā pāṭalipatre bhavati sā nūnaṃ kriyeti | yadi hyete śaktikṛtāssyuḥ śaktyānantarameva pācaliputreṇa prāptissayāt | naca bhavati tasamāt śaktikṛte nānyena dharmeṇa, , yasya phalaṃ deśāntaraprāptiriti | kriyāmanye tu manyante kkacidapyanapāśritām | sā nāvārthāvabālasatve pravṛttiranapāyinī || sāmānyābhūtā dhātvarthaissā punaḥ pravibhajyate | tato vyāpārarūpeṇa sādhye prayavatiṣṭhate || prakṛtissādhanānāṃ sā prathamāntamakārakam | śaktirekādhikaraṇe strotovadapakarṣati || apūrvaṃ kāsaśaktiṃ vā kriyāyāḥ kālameva vā | tamekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kecidāhuḥ kathañcana || sā tu yathā asti bhavati kakarotītyādikriyāvacchede bhedābhinnā'pi bhinneva prakāśate, tathā kramarūpoparādānānnityameva kālasaṃbandhobhūtabhūtabhaviṣyadādivyapadeśamāsādayati | kaḥ punarayaṃ kālo nāma? kriyaiva kriyāntarāvadhṛtaparimāṇavyavacchinnā vā kriyāparicchinnahetuḥ kālaḥ, kathaṃ punaḥ kriyāyaiva kriyāparicchittiḥ? śrayatām | iha tu kriyāḥ kāścitkriyāntaraiḥ kaiścidvuddhyaiva parimīyante | yathārkādīnāṃ gatayaḥ yathā ca godohādayaḥ, tathā'smādādivyāpārāḥ | yathā puruṣāyuṣādayastatrāvadhṛtaparimāṇābiritarāḥ paricchidyante, yathā divasaṃ gacchati, varṣaśataṃ jīva, odanapārakamāste, godohaṃ svapiti | tatra paricchedakālavayavahāraṃ vartayanti, yathā saviturudayādirastamayaparyantaḥ kriyāprabandho divasaḥ, sa evastamayādiḥ punarudayāvasāno niśā, sarvākakarṣāṇāṃ sakṛtparivṛttirahorātraḥ, kalābirindorāpyāyanaṃ parikṣayo vā pakṣaḥ, candrasya sakalaṃnakṣatrātikramomāsaḥ, sūryācandramasorgativibhāgādekāhorarātrakṣaya ṛtuḥ, raverdakṣiṇata uttarate vā gamanamayanaṃ, vṛhaspaterekṛrātryatikramassaṃvatsara iti | tena coktānuktaṃ kriyā kālo'vācchidyate | yathā divā divaḥ, divaso niśācāhorātraḥ, pañcadaśāhorātraḥ pakṣaḥ, pakṣadvayaṃ māsaḥ, māsadvayamṛtuḥ, ṛtutrayamayanaṃ, ayanadvayaṃ saṃvatsaraḥ, pañca saṃvatsārā yugam | yugāni dvādaśā kalapaḥ, kalpaśatāni dvādaśa mahākalpaḥ, mahākalpaṣṭiścaturyugaṃ, caturyugāni dvisaptatirmanvantaram, manvancarāṇi caturdaśa brahmadivasaḥ, tāvatyeva tanniśā pralayaḥ, tanmānena varṣaśatānte brahmaṇo'pavargo mahāpralayaḥ | yathā vā sūryasya bhagaṇabhogo varṣe, rāśibhogo māsaḥ, māsātriṃśāṃśo dinaṃ, dinaṣṭyaṃṣā kalā, kalāṣaṣṭyaṃśā vikalā, vikalāṣaṣṭyaṃśaḥ tatpareti | tatra yathā rajatānyadhikaraṇagauravamavadhṛtaparimāṇadravyāntarasaṃbandhasamutkīrṇaparekhastulādaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ | rekhāsu sūtrāvasthānaphalaśaḥ karṣaśobhā paricchinatti | tathā kāladinādīnvayavasthānavaśena bhāgaśaḥ kālāntaraṃ paricchinatti | parimāṇāṃ parimimīte kriyāniyamaiḥ kākalāvacchedaniyamaḥ yathā parimāṇo svavaṣṭubdhapradeśo kmalakṣaṇaḥ, paśyamasaṃpāto niṃṣaḥ, ityatkṣeṇe iyannimeṣo vā nāḍiḍḍatdhkā, dvināḍiḍḍatdhko muhurtaḥ, pādonacaturmuhūrto yāmaḥ, yāmāṣṭakamahorātraḥ iti | buddhyanavacchedena vā kālaparicchedaḥ, yathārkasya udāyāvidūratā pratyūṣaḥ, puruśabhrūpradeśatā dīrghatā pūrvahṇaḥ, tapamā madhyāhnaḥ, parāvṛtyā darśanamaparahṇaḥ, astamayāsannatābhisandhiḥ sandhyeti | rotreḥ prārambho niśāmukhaṃ, niśāmukhādrātresturyaṃśaḥ, ardharātramubhayato niśāṣṭamo niśīthaḥ, niśīthāttāvanmātramapararātraḥ, parato niśāvaseṣaḥ prabhaitamiti kriyāviśeṣaiḥ kālaviśeṣāvagamaḥ | tathāhi śayāne śerate rātrai divā jāgrati jāgrati | jagatpradīpe padmāni kalatrāṇīva bhartari || ratāntakālakāntastrīdṛgvilāsaikasākṣiṇī | niśā nīlotpalānīkenimīlati nimīlate || cañcvagracimbitātāmracūtāṃkurakagadambakaiḥ | kathyate kokilaireva madhurmadhurakūjitaiḥ || divākarakārālatapātanirdagdhavīrūdhaḥ | mārgāssamallikāmodā bhāvigrīṣmasya śaṃsaniḥ || śikhaṇḍiḍḍatdhmaṇḍaḍḍatdhlārabdhacaṇḍaḍḍatdhvaḍaḍḍatdhvaḍaḍḍatdhmbaraiḥ | prāvṛḍākhyayate medhamedurairmedinūdharaiḥ || mailikākāranistāri tārānikaracitritam | śaratpiśunatāṃ yāti yāmunāmbhonibhaṃ nabhaḥ || āyāmiyāminobhogasaphalābhogavibhramāḥ | hemantamabhinandanti soṣmāṇastarūṇīstanāḥ || āskandavadalatkundakalikotkaradanturāḥ | vadanti śiśiraṃ vātāstuṣārakaṇakarkaśāḥ || vālyayaivanaraimārayauvanādayo maugdhyamādhyaprāgalbhāyaśca kriyāviseṣavyaṅyāḥ kālaviśeṣāḥ eva | vayo hi dehitāṃ vatsarādibhiḥ kālabhedaḥ, vayonimittāśca teṣāṃ maigdhyādaya iti | ucyata uttālalakabhañcanāni kabarībhāreṣu śikṣāraso | dantānāṃ parikarma nīvinahanaṃ bhrūlasyayogyāgrahaḥ || tiryaglocanavalgitāni vacasāṃ chetoktisaṅgakrāntayaḥ . strīṇāṃ mlāyati śaiśave pratikalaṃ ko'pyeṣa kelikramaḥ || vyasanotsava nityanaimittikakṣaṇaprakīrṇacandoyacandrastamayaprabhṛtayaśca kālavyapadeśabhājo godohādidveditavyāḥ | apica, parāvaracikṣiprakramotkramavibhāgavān | kālakriyāviseṣābhivyaṅgyārītiḥ pratīyatām | tathāhi, utpattyādikriyāṇāṃ prathamatve paraḥ tatheyaṃ bālā jyeṣṭhā ca vaiparītye puraparaḥ yathaiṣā pragalbhā kaniṣṭhā ca | sādhanānāṃ manedasāpātitve ciraḥ yathā vatsyati kālaḥ, bhokṣyate tālaphalaṃ, tadanyathātve kṣipraḥ yato bhinnaśca vaṃśakārī, śirāgataśca pramāṇaṃ, kriyāṇāṃ apaurvāparyai yugapat, yathā divasāgrato niśā, niśāgrato divasa iti| seyaṃ vastunaśśāktiḥ pākagaprabhāvā svābhāvikī kriyaiva, kriyāparicchedahetuḥ kālaḥ, kriyāśca tā bhaviṣyanti vartamānāḥ avyaktāśca | tatra vyatipatitasādhanabhūtā yathā'pākṣīditi, anāgatā'sannihitasādhanā ca bhaviṣyati yathā pakṣyīti, avāptā aprcayutasvarūpā vartamānā yathā pacītīti, anirdhāritāviśeṣā avyakta yathā pacedayamiti, tannibandhanaśca loke, adyaśaavaḥ, paraśvaḥ, paredyuḥ, anyedyuḥ, ubhayehyuḥ, idānīṃ, etarhi, eṣamaḥ? , parut, pārāri, śaśvat, svaḥ, bhūḥ, sadyaḥ, purā, ha, sma, yāvat, tadā, yadā, anyādā, ekadā, sadeti vyavahāraḥ luṅādīnāṃ bhūtādiṣu smaraṇamiti | anye punaḥ kriyānyatiriktamanudāyāstamabhinnamanavāvacchinnadeśaṃ ca dravyaṃ pṛthagvidhānekaśaktiśatasahastrapākāyatanaṃ jagatprattiniyamakāraṇaṃ kriyāparicchedahetumadṛṣṭādyapekṣaṃ kālāmācakṣate, sa ca kriyāparicchedyaḥ kileti | kecidāhūśca nityo vyāpi saṃprati bhūtaviṣyatkriyāsamāvośāt | ākāśaklapa eko dravyātmā bhidyate kālaḥ, tañcāsamīcīnameveti brūmaḥ | kriyā hi sādhyatvāt sādhanamevāpekṣate | na ca kriyāviśṣṭasyāpi dravayātmanaḥ kālakārakeṇa saṃbandho ghaṭate, dvayorapi siddhatvāt | tasmāddravyapūpe kriyarūpe vā kriyāmeva viśeṣayati | sa ca tadviśiṣṭā kārakaviśeṣamupatiṣṭhate | yadāha guṇaḥ kṛtātmasaṃskāraḥ pradhānaṃ pratipadyate | pradhānasyopakāritve tathā bhūyasi vartate || kalābhiḥ pṛthagarthābhiḥ pravibhaktaṃ svabhāvataḥ | kecidbūnusaṃdhānalakṣaṇatatvaṃ pracakṣate || sattālakṣaṇamanye tu kṣaṇarūpaṃ tathā'pare | devatāvastuśaktyātmasvarūpamapare viduḥ || tamasya lokayantrasya sūtradhāraṃ pracakṣate | pratibandhābhyanujñābhyāṃ vṛttiryā tasya śāśvatī || tayā vibhajyamāno'sau labhate kramarūpatām | tṛṇarājasya yā vṛddhistavācisārasya vā dadhat || cirakṣiprādibhede ca kālakatvaṃ vikalpate | vyatikme'pi mātrāṇāṃ na tasyāsti vyatikramaḥ || niyantṛgatibhedena mārgabhedo'sti kaścana | dūrāntikavyavasthāvanamadhvādikaraṇaṃ yathā || cirakṣipravyavasthānaṃ kālādhikaraṇaṃ tathā | kriyopādhissa yā bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānatā || parāvaravibhāgārthaṃ sā śaktiḥ pratipādyate | bhūtānāṃ caiva yadrūpaṃ rūpaṃ yadbhāvināmapi || sudurdarśa ivādarśe kāla evopalabhyate | kriyābhedyathaikasmastakṣādyākhyā pravartate || kriyābhedāttathaikasmin nṛtvākhyācopajāyacate | viseṣṭamapi dhattaṃ tamupādāyāvakalpate || kālaḥ kālavidāmekaḥ kālādipravibhaktaye | tṛṇaparṇalatādīni yathā stroto'vakarṣati || pravartayati kālo'pi mātrā mātrāvatāṃ yathā | prārambhāveśaniṣṭhāsu sthitivipratipattiṣu || sāmyotkarṣeṣu nimittaṃ kāla iṣyate | saṃsargiṇāṃ tu ye bhedā viśeṣāstasya te matāḥ || saṃbhinnastaivyavasthānāṃ kālo bhedāya kalpate | prativyavasthaṃ kālasya vyāpāro na vyavasthitaḥ || kālo vā viśvarūpātmā vyāpārā iti kathyate | kriyāvacchedahetuṃ vā kriyāvacchedyameva vā || kālātmānamanāśritya vyavahartuṃ na śakyate | tasya vyaktasvarūpasya vyavahāre kriyākṛtāḥ || bhūtādayo mahābhedā yān loko nātivartate || ke punaste yān bhūta upādhau luṅādiviṣayānudahariṣyāmaḥ | tadetat dravyātmanaḥ kriyātmano vā kriyāparicchedinaḥ kālasya svarūpamabhihitam | athāparamaparimeyātmano devatādirūpasya svaśaktinimittaviśaavapravṛttiparicchedyasya tasya paricchedino vā kriyāhetiśaktayāyatanabhūtadravyarūpapariṇataṃ nivṛttaṃ vā, na samastanivṛttasaṃgrahānugrahādinityavanaimittikādirūpaṃ, svarūpamasti | tatpurastāt pratipāditaṃ, agrataśca viśeṣataḥ pratipādayiṣyata iti neha pratanyate, saṃbandhāvacchedārthaṃ tu leśato abhidhīyata iti | tatprabhedāddravyarūpo'pi kālaścatirdhā nityo, naimittikaḥ, svābhāviko, vaiparāmarśika iti | teṣu nityaśśaśvatiko vaikalpikaḥ naiyogikaśca tridhā | naimittiko'pi audyogikaḥ aupayogikaḥ prāyogikaśceti trividhaḥ | evaṃ svābhāviko'pi āgantukaḥ naisargikaḥ sāmasargika iti tridhā | vaiparāmarśiko'pi saṅkīrṇaḥ prakīrṇo viprakūrṇa iti tridhaiva | teṣu kṣaṇanimeṣanāḍiḍḍatdhkāmuḍūḍḍatdhrtapraharāhorātrasvapaśśāśvatika, ayaṃ hi śaśvatpravartamāno nāvadhiviśeṣamapekṣate | yathā kṣaṇe nimeṣe nāḍyāṃ vā muhūrte prahare'hni vā | gate tvameṣyasītyukte rurodha pathikaṃ priyā || dinārātripakṣamāsatrvayanarūpo vaikalpikaḥ | ayaṃ hi sūryodayādiviśṣṭamadhimapekṣamāṇo vikalpāya prabhavati | yathā dināni rātrayaḥ pakṣamāsāvṛturathāyanam | jarā vai yadyadaṅgānāṃ tattatpremṇo rasāyanam || saṃvatsarayugakalpamanvantarapralayamahāpralayarūpo naiyogikaḥ | ayaṃ hi vṛhaspatitārāyaṇamuramathanabrahmaṇāṃ rājyādivṛttiviśeṣṭamevāvadhimapekṣamāṇāḥ prāṇino viśiṣṭāsu pravṛttiṣu niyuṅkte | yathā saṃvatsarairyugaiḥ kalpairmanubhiḥ pralayaiḥ kṣayaiḥ | hīyate hi jagatsarvamekaḥ kāmo na hīyate || te'mī śāśvatikavaikalpikanaiyogikāstrayo'pi kālabhedā nityā ucyante, nityarūpeṇaivānivāritapravṛttitvāt | prātaḥpratyūṣapāhṇamadhyāhnasandhyārūpa audyogikaḥ | ayaṃ hyupekṣitahavirbhāgapaurvāparyāvadhiḥ prāṇināṃ prabodhotthānasnanabhojanaprasādhanavihārāderudyogasya nimittaṃ bhavati | yathā prātaḥ pratyūṣayorasnāti bhuṅkte sandhyāparāhṇayoḥ | prāhṇamadhyāhnayoryūnāṃ śate manasi manmathaḥ || ayaṃ hyapekṣitaparātrivibhāgapaurvāparyāvadhiḥ kāmināṃ dūtīsaṃpreṣaṇaprekṣānidrāsukhamadhupānābhisaraṇāderupabhogasya nimittaṃ bhavati | yathā niśāmukhe pradoṣe ca niśīthāpararātrayoḥ | indoḥ prakāśe nāśe vā suptaḥ kāmo vibudhyate || śaraddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmarūpaḥ prāyogikaḥ | ayaṃ hyapekṣitasaṃvatsaraviṣupaurvāparyāvādhiṃ prāṇināṃ kāmakṛtacittevaikṛtānāṃ prayoganimittaṃ bhavati | yathā śaraddhemantayoranyadanyadvarṣāvasantayoḥ | himartugriṣmayoranyatkāmāvasthā pravartate || te'mī trayo'pyaudyogikaupayogikaprāyogikāḥ kālabhedāḥ naimittikāḥ, nityatvepyeśāmudyogādernimittātvāt | madapramādābhyudayotsavavyasanaparihārābhirūpa āgantukaḥ | sa hi viśiṣṭakriyopanipātādikamavadhimapekṣamāṇaḥ prāṇināṃ madapramadādirūpeṇaivāgacchati | yathā madapramadaharṣeṣu vyasaneṣūtsaveṣu ca | parihāseṣu ca prāyaḥ kāmassāmānyamarhati || bālyakaumārayauvamanamaigdhyamādhyasthyaprāgalbhyādirūpo naisarhikaḥ | ayaṃ hi vayobhāgādikaṃ viśiṣṭamevāvadhimapekṣamāṇaḥ prāṇināṃ nisargata eva bhavati | yathā gaugādhyaprāgalbhyamāghyasthyabolyakaumārayauvanaiḥ | ātiṣṭhati padaiṣṣaḍḍḍitdhbhaḥ trijātiḥ kāmaṣaṭpadaḥ || parāparayaugapadyacirakṣiprarūpassāṃsargikaḥ | ayaṃ hi pravṛttisādhanānāṃ pūrvāparatve sahekatve mandaśīghrasamapātitve ca kriyāsvapekṣāmāṇo mithaḥ ssargāya prabhavati | yathā kameṇa yugapatpūrvamagrato drāk cireṇa vā | samāsajantyaścetāṃsi na jñāyante svarārtayaḥ || te'mī āgantukanaisargikasāṃsargikāstrayo'pi kālabhedāḥ svābhāvikā ucyante, svabhāvataḥ pravartamānatvāt | deśyakrīḍākalikelidyutavratagoṣṭhīviprekṣādirūpassaṅkīrṇaḥ | sa hi viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ tamavadhimapekṣamāṇassaṃbhūya pravartitassaṅkīrṇa evaṃ bhavati | yathā vrateṣu goṣṭhīprakṣāsu kelidyuteṣu keliṣu | deśyakrīḍāsu cānaṅgaḥ punaṅgena yujyate || viviktaṃ dīrghikodyānasaudhakrīḍādidarśanarūpaḥ prakīrṇaḥ | sa hyekasya vā parimitaparivārasya vā viśiṣṭāvadhika eva prakīrṇakanyāyena yadākadācidutpadyate | yathā viviktadīrghākodyānasaudhākrīḍādidarśane | latāveśmopaveṣe ca kāmaḥ kamena yujyate || aṣṭamīcandrakendrotsavayakṣarātrikundacaturthīsuvasantakamadanatrayodaśyādirūpo viprakīrṇakaḥ | sa hi viśiṣṭamaṣṭamyādikālamevāvadhimapekṣamāṇaḥ kāmibhirnirvatryate | samasteṣvapi deśeṣu viprakīṇaṃ iva dṛśyate iti | yathāṣṭamīcandrake kundacatithryāṃ suvasantake | harasmarārcā śakrārcā yakṣarātriṣu vardhate || sa eva kālaḥ kārtsnyena dvirūpa iva darśitaḥ | kriyāpadaikavācyo yaḥ kriyāyāssādhanaṃ ca yaḥ || kiṃ punassādhanaṃ svaparāśritakriyābhinirvṛttihetuśśaktimadadravyaṃ, yaddravyaṃ kārakamityācakṣate | kārakaśabdaśaacāyamavyutpavannaḥ kriyānimittavacano lokatassiddhaḥ karotīti vā kārakaśabdena śaktimadravyamucyate | tathāhi niṣpannmātre kartṛtvaṃ sarvatraivāsti kārake | vyāpārabhedāpekṣāyāṃ karaṇāditvasaṃbhavaḥ || putrasya janmani yathā putroḥ kartṛtvamucyate | ayamasmādiyaṃ tvasmaditi bhedāvivakṣayā || śaktimātrā samūhasya viśvasyānekadharmiṇaḥ | sarvathā sarvadābhāvātkkacitkacidvivakṣyate || sarvatra sahajā śaktiryāvadravyamavasthitā | kriyākakāletvabhivyaktirāśrayaḥ parakāriṇī || sāṅgasaṃyoginaḥ pāśādanyānāṃ vāraṇā yathā | vyajyente vijigīṣūṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ śaktayastathā || taikṣṇagauravakāṭhiṇyasaṃsthānaiḥ svairasiryadā | bhedyaṃ prativyāpriyate śaktimāruhyate tadā || svāśraye samavetānāṃ tadvadevāśrayāntare | kriyāṇāmabhiniṣpatternimittaṃ śaktiriṣyate || tatve vā vyati reke vā vyatiriktaiva socyate | śabdapramāṇako lokassa śāstreṇānugamyataṃ || tatra śaktimato dravyasya kārakākhyāyāmavāntaravyāpāranibandhanāḥ ṣaḍuḍḍatdhpākhyā bhavanti, kartā, karma karaṇaṃ saṃpradānāmapādānamadhikaraṇaṃ ceti | teṣu svatantraḥ, kartā, kiṃ punastasya svātantryaṃ, yat karaṇādīni prayuṅkte, na taiḥ prayujyate | tāni nyakkaroti, na tairnyakkriyate, na tairnirvatryate, tāni tāni nirvartayat, tāni pratinidhatte na taiḥ pratinidhīyate | tebhyassaḥ prathamamātmānaṃ labhate, na tāni | tasmāt sa tairvinā'pi dṛśyate, na tāni teneti | tadāha prāganyataśśaktilābhānnyagbhāvāpādanādapi | tadadhīnapravṛttitvātpravṛttānāṃ nivartanā || adṛṣṭatvātpratinidheḥ praviveke ca daraśanāt | ārādabhyupakāritve prādhānyaṃ karturutacyate || kathaṃ tarhi nyakkṛteṣu karaṇādiṣu kārakatvaṃ svavyāpāre pradhānavyāpāre ca svātantryāt | guṇakriyāṇāṃ kartāraḥ katrrā nyakkṛtaśaktiyaḥ | kāraṇatvādibhirjātāḥ kriyābhedānuvādibhiḥ || vyastāyāmapi saṃpūrṇaissvavyāpāraissamanvitaḥ | svātantryamuttaraṃ labdhvā pradhāne yānti kartṛtām || yathā rājño niyukteṣu yīddhṛtvaṃ yoddhṛṣu sthitam | teṣu vṛttau tu labhate rājā jayaparājayau || tathā katrrā niyukteṣu sarveṣvekārthakāriṣu | kartṛtvaṃ karaṇāditvairuttaraṃ na virudte || katrrādīnāṃ ca ṣaṇṇāmapi pratyekaṃ triprakāratvādaṣṭādaṣaprabhedā bhavanti | tatra katrrā svatantraḥ, hituḥ, karmakartā ca, karma nirvatryaṃ vikāryaṃ prāpyaṃ ca, karaṇaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca, saṃpradānaṃ dadātikarmāpyaṃ karmamātrāpyaṃ ca, apādānaṃ nirdiṣṭaviṣayamanirdiṣṭaviṣayamupāttaviṣayamapekṣitakriyaṃ ca, adhikaraṇaṃ vaiṣayikamaupaśloṣikaṃ naimittikaṃ ceti | tañca kartṛbhadeṣu svatantraḥ samarthā'samarthassamarthāsamarthaḥ, saṃbandho'saṃbandhassaṃbandhāsaṃbandhaśca | teṣu samartho yathā vrajati, pacati, asti, śvetate | asamartho yathaā jāyate, viramati, naśyati, vikaroti | samarthāsamartho yathā caitrasya rujati, caitrasyāmayati, coraṃ jvarayati, coraṃ saṃtāpayati| saṃbando yathā priyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhaṃ bhavati, ripuṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamutpadyate, ramyaṃ śritvā didṛkṣā jāyate, rahaḥ prāpya ratirnirvartate | asaṃbandhoyathā mairau daugdhari dharitrīmadrayo duduhuḥ, pañcabhirhalaiḥ kṣetraṃ grāmaṇamīḥ karṣati, śaisairvālmīkirambhodhiṃ bandhayati, ujjayinyāḥ, prasthito māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryamudgamayati | saṃbandhosaṃbandho yathā bhavati pacati, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, bhavedapi bhavate, syādapi syāt | hetuḥ karmaprayojakaḥ kartṛprayojakaḥ hatuprayojakaḥ ahetuprayojakaḥ, hetvāhetuprayojakaśca | teṣu karma prayojako yathā gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ, pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate, gargāñchataṃ daṇḍaḍḍatdhti, kāśān kaṭaṃ karoti | kartṛprayojako yathā yajñadattaḥ pācayati, māṭharaḥ pāṭhayati, bhikṣā vāsavati, kārīṣo'gniḥ ādhyāpayati | karmakartṛprayojako yathārohayati hastinaṃ hāstipakaḥ, ārohayate hastinaṃ hāstipakaḥ, ārohayate hasti, niṣādayati kramelakamauṣṭrikaḥ, śrapayati yāvāgūṃ yajñadattaḥ, sādhayati odanaṃ sūpakāra iti | kathaṃ punaḥ, śrāyati, sidhyati? katrroryavāgvoḥ karmakartṛtvaṃ ghaṭate | śrātisidhyatī akarmakau karmakartaḍaḍḍatdhviṣayasya pacerarthe pravartate | etau punaḥ prākṛtaṃ vācyārthamāhaturiti | hetuprayojako yathāvīvadat pravīṇo vīṇāṃ parivādakena, apīpaṭhat kaṭho māṇavakaṃ māṭhareṇa, ajighrapat priyaḥ kusumaṃ kāntayā, adūduhat gāṃ valalvo gopālakena | kathaṃ punaḥ duhikartā kartṛprayojakasya hetutvaṃ duherantarbhūtaṇijarthatvāt vakṣyate hy antarbhūtaṇijarthānāṃ duhādīnāṃ ṇijantavat | siddhaṃ pūrveṇa karmatvaṃ ṇijantaniyamastāthā || iti | ahetuprayojako yathā, saṃparmayati, atihastamayati, abhiṣeṇayati, upaślokayati| hetvahetiprayojako yathā, putra upādhyāyamadhyāpayati, kanyā nadau na vartayati, yājyayājakau yājayati, kanyāvarau vivāhayati | karmakartā vikarmakartā prayojyakartā karmaprayojyakartā prakṛtikartā vikārakartā prakṛtivikārakartā ca | taṣu vikarmakartā yathāvakirate hastī, grathate mālā, prasnute gauḥ, cikīrṣate kaṭaḥ | prayojyakartā yathā pācayati devadattena, pāṭhayati viṣṇumitreṇa, bhārayatibhāraṃ vāhakena, kārayati kaṭaṃ varuṭena | karmaprayojyakartā yathārohayate niṣādaṃ kareṣuḥ, lāvayate pāmaraṃ kedāraḥ, darśayate rājā bhṛtyaiḥ, abhivādayate gururdevadattena | prakṛtikartā yathā kāṣṭhāni bhasmavanti, mabadbhūtaścandramāḥ, tvadbhavanti jātayaḥ, madbhavanti dāyādāḥ | vikārakartā yathā mūtrāya saṃpadyate yāvāguḥ, abhyuṣāya kalpate yavaḥ, ghaṭāya kapālau bhavataḥ, suvarṇapiṇḍaṃ, kuṇḍaḍḍatdhle bhavatiḥ | prakṛtivikārakartā yathā śaṅdhībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ, vargībhavanti gāvaḥ, vatso vṛṣassaṃpadyate, bālā pragalbhā bhavati, | sa eṣo'ṣṭādaśaprakāro'pi abhihitānabhihitaprayudajyamānāprayujyamānaphrasiddhaprakṛkatāpekṣitaipacārikaprakalpitānusyūtasāmānyādibhedādanekadhā kartṛbhedassaṃbhavati | tatrābhihito yathā bhavatā kṛtaṃ, tena supyate | prayujyamāno yathā tvaṃ pacasi, ahaṃ pacāmi | aprayujyamāno yathā pacasi, pacāmi | prasiddho yathā varṣati, heṣate | prakṛto yathā bhremuḥ vavalguḥ | apekṣito yathetyācakṣate, yamayuṅkta | upacarito yathā dhanurvidhyati, mañcāḥ krośanti | prakalpito yathātmano'pi nātmāno jāyante, ātmaivanātmānaṃ jānāti | vikalpito yathāhamanyo vā gacchati, anyo'haṃ vā gacchāmi | anusyūto yathā sa ca tvaṃ ca pacathaḥ, tvaṃ cāhaṃ pacāvaḥ | sāmānyo yathā pacati, paṭhati, ceti | ete ca bhedāḥ karmādiṣvapi yathāsaṃbhavamūhanīyā iti | vibhaktāḥ, tat kriyāpyaṃ karma, yadāha karturīsipsitatamaṃ karmeti | tattu trividhaṃ, nirvatye vikārthaṃ prāpyamiti | tatra yadavidyamānamutpādyate vidyamānaṃ janmādinā prakāśyate tannirvatryaṃ, yadaminirvṛttameva prakṛtyucchedena guṇāntarādhānena vā vikāramāpadyate tadvikāryaṃ, yasya kriyākṛtānāṃ viśeṣaṇāṃ sarvathānupalabdhistatprāpyam | tadupaktaṃ yadasajjayate sadvā janmanā yataprakāśate | tannirvatryaṃ vukārthaṃ tu karma ddhaidhā vyavasthitam || prakṛtyucchedasaṃbhūtaṃ kiñcitkāṣṭhādibhasmavat | kiñcidaguṇāntarāpattyā suvarṇādi vikāravat || kriyākṛtā viśeṣāṇāṃ siddhiryatra na gamyate | darśanādunumānādvā tatprāpyamiti kathyate || tatra nirvatryeti vikāryaprāpyadharmassvathadharmaśca vikārye prāpyadharmassvadharmaśca prāpye tu svadharma eva | kaḥ punarasāv ābhāso'vagamo vyaktissoḍhatvanamiti karmaṇaḥ | viśeṣāḥ prāpyamāṇasya kriyāsiddhau vyavasthitāḥ || virvatryavikāryayostu nivṛttikāryāveva | yathocyate nirvatryādiṣu tatpūrvamanubhūya svatantratām | katrrantarāṇāṃ vyāpāre karma saṃpadyate punaḥ || tatra nirvatryaṃ utpādyaṃ prakāśyamupasarjanaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavahitamaprāpyaṃ ca | teṣu yadastutpādyate tadutpādyaṃ, yathā śaṃyogaṃ vidhatte, sukhamutpādayati, vibhāgaṃ kurvate, duḥkhaṃ janayati | vidyamānameva yadāvaraṇāpāyādāvirbhavati tatprakāśyam, yathā śabaṃda janayati, putraṃ sūyate, tailaṃ kurutaṃ, payo dogdhi | apradhānabhūtamupasarjanaṃ yathā kaṭaṃ kartumārabhate, grāmo vāsayutumiṣyate, pakkaudano bhujyate, paktumodanaścanttayate | svānuraktapratyayajanakaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā bhūṣmamudāraṃ kaṭaṃ karoti, mahāntamavyaktaṃ śabdamuñcarayati, dīrghāyuṣaṃ guṇinamātmajaṃ prasūte, citramacchapaṭaṃ vayati | kriyāntareṇa vyavadhānavaddhavahitaṃ yathā māsamāste, godohaṃ pacati, kroṣamadhīte, kurūn gaccha svapiti | kālādhvabhāvadeśānāmantarbhūtaḥ kriyāntaraiḥ | sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatatvamupajāyate || sakarmikā'pi kriyā dravyādikarmaṇyeva niviśate | kālādikarmaṇi yathā māsamodanaṃ pacati, krośamanuvākamadhīte | ādhāratvamiva prāptāste punadrravyakarmasu | kālādayo bhinnakakṣyā yānti karmatvamuttaram || kriyāviśeṣaṇamaprāpyaṃ yathā sukhamabhidhatte, duḥkhaṃ nivartayati, mandaṃ gacchati, śīghramāyāti | kathaṃ punarupasarjanādīnām virvatryamānatā? yathā nirvatryamānasya yathāhyasau kaṭaṃ nirvartayati, evaṃ tadgatabhūṣmodārādikamapīti | evaṃ śabde'pi pakkodano bhujyata iti | aitratu pākenaudano nirvatryate, kevalaṃ sā'sya śaktiḥ, pradhānabhujikriyāviṣayakarmaśaktisannidhau paktyupasarjanībhūtākhyānena pradhānaśakyabhidhāne'bhidhāne'bhihitavat prakāṣate | puktumodanaścintyata ityatra pacyarthatvāt cintāyāḥ yadyapi pākasya vāstavamapradhānatvaṃ, tathā'pyākhyātapratyayena prādhānyaścintābhidhānāt pacikriyopasarjanaṃ bhavati | atastadviṣayā karmaśaktiḥ pradhānaśaktyabhidhāne'bhihitadbhavati | etena kaṭaḥ karthumārabhyate, grāmo gantumiṣyate ityapi vyākhyātam | nanu gamegrrāmaḥ, iṣerubhe karmaṇī, tatkasyātropasarjanatā? naivaṃ, iṣerūbhekarmaṇī iti yaducyate tatsāmathryapradarśanaparamavagantavyam | iṣyate grāmaṃ, kiṃ kartuṃ, gantuṃ grāmo grāmamiti vā, va na punariṣeḥ yugapadubhe karmaṇī saṃbhavataḥ |evamabhihite'pi kaṭādivadeva māsādīnāmāsanādibhirabhinirvatryamānatā pratīyate | tathā hi paktāro bhavanti iha sthito'yaṃ māsaṃ nirvartayatīti | evaṃ pacan godohamadhīyānaḥ krośaṃ, svapan gantavyaṃ kurvanti kramakālamiti gantavyānāmeva kurukrośādīnāṃ karmatvam | yadāha kālābhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām || iti | aprāpyaṃ yatkiyāviśeṣaṇatvāt, kriyāvadeva nirvatryamānaṃ tatkriyāyāḥ kathamiti cet puruṣavyāpārasāmānyāśrayaṇāt, aprāpyatvaṃ punastasya dhātvarthabhiprāyeṇa | nahyasau dhātvarthena prāpyate, apitu puruṣavyāpāreṇa | dhātvarthasya tu tatra karaṇatvam | viśvadajitā yajetetyādau dhātvarthanāmadheyebhyo viśvajidādibhyāḥ karaṇavibhaktidarśanādagniṣṭomayājītyādisiddhyarthaṃ karaṇe yajeti ca sūtrārambhāt | agniṣṭodayo hi svargādiphalabhāvanāyāṃ karaṇam | kāryamavināśyaṃ vināśyamīpsitamanīpsitamāsthitaṃ kartṛkarma ca | tatrāvināśyaṃ yathā suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍaḍḍatdhlīkaroti, kāṇḍaṃ, lunāti, kāntāṃ sādayati, priyaṃ sādayati | vināśyaṃ yathā kurūlaṃ bhinatti, kāṣṭhaṃ dahati, dhānāḥ pibati, udapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | īpsitaṃ yathā striyaṃ gacchati, payaḥ pibati | anīplasitaṃ yathā corān paśyati, dhanaṃ tyajati, viṣaṃ bhakṣayati, ahiṃ laṅghayati | kaḥ punareṣāṃ vikāraḥ? prakṛteranyathātvaṃ, na hi corādayo darśanādiviṣayā bhavanti | āsthitaṃ tathā panthānaṃ gacchati, nadīṃ tarati, parvatamārohayati, gartamuttarati | kaḥ punaranyato'sya bhedaḥ | ucyate tyāgarūpaṃ prahātavye prapye saṃdarśanādike | āsthitaṃ karma yattatra ddairūpaṃ bhajate kriyā || kartṛkarma yathā lūyate kedārassvayameva, pacyata odanassvameva, bhidyate kusūlassvayameveti | prāpyamapi prāpyaṃ prayojyaṃ parihāryamabhihitamanabhihicamatathitaṃ ca | tatra prāpyaṃ yathādityaṃ paśyati, himavantaṃ śṛṇoti, vedamadhīte, carcāḥ pārayati | prayojyaṃ yathā māṇavakaṃ gamayati, śiṣyaṃ bodayati, brāhmaṇamāsādayati, pattiṃ śāyayati | nanu ca? kāryametta, tanna, prayojakaḥ vyāpāramātrsayāvivanakṣitatvāt vikāryaścaiṣāṃsvakriyānibandhana iti | aparihāryaṃ yathā vibhāgaṃ janayan saṃyoganucchanatti, kaṭaṃ kurvan kāśānāharati, grāmaṃ gacchan vṛkṣamūlānupasarpati, āmikṣāṃ bhakṣayan vājinamāpnoti | abhihitaṃ yathoṣṭrāsikā āsyante, hataśāyikāśśayyante, raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, udapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | anabhihitaṃ yathā paśya mṛgo dhāvati, smarasi devadatta kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ, na marṣayāmi yattatra bhavān vṛṣalaṃ yājayet | bhāvarūpaṃ tu yatkarma tadihābhihitaṃ viduḥ | kriyārūpaṃ tu manyante karmānabhihitaṃ budhāḥ || athākathitaṃ, tadyathā gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ, pauravaṃ gāṃ yācate, vrajaṃ gāmavarūṇaddhi, māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati, pauravaṃ gāṃ bhukṣate, vṛkṣamapacinute phalāni, māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brute, māṇavakaṃ dharmamanuśāsti, śatānīkaṃ jayati, gargāñchataṃ daṇḍaḍḍatdhyati, upasaramaśvaṃ puṣṇāti, ambunithadhimamṛtaṃ mathnāti, śākhāṃ grāmaṃ karṣati, ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati, edhāt grāmaṃ harati, bhāraṃ grāmaṃ vahati, evaṃ nagaraṃ harati bhāraṃ, samāhartāramayutaṃ gṛhṇāti, kāśān kaṭaṃ karoti | kiṃ punarihākathitaṃ? payaḥ prabhṛti, kenākathitaṃ? lakṛtyaktastralarthādibhiriti | na hi payaḥ prabhṛtayo lādibhiḥ kathyante, apitu gavādayo yathā duhyate gauḥ payaḥ, suduhā gauḥ paya iti | yattu tairākhyāyate tadīpsitatamaṃ pradhānakarma prāgeva kriyāsaṃbandhāt | taduktaṃ yasmācchabdasya duhe bhavati gavā pūrvameva saṃbandhaḥ goduhinā payasastu prāktasmāllādayastasminnevaṃ sārādiṣvapa ānayanādibhyaḥ prāgeva nayatyādisaṃbandhāt lādibhirabhidhāne taddhitotpattiravagantavyā | tañcākhyānataḥ kathimucyate, taddhiparītamakathitamiti | druhiyācikathipracchibhikṣiciyāmityādi cidaṇḍiḍḍatdhmukhimasjīnāṃ gatyarthānāmakīrtite | nīvṛppahivṛhādīnāmupasaṃkhyānamiṣyate || asyārthaḥ druhyādīnāṃ ya upayogaḥ prapūraṇādistasya yannimittaṃ payaḥ prabhṛti yañca bruviśāsyoḥ kriyādharmadikaṃ samavāyena saṃbadhyate tadapādānādisaṃjñānāmavidhāne dvitīyāvātacyaṃ pradhānaṃ karmakathitaṃ ucyate | jiprabhṛtīnāṃ cāpradhānakarmaṇastatraivopasaṃkhyānamiti, anye tūpayujyata ityupayogaḥ payaḥprabhṛtiḥ, tasya yannimittaṃ gavādi bruviśāsiguṇena ca pradhānena dharmādikarmaṇā māṇavakādi yatsaṃbadhyate tadakathitamityācakṣate | tatpakṣe lādivācyānāṃ gavādīnāṃ prādhānyaṃ vyāhanyeta | akathitasaṃjñā ca nānārthā syāt | lādayaśca teṣāmapi te pradhānakarmaṇyeva yathājā nīyate grāmamiti | yathoktaṃ pradhānakarmaṇākhyeye lādīnāhurdvikarmaṇām | apradhāne duhādīnāṃ ṇyante kartuścā karmaṇaḥ || tānmitho viruddhārthatvādeṣāmevāvimṛśyavāditāmāpādayati | kathaṃ samāna eva yogakṣeme gavādīnāmaprādhānyaṃ, ajādīnāṃ ca prādhānyaṃ, kathaṃ vā pradhānaṃ gavādi lādibhirajādivadevābhidhīyate? kiñcāntarbhūtaṇijarthānāṃ duhādīnāṃ ṇijantavat | siddhaṃ pūrveṇa karmatvaṃ ṇijantaniyamastathā || asmin pakṣe gavādīnāṃ vyaktameva prayojyatvāt praksūtreṇaiva pradhānakarmatvaṃ | tathā ca gāṃ degdhi payaḥ ityatra gāṃ payaḥ kṣārayatītyarthaḥ | yato duhiḥ prapūraṇārthaḥ, pūraṇāmāpyāyanaṃ, prapūraṇaṃ tu virecanaṃ preraṇasthānādāvivārthavaiparītyādhānāt | yastu ṇijantādīnāmapi gatibuddhītyādinā karmasaṃjñārambhaḥ, sa pācayati devadattenetyādau prayojyasya kartuḥ karmasaṃjñāṃ nivartayanniyamārtho bhaviṣyatīti vibhaktaṃ karma karaṇamucyate | tatra kriyāṃ pratyupāttanyāpāreṣu karmādiṣu yadvyāpārānaṃtaraṃ kriyāsiddhivivakṣā tatkārakaṃ sādhakatamaṃ karaṇamiti | yadāha kriyāyāḥ pariniṣpattiḥ yadvyapārādanantaram | yadā vivakṣyate tasya karaṇatvaṃ tadā smṛtam || tadapi tredhā bāhyāmābhyantaraṃ bāhyābhyantaraṃ ca | teṣu bāhyaṃ kartṛrūpaṃ katrrāśritaṃ karmarūpaṃ karmāśritaṃ kriyāśritamanāśritaṃ ceti | tatra kratṛrūpaṃ yathaidhaiḥ pacati, senayā jayati, aśvena gacchati, nāvā tarati | katrrāśritaṃ yathākṣairdīvyati, dātreṇa lunāti, dhanuṣā vidhyati, paraśunā chinatti | karmarūpaṃ yathā pathā gacchati, antikena yāti, payasā bhuṅkte, yavāgvā jihoti, karmāśritaṃ yathā payasā odanaṃ bhuṅkte, pathā grāmaṃ gacchati, dvidroṇena dhānyaṃ krīṇāti, pañcakena paśūna bandhāti | kriyāśritaṃ yathā māsenādhīte, krośenādhīte, viśvajitā yajate, vidhinā vidadhāti | anāśritaṃ yathā stokena muktaḥ, ta kṛcchreṇa labdhaḥ, ālokena yāti, dīpikayā yāti | ābhyantaramapy āntaramavāntaramābhyantaramanantaraṃ samanantaraṃ pratyanantaraṃ bāhyābhyantaramiti | tatrāntaraṃ yathātmanā budhyate, svamupakramate, svataḥ prakāśate, anyonyato jānāti | avāntaraṃ yathā jātyā dirjanaḥ, prakṛtyā abhirūpaḥ, nisargeṇaryaḥ, svabhānena subhagaḥ | ābhyāntaraṃ yathāhaṅkāreṇa katthate, satvena sahate, rajāsā'nurajyate, tamasā muhyati | anantaraṃ yathā manasā modate, antarānācarati, pratibhayā paśyati, saṃskāreṇa smarati | samanantaraṃ yathā prayatnenārabhate, budhdyā jānāti, sukena śete, duḥkena paṭhati | pratyanantaraṃ yathā dharmeṇa vardhate, adharmeṇa patati,
