avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tarati, vidyayā'mṛtaṃ prāpnoti | bāhyābhyāntaramapi bahirmukhamantarmukhaṃ nirmukhaṃ bahirudrekamantarudrekaṃ nirudrekaṃ ca | taṣu bahirmukhaṃ yathā vidyayā'mṛtaṃ prāpnoti | bābyābhyāntaraṃ yathā cakṣuṣā paśyati, vācā vadati, iṅgitena kathayati, ākāreṇa jñāpayati | antarmukhaṃ yathā ghrāṇena jighrati, jibvāyā svādayati, sparśeṇa budhyate, śrotreṇa śṛṇoti | nirmikhaṃ yathā niśśaṅktatvena yātaḥ, nirbhayatvena yātaḥ, niṣkiñcanatvena muktam, nirāyudhatvena hataḥ | bahurudrekaṃ yathā padbhyāṃ gacchati, pāṇibhayāṃ spṛśati, saṃjñayā gamayati, pauṃstrena prīṇāti | antarudrekaṃ yathā balena varṣati, kauśalena pañcayati, abhiyogenādhīte, abhyāsena dhārayati | nirudrekaṃ yathā prāyeṇa yājñikaḥ, gotraṇa gāgryaḥ, abhijanena sauhyaḥ, śākhayā cchandogaḥ, iti | niṣkiñcanatvastokādīnāṃ sadabhāvā satvarūpatvādasādhakatvamiti cet tanna | yathaiva sannidhau tasya tathaivāsannidhāvapi | bhāvasya karaṇatvena kriyāsiddhiḥ pratīyate ||| stokatvāsyābhinirvṛtteranirvṛtteśca tasya vā | prasiddhiṃ karaṇatvasya stokakādīnāṃ pracakṣate || na ca karaṇasya vāstavaṃ rūpamasti vivakṣānibandhatvāt | taduktaṃ vastutastadanirdeśyaṃ nahi tadvastuni sthitam | sthālyā pacyata eṣā'pi vivakṣā dṛśyate yataḥ || na ca bhavati edhāḥ pacanti dhanurvidhyati cakṣuḥ paśyati mano jānāti karaṇamuktaṃ, saṃpradānamucyate, tantrividhaṃ dadātikarmāpyaṃ karmamātrāpyaṃ kriyāpyaṃ ceti | tatra saṃpradānamiti mahatyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ karaṇāt | samyagasmai pradīyate tadgavādinā dadātikarmaṇā prāpyamupādhyāyakaṃ saṃpradānasaṃjñaṃ bhavati, tat svasvatvanivṛttau parasvatvāpattau ubhayayoge svoparayoge ubhayopayoge ceti ṣoḍhā viprathate | svatvanivṛttau yathā śiṣyāya vidyāṃ prayacchati, varāya kanyāṃ viśrāṇayati, āptāyopadeśaṃ dadāti, gurubhya ātmānaṃ nivedayati | parasvatvāpattau yathā ripubhyo bhayaṃ dadāti, śatrave prahāraṃ prayacchati, vādine uttaṃra dadāti, devatāyai vācaṃ vitarati, priyatamāya śarīraṃ dadāti | vātāya cakṣurdadāti, pṛṣṭhāmātapāya sparśayati, gītāya karṇaṃ dadāti, śrutāya ceto vitarati | paropayoge yathā putrāyāśiṣaṃ prayacchati, chātrāya capoṭāṃ dadāti, bhītāyābhayaṃ prayacchati, ārtāyauṣadhaṃ dadāti | ubhayopayacoge yathā nāpitāya kṣuraṃ prayacchati, maitrāvarūṇāya daṇḍaṃ, dadāti, priyatamāyādharaṃ prayacchati, priyāyāṅkapālīṃ dadāti | “karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam” iti paribhāṣayā lakṣyamāṇaṃ karmamātrāpyaṃ, tadapi ṣoḍhā, praikamanumantṛnirākartṛ anirākartṛ prasyarpakaṃ apratigrāhakamiti | teṣu prerakaṃ yathā yācakāyānnaṃ dadāti, vṛddhimuttamarṇāya prayacchati, dvāsrthāyopacāraṃ kalrayati, dāyātadāya bhāgaṃ nirdiśati | anumantṛ yathā gāmupādhyāyāya nivedayati, sevakāya grāmaṃ nirdiśati, patiṃvarāyai varaṃ draśayati, dāsyai vastramatisṛjati | nirākartṛ yathā devāya puṣpaṃ kṣipati, kuborāya balimupaharati, rudrāya paśumālabhate, somāyādhryaṃ dadāti | anirākṛtaṃ yathonmattayauṣadhaṃ nirdiśati, vādine dūṣaṇaṃ dadāti, ṭaṅkāya daṇḍaṃ, korati, śākyāyāmiṣaṃ praṣayati | pratyarpakaṃ yathā śādineṣaśvaṃ nirdiśati, sannidhātre kośamarpayati, samāhatrre rāṣṭraṃ nivedayati, amātyāya mudrāmupanayati | apratigrāhakaṃ yathā devebhya uṣitānnaṃ dadāti, pitṛbhyo bhuktaśeṣaṃ prayacchati, andhāya rūpaṃ darśayati, badhirāya śāstramupadiśati | karmagrahaṇena kriyāyā api saṅgrahāt kriyayā yadāpyate tadapi saṃpradānaṃ kriyāvyāpyamiti ca bhavati, karmaṇo'smāt ko viśeṣa iti cedīpsitatamaṃ nāma | tadāpi ṣoḍhāśeṣaḥ karmaśeṣaḥ karma vyavahitaḥkarma hetuḥ nimittaheturitica | yadāha hetutve karmasaṃjñāyāṃ śeṣatve vā'pi kārakam | rucyarthādiṣu śāstreṇa saṃpradānākhyāmucyate || tatra śeṣo yathā devadattāya rocate, devadattāya svadate, devadattāya tiṣṭhate, devadattāya namate | karmaśeṣa yathā devadattāya gāṃ pratiśṛṇoti, devadattāya santaṃ dhārayati, devadattāya daivamīkṣate | karma yathā devadattāya rādhyati, puṣpāya spṛhayati, grāmāya gacchati, devebhyo namati | vyavahitakarma yathā chātrasya ślāghate, caitrāya śapate, hotre pratigṛhṇāti, potre anugṛhṇāti | heturyathā devadattāya krudhyati, devadattāya druhyati, devadattāyeṣryati, devadattāyāsūyati | nimittaheturyathaidhebhyo vrajati, śrāddhāya nigadate, yuddhāya sannahyati, patye śete iti | etena “rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ ślāghanhuṅasthāśāpāṃ jñīpsamānaḥ, dhāreruttamarṇaḥ, spṛherīpsitaḥ, krudhadruhetaṣryāsūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ, rādhīkṣyoryasya viprakṣaḥ, pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā, anupratigṛṇaśca, gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācatuthryau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani kriyārthāpapadasya karmaṇi sthāninaḥ” ityādivacanaṃ “karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānaṃ” mityādyayogsayaiva prapañcārthamityuktaṃbhavatītyavasitaṃ saṃpradānam | apādānamuṭacyate, “dhruvamapāye'pādānam”kāyasaṃsargapūrvake buddhisaṃsargapūrvake vā apāye yaddhruvamavadhibhūtaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tasyāpādānamiti saṃjñā | yathocyatāpāye yadudāsūnaṃ tadrūpaṃ yadi vā calam | dhruvameva tadāveśāttadapādānamucyate || tadapi trividhaṃ nirdiṣṭaviṣayamupāttaviṣayamapekṣitākriyaṃ ceti | taduktaṃ nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ kiñcidupāttaviṣayaṃ tathā | apekṣitakriyaṃ ceti tridhāpādānamucyate || teṣu yatropāttakriyoparādānenāpāyaḥ pratīyate, tannirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ | tat ṣoḍhojjhitamanujjhitanīpsitaṃ jihāsitaṃ pariṇataṃ nivṛttamiti | tatrojjhitaṃ yathā grāmādāgacchati, vṛkṣātparṇa patati, meṣādeṣo'pasargati, dhāvato'śvātpātitaḥ | anujjhitaṃ yathā śṛṅgāccharojāyate, himavato gaṅgā prabhavati, vaṭātpraroho laṃbate, agnerdhūma uñcarati | īpsitaṃ yathā yavebhyo gāṃ niṣedhati, māṣebhyo mahiṣān ruṇāddhi, kūpādandhaṃ vārayati, agnermāṇakamapasārayati | jihāsitaṃ yathāraṇyānniṣkrāmati, gartāttarati, parvatādavarohati, ākāśātpatati | pariṇataṃ yathā gomayādvṛściko jāyate, golomavilomebhyo dūrvai bhavanti, suvarṇātkuṇḍaḍḍatdhlamutpadyate, kāśauḥ kaṭo bhavati | nivṛttaṃ yathā prabhāvāddhīyate, prajñāyāḥ prabhraśyate, nyāyādapaiti, svarūpāt pracyavate | kathaṃ prabhāvānāṃ dhrauvyamiti cet śabdavyāpāratopāyābhiniveśaḥ, audāsīnyādyatropāttakriyāsamāmathryādavagamyamānakrāyāpadenāpāyapratītistadupāttaviṣayaṃ | tadapi ṣoḍhā śiddharūpaṃ sādhyarūpaṃ prāpyarūpamaprāpyarūpaṃ parihratavyaṃ nihartavyamiti | teṣu siddharūpaṃ yathā kulātpatati, kusūlātpacati, kāṃsyapātrayo bhuṅkte, brāhmaṇavchaṃsati, upādhyāyādadhīte | sādhyarūpaṃ yathādhyayanātparājayate, dharmātpramādyati, adharmājjugupsate, akṛtyādviramati | prāptarūpaṃ yathāsanātprekṣate, prāsādādavalokayati, balāhakādvidyotate, yauvanato vikurute | prāpyarūpaṃ yathā dyvaṅgānnaṃ bhokṣyate, āmṛtyoḥ śriyamākāṃkṣet, krośāllakṣaṃ vidhyati, āpāṭaliputrāt vṛṣṭo devaḥ | parihartavyaṃ yathaā corebhyo bibheti, durjanebhya udvijate, upādhyāyādvantardhatte, sahādhyāyibhyo nilīyate | nihartavyaṃ yathā corebhyo guhyaṃ trāyate, rogebhya āturaṃ rakṣati, kākebhyo dadhyavati, asatyādātmānaṃ pāti | yatrārthāprakaraṇādibhyo gamyamānāt kriyāpadādapādāya buddhistatadapekṣitakriyaṃ, tadapi ṣoḍhā | sāmānyakriyāpekṣaṃ viśeṣakriyāpekṣaṃ satvabhūtāpekṣamasatvabhūtāpekṣaṃ niyatarūpāpāyamaniyatarūpāpāyaṃ ceti | teṣu sāmānyakriyāpekṣaṃ yathā dānavebhyo devā buddhimantaḥ, surebhyo'surā voddhāraḥ, suhyā brahmottarebhya āḍhyatarāāḥ, pāṭaliputrebhyaḥ sukumāratarāḥ | viśeṣakriyāpekṣaṃ yathā pohaṇādratnam, payovāridharāt, kuto bhavān paṭaliputrāt | stavabhītāpekṣaṃ yathānyo devadattāt itaro devadattāta pṛthak devadattāt nānā devadattāt | astavabhūtāpekṣaṃ yatharte devadattāt | vinā devadattāt, ārāddevadattāt, dūroddevadattāt | niyatarūpāpāyaṃ yathā kaumidyā kṣarātruḥ, pakṣe kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māse, gavothumataḥ sāṃkāśyaścaturṣu yojaneṣu, pāṭaliputrādrājagṛhaṃ saptayojanāni | aniyatarūpaṃ yathā prāggrāmāt, dakṣiṇā grāmāt, tata uparuṣṭāt | anye tu dhruvamapāye'pādānamiti nirdiṣṭaviṣayaṃ, “bhūtrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ parājerasoḍhaḥ, antardhau yenādarśanamicchati, ākhyātopayoge, janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ, bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ, lyablope karmaṇaḥ upasaṃkhyānāṃ, saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye, “ ityādiyogoktamupāttaviṣayam | “pañcamī vibhakte, anāyarādiratarte dikśabdāñcūttarapadājāhi yukte, pratiḥ, pratinidhipratidānayoḥ, pratividhipratidāne ca yasmāt, ityādikaṃ tvavadhibhāvanādapekṣtakriyāmiti tridhā'pādānaṃ manyante | āhuśca nirdhāraṇe vibhakte yo bhītrādīnāṃ ca yo (va)vidhiḥ | utpātāpekṣitāpāyassdhruvaḥ pratipadyate || “ uktāmapadanam, adhikaraṇamucyate, “ādhāro'dhikaraṇam”, kartuḥ karmaṇo vā kriyāśraysaya kriyāṃ prati ya ādhārastadadhikaraṇam | taduktaṃ kartṛkarmavyavahitāmasākṣāddhārayat kriyām | upakurvat kriyāsiddhau śāstre'dhikaraṇaṃ smṛtam || tatrtredhā vaiṣayikamaupaśleṣikaṃ naimittikaṃ ceti | tatrtrividhamapi anekaprakāraṃ vinotīti viṣayo jātiguṇakriyādīmanāmāśrayaḥ, viṣaya eva vaiṣayikamiti, vinayādibhyaṣṭhak | tat ṣoḍhā jātivaiṣayikaṃ guṇavaiṣayikaṃ kriyāvaiṣayikaṃ dravyavaiṣayikaṃ saṃjñāvaiṣayikamiti | teṣu jātivaiṣayikaṃ yathā divi devāḥ, bhūvi manuṣyāḥ, jale matsyāḥ, pātāle pannagāḥ | guṇavaiṣayikaṃ yathāyuktaḥ kaṭakaraṇe kuśalaḥ kaṭakaraṇe sādhuḥ mātari nipuṇaḥ pirati pravīṇaḥ | kriyāvaiṣayikaṃ yathā prācyamāditya udeti, dakṣiṇasyāmagastyo dṛśyate, ākāśe śakunāḥ patanti, śabdādiṣu śrotradayo'bhiniviśante | dravyavaiṣayikaṃ yathā goṣu svāmī, goṣu dāyādaḥ, adhibrahmadatte pāñcālāḥ, adhipāñcāleṣu brahmadattaḥ| saṃjñāvaiṣayikaṃ yathā brahmaṇi pitāmahaḥ, viṣṇau puruṣottamaḥ, rudre maheśvaraḥ, indre śakraḥ | saṅketavaiṣayikaṃ yathā tarjanīmadhye udāttaḥ, kaniṣṭhikāmadhye'nudāttaḥ, anamikāmadhye svaritaḥ, madhyamāmadhye pracaya iti| upaśloṣovaṣṭambhaḥ | tasmai prabhavatyaupaśleṣikam | tadapi ṣoḍhaikadeśikamabhivyāpakaṃ sāmīpyakamaupaśleṣikamaupaśalyakamaupacārikaṃ ceti | teṣvekatadeśikaṃ yathā gṛhe tiṣṭhati, sthālyāṃ pacati, paryaṅke śete, śākhayāṃ lambate | abhivyāpakaṃ yathā tiseṣu tailam, śeleṣu rāgaḥ, gavi gotvaṃ, tantuṣa paṭaḥ | sāmīpyakaṃ yathā gurau vasita, tīrthe vasita, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ, kūpe gargakulam | aupaśleṣikaṃ yathā dvyahe bhoktā, kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māse, ihastho'yamaviśvasaḥ, krośe lakṣyaṃ vidhyati, pāṭaliputrādrājagṛhaṃ saptasu yojaneṣu | aupaśalyakaṃ yathopakhāryāṃ droṇaḥ, upaniṣke kārṣāpaṇaṃ, upavyāme vitastiḥ, upaśate paṃcāśat aupacārikaṃ yathā yo yasya priyassa tasya hṛdaye vasita, yo yasya dveṣyassa tasyākṣṇoḥ prativasati, same samagro muṣṭimadhye tiṣṭhati, aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāsta iti | nimittameva naimittikaṃ, tadapi ṣoḍhaiva deśanaumittakaṃ kālanaimittakaṃ bhāvanaimittikaṃ vastunaimittakaṃ karmanaimittikaṃ karmayoganaimitti kamiti | teṣu deśanaimittikaṃ yathā gehe modane, araṇye vibheti, jale śvabhre patati | kālanaimittikaṃ yathā kāṣāḥ puṣyanti medhānte madhau mādyanti kokilāḥ | puṣye pāyasamaśnīyānmaghāsu palalodanam || bhāvanaimittikaṃ yathā darśane prasīdati | varāhe viṣīdati, arthalāme hṛṣyati | arivināśe tuṣyati | vastunaimittikaṃ yathātape klābhyati, chāyāyāmāśvasiti, doṣoṣūddhijate, guṇeṣu rajyata iti | kramanaimittikaṃ yatheṣṭa yajñe parigaṇitī yājñikye, āmnātī chandasi, adhītī vyakaraṇe | kramayoganaimittikaṃ yathā carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayorhanti kuñcaram| vāleṣu camarūṃ hanti sīmni puṣkalako hataḥ || nanu ca nimittahetoḥ kārakatvat kārakasya ca prayojakaparantratvanādiha kathaṃ kārakatanmiti | ucyate dvividhaḥ kakārakahetuḥ, pravṛttaprerakaḥ apravṛttaprerakaśca | tatrādyo ṇijviṣayaḥ, itarastu vidhyādyātmako nimittātmakaśca | tayośca prathamo liṅaloṭtavyādivācyaḥ | taduktaṃ dravyamātrasya tu praṣapracchādeḥ loḍḍḍitdhvadhīyate | sakriyasya prayogastu yadā sa viṣayo ṇicaḥ || nimittātmakastu kriyāślayatvāt saptimīvācyo naimittikamadhikaraṇamiti vibhaktamadhikaraṇam | nanu ca upakhāryo droṇaḥ, adhipāñcāleṣu brahmadatta ityādau yadyidhikaraṇaṃmeva saptamī adhikaraṇaṃ kiṃ? ucyate “yasmādadhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī “ iti | ucyate kramapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā mā bādhiṣṭa iti | nanu ca “upapadāvibhakteḥ kārakavibhāktirbalīyasī”ti dvitīyā na bhaviṣyati | yathā gosvāmī vrajati devānāṃ nasaskarotīti | naivam, neyamupapadavibhaktiḥ, apitvantarbhatakriyāntarasaṃbandhā kramavibhaktiḥ | tadyathā śākalyasya saṃhitāmanu prāvarṣati, saṃhitāmanunigamyetyarthaḥ | kiṃ tarhi kiṃmarthaṃ vidhāyate kārakantare'pi yathā syāt te upārjanaṃ yoddhāra ityāpādāne'pi pañcamī bādhate | ata eva pañcamyapāṅparītyapādāne'pyarabhyati iti | etenādhītī vyākaraṇe, edhebhyo vrajatītyādayaḥ kārakavibhaktiviṣaye, goṣu svāmī, prāggrāmādityādiyaḥ saṃbandhivibhaktiviṣaye kārakavibhāktisāmāveṣāt prakāśitā bhavanati | nanu ca śaktissādhanaṃ tadvaśena dravyasya kriyāsu yogitvāt | kiñca dravyamapi sādhanaṃ klapayitvā sādhanabhedādapunārāśrayitanyāśśaktayaḥ saṃnyāstā eva satyabhedāssādhanamiti kalpitam | na ca tāsāmadhikaraṇadranavyametāvati dravyānapekṣasādhanatvaṃ, dravyasyāpi svarmaṇāyattajanmastadapekṣayā tulyādoṣatvāt | śaktīnāmeva ca sādhanatve pratyayābhihitāsu śaktiṣu dravyavacanānāmanuprayogo yujyate | vardhate devadattaḥ parigatamarthatatvaṃ iti dravye tu sādhane tasyābhihittavādaniprayogo na prāpvanoti | śaktīnāmeva ca kārakamadhye labhyate| dravyasya devadattāderekatvānmadhye dvahagādikālo na sebhavati | śaktīnāmeva ca sādhanatve prāsāde āsta iti dhañādiviṣayamadhikaraṇamabhihitaṃ, na tvāsiviṣyamityanabhihitaviṣayalakṣaṇā saptamī labhyate | dravye stayabhihitatvāt iti saktīnāmeva sādhanatve yo'yamekadravyādhikakaṇaḥ sādhanabedaḥ, śrṛyate, sa upapanno bhavati | vegena patito rugṇāt sphurato dhvamanirudita iti | dravye tasyaikatvānn saṃbhavati | kriyabhedanibandhano bhaviṣtītī ceti karmādiniyamo bādhyeta, pratītibhedaśca na syāt, tatra kriyāyā arthāntaratvāt | na hyanyasya bedaḥ, anyasmādbhidte | apica dravyasyaikatve kutaḥ kriyābedakaraṇabedaḥ kāryasyābedāt | śaktināmeva ca sādhanatve prātipadikādvibhaktayo yujyante| dravyasya tu prātipadikanābhihitatvāt anarthakā notpadyeran vacanāt svārthikā iti cet karmādiniyamo bādhyeta, prātītibhedaśca na syāt | vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣeṇeti asti cāsāvabhinne'pi prātipadikārthe tasmādarthāntaraṃ prātīpadikārthādvibhaktyarthaḥāḥ kārakamiti | naivam, śaktimaddravyaṃ kārakaṃ kriyāniṣpattāvupāttavyāpātatvāt | na cāśaktānna kriyāniṣpattirityetāvatī śaktyapakṣā tasya sādhanatvaṃ vihanti, śakterapi dravyapekṣatve tulyadoṣatvāt | na cānyāpekṣā kārakāṇāṃ kārakatvaṃ viruṇāddhi, kāryata evānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kārakatvāvagateḥ | kāryaṃ hi kasyacit saṃbhave'pyanavāpkasatkāraḥ punaravāpruvan sattāntarasya bhāva eva parigṛhītātiśayāntara, sy kāraṇatāṃ kusūlādau bījasamavadhāne'pyalabdhopalabdheraṅkurasya kṣityādisahakārigrāmabījasya samavadhānasaṃdṛśamānamūrteranvayakāryaṃ na pratītyate | api tu tadeva bījaṃ samavahitakṣityādisahakārakāripratyayamasya janakamitaratheti gamyate | dravyasyaikatvāt sādhanabhedaḥ, kathamiti cet ekadravyādhikaraṇāśśaktayo bhinnanarūpāḥ svarūpabhedenāśrayabedamupadadhantyo'bhedamadhikaraṇasya darśayanti | ekhasyāpi devadattādeḥ śilpabhedāttakṣāyaskārādisamākhyā arthabedavyavasthāṃ caratīti | tattūktam, dravye sādhane pratyayābhihitatvāttadinuprayogo na syāt | tatra sāmānyamabhihitaṃ, viśeṣo na prayokṣyate na vaktavyaṃ sādhane vidhīyamānaḥ pratyayaḥ kathaṃ sādhanaṃ sāmānyamabhidadhīta? sāmānyasya viśeṣāśrayatvāt viśeṣe eva vā pratyayainaikarūpatvādamanuprayogāpekṣiṇā'bhidhīyate gośabdenaiva prakaraṇādyapekṣiṇā gavādirartha iti | nanu cānyāpekṣayā viśeṣamabhidadhataḥ pratyayasya kathamabhidhānaśakternoparedhaḥ? yathā ganārdi abhidadhato gośabdasya śaktāvapari cetatsamānaṃ sādhanaśaktīnāṃ viśeṣe śabdasyābhidhānaśaktipratidhāta iti | naivaṃ, śaktārviśeṣa evocyate dhātoḥ kriyāviṣeṣavacanādeva pratyayotpatteḥ | sa ca kāryaviśeṣāśrayabhedābhyāmavadhāryate | tatra kāryabhedo dhātunaivābhihitaḥ, āśrayabhedaḥ punarapratītaḥ padāntareṇaivocyate | caitro maitra iti tathāpyanyāpekṣā tulyaiva | na cāśritāśrayayossāmānādhikarakaṇyaṃ ataścaitro vardhayatīti vana syāt, api tu caitro vardhata iti | api tu dhātuḥ kriyāviseṣavacana eveti kuta etadvardhate yāvadanena vardhayitavyaṃ, idaṃ karma kuryāḥ, nāgarakavṛttaṃ vartate, sāmānyenaiṣā na puṣyati, ityādau sāmānyasya viśeṣaḥ pratīyate | yattu devadattaiderdivyasyaikatavanmadhye dvayhādiḥ kālo na saṃbhavatītyucyate, tadapi na samyak, āśritopādhinimittasya bhedasyopapatteḥ | tathāhi, vaktāro bhavanti, paṭurbhavān, paṭurāsītaṃ, paṭutaraśśreṣṭhaḥ, adyānya evāsi saṃpanna iti tadevaṃ sāmathryabhedādāhitāvibhāgamadhikaraṇaṃ bhāgaśo'vacchidya sādhanabhedaḥ prakalpyamāno madhyamapyupakalpayati | na ca śaktipakṣe'pi sākṣānmadhyasaṃbhavaḥ pūrvaśakatikāle parasyāḥ parākāle tu pūrvasyābhāvāt | athāvā dvayhe bhoktetyavadhisapkatamī dvyahādebhoktetvayavadhireva pañacamī sa cāntyabhojanevacchidyeta | yadi tu madhyasiddhaye dravyabhedaśśaktibedaṣca klapyate tāda kartṛbhedātbhuktveti ktavāpratyayaḥ samānakartṛrakayoḥ pūrvakāla iti na syāt| upacitābhedāśrayassa iti cenmadhyaṃ na sidhyati | athaiktavāt bhuktikriyāyāṃ kārakaikatvakālabedāśrayaśca kārakabhedaḥ sattvo vrajatīti na syāt, snnānasṛprajyayāśca bhedāt tannimtyoḥ kartṛśaktyorapi bhede samānakartṛkatvābhāvāt | nanu cātrāpi dravyamāśritaśaktibedasaṃpāditanānātvaṃ sādhanaṃ tasyāpyeṣa doṣaḥ | api ca bhinnadhāravartitayā sāmathryayorabhedāmādheyaśaktivādinā śakyate vaktuṃ samānaḥ, katrreti | yasaya tu śaktibhedopanītasyadādhārasya bhedastasya nibandhanamucaritamapyekatvaṃ na vidyeta, apekṣaṇīyaścādhārabhedākriyābhedasya paurvāparyavataḥ apekṣitatvāt | atrocyate dravyasyaikatvena śaktyorekatvamucyate | śaktinānātvena ca dravyasyacāpi nānātvaṃ kakaraṣyate, dravyasya tu pāramārthikamapyekatvaṃ na mṛṣyata ityaho kāmacāraḥ | apitu śaktau sādhane paśau kartari hastikavāṭayoḥ katrroriti kathaṃ śaktirākhyā dhārāvacchinnā pratipādyate, pratipādyanāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pṛcchāmi paśau dravye yaḥ karteti cet upamānāt karturiti na prāpnoti | atha śaktibhedopakaraṇāḥ katrrādiśrutayaḥ tadapi kāraṇaṃ kāryayogitayā'vagamati | śuklādayaḥ rūpaviśeṣāśrayamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ | jitaṃ tarhi bhavatā, siddhaśśaktisādhanabhedaḥ katrrādiśrutibhirāśrayasya śaktimatobhidhānāt | kiñca śaktikārakapakṣe kama.....karmaṇo dvitve bahutve vibhaktivacanāditi na syāt | na hi guṇasya saṃkhyāsaṃbandho dṛśyate, pañca karmāṇi, caturo karmaṇo bhāvāstrayassaṃyogā dve sāmānye ekassamavāya iti | na cāyamupacāraḥ pratyayāviśeṣāt, evaṃ śaktayo'pi kāryabhedābhinnassaṅkhyābhedamanubhaviṣyanti | satyamasti śaktīnāṃ bhedaḥ, na tu tatrāpi te vacanabedaṃ, yasmādādityaṃ paśyati stautīti darśanādikriyābhedāt bhinnāsvapi śaktuṣu na bahuvacanaṃ dṛśyate | na paryāyoktau śaktayaḥ kriyābhirabhisaṃbadhyanta iti cenna | pratyekāsamāptā api kriyābhedāssamāsyābhidhāneṣu vacanabhedaṃ prayuñjate | yathā pañca śarānasyati, savyāpasavyābhyāṃ vidhyati, dvayoḥ paryaṅkayośśete iti | naca paryāyeṇaiva darśanādayassyuḥ yaugapadyenāpi bhāvāt | tasmātsāmathryadhāranibandhano vacanabhedo na śaktyāśraya iti | ata eva svātantryā vibhaktayā'pi śaktirnābhidhīyate | yadi hi svatantrāṃ śaktiṃ vibhaktirabhidadhyāt tadā dgatāmeva saṃkhyāṃ vibhaktirabhidadhīta, samānaśabdopādānāt na caitadasti | tasmādyasya saṃkhyāṃ vibhaktirupādatte tadeva śaktimatkārakamiti | yattu śaktāmeva vibhaktyarthe vartamānamavyayaṃ samasyate ityucyate tacchaktimatyapi kārake avyayānāmapi satvavacanāttanmātrābhidhānamiti kathaṃ satvabhūtaṃ dravyamasatvārthenāvyayenābhidhīyeta? yastu prāsāda āsta ityanabhihitalakṣaṇā saptamī na lakṣyata, iti tatra yathā ghañādiviṣaye śaktimaddravyamabhihataṃ, na tvāsiviṣayaśaktimaditi tatra na ca kena saptamī vāryate? yadi ca ghañādayaḥ śaktimabhidhīran tadā śakterasiśabdābhibahitāyāḥ śaktyantarāyogādāstāṃ saptamī dvitīyādayo'pi notpadyeran | kathaṃ caivamāha adhikaraṇādivacanāni prasādādayaḥ | te hi saṃjñāśabdā vṛkṣādivadeva keṣucidarthaviśeṣeṣu rūḍhāḥ kevalamamīṣāṃ dharmaniyamā vā yathākathāñcidutpattiṃ etena ca vegena patataḥ ityādau ye yamekadravyādhikaraṇā sādhanabhedaśrutiḥ sāpi prativihitaiva bhavati | na caitāvatā kārake prātipadikādayo notpadyaran | dravyaṃ hi vibhaktiliṅgaśaktisaṃkhyāliṅgavañca vibhaktivacanasaṃskāro labhyata ityataḥ sthitametacchaktimaddravyaṃ kāramiti | ākhyātapratyayābhidheyaṃ kāraviśeṣaḥ puruṣaḥ | sa tridhā prathamo madhyama uttamaśca | tatra parasmaipadātmanepadayoḥ prathamatrikābhidheyaḥ prathamaḥ, madhyamatrikābhidheyo madhyamaḥ, antayatrikābhidheya uttamaḥ | tatra ca pratyuktāparabhāvaścedupādhiḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ | tayoḥ śrutiviśeṣeṇa vācakau madhyamamottamau || tadāha yuṣmadi madhyamaḥ, asmadyuttamaḥ, śeṣe prathama iti | tatra kartari puruṣaprayogo yathāthā''ha vaṇīṃ vidito maheśvarastatadarthinī tvaṃ pura eva vartase | amaṅgalābhyāsaratiṃ vicintya tāvābhyanujñāṃ na tu kartumutsahe || karmaṇi yathā yadi tvaṃ manyase tena tvayā sa yadi toṣyate | tatkimāsthā na kopena dūti dadyāmahe vayam || athaiṣāṃ kkacit prathama eva yathā yuvābhyāmāsyate, asmābhirgaṇyate iti | kkacinmadhyama eva yathā kriyāsamabhihāratrayābhyāṃ sa samuñcayeṣu lunīhi lunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti, alāvīt laviṣyati vā, adhīṣvādhīṣvetyevamadhīyāte, adhyaiṣātāṃ adhīṣyete vā, rāṣṭramaṭa, maṭhamaṭa khadūramaṭetyevāvāmaṭāvaḥ, aṭiṣva aṭiṣyāmo vā, chando'dhīṣva vyākaraṇamadhītva, niriktamadhīṣvetyeva yamadhīmahe, adhyagīṣmahi adhyeṣyāhe vā, saktūne piba, dhānāḥ khādata, odanaṃ bhaṅkṣva ityevaṃ yūyamabyavaharata abhyavābāṣrṭa abhyavahariṣyatha vā | kkaciduttama eva yathā prahāse manyante, ehi manyante, rathena yāsyasi, duhi yāsyati, yātaste pitā, ehi manye odanaṃ bhokṣyate, na hi bhākṣyase, bhuktassotithibhiriti | manyatestu uttamaviṣaye'pi madhyama eva eva, tatrādyatrāyamarthaḥ, ehi manyase odanaṃ bhośyatha, iti | yugapadvatacane punaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ paro bhavati | yathā śa ca tvaṃ ca pacathaḥ, tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca pacāvaḥ, sa ca tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca pacāma iti | yugapadvacanatā caikaśeṣasya dvandvaḥ samānārthatvāñca arthaviṣayaiva gṛhyate, na cārthaviṣayā | tenāhaṃ vā kumbhakarṇo vā tvaṃ vā rākṣasapuṅgavaṃ | indrajidvā nikumbho vā vaheyurbhārabhīdṛśam | śeṣe prathama eva bhavati, tvamahamanyo vā gacchatviti || evaṃ tarhi cārthe yugapadvacanatāyāmabāvāt vaheyuriti bahuvacanaṃ na prāpnoti | naivam, vārtheṣu kkacidyugapadvacanatā dṛśyate | yathā dvau vā trayo vā dvitrā iti āha ca mahābhāṣyakāraḥ, dvau prayukte trayo vati gamyate, trayo vetyukte dvau veti gamyate | sauṣā pañcādhiṣṭhānavāk | tatra yuktaṃ bahuvacanaṃ sāmānyāśrayo vā bahuvacanam, yathā nākita bhavataḥ putrāḥ, kati te bhāryā iti bahutvaṃ saṃpadyate yasminnatasminyuṣmadāśrayā | pravṛttiḥ puruṣāsyāsti prakṛte ssā vidhīyate || yathā atvantaṃ saṃpadyate tvadbhāvati, ayūyaṃ yūyaṃ saṃpadyante yuṣmādbhavantīti, upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | prakṛtivikṛtyāśrayapuruṇasaṃpradhāraṇāyaṃ prakṛtyāśraya eva puruṣo bhavati, na vikṛtyāśraya iti | tena anahamahaṃ saṃpadyate madbhavati, avayaṃ vayaṃ saṃpadyante asmadbhāvanti, asassa saṃpadyate tadbhavati, anahamahaṃ saṃpadyate madbhavasītyādyapi siddhaṃ bhavati | kā punaratropapattiḥ? abhūtatadbhāve prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ kāmacāraḥ | tathāhi, kkacidvikateḥ kartṛtvaṃ vivakṣyate | yathā mūtrāya saṃpadyate yāvāguḥ, yathā ca suvarṇapiṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ punaraparayā ākṛtyā saṃpṛktaḥ khadirāṅgārasavarṇe kuṇḍaḍḍatdhle bhavati iti | tathāhi, klṛpi saṃpadyamāne yā caturthī sā vikārataḥ | suvarṇapiṇḍe, prakṛtau vacanaṃ kuṇḍaḍḍatdhlāśrayam | kkacittu prakṛteḥ, yathā śaṅghībhavanti brāhmaṇaḥ, mahadbhītaścandramā iti | atra yadi prakṛteḥ partṛtvaṃ na vivaśyatetadā vikṛtessaṅghasyaivakartṛtvādbhavantīti bahuvacanaṃ na prāpnoti | mahadbhataḥ ityatra ca mahacchabdasya ca mukhyārthātvādānmahatassamānādhikaraṇajātīyayorityātvaṃ syāt | prakṛtirhi kācidupacaritabikārarūpā, yathā indrasthūṇā upendrā grāva iti | kācitpariṇāminī yathā dugdhaṃ dadhi pūrvasyā asvāsthāyāḥ pracyutasyottarāmavasthāṃ prāptasya pūrvottarayoravasthayorāśritayossavyāpāravatvāt pūrvasyāvasthāyāṃ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāḥ saṅghamahadādervikāraśabdasya prakṛtyupagrāhiṇo gauṇatvaṃ vijñāyate | taduktaṃ mahattvaṃ saṅghabhāvaṃ ca prakṛtiḥ pratipadyate | bhedenāpekṣitā sā tu gauṇatvasya prasādhikā || iti | yadyevam, atimahatī mahatī saṃpannā mahadbhūtā brāhmaṇīti puvadbhāvo na prāpnoti, arthāśrayaḥ etadevaṃ bhavati | śabdāśrayaśca puvadbhāvaḥ, yathā go to ṇit, autoṃśasoriti bāhyīke | vartamānasya gośabdasya gostiṣṭhati gāmānayeti vṛddhirātvaṃ ca bhavati | te'mī kriyā ca kālaśca kārakaṃ puruṣastathā | uktāḥ padārthaścatvārassvaissvairbhedaissmanvitāḥ || dravyātmā cāpi kālo yaḥ psaṅgātso'pi kīrtitaḥ | sa hi prāyaḥ brabandheṣu tatra tatropayujyate || kriyāyāṃ kālontarbhavati puruṣaḥ kārakapade | pradhāne sopādhidvayamapi tedatanniviśate | pradhānaṃ taṃ prāhuryamabhidadhate ghañprabhṛtayaḥ | sahopaskārarthairnivasati sa tu prātipadike || iti mahārājadhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe kriyādyarthacatuṣṭayaprakāśo nāma caturthaḥ prakāśaḥ || <5> pañcamaḥ upādhyādyārthacatuṣṭayaprakāśaḥ prakṛtyrathapratyayārthadeṣu kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiviśeṣaḥ kriyā, tāmanupahitāṃ kṛbhvastayo vadanti | teṣāṃ parasparamasaṃbhedābhyāṃ sāmyotkarṣāpakarṣajanmānaḥ dvādaśa dhātvarthabhedāḥ kriyā bhavanti | tadyathākarmakāḥ, antaḥkarmakāḥ, arthānatarakarmakāḥ, avivatritakarmakāḥ, prasiddhakarmakāḥ, dvikarmakāḥ, prasiddhakartṛkāḥ, bhāvakartṛkāḥ, karmakartṛkāḥ, kartṛsthakriyāḥ, karmasthakriyāḥ, ubhasthakriyāśceti | te cāparispandasaparispandabhedāt pratyekaṃ dvidhā bhūtvā catirviṃśatirjāyante | tatra svabhāvatostiḥ tadudāsīnakartṛkatvādaparispandaḥ |karotiḥ prayuñcānakartṛkatvātsaparispandaḥ | bhavatiḥ vikurvāṇakartṛkatvātsaparispandāparispanda iti sthitam | ato'styarthāśca nyagbhavatayo nyagastayaścākarmakā bhavanti | teṣu pūrve aparisampandā yāta bhidyate, svadate, vartate, prīyate iti | uttare saparispanadāḥ yathā jāyate, vivardhate, spharatīti | ta eva nyakkarotayo'ntaḥ karmakāḥ, teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā jīvati, mriyate, putrīyate, prāṇitīti | uttare saparispandāḥ yatā nṛtyāti, śvasiti, vāṣpāyate, roditīti | astikarotyarthāḥ karotibhavatvarthāścārthaāntarakarmakāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā tarati kāṣṭhaṃ, tarati vipadaṃ viparyasti matiṃ, viparyasyati hastamiti | uttare saparispandāḥyathā vahati bhāraṃ, patati parṇam, patatyadhvānamiti | ata evanutkarotayo'pi vivakṣitakarmakāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā śaṃjñā saṃjñinyabhiniviśate, buddhistattvamabhiniviśate, tīrthe upavasati, trirātramupavasatīti | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā caitro hasati, maitro hasati, cakraṃ bhramati, deśādbhramatīti | utkarotayastu, ta eva prasuddhakarmakāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yatā vapatītyukte bījamiti gamyate, pariṇayatītyukte kanyāmiti gamyata iti | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā kṛṣatītyukte kṣetramiti gamyate, prasūta ityukte garbhamiti gamyata iti | satyevotkarotitne nyagāstayo nyagbhavatayaśca ta eva dvikarmakāḥ |teṣu pūrve apiraspandāḥ yathā liṅge liṅginamavagamayati jñātāraṃ, jayati śatamaśvānaśvasenamiti | uttaresaparispandāḥ yathā gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ, vṛkṣamapacinoti phalānīti | evamete ṣaṭ viyodavikalpāḥ paraṃ triyogavikalpāḥ ṣaḍḍḍatdhbhavanti | tatrodastaya udbhavatayo vā prasiddhakartṛkāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā dahatītiyukte vahniriti gamyate | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā kūjatītyukte puka iita gamyate, heṣata ityukte asaśva iti gamyata iti | nyagbhavatikarotayo nyagastikarotayo vā bhāvakartṛkāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā cerasya rujati, corasyāmayati, coraṃ jvarayati, coraṃ saṃtāpayatīti | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, bhavedapi bhavet, syādapi syāditi | udastinyakkarotaya udbhavatinyakkarotayo vā karmakartṛkāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā dugdhe gossnaॉvayameva, prasūte gaussvayameva, vṛṇīte kanyā svayameveti | uttare saparispandāḥ yathāvākirate hastī svayameva, ucchrayate daṇḍaḍḍatdhssvayameva, namate daṇḍaḍḍatdhssvameva, ārohayate hastī svayameveti | udastakarotayaḥ udbhavatikarotayo vā kartṛsthakriyāḥ | teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathārhati pūjāṃ, jānāti varṇe, paśyati rūpaṃ, śṛṇoti śabdamiti | uttare saparismapandāḥ yathā gacchati grāmaṃ, ārohayatyāśvamiti | nyagbhavatyutkarotayo nyagastyutkarotayo vā karmasthākriyāḥ | teśu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā dunoti śatruṃ, dhinoti mitraṃ, madayati suhṛdaṃ, sukhayati sakhāyamiti | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā pacatyodanaṃ, bhinatti kusūlaṃ, saṃkṣṇute ślakṣṇayate vā śastraṃ, takṣṇoti vā ubhayasthakriyāḥ |teṣu pūrve aparispandāḥ yathā labhate pūjāṃ, prāpnoti dharmaṃ | uttare saparispandāḥ yathā bhuṅkta odanaṃ, adhīte svādhyāyaṃ, tapyate tapaḥ, sādhayati svargāmiti | nanu ca, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt, bhavedapi bhavet, syādipi syāditi naitānavastibhavatyarthāvapi tu sākṣādastibhavatī | tau cānupahitakriyābhidhāyakāviti nopādhībhavitumarhataḥ | ucyate, asabhuvi, bhūsattāyāmiti dhātupāṭhādanuprayogavarjamārdhadhātuke'sterbhūvidhānātsaṅkaraḥ eveti vijñāyate | evamapi kārotyarthānupraveśo durupapādaḥ | so'pi kartṛtvānvayathānupapatterupapadyate | nanu ca, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīdītyayaṃ laṭ prayoga eva | astigacchāmo vayamiti ca astiprayogo'pi bhāvakartṛkeṣu dṛśyate | naivam, nāsmābhirastibhavatī bhāvakartṛkāvucyete | api tu astibhavati kartāro'styādayaḥ pacatyādayayaśca | te hi rujātyādivadupadhirā apyastau kartāro bhavanti | etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ rūjādīnāṃ kartṛtvaṃ tatpareṇaiva lakāreṇocyate | pacādīnāṃ ca bhavatyastipareṇeti, yathā ca dhātvarthaḥ kriyoṣādhirevaṃ kālepi | yaduktaṃ kiyāpādhiśca saṃbhūtabhāviṣyadvartamānatāḥ | parāparavibhāgārthāssaśaktiḥ pratipadyate || sa bhūtādibhedāddhādaśādhā | tadyātā bhūtaḥ, bhūtānadyamaॉtanaḥ, bhaviṣyat, bhaviṣyadanadyatanaḥ, vartamānaḥ, vartamānānadyatanaḥ, parokṣaḥ, atapannaḥ, avyaktaḥ, saṅkīrṇaḥ, prakīrṇaḥ, viprakīrṇa iti | luṅādiviṣaśayo'ṣyatītamātraṃ bhūtaḥ, sa ṣoḍhā bhūtaḥ, prakarṣabhūtaḥ, bhūtānadyatanaḥ, abhimānādyatanaḥ, prabandhādyatanaḥ, sāmīpyādyatanaḥ iti | teṣvanirdhāritaviśeṣo bhūto yathākarṣīt, niṣasāda, uvāsa, śuśrāva, apakta, paktavāniti | śabdāntarāvagataprakarṣādanavekṣitānadyatanaparokṣādipratyayaḥ prakarṣabhūtaḥ yathāvātsuriha purā cchātrāḥ | vivakṣitānyāvadhirbhūtānadyatanaḥ, yathānyāmagāmaghoṣāt | rātriśeṣo jāgaraṇasaṃtatāvabhimānānadyatanaḥ, yathāmutrāvātsam, kaॉsakalāṃ rātriṃ jāgaritaḥ, rātrerabhāttavādadyatanamina kālaṃ manyate| avivakṣitakriyāvirāmaḥ prabandhādyatanaḥ |yathā yāvajjīvaṃ bhṛṣamannamadāt | vivakṣitakriyānantaryaḥ sāmūpyādyatanaḥ sāmītyādyatanaḥ | yathā yeyaṃ gatā paurṇamāsī asyāmupādhyāyo'gnīnādadhīta | atrānantarayornā'nadyatanavat kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoriti smaryate | evaṃ laṅnimittamavidyamānādyatano bhūtādyatanaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā śāmānyānadyatanaḥ, viśeṣānadyatanaḥ, abhijñānadyatinaḥ, prasiddhāparokṣaḥ, praśnāparokṣaḥ, haśaśvadaparokṣa iti | teṣvavivakṣitaparokṣatvādiḥ sāmānyānadyatanaḥ | yathā yāvajjīvaṃ bhūśamannamadāt | vivakṣitakriyānantaryaḥ sāmīpayādyatanaḥ | yathā yeyaṃ gāta paurṇamāsī asyāmupādhyāyo'gnīnādadhīta | atrānantarayorvā'nadyatanavat kriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoriti smaryate | evaṃ laṅnimittamavidyamānādyatano bhūtānadyatanaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā śāmānyānadyatanaḥ, viśeṣānadyatinaḥ, abhijñānadyatanaḥ, prasiddhaparokṣaḥ, praśnāparokṣaḥ, haśaśvadaparokṣa iti | teṣvavivakṣitaparokṣatvādiḥ sāmānyānadyatanaḥ | yathākarot, aśṛṇot, nyaṣīdat, amutrāvasam, āsīdidaṃ tamo bhūtaṃ, rāmo vanamagacchāditi | padāntarāvagataparokṣatvādiviśeṣo viśeṣāvadyatanaḥ | yathāvasanniha purā chātrāḥ | na yadītyābhijñāvacanaṃ lṛḍaḍḍatdhpavādo'bijñānadyatanaḥ, yathā śmarati devadatta kāśmīreṣu yadavasamāma | lokaprasiddherāropitāparokṣābhimānaḥ prasiddhaparokṣaḥ, yathājayajjayanto hūṇān | praśnopabhūktaparokṣatvaṃ praśnāparokṣaḥ, yatā kimagacchaddevadattaḥ | haśaśvadarthopakṣīṇāparokṣatve haśaśvadaparokṣaḥ, yatheti hākarot śaśvadakaroditi | anāgatamātraṃ lṛḍādiviṣayo bhaviṣyatprabandhādyatanassāmīpyādyatanaḥ pravibhāgādyatana iti | teṣvanirdhāritānadyatanādiḥ sāmānyabhaviṣyat, yathā kariṣyati, balirindro bhaviṣyati, kadā gamiṣyati? eṣa gamiṣyāmi, pakṣyan vrajati, pācako vrajatīti | nirdhāritādyatvaviśeṣo viśeṣabāviṣyati, yathādya gamiṣyāmīti | avivakṣitakriyāvirāmaḥ prabandhādyatanaḥ, yathā yāvajjīnaṃ bhṛśamannaṃ dāsyatīti | vivakṣitakriyānantaryassāmūpyādyatanaḥ, yathā yeyamāgāminī paurṇamāsī asyāmupādhyāyo'gnīnādhāsyatīti | bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane parasminkālavibhāgecānahorātrāṇāṃ parasminvibhāṣeti pravibhāgānadyatanaḥ, yathā yoyamadhvā gantavya āpājaliputrattasya yadavaraṃ kauśāmbyāstatraudanaṃ bhokṣyamahe | yo'yamāgāmī saṃvatsarastasya yadavaramāgrahāyaṇyāstatra yuktā adhyaṣyāmahe | evaṃ parasminvibhāṣetyapi draṣṭavyamiti | bhaviṣyannevāvidyamānādyatano luṇṇimittaṃ bhaviṣyadanadyatanaḥ, sa ṣoḍhā śāmānyānadyatanaḥ, lipsānadyatanaḥ, paridevanānadyatanaḥ, yathā kartā kartārau kartāraḥ, kāritā kāritārau kāratāra iti| | śabdāntarāvagataviśeṣo viśeṣānadyatanaḥ, yatā tvaṃ paktā | lipsopādhiko lipsānadyatanaḥ, yatā yo me gantā yaivaṃ pādau nidadhāti, ayaṃ mu kādadhyetā ya evamanabhiyuktaḥ | kālavibāge cānahorātrāṇāmityāhorātraviṣayaḥ parāparavibhāgīyaḥ | yathā yo'yamāgāmī saṃvatsastasya yadavaramāgrahāyaṇyāstatra pāṭaliputraṃ gavantāsmaḥ | sa eva adhvavibhāṣāviṣayo'dhvāvibhāṣīyaḥ | yo'yamadhvā gantavya āpāṭaliputraṃ tasya yatparaṃ kauśāmbyāḥ tatra siktūnpātāsma iti | avāptāpracyukriyāviṣayo laḍādinimittaṃ vartamānaḥ | sa ṣoḍhāsāmānyavartamānaḥ, viśeṣavartamānaḥ, avipāmavartamānaḥ, pravṛttoparaḥ, vṛttāvirataḥ, nityavṛtta iti| teṣvānapekṣitavirāmādiviśeṣassāmānyavartamānaḥ, yathāsti, bhavan, kurvāṇāḥ, pacyamānaḥ, pavamānaḥ, patradudvahamāna iti | porakṣādajiviṣayo viśeṣavartamānaḥ | atra vaṭe yakṣaḥ prativasati | vivakṣitakriyāprabandho'virāmavartamānaḥ, yathā prāsādaṃ korati | vivakṣitapravṛttivirāmaḥ pravṛttoparataḥ, yathā jīvantaṃ mārayati | avivakṣitapravṛttivirāmo vṛttāvirāmo vṛttāvirataḥ, yatheba kumārāḥ krīḍaḍḍatdhnti |avicchinnapravṛttisaṃtāno nityapravṛttaḥ, yathā tiṣṭhati parvata iti | anāgatātikrāntakriyāsvapi pādantaraprayogāpāditavartamānatvāllaṭo nimittamāvidyāmānānadyatano vartamānādyatanaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā lipsāviṣayaḥ, āśaṃsāviṣayaḥ, puroyogīyaḥ, snayogīyaḥ, ubhayayogīyaḥ, anubhayayogāya iti | teṣu lipsāviṣayo yathā yo me bhikṣāṃ dadāti svargaṃ yāti, ko me bhikṣāṃ dadāti lokaṃ yāti, evaṃ kataro me bhikṣāṃ dadāti, katamo me bhikṣāṃ dadāti | āsaṃsāviṣayo yathā devaścedvarṣati saṃpadyante śālayaḥ | purāyogīyo vasantīha purā chātrāḥ | smayogīyo yatheti smopādhyāyaḥ kathayati | ubhayayogīyo yathā naḍeḍḍatdhna smapurādhīyate | anubhayayogīyo yathā bhāṣate rāghavastadeti | bhūta eva liṅviṣayo'kṣāṇāṃ paraḥ parokṣaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā śvarokṣaḥ, paraparokṣaḥ, svapararokṣaḥ, manaḥparokṣaḥ, pramāṇaḥparokṣaḥ, nirṇayaparokṣaḥ | teṣu svapekṣayā porakṣo yathā cakāra cakāra, cakāsāñcakāra, uṣuriha purā chātrā iti | parāpekṣayā paraparokṣaḥ, yathā kaḥ kaliṅgādviveḍhaḥ, ko brāhmaṇāndadarśa, nāhaṃ kaliṅgān jagāmeti | ubhayāpekṣayā svaparaparokṣaḥ, yathā jaghāna kaṃsaṃ vīsudevaḥ, dadāha tripuraṃ haraḥ, mamātha vṛtraṃ madhaveti | smaraṇāpokṣayā manaparokṣo yatheti cakāra, śaśvaḍhcakāra, iti ha, śaśvañcakāreti | praśne cāsannakāla iti nirṇayaparokṣaḥ, yathā kiṃ sā jagāma tatpāśrvaṃ, kimuvāca yathocitaṃ, sa kiṃ śuśrāva tadvākyamiti, pṛcchāmi kiṃ sakhīti | bhaviṣyadbhūtavartamānakriyātipattiviṣayo lṛṅnimittamatipannaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā bhaviṣyadbhatavarmamānakriyātipattīnāṃ śuddhāmiśrabhedāt | tatra kenacilliṅgena bhaviṣyantīṃ śuddhāmeva kriyātipattimavagamya prayuṅkte | yathāpi vajrāhatenāpatiṣyat, kathaṃ nāma tatrabhavān vṛṣalamayājayiṣyat | dakṣiṇena cedayāsyāt na śakaṭaṃ paryābhaviṣyat | yathā ca sadbhiḥ pradiṣṭena pathā samacariṣyatha, na te samacariṣyanna caraṇānte na bhūtayaḥ | evaṃ miśrāmapi yathā rāmāya puṇyamahase sadṛśāya sītā dattaiva dāśarathicandramase'bhāviṣyat | āropaṇena paṇamapratikāryamāryastraiyambakasya dhaniṣo yadi nā'kariṣyat || kecanalliṅgenānītāṃ kriyātipattiṃ śuddhāmevāvagamya prayuṅakte | yathā na śraddadhe yattatrabhavānvṛṣalamayājayiṣyat | na saṃbhāvayāmi tatra nābokṣtayata bhavān | yathā ca durvacaṃ tvadatha mā sma bhūnmṛgastvayyasau yadakariṣyadojasā | nainamāśu yadi vāhinīpatiḥ pratyaratsyata sitena patriṇā || evaṃ miśrāmapi paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīyaśobhaṃ na cedidaṃ dvandvamayojayiṣyat | asmindvaye rūpavidhānayatnaḥ patyuḥ prajānāṃ vitatho'bhaviṣyat || kenacitpramāṇena vartamānāmapi kriyātipattiṃ śuddhāmevāvagamya prayuṅakte | yathotākariṣyat, apyakariṣyat | yathā ca gāmadhāsyatkathaṃ nāgo mṛṇālamṛdubhiḥ phaṇaiḥ | ārasātalamūlāttvamāvālambiṣyathā na cet || evaṃ miśrāmapi yathāmaṅkṣyadvasudhā toye cyutaśailendrabandhanā | nārāyama iva śrāmānyadi tvaṃ nādhariṣyathāḥ || iti |. tirobhūtabhūtabhaviṣyadādiviśeṣo'vyaktaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā liṅviṣayaḥ, loṅviṣayaḥ, laḍḍḍitdhvaṣayaḥ, lṛḍḍḍitdhvaṣayaḥ, tavyādiviṣayaḥ, tumunādiviṣayaśceti | teṣu liḍḍḍitdhvaṣayo yathā kaṭaṃ kuryāt, ciraṃ jīyāt, kathaṃ tatrabhāvān vṛṣalaṃ yajayet, api śirasā parvataṃ bhidyāt, saṃbhāvayāmi bhuñjītabhavān, kālo'yaṃ yadbhūñjīta bhavāniti | loḍḍḍitdhvaṣayo yathopādhyāyascedāgacchati āgantā āgamiṣyati vā, atha tevaṃ chando'dhīṣva | kuru kaṭaṃ prāptaste kālaḥ kaṭakāraṇe, ciraṃ jīvatu bhavān kimiha bavān karotu, lunīhi lunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti alāvīt laviṣyati veti | laḍḍḍitdhvaṣayo yathā kadā bhuṅakte karhi bhuṅkte, api natrabhāvan vṛṣalaṃ yājayati, jātu tatrabhavānvṛṣalaṃ yājayati, kañcijjīvati me māta, kaṃ vā vibhūtayo na madayantīta | lṛḍḍḍitdhvaṣayo yathāndho nāma parvatamārokṣyati uta daṇḍaṛ patiṣyati, kataro nāma vṛṣalaḥ, yaṃ tatrabhavān vṛṣalaṃ yājayiṣyati, na marṣayāmina śraddadhe nāvakalpayāmi yattatrabhavānvṛṣalaṃ yājayīṣyati, pratyekaṃ viniyuktātmā kathaṃ na jñāsyasi, prabho, iti | tavyādiviṣayo yathā śvādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ, brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ, pitaro vandanīyāḥ, guravo mānanīyāḥ, kṛtyaṃ na bāvayet, kāryaṃ na kuryāditi | tumunādiviṣayo yathā bhoktumaicchat icchati eṣiṣyati vā, bhuktvā abrājīt vrajati vrajiṣyati vā, adhītyāsnnāsīt snnāti snnāsyati vā, coraṅkāramākrukṣat ākrośati ākrokṣyati vā, pāyaṃpāyamāsisīṣṭa āste āsiṣyate vā, raipoṣamapuṣat puṣyati pokṣyati veti | kālāntarasampṛktassaṅkīrṇaḥ, saṅkaraścānekākāratvādivattayā na śakyate nirdiṣṭumiti bhaṅnirvāhārthaṃ tu ṣoḍhaivodāhiyate | sa bhūtabhītānadyatanayoḥ yathānyebhyo vā abuṃkṣmabi | bhaviṣyadbhaviṣyadyanadyatanayoryathādya śvo vā gamiṣyati | bhūtabhaviṣyadanadyatanayoryathāgniṣṭomayājakasya putrau janitā | bhūtānadyatanabhaviṣyatoryathā bhāvikṛtyamāsīt | vartamānaparokṣayoryathā krodhaṃ prabho saṃhara saṃhareti yāvadgiraḥ marūtāṃ caranti | tāvatsa vahnirbhavanetrajanmā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ madanaṃ cakāra || bhaviṣyadvartamānaparokṣāṇāṃ yathā sāṭomurvīmaniśaṃ nadanto yaiḥ plāvayiṣyanti samantato'mī | tānyekadeśānnibhṛtaṃ payodhesso'mbhāṃsi meghānpibato dadarśa || iti | vartamānasya bhaviṣvadbhūtayoranuprasene prakīrṇaḥ | sa bhaviṣyadanupraveśe āśaṃsāyāṃ yathopādhyāyaścedāgacchati yuktā vyākaraṇamadhīmahe | lipsāyāṃ yatā kopayato bhojayati yāvat | purāyoge yatā yāvadbhuṅakte, parā vrajati | sāmīpye yathā kadā grāmaṃ gamiṣyasi, eṣa gacchāmi, gacchantameva māṃ viddhi | evaṃ bhūtānupraveśe'pi bhūtasāmīpye yathā kadā grāmādāgato'si? eṣa āgacchami, āgacchantameva māṃ viddhi | pṛṣṭāprativacane yathāyi bhoḥ kaṭamakārṣīḥ, kaṭaṃ devadatta nanu karomi, ayaṃ nu karomīti | bhaviṣyato bhūtānupraveśe bhūtasya bhaviṣyadanupraveśāṃ viprakīrṇaḥ | sa bhaviṣyato bhūtānupraveśe yathā śmarasi devadatta kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ, abhijānāsi kaliṅgeṣu vatsyāmaḥ tatraudanaṃ bhokṣyāmahe, smarasi yatkāśmīreṣu vatsayāmaḥ yattatraudanaṃ bhokṣyāmaha iti | yathā vā smaratyado dāśarathirbhavanbhavānamuṃ vanāntādvanitāpahāriṇam | payodhimābaddhacalajjalāvilaṃ vilaṅghya laṅkāṃ nikāṣā haniṣyati || iti | bhūtasya bhaviṣyadanupraveśo yathā māsma kārṣīḥ, māsma karoḥ, devascedvṛṣṭassampannāḥ śālayaḥ iti | yathā vāpakartā'hamasmīti mā te manasi bhūdbhayam | mā sma samīntinī kācijjanayetputramīdṛśam |. jātaścāyaṃ mukenduste bhrukuṭīpraṇayī punaḥ | gataṃ ca vasudevasyakulaṃ nāmānaśeṣatām || iti | atha kathaṃ nityapravṛttasya vartamānaprāptāvapi tasthuḥ sthāsyanti girayaḥ, mārge kūpo'bhūt, kūpo bhaviṣyatīti bhūtabhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaḥ prayogo bhavati | ucyate | hehayādiveśeṣu ye rājāno babhuvuḥ teṣāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ tāsāmatītatvat tatsambandhavivakṣāyāṃ bhūtakālaviṣayaṃ pratyayaṃ prayuṅkte, hehayarājye'pi parvatā ityanena tasthuriti | tathā āgāmimanvantareṣu ye rājāno bhaviṣyanti teṣāṃ yāḥ kriyāstāsāṃ bhaviṣyatvāttatsambandhavivakṣayāṃ bhaviṣyatkālaviṣayaṃ pratyayaṃ prayuṅkte | yadā balirindro bhaviṣyati tadāpītthameva parvatāḥ sthāsyantīti | evaṃ kūpasyāpi bhūtabhaviṣyaddarśanakriyāsambandhāt abhūdabhaviṣyatīti kriyābhisambandho na virudhyata iti | upagraho'pi prakṛtyarthopādhireva | kaḥ punarasau parasmaipadātmanepadobhayapināmātmanepadaparasmaipadayoganimittamarthaviśeṣaḥ | taduktam | ya ātmanepadādbhedaḥ kkacidarthasya gamyate | parasmaipadato vāpi manyante tamupagraham || yathā nāthati nāthate, śapati śapate, āhvayati āhvayate, pratijānāti pratijānīta iti | atrāśiṣi nāthaḥ, śapa upālambhane, spardhāyāmāḍaḍḍatdhḥ, sampratibhyāmanādhyāne, jñā ātmanepadaṃ, śeṣe parasmaipadamityarthabhedāḥ | evaṃ miṇḍo bhīṣayate, kuñcikayainaṃ bhāyayati, jaṭilo vismapayate, matyainaṃ vismāpayati | śyeno vartikāmullāpayate, kastvāmullāpayati, saṃpravadante grāmyāḥ, saṃprapadanti śakunaya iti | atra bhīsmyorhecatubhaye, liyaḥ sammānanaśālimīkaraṇayośca, vyaktavācāṃ samuñcāraṇe, vada ātmanepadaṃ, śeṣe parasmaipadamityarthabhedaḥ | evamanayadapyūhanīyam | nanu ca, “ya ātmanepadāt bhedaḥ kkacidarthasya gamyata” ityatra kkacidnrahaṇaṃ kimartham? ucyate | parasmaipadātmanepadobhayapadananāmātmanepadapasasmaipadobhayapadayogaḥ ṣaṭ prakāro bhavati | prakṛtinimittaḥ, prakṛtyarthanimittaḥ, pratyayanimittaḥ, pratyayārthanimittaḥ, upaskāranimittaḥ, upaskārārthanimittaśca | tatrārthanimitteṣu yathāyogamarthāvagatihetutvaṃ vidyate, śeṣeṣu tu na vidyate | kkacidnrahaṇena jñāpayati | tatrātmanepadayogaḥ prakṛtanimitto yathānudāttaṅita ātmanepadam, jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ, edhate cyavate susmūrṣate didṛkṣata, iti | prakṛtyarthanimitto yathā prakāśanastheyākhyayośca, bhujo'navane, gṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhate, karmavyatīhāre tiṣṭhate bhuṅkte gandhāyate vyatilunīta iti | pratyayanimitto yathā vipārabhyāṃ jeḥ, samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ, samastṛtīyāyuktāt, mithyopapadātkṛño'bhyāse, vijayate parājayate, saṃtiṣṭhate avatiṣṭhate pratiṣṭhate vitiṣṭhate, aśvenasañcarate, padaṃ mithyākārayati | upaskārārthanimitto yathā veḥ pādaviharaṇe, āṅojyetirudbhamane, upāṅ mantrakaraṇe, dāṇaścasāceñcatuthryarte, vikramate vājī, ākramate jyotaḥ, sāvitryupatiṣṭhate, dāsyā saṃyacchata iti | prakṛtinimittaḥ parasmaipayoge yathā śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam, bhavati vyatihasanti, vyatiharanti, parasparasya vyati | pratyayārthanimitto yathā kuṣirajauḥ prācāṃ śyan, parasmaipadaṃ ca, śeṣātkartari parasmaipadam | rajyati vastraṃ svayameva, kuṣyati pādassvayameva, rajyate vastram, kuṣyate pādamiti, upaskāranimitto yathānuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ | itaretarānyonyopapadāñca, anukaroti parākaroti, itaretasya vyatilunanti, anyonyasya vyatilunantīti | upaskārārthanimitto yathā śamo'kūjane, āṅodo'nāsyaviharaṇe, udo'nūdhrvakarmaṇi, prāderajādyantarādyujerayajñapātreṣu, saṃkrīḍaḍḍatdhnti śakaṭāḥ, vyāghro mukhaṃ vyādadāta, āsanāduttiṣṭhati, yajñapātrāṇi prayunaktīti | ubhayapadayogaprakṛtinimitto yathā vākyaṣaḥ, anupasargādvā, lohitāyati lohitāyate, krāmati kramata iti | prakṛtyarthanimitto yathā vibhāṣākarmakāt vibhāṣā vipralāpe, uparamiti uparamate, saṃpravadanti mauhūrtāḥ saṃpravadante mauhūrtā iti | pratyayārthanimitto yatā rajāyati rajyate, kuṣyati kuṣyate, kuṣirajauḥ prācāṃ śyan, parasmaipadaṃ ca karmakartari, iti | upaskāranimitto yathopasargādasyātyūhyorvā, udasyati udasyate, samūhati samūhata iti | upaskārārthanimitto yathā vā lupsāyām, vibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne, bhikṣuko brāhmaṇākulamupatiṣṭhati upatiṣṭhate, brāhmaṇassvaṃ yajñaṃ yajati, yajata iti | evamanye'pi hetulakṣaṇābhīkṣṇyabhṛśārthagarhākauṭilyasākalyapūrvakālatādathryādayaḥ prakṛtyarthopādhiviśeṣā veditavyātaḥ | yathādhīyāno vasita, pacannāste, punaḥpunaḥ paṭhatipāpaṭhyate, punaḥpunaḥ pacati pāpacyate, garhitaṃ dahatidandahyate, kuṭisaṃ krāmati caṅkramyate, kanyādarśaṃ varayati, bhuktvā vrajati, bhoktuṃ vrajantīti | evamete dhāturūpāyāḥ prakṛterarthopādhayaḥ pratyayarūpāyāḥ svapratyayārthopādhaya evopādhayo bhavanti | prātipadirūpāyāstu svārthādapyaliṅgasaṅkhyāparimāṇakarakasaṃbandhasaṃbodhanasahārthatādathryahetulakṣaṇādaya upādhayo vidyante | te tu pratyayārthopaskārārthaprātipadikārtheṣvanantarameva varṇayiṣyanta iti neha pratanyante | atha pratyayārthopādhiḥ | tatra kārakopādhiṣu puruṣa uktāḥ, saṅkhyātvagratobhidhāsyate | apare'pi cāsya yasya vidhinimantraṇādhīṣyasaṃprāśnaprārthanapraiṣātisargaprāptakālaśaktyarhagarhādayaḥ upādhayo bhavanti | tadyathāgnihatraṃ juhuyāt, iha bhuñcita iha bhāvānāstām, bhāvanmāṇavakamadhyāpayet, kiṃ nu khalu vyakaraṇamadhīyīya, itaśchando labheyāhaṃ bhikṣāt, ārśasanamapi prārthanameva, ciraṃ jīvyaḥ, grāmaṃ gaccha, gacchānujñāto'si, kuru kaṭaṃ prāptaste kālaḥ kaṭakaraṇe, bhavānkhalu śatruṃ hanyāt khalu tatrabhavān bhāraṃ vahet, kathaṃ navāma tatrabhavānvṛṣalaṃ yājayediti | evamanye'pi tacchīlataddharmatatsādhukārihetvānulomyaśaktivayovacanakṛcchrānudyamanaśilpilakṣaṇaliṅgādayo'vagantavyāḥ | yathā vaditā janāpavādāt, muṇḍaḍḍatdhyitāraḥ śrāviṣṭhāyanāḥ, vadhūmūḍhāṃ kanyāmalaṅkariṇaaṇuḥ, yāśaskarī vidyā, ājñākarī bhāryā, hastighno bhaṭaḥ kavacaharaḥ kṣatriyakumāraḥ, dhārayannupaniṣadam, aṃśaharassutaḥ, nartakī veśyā, jāyāghnastilakaḥ, vyasasya vacanaṃ, pāṇineruktiḥ, kālidāsasya prabandha iti | ayomayopādhiḥ | so'pi saṃjñājātiprabhāsaparimāṇadyūtābhreṣabhāṣācchandomantrabrāhmaṇāśīrutkośādibhedādanantaprakāraḥ | tadyathā ticūko ca saṃjñāyām, bhadrabhūtirdevadatta iti hastā puroḍā iti | dvitīyā brāhmaṇe grāsya tadahassahāyān dīvyeyuḥ, praṣṭhauhīṃ dīvyatīti, āśiṣi vun, jīvatāt jīvakaḥ, nandatāt nandaka iti | māṅcākrośe, ākrośe nañyaniḥ, mā jīvanyaḥ parāvajñāduḥkhadagdho'pi jīvati | “tasyājananirevāstu jananīkleśakāriṇaḥ” iti | evamanye'pyasūyasaṃmatikopakutsanabhatrsavābādhaprakārakṛcchraparyāyārhaṇotpattiprabhṛtayo'vagantavyāḥ |ceṣvasūyā yathā māṇavakāmāṇavaka abhirūpakā abhirūpaka riktaṃ te ābhirūpyam | saṃmatiryathāmāṇavakā māṇavaka abhirūpakā abhirūpaka śobhanaḥ khalvasi | kopo yathā māṇavaka māṇavaka avinītakaavinītaka idānīṃ jñāsyasi jālma | kutsanaṃ yathā śaktike śaktike yaṣṭike yaṣṭike riktā te śaktiḥ | bhatrsanaṃ yathā cora cora vṛṣala vṛṣala ghātiṣyāmi tvām | ābādho yathā gatagatā naṣṭanaṣṭā priyā priyā gamanādinā pīḍyamānaḥ kaścadekaṃ prayuṃkte | prakāro yathā paṭupaṭu, bhītabhīta, paripūrṇaguṇena nyūnaguṇasyopamāne satyevaṃ bhavati | akṛcchraṃ yathā śukhaduḥkena dadāti, priyāpriyeṇa dadāti, apīḍyamāno dadātityarthaḥ | pāramparyādayo yathā bhavataśśāyikā, arhati bhavānikṣubhakṣikām, ukṣubhakṣikāṃ me dhārayasi, udapādīkṣubhikṣiketi | sarvo'pi cāyamupādhiprapañcastridhaivākyāyate, dhamryupādhirdharmopādhiḥ prakīrṇopādhiśca | tatra kṛñaḥ stambaśakṛdbhyāṃ vrīhivatsayorin, stambakarṇayoramujapoḥ, hastisūcakayorityādi | dhamryupādhiryathā vrīhisstambakariḥ kṣetre gṛhe vatsaśśakṛtkariḥ | janaḥkarṇejapo rājye mattastamberabho vane || “prajane sarterap” “samudorajaḥpaśuṣ” | dharmopādhiryathā samajassyādgavāṃ gobhirukṣmāmudaja ukṣabhiḥ | bhavatyavasare yasyāsare yasyāssaiṣā me gomatallikā || manyakarmaṇyanādare, vibhāṣā prāṇiṣu, ṣaṣṭhī cānādarādhike bhāvalakṣaṇe iti | prakīrṇopādhiryathā manyate na tṛṇāyāpi tvāṃ nāvaṃ paśyato haraḥ | miṣatsu lokapāleṣu haviḥ pibati so'dhvare || tiṅkṛttaddhitābhidheyapratyayārthaḥ pradhānaḥ | sa tridhā śvārthassambandhī kārakañca | teṣu prakṛtyartha eva svārthaḥ | sa tridhā dhātvarthaḥ prātipadikārthaśśoṣaśca | tatra dhātvarthastridhā | bhāvaḥ kriyā kārakañca | teṣu bhāvo dvidhā śattvabhūto'sattvabhūtaśca | tayorliṅgaṅkhyāyogi satvabhūtaḥ yathāvacanaṃ vacanaṃ pratiyasannidhāvanavalokanameva vilokanam | avayavāvaraṇaṃ ca yadaṃśukavyakareṇa tadaṅgasamarpaṇam || aliṅgasaṅkhyo'sattvabhūto yathāpi prasannena maharṣiṇā tvaṃ samyagvinīyānumato samyagvinīyānumato gṛhāya | kālohyayaṃ saṃkramituṃ dvitīyaṃ sarvopakārakṣamamāśrayaṃ te || kriyā dvidhā śuddhā saṅkīrṇā ca | tayoḥ kārakāsaṃpṛktā śuddhā yathā pallavomitisāmyasapakṣaṃ daṣṭavatyadharabimbamabhīṣṭe | paryakūji sarujeva taruṇyāstāralolavalayena kareṇa || kartṛtvāpannasādhyarūpā saṅkīrṇā yathā kucadvandve tanvi dvipakalabhakumbhasthalatulāṃ dadhāne'sminkasyā na yuvatiṣu cittasya rujati | tavorvoryugame vā hutaruciracāmīkararucau vikarṣatyūṣmāṇaṃ kamiha na yuvānaṃ jvarayati || kārakaṃ dvidhā, niyatadhātuviṣayamaniyatadhātuviṣayañca | tayorniyatadhātuviṣayaṃ yathā tuṣāraleśākulicatotpalābe paryaśruṇī maṅgalabhaṅgabhīruḥ | agūḍhabhāvāpi vilokane sā na locane mīlayituṃ viṣehe || aniyatadhātuviṣayaṃ yathābhimukhe mayi saṃhṛtamīkṣitaṃ hasitamanyanimittakṛtodayam | vinayavāritavṛttiritastayā na vivṛto madano na ca sehṛtaḥ || pratipadikārthastridhā, vyakto'vyaktassaṃdigdhaśca | teṣu pratyayotpādānutpādayoraviśiṣṭo vyaktaḥ | sa dvidhā talliṅgo'nyaliṅgaśca | tayostalliṅgo yathā mana eva mānasam, bandhureva bāndhavaḥ, yava eva yāvaka iti | anyaliṅgo yathopāya eva opayayikam, deva evadevatāḥ, devataiva daivatamiti | avyakto dvidhā, ujjhitasvarūpo'nujjhitasvarūpaśca | tatrojjhitasvarūpo yathā veśśālacchaṅkaṭacau, saṃprodaśca kaṭat, upādhibhyāṃ tyakannāsannārūḍhayoriti | yathā, viśālaṃ, viśaṅkaṭaṃ, prakaṭaṃ, vikaṭaṃ, upatyakā, adhityaketi | atropasargairasaṅkhyatvādisvarūpamujjhitam | anujjhitasvarūpo yathā vatsokṣāśvarṣabhebhyastanutve, kāsūgoṇībhyāṃ ṣṭarac, kimettiṅavyayaghādāmbadravyaprakarṣe | vinañbhyāṃ nānāñau na saha | yathā vatsataraḥ, ukṣataraḥ, nitarāṃ, atīvatarāṃ, vinā, nāneti | upacaritārthavṛttiḥ saṃdigdhaḥ | sa dvidhā śaṅkhyāvānaṅkhyaśca | tayostiṅantārtho yathā pacatitarāṃ, pacatakīti | subanitārtho yathā tvayakā, uñcakairiti | pratyayārtho dvidhā, kṛdarthastaddhitārthaśca | tayoḥ kṛdartho yathā nyāvakrośī, sāṃrāviṇamiti | taddhitārtho yathābhijityaḥ, kauḍhjāyanya iti | samāsārtho dvidhā, samāsyanimittaṃ, samāsanimittaśca | tatra yamāśritya taddhitārtha iti samāso bhavati | samāsyanimittaṃ yathā dvaimāturaḥ pañcakapāla iti | sambandhī yasya tu samāsānta iti samāso nimittaṃ sa samāsanimittaḥ yathā devarājaḥ pratyurasāmiti | sambandhī tridhā, kriyā dravyaṃ guṇaśca | teṣu kriyā tridhā, kriyāsambandhinī ubhasambandhinī ca | tāsu kriyāsambandhinī dvidhā, bhinnarūpā'bhinnarūpā ca | tayorbhinnarūpā yathā kartumicchati cikīrṣati, jugupsitumicchati jugupsiṣata iti | abhinnarūpā yathātyarthaṃ pāpacyate, punaḥ punaḥ pāpaṭhyata iti | kārakasambandhinyapi dvidhā, sākāṃkṣā nirākāṃkṣā ca | sākākṣaṃ yathā paṭamivācarati paṭīyati kambanam, prāsādamivācarati prāsādīyati kuṭīm | nirākāṃkṣā yathā putramicchati putrīyati, pucchamudasyatyutpucchayata iti | ubhayasambandhinī dvidhā, kriyākārakasambandhinī kārakakriyāsambandhinī ca | tayoḥ prathamā yathā pacantaṃ prayuṅkte pācayati devadattaḥ, adīyānaṃ puyuṅkte adhyāpayati kārīṣo'gniḥ | dvitīyā yathā kaṃsavadhamāṣṭe kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, ārātrivivāsamācaṣṭe rātriṃ vivāsayati | dravyamapi tridhā, viśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vyavahitañca | teṣu viśeṣyaṃ dvidhā, sāpekṣamanapekṣañca | sāpekṣaṃ yathā yuṣmākamayaṃ yauṣmāko gauḥ, vatsebhyo hito vatsīyo godhuk | anapekṣaṃ yathā vasiṣṭhasyāpatyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaḥ, pṛthivyā īśvaraḥ pārthivaḥ | viśeṣaṇaṃ dvidhā, dharminiṣṭhaṃ dharmaniṣṭhaṃ yathā gāvo'sya santīti gomān, prāsādo'sya syātprāsādīyaṃ dāru | dharmaniṣṭhaṃ yathāstīti matirasyāstikaḥ, nāstīti matirasya nāstika iti | vyavahitaṃ dvidhā, viśeṣyarūpaṃ viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ ca | viśeṣaṇarūpaṃyathā dvimayamudaśvinyavānāṃ dvamayā yavāḥ udaścitaḥ | viśeṣaṇarūpaṃ yathā pañcamo māso'sya jātasya pañcamī bālakaḥ, ṣaṣṭhaṃ rūpagranthagrahaṇamasya ṣaṭko vaṭuḥ | guṇo'pi tridhā, āśritaḥ pravṛttinimittamupādhiṣcaṭa | teṣaavāśrito dvidhā, abhinnarūpo bhinnarūpaśca | tayorabhinnarūpe yathā bhikṣāṇāṃ samūho bhekṣam, kākolūkasya vairaṃ kākolūkikā | bhinnarūpo yathartvijāṃ karmāÐtvajyaṃ, pīlūnāṃ pākaḥ pīlukaṇa iti | pravṛttinimittaṃ dvidhā, anuñjakamananurañjakaṃ ca | tatrānurañjakaṃ jātyādi yathā brāhmaṇasya bhāvaḥ brāhmaṇyaṃ, ṛḍorbhāvaḥ ārjavamiti | anunurañjakaṃ saṃbandhādi, yathā daṇḍiḍḍatdhno bāvo daṇḍiḍḍatdhtvam, pācakasya bhāvaḥ pācakateti | prakṛtyartapratyayārthayorviseṣaṇamupādhiḥ | sa dvidhā, vyastassamastaśca | vyastaḥ prakṛtyarthe yathā śivo devatā'sceti śevaṃ, lavaṇaṃ paṣyamasyeti | sāvaṇikaḥ | pratyayārthe yathā gārgikayā ślāghate, kāṭhikayā'dhikṣipati | atra devatāpayaṇyaślāghādhikṣepā upādhayaḥ | samasto yatā daṇḍāḥ praharaṇamasyāṃ krīḍāyāṃ dāṇḍā | atra daṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdāt tadasyāmityadhikaraṇe pratyayo vihito daṇḍaḍḍatdhsthaṃ praharaṇatvaṃ, adhikaraṇatvaṃ ca krīḍātvaṃ pratyāyati | evaṃ hyogodohasya vikāro haiyaṅgavīnaṃ navanītam | atra hyogośabdādvikāre pratyayo vihitaḥ, prakṛtyarthopādhiṃ dohaṃ pratyayārthopādhiṃ ca saṃjñāṃ pratyāyatīti | kārakaṃ tridhā, sakriyaṃ bhinnakriyamabhinnakriyaṃ ca | teṣu sakriyaṃ tridhā, kartṛrūpaṃ karmarūpamanusyūtañca | kartṛrūpaṃ dvidhā, kriyāviśeṣasthaṃ kārakaviśeṣasthaṃ ca | tayoḥ kriyāviśeṣasthaṃ yathā susnātaṃ pṛcchati sausnātikaḥ, evaṃ saukhaśāyanikaḥ, prabhūtamāha prābhūmāha prabhūtikaḥ, evaṃ māśabdikaḥ, pratīpaṃ vartate prātīpikaḥ, pratikūlaṃ carati prātikūlika iti | kārakaviśeṣasthaṃ yathā vyākaraṇaṃ vettyadhīte vā vaiyākaṇaḥ, samāṃ samāṃ vijāyate samāṃsamīnā, akṣairdīvyatyākṣikaḥ, saṃtāpāya prabhavati sāntāpikaḥ, puturāgataṃ pitryaṃ, samānodare śayitaḥ sodarya iti | karmarūpaṃ dvidhā, sajātīyasthamasajātīyasthaṃ ca | sajātīyasthaṃ yathāyanaṃ neyaḥ āyānayīnaḥ śāraḥ, māsaṃ bhṛto māsiko bhṛtyaḥ, varṣamadhīṣṭo vārṣiko upādhyāyaḥ, pakṣaṃ lakṣaḥ pākṣiko nibandhaḥ, ṣaṇmāsaṃ krītaḥ ṣāṇmāsiko dāsaḥ, saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtassaṃvatsariko'bhyāsa iti | asajātīyasthaṃ yathā vāmadevena dṛṣṭaṃ vāmadevyaṃ sāma, lākṣayā raktaṃ vastraṃ lākṣikaṃ, devāya deyaṃ daivyaṃ haviḥ, tantrādacirāpahṛtaḥ tantrakaḥ paṭaḥ, dvāre niyukto dauvārikaḥ pumān, caturdaśyāṃ dṛśyate cāturdaśyaṃ rakṣa iti | arthāntarānubandhanamanusyūtam | taddvidhā, kriyānusyūtaṃ kārakānusyūtaṃ ca | tayoḥ kriyānusyūtaṃ yathā śītānveṣaṇamadhikṛtya kṛto granthaḥ sītānveṣaṇīyaḥ, evaṃ kirātārjunīyaḥ, vākyapadīyaḥ, pauṣī paurṇamāsī asminmāse bhavati pauṣaḥ, evamāgrahāyaṇikaḥ aśvatthika iti | kārakānusyūtaṃ yathā tittiriṇā proktaṃ vedaṃ vidantyadhīyate vā taittiriyāśchātrāḥ, evaṃ vāratantavīyāḥ, egaleyinaḥ, aitareyiṇaḥ, tathā pārāśariṇo bhikṣavaḥ, śailālino naṭāḥ | bhinnakriyaṃ tridhā, lakṣitakriyamapekṣitakriyamanumatākriyaṃ ca | teṣu lakṣitakriyaṃ dvidhā, kartṛsthaṃ karmasthaṃ ca | tayoḥ kartṛsthaṃ yathā mudnā bhavantayasmānmaudnīnaṃ kṣetram, daṇḍiḍḍatdhnaḥ santyasyāṃ daṇḍiḍḍatdhmatī śālā | karmasthaṃ yatā śrāddhamanena bhuktaṃ śrāddhikaḥ, agrabhojanamasmai dīyate āgrabhojanikaḥ, padamasmin dṛśyaṃ padyaḥ kardama iti | apekṣitakriyaṃ dvidhā, vyahitamavyavahitaṃ ca | tayovryavahitaṃ yathā grāmādāgacchati, brāhmaṇāya dadāti, paryaṅke śeta iti | avyavahitaṃ yathā kaṭaṃ karoti, dātreṇa lunāti, devadattenāsyata iti | anuśaktakriyaṃ dvidhā, tulyādhikaraṇamatulyādhikaraṇaṃ ca | tayostusalyādhikaraṇaṃ yathā śuklibhavati, unmanīsyāt, bhasmasātsaṃpadyata iti | atulyādhikaraṇaṃ yathā paṭapaṭākaroti, devatrāgacchati, devatrāgacchati, manuṣyatrāvasatīti | abhinnakriyaṃ tridhā, tiṅabhidheyaṃ kṛdabhidheyaṃ taddhitābhidheyaṃ ca | tatra tiṅabhidheyaṃ dvidhā kartṛrūpaṃ karmatarūpaṃ ca | tayoḥ kartṛrūpaṃ yathā pacati devadattaḥ, dugdhe gauḥ, corasyarujati roga iti | karmarūpaṃ yathā pacyate odanaḥ, bhidyate kusūlaḥ, uṣṭrāsikā āsyanta iti | kṛdabhidheyaṃ dvidhā, viśeṣyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ ca | tayorviṣyaṃ yathā dātraṃ, prāsādaḥ, kumbhakāra
iti | viśeṣaṇaṃ yathā kartavyaṃ, pācakaḥ, subodhamiti | taddhitābhideyaṃ dvidhā sāpekṣakriyamanepekṣitakriyaṃ ca | tayossāpekṣakriyaṃ yatheṣṭī yajñe, parigaṇitī yājñikye, āmnātī chandasi, adhītī vyākaraṇe, kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti | anekṣakriyaṃ yatā pākevana nirvṛttaṃ pākim, sekena nirvṛttaṃ sekimaṃ, kuṭṭena kuṭṭimaṃ, karaṇena kṛtrimaṃ, śyenapāko'syāṃ tilapāko'syāṃ tilapāko'syāṃ kriyāyāṃ śyainaṃpātā tailaṃ pāteti | prakṛtipratyayobhayadvārakaṃ padārthaviśeṣaṇamupaskārārthaḥ | sa tridā, prakṛtidvārakaḥ, pratyayadvārakaḥ, ubhayadvārakaśca | teṣu prakṛtidvārakaḥ ṣoḍhā, ārye vrajāmo'nyata ityathaināṃ vadhūrasūyākuṭilaṃ dadarśa || kriyālakṣaṇaṃ yathā badhnannaṅgeṣu romāñcaṃ kurvanmanasi nirvṛtim | netre cāmīlayanneṣa priyāsparśāḥ pravartate || upapadaṃ ṣoḍhā, kriyārūpaṃ, nāmarūpaṃ, nāmārtharūpaṃ, pratyayārūpaṃ, nipātarūpaṃ, karmapravacanīyarūpamiti | teṣu kriyārūpaṃ yathā bhavatsambhāvanotthāya paritoṣāya mūcrchate | api vyāptadigantāni nāṅgāni prabhavanti me | nāmarūpaṃ yathā sukhaistebhaayo vibhāvaryastebhyo hitamahassadā | yaṣāmakaḍaḍḍatdhtrimapremā priyā pāśrvaṃ na muñcati || nāmārtharūpaṃ yathā hutahutāśanadīptivanaśriyaḥ pratinidhiḥ kanakābhāraṇasya yat | yuvatayaḥ kusumaṃ dadhurāhitaṃ tadalake dalakesarapeśalam |. pratyayarūpaṃ yathā nṛpasutamabhitassamanmathāyāḥ pariḍaḍḍatdhjanagātratirohitāṅgayaṣṭeḥ | sphucamabhilaṣitaṃ babhūva vadhvā vadati hi saṃvṛtireva kāmitāni || nipātarūpaṃ yathā yo hi dīrdhāsitākṣasya vilāsavilitabhruvaḥ | kāntāmukhasyāvaśagastasmai nṛpaśave namaḥ || karmapavacanīyarūpaṃ yathālocanāntācchravaṇe vivṛtya pūtaṃ gurostadvacanaṃ bhāvānyā | nidāghakālolbaṇatāpayeva māhendramambhaḥ prathamaṃ pṛthivyā || śabdāntarasāhacaryavirodhaliṅgasvarābhinayādayaḥ prakīrṇam | tatra sāhacaryaṃ yathā bhavati samadanā rataye tilakavatī cārucampakacchāyā | ghanacandanavalakicākrāntā tava vidviṣāmaṭavi || sāhacaryaṃ yathā lakṣmaṇānugato rāmastyāgīrāma ivāparaḥ | kausalyeva bibharti dyaurabhiṣekojjavalāṃ śriyam || virodho yathā haribāṇāvimau roṣādubhāvāpi dhṛtāyudhau | prahartumudyatau vīrau raṇe rāmārjunāviva || liṅgaṃ yathāpyāyayati mitro'yamasya mitraṃ payonidhiḥ | so'pyamitraśśaśī jātastadamaitryādya me sakhi || svaro yathā yadi me vallabhā dūtī tadāramapi vallabhā | yadi tasyāṃ priyā vācastanmamāpi priya priyāḥ || abhinoya yathaite vāyamamī dārāḥ kanyeyaṃ raॉkulajīvitam | brūta yenātra vaḥ kāryamānāsthā vā hyavastuṣu || prātipadikārthastridhā, svārtho, dravyaṃ, liṅgaṃ ca | teṣu śabdātmaiva svārthaḥ | sa dvidhā, svarūpamanukāryaśca | tayoḥ svarūpaṃ dvidhā, sattvavacanārhamasattvavacanārhaṃ ca | tatrādyaṃ yathā cīḍāmaṇīśśirorante karalo hāramadhyage | paryaṅkaśśayane prokta āveśaścāpi veśmani || dvitīyaṃ yathā manye śaṅke dhruvaṃ prāyo nūnamityevāmādibhiḥ | utprakṣā vyajyate śabdairivaśabdo'pi tādṛśāḥ || iti || anukāryo dvidhā, arthavānanarthaśca | tayorarthavānyathonnamayya sakacagrahamāsyaṃ cumbati priyatame haṭhavṛttyā | huṃhu muñca mamameti ca mandaṃ jalpitaṃ jayati mānavatīnām || nirarthako yathāgraśālamadhiruhya nagasya sphārakaṇṭhakuromadamattaḥ | hrasvadīrghasavisargaghukārān ghoṣayatyuṣasi pāṇḍuḍḍatdhkapotaḥ || upāttanimittenānupāttanimittena vā yat śrūyate gamyate pratyabhidhīyate taddravyam | taddhidhā, āśrayarūpamanāśrayarūpaṃ ca | tatra jātyādibhiḥ pravṛttinimittairyadāśrayate tadāśrayarūpam, yathā gauḥ, aśvaḥ, śuklaḥ, ekaḥ, prasthaṃ, palaṃ, ṛjuḥ, pūrvaḥ, pācakaḥ, daṇḍī, rājapuruṣaḥ, caitraḥ, iti | tadviparūtamanāśrayarūpaṃ nipātavyayopasargagatikarmapravacamīyādīnāmarthaḥ yathāhaṃ ca tvaṃ, ca vṛtrahan, kastvāmūrīkariṣyati, kastaṃ prati nayāsyati, svayaṃ prayetumicchati | liṅgaṃ dvidhā, śabdaliṅgamarthaliṅgañca | tayoriyamayamidatyarthavyapadeśanimittaṃ śabdasaṃskāraheturayamityarthavyapadeśakāraṇaṃ pumān napuṃsakasya jhalaca iti ........ upaskāraheturidamityarthavyapadeśakāraṇāt napuṃsakamiti | tadenacchuddhamiśrādibhedāt ṣoḍhā viprathate | śuddhaṃ, miśraṃ saṅakīrṇaṃ, upasarjanaṃ, āviṣṭaṃ, avyaktaṃ ca | teṣvekasaṃkāskārahetuśśuddham, khaṭvā, vṛkṣaḥ, kuṇaḍaṃ, strī, pumān, napuṃsakamiti | saṃskāradvayopagrāhi miśram, marīciḥ, ūrmiḥ, artiḥ, chardiḥ, kaṣāyaḥ, kavāṭamiti | saṃskāratrayayogi saṅkīrṇam, taṭī taṭaḥ taṭaṃ, śṛṅkhalā śṛṅkhalaḥ śṛṅkhalamiti | viśeṣyaśabdaniyataviśeṣaṇarūpamupasarjanam, śuklā śuklaḥ śuklaṃ, paṭvī paṭuḥ paṭviti | viśeṣaṇatve'pi niyataśabdasaṃskārārhamāviṣṭam, prakṛtiḥ, viṣayaḥ, pradhānaṃ, bhāryā, dārāḥ, kalatramiti | liṅganimittaśabdasaṃskārāvarhamavyaktam, pañca, ṣaṭ, kati, uñcaiḥ | viśeṣyate, avacchidyate dravyaṃ yena tacchabdasyārthe pravṛttinimittamarthadharmo'rthaliṅgaviśeṣaṇaṃ guṇo bhāva iti cākhyātam | tatrtridhā, guṇaḥ, paramāṇaṃ, saṃbandha iti | tatra dravye svādyukte pratyayajanako guṇo jātiḥ, guṇassaṅkhyā, saṃsthānamavasthānamityādi | yathā gauḥ, brāhmaṇaḥ, paṭuḥ, gauraḥ, ekaḥ, anekaḥ, hanūmān, vāsudevaḥ, yuvā, vṛddhaḥ, ṛjuḥ, pūrva iti | ananurañjakamātrābhidheyamavacchedakaṃ parimāṇaṃ tadadhvagauravasaṅkhyāsaṅghātakṣetrādibhedādanekadhā | yathā yojanaṃ parvataḥ, phalaṃ suparṇaḥ purāṇaḥ, kapardakāḥ, akṣauhiṇī balā, khārī vrīhayaḥ nivartanaṃ bhūmiriti | kṛttaddhitasamāsapratipadikaviśeṣāṇārtheṣu pravṛttinimittaṃ saṃbandhaḥ | sa traidhā, kriyāsaṃbandho dravyasaṃbandhaḥ kriyādravyasaṃbandhaśca | tatra kriyāsaṃbandho yathā, pācaka iti | dravyasaṃbandho yathā daṇḍī rājapuruṣa iti | kriyādravyasaṃbandho yathākṣikaḥ, niṣekauśāmbiriti | yadā punaḥ jātiguṇaparimāṇādayaśśabdāḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyante bhāvapratyayairvā pratipādyante tadaiteṣāṃ dravyatvameva, na liṅgatvam | bhāvapratyayo hi jātiguṇājjātiguṇe, samāsakṛttaddhitāttu saṃbandhe, ḍiḍḍatdhtthādeḥ, sve rūpe, dhavakhadirājjātisaṅghāta iti | anye tu svārtho viśeṣaṇaṃ, dravyaṃ viśeṣyaṃ, liṅgaṃ strīnapiṃsakamityācakṣate | tañca nipātagatyupasargakarmapravacanīyādiprātiradikārthā ityabhidhīyate | na hi nipātadikaṃ pravṛttinimittamupādāyedaṃtaditi vyapadeśayogyeṣu sattvabhūteṣvartheṣu vartante | api tu pravṛttanimittnupagraheṇaivāsattvabhūtaṃ samuñcayādikamarthamabhiniviśante | tadāha teṣāmuñḍāvacārthatvātsarvasaṃbandhadarśanāt | anyatantratayodbhūterasattvārthatvamucyate || atha kimimī vācakā uta dyotakā iti | tatraike varṇayanti, “tatpratyogāvaseytavāddhācyasteṣāṃ, yathānyeṣāṃ gavādikaḥ | “ anvayavyatirekanibandhanā hi śabdānāmabhidheyavyasthā | tataśca anādiprayogādavasīyamānaḥ samuñcayaviraṇādirarthātmā kathamamīṣāṃ vācyo na bhavet? pratīyeta ca śabdātsamuñcayaḥ, abaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahanniti | vicāraṇā vā śabdāt, hantāṃha pṛthivīmimāṃ nidadhāni havehaveti | evaminādibhya upamānādayo gamyanta iti tadvācyāste bhavanti | anye tvāhuḥ “ṣaṣṭhyabhāvādasa (tvāñca samuñcayavikalpayoḥ)| (akāmacari) taiścaiṣāṃ dyotaktavaṃ suniścitam ||” tathāhi | plakṣanyagrodhayoḥ samuñcaya iti vākyaprayoge ṣaṣṭhī nirdiśyate | naivam, plakṣanyagradhayaściti | yathā ca vrīhiyavayorvikalpaḥ pravartatāmiti vācakaśabdaprayoge sattvabhūto viklapaśabdārthaḥ kriyayā saṃbadhyate, naivaṃ vrīhiyanayorveti | yathā ca vṛkṣa ityekenāpi vācakena śākhādimānarthaḥ pratīyate, naivaṃ samuñcayo vikalpovā | yathā ca bhīkṣāṃ dehi bhikṣāmiti vācakaśabdānāṃ paurvāparyaprayoge kāmacāraḥ, naivaṃ vṛkṣaśca vṛkṣa iti | yathā ca vṛkṣaśśobhana iti vācakasya viśeṣaṇayogo dṛśyeta, naivaṃ ca śobhana iti | tadevaṃ vācakaśabdavaidhamyāt dyotakāścadaya iti niścīyate | smarati ca sūtrakāraścādayo'sattva iti | niraktakāro'pyāha bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ sattvapradhānāni nāmāni copasargā uñcāvaceṣvartheṣu patantīti nipātā iti | sacaiśāmuñcāvaco'nekaprakāro'rthaḥ svato'navagamyamānātmā padāntarasaṃbandopahitaprakaraṇādyunuvidhaānenāvasīyate | tataḥ svarūpamātreṇāpyarthānavagatau itaraprayogāpekṣatvāt dyotaka evaite, na vācakā iti | etattu sarvaṃ savyabhicāramiti kecit | tathāhi | vācakenāpyākhyātena dyotitaṃ sattvabhūtārthamapi ca vācakamākhyātamāsyate bhavadbhiriti vācakāvapi prakṛtipratyayau naiva kevalau prayujyete | juhotīti vācakavivartipadaṃ paurvāparyaniyamenāvatiṣṭhate | rājapuruṣa iti smṛteścoti yaducyate tadapyayuktam | na ha vyākaraṇe'rthā ādiśyante, niruktakāro vācakatāṃ manyate na tu dyotakatāṃ, ato vyabhicāradarśanāt kathamivaitadupapannaṃ bhavati? ucyate | vācakatvādākhyātaprayoge śeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyapi dṛśyate, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditi | cādiprayoge tu ṣaṣṭhī naiva bhavati | na ca svabhāvasyāsattvarūpatā saṃbandhaḥ, dṛśyate rūpamavagantuṃ, tadevāsattvabhūtamarthamātramavagamayanti | prakṛtipratyayābhyāṃ ca kevalābhyāmapyartho'bhidhīyate, dadhi madhu iyānadhuneti | cādayastu naiva kevalāḥ tamabhidadhate | athaivamucyate śabdāntarāṇyevaitāni dadhyādīni prayogasamavāyīni .......... he prakṛtipratyayāvapi na staḥ | kathamabhidhīyate prakṛtipratyayāvapi kaivalai nārthaṃ brūta iti varti padānāṃ puranuyataprayogatvamapi dṛśyate, āhitāgniragnyāhita iti | na caivaṃprakāratānādināṃ śabdāntarameva vā samāsaḥ | vāvacanānathrya ca svabhāvasiddhatvāditi | yadi vāvartinīpadāvanāṃ upasarjanaṃ pūrvamityādinā prakṛtipratyayayorapi paraśceti vacane gatyupasargāṇāṃ te prāgdhātorityanena prayoganiyamaḥ, prayoganiyamānāmapi prayoganiyamo dṛśyate, tasmādavyabhicāra iti | upasarjanānāmapi ca viśeṣayogo dṛśaayate, devadattasya gurukulamiti | cādīnāṃ tu naitatkadācidapyasti, vyākaraṇe cārthāḥ kathaṃ vādiśyanta iti | śaālīnakaupīne, adhṛṣṭākāryayoḥ, agāraikadeśe praghaṇaḥ praghāṇaśceti | nirukte'pyuñcāvacasyārthasya kevalānnipātādanupalabdheḥ padāntaropādānāttu tadarthābhivyakternipāto dyotyate | ato dyotakā eva na vācakāścādaya iti | atha gatyupasargakarmapravaca nīyānāṃ vārtā? ucyate | gatīnāṃ tāvatsadasadādīnāmādarānādarādinācyanirdeśenaiva gati saṃjñāvidhānārdiṣṭavācyānāmapyūryādīnāṃ vācakatvameva gamyate | upasargāstu vācakāḥ dyotakāḥ viśeṣakāssahābhidhāyakāḥ kāryārthā nirarthakāśca bhavanti | karmapravacanīyāḥ punarnipātavat dyotakā eva | tadāha kriyāviśeṣajanyātāṃ saṃbandhānāṃ prakāśane | karmatvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ca bhedenaivāśritaṃ katham || iha khalu saṃbandhāḥ kriyāpūrvakatvāt karaṇānavidhāyitayā kriyopadarśitaviśeṣaṃ kārakamāśrayanti | tatra ca bhinjātīyasya yugapadekayā vibhaktyāvaktuṃ śakyatvāt śeṣasaṃbandhābhidhānavelayāmaśabdopādānaḥ kriyākārakasaṃbandhaśśabdavatā śaeṣasaṃbandhenānumīyamānasannidhiravatiṣṭhate | tañcānumānaṃ śeṣasaṃbandhasya kvarūpasāmathryanniyatakriyāyaviṣayamaniyatakriyāviśayañca | niyatakriyāviṣayaṃ yathā ... nā janā kartaryapekṣitakarmaviśeṣe śeṣalakṣaṇaṃ pitāputrasaṃbandhamutpādayatīti | saiva tasmādanumīyate | tathā vṛkṣasya śākhetyādhārādheyanibandhānā sthaitirapekṣitakartṛviśeṣe'dhikakaraṇe'vayavāyavayavilakṣaṇaṃ śeṣasaṃbandhaṃ nibandhātīti saiva pratīyate | aniyatakriyāviṣayaṃ yathā rājñaḥ puruṣa iti svasvāmisādhanābharaṇakrayaṇāpajayādiraniyatānekā kriyā kartāśeṣasaṃjñakaṃ svasvamisaṃbandhaṃ saṃniveśayati | sa cāniyatānekakriyāpūrvakatvādaparyāptaḥ kriyāviśeṣamanumāpayitumiti svanimittakriyāsāmānyamevānupayati | evaṃvide viṣaye kriyāviśaeṣaṇaprakāśanāya karmapravacanīyāḥ prayujyunte | yathā śākalyāsya saṃhitāmuprāvarṣavarṣaṇayorhetuphalabhāvo niyamayati kriyāpūrvakaḥ ityetadamunā prakāśyate | yataḥ kriyāpadasya vibhakteraśakyaṃ kalpayituṃ kriyāviśeṣaprakāśanamapi kriyāpadasannidhānāyattamasati kriyāpade na yuktam | saṃbandho'pi nāsyābhidheyaḥ | tasya vibhaktipratyayanibandhanatvāt | yadi ca karmapravacanīyastabhidadhīta, prātipadikārthasya vyatirekopajano na syāt, yathā rājasvāmīti | pratīyate ca loke karmapravacanīyayogo saṃbandhasya nimittaviśeṣāvacchedaḥ | tasmātsa tasya prayogajaka ityavasīyate | taduktaṃ kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ vana saṃbandhasya vācakaḥ | nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī saṃbandhsaya tu bhedakaḥ || iti | nanu ca nāpratītāyāṃ niśamayatikriyāyāṃ tayā saṃbandhasyāvacchedaśśakyate kartum | tadamanuḥ kriyāmapratyāyayat saṃbandhamavacchinattīti na yujyate | athāsya kriyāprakāśanamanyatrādarśanānna kalpyate | saṃbandhāvacchedo'pi mā prakalmi, anyatrādarśanādeva | ucyate | kriyaibhedasamadhigatamātmātiśayasaṃbandhasyāvagamayannarthasāmathryat kriyāviśeṣaḥ prathyayanimittamanuḥ | ato'sya kriyāvacanatvamanyataḥ kriyāpratīterna kalpyate | yadi vā nimittabhedopadheyaviśeṣāparāmarśena rūpabhedaṃ saṃbandhasyāvagamayanti karmapravacanīyāḥ | yathādhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ, abhimanyuḥ arjunataḥ pratīti svasvāmibhāvassādṛśyaṃ ca karmapravacanīyātpratīyate | viśiṣṭādhikaraṇavyavacchedāstu saṃbandhāssvarūpātiśayena kriyābedāmadhigamayanti | yathā pañcālānāṃ paripālanakarādānādayaḥ kāryā brahmadattena, abhimanayuradhyavasāyasaṃpraharaṇādayassadṛśā arjunena, prakrantasaṃbandhavaśāt apapriyante | tadayamanuḥ saṃhitāpravarṣaṇayossaṃbandhaṃ hetuphalabhāvenāvacchinatti | adhyayanaviśeṣarūpatvattu saṃhitāyāḥ | tasya ca śabdātiśayaprakāśasāmathryānniśamanamatrārthagṛhītaṃ na karmapravacanīyādhigamyamiti | tasya tu darśanaṃ, anuḥ paścādbhāvābhaidhāne pratītasāmartho yathānurūpādānamiti | sa ihāpi tadarthameva bhavitumarhatīti tasya hetau vidhīyavaśāddhetau vṛttiḥ kalpyate | paścādbhāve'pi avirodhaḥ, yataḥ paurvāparyamiha hetuphalaviṣayam | ayameva tarhi saṃbandhāvacchedaretutvaṃ pṛthakkaraṇanimittaṃ nipātebhyaḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñānāṃ | kathaṃ tarhi adhiparī anarthakau, suḥ pūjāyām, atiratikramaṇe ca, apiḥ padārthasaṃbhāvānānvavasargagarhāsamuñcayeṣvityamīṣāṃ karmapravacanīyatvam | na hi kaścidebhissaṃbandho'vacchidyate | satyametat | kintu kāryārthameṣāṃ ataddharmāṇāmapi śāstre vācanikakarmapravacanīyatvamabhihitamiti| nanu ca jātyādipravṛttinimittopagrāhiṇo vṛkṣādayaḥ satvavacanāḥ | tadviparītāścādayo asatvavacanā ityucyate | na ca jātirnāma pratyakṣādisamadhigamyaṃ kiñcitprameyamasti | tathā hi, asau na pratyakṣāpratyakṣasya pūrvāparānanusyūtāsvalakṣaṇatvājjāteścapūrvāparānusyūtarūpatvāt | tadāha samānavṛttitā nāma sāmānyasya viśeṣataḥ | kathaṃ spṛśati sāpekṣamanapekṣākṣajā matiḥ || taṃ paṣṭabhāvinastu vikalpāssvābhāvenāvastuviṣayatvānna sāmānyasidhdyai prabhavanti | nāpyanu māna śabdo vā samānyamavasthāpayati | tayopari vikalpaviṣayatvena vastuvyavasthāpakatvāyogāt | vastuprāptistu bhedānavadhyavasāyanimittanastvadyavasāyādbhaviṣyati | itaśca na vyaktivyatiriktasāmānyaṃ kuvalayāmalakabilvādivadbhedenānupalambhāddhaṭapaṭādivañca deśabedāgrahaṇāt vyaktyagrahe ca ghaṭapaṭādivadeva tadanupalabdhevryaktivṛttitvātsāmānyasya tadagrahe tadanupalabdhiriti cenna | vṛttyanupapatteḥ | kiṃ prātipiṇḍaṃ, kārtsnyena vartate jātirudaikadeśena? piṇḍe, sāmānyamekatra yadi gotnavajātirna kutracit || samagrā'stīti gobuddhiḥ pratipiṇḍaṃ, kathaṃ bhanet || na cāsya niravayavatvādekadeśā vidyante | na caikapiṇḍe, samāptyā vartamānā piṇḍāntare'pi samāptyaiva kāciddhṛttirupalabhyate | na casamavāyātmikā vṛttiḥ | sa hyayutasiddhānāṃ bhavati | ayutassiddhissambandhaśceti vipratiṣiddham | dravyaguṇayoḥ apṛthaksiddhayorapi sambandhadarśanānnaivamiti cenna | tatrāpi guṇavyatiriktasya guṇino bhedenāsiddheḥ | avayavāvayanorapi pṛthaksiddherabāvānna sambandhaḥ | nāpi rūparūpilakṣaṇassambandho bhaviṣyatīti vaktavyam, rūpārthasya nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt | kimayaṃ rūpaśabdaśśuklādigumavacanassvabāvavacano vā | śuklādivacanatve nīrūpāṇāṃ pavanamanaḥ prabhṛtīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ sāmānyaśūnyātā syāt |ākāraḥvacanatve'pyavasanniveśarahitānāṃ teṣāmeva sāmānyavacanaṃ prāpnoti | svabhāvavacanatve tu jātijātimatoravyatireka eva bhavet | “bhāti hi vibhedena svabhāvo na svabhāvinaḥ | śabdātiriktataiveyaṃ na tu vastavatiriktatā ||” api ceyaṃ jātiḥ, sarvasarvagatāpi syātpiṇḍaḍḍatdhsarvagatāpi vā | sarvasarvagatve'syāḥ karkādāvapi gomatiḥ || aśvadhīśśābaleyādāvuṣṭrabuddhirgajādiṣu | padārthasaṅkaraścaivamatyantāya prasajyate || athābhivyaktisāmathryaniyamānnaiṣa saṅkaraḥ | hitakarkādipiṇḍānāṃ gotvābhivyaktikauśalam || maivaṃ khaṇḍādyabhivyaktamapi gotvanamanaṃśakam | sravatraiva pratīyeta na vā sarvagaṃta bhavet || tadaṃśagrahaṇe tasya na hi kaścinniyāmakaḥ | dīpavadvyañjakaḥ piṇḍo na tu taṃ piṇḍaḍḍatdhvṛtti tat || sarvatrāgṛhyamāṇaṃ ca sarvatrāstīti ko vadet | sarvasarvagataṃ tatra na gotvamupapadyate || piṇḍaḍḍatdhsarvagatatve tu kāmametadadūṣaṇam | kintu naivādya jātāyāṃ gavi gopratyayo bhavete || piṇḍeḍḍatdhnāsīdasañjāte jātirjāte'pi vidyate | saṃkrāmati na cānyasmātpiṇḍādanyatra niṣkriyā || āyāntyapi na tatpiṇḍaḍḍatdhmapoñjhitapurātanam | na cāṃśairvartate ceti keyaṃ vyasanasantatiḥ || tasmādapoharūpamalīkameva sānānyaṃ, na paramārthasaditi | tataśca tadabhāvāttadvata'nupapattiriti | atrocyate | kiṃ jātyāderbāhyasya śabdārthasyābhāvādapohe pakṣarātaḥ, uta pratītibaleneti | na taivatpratītibalena, pratīteranugatākārakaॉviṣayatvenāpohaparipanthitvāt | nāpi jāterasattvaṃ pratyakṣeṇa, svalakṣamavadāveditasvarūpatvāt | ādyameva hi vijñānamarthasaṃsparśi cākṣuṣam | na datuttarabhāvīti kimidaṃ rājaśāsanam || tadevāstu pramāṇaṃ vā tenāpi tvadhigamyate | vyāvṛttaṃ vastuno rūpaṃ nānugāmīti kā pramā || bhavedyadi viśeṣaikaviṣayaṃ nirvikalpakam | sāmānyādhyavasāyo'yamakasmātkathamudbhavet || nacaitacchābdarūpam | yataḥ, paśyatyanugataṃ rūpamavijñāte'pi vācake | dākṣiṇātya ivākasmātpaśyannuṣṭraparamparām || api ca śābaleyapiṇḍaḍḍatdhmavalokitavataḥ kālāntare kālāntare bāhuleyapiṇḍaṃ, paśyataśśābaleyapiṇḍaḍḍatdhmasmaraṇamutpadyate | tatsāmānayābhāve na ghaṭate | na hyanyasmindṛṣṭe'nyasmaraṇanimittaṃ kiñcidasti | tayoranugatarūpābhyupagame tadupapadyate nānyatheti | kiñca vyaktyantaradraśane'pi sa evāyaṃ gauriti pratyabhijñāyate | tadapyanugatarūpāgrahaṇe na yujyate | na ca vyaktibhedasya, pratyakṣasiddhatvāt | yatra ca laghutaraparimāmatalamudgādipracayasannidhāne'vīcchinnasvalakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ nāsti | tatrānuvṛttameva rūpamindriyeṇa gṛhyate | tasmādviśeṣavatsāmānyāpahvavona yuktaḥ | tasmātpūrvākṣasampāte tulāyatvagamyate | nānātvaṃ ceti sāmānyabhedau dvāvapi vāstavau || sāmānyamidamityevamtha tatrānupagrahaḥ | vyāvṛttamidamityevaṃ kiṃvā biddhissvalakṣaṇā || samānavṛttisāpekṣaṃ na ca sāmānyavanedanam | tatra sannihitatvāt vyaktivannānupagrahaḥ || samānavṛttyapekṣatvātsāmānyasyānupagrahe | viśeṣo'pi ca māgrāhi vyāvṛttiṃ sa hyarekṣate || anuvṛttirhi yeṣvasya kā teṣāṃ grahaṇe gatiḥ | vyāvṛttirapi yebhyo'sya yebhyo'sya kā teṣāṃ grahaṇe gatiḥ || athānuvṛttivyāvṛttinairapekṣyeṇa kevalam | vastveva gṛhyate kāmaṃ kīdṛktaditi kathyatām || nirvikalpakavelāyāṃ nirdiṣṭuṃ tanna śakyate | tadutthāstūbhayatrāpi sākṣyaṃ dadati niścāyāḥ || yañca vṛttivikalpādidūṣaṇaṃ tatra varṇitam | tatpratyakṣamahimnaiva sarvaṃ pratihataṃ bhavet || yattāvadiktaṃ kuvalayāmalakādivadanavabhāsāditi tatra pratītibhedo darśita eva | yattu deśabhedenāgrahaṇāt, tadagrahe tadbudhdyabhāvāditi tatra jātestadāśritvaṃ kāraṇaṃ, nāsattvam | yadapyuktaṃ vṛttyanupapatterati tatrāpyucyate, pratipiṇḍaṃ, kārtsnyenaiva jātirvartata iti piṇḍāntare tadupalambho astyeva | ekadeśāstu jāterna santyeva | kkedamanyatra dṛṣṭaṃ cedaho nipuṇatā tava | dṛṣṭānāṃ yācate yastvaṃ pratyakṣe'pyanumānavat || kiṃnāmadheyā vṛttiriyamiti cenna nāmadheyamasyāḥ jānīmaḥ, piṇḍaḍḍatdhsamavetā jātirityava prachakṣmehe | nanvayutasiddhayossambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ, sa vipratiṣedhādeva nirastaḥ na śakyate nirasitum | pratītibhedādbhedo'stu deśabhedastu neṣyate | tenāvakalpate vṛttissamavāyasstūcyate || avayavāyavinorguṇaguṇinośceyameva vṛttiḥ | arthāntaratvaṃ caitarorjātitulyanyāyayatayā siddhameva | deśabhedaśca tayornāstīti vispaṣṭamayutasiddhatvam | yadapyucyate “nāniṣpannasya sambandho niṣpattau yutasiddhātā | “ iti tadapi parihṛtamācāryaiḥ | jātisambandhaṃ cetyekaḥ kāla iti vadadbhiḥ yā ceha vṛttistatsūtrabhūtakaṇṭhaṇādiṣu | jātyādīnāmanaṅgatvāttābhyāṃ vṛttirvilakṣaṇā || tasmādvṛttyanupapatterityadūṣaṇam | yadapi sarvasarvagatatvaṃ piṇḍaḍḍatdhsarvagatatvaṃ ca vikalpaya dūṣitaṃ tadapi yatkiñcit yathāpratīti tadabhyupagamāt sravasarvagā jātiriti tāvadupeyate | sarvatra grahaṇaṃ tasyā vyañjakavyaktasannidheḥ | vyaktivryañjakatāmeti jāterdṛṣṭaiva nānyathā || dṛṣṭiryatra yajadātvasyāstadā tatraiva tanmatiḥ | sarvatra vidyate jātarnatu sarvatra dṛśyate || tadabhivyañcikā yatra vyaktistatraiva dṛśyate | vyakteranyatra sattve'syāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ taducyate || ihāpyānīyamānāyāṃ gavi gotvopalambhanam | gopiṇḍeḍḍatdhna sahaikasyā nacāgamanasambhavaḥ || dehenevātmanastasmādihāpyastitvamiṣyatām | abhinavyaktistutatkālā yatkālaṃ vyaktidarśanam || tasmātsakṛdabhivyaktā nānyadāpi pratīyate | abhivyaktiśca taddeśā yaddeśā vyaktirīkṣyate || tasmādasminnabhivyāktā na deśe'nyatra dṛśyate | piṇḍaḍḍatdhsarvagatatve'pi svayūthyaiḥ kaścidāśrito || bhaviṣyatyanyajātāyāṃ gavi godhīstayāgrahāt | jāyamānaiva hi vyaktirjāyate jātiyoginī || eka evahi kālo'syā jātisambandhajanmanoḥ | neha jāteḥ purāstitvaṃ nacasaṃkrāntiranyataḥ || kiṃntu svahetossā vyaktistādṛśauvopajāyate | kathametaditīdaṃ tu yena paryanuyujyate || idamapyaparaṃ hanta tena paryanuyujyatām |vṛṣaḥ piśaṅgo gauḥ kṛṣṇā sā ca nīsatṛṇāśinī || tābhyāmutpādito vatsaḥkathaṃ bhavati pāṇḍuḍḍatdhraḥ | yathā rūpādisambandhā sā vyaktirupalabhyate || tathaiva jātiyukteti kā te vyasanasantatiḥ | agovyāvṛttatāyāṃ ca naiṣa praśno nivartate || tasmādagonivṛttaṃ tadanyajātaṃ svalakṣaṇam | tasmādvastusvabhāvasya viditvānuyojyatām || yodyacuñcucvamutsṛjya pratipattirnirūpyatām || pratipattiśca viśeṣeṣaaviva sāmānye'pi nirapavādā darśitaiva | tasmādviśeṣavadapratyākhyo'yaṃ sāmānya iti | upādhireva trividhaḥ pradhānamapi ca tridhā | tridhopaskāravānprātipadikārthaśca varṇitaḥ || vācakatvaṃ nipātānāṃ dyotakatvaṃ ca niścitam | karmapravacamīyānāmukta sambandhasaṅgatiḥ || atho vibhaktyarthavidhāstridhocyate tridhaiva vṛttyarthapadārthanirṇayaḥ | kriyādivākyarthanivartanāttatastridhaiva vākyārthagatiḥ prapañcayate || iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviraceti śṛṅgāraprakāśe upādhyādyarthacatuṣṭayaprakāśo nāma pañcamaḥ prakāśaḥ|| <6> ṣaṣṭhaḥ vibhaktyarthādicatuṣṭayaprakāśaḥ vibhaktyarthastridhā, saṅkhyā, kārakaṃ, śeṣaśca | teṣu kārakasambandhagataikatvadvitvabahutvāni saṅkhyā | sā ṣoḍhā, ābhidhānikī, vaivakṣikī, naimittikī, pāribhāṣikī, vaibhāṣikī, pāriśeṣikī ca | tatrābhidhānikī yathāpaḥ, dārāḥ, lājāḥ, dvayaṃ, anekaṃ, niyutamiti | atrābhidhānato bahivacanaikavacane evetyābhidhānikī | vaivakṣikī yathā rodasī rodasyau, kabarī kabaryaḥ, stanau stanāḥ, viśākhā viśākhe viśākhāḥ, dṛke dṛśau dṛśāḥ, jagat jagatī jaganti | atra vivakṣayaikatvaddhitvabahutvānīti vaivakṣikī | naimittikī yathā vṛkṣaḥ, śobhanaḥ, dampatī, pitarau, akṣāḥ, gabhastaya iti | atra vastuno nimittasya sadbhāvānnaumittikī | pāribhāṣikī yathā mārdaṅgikapāṇavikaṃ, puruṣau, khalatikaṃ, vanāni, gaudau, grāmaḥ, tiṣyapuvarvasū, tārakaḥ, pañcālā janapadaḥ, sa cāhaṃ ca pacāva iti | atra dvitvabahutvādiṣu ekatvādiparibhāṣaṇamiti pāribhāṣikī | vaibhāṣikī yatāśvabaḍaḍḍatdhbam, aśvabaḍaḍḍatdhbau, plakṣanyagrodham, plakṣanyagrodhāḥ, pūrva phalgunyau, pūrvāḥ phalgunya iti | atra vibhāṣayaikatvadvitvabahutvānīti vaibhāṣikī | pāriśeṣikī yathaikaḥ dvau bahavaḥ, ubhau dvitrāḥ, ardhatṛtīyā iti | atraikādyuktasaṅkhyāpariśeṣe svādaya iti pāriśeṣikī | taduktaṃ nimittamekamityatra vibhaktānāmadhīyeta | tadvatastu yadekatvaṃ vibhaktistatra vartate || kārakaṃ ṣaḍḍḍitdhvadhamabhihitaṃ purastāt | taddvitīyādinavācyatvena pṛthakpṛthak ṣaṭ prakāraṃ pratate | tatra karma dvitīyāvācyaṃ kaṭaṃ karoti | tṛtīyāvācyaṃ mātrā sañjānīte | yaturthīvācyaṃ na tvā śune manye | pañcamīvācyaṃ pari trigartebhyo vṛṣṭo devaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaṃ mātussmarati | saptamīvācyam adhītī vyākaraṇe | kartā dvitīyavācyaḥ, gamayati grāmaṃ devadattam | tṛtīyāvācyaḥ, caitreṇa kṛtam | caturthīvācyaḥ, mūtrāya kalpate yavāguḥ | pañcimīvācyaḥ, upādhyāyādadhīte | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaḥ, vyasasya kṛtiḥ | saptamīvācyaḥ, brāhmaṇeṣu bhuñcāneṣu vṛṣalā āsate | karaṇaṃ dvitīyāvācyaṃ, ākṣāndīvyatī | tṛtīyāvācyaṃ, dātreṇa lunāti | catirthīvācyaḥ, śatāya parikrītaḥ | pañcamīvācyaṃ, stokānmuktaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaṃ, sarpiṣo jānīte | saptamīvācyaṃ, akṣeṣu dīvyati | sampradānaṃ dvitīyāvācyaṃ, devadattamabhyasūyati | tṛtīyāvācyaṃ, dāsyā samprayacchate | caturthivācyaṃ, devāya dadati | pañcamīvācyaṃ, gurorārabhya gāḥ prayacchati | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaṃ, ghnataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dadāti | saptamīvācyaṃ, puṣpeṣu spṛhayati | apādānaṃ dvitīyāvācyaṃ, arjunaṃ yoddhāraḥ | tṛtīyāvācyaṃ, dhanuṣā vidhyati | caturthivācyaṃ, śraddhāya nidagṛhṇate | pañcamīvācyaṃ, grāmādāgacchati | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaṃ, kṛṣṇā gavāṃ saṃpannakṣīratamā | saptamīvācyaṃ, bhukta odanaḥ kaṃsapātryam | adhikaraṇaṃ dvitīyāvācyaṃ, grāmamadhivasati | tṛtīyāvācyaṃ, samena dhāvati | catirthīvācyaṃ, yuddhāya sannahyati | pañcamīvācyaṃ, krośādvudhyati | ṣaṣṭhīvācyaṃ, ganāmīśvaraḥ | saptamīvācyaṃ, tīrthe upavasatīti | kārakakātirekī kriyākārakapūrvakaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣaḥ | sa tridhā, uktādanayaḥ, kārakebhyo'nyaḥ, kārakāṇāmavivakṣā ca | teṣu uktadanyatve bhinnasambandhyapekṣaḥ, abhinnasambandhyapekṣaśca | tayorādyo rājñaḥ puruṣa iti yathā patyuśśiraścandrakalāmanena spṛśeti sakhyā parihāsapūrvam | sā rañjayitvā caraṇau kṛtāśīrmālyena tāṃ nirnacanaṃ jaghāna || dvitīyā rāhośśira iti yathā śikhicchadacchatrapatatramaṇḍaḍḍatdhlībharoparuddhaṃ mukhameṇacakṣuṣaḥ | mukhena rāhorabhiyoktumudyataṃ kalāpatau bimbamiva vyarājata || kārakebhyo'nyatve upāttakriyo'nupāttakriyaśca | tayorādyo'nnasya hetorvasatīti | yathaikātapatraṃ jagataḥ prabhutvaṃ navaṃ vayaḥ kāntamidaṃ vapuśca | alpasya hetorbahu hātumicchanvicāramūḍhaḥ pratibhāsi me tvam || dvitīyo brāhmaṇasya tulyo yathā kulena kāntyā vayasā navena guṇaiśca taistairvinayapradhānaiḥ | tvamātmanastulyamamuṃ vṛṇīṣva rantaṃ samāgacchatu kāñcanena || kārakavivakṣāyāṃ dravyāpekṣaḥ kriyāpekṣaśca | tayorādyaḥ sādhossvaṃ dhanaṃ rocata iti, yathā dattamātatmadanaṃ dayitena vyāptamātiśayikena rasena | sasvade mukhasuraṃ pramadābhyo nāma rūḍhamapi ca vyudapādi || dvitīyo na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāditi yathā nivāryatāmāli kimapyasau vaṭuḥpunarvivakṣāsphuritottarādharaḥ | na kevalaṃ yo mahatāṃ vibhāṣate śrṛṇoti tasmādapi yarasa pāpabhāk || sahārthatādathryahetulakṣaṇopapadasambodhanādayastu saṃbandhaviśeṣā upaskārādhikāro'bhihitā iti neha pratanyante | nanu ca sambandhasya kriyākārapūrvatvāt kārakeṣveva śeṣasambandhasyāpyantarbhāva iti saṅkhāyaśaktiśca vibhaktryaḥ | tatra jatau padārthajātyabhidhāyinaḥ prātipadikasya saṅkhyākārakābhidhāyinyā vibhaktyā sambandho na ghaṭate | na hi jāteḥ saṅkhyāśaktiyogassaṃbhavati | ucyate, jātyavinābhāvena lakṣitāyā vyakteḥ saṅkhyāsandhiyogādekārthasamavāyalakṣaṇssambandho bhaviṣyati | naivam, yathānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ bhedavatīṃ vyaktimaśaktāḥ prakṛtayo'bhidhātumityabhinnāmavyabhicāriṇīṃ ca jātimācakṣate | tadādhārabhedādbhinnāmānantyavyabhicārābhyāmaśaktāḥ vibhaktayaśśaktiṃ saṅkhyāṃ cākhyātumatastadādhārāṃ śaktisaṅkhyāsāmānyanāsambandhādanupapanna eva prakṛtipratyayayoḥ samabhivyāhāraḥ | nānupapannaḥ, ekārthasamanetasamavāyena tadupapatteḥ | kathaṃ punassāmānyābhidhānenābhidhīyamānayossaṅkhyadravyayoḥ paraspareṇa sambandhaḥ | yathābhidhīyamānayoḥ | yathābhiśabdenābhihitāvarthau buddhau
