viparivartamānau mithassambandhyete tathā śabdenābhihitādarthāt pratīyamānāvapi paraspareṇa sambandhamanubhaviṣyata iti | kiṃ punariyaṃ saṅkhyā śaktirvā niyogato jātimavacchinatti? netyāha | na hi grahaṃ saṃmāṣrṭīti śrayamāṇamekavacanamekatvasaṅkhyāṃ kriyāṅgabhāvena pratipādayati | nāpi saktīn juhotīti dvitīyāśrutiḥ saktūnāṃ homakriyāyāṃ karmaśaktimabhidhat | api tvakṣāndīvyatītivatsaṃbandhasāmānyatirohitakarmarūpāt saktūn sādhakatamatvena homakarmaṇi niyuṅkte | kkacittu tadrapayaiva vibhaktaśrutyā saṃkhyākarmādiśaktīnāṃ kriyāsvaṅgabhāvo'vabodhyate | yathā paśumālabheta vrīhīnavahantīti | kutaḥ punaridaṃ śrutyupātte api kkacideva saṅkhyāśaktī vivakṣyate? tatra tāvatsaṅkhyāṃ prati śrūyate sattvabhūtamidaṃtaditi vyapadeśayogyaṃ vastu na śakyate śaṅkhyāmantareṇa śabdairabhidhātum, sasaṃkhyānāmeva śabdānāṃ sattvābhidhāyakatvāt | ato nāntarīyakamupādānaṃ saṃkhyāyā iti sattvanirdeśe saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate | yathā brāhmaṇo na hantavya iti | evaṃ ca jātyāpi vinā vastamātras yasaṃpramugdhatvādvivekenābhidhānamaśakyam | ato nāntarīyakaṃ jātyupādānamiti jāterapyavivakṣā prāpnoti | apara āha, yatra saṃkhyāpadairekādibhissaṃkhyā abhidhīyate, tatra niyogataḥ karmāṅgabhāvena vivakṣyate | yathaikāṃ gāṃ dadāti, dvābhyāṃ khanati, trīnpaśūnālabhata iti | ekādiśabdarūpāddhi sā pratīyamānā na śakyamavivakṣatum | anyatra tu śabdasaṃskāramātraparatvādekavacanaideravivakṣā yathā gauḥ padā na spraṣṭavyā | etadapi nāsti yasyobhayaṃ havirārtimācrchedityevamādāvabhayādiśabdopādānādapyavivatrādarśanāt | anye manyantejātyakhyāyāmekasminnanyatarasthāmiti jñāpakādekabahuvacanaṃ ca na vivakṣyate| dvivacanaṃ tu vivakṣyate | yathā sārasvatau bhavataḥ iti | tadapyayuktaṃ, dvivacanasyāpi avivakṣādarśanāt |yathā yadyetau vyadhitau syātāṃ deyaṃ syādidamauṣadham | yatastadauṣadhamekasyāpi dīyamānaṃ vātādivikāraṃ śamayituṃ śaknoti, evaṃ tarhi yatra parāṅgatayā jātirvidhīyate, tatra saṃkhyā vivakṣyate | yatra tu svasaṃskārapratipattaye'nūdyate tatra na vivakṣyate | yathā paśunā yajeta, grahaṃ saṃmāṣrṭīti | tadetadubhamayapi udāharamamātreṇāśakyaṃ pratipattumiti yuktirabhidhātavyā | seyamucyate | paśunā yajeteti yāgasya phalavattayā prādhānyaṃ tadaṅgaṃ paśuḥ, aṅgaṃ ca yatpradhānasyopakaroti | ekenaiva paśunā kṛtaḥ pradhānasyopakāra iti dvitīyo nopādīyate | yadi hi yasya yāvantaḥ paśavassanti tāvata upādatta ityāśrīyate | prakṛtasya yāgasyaikena paśunā samāpitatvāditaravaiyathryaṃ mābhūditi yāgāntarāṇi kriyante | guṇena dravyeṇāpradhānaṃ yāgaḥ pruyaktassyāt | na caiṣa nyāyo yadguṇaḥ pradhānaṃ prayuñcate | kiñca paśumālabheta paśunā yajetetyādau kriyāṅgabhāvenāprajñātasya paśossādhanabhāvaprakhyāpanāyedamutpātitavākyam | tatra śabdadarśanāvaseyatvādarthasya yathābhūtaṃ śabda āha tathābhūtassorthonugatatayā samāśrīyate | śabde'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ prakṛterjātiriva vibhaktessaṃkhyābhidheyatvenāvadhāryate | yadi ca dvitīyasya paśorupādānamantareṇa śabdārtho na samāpyate, kriyā vā na nivatyeta, tadopādiyetāpi dvitīyam | paratvajāteśca prativyaktyavikalpātmanaḥ samāptātvādekapaśvavadainaiśca yāgākriyābhinirvṛtterdvitīyo nopādīyate | na ca paśunā yajetetyasyāssaṃkhyā virodhīni saṃkhyotpattivākyāgatā kācidvidyate | yadanurodhādiyaṃ tyajyeta, yasmādidameva paśorutpattivākyaṃ, ataśśabdavāttvāt saṅkhyāntareṇa cāvipodhāt | paśunā yajetetyādau saṅkhyā vivakṣyate | grāhaṃ saṃmāṣrṭītyatra tu na vivakṣyate | yasmāt prājāpatyā navagrahā bhavantītyādau grahāṇāmutpattivākye yā anekatvasaṅkhyā sā pradhānaviṣayā, tatra grahāṇāṃ vidhīyamānatvāt | grahaṃ saṃmāṣrṭītyatra tu yā ekatvasaṃkhyā sā śeṣaviṣayā, sammārgasya vidhīyamānatvāt, tadidhikaraṇasaṃpādanārthatvāt grahaśabdasya | na ca yuktaṃ yatpradhānasambandhinī saṃkhyā śeṣassaṃkhyāyā bādhyate | nanu cotpattivākyayavaśenāneka eva graho gṛhyate | grahamityetasmāñcaikavacanādekassammṛjyeta | kimatra bādhitaṃ syāt? evaṃ tarhi vidānavākye pūrvameva prajñātāṅgābhāvāḥ sammārgamapūrvaṃ vidhātuṃ kevalaṃ grahamityanena samṛtau saṃniveśyante | grahasmṛtiścānubhavasāmathryādudbhavantī yathānubhutānevārthāndarśayatīti naiko grahaśrigrrahāṇameva smārayati | na camasādīnāṃ tathaivānekagrahasannidhivekavacanamekasyaiva smārayet | yena hi bahavo'nubhūtāstenaikī'pyanubhūta eva | satyametat | kintu pratīyamāno'pyasau saṃkhyābhedaḥ kriyāṃ pratyavidhīyamānatvādasamarthaḥ kriyāmekasminnavasthāpaparyavasitaṃ vākyam | na cāpasaśśabdo'sti, yenaikasya sa vidhīyeta | na caikaśśabda ubhayaṃ śaknoti vidhātum, aprajñānaṃ saṃmārgaṃ prajñātsaya caikatvena saṃbandhamiti pravṛttibhedāt | atha grahaikatvābhyāṃ viśiṣṭassaṃmārgo vidhīyate | na bhidyeta pravṛttiḥ, arthastu naivaṃ, yato grahārthaḥ saṃmārgastasya prayojanattvāt | vibhaktiviśeṣaśca prādhānyaṃ darśayati | ato na vidhīyate saṅkhyā | iha tarhi kathaṃ citragavīṃ badhnātīti citro guṇo vidhīyate, yato'trāpi gorasvatantrīkārastasyāśca citrāyā iti bhidyate pravṛttiḥ, guṇadravyayogasya śrutyaivābhidhīyamānatvāt tadviṣayatvāñca | kriyāyā nātrāparādha iti cet grahamityati | śrutireva saṅkhyāyāstadadhikaraṇasya ca dravyasya kriyāṅgabhāvamabhidhatte | tathā śoṇaṃ yojayedityekaśabdopādānayorjātiguṇayoraṅgīkaraṇam | evaṃ tarhi svārthāyāṃ pravṛttau saṅkhyābedasya vidhātumaśakyatvādavivakṣitā saṅkhyā | yathā grahaṃ saṃmāṣrṭīti | atra grahārthatvātsaṃmārgasya pradhānaṃ grahāḥ, tadaṅgaṃ saṃmārgaḥ | paśunā yajeta, śoṇaṃ yojayet, citragavīṃ vadhnātītyadau tu yāgādikarmārthatvāt pasvadīnāmapradhānānāṃ sasaṅkhyānāṃ saguṇānāṃ ca viśiṣṭānāmeva vidhānamiti vivakṣyate saṅkhyāguṇaśceti | ācāryapravṛttirapyetadeva jñārayati pradhāne saṃkhyā navivakṣyate, guṇe tu vivakṣyata iti | tathā hi | sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa iti karmasādhane śeṣaśabde śeṣaśabdābhidheyasya dravyasya sādhutvadvyākhyānenābhidhīyamānasasaṃskāratvāt prādhānyam | ataḥ svārtha pravartamānasyāvivakṣitasaṅkhyatvādekaśabdopādānaṃ kṛtamekaśśiṣyata iti | tadetalliṅgaṃ pradhānasyāvivakṣitā saṃkhyeti | evaṃ subantaṃ subantena samasyata iti saṃkhyāyā aṅgīkaraṇāt būhanāṃ samāso na bhavati | yathā mahatkaṣṭaṃ śrita iti | atra hyevaṃprakārāvayavasanniveśāvacchinnassamudāyassādhurityanvākhyāyate | ato'vayavaparāmarśepāyena samudāyasya saṃskārādhānaprakrame pradhānaṃ samudāyastamuddiśya pravartamānā avayavā upātatasaṅkhyāviśeṣāṅgīkaraṇena prāvartante | yatra tu yatnāntaramārabhate tatra bahūnāmapi bhavati | yathā kālāḥ parimāṇineti | bahuvacanāt dvyahnajātaḥ, iti | yathā ca bahuvrīhidvandvavidhāvanekagrahaṇānmattabahumātaṅgaṃ vanaṃ, dhavakhadirapalāśā iti | kkacitpurguṇe'pi saṅkhyā na vivakṣyate | yatra tadavivakṣayā pradhānāntasya siddhirbhavati | yathā karturīpsitatamaṃ karmeti | atra hīpsitatamasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ vidhīyamānāvacchedāyā īpsāyā avacchedāyopādīyamānaḥ kartā yadyāśritaikatvasaṃkhyaḥ pratīyeta, anekasyeṇsitaṃ vastu karmasaṃjñāsaṃbandhādapeyāt | ataḥ pradhānasaṃskāroparodhatiraskārāya kartānapekṣitasaṃkhyāviśeṣassāmāśrīyate | nanu ca prayojanamidaṃ pradhānāntarasiddhiḥ | tasmādavivakṣāyāmupapattirvaktavyā | iyamucyate | sāmānyanibandhanatvādīpsitatamaśabdasya saṃbandhināmaviśeṣeṇa praśaktau sādhanāntarocchittaye kartṛgrahaṇaṃ kriyate | tadupāttaviparītapratiṣedhamātropakṣayamasamarthaṃ saṃkhyābhedamaṅgīkartumiti | śaktiḥ punarapradhāne padhāne vā saṃkhyāvati vibhaktyā vidhīyamānā vivakṣāmevānurudyate | evaṃ ca yathā paśvādīnāṃ sasaṃkhyātā tathā grahādīnāmasaṃkhyānāmeva kriyāsu sādhanabhāvo bhavati | kathaṃ panaḥ paśvādigatā saṃkhyā sādhanatvenāvagamyate, yāvatā prātipadikārthasya sākṣātpāraṃparyeṇa vā saṃbandhisādhanatvaṃ saṃkhyā ca vibhaktyā vidhīyate | nu tu saṃkhyāsādhanatvayoḥ paraspareṇa saṃbandho'sti | evaṃ tarhi prathamataraṃ vyaktissaṃkhyayā saṃbadhyate | saṃkhyā saṃsargaprāptātiśayā tu sādhanabhāvena | so'yaṃ sādhanabhāvo viśiṣṭe nipatadviśeṣaṇamapi sādhanamityāvedayati | yathā sāyudhena jītamiti | kutaḥ punarayaṃ saṃkhyāsādhanatvayorekaśebdepanindhanayobandhakārikālabhedena saṃbandhaḥ | na hyetadasti | saṃkhyayā saṃsargamanavāpya na śaknoti sādhanabhāvamāsādayitumiti | evaṃ tarhi saṃkhyāsādhanabhāvābhyāṃ vyaktissaṃbadhyate | tābhyamupahitātmātiśayāmākhyātavithabhaktistāṃ kriyāsu viniyuṅkte | sā viśiṣṭā kriyāsaṃbandhamanubhavatīti viśeṣaṇamapi kriyāsaṃbaddhaṃ pratīyate | nanu ca karmakaraṇādikārakaṃ vibhaktyarthastañca kriyāsiddhāvupāttavyāpātvācchaktimaddravyameva | tasmaśca prātipadikainaivokte kiṃ vibhaktyocyate | śaktiriti brumaḥ? dvidhā hi dravyaṃ sattvabhūtamasattvabhūtañca | tayośśaktisaṅkhyāśrayassattvabhūtaṃ vṛkṣādyarthaḥ | tadanāśrayo'sattvabhūtamavyāyārthaḥ | tadubhayamapi nirupādhyeva prātipadikenocyate | tadāśritāstu saśaktisaṅkhyāsaṃbandhopādhayo vibhaktyeti | nanu ca svarūpādudbhavatkāryaṃ sahākāryubṛṃhitam| naiva kalpayituṃ śaktaṃ śaktimanyāmatīndriyām || śaktirhi kalpyamānā padārthasvarūpavannityā vā syāt | kāryaṃ vā tatra nityatve nityameva kāryotpādaprasaṅgaḥ |sahakāryapekṣā tu svarūpasyaivāstu kiṃ śaktyā | kāryatve tu padārthasvarūpamātrakāryatāyāṃ sadā śakterutapādāt sadaiva kāryotpādaḥ | sāmagrīkāryaṃ tu kāryamevāstu | kimantarāle śaktyā? aśaktātkārakātkāryāniṣpattiriti cecchaktirapi kāryaṃ, tadutpattatau śaktyantarakalpanādanavasthā, anyathā'byupagamanyāghātaḥ | āha, dṛṣṭasiddhaye hyadṛṣṭaṃ kalpyate | śaktyantarakalpanāyāḥ śaktiśreṇinirmāṇa eva, kṣāṇatvāt | kārakāṇāṃ mābhūtkāryavyāghāta ityekaiva śaktiḥ kalpyate | tatkutonavasthā? naivam, anyathāpi tadupapatteḥ | yadi hyarthatattvaṃ kriyāsu pratihanyeta tadā tadatiriktāśaktikalpanā yuktamiti | apratihatāśca sahakārilābhādapi kāryopajanaścārthavyaktayaḥ | tatka vṛthā śaktikalpanayeti | nanu śaktimantareṇa kārakaṃ, kārakameva na bhanet, bhāvatattvasya kriyāsu pratidhātāt | rupameva hi dṛśyate na rasādi, darśanāyatanaṃ paśyati na rasanādi, rasa eva ratasyate na rūpādi, rasanameva rasayati na cakṣurādi, āpa eva pipāsāmapanayanti na tvagniḥ, agnireva śītaṃ śamayati na tvāpa iti | apratighāte hi vastusvarūpāviśeṣāt sarvasmātsarvakāryodayaprasaṅgaḥ | tatascakṣuriva rasanamapi paśyet | rūpamiva saro'pi dṛśyeta | rasanamiva cakṣurapu rasayet | rasa iva rūpamapi rasyeta | āpa ivāgnirapi pipāsāmapanayet | agnirivāpopi śītaṃ śamayeyuḥ | yathā ca tailārthinā tilā upādīyante tathā sikatā apyupādīyeran | yathā vā pādapaṃ chettumanasā paraśurudyamyate tathā pādukādyapyudyamyeta | api ca viśadahanayormāraṇe dāhe ca śaktāvaniṣyamāṇāyāṃ mantrapratibaddhāyāṃ yattayossvakāryodāsūnyaṃ tatra kā yuktiḥ? cakṣuḥśrotrayorvā darśane śravaṇe ca rogādinā yat svakāryākaraṇaṃ tatra kopapattiḥ? na hi mantrādinā rogādinā vā tatsvarūpāṇi sahakārimo vā pratibadhyante, tadrūpeṇaiva teṣāmuralambhāt | śaktayastu pratibadhyanta iti satsvapi svarūpasahakāriṣu kāryānutpādo yuktāḥ | tasmādyathā sukhādikāryānumutamadṛṣṭaṃ sātiśayabuddhinibandhanasmṛtipratyayahetissaṃskāraḥ kriyāviśeṣajanitaḥ kriyāntaraprasavopayogī vega ityādyaparamatīndriyameva kalpyate | bhavadbhistathā śaktirapi kāryātiśayakāramamatīndriyā kalpyatāmiti | tadanupapannam, śaktimantareṇāpi kriyāpratighātādīnāmupapatteḥ | svakāraṇaparaṃparāyātaniyatasvabhāvatayaiva bhinnasvabhāvā rasādayo rūpādibhyaste rūpādibhyaste kathaṃ rūpādisādhyāmarthakriyāmatathābhūtāssādhayeyuḥ? niyogataścaitadaṅgīkartavyam, śaktikalpanāyāmipi tulyānuyogitvāt | kathametāśśaktayo niyatādhārā napuṃravayameva śaktivryāpnuvantīti | padārthasvarūpātiśayāditi cetkāryabhedo'pi tata eva setsyati | api cāśrayasya bhede kathaṃ śaktibhedaḥ? yato vā śaktayaḥ prāptarūpabhedāstata evāśrayarūpabhedena kāryabhedasiddheḥ, kiṃ śaktibhedakalpanena? yāstarhi tulyarūpā vyaktayaḥ kāryamatulyaṃ sādhayanti tāsu katham? yathā galvrathāścandrakāntibhiḥ syandante na sūryagrāvāṇaḥ, karakā arkoṃśubhirvilīyante na muktāmaṇayaḥ, āntaraṃ tejaḥ paśyati na brāhyam, prāṇo vāyuḥ prāṇini na vyānaḥ, śrotrākāśaśśṛṇoti na vaktrākāśaḥ, vidvān kriyāsvadhikriyate nāvidvāniti tulyājātīyatve'pi teṣāmadṛṣṭaphratiniyamo dravyāntarasaṃparkabhedaśca kāryabhedaṃ vyavasthāpayati | yāstasyābhinnābhimarthavyaktayaḥ kāryaṃ sādhayanti, tāsu kathaṃ, yathā tadeva tejo dahati prakāśayati śītaṃ cāpanudati tā evāpaḥ plāvayanti, klamaṃ cāpanayanti, tādṛśaḥ sa tejasaḥ payaso vā rupātiśayaḥ karmaṇā iva saṃyogavegavibhāgavegānukūlatā dharmasyeva sukhajñānāpavargakāraṇatvamiti | upādānaniyame tu na vāyamanyaṃ kaṃcidābhinavaṃ bhāvanāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvamutpājadayāmaḥ | kintu yathāprāptamanusaranto vyavaharāmaḥ | tatra tailotpādapādapacchedāvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vṛddhavyavahārādvā tilaparaśvathādereva kāraṇatvamavagacchāma iti | tadeva tadarthina upādadmade, na sikatāpādukādīti | na ca tilādeḥ paraśvathādervā svarupe satyapi sadā kāryodayaḥ | svarūpavat sahakārisannidherapyapekṣaṇīyasya sarvadānupapatteḥ | sahakarivarge ca dharmādikamapi nipatati, tadapekṣe ca kāryotpāde kathaṃ sravasmātsarvasaṃbhavaḥ? dharmādīnāṃ tu jagadvaicitryādikāryabalena kalpanamaparihāryam | yadapi viṣadahanayoḥ sannidhāne satyapi mantropayogāttatkāryājananaṃ tadapi na śaktipratibandhanibandhanam | api tu sāmagyrantarānupraveśahetukam | nanu mantroṇānupraviśatā kiṃ kṛtam? na kiñcitkṛtam | sāmagyrantaraṃ tu saṃpāditam | kāciddhi sāmagrī kasyacitkāryasya hetussvarūpaṃ tadavasthameveti cedabhakṣitamapi viṣaṃ kathaṃ na hanyāt? tatrāsya saṃyogādyapīkṣaṇīyamasti | mantrābhāvo'pyapekṣyatāṃ divyakāle dharma iva mantro'pyanupraviṣṭaḥ kāryaṃ pratihanti | śaktipakṣe'pi vā mantrasya ko vyāpāraḥ | mantreṇa hi śakternāśo vā kriyate pratibandho vā | na tāvannāśaḥ, mantrāpagame punaḥ kāryadraśanāt | pratibandhastu svarūpasyaivāstu | nanu svarūpasya kiṃ jātam? śakterapi kiṃ jātam? kāryaudāsīnyamiti cettaditaratrāpi samānaṃ svarūpamastyeva, dṛśyamānatvāt | śaktirapyasti punaḥ kāryadarśanānumeyatvāt | etena cakṣuḥ śrikṣayorapi rogādinā darśanaśravaṇaśakternāśapratibandhavikalpo vyākhyātaḥ | apica vyāpāro'pi atīndriyaśaktivadiṣyate bhavadbhiḥ | anayatarakalpanayaiva ca kāryopapatteḥ kimubhayakalpanāgauraveṇa? śaktamāpyavyāpriyamāṇaṃ na kārakamiti cet śaktamiti kathaṃ jñāyeta? kāryadarśanāditi cet vyāpārādeva kāryaṃ setsyati, pādukādevryāpriyamāṇādapi na pādapacchedaṃ paśyāmi | pratyakṣastarhi nātīndriyaḥ, yataḥ kāryadarśanātpūrvamapi vyāpriyamāṇatvaṃ jānāti | kāryānumeyo hi vyapāraḥ kāryādvinā na jñāyetaiva | kāryaṃ tvanyatakasmādapi ghaṭamānaṃ nobhayaṃ kalpayituṃ prabhavatītyasaṃbhavaḥ| śakteriti cedatrocyate | svarūpaṃ svarūpamiti yadbrūṣe tatra kimidaṃ svarūpaṃ nāma? na tāvaddravyaṃ, dravyasya svarūpamiti bhedenābhidhānāt | kiṃ punastatsajatīyebhyo vijātīyebhyasca bhedako dharma iti nāstarkaḥ | taṃ hi bhavanto'pi arthatattvaṃ bhāvatattvamiti bhāvapratyayena bhāṣayante | sa ca yasya guṇasya bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśastatabhidhāne tvatalāviti guṇābhidhāne smaryate | guṇo dharmasāmathryamarthakriyākāritvaśayaśśaktiriti caiko'rthaḥ | sa tudravyadvibhinno vā dravyasyātmaiva vā tathā | vyatirekamupāśritya sādhanatvāya kalpate || parasparato hi vyāvartamānaśarīrāḥ karaṇādayassādhanabhedāḥ kathamekadravyatmatāmupayanto na saṅkīryeran? asaṅkare vā kathamamīṣāmekadravyatmatā yujyate? tasmādekadravyādhikaraṇā karaṇātītirevāsyā dravyadbhedamāpādayati | kiñca vibhaktyrathe'vyayībhāvavacanādavasīyatām | anyo dravyādvibhaktyarthasso'vyayenābhidhīyate || tathā hi | vibhaktyarthe vartamānamavyayamuttarapadena samasyate | yadi ca vibhaktyartha ityenena śaktyāśrayassattvabhūtaṃ dravyamucyate, tadasattvavācināvayayena nābhidhīyeta | tasya cārthasya prātipadikenaivoktatvāt tadabhidhāyyavyayamabhidadhaduttarapadena samāsamanubhavati | tena cāvadhāryate dravyātiriktāṃ śaktimabhidhatte vibhaktiriti | bhavato'pi yuktamevocyate | svarūpādūdbhavācyāt kārakatvādedrravyasvarūpānna śaktimanyāṃ manyante | kintu kāryopajanāyārthavyaktayaḥ kṣamā iti na kṣamante sarvammādapi kāryodayaprasaṅgāt | svakāraṇaparaṃparāyātaniyatasvabhāvatāṃ tu na vidmaḥ | kāraṇaguṇotthaḥ padārthātiśaya iti cet śaktiḥ | tasyāstu nityatvānityatvavikalpanaṃ nopayuktaṃ, yvaddravyabhāvitvena dravyavadeva nityānityātvātasrvadā kāryotpādaḥ kriyātpādaḥ kriyākāla eva śakterunmeṣāt | adṛṣṭa pratiniyatasahākaryādayastu śaktyunmeṣahetavo nāsmābhirapi nārākriyānte | yena tūpādānaniyame anvayavyatirekau vṛddhavyaharaśate'pi kāryadarśanāvaseyaśaktimūlā eva vṛddhairapyanvayavyatirekokteḥ nāśapratibandho vā mantrādinetyādivikalpastu svarūpasya śaktitvasiddhau niṣiddha eva bhavati | vyāpārastu dhātuvācya evātīndrīyo na vāstavaḥ, tena tābhyāṃ tathaiva kāraṇatvāvagamāt | kāryadarśanānyathānupapattikalpitā śaktiratīndriyāyopapannataraiveti | vṛttyarthastridhā, apadārthaḥṣa ekapadārthaḥ, anekāpadārthaśca | tatrāpadārthastridhā, dhātupratyayārthīyaḥ, pratyayapratyayārthīyaḥ, prātipadikapratyayārthīyaśca | teṣu dhātupratyayārthīyo dvidhā, kriyārūpaḥ, kārakarūpaśca | tayoḥ kriyarūpo yathā kartumicchati cikīrṣati, kurvantaṃ prayuṅkte kārayati, atyarthaṃ punaḥ punarvā pacati pāpacyate | kārakarūpo yathā pākaṃ karoti pacati, pākena kriyate pacyate, pācakaḥ paktavyamiti | pratyayapratyayārthīyo dvidhā, nityovaivakṣikaśca | tayornityo yathā kṛtrimaṃ sāṃrāviṇam, vyāvakrośī bhidā, ābhijityaḥ kauñjāyanya iti | vaivakṣiko yathā cikīrṣuḥ, kāraṇā, gāgryāyaṇaḥ, kālyāṇineyaḥ, mālāyāḥ, kumāryā iti | prātipadikapratyayārthīyo dvidhā, vyaktirūpaḥ, śaktirūpaśca | tayovryaktirūpo yathājā, kumāra, brahmabandhuḥ, vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣau vṛkṣāḥ, iti | śaktirūpo yathā vṛkṣaṃ, vṛkṣeṇa, vṛkṣāya, vṛkṣāt, vṛkṣe, vṛkṣasyeti | ekapadārthastridhā, vasturūpaḥ, avasturūpaḥ, kriyārūpaśca | teṣu vasturūpo dvidhī, sattvabhūto'rthaḥ, asattvabhāto'rthaśca | tayossattvabhūto'rtho yathāupagavaḥ, chāndasaḥ, lākṣikaḥ, yauṣmakaḥ iti |asattvabhāto'rthaśca yathāstikaḥ, upatyakā, prakaṭaṃ, tatratya iti | avasturūpo'pi pūrvavadeva dvidhā | tayoḥ sattvabhūto'rtho yathāgnivat, pañcakṛtvaḥ, karvadā, bahuśa iti| asattvabhūto'rtho yathā nātarāṃ, prāha tarāṃ, pacatitarāṃ, pacatirūpamiti | kriyārūpo dvidhā, saṃkṣipto, vitriptaśca | tayoḥ sakṣito yathātmanaḥ, putramicchati putriyati, śyena ivācarati śayenāyate, abhṛśo bhṛśo bhavati bhṛśāyataṃ, senayā abhiyāti abhiṣeṇayatīti | vikṣipto yathā kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, ārātrivivāsamācaṣṭe rātriṃ vivāsayati, puṣyacandrayogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa candraṃ yojayati, ujjayinyāḥ prasthito māhiṣmahīsūryodgamaṃ prāpnoti māhiṣmatyāṃ sūryamudgamatīti | anekapadārthastridhā, ekapadārthāśrayaḥ, ubhayapadārthāśrayaḥ, anyapadārthāśrayaśca | tatraikapadārthāśrayo dvidhā, pūrvapadārthastridhā, ekapadārthāśrayaḥ, ubayapadārthāśrayaḥ, anyapadārthāśrayaśca | tatraikapadārthāśrayo dvidhā, pūrvapadārthaśrayaḥ, uttarapadārthāśrayaśca | tayoḥ pūrvapadārthāśrayo yathopakumbhaṃ, paruṣavyāghraḥ, gomatallikā, pūrvakāyaḥ, rājadantaḥ, prāptajīvika iti | uttarapadārthāśrayo yathā rājapuruṣaḥ, yūpādāru, kaṣṭāśritaḥ, śvalebhyaḥ, dvyāhnajātaḥ, prāptajīvika iti |utatarapadārthāśrayo dvidhā, ekadhikaraṇo bhinnadhikaraṇaśca | tayorekādhikaraṇo yathā nīlotpalam, agnistokaḥ, puruṣottamaḥ, sarvaśvetaḥ, saptarṣayaḥ, khajekuṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, iti | bhinnādhikaraṇe yathā dhavakhadirau, asvabaḍaḍḍatdhbau, dadhipayasī, dhavakhadirapalāśāḥ, kākolūka, gavāśvamiti | anyapadārthāśrayo dvidhā, satadguṇo'tadguṇaśca | tayossatadguṇo yathonmattagaṅgāṃ, śastrīśayāmā, sahastrākṣaḥ, śūlapāṇiḥ, dvitrāḥ, ardhatṛtīyā iti | atadguṇo yathoḍharatha, citraguḥ, dakṣiṇapūrvā, uṣṭramukhaḥ, guḍaḍḍatdhpriyaḥ, priyaguḍa, iti | atha ye vṛttiṃ vartayanti kiṃ ta āhuḥ parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiriti? kaḥ punasyārthaḥ? kiṃparārthasyābhidhānamāhosvitparārthamabhidhānamiti? ubhayathā'pi na doṣaḥ, yadā tāvadetāvaddarśanamanekamapyarthameka eva śabdaḥ pratyāyayati, tadā vākyāvasthāyāṃ śabdāntarābhidheyatāyā pratītamarthātmānaṃ vṛttirviṣaye tadupasarjanapadamabhidheyabhānenopādatte | tadetadvibhaktapadāvasthāyāmabhidhānaśaktipratighātādvṛtau parārthasyābhidhānaṃ parārthasyabhidhānaṃ parārthābhaidhānamucyate | yadā punareṣa pakṣaḥ ekaśśabdo anekamarthaṃ pratyāyayati tadā puro vārtamevārthe vṛtativiṣaye tānyupalarjanapadāni parārthamupādadate | vyaktamevāsmindarśane parārthābhidhānam | tatra dvayī gatiḥ | vihāya vā prasiddhamarthasambandhamupasarjanapadānyarthāntamupādadīran | avasthita eva vā prācye'rthe'rthentaramabhidadhīran | dvayamapi hītamanyatra dṛśyate | tadyathā dadhikalaśe dadhyapanīya kṣīraṃ nidhīyate | jalaṃ tu sikatākumbhe sahaivāvatiṣṭhate sikātādibhiḥ | tadāha teṣāṃ parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiriti bruvatāṃ kiṃ jahatsvārthā vṛttirāhosvidajahatsvārtheti? kiñcātaḥ yadi jahatsvārthā rājapuruṣa ānīyatāmityukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti | aupagavamānayeti cāpatyamātrasya | athājahatsvārthā | ubhayorbhidyamānasvārthayodrvayordvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | tadevamubhayatrāpi doṣadarśanādubhayāpratipattiḥ | tatraikeṣāṃ darśanam | upāttārthaparityāgenārthāntaraniveśīnyupasarjanapadāti, yato'rthāntaramaparādhīnasya śabdasya prācyamevārthamuvidhīyamānasyārthāntarābhidhānamaśakyam | tasmādarthantaramabhidadhatā parityājyamanenopāttamarthavastu | tadāha kā punarvṛttinryāyyā, jahatsvārtheti yuktaṃ punaryajjahatsvārthā nāma vṛttissyat? bāḍhaṃ yuktam | evaṃ hi dṛśyate | loke puruṣo'yaṃparakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ svaṃ karma jahāti | tadyathā takṣā rājakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ svaṃ karma jahāti | evaṃ ca yadrājā puruṣārthe upaguścāpatyārthe vartamānaḥ svamarthaṃ jahyāt | nanu ca yathā takṣā kośasamāharaṇasannidhāpanādau rājakarmaṇi vyāpriyamāṇaḥ svavyāpārāparityāgena rājakarmaṇo'nuṣṭhātumaśakyatvāt svaṃ dārucchedaturaśrīkaraṇādivyāpāraṃ jahāti, tathā yadyupasarjanamapyrathaāntarapratyāyanādau parārthe vyāpriyamāṇaṃ svārthāparityāgena parārthābhidhānaṃ kartumaśakyamiti pūrvepāttamarthaṃ viśeṣaṇatvādi jahyāt | taduktodāharaṇayoḥ puruṣamātrasyāpatyamātrasya cānayanaṃ prāpnoti | naiṣa daṣaḥ | yadyapi svārthamupasarjanapadānyabhiniviśante, tathāpyādhāya pradhāne rūpabhedamupagṛhītārthātiśayanibandhanamuttarakālaṃ svārthamujjhanti |atastadā rūpabhedānugataḥ puruṣārtho nivṛtta'pyupasarjanapadārthe viśiṣṭa eva pratīyate | na hyatiśayādāyinimittasanimittasannidhānakālamātrānuvartinastadāhitā viśeṣāḥ | api tu nimittavyavāye apyunuvartante | tatra yathā śaradarkaraśmisaṃtāpodabhutenāntaśśarīratejasā jvassamudīryamāṇo nātapasparśavarjanamātreṇa pratikriyate | yathā vā pradīptatejassaṃyogapratilabdhajanmāno rūparasagandhasparśāviśaṣāḥ dūrotsārite'pi tejasi yāvadāyadhāramavatiṣṭhante, tathopasarjanapadārthopahitaḥ pradhānarūpātiśayaḥ tadarthāstamaye'pi prayāsyaviśeṣāvacchedanimittaṃ bhavati | yadivopasarjanaśrutimarthaviśeṣabhidhānasāmathryavatīmavadhṛtavataḥ tadavasāyopahitasaṃskāravṛttilābhaprāpitajanmā tadarthaparicchadeḥ parityaktārthāyāmapi śrutau rūpasāmānayādapahṛtabuddheranavagatārthaparityāgasya pravartate | tatastadupahitaviśeṣaṃ pradhānameveti | nanu ca yadi tasyā eva śruteḥ prayogadarśanābhyāsasāmathryattamevārthe pratipadyate kaḥ svārthaparityāgaḥ | na hi śrūtau tasyāṃ bhastrāyāmuvopakaraṇaviśeṣāḥ kṛtasanniveśāḥ padārthāḥ | kiṃ tarhi te śabdarūpadarśanānumeyāḥ, tadihāpi tathaiveti kimavahīyate svārthasya? naivam, nivṛtte'pi svārthe'nvayato'rthāḥ pratīyante | tadyathā ghṛtaghaṭastailaghaṭa iti | niṣiktepi ghṛte taile vā anayoḥ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā ghaṭaviśaṣaṇaṃ bhavati | ayaṃ ghṛtaghaṭastailaghaṭa iti | viṣaya upānyāso bhavati | tatra yā ca yāvatī cārthamātrā aṅgaṃ hi bhāvāgnau niṣṭapya tṛṇakūrcau prakṣālayituṃ na gamyate sa viśeṣaḥ, yathā tarhi mallikāpuṭaścampakāpuṭa iti | niṣkīrṇāsvapi sumanassu tatsamparkopahitagandhaviśeṣādyanupravṛtteḥ pratīyate vyapadeśāḥ | ayaṃ mallikāpuṭo'yaṃ cambakapuṭa iti | tathehāpyanvayādupasarjanārthaḥ parityakte'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | athavā jahadapyasau svārthe rājaśabdo nātyantāya jahāti | kaścideva bhāgaḥ svārthasyāpi hiyate | kathaṃ virodhādeṣassvārthamavajahāti? tato yāvatāsya pradhānārthopayogavirodhastāvantamevārthe jahyāt | tadāha yaḥ parārthavirodhī svārthaḥ taṃ jahāti | nahi pradhānārthopayoginaḥ svārthasya tyāge nidarśanamasti | nahi rājakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ takṣā rājakarmaiva jahāti, nahi hītahasitakaṇḍūḍḍatdhyitāni | na cāyamarthaḥ parārthavirodhiviśeṣaṇatvaṃ nāma | tasmānna hāsyāti | nanu copasarganapadāni pradhānārthāvacchedavyāpārāveśavanti | pradhānepakāriṇaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvaṃ na jahatītyacyate | ayameva caupasarjanapadārthānāmartho yatphradhānamavāptarūpabedamavagamayanti | tathāhi | rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti snāmiviśeṣasambandhopahitabhedaḥ puruṣortho'vagamyate rājapuruṣa iti | na cāpadārtharūpabhedapradhānasyādhātuṃ tadanavahūyamānasvārthamevopasarjanapadamiti | kimucyate jahatsvārthā vṛttiriti? evaṃ manyate padasya svākiśayapratirapattau svādhīnatvaṃ, tasya tyāgāt svārthāpahānam | yadi copasarjanapadaṃ na svārthena pradhānasyopakuryāt, svarūpamevāsyahīyate | yataḥ paropakāritākāraṇakamvopasarajatvaṃ prayogavaiyathrya copasarjanasya, prasajyate | pradhānasyottarapadenaiva pratītatvāt | na cānarthakāṇaṃ pareṇa sambandho ghaṭate, sāmāthryanibandhanā samāsasaṃjñā ca nopapadyate | tasmānna sakalārthaparityāgaḥ | kiṃ tarhi viśeṣaṇatayā svapadepadhīyamānarūpātiśayapratipattiyogyatāmātrasyapahīyate | nanu ca parityaktaseṣārthamapi upasarjanapadarthaviśeṣābhidhāyinassamudāyasya varṇavadaṅgabhāvamāpatsyate? naivam, evaṃ hi rratīyamānaḥ pradhānārthorayogī padārthaḥ parityakto bhāvī | na ca piratyaktasvārthabhya upasarḍaḍḍatdhnapadebhyaḥ pradhānaviśeṣo viśeṣaṇavisaśeṣyāvacchinnaḥ samudāyo vā pratīyate | na cāpratīyamānaśśabdārtho nyāyyaḥ kalpayitumiti yatkiñcidetate | yadyapi cāyaṃ samudāyaḥ evāvyapadeśyapūrvāparabhāgo bhāgabhedānuyāta ivāsīyamānaḥ saṃbandhī padārthadvayopahitabhedaṃ hyarthamabhidhatte | tathāpi tadadhigamopāyaḥ pūrvottaravibhāgadarśanam | tatra ca vṛttau samarthādhi kāraḥ kriyate samarthanāmabhedo bhedassaṃsargo vā | iha rājña iktayukte sarvasvaṃ prasaktam | puruṣa ityekta sarvaḥ svāmī praśaktaḥ | ihedānīṃ rājapuruṣamāyetyukte rājapuruṣaṃ nivartayati anyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ | puruṣo'pi rājānamanyebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ evametasminnubhayato 'vacchenne yadi jahāti kāmaṃ jahātu | na jātu cit puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ bhaviṣyati | nanu ca puruṣa ityukte na strītyetāvatā saṃpratyayena bhavitavyam | satyamevametat | yadā tu puruṣa ākāraviśeṣāddravyāntarasambandhādvā svātantryeṇa nijrñāta upalabdhaṃ tatpratyetaducyate | rājño hi nijrñātārthatvāt parārthāyāṃ pravṛttau sāmānyasaṃsargaviṣayaḥ prātipadikārthavyatireka upajāyate | puruṣastu nijrñātārthāt svāmiviśeṣasaṃbandhādavadhriyamāṇaḥ pūrvamavyatiriktaprātipadikārthaḥ prathamāntaḥ svāmuviśeṣasthaṃ sambandhamanubhavati | tasmin pratilabdhāvibhaktau yathā uttaro vyatireka upajāyate vākyārthaḥ sa bhavati | ihedānīṃ rājā puruṣaṃ nivartayati anyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ | tatra yo'sau bhedastatsāmathryaṃ tannimittā ca vṛttiḥ bhedanimittayāṃ ca vṛttauḥ satyāṃ vṛttyabhimukhasya bhedamupajanayya svārtho nivartate | yasyāpi na nivartate puruṣasya so'pi svāminaṃ bhinatti | evametayodrvayo ranyonyakṛptau satyāmubhayato vyavacchedena nijrñāte puruṣaviśeṣe samudāyārthe cānyasminna prādurbhūte yadi rājārtho nivartate kāmaṃ nivartatām | prāktu vṛtterakṛtārthasya nivṛttau vṛttireva na syāt | vṛttinimittā ca nivṛttiḥ | tasmādadoṣaḥ | apara āha puruṣa eva hi rājapuruṣo brāhmaṇādipuruśca | tatra rājā svāmyantaranivṛttimātraṃ karoti | na tvasau rājārthameva nivartayati | svāmyantaranivṛttau tu kṛtāyāṃ puraṣa eva rājapuruṣārthamāheti | athānyamataṃ nāvasthitārthaparityāgena śabdo'rthāntaraṃ upādatte | na hyapauruṣeyasaṃbandhopahitanivośamārthāstyuktuṃ tāthārthamapi naiva yogakṣemamapahūtuṃ kṣamante | na hi jalamanalasaṃsparśopacīyamānasparśātiśayamapyātmīyaṃ snehaṃ jahāti |nimittaviśaeṣasannidhānopapādite punareṣāmarthāntarabhidhānasāmathryakāmacārastasmādabhyuñcaya evārthāntarasya vṛttāvupasarjanapadānāṃ pradhānopakārātiśayaḥ | pradhānopakārastu svāmiviśeṣāvacchedaḥ puruṣārthasya | sa cāparityāgenaiva svārthasya kartuṃ śakyate | na hyatyantamapākīrṇasvārthaṃ śabdarūpātiśayamarthāntare niveśayituṃ śaknoti | paॉrūpātiśayaniveśanāyāṃ padārthanipabandhanatvādanaṅāgīkṛtasvārthani ca yānyupasarjanapadāni pradhānārthaniveśīni tamevārthaṃ śabdāntareṇa pratipādayanti | na tairatiśayaḥ pradhānasya pratipādito bhavati | tataśca rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti | aupagavamānayeti cāpatyamātrasyeti | tadavadhāryāmāhe, athavā punarastvajahatsvārthā vṛttiḥ | yuktaṃ punaḥ yadajahatsvārthā nāma vṛttissyāt? bāḍhaṃ yuktaṃ, evaṃ dṛśyate loke bhikṣiko'yaṃ dvitīyāṃ bhikṣāmāsādya pūrvāṃ bhikṣā na jahāti, sañcayāyaiva yatate | nanu coktamubhayorvidyamāsvārthayoḥ dvayordvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | kasayāḥ punardvinavacanaṃ prāpnoti? prathamāyāḥ | na prathamāsamartho rājā | ṣaṣṭhyāstarhi prāpnoti | na ṣaṣṭhīsamarthaḥ puruṣaḥ | prathamāyā eva tarhi prāpnoti | nanu coktaṃ na prathamāsamartho rājābhihitaḥ, so'rtho'ntarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthassaṃpannaḥ | tatra prātipadikārthe prathame prathame prathamāyā eva dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | tatra yathā dhavakhadirāviti padārthāntaropacaye saṅkhyabhedopajanakādekavacanaṃ pravartate tadvidihāpi rājapuruṣa iti puruṣaśabdāddvivacanaṃ prāpnoti | naivam, ghavakhadirāvityavayavārthasamavetassaṅkhyāviśaeṣaḥ, tato'vayavātparasyā vibhakteḥ kāraṇam | iha tu eka ekapuruṣārthastadekavacanameva puruṣaśabde nyāyyaḥ | na hi rājaśabdenāsambadhyamānā vibhaktistadarthasamavavetāṃ saṅkhyāmabhidheyatvena apekṣate | dvandvapadānāṃ tu pratyayavayavamanekārthābhidhānasāmathryādanavekavacanaṃ na virudhyate | anuttarapadeṣvapi tarhi tatprāpnoti | prāpnatu| “supo dhātuprātipadikayo”riti lopo bhaviṣyati | athāyamabhiprāyaḥ | samudāyātparā vibhaktiḥ, atassamudāyārthasamavāyinīṃ saṅkhyāmabhidhatte | samudāyasya cāvayavātmakatvādavayavabhedenibandhanassaṅkhyābedaḥ, nimittamanekavacanasyeti | tadetatkka yujyate? yatra padasamudāyenārthasamudāyaḥ pratyayyate, yathā dvandvapade | yatra tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāvacchinnamarthāntaramevābhidheyamavayavaiḥ samudāyenopādīyeta, yathā bahuvrīhipade lohitavasanaḥ cetraveṣṭana iti| tatrāvayavārthāhitabhedasya padārthasya samudāyenābhidhīyamānatvāt | tataḥ parā vibhaktissamudāyārthaniveśinīṃ saṅkhyāmupādatte | tadāha saṅghātasyaikāthryānnāvayavasaṅkhyātassubutpattiḥ | atra hi samudāyādrājapuruṣa ityetasmāt vibhaktyotpattavyam | tena samudāyenaivaikārthapiṇḍo'vayavārthaśaktyanugṛhītaḥ pṛthagavyapadeśyo'vayavaśaktirabhidhīyate | tasmaśca saṅghātārthe svāmiviśeṣaparicchinne nivṛttasvāmyantarasaṃbandhe ekatvaṃ samavetaṃ, tena vidyamānāyāmapyavayavasaṅkhyāyāṃ tadāśrayā subutpattirna bhaviṣyati | tadevamajahatsnavārthāyāṃ vṛttau tadupasarjanapadaṃ svārthātiśayāvacchinnaṃ pradhānārthamabhidadhāti | tato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhūtārthadvayābhidhānamupasarjanasya vṛttau bhavati | yattu pradhānārthasaṃbhāvaviśeṣaṇaṃ pāṭaliputrakādi tadasya nivṛrtate | ato vṛttiviṣaye rajārthaḥ tairviśaṣaṇairnāvacchidyate | yadā tu vākyāvasthāyāmupasarjanaṃpadārthaḥ pradhānasaṃsparśāvibhaktaḥ kevala eva bhavati tadā yuktameva ydaviśeṣaṇabhaāvamanubhavati, yathā rājñaḥ pāṭaliputrakasya puruṣa iti | yadi vopāyamātrānnānātvaṃ samūhastveka eva saḥ | vikalpābhyuñcayābhyāṃ tu bhedasaṃsargakalpanā || tatrātyantājahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau puruṣaśabde puruṣārthābhidhāyini sravaśabdeṣu ca pratiniyamārthābhiniveśiṣu bheda eva sāmathryam | ajahatsvārthāyāṃ tu vṛttau puruṣaśabde purumātrābhidhāyini sarvaśabdeṣu ca pratiniyatārthābhiniveśiṣu saṃsarga eva sāmathryam | nātyantamajahatsvārthāyāṃ vṛttau puruṣādiṣu saṃbandhiśabdeṣu saravaśabdānāṃ cāsamarthayonitvābhyupagame samāptau bhedasaṃsargau sāmathryamityākhyāyate | vṛttiṃ vartayatāmevamabudhapratipattaye | bhinnāḥ sambodhanopāyāḥ puruśeṣvanavasthitāḥ || nahi paramārthataḥ parākṛtapūrvottaravibhāgasaṃsparśena saṅghātenātiśayavatyarthe'bhidhīyamāne bedasaṃsargadarśanāvakāśaḥ kaścidasti | tasmādasatyeva bhedasaṃsargadarśanena satyassamudāyārtho nirupyata iti | padārthastridhā, jātavryaktirākṛtiśca | tatra bhinneṣvabhinnapratyayanimittaṃ jātiḥ | sā tridhā, dravyajātirguṇajāti kriyājātiśca | tāsu dravyajātirdvidhā, saṃsthādivyaṅgyā upadeśavyaṅgyā ca | tayorādyā yathā gauḥ padā na spraṣṭavyā, saṃpanno vrīhissubhikṣaṃ kārotīti | dvitīyā yathā brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ, kaṭhaḥ pravaktaḥ bhavatīti | guṇajātirdvidhā, pratyakṣā anumeyā ca | tayorādyā yathā śvetaṃ chāgamālabheta, amlo saraḥ pācanaṃ dīpanīya iti | dvitīyā yathā dakṣaḥ śriyaṃ adhigacchati, kāmī maṇḍaḍḍatdhnapriyo bhavatīti | kriyājātidvidhā, sāmānyarūpā viśeṣarūpā ca | tayorādyā yathā raipoṣaṃ puṣyati, nāgarakavṛttaṃ varteteti | dvitīyā yathāṣṭakā kṛtā, viśaavajitā yajeteti | jātyādhāro vyaktiḥ |sā tridhā, dravyavyaktiḥ, guṇavyaktiḥ, kriyāvyaktiśca | tāsu dravyavyaktirdvidhā, śuddhā miśrā ca | tayorādyā yathā gāṃ badhāna, gāṃ dogdhi, tvaṃ pacasi, ahaṃ pacāmīti | dvitīyā yathā magadeṣu stanau pūnau kaliṅgeṣaavakṣiṇī śubhe | bāhū pralambāvaṅgeṣu vaṅgeṣu caraṇau mṛdū || iti | guṇavyaktirdvidhā, mukhyā gauṇī ca | tayorādyā yathā śvetimā rūpaṃ paśyāmi, madhuraṃ rasamāsvādayāmi, sugandha gandhamājighrāmi, śītaṃ sparśamanubhavīmīti | dvitīyā yathā “tīvraḥ pratāpo madhuraṃ navacaste yaśo'vadātaṃ surabhiḥ svabhāvaḥ | “ iti | kriyāvyaktirdvidā, katrrāśritā, karmāśritā ca | tayorādyā yathāste devadattaḥ, prasnute gaussvayameveti | dvitīyā yathā pacyate odanaḥ, lūyate kedāraḥ svameveti | vyaktaḥ pratirūpamākṛtiḥ . sā tridhā, dravyākṛtiḥ, guṇākṛtiḥ, kriyākṛtiśca | tāsu dravyākṛtirdvidhā, śrutadaśā, dṛṣṭadaśā ca | toyarādyā yathāsyāṃ dṛṣadi vāsudevaḥ kriyatām, asyāṃ bhittau krāmadevo likhyātām, atra dhvaje hanūmān badhyatāmiti | dvitīyā yathāmī piṣṭapiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantām, ayaṃ kūpe candramāḥ, ayamākāśe devapatha iti| guṇākṛtirdvidhā, pratyakṣāśrayā, anumeyāśrayā ca | tayorādyā yathā vaṃdhrīkā darśanīyo manuṣyaḥ, cañcā ramaṇīyaḥ, tadetadghuṇākṣaraṃ dvitīyā yathāho duḥkhaṃ rūpaṃ lekhyasya, vidagdha ākāraścittasya, saumyā mūrtiḥ pratimāyā iti | kriyākṛtidvidhā, kāyakriyādhārā, manaḥkriyādhārā ca | tayorādyā yatharjvāgatamālekhyam, sācimukhavartakaḥ parāvartakamukhasthānamiti | dvitīyā yathā bhītā dṛṣṭiḥ, trasta ākāraḥ, savikāraṃ rūpamiti | nanu ca jātirena iti jaiminīyāḥ | jaiminirhi, jātimevākṛtiṃ prāha vyaktirākṣipyate yayā | sāmānyaṃ tañca piṇḍānāmekabuddhinibandhanam || nanu ca, sāsnādīnāṃ sanniveśa ākṛtiḥ | na cāsau jaiminimate'pi na pṛthagasti | yadāha bhāṣyakāro’atha gaurityatra kaśśabdārthaḥ sāsnādiviśiṣṭā ākṛtiriti | tataśca saiva śabdārtho bhavati | naivam, evaṃ sati saṃsthānasya prativyaktibhinnatvāt, ānantyavyabhicārābhyaṃsaṃbandhasya grahītumaśakyatvāt | na ca vidyamānāyāmapyākṛtau gāmānayetyuktaścitrapustamayīṃ kaścidgāmānayati | nanu jātipakṣe'pi jātessarvagatatvātkimiti mṛdgakānayanaṃ na bhavati, sāsnādimataḥ prāṇina eva gotvābhivyañjakatvāt | ato nākṛtirjāteḥ pṛthakchabdārtha iti| vyaktirapi na śabdārthaḥ, sā hi vyaktimātraṃ vā syādviśiṣṭā vā | na tāvadvyaktimātraṃ, asvādivyaktāvapi gauriti jñānābhidhānayoḥ prasaṅgāt | avagamastu śabdāt pramāṇāntarato vā | na pramāṇāntarataḥ, tadasannidhānāt | śabdatastu gotvāvagame tadeva prathamataśśabdo'bhidadhāti, nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiriti nyāyāt | nanu jātiṃ viśeṣaṇatvena viśeṣyatvena ca vyaktiṃ gośabdo vakṣyati, na śaknoti vaktumatibhārāt | tadāha viseṣyaṃ nābhidhā gacchet kṣīṇaśāktirviśeṣaṇe || iti || nanu daṇḍyādiśabdaviśeṣaṇaṃ jātiviśeṣyaṃ ca vyaktiṃ gośabdādeva pratipatsyāmahe | tatko syātakibhāraḥ? viṣama upanyāsaḥ | tatra hi prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭaḥ pratyayārthaḥ avagamyate | gośabdena tu naivamiti | na ca vyaktyavagatau gatiranyā nāsti, yenobhayābhidhānaṃ kalpyate | avinābāvabalena jātipratītāvapi tatpratītisiddheḥ | yadi ca vyaktiśśabdārtho bhavet, vyaktyantare gośabdo na prayujyate, na ca na prayujyate, tasmātsarvavyaktisādhāraṇo jātirasyārthaḥ, na vyaktiḥ | nanu ca, vyaktyantarampi vyaktireva | so'yaṃ vyaktau gauśabdaḥ prayukto na sāmānye | naivam | evaṃ sati karkādivyaktāvapi prasaṅgaḥ | yatrāsya prayogo dṛṣṭastatra vā prayujyata iti cet, adya jātāyāṃ gavi prāyoji | api ca vyaktau padārthe iyamiyaṃ vā gauriti pratītissyāt |, na punariyamiyaṃ ceti | na ca ākṛtāviva vyaktāvapyānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ samabandhagrahamamupapadyata iti | kathaṃ purimā jātayaḥ parasparato vyāpartamānaśarīrā bhaveyuḥ | rūpameva hyāsāṃ parasparato vyāvartate | viṣayarūpānurodhī ca pratyayassvākārabhedena tadavacchinatti | tadanuvidhāyinaśca śabdāstathaiva tadupādadate | evaṃ tarhi nityatvādāsāṃtadrūpāsāyassadā prayujyata | naivam, asmanniyatāśrāṇāmanabhivyakteḥ | yadyenamabhivyañcakavaśādavasāyastāsāmiti sopavyañjanāśśabdairabhidhīyeran | tanna | yathā kācādarśādakādiṣu pratīyamānabhedo mukhādirarthaḥ kācādidarśanāpekṣo na pratīyate | na ca kācādibhirupadarśitamarthamābhidadhānāḥ śabdāḥ kācādīnupādadate, tathā vyaktibhiruparśitarūpavibhāgā jātayastābhirasaṃspṛṣṭā eva śabdaiḥ pratyayyante | kathaṃ punarāśrayāśśabdena asamakpṛśyamānabhedā api jātibedāvagamāya kalpante | yathā cakṣirādayo'pratīyamānā api rūpādiviṣayaviśeṣapratipattaye | taduktaṃ yathā jalādibhivryaktaṃ mukhamevābhidhīyate | tathā dravyairabhivyaktā jātirevābhidhīyate || yathendriyagato bheda indriyagrahaṇādṛte | indriyārtheṣvadṛśyo'pi jñānabhedāya kalpate || vinātmarūpagrahaṇādvyañjikā vyaktayastathā | sāmānye jñānabedānāmupayānti nimittatām || iti | vyaktireva śabdārtha iti vyāḍīyāḥ | śabdo hi padaṃ, tañca vibhaktyantameva na prātipadikamātram | vibhaktiḥ prātipadikaduñcarantī prātiradikārthagatameva svārthāmācaṣṭe | yugapañca tritaṃya vibhaktyartho liṅgaṃ saṅkhyā kārakaṃ ca | na yaitatrtritayaṃ prātipadikārthe jātāvanveti, na hi jāteḥ kārakatvaṃ, amūrtatvāt | na saṅkhyāsambandhitvamabhedāt | na strītvādisāmānyayogo nissāmānyatvāt | nanvavātmanīyasāmānye kārakatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | kakṣyāntaritamityeṣa yukto vaibhaktikonvayaḥ || naitatsāram | amūrtasyāpyātmano jñānaprayatnādiyoge kārakatvamupapadyate | jātestu na mānagapi vyāpārasaṃsparśa iti | nanu ca vyaktilakṣaṇāyā sravamupapadyate | naivam, lakṣaṇā hi tatra bhavati, yatra sakṛtprayuktaṃ padaṃ kiñcanārthamabhidhatte, bhūyaścānupapadyamānamarthāntaraṃ lakṣayati | lakṣite ca śaktisaṅkhyādikaṃ niveśayati | atra tu nānyathānupapattyādi saṃbedyate | na ca vyaktipratītivryavahiteti kecanmanyante | vyaktimeva ca śaktisaṅkhyānurañjitāṃ kāryayoginīṃ paśyāmaḥ | ata eva cālambhanaprokṣaṇaviśasanādyo jātau na vidhīyante | na ca ṣaṭ deyāḥ dvādaśa deyāḥ caturviśatirdeyā iti bhedasaṅkhyayā jātiryujyate | api tu vyaktirevainaṃ bhāramudvahiti | kiñca jātau padārthe “yadi paśurūpākṛtiḥ palāyetānyaṃ tadvayasamālabhete “ti paśoranyantavaṃ na yujyate, jāterabhedāt | api ca, cayāpacayasaṅghātasvasvamitvādikalpanāḥ | yānti jātyabhidheyatvapakṣe sākṣānna saṅgatim || etena tulyayogakṣematvādākṛtirapi na śabdartha ityuktaṃ bhavati, tasyā api prokṣaṇādikriyāsādhanatvāyogāt | na hi sanniveśaḥ prokṣyate ālabhyate viśasyate vā | ye ca saṅkhyāyogādayaḥ cāyāpacayādayo vā te jācāvākṛtāvapi na yujyante | kiñca ākṛtivacanatve gośabdasya śuklādigumavācibhiḥ padāntaraissāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na prāpnoti |na hi śuklādayo guṇāḥ ākṛtivṛttayaḥ | api tu vyaktivṛttaya iti | na caitadvācyaṃ vyaktilakṣaṇādvārakamidaṃ bhaviṣyatīti lakṣaṇā hi mukhyābhāve pravartate | na khalu ṛjau vahati vatrmanyanṛradhvā''śrayitavyo bhavati |na catānantyavyabicārābhyāṃ sambandhāgrahaṇamiti vaktavyam | taddhi jātimākṛtiṃ vopalakṣaṇamāśritya bhaviṣyati | yadyevamupalakṣaṇabhūtāṃ jātimākṛtiṃ vābhidhāya śabdo vyaktimabhidhtate | naivam, āstamabhidhīyamānaḥ vidyamānamapi pratirannamātrameva upalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | tadyathā katamaddevattagṛhaṃ, yatrāyaṃ kāka iti | atra hi na kākalakṣaṇopalakṣaṇadvārema pravṛtto devadattagṛhaśabdaḥ kākārthamābhidhatte | uparate vā kākasaṃbandhe tadvyavacchinnavastuniveśitāṃ jahāti | evaṃ jātyupalakṣaṇadvāreṇa vyaktau pravartamānaśśabdo jātiṃ ca nābhidhīsyati | tadvyavacchinnagovyaktiviniveśaṃ ca na hāsyati | etenākṛtirapi, śabdenānabhidhīyamānaiva vyaktimupalakṣayatīti lakṣyate | tadyāthā kataratsuvarṇaṃ, ya eṣa rucakaḥ, svastiko vardhamānaka iti | na hyatra rucakādyākāradvāreṇa pravṛttassuvarṇaśabdorucakādyākāramabhidhatte | uparateṣu rucakādyākāreṣu tadvyavacchinnasvarṇārthaparatāṃ parityajati | taduktam adhruveṇa nimittena devadattagṛhaṃ yathā | gṛhītaṃ gṛhaśabdena śuddhamevābhidhīyate || suvarṇādi yathā yuktaṃ svairākārairupādhibhiḥ | ruṭakādyabhidhānānāṃ śuddhameveti vācyatām || tathopalakṣaṇe jātāvākṛtau vā samāśrite | vyaktayo yānti śabdānāṃ śuddhā evābhidheyatām || etena yaduktaṃ vyaktyabhaidhānapakṣe srave śabdāḥ sarvārthā bhaveyuriti tadapi nirastaṃ bhavati | tathāhi, yathā cakṣirādiśabdānāmaseṣarūpādiprakāśanasāmathrya nalikādisuṣiravatrmani yuktaṃ darśanasya tadavakāśāvasthitarūpabhedoparuddhatayā viṣayāntareṣu na viprakriryate tathā jātyākṛtibhyāmavaruddhaviṣayā gavādiśabdanāmabhidhānaśaktirnāśvādiṣvatiprasajyata iti | uktaṃ ca, ārāraiśca vyacchedātsārvāthryamarudhyate | yathāva cakṣurādīnāṃ sāmathryaṃ nalikādibhiḥ || yañcoktaṃ yathāvādibhirādarśairabhiktāścandrādaya eva candrādiśabdairabhidhīyante | yathā cendriyabhedagrahaṇamantareṇāpi rūpākārādiviṣyajñānabhedo bhavati, tathā vyaktibhirupavyāñcitā jātayaeva gavādiśabdairabhidhīyante | vyaktigrahaṇe ca dupavyañjanā jātigrrahīṣyati | tadapi na samyak | yadā tāvatpratibimbamudakādiṣu bhāvāntaramevopajāyata iti darśanaṃ, tadā tu rūpabhedānupātinaḥ śabdāḥ kimiti udasādīnupādadīran | yato nodakādastadānīṃ candrādīnāmuvyañjanamapi tu rupajananakāraṇam, na ca kāryavacanāt śabdāḥ kāraṇasaṃsparśamanubhavanti | yadā tu darśanavilpavaḥ sa dādṛśa iti pratipattiṃ, tadā dūrotsāritāvakāśo vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvaḥ | yadā tarhi jalādyādarśapratighātāt parāvṛtte cakṣuṣi svaktrañjandrādayo'pi dṛśyanta iti darśanaṃ tadaitadupapatsyate | tadāhyudarakādivat sannihitamupavyañjanaṃ rūpabhedena jātimabhivyaktarūpabhedāṃ darśayati | tadeva ca śabdo'bhidhatte | etadapyavyabhicaritopavyañjanāyatdarśanajātayaḥ kathaṃ vinopavyañjanaiḥ pratīyanta iti paryunuyogenāticaturaśraṃ, candrādīnāmanyathāpi darśanopapatteḥ | evaṃ jātibhedapratipattāvapi yathā darśanādīndriyāyattodayāḥ nīlādyarthāvasāyāḥ kāraṇabhedamanurivartante | naivam, jātiparicchedāḥ vyaktirūpapratibandhotpādāḥ, yena tadbhedamanuvidadhyuḥ | tataśca gotvādayo'pi parasparato na vyāvarteran | saṃvedyamānabhedaśca padārthaḥ kathamakasmādeka iti śraddhīyate? vyaktareva pārdathatvaṃ tasmādabhyupagamyatām | tathā ca buddhistatraiva śrutaśabdasya jāyate || yeṣāmartheṃṣu sāmānyaṃ na saṃbhavati taiḥpunaḥ | ucyate kevalā vyaktirākāśādipadairiva || evaṃ ḍiḍḍatdhtthādiśabdānāṃ saṃjñātvaviditātmānām | abhidheyasya sāmānyaśūnyatvādvyaktivācyatā || yepunaḥ kalpitānekabedavṛttiṃ pracakṣate | vācyaṃ tatrāpi sāmānyamatīva grāhayanti te || na hi ḍiḍḍatdhtthatvasāmānyaṃ dṛśyate gaganatvavat | kalpanāyāśca nābhūmiḥ kācidasti vipaścitām || iti || ākṛtireva padārtha iti vindhvāsimatagandhīyāḥ | tatrākṛtipadeneha saṃsthānamabhidhīyate | loke śāstre ca dṛṣṭatvānna jātirjaimunīyanavat || loke yathā yatrākṛtistatra guṇā vasantīti | śāstre yathākṛtigrahaṇā jātirliṅgānāṃ ca na sarvabhāk || iti || ubhayatrāpi cākṛtiśabdenāvayavasanniviśeṣa ucyate | vṛddhāśca vyavaharanto yatrārthe yatpadaṃ prayuñjate sa tasyārtho bhavati | tatra yadeṣa gośabdaḥ sāsnādimati prayujyate na kesarādimati tadayamāsādharaṇasanniveśaviṣayatāṃ dyotayati| pratyakṣaviṣaye ca gorityādipadaṃ prayujyate | pratyakṣaṃ cākṛtiviṣayam | aśvapiṇḍaḍḍatdhsanniveśāddhi vilakṣaṇo gopiṇjasanniveśa indriyeṇa pratīyate | tatkṛtameva vastīnāmitaretaravailakṣaṇyāt | ataḥ pratyakṣaviṣaye gaurityādipadaṃ pravartamānamākṛtāveva pravartitumutsahate | api ca śyenacitaṃ cinvīteti na jātiścīyate, na vyaktiḥ, api tu ākṛtireva | pradīpapravāhadīnāṃ ca śabdānāmākṛtirevārtho'bhyupeyaḥ | na hyoṣāmartheṣu vyavasthitaṃ jātirūpaṃ vyaktirūpaṃ vā samasti | yadi cākṛtiśśabdārtho na bhavet, kathamiva gavādiśabdaiḥ gavādyākārameva jñānaṃ janyate? api tāneva śāṭakānācchādayāmo ye pāṭaliputre, tāneva śālīnyabhuñjāmahe ye madhurāyāmiti yogyamevaṃprakāro vyavahāraḥ, sa ākṛtāveva padārthe saṅgacchate | yañja vrīhyādermukhyāsyābhāve nīvārādibhiḥ karma samāpyate tadākṛteḥ aśabdārthatve samāparitamapyaṅgahīnatvādaphalameva prāpnoti | nīvārādau vrīhyādijātivyāktyorabhāvāt | yaścāyamarcādipratikṛtau vāsudevādiśabdaprayogaḥ, so'pyākṛtāveva padārthe yujyate | kiñcātyantamadṛṣṭeṣvapyartheṣu śabdādākāraviṣayaḥ pratyaya upajāyamāno dṛśyate | tadyāthendraskando vaiśravaṇaḥ iti | tañcākṛtereva śabdārthatvamupapadyate | sambandhagrahaṇeṃ cāsyā jātivadupapatsyate | samastagavīṣvapi gosaṃsthānasyaikarūpatvāt mukhyagauṇabhāve tu prasiddhirapratisiddhaśca niyāmikā bhaviṣyati | prokṣaṇādikriyā śuklādiguṇayogaśca vyaktidvārā ākṛterupapatsyate | na cāmūrtatvādākṛterakriyāṅgatvaṃ, amīrtānāmi gumakarmaṇāṃ kriyāṅgatvāt | aruṇayā krīṇiti abhikrāmaṃ juhotīti ṣa kiñca, yathābhūtendriyotpādyamātmakartṛkamiṣyate | tathā tallikṣitavyaktisādhyaṃ tatsamādhyamucyate || tasmādākṛtiḥ padārtha iti | kathaṃ tahryācāryāṇāṃ matavirodho jātivryaktirākṛtiśca padārtha iti gavādiśabdaistadvatobhidhānāt? nanu ko'yaṃ tadvānnāma | tadasyāstīti tadvāniti viśeṣa evākārasāmānyavānucyate | viśeṣavācyate cānantyavyatibhācāro tadavasthai | sāmānyaṃ ca śabdenānucyamānaṃ nopalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | ubhayābhidhāte ca śabdasyātibhāra ityuktam | ucyate, nedantayā nirdiśyamānaḥ śābaleyādirviśeṣastadvān | kintu sāmānyākṣayaḥ kaścidanullakhitaśābaleyādiviśeṣaḥ tdavānityucyate |sāmānyākṣayatvāñca nānantyavyabhicārayostatrāvakāśaḥ| na ca viśeṣamabhidhāya viśeṣyamabhidadhāti śabda ityupagacchāmaḥ | yenainamatibhāreṇa pīḍaḍḍatdhyema | sāmānyaśrayatvamātre saṅketagrahaṇāt tāvanmātraṃ vadataḥ śabdasya koṣatibhāraḥ? kiñca pratyakṣaṃ na ca niṣkṛṣṭajātyaṃśapariniṣṭhatam | tadgocarapravṛttaśca śabdastatkathayetkatham || yugapannanu saṃvittirviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ | pratyakṣe'pi na dṛṣṭaiva na ca yuṣmābhiriṣyate || kāryakāraṇabhāvo hi taddhi yo bhavatāṃ mate | tasmādviśeṣaṇe jātau pūrvamindriyajā matiḥ || padādapi tadāyattasambandhajñaptyapekṣiṇaḥ | tatraiva buddhirityevaṃ na vyakterapi vācyatā || ucyate, pratyakṣe tāvadddhayorapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ indriyaviṣayatāsāmānye saṃyuktaṃ samavāyādīndriyaṃ pravartamānaṃ viśeṣaṇavadviśeṣyamapi viśayīkaroti | na ca sāmānyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ viśeṣo'numeya iti vyavahāraḥ | evaṃ hi guṇamātragrāhiṇīndriye guṇino'numeyatvaṃsyāt | na caivamasti | tasmādviśeṣyaparyantaṃ pratyakṣaṃ, tathāpadamapa tattulyaviṣayaṃ na sāmānyamātraniṣṭhamiti yuktam | yattu, sāmānyāṃśādapoddhṛtya padaṃ sarvaṃ pravartate || iita kevalavyāktyabhidhāne satyānantyavyabhicārabhayāducyate | tadvidabhidhāne tu na tadubhayamastīti na śuddhajātyabhidheyatayā śabdavyāpāraḥ saṅkocanīyaḥ | nanu sarvātmanā pratyakṣatulyaviṣayaścecchabdaḥ pratipattisāmyaṃ prasajet | na ca śabdādindriyāñca tulye pratipattī bhavataḥ | taduktam | anyethaivāgnisaṃyogāddāhaṃ dagdhohi manyate | anyathā dāhaśabdena dāhārthassaṃpratīyate || ucyate, parihṛtametat sakalaviśeṣagrahaṇāgrahaṇābhyāṃ pratipattiviśeṣasiddheḥ | naitāvatā sāmānyamātraniṣṭhaḥ śabdau bhavati | api ca niṣkṛṣṭasāmānyāṃśavacanatve gośabdādgotvaśabdāñca tulye pratīpattī syātāṃ | gauḥ śuklā itivañca gotvaṃ śuklamiti buddhiḥ syāt |cāturvaṇryadivañca svārtha eva gośabdāt bhāvapratyayastvatalādiḥ syāt | atha manyethāḥ ākṣiptavyaktikāṃ jātiṃ gośabdo vakti, bhāvapratyayāntastu niṣkṛṣṭāmiti | tadanupapannam, anakṣiptavyaktikāyāḥ kkacidapi jātedarśanāt | atha gośabdaśravaṇavelāyāṃ na vyaktisaṃsparśaśūnyā jātiravagamyate | bhāvapratyayānte tu gośabde śrute tacchīnyā śuddhāsau pratīyata iti yadyevamāgo'siṃ madīyaṃ panthānaṃ, āśrayavatī cejjātirucyate jātyāśraya ukta eva bhavati nānyathā hi sāśrayavatyuktā syāt | tadāśrayaparireṇāśrayisāmānyamātravivakṣāyāṃ tvatalādayaḥ prayujyante | tathā cāhuḥ, yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśastadabhidhāne tvatalāviti guṇasya bhāvāddravye śabdaniveśaityāsmatpakṣasākṣīṇyakṣarāṇi | sāmānādhikaraṇayaṃ ca tatraivopapadyata ityuktameva | tasmāt, yathāvidhyantaparyanto vākyavyāpāra iṣyate | tathaiva vyaktiparyantaḥ padavyāpāra ipyatām || anuparatavyāpāra eva śabde tadavagamād yenānvitābhidhānaṃ ca padānāmabhyupeyate | sutarāṃ tena vaktavyā vyaktayantaṃ tāvato matiḥ || nabi vyaktyanapekṣāṇāṃ jātīnāmitaretaram | anvayābhidhānamiti sthitiḥ | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādau yathā sāmūpyalakṣaṇā | naivaṃ gauśśukla ityādau vidyate vyaktilakṣaṇā || prayogapratipattibhyāṃ vṛddhebhyo vyavasīyate | tasmādgavādiśabdānāṃ tadvānartha iti sthitam || artheṣu ca prayogeṣu gāṃ dogdhityevamādiṣu | tadvato'rthakriyāyogāttasyaivāhiḥ padārthatām || padaṃ tadvantamevārthamāñjasyenābhijalpati | na ca vyavahitā buddhirna ca bhārasya goravam || sāmānādhikaraṇyādivyavahāraśca mukhyāyā | vṛttyopapadyamānassannānyathā yojayiṣyate || tadudamuktaṃ bhagavākṣapādena, vyaktayākṛtijātayastu padārthā iti tuśabdo viśeṣārthaḥ, kiṃ viśeṣyate? guṇapradhānabhāvasyāniyamena śabdārthatvam | ataḥ sthite'pi tadvato vātyatve kkacitprayoge jāteḥ prādhānyaṃ vyakteraṅgabhāvaḥ, yathā gauḥ padā na spaṣṭavyeti sarvagavīṣu pratiṣedho'vagamyate | kkacidvyakteḥ prādhānyaṃ vyakteraṅgabhāvaḥ, yathā gāṃ muñca gāṃ badhāneti, niyatāṃ kāñcidvyaktimuddiśya prayujyate | kkacidākṛteḥ prādhānyaṃ vyakteraṅgabhāvaḥ, jātistu nāstyeva | yathā puṣṭamayyo gāvaḥ kriyantāmiti, tatsānniveśacikīrṣayā prayoga iti | guṇaśabdāstu kecit svajātyavacchinnaṃ guṇamabhidhāya tavatyeva viramanti | kecittu guṇamabhidhāya dravyamapyākṣipanti | tatsāmānadhikaraṇye prayogadarśanāt | guṇaikaniyatāstāvadgandharūparasādayaḥ | gandhātvādivyavacchinnagandādiguṇavācinaḥ || teṣāṃ na dravyaparyāntā vṛttiḥ kkacana dṛśyate | na gandhaḥ padmamityasti sāmānādhikaraṇyadhīḥ || guṇaṃ śuklādiśabdāstu kathayantastaśrayam | dravyamapyākṣipantyeva śuklo'śva iti darśanāt || kriyāśabdāstu vividhāḥ kecitkartari karmaṇi | karaṇe ca prayujyante kecidbhāne'vadhāvapi || katrrādivacanāstāvannimittīkṛtya kāṃcana | kriyāṃ tadyogini dravye vartante pācakādayaḥ || yatrāpi tatakriyāyogastadānīṃ nopalabhyate| tatrāpi yogyātāṃ dṛṣṭvā śabdaṃ santaḥ prayuñjate || anye pūrvāparībhūtasvabhāvaparihārataḥ | siddharūpatayā prāhuśśabdāḥ pākādayaḥ kriyam || anyatpravṛttau śabdasya nimittamavagamyate | abhidheyaṃ tataścānyadityayaṃ prathamaḥ kramaḥ || pācakādiśabdānāṃ hi pravṛttinimittaṃ kriyā | abhidheyāstu katrrādayaḥ | kkcitpunaryadevāsya syātpravṛttanibandhanam | tasyaiva vācyatā bhāvapratyayāntapadeṣviva | itīyaṃ leśatastāvannāmnāṃ vṛttirudāhṛtā || ākhyātānāṃ tu vācyorthaḥ purastādupavarṇitaḥ | upasarganipātānāṃ nāmnāmiva vibhāgataḥ || prayogapratipattibhyāmaneko'rtho'vagamyate | upasargavaśāddhāturarthānataravilāsakṛt || vihārāhārasaṃhāraprahāraparihāravat | anvayavayatirekābhyāṃ tadartho'bhyavagamyate || tadāgame tatpratītistadabhāve tadagrahāt | ayamāsya padāsyārtha iti kiṃ cintitena vā || yo'rthaḥ pratīyate yasmātsa tasyārtha iti sthitiḥ || vākyārthastridhā, bhāvanā vidhiḥ pratibhā ca | tatrānyotpādānukūlo bhavantaṃ prayuñjānaḥ puruṣavyāpāraḥ karotyartho bhāvanetyucyate | anavacchinnaścānuṣṭhātumaśakya iti sānnidhyātsamānapadopāttaṃ dhātvarthamavacchedakatvenāpekṣate | sa caidanaṃ pacatītyādau samānapadopāttatve'pyayogyatvena sādhyatvātpracyutaḥ karaṇāṃśe'bhinivisamānaḥ pradhānakriyāmodanaphalikāṃ niṣpādayati | karaṇaṃ ca kevalamasādhakatvāt kkacidapi kriyāṃ na niṣpādayadupabdham | atatsatsādhakatamatvasiddhaye kāṣṭhādītikartavyatānupraveśaḥ | phalānupraveśastu taduddeśenaiva bhāvanāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ | ataḥ phalakaraṇetikartavyatāvacchedāt kiṃ kena kathamityapekṣiṇī tryaṃśapirapūrṇā bhāvanā bhavati | tatra devadattaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāmodanaṃ pacatītyādauca audanaṃ phalaṃ, pākaḥ karaṇaṃ, kāṣṭhādikārakacakramitikartavyatā, iti | taduktam audane sādhyamāne hi pākaḥ karaṇamiṣyate | sthālyagnicillikāṣṭhānāmitikartavyatā matā || sa ca prayatnaparispandādaudāsīnyapratyupalakṣyamāṇaḥ puruṣavyāpāraḥ karotyartho bhāvanā | kathaṃ tarhi kāṣṭhānāṃ karaṇatvaṃ? dhātvarthasya kriyātvāt | bhāvanāyāṃ tu dhātvarthasya karaṇatvāt karaṇavibhaktyupādāne ca pradhānāntareṇa sambandhāyogāt | ucyate, bhāvanāsaṃbandhāddhātvartho'pi pūrvāparībhūto bhavanātmāvagamyata iti tadapekṣayā kāṣṭhānāṃ karaṇatvam | ataḥ sthitametat tryaṃśaparipūrṇā bhāvanā vākyārtha iti | pravṛttinivṛttyorvidhāyako'rthavādādibhirupakriyamāṇo liṅloṭvyādivācyaḥ śabdavyāpāro vidhiḥ | tena hi bhāvanāyāṃ puruṣaḥ pravatryate nivṛtryate vā | yathā yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt, brāhmaṇaṃ na hanyāt, prauṣānanubrūhi, māpabhāṣasva, hoturaṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ, surā na pātavyā, pitaro vandanīyāḥ, guravo nāmamānyāḥ, śivaṃ te bhūyāt, mā tva śyena udvadhīditi | sa ca sarvavākyānāmarthaḥ sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ vidhīniṣedhayoreva paryavasyati | yatrāpi ca liṅādayo na śrūyante tatrāpi vidhinisedhaparatayā sarvavākyānāṃ vākyaśeṣabhūtāste'vagamyante | tadyatheha deśe subhikṣamityukte'treva sthātavyamasyāṃdho vartata ityukte, ihaiva bhoktavyaṃ sacoraḥ panthā ityukte, na gantavyaṃ grāhāḥ sarityasyāmityukte na snnātavyamiti pratīyate | kiñca mahākāvyairipa rāmāyaṇādibhiridameva vyutpādyate| rāmasya piturājñāṃ pālayato vananivāsino'pi tathāvidho'bhyudayaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ | rāvaṇasya paradārānabhilaṣyatastrailokyavijayino'pi tathāvidha ucchedaḥ | tasmātpiturājñāṃ pālayet | paradārānnābhilaṣyet | rāmavadvarteta na rāvaṇavaditi | nanvākhyātavācyatvena bhāvanaiva vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ ca tatraiva tasya pravartaktavaṃ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt? tanna, śabdārthabhedena bhāvanāyā dvaividhyāt | taduktam abhidhābāvanāmāhuranyāmeva liṅādayaḥ | arthātmā bhāvanātvanyā sravākhyāteṣu gamyate || tatra śabdabhāvanā preraṇātmikā śabdasyābhidheyā vidheyā ca | taduktam abhidhatte, karoti ceti | sātvarthabhāvanāṃśadvayaviṣayā vana phalāṃśaviṣayā| taduktaṃ phalāṃśe bhāvanāyāśca pratyayo na vidhāyakaḥ | abhidadhyuḥ svaśaktyāhi vidhimātraṃ liṅādayaḥ || tasyāśca kiṃ kena kathamityapekṣāyāmarthabhāvanāviṣayā puruṣapravṛttiḥ, preraṇājñānaṃ karaṇāṃśaḥ, artha vādādaya itikartavyatāṃśa iti tryaṃśaparipūrṇatvam, sā ca phalakaraṇayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvamajñātaṃ gamayantī gamakatvātapramāṇaṃ bhavati | nanu ca vidhilakṣaṇametāvadapravṛttapravartanaṃ, ajñātajñāpanaṃ hyevaṃ sarvo'pi hi vidhirbhavet | tathāhi sādhyasādhanasambandhaḥ sarvākhyāteṣu vidyate | sravavākyeṣu cākhyātaṃ tenākāṅkṣā nivartanāt || na ca sādhyasādhanabhāvāvagamamantareṇa pravartakatvaṃ na sidhyatīti sādhyasādhanabāvavagatiravaśyakalpanīyā | preraṇājñānajanakatvenaivāsya pravartakatvāt kimityasau niṣphale vyāpāre pravartata iti cedvidhīta eveti brūmaḥ | sahi saphale niṣphale vā vyāpāre puruṣaṃ pravartayati, evaṃ yañjapuruṣeṣvapravartamānaṣu aprāmāṇyaṃ tadaparihāryameva | kalpite hi phale vaiṣayikasukhadveṣiṇo vītarāgā na pravartante | pravṛddhatararāgāstu na nivartante iti | ucyate yajeta svargakāma ityādau vidhirbhāvanāyāṃ puruṣaṃ pravartayeti | bhāvyaniśaṣṭhasvabhāvako vyāpāro bhāvanā | sā casādhyādisvarūpaparityaktā nirupapattikaiva syāt | sādhyatvaṃ ca samānapadopādānasannidhinaśāddhātvarthasyāhosvidiṣyamāṇatayā kāmipadopāttasya svargādeḥ syāditi saṃśaye yogyatvātsvargasyaiva, na dhātvarthasyeti | tadaktaṃ vidhāvanāśrite sādhyaḥ puruṣārtho na labhyate | śrutasvargādibādhena dhātvarthaḥ sādhyatāṃ vrajet || vidhau kṛtamatikramya svargādeḥ sādyateṣyate | tatsādhanasya dharmatvamevaṃ sati ca gamyate || dharmehyadṛṣṭaviṣaye codanaiva pramāṇam |codanaiva hi bhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ vārthamavagamayituṃ śaknoti | nānyātkiñcanendriyamiti | etenāpauruṣeyatvena yathārthapratipādakāptapraṇītatvena vā nirastadoṣāṃśasya bādhakapratyayarahitasya vaidikasya ca vākyasyautsargikaṃ prāmāṇyamuktaṃ bhavatīti vidhirvākyārtha iti | svaṃ svamarthamabhidhāyoparateṣu padeṣu padārthapratipattyanantaramupajāyamānā idaṃ taditi vyapadeśyānupadeśasiddhā hitāhitaprāptiparihārahetuḥ pravṛttyanukūlā buddhiḥ pratibhā | tathāhi, padanibandhānānāṃ padāvayavanibandhānānāṃ cārthapratyavabhāsamātrāṇāṃ avicchedena pravṛttau pratyavabhāsā pravṛttiphalaprasavā'numeyābhinnajātīyaiva pritabhā pratyātmaṃ vivartate | yathā madyaviṣarasādiṣu bhinnānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pūrvamadṛṣṭāśasaṃrgāt prāptaparipākānāṃ madamaraṇasuvarṇādirarthakriyā dṛśyate | tathā pratirapadaṃ bhinnānāṃ śabdānāmuccāyamānā dṛśyate | ayaṃ cāsyā bhāvānādibhyo viśeṣaḥ | yāvatkimatra mayā kathitaṃ pratipannamartharūpaṃ vā pareṇa kathamanusandhīyata iti na vicāryate, tāvadanākhyeyenopāyena pūrvottarānusandhānameṣāṃ prakalpayati | pratyakṣānumānaviṣaye'pi yāvatpūrvāparapratyamarśaḥ śabdollekhavān sarvapramāṇāni pramāṇatāṃ labhante | pratibhālocano hi loka iti kartavyatāsu pravartate | nanu ca na pratibhā vākyārtho yato bālānāṃ stanyapānādiṣu, haṃsānāṃ kṣīravivecane, jantvādīnāṃ kulāyādikaraṇe, jātamātraṇāmeva ca paśumṛgasarūsṛpādīmanāmudakasantareṇe, suptānāṃ ca prabodhādau, kumāryaśca śvo me bhrātā āgamiṣyatīti jñāne, syabhāvato vākyaśravaṇamantareṇāpi pratibhopajāyamānā dṛśyate | tathā kālaviśeṣātpuskokilānāṃ svaravikāre, abhyāsaviseṣāt ratnādiparūkṣakāṇāṃ taddoṣaguṇajñāne, adṛṣaaṭādrakṣaḥpitṛpiśācādīnāṃ parāveśāntardhaāyanādau, yogādyogināṃ parabhiprāyāvagatau, bahyondriyavṛttinirodhādvasiṣṭhādīnāmatīndriyajñāne, kṛṣṇadvaipāyanādyunudhāyānāt sñjayādīnāṃ duradarśanaśravaṇādau, kāraṇanarebhyo'pi prātibhamupalabhyate | uñcayate yathaiva sākṣātpuruṣopadiṣṭavākyādrathakriyāsu śabdavyāpāreṇopasaṃhṛtā pratipattṛṇāṃ pratibhā vivartete tathaiva bālādīnāṃ stanyapānādiṣu pūrvaśabdabhāvanānugamādvākyārthapratipattibhiraviśiṣṭaiva pratibhopajāyate | yaṣāmapi cāprasiddhaśabdanibandheno vyāvahāraḥ, te'pi hastayaśaavādayo'pi janmāntarīyaśabdabhāvanāvaśāt pratyutpannaśbadapratyayāḥ pratibhāmanugacchantaḥ sarvamārabhante | pūrvaśabdānubhavanānugamāñca svabūjanāmābhimukhyeṣa'pi prakṛṣṭaśabdavayāpāre kokilādīnāṃ svaravikārādau pratibhopajāyate | pūrvajanmajanitaśabdaśravaṇasaṃskārodvodhakāni tvanyāti kālābhyāsādṛṣṭayogadhyānānāudhyānādīni sādhanāni | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ | kkacidvākyamuñcaritamātrameva tamanavyapadeśyamasattvabhūtaṃ prātibhāpadābhidheyaṃ svārthaṃ prakāśayati | kkacittu ciravyavahitāmapi viśaiṣṭapratibhābūjabhāvanānuveśānnimittāntarasānnidhye tadeva vākyaṃ pāramparyeṇa pratabhāravyaṃ svārthamāvirbhāvayatīti pratibhāvākyārtha iti | nanu ca kriyāpi nāma vākyartho vidyate so'pi vaktavyo bhavati | naivaṃ, padārthaḥ kriyā na vākyārthaḥ | padārthānāṃ tu mithaḥ samasarge yadādhikyamupajāyate sa vākyārthaḥ | tadāha, yadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthaḥ iti | sa kādācitpuraṣavyāpārarūpo bhāvanepi, kadācicchabdavāpārāparūpo vidhiriti, kadācidvuddhivāyapārarūpaḥ, pratibheti | nanu ca bhāvanapi pādartha eva dhatorvā pratyayādvā gamyamānā padārthatvaṃ na vyabhicarati | athaivamucyeta na padārthamātraṃ bhāvānā | apitu paridṛśyamānapūrvāparūbhūtavidhyādibhāvārthasvarūpātiriktāḥ puruṣavyāpāraḥ, se'pi dhātuvācyatve pratyavācyatve vā na pādarthatvamiti krāmati ucyate, yajetetyādau prakṛtyarthaḥ kriyārūpo yāgādiḥ, pratyayārthaḥ, preraṇārūpo vidhyādiḥ, na caitadatirikto bhāvanākhyaḥ kaścidapi puruṣavāyapāro dṛśyate, na ca bhāvanāvācinīṃ kāñcidapi vibhaktiṃ siḍādimiva vidhyādau smarati pāṇiniḥ | maivaṃ, āstāṃ vidhipadaṃ tāvadvartamānāpadeśinaḥ | śabādādyajana ityāderbhāvanā sāvagamyate || pacata ityāderhi yathā pākādirdhātvarthaḥ, pratīyeta tathā kartṛvyapāraḥ karotyartho'pi | pākādyuparañja kābhāve'pi tatpratīteranapāyāt | yathaā hyaupagavaḥ, kāpaṭavaḥ, opamanyava ityupaguprabhṛtīnāmāvāpodvāpayora'pi tasyāpatyamiti pratyayārtho'nuvartate tathā pacati paṭhati gacchatītyādāvapi karotyartho'nuvartamāno dṛśyate | tathāha, yadā pacatītyākhyāsito bhavati tadā pākaṃ karotīti vākyaṃ vyākhyātāraḥ prayuñjate | tatra pākaśabdena dvitīyāntena sādhyaṃ prakṛtyarthaṃ, kṛrtavyāpāraṃ tu karotīti padena vyācakṣate | apica kiṃ karoti devadatta iti pṛṣṭāssanto dvaye vaktaro bhavanti pacatīti pākamiti | tadidamibhayarūpamapyutatramekārthe, anyāthā na tena praṣṭā pratyāyyeta | tasmātpākaṃ karotīti padadvayasya yo'rthassa eva pacatītiyekapadasyati, āha | na pratyayātkartṛsaṅkhyāvyatirekeṇa dhātvarthātirikto vyāpāraḥ pratīyeta, pratīyeta cet karotītaytrāpi pratayeta | taduktaṃ yathā pākaṃ karotīti vyavahāro vibhāgataḥ | tathā kāraṃ karotīti pratitirnāsti laukikī || tasyāḥ kiṃ bījamiti cet kṛbhyastīnāṃ kriyāsāmānyavacanatvam | na ca sāmānye sāmānyani bhavanti, yathāhi yajeta dadyājjuhuyāditi karotisāmānyamavagamyate naivamasti bhavati | karotīti | nanu ca kathaṃ karotyarthaḥ karotiśbadānnāvagamayate | na nāvagamyate | kintu yāgādiviśeṣānavacchinno nānuṣṭhānayogyo bhavati | evaṃ tarhi mābhūtpratyayārtho bhavānā prakṛtyartho bhaviṣyati | yathāhi śabaloyādīnāmanugataṃ gorupamavabhāsate vyāvṛttaṃ ca śābaleyādirūpaṃ evaṃ yāgādikarmaṇāmanugataṃ vyāpārarūpavabhāsate | parasparavibhaktaṃ ca yāgādirūpaṃ tatra yadanugataṃ karotisāmānyaṃ sā bhāvatā, yadvyāvṛttaṃ yāgādikaṃ sa dhātvarthaḥ | yathā ca śābaleyādeḥ pṛthagdarśayituṃ gotvamaśakyamevaṃ bāvanāpi yāgādeḥ pṛthagdarśayituṃ na śakyate | taduparaktatvena sarvadopalambhāt | na caitāvatāsau nāsti, nāstitāyaṃ hi tasyāḥ kiṃ karotīti anavagataviśeṣyavāyāpārapraśne pacati paṭhatītyuttaramanuttarameva bhavati | kiñcaudāsīnyadaśāyāṃ tu pumānyate pravatryate | sa yatno yāgahomādau bhāvanetyadhīyate || sā ca sāmānyarūpāpi na gotvādivatkriyā kkacidyā siddhatayāvabhāsate, yena vidheyā na bhavati | yadvevaṃ kriyāviśeṣa evāsau vyāpārojñāturāntaraḥ | spandātmakabahirbhūtakriyākṣaṇavilakṣaṇaḥ || kriyāyāśca padārthatvamiṣyata eva, nanuca padārthatve'pi kriyayā vākyārthatvameva nyāyyaṃ yataḥ padārthā vākyārthabhāvamāyānti saṃhatāḥ | aphekṣānuguṇānyonyavyatiṣaṅgaviśeṣitāḥ || vyatiṣahgaśca pradhānagumabhāve bhavati | sādhyaṃ ca sādhyamānatvātpradhānamavagamyate | kriyāto nārapaṃ tañca vākyārtho'taḥ kriyeṣyakatām || yajeta dadyājjuhuyādadhīyīteti coditaḥ | kriyāṃ sādhyatāyā vetti tāṃ ca loko'nutiṣṭhati || yañjādhikāripadaṃ svargakāma ityādi tadapi bhāvanāpekṣitakartṛsamarpakatvena saṅgacchate | asyāṃ kriyāyamayaṃ kartā anenaiṣā kriyā saṃpādyeti | na cātra kriyā prādhānyamujjhati | nāhi kriyā kratṛsthā, kartā tu kriyārthaḥ, sahi tāṃ nirvartayannupalabhyeta | śabde'pi tathaivopadiśati eṣa idaṃ kuryāditi | kimarthaṃ punarasau kriyā puvarasai kriyāmanitiṣṭhatīti cet śabdādeveti brīmaḥ | budhdvedameva bhagavāndadarśa khalu bādariḥ | na dravyagiṇasaṃskāravyatirikte'sti śeṣatā || vedādguurunyogādvā śālanādvā mahībhujaḥ | na sacetāḥ kriyāṃ kācidanutiṣṭhati niṣphalām || atrocyate, śabdapramāṇakā vayaṃ yacchabda āha tadasmākaṃ pramāṇaṃ tarhi svargakāmapadimapi śabda eva | tasyāpyatrānvayo vaktavyaḥ | nanu ca kartṛpadamekaṃ kartā ca kriyārtha iti, naivam | na kartṛpadaṃ svargaṃkāma iti, api tvadhikāripadaṃ | svarge kāmo'sya svargaṃ vā kāmayate, svargakāmanāviśaṣṭaḥ puruṣo'smātpadādavagamyate | tadatra kāmyamānaḥ svargaḥ kathaṃ yāgakriyayā sambandhate? svargasya niratiśayaprītirupatvāt, na prītiradravyatvāt kriyāṅgabhāvaṃ bhajeta | na ca prīteḥ kriyārthatvamupapadyate | prītyarthamanyannānyārthā prītiriti |evaṃ ca kriyāsādhanānupadeśāt na kartṛsamarpakatvena svargakāmapadasamaṃnvayaḥ | api tvadhikārisamarpakatvena | atha ko'yamadhikārī nāma? karmaṇaḥ svamī | nanu ca kartaiva karmaṇaḥ svamī | naivaṃ svāmī | sa kartā na tatsvāmī | nanu kriyākārakasambandhavyatirekeṇa ko'nyaḥ karmaṇaḥ ṣuruṣasya ca sambandhaḥ | ucyate, mamedaṃ kṛtyaṃ ahamatra svāmīti svasvāmibhāvamaśakyamāśaṅkya pāścātyaḥ kriyākārakasambandho gamyate | pāścātya ityatra kiṃ pramāṇamiti cet anupādeyaviśeṣaṇavisiṣṭasya puṃso nirdeśastasmādidhikṛtasya kartṛtvaṃ, na karturadhikāra iti | itthaṃ ca svargakāmasyādhikāro nirvahati yadi tatkarma svargārthaṃ syāt svargo'pi bhogyo bhavet | kathamahaṃ svargeprāpnuyāmityevaṃ sādhyatvena svargamicchan svargakāma ucyate | yadi ca na svargasādhanaṃ karma syāt tadviruddhamidamāpatati | svargaṃ kāmayate yāgaṃ korati anayadicchatyanyatkarotīti | ataḥ karmami kāmyamāne sādhanatāṃ pratipadyamānaḥ svargakāmastānnaivādhikriyate | na cānadhikriyamāṇastatra sambandhate | tadevamadikṛtatvena svargakāmasya karmami sambandhāt svargayāgayośca sādhyasādhanabāvāvagamamantareṇādhikārasyānurvāhādavaśyaṃ kriyāyāṃ sādhanatvaṃ svasyaiva sādhyatvamubhyupagantavyam | ataśca kriyāyāḥ phalaṃ prati guṇabhāvādaprādhānyamaprādhānyāñca na vākyārthatvam | taduktaṃ “karmāṇyapi hi dajaiminiḥ phalārthatvā” diti | kā ceyaṃ kriyā? vākyartha ityucyate, ya eṣa yādādirbhāvārthā dhātuvācya, uta pratyayārthaḥ, kaścidatiriktā iti | tatra bhāvārthasya kāmyamānasādhanatvādaprādhānyumuktemeva | pratyayārthastu kāmyamānabhāvārthagatasādhyasādhanasambandhāparityāgenaiva vākyārthatāṃ pratipadyate | tasmānna kriyāmātraparyavasāyī vākyārtha iti | kimidānīṃ phalasyaiva vākyārthātvaṃ pracakṣmahe | taddhipradhānaṃ sādhyaṃ ca tadartho hyakhilaḥ śramaḥ || naivam, yathā kriyāyāḥ phalārthatvādaprādhānyaṃ evaṃ phalasyāpi puruṣārthatvāt | nahi svargaḥ svatantra eva sattāṃ labhatāmiti puruṣo yatate | apitu svopabhogyatayainamabhilaṣati, tadāha “phalaṃ ca puruṣārthatvāt” | tarhi, puruṣa eva vākyārtho bhavatu | naivaṃ, yajamānasaṃmitaudumbarī bhavatīti tasyāpi kriyāṅgatvāt | tadāha, puruṣaśca karmārthatvāditi | hantaivaṃ kriyā phalārthā, phalaṃ puruṣārtheṃ, puruṣaḥ kriyārtha iti cakrake patitāḥ kasya patitāḥ kasya prādhānyaṃ śiṣmaḥ | ucyeta, puruṣastāvanna vākyārthaḥ pādarthānāṃ mithaḥ saṃsarge'pi avyayakārakaviśeṣaṇārthopagṛhītasyākhyātārthasyaiva prādhānyena vākyārthatvāt | nanu cākhyāte'pi yajetetyevamādau kartaryaiva lakāraḥ | maivam, yo'yaṃ lakāro nāma siddhaṃ hi sādhyāyopādīyata iti pratyayārtho'pi kartā prakṛtirthe kriyāyāmeva nyagbhavati, phalamapi na vākyārthaḥ siddhāsiddhavikalpānupapatteḥ | siddhasya tāvatphalasyābhidhānameva nāsti, kāmyamānatvena nirdeśāt | sādhyamānatvapakṣe tu sākṣāttatsiddhyavedanāt | vyāpā raeva tanniṣṭho vākyārthaṃ iti yujyate || ataeva hi vākyārthaṃ bhāvanāṃ pratijānate | yathocitaphalāmaṃśatrayasambandhabandhurāḥ || bhāvyaniṣṭho hi bhāvakavyāpāro bhāvaneti | saiṣa dvādaśabhedo'rthaḥ kriyādiḥ prakprakīrtitaḥ | vācyo viśeṣyaḥ śabdasya pratyāyyohyabhyupeyate || nacaitadvācyaṃ, vākyasyaiva pratyayakatavaṃ na padānāṃ, yato yathā guḍaḍḍatdhśabdo guḍaḍḍatdhdravyamabhidhatte tathā pratyāyayatyapi tadavinābhāvimādhuryaṃ, yadi vā padānyeva saṃhatyārthamabhidadhati vākye || ākhyātaśabdo vākyapadasaṅghāto vākyamityapi darśanāni vidyante | kriyādayaśca padārtha evāntarbhavanti | tathāhi, dhātvarthaḥ kriyā, tāṃ kālo viśinaṣṭi, pratyayārthaḥ, kārakaṃ tatpuruṣo viśeṣayita | tasyobhayasyāpyupādhayo'pyavacchedakā bhavanti, sambhūya prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthaṃ brūtaḥ | yaṃ taṃ pradhānamāmananti sa bhedābhedābhyāmupaskārārthaviśiṣṭaprātirikārthavyapadeśaṃ labhate | tasya śaktisaṅkhyābhivyakteye vibhaktistadantaṃ padaṃ padānāmapadānāṃ ca sāmathrye vṛttiḥ, vṛttānāmapi ca kṛttaddhitasamāsānāṃ punaḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ subutpatteḥ padasaṃjñeteni vākyaṃ punarakhaṇḍaḍḍatdhvākyārthapakṣe vācakamapi bhavati | tatra śabdasyārthābhidhānasāmathryaṃ vācakatā | sā trīdhā, mukhyā, gauṇī, lakṣaṇā ca | yathā gaurgacchati, gaurvāhīkaḥ, goṣu nivasatīti | āsāṃ ca viśeṣān viśeṣemāgrato vakṣyāmaḥ | teṣu hi prabuddheṣu prabuddhāprabuddhaiḥ prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyopadeśavṛddhavyavahārebhyo'dhigateṣu saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhabalena śabdastaṭastha eva gotvamarthaṃ pratyāyayati | tadāhur prasiddhapadasāmānādhikaraṇyātpratīyate | aprasiddhāpadasyārtha ścūte rauti piko yathā || tathaihi rauti yaścūte pikaḥ sa iti niścayaḥ | upadeśādyathārtho'yaṃ pavasākhyāḥ prakāśate || vyavahārāttu śabadārthasambandhastripramāṇakaḥ | vṛddhaśabdābhidheyāni pratyakṣṇātrā paśyati || śrotuśca pratipannatvamanumānena ceṣṭāyā | anyāthānupapattau ca vettiśaktidvayāśrayām || iti || svāvacchedena viśiṣṭajñānakatā viśeṣaṇatvam | tatrtridhā, bhedakamanuraḍhjakamupalakṣake ca | yathā viśvajitā yajeta, śvetaṃ chāgamalabheta, lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracarantīti | na ca gotvādayaḥ kadācidapi śabdānuvedhavandhyabodhāviṣayatāṃ pratipadyante | tathāhi, “āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīt” ityādau yathā jātiguṇakriyāvcachinnaviṣayānavabhāsini savikalpake, tathā nirvikalpake vijñāne śabdaviśiṣṭa evārthaḥ pirasphurati | tadāha na so'sti pratyayo loke yaśśabdānugamādṛte | anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena gamyate || nacaitadvācyaṃ, astītyālocanājñānaṃ prathamaṃ nirvikalpakam | bālamūkādivijñānasadṛśaṃ śuddhavastujam || yato bālādayo janmāntarānubhavopajanitanānāsaṃskārajātayo jātyāhyullekhenaiva taṃtamarthaṃ pratiyanti | tathāhi, tadaharjāyamānasyāpi bālakasya purato vidagdhavanitāḥ pradīpaṃ na prasthāpayanti karkaṭonmā bhaviṣyatīti | atha tathātvātathātvayossithatiṃ prati hetutvātpratyayākatvaṃ kathaṃ punaratathābhūtamarthaṃ śabdastathā pratyāyayati? śabdaktimāhātmyāt | śabdaśakyupajanitā hi buddhayaḥ svabījaparipākavaśādākāraviśeṣavatya upajāyamānāḥ satyapi vastuno'bhede bhedamupadarśayanti | tadyāthā rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrakasya śarīramiti | taduktaṃ māyondrajālaprakhayo'yaṃ pravibhāgaḥ prakalpyate | śabdaśaktimahimnaiva nirvibhāge'pi vastuni || anye tvāhuḥ “na vastuno'dhikaṃ rūpaṃ na śabdasyādhikārthatā |śabdaḥ śabdāntaropādheradhikārthaḥ pratīyate ||” tadyathā, puruṣa itipuraṣamātraṃ, rājña iti śabdanātarasannidhesatu saeva viśiṣṭaḥ pratīye puruṣaviśoṣo'yaṃ rājapuruṣa iti | evaṃ bhavatīpacatītyādāvapi pacatīti kriyāmātrapratītiḥ, bhavatīti tu padopādhiḥ kartṛśaktiprayuktā pratīyate | apare tu manyaneta, kaॉsakalavikalpollekhavirahite'pi vastuni śabdāḥ svamahimnaiva nānāvidhabudhdyutpattikāraṇībhūtāḥ sanniveśayanti, yadvaśādibhinnarūpamapi vastvanyathācāvabhāsata iti | tathāhi, kathakaḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayatītyukte kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭa iti pratīyate | yadātvindraḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayatīti prayogastadā kaṃsaghnaṃ tamupendraṃ indraḥ prayuṅkta iti | anye tu kathakaḥ kaṃsaṃ ghātayītyatrāpi prayojakaṃ vyāpāraṃ bruvate, | yataḥ “śabdopahitarūpāstān buddherviṣayatāṃ gatān | pratyakṣamiva kaṃsādīn sādhanatvena manyate ||” teṣāṃ cotepatteḥ prabhūtyāvināśāt sa vṛddhirācakṣāṇaḥ parānapi tathaiva pratyāyayati | tathā vaktāro bhavanti gaccha hanyate kaṃsaḥ, kiṃ gatena, hataḥ kaṃsa iti | athāpareṣāṃ darśanaṃ, vikalpayonayaḥ śabdā vikalpāśśabdayonayaḥ | teṣāmanyonyasambandho nārthaṃ śabdāḥ spṛśantyapi || tadyathā guṇānurāgamikṣeṇa yaśasā cava sarpatā |digvadhūnāṃ mukhe jātamakasmādardhakuṅktumam || atrārdhakuṅktumetyukte saurabhādiguṇānvitā | yaśo'nurāgayorvarmapraklṛptiravagamyate || vadhūśabdena tu diśāṃ nāyikātvaṃ pratīyate | na ca sambandhagandho'pi vāstavasteṣu vidyate || tadupajñaṃ caiṣa laikikaḥpravadaḥ | atahaṭṭhaevi tahatahasaṃṭhievvahiaammi jāṇivetasei | atthavisese sā jaai viaukaigoarā vāṇi || bhavatu nāmaśabdasya vācakatvamakṣe'pi pakṣānupraveśādrathātathātve'pi tathā pratyāyakatvam | viśeṣaṇapakṣe tu kathamivaitadupapadyate? viśeṣaṇena hi pradhānānuyāyinā bhavitavyam | pradhānena tvavicalitasvārthena | naivaṃ, viśeṣaṇamapi śabdo'nurañcakatvenārthamadhyāsīmaḥ kutaścidupādheranyathāvabhāsamānaḥ svāśrayamapyanyathāvabhāsayati |tadyathā magadheṣu stanau pīnau kaliṅgeṣvakṣiṇī śubhe | bābūpralambāvaṅkeṣu vaṅgeṣu caraṇai mṛdū || iti || atra stanādiyo jātiśabdāḥ savyatvadakṣiṇatvajātidvayaikārthasamavāyopādherekatvayogino'pi dvitvenāvabhāsamānāḥ svāśrānapi tathaivāvabhāsayanti | etena vyaktau padārthe bahunāmapi dvitvānabhāso vyākhyātaḥ | tadyathā daityādhipaprāṇamuṣāṃ nakhānāmupeyuṣā bhūṣaṇatāṃ kṣatena | prakāśakārkaśya guṇai dadhānāḥ stanau taruṇyaḥ parivavrurenam || atra viśiṣṭanakhakṣatabhūṣādiviśeṣopādānātsuvyaktaiva stanaśabdasya vyaktyarthateti | evaṃ kadā pūrvāḥ phalgunyā iti candramasā saha yoge bahutvavivakṣāyāṃ dvayorapi bahutvenābabhāvaḥ | kadā tiṣyapunarvasū iti tārakānapekṣanakṣatradvitvāvivakṣāyāṃ bahūnāmapi dvitevenāvabhāso bhavati | evaṃ candramasā saha yogasya tārakāsaṅkhyāyāśca vivakṣitatve bhavitavyaṃ, tiṣyapunarvasava iti prayogeṇa na bhavitavyam | nahi loke tādṛśī vivakṣā vidyate, vivakṣā ca kulavadhūriva na lokamaryādāmatikrāmati | tadyathā janāya suddhāntacarā śaṃsate kumārajanmāmṛtasaṃmitākṣaram | adeyamāsīdddhayameva bhūpateḥ śaśiprabaṃ chatramubhe ca cāmare || namu cārthopādherapyartho'nyathābāsamāno dṛśyate | tadyāthā pāyādvo racitatrivikamatanurdevaḥ sa daityānatako | yasyākasmikavardhamānavapuṣastigmadyutekmaṇḍaḍḍatdhlam || maulau ratnaruciḥ śrutau parilasattāṭaṅkakāntikramāt | jātaṃ vakṣati kaustubhābamudare nābhīsarojaupamaḥ || tataśca na jñāyate kimayamarthopādhinibandhano'rthasyānyathāvabhāsaḥ uta śabdopādhinibandhana iti | ciraṃ jīva, yadavatīrṇa iva pratipādyārthapadavūṃ dṛśyate, pṛcchāmyāyuṣmantaṃ kaeṣo'rthonāma, kiṃ bhravīṣi yaḥśabdena pratipādyate, atha gaurityatra kaḥ śabdārthaḥ? kimātya sāstrādimānpaṇḍa, iti, kathaṃ svarūpamapi pṛṣṭaḥ śabdenaiva vyāpadiśasi | kimavocat śabdākhyāviśeṣaṇānuraktasya kasya svarūpamanyathākhyātuṃ na śaknoti | śabdāparityāgalabdhaprakāśayaiva ca tadanubhūtyānūbhavāmi | tarhi śabdātpṛthagarthatattvasya vyāpadeṣṭumanubhavituṃ cāśakyātvācchabdasyaivāyamadhyāyo vivarto vipariṇāmo vārtho nāma palabhāmahe | anye'pi caivamāhur avibhāgo'pi budhyātmā viparyāsitadarśanaiḥ | grāhyāgrāhakasaṃvittibhedavānivalakṣyate || grahītṛhaṇagrāhyamāyāpathaparicyutām | namāmaḥ paramānandajyotīrūpāṃ sarasvatīm || iti| kaḥ punarayaṃ vivarteo nāma | ucyate, ekasya tattvādaprayujyutasya sanniveśaviśeṣādibhirasatyapravibhaktānyarūpopagrāhitā vivartaḥ | tatra yathā jalādayaḥ kallolādirūpeṇa sarpādayaḥ kuṇḍaḍḍatdhlādirūpeṇa nīlādayaścitrādirūpeṇa vivartante tathā śabdatattvamavidyopādhestenatenārtharūpeṇatathātathā vivartate | tadyāthā vyapagataghanapaṭalamacalanidhīsadṛśavapurambaratalam | añjanacūrṇapuñjaśyāmalaṃ śārvaraṃ tamaḥ || iti | atha yathā śabdāsyārtho vivartastathārthasya śabdo yadi bhavet ko doṣaḥ syāt? na kaścit | kintu vāgrūpatā cedutkrāmedavābodhasya śaśvatī | na prakāśyaḥ prakaśeta sāhi pratyavamarśanī || idamandhaṃtamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jāyeta bhuvatatrayam | yadi śabdāhvayaṃ jyotirāsaṃsāraṃ na dīpyate || nu cābhidhīyamāteva pratīyamānatāpu vākyārthadharmo vidyate | yathā cocyate, pratīyamānaṃ puranyadeva vastvasti vāṇīṣu māhākavīnām | yattatprasiddhāvayavātiriktamābhāti lāvaṇyamivāṅganāsu || tasya ca vākyārthabhāvanottarakālamavagateradhyāsapakṣe vivartapakṣe vā kathamivopapattirbhavati? ucyate, vipiṇāmādbhaviṣyati vastuno avasthāntaragamanaṃ vipariṇāmaḥ, tatra yathā mṛdādayo ghaṭādirūpeṇa kṣīrādayo dadhyādirūpeṇa caitrādayo yuvādirūpeṇa viparimante tathedaṃ śabdabrahmāpyavidyopādheḥ tenatenārtharūpeṇa tathātathā vipariṇamate | tadyāthā santi mepañca putrāḥ, mātaraṃ vayasi gaṅgātīre tapaścarāmīti | atra ca śabdārthayoḥ pṛthagavābhāsadvākyārthasyabhidhīyamānatāyāṃ pratīyamānatāyāṃ vā nānupapattiḥ, na caitāvatā śabdavyāpāro viraṃsyati | yatastātparmasya hyagrato viśeṣeṇa vakṣyamāṇamāste | tasyodāhaṇamātraṃ prāptaśrīreṣa kasmātpunarapi mayi taṃmanthakhedaṃ vidadhyāt | nidramapyaraya pūrvāmanalasamahaso naiva saṃbhāvayamāmi | setuṃ braghāti kasmādayamiha sakaladvīpanāthānuyāta stvayyāte vitarkāniti dadhata ivābhāta kampaḥpāyadheḥ || atra varṇanīyarājaviśeṣasya digvijayino yathāśrutavākyārtho'bhidhaīyamānasatvyīti pade viṣṇavadhyāsavatāraḥ samastīti pratīyamānastadavatārāntarāṇāṃ nidrālasatvādidośayogādasya ca tadvyudāsāt | tato vaiśaṣṭyapratipādanaṃ tātparyaṃ yasya kāvyeṣu dhvaniriti prasiddhiḥ | taduktaṃ tātparyameva vacasi dhvanireva kāvye saibhāgyameva guṇasampadi vallabharaya | lāvaṇyameva vapuṣi ravadate'ṅganāyāḥ śrṛṅgāra eva hṛdi mānavato janasya || kaḥ punaḥ kāvyavacasoḥ dhvanitātparyayorviseṣaḥ | ucyate yadavakaṃ vacaśśāstre loke ca vaca eva tat | vakraṃ yadarthavādādau tasya kāvyamiti smṛtiḥ || yadibhiprāyasarvasvaṃ vakturvākyātpratīyate | tātparyamarthadharmastacchabdadharmaḥ punadhrvaniḥ || saubhāgyamiva tātparyamāntaro guṇa iṣyate | vāgadevatāyā lāvaṇyamiva bāhyāstayodhrvaniḥ || aduraviprakarṣāttu dvayena dvayamucyate | yathāsurabhivaiśākhau madhumādhavasaṃjñayā || iti | vibhaktyartho'tha vṛttyarthaḥ padārthaścopavarṇitaḥ | bhāvanādiprabhedena vākyārthaśca prakīrtitaḥ || kriyāyāśca pādarthatvādvakyārthatvamupākṛtam | kṛtaṃ ca bhāvanāyāstapadārthatvahetukam || vācyāḥ viśeṣyāḥ pratyāyyāḥ śabdasyoktāḥ kriyādayaḥ | adhāyasaviparīṇāmavivartāścāsya tānprati || vibhaktivṛtyarthavatorupaskriyā pradhānayordhāma padārtha iṣyate || padaṃ padārthasya tu nākyagocaro bhavedyato'rthastadato nirupyate || iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe vibhakyarthāducatuṣṭayaprakāśo nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakāśaḥ <7> saptamaḥ kevalaśabdasambandhaśaktiprakāśaḥ tatrābhidhāvivakṣātātparyapravibhāgavyapekṣāsāmathyānvayaikārthībhāvadoṣahānaguṇopādānālaṅkārarasāviyogarūpāḥ śabdārthayodrvādaśa samarthaḥ sāhityamityucyate | keṣu śabdasyārthābhidhāyinī śaktirabhidhā | tayā svarūpa ivābhidheye pravartamānaḥ śabdo vṛttitrayeṇa vartate, tāśraca mukhyā gauṇī lakṣaṇeti tistrāḥ | tatra sākṣādavyavahitārathābhidhāyikā mukhyā | gamyamānaśairyādiguṇayogavyavahitārthā gauṇi | svārthāvinābhūtārthāntaropalakṣaṇā tu lakṣaṇeti | tathāhi, gaurityayaṃ sabdo mukhayāyā vṛttyā sāsnādimantamarthaṃ pratipādayati, saeva tuṣṭhanmutratādiguṇasampadamapekṣamāṇo yadā bāhvike vartate tadā gauṇīṃ vṛttimanuvadati | tadāha, rūḍhyā yatra sadarthoṃ'pi loke śabdo niveśitaḥ | sa mukhyastatra tatsāmyādrgauṇo'nyatra skhasadgitiḥ || yadā tu śabdāḥ svārthataḥ kriyāsiddhau sādhanabhāvaṃ gantumasarthastadābhidheyāvinābhūtamarthāntaraṃ lakṣayati | tadā sā ca lakṣaṇā vṛttiḥ | yathā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasanakriyāyā adhikaraṇabhāvaṃ gantumasamarthaḥsvārthāvinābhūtaṃ taṭaṃ lakṣayati | taduktam abhidheyāvinābhūtapratītirlakṣaṇeti yā | saiṣā vidagdhavakroktijīvitaṃ vṛttiripyate ||pratyokaṃ caitāstistre'pi dvidhābhūya pṛthak ṣoḍhā bhidyante | tatra mukhyā dvidhā, tathābhūtārthā, tadbhāvāpattiśca | tayoḥ tathābhūtārthā ṣoḍhā, jātiviṣayā, vyaktiviṣayā, ākṛtiviṣayā, guṇaviṣayā, kriyāviṣayā, saṃbandhaviṣayā ceti | tatra gauraśaavaḥ puruṣo brāhmaṇo ityādirjātiviṣayā, yathā prasannāḥ kāntiharāriṇyo nānāśleṣavicakṣaṇāḥ | bhavanti kasyātpuṇyairmukhe vāco gṛhe striyaḥ || yathā vā yoratthaṇīe bahuṇo halāe sāmae saṃdagamaṇāe | koracchipecchirūe bahuppae ekkamahimīe || yathā ca nijanayanapratibimbairambuni bahuśaḥ pratāritā kāpi | nīlotpaleṣu vimṛśati karamarpayituṃ kusumalāvī || citravimbabhramakimādyārthavanācinyākṛtiviṣayā yatheṅgudīpādayaḥ so'yaṃ śrṛṅgeberapure purā | niṣādapatinā yatra stigdhenāsītsamāgamaḥ || śvetaḥ karkaśaḥ kṛśaḥ sthūla ityādirguṇaviṣayā yathā śyāmalāḥ prāvṛṣeṇyābhirdiśo jīmūtapaṅktibhiḥ | bhuvaśca sukumārābhirnavaśādvalarājibhiḥ || yathā vā tāmbūsabahalaraktaḥ priyabhukto dhūsaraḥ saparyantaḥ | bālādharo'dhirohati kusumarucaḥ kāñcanārasya || paktā pacan pakkaḥ pyamāna itayādikriyāviṣayā yathā dātuḥ sthātutardviśaṣāṃ mūÐdhna yaṣṭustarpayituḥ pitṛn | yudhyabhagnavipannasya kiṃ daśāsyasya śocasi || yathā vā kuviāopasāṇṇāo oruṇṇamuhīo vihasamāṇīo ū jahagahiā tahahiaaṃ haranti ucchaṇṇamahilāo || pitā mātā śatruḥ sīnuraupagava ityādiḥ saṃbandhaviṣayā yathā sūryācandramasau yasya mātāmahapitāmahau | svaṃvṛtapatidrvābhyāmūrvaśyā ca bhuvā ca yaḥ || guṇānurāgamiśreṇa yaśasā tava sarvatā | digvadhūnāṃ mukhe jātamakasmādardhakuṅktumam || yathā vānirākṛtatāpasampadaṃ phalahūnāṃ sumanobhirujjhitām | khalatāṃ khalatāmuvāsatīṃ pratipadyeta kathaṃ budho vastuno'vasthāntaropagamanaṃ vipariṇāmaḥ | yathā ya ete yajvānaḥ pratitamahaso ye'pyavanirāḥ mṛgākṣyo yāścaitāḥ kṛtamaparasaṃsārikathayā | aho ye cāpynaye phalakumumanamra viṭapino jagatyevaṃrūpā vilasati yadeṣā bhagavatī || yathā vā cyutāmindorlekhāṃ ratikalahabhannaṃsa ca valayaṃ samaṃ cakrīkṛtya prahasitamukhī śailatanayā | avocadyaṃ paśyetyavatu sa śvaḥ sā ca girijā saca krīḍācandro dhasanakiraṇāpūritatanuḥ || mithyājñānaṃ viparyayaḥ | yathā hṛtośaṣṭharāgaurnayanodabindubhiḥ nimagnanābhernipatadbhiraṅkitam | cyutaṃ ruṣā bhinnagaterasaṃśayaṃ śukodaraśyāmamidaṃ stanāṃśukam || yathā vā mābhaiḥ śaśāṅka mama śīthuni nāsti rūhuḥ khe rohiṇi vasati kātara kātara kiṃ bibheṣi | prāyovidagdhavanitānavasahgameṣu pumasāṃ manaḥ pracalatīti kimatra citram || avastuṣvanapi || kriyānimittaḥ samāso yathā kattosaṃvaḍaimahaṃ piasahiviasagamoṇisīhevi | jā jaai gahiakaraṇaarakaṃkhirita caṃ dacaṃḍālo || saevāsamāso yathā kiṃ dvāri devahatake saharakeṇa saṃvardhitena viṣapādapa mukhapaṅkajareṅge'sminbhrūlatā nartakī tava | līlayāṅgavībhyāṃ dṛṣṭai sakhi yūnāṃ niṣiḍhcati || viśeṣasya mukhyatve vaiyadhikaraṇyenākṛtinimitto yathā paḍiḍḍatdhpakkhamaṃtuṃpuṃje lāvaṇṇakuḍe, vi mao riṭhṭho sañca piabaillo || cetanaprakṛteryathā sañcaṃ ciakaṭhamao suraṇāho jeṇahaliadhūāe | hatthehi kamaladalakomalehi cetto na pallavio || acetanasya yathā bhavatu viditametatkāṣṭhamevāsi satyaṃ kimaparamabhidhāraye kānane vardhito'si | kuvalayanayanāyāḥ pāṇisaṅgotsave'smin musala kisalayaṃ te tatkṣaṇādyanna jātam || acetanasyaiva prabhāvato yathānviṣyadbharayaṃ cirātkathamapi prāpyeta yadyarthibhiḥ nātha tvaṃ punararthinaḥ pratidinaṃ yatnātsamanviṣyasi | prāptau cintitamātrakaṃ dadadasau cintātiriktapradaṃ tvāmālokya vidīryate yadi na tadgāvaiva cintāmaṇiḥ || mukhyāyā gauṇyā vānyaviśeṣaṇasya sato'nyatrāropaṇamupacāraḥ | tannimittakopacāranimittā, sā tu gauṇavyavahitārthatvāt gauṇī bhavati, tasyā api dharmaguṇakṛtikriyāsvarūpajātyayādayaḥ pravṛttinimittatadbhedāt | sāpi ṣaṭprakārā bhavati, dharmanimittā, guṇanimittā, ākṛtinimittā, kriyānimittā, svarūpanimittā, jātinimittā ca | tāsu dharmanimittā yathā bhavatu suṣi kaṭhorā kintu ramyā mṛgākṣī | ..... || taulaiḥ śiñjadvalayasubhagairnatitaḥ kāntayā me || ..... || atra kaṭhokasubhagaśabdau mūrtimaddravyaprāṇiviśeṣayoṣaṇatvena rūḍhau, roṣavalayaśiñjayorāropyamāṇau, tadyogātrāyikākālayerapi viśeṣaṇabhāvamanubhavataḥ | guṇanimittā yathā kimiva hi madhurāṇāṃ maṇḍaḍḍatdhnaṃ nākṛtīnām | esaavasāṇaviraso sasureṇa suo valaasaddo || atra madhuravirasāśabdau vā svānyaviśeṣaṇatvena rūḍhau | tadvyavanadhānena varṇanayā''kṛtivalayaśabdairāropitau viśeṣaṇabhāvamanubhavataḥ | ākṛtinimittā yathāṅkurite pallavite korakite kusumite ca sahākāre | aṅkuritaḥ pallavitaḥ korakitaḥ kusumitaśca hṛdi madanaḥ || yathā vā pallaviaṃ pivaakarapallavehiṃ paṣpulliaṃva ṇayaṇehiṃ | phaliaṃ via pīṇapaoharehi ajjāe lāaṇṇaṃ || atrāṅkuritapallavitādayo mūrtimatsu bhūruhādiṣu ākṛtiviśeṣato viśeṣaṇatvena rūḍhāstadvyavadhānenāmūrtayormadanalāvaṇyayorāropyamāmā gauṇaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvamanubhavanti | kriyānimittā yathā śaśinamasūta prācī nṛtyāti madano hasanti kakubo'pi | kumudarajaḥpaṭavāsaṃ vakirati
