gaganāṅgaṇe pavanaḥ || yathā vāvaūhiapuppadisaumaaṃ jehṇāese via paosamuhe | māirajhintau raaṇīaparadisābhuttapatthiammi miaṃke || atra sevopagūḍhādīnāmanyakriyāṇāṃ tadvyavadhānenānyatrāropaṇādviśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ | kathaṃ punarayaṃ bhedo gauṃṇyāḥ pṛthagbhavati yatra pasiddharupamānopameyaṃ gamyate tāṃ guṇavyavahitārthāmagauṇīyāmanyoktiṃ samāsoktiṃ vā varṇayanti | yasyāṃ punarupameyena guṇasāmyādupamānaṃ gamayte tāṃ gauṇyavyavahitārthā gauṇīyāṃ samādhimityācakṣate | taduktam uktāsyāprākaraṇiktave samāsoktiḥ, prākaramikatve samādhirati | svarūpanimittā yathā kasya nāvanitaṃ kuryāddainyamātā daridratā | kaṃ vā na madayatyeṣā śrīrunmādakuṭumvinī || yathāvābharaṇasyābharaṇaṃ prasādhanavidheḥsa prasādhanaviśeṣaḥ | upamānasyāpi sakhe pratyupamānaṃ vapustasyāḥ || atra daridratāyā dainyajanakatvena mātṛsvapādhayāropādapatyatā vyavadhānena sambandho daridratā dainyaṃ janayatīti vakyārthaḥ | tasya ca śaśinamasūta prācītyādivadupacāropapattiḥ | evamuttaratrāpi yojyam ||. jātinimittā yathā dhṛtiḥkṣamā damaḥśaucaṃ sāmathryaṃ| (aucityaṃ-iti mūlapāṭhaḥ) vāganiṣṭhāurā | bhūtānāmanabhidrohassaptaitā samidhaḥ śriyaḥ || yathā vā yeṣāṃ prāṇivadhaḥ krīḍā narma marmacchidogiraḥ | paropatāpaḥ kartavyaṃ te mṛtyopari mṛtyavaḥ || atrāgnisamiddharmeṣu matryamṛtyadharmeṣu ca śrīdhṛtyādiṣu mṛtyudurjaneṣu cāropiteṣu saminmṛtyujātyereva guṇabhāvo na tvagnimatryayoriti | amīṣāṃ sākṣādasaṃbandhe dīptivināśādidharmadvāraka upacāraḥ saṃbandhāya kalpate | tenāyamarthaḥ sampadyate | dhṛtyādayaḥ śriyaṃ samedhayanti, durjanā mṛtyumapi mārayanti | sā ceyamanyarūoḍhā kriyā'nyatrāropyata itayupacāravṛttireva bhavati | yaduktaṃ kumudāni nimīlanti kamalānyunminti ca | iti netrākriyādhyāsāllabdhā tadvācinī śrutiḥ || evaṃ pārtho yaḥ pūḍāmanubhavati .... | eti jīvantamānando naraṃ varṣaśatādapi || ityādi ca draṣṭavyam | yadyavevaṃ kriyānimittaiṣā kasmānna bhavati? kriyāyā eva dravyajātirūpeṇa vipariṇāmāt, yathā dainyamātetyādau vṛttirupeṇa | nanu ca yathā gauriva gaustathā samidha itīyamapi gauṇī kasmānna bhavati? bhavati yadi samidha ityanena śriya iti nāpekṣyate śrīvahneriti vā vahniśabdaprayogo bhavati | yathā papasāarūpasodhaṇasamao aṇaṃgagaakuṃbhedhaṇe | iti | etena dainyamātā daridratā, te mṛtyorapi mṛtyavaṃ ityādairapi na gauṇatvamityuktaṃ bhavati | ādigrahamānnāmasarvanāmāderapi bhedābhedābhyāsupacāre gauṇavyavahitārthova gauṇī bhavati | sa bhedopacāre nāmādhyāropādyathā he hasta dakṣiṇa mṛtasya śiśordvijasya jīvātave visṛja śūdramunau kṛpāṇam | rāmasya gātramasi nirbharagarbhakhinnasītāvivāsanapaṭoḥ karuṇā kutaste || yathā vā sthāne'vasīdasi raghudvaha kiṃ vidhāta rasyāstvayekṣitamalakṣaṇamaṅgakeṣu | adyāpi jāvasi daśānana he hanūman keyaṃ tavābhimukhavartiripoḥ pratīkṣā || abhedopacāreṇa sarvanāmādhyāropādyathā candrajotsnāviśadapuline saikate'stimanyarayvā vādadyūtaṃ ciratamabhūtsiddhayūnoḥ kayościt | eko vakti prathamanihataṃ kaiṭabhaṃ kaṃsamanyaḥ satyaṃ tattvaṃ kathaya bhavatā ko hatastatra pūrvam || yathā vā prāptaśrīreṣa kasmātpurapi mayi tammanthakhedaṃ vidadhyā nnidrāmapyasya pūrvāmanalasamanaso naivasambhāvayāmi || setuṃ badhnāti bhūyaḥ kimitica| ( “cā'sau kathamiva” iti pāṭhāntaram. ) sakaladvīpanāthānuyātaḥ tvayyāyāte vitarkāniti dadhata ivanābhāti kampaḥ payodheḥ || atrādyodāharaṇayo rāmahanūmantau nāmaśabdābhyāmatiniṣkaruṇe paribhavāsahiṣṇau ca svamūrtibhede saṃjñāviseṣaṇatvena rūḍhau, tadvyavadhānena tadviparītayorupacaritasvamūrtibhedāntarayopāropitāvaupacārikaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvaṃ bhajete iti gauṇavyavahitārthopacāranimittopatacāramitteyaṃ gauṇī | yatra tu na bhedopacārastatra vyavadhānābhāvadruṇanimittaiva gauṇī bhavati, yathā rāmo'smi sarvaṃsahe, tākṣryaḥ so'pi samaṃ nijeta vibhinā jānāti māṃ rāvaṇaṃ || iti | kathaṃ punaḥ śabdārthayorabhede'pi bhedavyapadeśaḥ | sahi rāhoḥ śiraḥ gaurgauḥ kāmadaddetyādau śabdārthabeda eva dṛśyate | ucyate, astitāvadenmukhyābhāve sati prayojane nimitte ca satyupacāraḥ pravartate | sa cābhinnānāṃ bhedavyāpadeśahetuḥ, bhinnānāṃ caibhedavyapadeśaheturbhavati | tatrābhinnānāṃ bhedo yathātmānamātmānā vetsi sṛjasyātmānamātmanā | ātmanā kṛtinā ca tvamātmanyeva pralīyase || atra paramātmavyatiriktavastvantarābhāvātkarmādikārakavyatirekeṇa ca jñānādikriyānupapattereka eva kratṛkarmakaraṇādikaraṇīpacāreṇa bhidyate | siddhe ca bhede sādṛśyanibandhane mukhyānāminopacaritānāmapyupamānopameyavyavahāraḥ pravartate | tadyathā tvanmukhaṃ tvanmukhamiva tvaddṛśau tvaddṛśāviva | tvanmīrtiriva mūrtiste tvamiva tvaṃ kṛśodari || vaisāddṛśyanibandhanastu vyatireko bhavati | yathā nāma yasyābhinandanti dviṣo'pi sa pumānpumān | raikiraṇāṇuggāgahiāihoti kamalāikamalāiṃ | tataśca bhinnārthavatsambandhasambobhaktyāderutpattiryathā rāmasya gātramasi, he hanūmanniti | etena mukhyagauṇayorapi upamārupakādayo vyākhyātāḥ | yathāyamālohitacchāyo madena mukhacandramāḥ | sannaddhodayarāgasya candrasya pratigarjati || candramāḥ pīyate devairmayā tvanmukhacandramāḥ | asamagro hyayaṃ śaśvadayamāpūrṇamaṇḍaḍḍatdhlaḥ || amṛtātmani padmāni dveṣṭari rinagdātārake |mukhendau tava satyasminnitareṇa kimindunā || na mīlayati padmāni na nabho vyavagāhate | tvanmukhendurmamāsūnāṃ hara ṇāyaiva yasyati || bhinnanāmabhedopacāro yathottarodāharaṇayoḥ, tatra hila pratīyamānābhidhīyamānatulyaguṇopamānaviśeṣaṇamanekaṃ sarvanāmopamānavyavadhānenopameye prayuktamabhedopacāreṇotkarṣamāropayati | nanviyamanyoktiḥ samāsoktirubhayoktirvā kasmānnabhavati? tathāhi, pratīyamānābhidhīyamānopameyaguṇavibhūtayaḥ sarvanāmādhyāse'pyanyoktisamāsoktyubhayoktayo dṛśyante | tatrānyoktiryathā hā saurabhaṃ kaka tatte kkanu te santāpahāri hā śaityam | aṅgārakārahaste candana patito'si dhigdaivam || samāsoktiryathā migdhāmajātarasaṃ kalikāmakāle bālāṃ kadarthayasi kiṃ navāmalikāyāḥ | anyāsu tāvadupamardasahāsu bhṛṅgaṃ lolaṃ vinodaja manaḥ sumanolatāsu || ubayoktirthayā kenāsīnaḥ sukhamakaruṇenākāraduddhṛtattvaṃ viketu vātvamabhilavitaḥ kena deśāntare'smin | yasmanvittavyayabharasaho grāhakastāvadāstāṃ nāsti bhrātārmaratakamaṇe ttavatparīkṣākṣamo'pi || ucyate, yatropamānameva prayuktaṃ pratīyamānabhidhayīmānaguṇamupameyaṃ gamayati, tatraivānyoktyādayo bhavanti | ihatu nopamānaṃ prayujyate | kiṃ tarhi? tadviśeṣaṇaṃ sarvanāma, tena pratamamotadāharaṇe nānyoktirdvitīyodāharaṇe tu na samāsoktiriti | yadyevamadhyāsātmikā tadbhāvāpattiḥ kasmānna bhavati? yathaiva bālābāhumūle bālacandramāḥ, yathā vā kimaho nṛpāḥ samamamībhirupapatisutairna pañcabhiḥ, vadhyamabhihatha, bhujiṣyamamuṃ sahacānayā sthavirarājakanyayeti | ucyate, nātra sarvanāmnāmeva prayogaḥ | kiṃ tarhi? viśeṣyāṇāmapīti yujyate tatbhāvāpattiḥ | candrajyotsnetyādau tu sravanāmādhyase samādhilakṣaṇayogādupacāragauṇyavaiṣā bhavati, yathā ca dharmiṇo'pyadhyāse samādhirupapadyate tathāgrato vakṣyāma iti | lakṣaṇā dvividhā lakṣaṇā lakṣitalakṣaṇā ca | tayoryasyāmupāttaśabdasyārthasya kriyāsiddhau sādhanatvāyogāt svārtho'vinābhūtamarthāntaraṃ vyavahitameva lakṣamati sā lakṣaṇā, tadgayatiriktā tu vakṣyamāṇānekarūpā lakṣitalakṣaṇeti | tatra lakṣaṇā ṣoḍhā, sāmīpyalakṣaṇā, sāhataryalakṣaṇā, sahṛcaritalakṣaṇā, hetulakṣaṇā, tādathryalakṣaṇā, parimāṇalakṣaṇā, ca | tatra gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativalasita, mañcāḥ krośantītiyādiṣu svārthāvinābhūtasamīpārthāntarapratītihetuḥ sāmīpyalakṣaṇā | yathā yattālīdalapākapāḍuḍḍatdhvadanaṃ | abhinavakaridantacchedakāntaḥ kapolaḥ | iti || atra pākacchedayoḥ kriyātvenāmūrtatvātpāṇḍuḍḍatdhtvaṃ kāntatvaṃ cāsambhavāt samīpasthaṃ pakkatālīpatraṃ sadyaśchinnaṃ ca hastidantaṃ lakṣayati | chatriiṇo gacchanti, kuntānpraveśayetyādiṣu svārthāvanābūtasāhacaryopalabghārthāntarapratītihetuḥjha sāhacaryalakṣaṇā | yathā yaṃ sarvaśailāḥ parikalpya vatsaṃ merau sthite dogdhiri dohadakṣe | bhāsvanti ratnāni mahauṣadhīśca paṛthīpadiṣṭāṃ duduhurdharitrim || atra dogdhṛsāhacaryācchaileṣvapi duduhuriti prayujyate | yathā vā padepade kūbariṇaḥ śataṃśataṃ śataṃśataṃ mattagajānratherathe | nyaveśayadvājiśataṃ gajegaje hayehaye kuntaśataṃ śatakratuḥ || yatroktadharmasahacarito'nyo'pi dharmo lakṣyate sā sahacaritalakṣaṇā | yathā madhupṛṣatpiṅgāḥ payobavandavaḥ | kanakakaphalakasphārajaghanā || iti | atra piṅgatvasphāratvasahakṛtāstadāśrayākārakātyādayo lakṣyaneta | annaṃ vai prāṇāḥ, āyurghatamityādiṣu svārthāvinābhūtanimittakāraṇārthaāntarapratītiheturhetulakṣaṇā | yathā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ tvamasi me hṛdayaṃ dvitīyam, iti | atra jīvitaśabdena hṛdayaśabdena ca jīvitacaitanyahetuḥ priyamocyate | indrasthuṇāmallikāpradīpā ityādiṣu tadarthapratītihetustādarthalakṣaṇā | yathārūḍhe malayācalaṃ jalanidheḥ pāraṃ paraṃ nāṭaya nnaudaṇḍaṃ, nṛpasiṃhasiṃhalapaterucchettumacchaṃ yaśaḥ || iti | atra daṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdena daṇḍaḍḍatdhnāprahito loka ucyate | prasthaṃ palaṃ krośa ityādau parimāṇāsādhanabhūtārthāntarapratītihetuḥ parimāṇalakṣaṇā | yathā yasmādanarghāṇi hṛtānyanūnaiḥ prasthairmuhurbhūribhirucchakhāni | āḍhyādiva prāhuṇikādajastraṃ jagrāha ratnānyamitāni lokaḥ || atra prasthaśabdena prasthaparimāṇasādhanaṃ mānabhāṇḍaṃ, kāṣṭhādimayamucyate | lakṣitalakṣaṇāpi ṣoḍhaiva rūḍhalakṣaṇā, pratīkalakṣaṇā, vivakṣitalakṣaṇā, viruddhalakṣaṇā, tadanyalakṣaṇā, prakīrṇalakṣaṇā ca | tāsu yasyāṃ yathākathaṃcidvyutpatyā lakṣtenābhidhānena ruḍhalakṣama evārtho lakṣyate sā rūḍhalakṣaṇā | durodaraścakravāko dvirepho bhramara iti | yathā madhu dvirephaḥ kumumaikapātre papau priyāṃ svāmanuvartamānaḥ | iti | atra durodaratvaṃ dvirephatvaṃ ca kurare'pi sambhavati, nacātra rūḍhā lakṣaṇeti | nāyaṃ lakṣte | yatra pratīkenābhidhānaikadeśena samudāyo lakṣita eva lakṣyate na yaḥ kaścite sā pratikalakṣaṇā | yathā bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ, sañcā api hoi aiadaṃsaṇaturīa | atra svena bhīmaśabdo bhīmasatyaśabdapratīkaśravaṇāt bhīmasenaḥ, satyabhāmetyabhidhānayoḥ pūrvalakṣitayorlakṣaṇā lakṣyate | na kahi bhavati jyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭheti, ādrrāvādrreti | yatra yathākathaṃcicchabdaprayoge vivakṣitameva lakṣyānusārato lakṣyate sā vivakṣitalakṣaṇā | yathā manasijajaitrarathaṃ vilocanārdhaṃ | cakitahariṇīhārinetratribhāgaḥ | iti || atra nārdhaśabdasya tribhāgaśabdasya arthaḥ, kintu tābhyāmasamagrālokanaṃ lakṣyate | nahi bhavati naitracaturbhāgo netraṣaḍḍḍatdhbhāgo veti | padaṃ kevakalamanyasannidhervā yatrābhihitaviriddhaṃ lakṣitamevārthe lakṣayati | sā viriddhalakṣaṇā | yathā viṣṭarbhadrā, aṅgārako maṅgalaḥ, puṇyavatyahaṃ yasyāsatvamevaṃvidhaḥ patirasīti | atra bhadrāmaṅgalaśabdau puṇyavācchabdaśca abhadramaṅgalatve apuṇyavattvaṃ ca lakṣitameva lakṣayanti | yathā vā ratnāvalyāṃ rājā vidīṣakamāha mahābrāhmaṇastvamasi, ko'nya evamṛcāmabhijña iti | atra mahābrāhmaṇa ityenena ṛcāmabhijñā ityanena ca vṛṣalādapyadhamatvaṃ vaidheyatvaṃca lakṣyate | yathāca mālatīmādhave, lavaṅgikā madayantikāmabhidhatte | kahaṃ ṇāma ṇavavahūvīsaṃbheṇāpāajāṇaaṃ laḍaḍḍatdhhaviaḍuḍḍatdhmahurabhāsaṇaṃ arosamaṃ ca bhādaraṃ de bhattāraṃ samāsādia, piasahī dumpaṇaissadi | atra navavadhūvistrambhaṇopāyajñatvādiyastadviruddhamarthaṃ lakṣayanti| evamanye'pi yathedamamlānamānāyā lagnaṃ stanataṭe tava | chādyatāmuttarīyeṇa navaṃ nakhapadaṃ sakhi || kuviāopasaṇṇāo oruṇṇamuhio vihasamāṇīo | jahagahiā nahahiaaṃ haraṃti ucchaṇṇamahilāo || vayaṃ tathā nāma yathāttha kiṃ vadāmyayantavakasmādvikalaḥ kathāntare | kadambagolākṛtimāśritaḥ kathaṃ viśuddhamugdhaḥ kulakanyakājanaḥ || eteṣvamlānamānaśabdena mānabhaṅgaḥ, utsannaśabdenānucchedāśīḥ, viśuddhamugdhaśabdenāviśuddhiramaugdhyaṃ ca lakṣyate | yatrābhihitaśabdārthatiraskāreṇārrthāntaraṃ lakṣyate sā tadanyalakṣaṇā | yathā suvarmapuṣpāṃ pṛthirvīṃ cinvanti puruṣāstrayaḥ | śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca yaśca jānāti sevitum || atra na suvarṇaśabdārtho, nāpi puṣpaśabdārthaḥ | kintu surrṇaśabdena sarvapuruṣārthamūlaṃ hiraṇyaṃ, kapuṣpaśabdena ca prasavārtho lakṣyate | tābhyāṃ ca lakṣitābhyāṃ vyavasāyināṃ puruṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ vasumatī sarvānkāmān prasūta iti | uktābhyo'nyā prakīrṇalakṣaṇā | yathā daśaraśmiśatopamadyutiṃ yaśasā dikṣu daśasvapi śrutam | daśapūrvarathaṃ yamākhyāyā daśakaṇṭhāriguraṃ vidurbudhāḥ || hiṃraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipuṃ pracakṣate | turaṅgakāntāmukhabavyavāhajvanāleva hitvā jalamullalāsa || iti | anye punarlakṣitalakṣaṇāmanyathā vyacakṣate | lakṣaṇayopacaritavṛttyā goṇyābhihitārthena yatrārthāntaraṃ lakṣyate sā likṣatalakṣaṇeti | yathā rathāvayavāyudhaḥ, paṅktirathaḥ, rathāṅganāmeti, atra rathāvayavaśabdena daśaśabdaḥ, tābhyāṃ cāyudhasannidheścakrāyudhaḥ, dalarathaḥ, iti devaviśeṣarājaviśeṣau lakṣyate | rathāṅgamityanena rathaikadeśo lakṣyate, tena cakraśabdaḥ . nāmetyanena paribhāṣaṇaṃ lakṣyamāṇārthaḥ, tābhyāmanyonyasannidheścakranāka iti pakṣiviśeṣo lakṣyate iti | asāyaśca prabandheṣu bhūyasā prayogaḥ | tadyathā sūrhavehisalaṃ vicchuhamāṇena uḍhḍhaloeṇa | ekaggāmepivio imehiṃ acchahiviaṇadiṭṭho || atra sūcīvedhe musalapraveśo na sambhavati, janastu tāmapi karotītyanena lakṣitena tasyāsambhāvyāmānārthāvāditā lakṣyate | yathā cuṃbujjai saahuttaṃ apavāhijjai sahassasaahuṃttaṃ | ramiapuṇo viramijjai piejaṇe ṇatthi puṇaruttaṃ || atra punaruktāśabdo'pyarthavān punaḥ prayogaviśeṣe vaniruḍhaśaktiḥ kriyā punaḥ karaṇasāmānyaṃ lakṣaya ...... vipakṣicumbanā .... ṇaviśeṣayathryāya lakṣayati | evaṃ dui tumaṃ viaṇiaṇā kakkasamahuai ṇavaṇāi | ṇirahaṃkāramiaṃkā haraṃti nīlāo via ṇisāo || atra mattanirahaṅkāraśabdāvanibhṛtatvaṃ ca lakṣyantau cetaneṣu rūḍhāvacetaneṣu prayujyamānau tayorapi tathāvidhārthayogaṃ lakṣayataḥ | kiñca aṇṇaṃ laḍaḍḍatdhhattaṇaaṃ aṇṇañciaaṃgavaḍhḍhaṇacchāā | sāmāsāmaṇṇavaā paissarehañcihaṇahoi || atra rekhāśabdena citrālekhyaṃ lakṣyate, na ca viśiṣṭaṃ rūpanirmāṇamiti | aparaṃ, agaṇia naaṇāāsā māliṣuloijjatajaṃkatako hosi maaṇassa || atra madanasya ko bhavasītyanena tatsanābhitvaṃ lakṣyate | tenaca tadaupamyamiti | tathā pratovchatyāśokīṃ kisalayaparāvṛttimadharaḥ kapolaḥ pāṇḍuḍḍatdhtvādavatarati tālīpariṇatim | parimlānaprāyāmanuvadati dṛṣṭiḥ kamalinīṃ navīnastanvaṅgyā manasijavikāro vijayate || ataḥ pratīcchatyavataratyanuvadatīti cetanadharmairacenaprayuktairupalakṣiteṣu dhāraṇaprāptyanu.......kisalayaparāvṛttyā śvasadhūsaratvaṃ lakṣyate | tenāpi tatsāmīpyādaśokakisalayaupamyamiti tālīpariṇatyā kalamalinīparimlānakatayā ca virahakāśrya, tena snehātireka iti | evaṃ parimlānaṃ pīnastanajaghanasabgādajubhayatastanormadhyāsyāntaḥ parimilanamaprāpya haritam | itaṃ vyastanayāsaṃ ślathabhujalatākṣepavalanaiḥ kṛśāṅgyāḥ santāpaṃ vadati bilinīpatraśayanam || atra vadatītyanenopatacāravṛtyā jñāpayatīti, kaparimlānamityādibhistaddharmaistasyāstunusanniveṣacārutvotkarṣo lakṣyate | api ca nirmālyaṃ nayanaśriyaḥ kuvalayaṃ vaktrasya dāsaḥ śaśī kandarpasya dhanurlatā kimaparaṃ dvāri bhruvordhāryate || iti || atra nirmālyadāsaśabdābhyāmupacāravṛttyā hīnatvena lakṣitena nayanavaktrayorumotkarṣo lakṣyate | kandarpadhanurlatāyāstu dvārapraveśāpākaraṇopalakṣaṇena tayorapi hīnatvena sutarāṃ brūte | kuñca yattālīdalapākapāṇḍi, vadanaṃ yaddurdinaṃ netrayoḥ | yañcānartitakeli paṅkajadalaṃ śvāsāḥ prasarpanti ca || atra durdinaṃ naitrāyorityatra durdinaśatavṛṣṭimeghāhataśobhe'hni rūḍhābhidhānaśaktirnetrayorasambhāvyamānatvena svārthāvinābhūtaṃ payaḥpravāhaṃ lakṣayannaśrupravāhaṃ lakṣayati | anyañcātikrantasukhāḥ kālāḥ pratyupasthidāruṇāḥ | śaśvatpāpīyadivasāḥ pṛthvī| (atra “śvaśśvaḥpā”-“pṛthivī”-iti pāṭhāvantaram) ca gatayauvanā || atrātikrantasukhatvāditi cetanadharmairacetaneṣu kālādiṣvaropitaisteṣu tadasambhavena tadavinā bhūtāstadgatāḥ prāṇyādayo lakṣyante | tenātmanirveda iti | aparaścedamandhatamaḥ kṛtknaṃ jāyeta bhuvanatrayam | niśvāsāndha ivādarśaścandramā na prakāśate || atra yathā andhe rūpaviśeṣābhivyaktirna sambhāvyate evaṃ tamasyapi yatra nīrandhe rūpaviśeṣābhivyakterasambhavastadandhatam ityucyate, tathā yathāndho rūpagrahamāsamartha evamādarśo'pi | yo rūpamṛgrahaṇāsamarthaḥ so'ndha ityucyate | tatropacaritavṛttau yo'ndhavanna paśyati sa evāndha ityucyate | iha yatra kiñcinna dṛśyate tatrāpi andhaśabgadopalakṣitalakṣaṇayā pravartata iti | evamanyadapi yathā svalpai rasāvapi na dahyata eva kāṣṭhaiḥ | vaassa tumaṃpi theva caṃdaṇaraseṇa sāmā ... jjasi || atra pūrvasminnathāśrutārtho varṇanīye sambhavaḥ | yathā vikramādityasthathāyamapi mahāpuruṣaviśeṣa iti lakṣayati | tatena ca svalpairvacobhiranākhyeyaṃ māhātmyādigumagauravamubhayorapi lakṣayati | uttaratra tu sa evārtho lakṣaṇayā vaiparītyenākhyāyata ityevamayamananto lakṣitalakṣaṇavyāpāraḥprabandeṣu lakṣaṇīyaḥ | yathaikāhiaddhihi sāvaṇua nahi bhaddavao | māhavumahilapattha ......utthavesarao || aṃgahigiṃhasugacchaḍiḍḍatdhtilavaṇemaggarūmuddhahe | mumuhaṣaṃkaasare āvāsiosisiru || nīhārajālamalinaḥ punaruktāsāndrāḥ kurvanvadhūjanavilocanapakṣmamālāḥ || kṣuṇṇaḥ kṣaṇaṃ yadubalairdivamātitāsuḥ pāṃsudriśāṃ mukhamatutthayadutthito'draiḥ || śabdeṣvarthe'bhidhānadānābhiprayo vivakṣā | yadāha vakturvivakṣitapūrvikā śabdapravattiriti | tridhā hi vāḍḍḍatdhyyaḥ, apauruṣeyamarṣeṃ pauraṣeyaṃ ca | tatra śabdapradhānamapauruṣeyaṃ māntro brāhmaṇaṃ ca | tatra vakturabhāvādvivakṣā nopapadyate | arthapradānamārṣe smṛtiritihāsaśca | tatra vivakṣāmātraṃ pravartate lokikānāṃ hi sādhūnāṃ vāgagardhamanuvartate | ṛṣīṇāṃ punarādyānāṃ vācamartho'nuvartate| (“dhāvati” iti pāṭhāntaram) || iti || pradhānaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ ca tadubhayamapyabhiniviṣaaṭabuddhināṃ viśiṣṭavi vakṣābhyo jāyate | tadyathā vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇi bhavanti | akṣāndīvyati akṣairdīvyati ekṣeṣu dīvyata iti | vavāhako vidyotate, valāhakasaya vidyotata iti | śaktimātrā samūhasya viśvasyānekadharmamaḥ | sarvadā sarvathābhāvātkkaciñcidvivakṣyate || kārakeṣvaṣyapyakārakavivakṣā yathā mātuḥ smarati, sarpiṣo jānīte, na māṣāṇāmaśnīyāt | naite sukhasya jānanti yena vatsyanti nandane || iti | atra karmādiṣu śeṣatvena vivakṣiteṣu sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī na karmakaraṇakartṛṣvapi kārakavibhaktiriti | akārakeṣu kārakavivakṣā yathā bhavati, pacati, bhavati pakṣyati, bhavatyapākṣīt | astigacchāmo vayamiti | tathā smarasi kāśmīreṣu vatsyāmaḥ | ehi manye na yāsyāsi, paśya mṛgo dhāvati, iha paśyamāmaḥ, karmaṇi dvivacanabahuvacanānyudāhriyanta iti | kriyāyāmapi kārakavivakṣā yathā corasya rūjati, corarasyamayita, ceraṃ jvayati, coraṃ saṃtāpayatīti | atra rujārthānāṃ yathā corasya rujati, corasyāmayati, coraṃ jvarayati, tacoraṃ saṃtāpayatīti | atra rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmaḍaḍḍatdhjvarisantāpyoriti bhāvasyaiva kartṛtvam | akriyāyāṃ kriyāvivakṣā yathā nīlati vanam, śvetate prāsādaḥ || viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvadhrya svayaṃ dhetetumasāmpratam || iti || kriyāyāṃ kriyāntataravivakṣā yathaisitumicchiti, kamituṃ kāmayate, bhavedapi bhavet, sāyadapi syāditi | kārake'pi kriyāvivakṣā yathā draṣṭuṃ cakṣuḥ, yoddhuṃ dhaniḥ, gantumanāḥ gantukāma iti | atra kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmupapade tumun bhāvauktaḥ | sa cakṣurādīnāṃ kriyāvivakṣāmantareṇa na sidhyatīti | asambandhe sambandhavivakṣā yathā rāṭopamuvīṃmaniśaṃ nadanto yaiḥ plāvayiṣyanti samantato|mī | tānyokadeśānnibhṛtaṃ payodherambhāṃsi meghānpibato dadarśa || acetaneṣu caintayavivakṣā yathā nadīkūlaṃ pipatiṣati, aśmā lunodhimicchati | .....vivakṣā yathāśvārohaḥ pipatiṣati | pradhāne guṇavivakṣā yathā balākāyāḥ śauklyam, kākasya kāṣṇryamiti | guṇe pradhānavivakṣā yathā madhuro rasa āpyāyayati, āmlo dīpayatīti | avayave samudāyavivakṣā yathā grāmo dagdhaḥ, paṭo gagdhaḥ, akṣṇā kāṇaḥ, pādena svañca iti | samudāye avayavavivakṣā yathā dordaṇḍaḍḍatdhcaṇḍiḍḍatdhmamātrāropaṇīye dhanuṣi sati padātilave lakṣmaṇena prabhurāryaḥ māmapi tasyaiva sugṛrahītanāmno devasya bhṛtyaparamāmuṃ vikukṣināmānamavadhārayatu bhavatīti | abede bhedavivakṣā yathā paṭubhāṣī bhavān paṭurāsīt | paṭutaraḥ eṣaḥ | anya evāsītsampannaḥ, rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrasakasya śarīramiti | bhede'pyabhedavivakṣā yathā tāneva śālīnaśnīmo ye madhurāyāṃ, tāneva śāṭakānācchādayāmo ye pāṭhaliputra iti | asato vivakṣā yathā samudraḥ kuṇḍiḍḍatdhkā, vindhyo vardhaitakamiti | sato'pyavivakṣā yathānudarā kanyā, alomikā ejaketi | sadalatorvivakṣā yathā tadidamapamedhodayaṃ varṣaṃ, socchvāsaṃ maraṇamiti | sadasatoravivakṣā yathā śelādhirājatanayā na yayau na tasthāviti || stutyā nindāvivakṣā yathā guṇānāmeva daurātmyāddhuri dhuryo niyujyate | asañjātakiṇaskandhaḥ sukhaṃsvapitigaurgalī || nindayā kastutivivakṣā yathā capalo nirdayāścāsau janaḥ kiṃ tena me sakhi | āgaḥ pramārjanāyaiva cāṭavo yena śikṣitāḥ ||vidhinā niṣedhavivakṣā yathā gaccha gacchasi cetkānta panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ | mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyādyatra gato bhavān || niṣedhena vidhivivakṣā yathā māgaccha pramadāpriya priyāśatairbhūyastvamukto mayā bālā prāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā prāptanotyavasthāntaram | kiñcāsyāḥ kucabhārapīḍaḍḍatdhnaparairyatnaprabandhairapi truṭyatkañcukajākairanudinaṃ nissūtramasmadgṛham || evamiyamanekadhā vivakṣā viprathate tadeṣa lokikavādaḥ |(“apāre kāvyasaṃsāre”iti pāṭhānataram)asminnapāre saṃsāre kavirekaḥ prajāpatiḥ | yathāsmai rocate viśvanaṃ tathedaṃ parivartate || api ca ṭhiamaṭhṭhiaṃbadīsai a ṭhiaṃpijahaṭhṭhiaṃvapaḍiḍḍatdhbhāi | jahasaṃcaṭṭiaṃbavajasai sukaīṇaimāopaaīo || kiñca kkacitsvalpe'pyarthe pracuravanaireva racanā kkacidvastu spharaṃ katipayadairpitarasam | yathā vācyaṃ śabdāḥ kkacidapi tulāyāmiva dhṛtā stribhiḥ klapairevaṃ kavivṛṣabhasandarbhaniyamaḥ || vivakṣā lokavyavahāre kāvyanyavahāre ca sumatibhirunnīyamānā tridhā vikhaayāte, kākkādivyaṅgyā, prakaraṇādivyaṅgyā, abhinayādivyaṅgyā ca | tatra kākuḥ svaro viccheda iti kākkādayaḥ | teṣu bhinnakaṇṭhadhvanidhīraiḥ kākurityābhidhīyate | sā tridhā niyatapratibandhā, aniyatapratibandhā, aprativandhā ca | tāsu niyatapratibandhā dvidhā, sākāṅkṣā nirākāṅkṣā ca | tayorvākyāntarāpekṣiyaṇī sākāṅkṣā | sā tridhākṣepagaparbhā, paśnagarbhā, vitarkagarbhā ca | vakyāntarabhāvinī nirākāṅkṣā | sāpi tridhā, vidhirūpā uttararūpā nirṇayarūpā ca | tadeva vākyaṃ kākuviśeṣṇa sākāṅkṣaṃ, tadeva kākkantareṇa vanirākāṅkṣām | tatrākṣepagarbhā yathā yadi me vallabhā dūtī tadāhamapi vallabhā | yadi tasyāḥ priyā vācastanmamāpi priyapriyā || iyameva nirdiṣṭurvidhirūpā | praśnagarbhā yathā gataḥ sa kālo yatrāsīnmuktānāṃ janmavalliṣu | vartante sāmprate tāsāṃ hetavaḥ śuktisampuṭāḥ || iyamevopadeṣṭuruttararūpā |vinavajaladharaḥ sannaddho'yaṃ na dhṛṣṭaniśācaraḥ siradhanuridaṃ dūrākṛṣṭaṃ na tasya śarāsanam | ayamapi paṭurdhārāsāro na bāṇaparamparā kanakanikaṣasnigdhā vidyutpriyā na mamorvaśī || iyamevopadeṣṭurnirmayarūpā | evamanyā api sarvakṣitibhṛtāṃ nātha dṛṣṭa sarvāṅgasundarī | rāmā ramye vanānte'sminmayā virahitā tvayā || ityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ | tā imāstisro'pi niyatapratibandhā | aniyatapratibandhā punaranantāḥ | tāsvabhyupagamānunayakākuryathā yuṣmacchāsanalaṅghanāṃhasi mayā magnena nāma sthitaṃ prāptānāmavigarhaṇāṃ sthitimatāṃ madhye'nujānāmapi | krodhollālitaśoṇitāruṇagadasyocchindataḥ kauravānadyaikaṃ divasaṃ mamāsi na gururnāhaṃ vidheyastava || abhyanujñopahāsakākuryathā mathnāmi kauravaśataṃ samare na kopādduśśānasya rudhiraṃ na pibāmyurastaḥ | sañjīrṇayāmi gadayā na suyodhanoru sandha karotu bhavatāṃ nṛpatiḥ paṇena || viṣānnādyākṣepakākuryathā lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnāsabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya | ākṛtya pāṇḍaḍḍatdhvavadhūparidhānakeśān svasthā bhavantu mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ || evamanyā api śalyamapi sphuradantaṃ soḍhuṃ śakyeta hālahaladigdham | dhīrairna punarakāraṇakupitakhalālīkadurvacanam || ityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ || apratibandhā tu ekaguṇā dviguṇā triguṇā ca | tatraikaguṇā yathā bhrukuṭirāracitā gatamagrato hṛtamathānanamuktamasādhu vā | iyamapi prabhutā kriyate balādakupitopi hi yatkupito janaḥ || dviguṇā yathā kiṃ kirātena yañcakre samākṛṣya śilīmukhān | śilīmukhān samākṛṣya kiṃ kirātaḥ karoti tat || triguṇā yathā seyaṃ paśyati no kuraṅgakavadhūtrasteyamudvīkṣate tasyāḥ pāṇirayaṃ na mārutacalaḥ patrākṛtiḥ pallavaḥ | tāraṃ roditi saiva naiṣa marūtā veṇuḥ samāpūryate seyaṃ māmabhibhāṣate priyatamā no kokilaḥ kūjati || caturguṇā khalvapi yathocyatāṃ sa vacanīyamaśeṣaṃ neśvare puruṣātā sakhi sādhvī | ānayainamanunīya kathaṃ vā vipriyāṇi janayannanuyeyaḥ || kiṃ gatena nahi yuktamupaituṃ kaḥ priye subhagamānini mānaḥ | yoṣitāmiti kathāsu samataiḥ kāmibhirbahurasā dhṛtirūhe || sakhyā vā nāyikāyā vā sakhīnāyakayoratha | bhūyasīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ vā vāci kākuriha sthitā || evamanyā api ko'himityādayo draṣṭavyāḥ | svarāsbhidhā plutādayaḥ, udāttādayaḥ, pragṛhyādayaśca te ṣu plutādayo yathā subhrutvaṃ kupitetyapāstamaśanaṃ tyaktāḥ kathā yoṣitāṃ dūrādeva vivarjitāḥ surabhayaḥ sraggandhadhūpādayaḥ | kopaṃ rāgiṇi muñca mayyavanate dṛṣṭe prasīdādhunā sarvaṃ tvadvirahādbhavanti dayite sarvā mamāndhā diśaḥ || tadetatpriyatamāprasādanaparamapi vākyaṃ dṛṣṭe ityatra sambuddhau plutasvarakaṇādutkupitadṛṣṭiprasādanaparaṃ sampadyate | ādigrahaṇena hrasvadīrdhānunāsukāḥ saṅgahyante | tatra hi hrasvarakaṇādarthabhedo yathāśvavaditi sambodhanaṃ pratīyate | dīrghakaraṇādarthabhedo yathā viśvāmitro viśvānara iti ṛṣiḥ saṃjñā ca pratīyate | anunāsikakaraṇādarthabhedo yathā gambhūraām̐ apaḥ, āṅo'nunāsikaśchandasīti īṣadādirthaḥ pratīyate, na sthāṇuḥ | dinaṃ yathājñātaṃ sa jaṭāyureṣu jarasā kliṣṭo vadhaṃ vāñchati | udāttādayo yathā kālo ravo'syeti kalaravaḥ, ekaḥ putro'stetyekaputra iti | samāse bahuvrīhisvaro bhavati, sa ca pūrvapadasyāntodāttaḥ | kalaścāsau ravaśca ekaścāsau putraśceti samāse kramadhārayasvaro bhavati | sa ca samāsasyeti samāsasyāntodātto bhavati | tābhyāṃ cānyapadārtha uttarapadārthaśca pratiyate | taduktaṃ saṃśayāya dadhatoḥ sarūpatāṃ dūrabhinnaphalayoḥ kriyāṃ prati | śabdaśāsanavidaḥ samāsayorvigrahaṃ vyavasasuḥ svareṇa te || ādigrahaṇenānapadāttasvaritaikaśrutayaḥ saṅgṛhyante | tatrānudāttādarthabhedo yathā pūrvoktayorevodāharaṇayoranyapadārthaḥ pratīyate nacottarapadārtha iti | svaritādarthabhedo yathā bhrātṛvya iti bhrātuvya iti bhrāturapatyaṃ yoranyapadārthaḥ pratīyate, na sapatnaḥ | ekaśruterarthabhedo yathāgaccha bho māṇavakadevadattā | āgnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ, apāṃ retāṃsi jinvato ...... putraika | āśruteryathā ..... dūrādāhvānayajñaka ... sandhīyate | tatsvaro'pi tāsthyāt pragṛhya ityucyate | tato'rthabhedo yathālīka āgacchāmi tāmita iti sakhībhyāmivāgantavyamityarthaḥ pratīyate | nāgantūnāṃ piṅktarasmarādati, ādigrahaṇena sandheyasaṃvṛtā vṛddhāḥ saṅgahyante | tatra sandheyādarthabhedo yathāṅgirasa iti | vicchedastridhā padavicchedo | teṣu śṛṅkhalā yathā kāntāratarutalāsitamṛgayuvaracitāntarāharatyaṭavī, iti | atra yadā kāntarāḥ tarutalaḥ āntarā iti padacchedastadā priyāsambhogamaṇitaharṣitavyādhapradhānavyāptāmadhye iti | seyaṃ śṛṅkhalevānyonyasaṅkalācchaṅkhalā | bhaṅgo yathā jāya ...... vākyaṃ nindārtha kriyate seyaṃ padadvaidhībhāvo bhaṅgaḥ | parivartako yathā kalikāmadhugarhaṇetyavikṛtameva vicchidyate | kuṭamalakarandaniṣyandetyarthapratītiḥ | yadātu kalikāmadhuk arhaṇeti tadā pūjanaiva kalikāle kāmadhenuriti | so'yaṃ gakārakārayoḥ parivartane parivartakaḥ | cūrṇakaṃ yathā paśya salilaṃ payodherdūrasamunmuktaśuktimīnāṅkāntam | matsyānāṃ vallabhaṃ payodherjalamavalokayetyarthaḥ | yadā tu dūrasaṃ unmuktaśuktimīnāṅkāntamiti, tadā duḥkhena rasanīyaṃ udvāntamauktikādhāraṃ matsyacihnitaparyantaṃ jalamavalokayeti | akṣa śuktītyasya saṃyogākṣarasya dūrasamityatra rephasya ca cūrṇanimittaṃ cūrṇakaṃ | vākyavicchedo'pi caturdhāvākyasambhedo, vākyāsambhedo, vākyāsambhedo, vākyānyathātvaṃ, vākyāsamāptiḥ, vākyānuñcāraṇamiti, teṣu vākyasambhedo yathā diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭau mahī sādhyate | siddhā sāpi vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata | viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namo | yasmādāvibabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam || atra vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyateti vākyasaṃbhodo vakturbhāvakatvena guṇaviśeṣavijñānātiśayaprakāśanaṃ pratipādayati | vākyānyathātvaṃ yathā sahabhṛtyagaṇaṃ sabāndhavaṃ sahamitraṃ sabalaṃ sahānugam | svabalena nihanti saṃyuge na cirātpāṇḍuḍḍatdhsutaḥ suyodhanam || atra pāṇḍuḍḍatdhsutaṃ suyodhana iti vaktavye pāṇḍuḍḍatdhsutaḥ suyodhanamiti bhānumatīvirahavaimanasyaprayuktasya suyodhanavākyasyānyathātvamanucyamānaṃ bhāvino'rthasya tathātvamavabodhayati | vākyāsamāptiryathā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ tvamasi me hṛdayaṃ dvitīyaṃ tvaṃ kaumudī nayanayoramṛtaṃ tvamaṅge | ityādibhiḥ priyaśatairanurudhya mugdhāṃ tāmeva śāntamathavā kimataḥ pareṇa || atra śāntamathavā kimataḥ pareṇeti vāsantīvākyāsamāptiḥ suhṛdviṣaye nāmaṅgalaṃ vaktāvyamiti pratipādayati | vākyānuñcāraṇaṃ yathā akṣatrārikṛtābhimanyunidhanaprodbhūtatīvrakrudhaḥ kīrṇābāṣpakaṇaiḥ patanti dhanuṣi vrīḍājaḍā dṛṣṭayaḥ | pārthasyākṛtaśākṣavapratikṛterantaśśucā muhyato hā vatseti giraḥ sphuranti na punarniryānti kaṇṭhādvahiḥ || atra hā vatseti vākyānuñcāraṇamakṛtaśatrupratikriyāṇāṃ mahātmanāmanucitaṃ paridevanamiti jñāpayati | virāmo yatiḥ | sa caturdhā, pade pāde ardhe sthāne ca | tasyānyathākaraṇaṃ yativicchedaḥ | tatra pade yathā sampado jalataraṅgavilolā yauvanaṃ tricaturāṇi dināni | śāradābhradalacañcalamāyuḥ kiṃ dhanaiḥ parahitāni vidadhvam| (“tanuddhaṃ “ iti vā pāṭhaḥ |) atra kiṃ dhanairiti padayatau nyāyyo'rtha pratīyate | yadātvājñāsiddhāni catvāri neti pādamatikramya tadā anyāyy iti | ardhe yathocyatāṃ sa vacanīyamaśeṣaṃ neśvare paruṣatā sakhi sādhvī | ānayainamanunīya kathaṃ vā vipriyāṇi janayannanuneyaḥ || atra yadārdhe yati stadaikasyā evedaṃ vākyamityānyo'rthaḥ pratīyate | yadā tu tadvicchedātpādā eva yatiḥ kriyate tadā dvayorbahvīnāṃ vā eko vākyenānya iti | sthāne yathā yena dhvastamanobhavena balijitkāyaḥ purā strīkṛto yogaṅgāṃ ca dadhe'ndhakakṣayakaro yo barhipatrapriyaḥ | yasyāhuśśaśimacchiro hara iti stutyaṃ ca nāmāmarāḥ so'vyādiṣṭabhujaṅgahāravalayastvāṃ sarvadomādhavaḥ || atra dvādaśasu cākṣareṣu yatisthānam, tadatikrameṇa balijitkāya iti śaśimacchirohara iti ca yatikaraṇe umādhavo mādhavaśca tvāmavyādityarthau krameṇa pratīyete iti | prakaraṇamartho liṅgamaucityaṃ deśaḥ kāla iti prakaraṇādayaḥ | tatra prakaraṇādyāthā saindhavaḥ sāmānyena lavaṇe'śve puruṣe ca vartamānaḥ bhojanādiprakaramavaśādarthaviśeṣapratipattinimittaṃ bhavati | devo varṣatītyarthāt devaśabdo meghamabhidhatte, rāmalakṣmaṇāviti lakṣmamaliṅgādrāmaśabdo dāśarathau vartate | puṇḍaḍḍatdhrīkamukhītyaucityātpuṇḍaḍḍatdhrīkaśabdaḥ kamalamāha | amarāvatyāṃ haririti hariśabdo deśataḥ śatakratuṃ brūte | rātrau pataṅgaṃ paśyati, atra kālataḥ pataṅgaśabdaḥ śalabhamabhidhatta iti | evamanye'pi | tadyāthā bhavatu viditaṃ śabdā vakturvivakṣitasūcakāḥ smarati ca yataḥ kānte kāntāṃ haṭhātpariṭumbati | nanana mamamāmāṃ mā sprākṣīrniṣedhaparaṃ vaco bhavati śithile mānagranthau tadeva vidhāyakam || iti || abhinayo'padeśo nirdeśaḥ saṃjñā iṅgitamākāra ityabhinayādayaḥ | teṣvabhinayo yathaiddahamettatthaṇiā eddahamettehi acchivattehiṃ | eddahamettāvatthā eddahamettehidiaehiṃ || apadeśo yathetaḥ sa daityaḥ prāptaśrīrneta evārhati kṣayam | viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvadhrya svayaṃ chettumasāmpratam || nirdeśo yathā bhartṛdārake diṣṭyā vardhāmahe, yadatreva ko'pi kasyāpi tiṣṭhatīti māmaṅgulīvilāsenākhyātavatyaḥ | saṃjñā yathāpyavastuni kathāpravṛttaye praśnatatparamanaṅgaśāsanam | vīkṣitena parigṛhya pārvatī mūrdhakampamayamuttaraṃ dadau || iṅgitaṃ yathā kadā nau saṅgamo bhāvītyākīrṇe vaktumakṣamam | avetya kāntamabalā līlāpadmaṃ nyamīlayat || ākāro yathā niveditaṃ niśvasitena soṣmaṇā manastu me saṃśayameva gāhate | na vidyate prārthayitavya eva te bhaviṣyati prārthitadurlabhaḥ katham || evamanye'pi, yathāśloṣe prathamaṃ kamādatha jite hṛdye'dharasyārpaṇe kerlādyūtavidhau paṇaṃ priyatame kāntāṃ punaḥ pṛcchati | sāntarhāsaniruddhasambhṛtarasodbhedasphuradgaṇḍaḍḍatdhyā tūṣṇīṃ śāravisāraṇāya nihitaḥ svedāmbugarbhaḥ karaḥ || yatparaśśabdaḥ sa śabdārtha iti tātparyam | tañca vākya evopapadyate | padamātreṇābhiprāyasya prakāśayitumaśakyatvāt | tañca vākyapratipādyaṃ vastu trirūpaṃ bhavati | abhidhīyamānaṃ pratīyamānaṃ dhvanirūpaṃ ca | yatra yadupāttaśabdeṣu mukhyagauṇīlakṣaṇābhiḥ śabdaśaktibhiḥ svamarthamabhidhāyoparatavyāpāreṣu ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatādibhirvākyārthāmātramabhidhīyate tadabhidhīyamānam | yathā gaurgacchatīti vākyārthāvagateruttarakālaṃ vākyarthaṃ upapadyamāno'nupapadyamāno vārthaprakaraṇaicityādisahakṛtau yatpratyāyayati tatpratīyamānam | yathā viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva mācāsya gṛhe bhuṅgathāḥ, ityukte varaṃ viṣaṃ bhakṣitam, na punarasya gṛhe bhuktīmiti pratīyate | arthaśabdopāyādupasarjanīkṛtasavārtho vākyārthāvagateranantaramanunādarūpamapratiśabdarūpaṃ vā'bhivyañjayati taddhvanirupam | tañca na sārvatrikam | tathāhi, yathā nivṛtte'bhidhāte kasyacidevakāṃsyādedrravyasyānunādo jāyate, kasyacideva kandarādeḥ pratiśabdaḥ | yathā kasyacideva vākyasya pratīyamānābhidhīyamānavākyārthapratīteranantaraṃ dhvanirupalabhyata iti | nimiṣatyeṣetyukte'kṣṇornimeṣo'bhidhīyate, devī na bhavatīti pratīyate | rūpātiśayaśca dhvanati | athaiṣāṃ prayogaḥ, tatrābhidhīyamānaṃ caturdhā vidhirūpaṃ niṣedharūpaṃ vidhiniṣedharūpamavidhiṣedharūpaṃ ca | teṣu vidhirūpaṃ yathā dānaṃ vittādṛtaṃ vācaḥ kīrtidharmo tathāyuṣaḥ | paropakaraṇaṃ kāyādasārātsāramuddharet || niṣedharūpaṃ yathā lokayātrā bhayaṃ lajjā dākṣiṇyaṃ dharmaśīlatā | yasyaitāni na vidyante na tena saha saṃvaset || vidhiniṣedharūpaṃ yathā pakkānnamivarājendra sarvasādhāraṇāḥ striyaḥ | tasmāttāsu na kupyeta na rajyeta rameta ca || avidhiniṣedharūpaṃ yathā na dānena na mānena na śāṭhyena na sevayā | na śāstrema na hṛdyāstāḥ sarvāthā kimiva striyaḥ || pratīyamānaṃ punaranekadhā | kkacidvidhau niṣedho bhama dhammia vīraddho so suṇao ajja mārio teṇa | golāṇaīkacchakuḍuṃḍḍatdhgavāsiṇā dariasīheṇa || atra visrabdho bhrameti vidhivākye tatra nikuñje siṃhastiṣṭhati | tvaṃ ca śuno'pi vibheṣi | tasmāttvayā tasminna gantavyamiti niṣedhaḥ pratīyate | kkacinniṣedhe vidhiryathāttā ettaṇimajjai etthaahaṃ divasaaṃ paloehi | māpahia rattiaṃdhia sejjāe maha ma majjihisi || atra śayyāyāṃ mā nivatsyāsīti niṣedhavākye iyaṃ śvaśrūśayyā, iyaṃ macchayyeti divābhyupalakṣyarātrau tvayehāgantavyamiti vidhiḥ pratīyate | kkacidvidhau vidhyantaraṃ yathā bahalatamāhaarāī ajja paḍaḍḍatdhttho paī gharaṃ suṇṇaṃ | tahaṃ segajja saaṃdhia ṇajahāaṃmemusijjāmo || atra yathā vayaṃ na muṣyāmahe tathā jāgṛhīti vidhyabhidhāne rātriratyandhakārā patiḥ proṣito gṛhaṃ śūnyamatastvamabhayo matpāśrvamāgaccheti vidhyantaraṃ pratīyate | kkacinniṣedhe niṣedhāntaraṃ yathāsāiaṃ aṇāe ṇajattiaṃ tattieṇabaṃdhidhihiṃ | oramasuvisasuehnirakijjihagapaīchattaṃ || atra gṛhapatikṣetre duṣṭavṛṣavāraṇapare niṣedhavākye upapativāraṇaṃ niṣedhāntaraṃ pratīyate | kkacadvidhiniṣedhe vidhiryathā mahuehikiṃva patthiajaihasiṇiaṃṇiaṃbāau | vāhemi kassaraṇṇe gāmo dūre ahaṃ ekkā || atra vidhiniṣedhayoranabhidhāne ahamekākinī grāmo dūra iti viviktopadeśānnitambavāso'pi me varaiti vidhiḥ patīyate | kkacidavidhiṣedhe niṣedho yathā jīvitāśā balavatī dhanāśā durbalā mama | gacchavā tiṣṭhyā kānta svāvasthā tu niveditā || atra gacchavā tiṣṭhavetyavidhiniṣedhājjīvitāśā balavatī | dhanāśā durbalā mameti vacanāttvayā vinā'haṃ jīvituṃ na śaknomītyupakṣepeṇa gamananiṣedhaḥ pratīyate | kkacidvidhiniṣedhayorvidhyantaraṃ yathā ṇiadaiadaṃsaguṇakidavattapahiaaṇṇeṇadañcasuvaheṇa | gahapaidhūādukkaṃ ghavā urāihahaamāme || atrānyena pathā vrajeti vidhiniṣedhayorabhidhāne he svakāntābhirūpatāvikatthana pānthābhirūpaka iha grāme bhavato gṛhapatisutā draṣṭavyarūpeti vidhyantaraṃ pratīyate | kkacidvidhiniṣedhayorniṣedhāntaraṃ yathocchiṇasu paḍiakusumaṃ mādhuṇa sehāliaṃ haliasuhṇe | esa avasāṇāviraso sasureṇa suo valaasaddo || atra patitaṃ kusumamuñcinu mā dhunīhi śephālikāmiti vidhiniṣedhayorabhidhāne sakhi cauryarataprasakte valayaśabdo na kartavyaṃ iti niṣedhāntaraṃ pratīyate | kkacidvidhāvanubhayaṃ yathā saṇiaṃvañcakisoarivahivaatteṇavavavasusahipaṭṭedi | bhajjihisivitthaatyaṇivihiṇā dukkheṇaṇimmaviā || atra śanaivrrajeti vidhyabhidhāne hi na vidhirnāpi niṣedhaḥ, api tu varṇanāmātraṃ pratīyate | kkacinniṣedhe'nubhayaṃ yathā de ā pasiaṇi vattasu muhasasijohṇāviluttatamaṇivahe | ahisāriāṇa vigdhaṃ karesi ahṇāṇavihaāse || atra nivartasveti niṣedhābhidhāne'pi na niṣedho nāpi vidhiḥ, api tu mukhendukāntivarṇanāmātraṃ pratīyate | kkacidvidhiniṣedhayoranubhayaṃ yathā vañca mahavvia ekkā ehoṃtuṇisāsaroiappāi | mā tujjavi tīa viṇā dakkhiṇṇa dṛassa jāantu || atra mamaiva niśvāsaroditavyāni bhavantu mā tavāpi tāṃ vinā tāni jāyantāmiti vidhiniṣedhayorabhidhāne na vidhirnāpi niṣedhaḥ, api tu kṛtavyalīkapriyatamopālambhamātraṃ pratīyate | kkacidavidhiniṣedhe'nubhayaṃ yathā golāṇaīe tūhe cakhaṃtorāi āevattāi | atra na vidhirnāpi niṣedho'bhidhīyate | nāpyenayo ... ranyaketuku ṭuṃge abhyāgāto bhavānna gata iti taṃ jñāpayatīti pratīyate | pratīyamānābhidhīyamānavākyārthānāmānantyāddhvaniparūpamapyanekaprakārameva | dhvaniśca dvidhārthadhvaniḥ, śabdadhvaniśca | tayorarthadhvaniranunādadhvanirūpaḥ pratiśabdadhvanirūpaśca | tatra yo'bhidhīyamānavākyārthānusyūtameva kāṃsyānunādarūpamarthāntara .... śikhiriṇi kkanu nāma kiyañciraṃ kimabhidhānamasāvakarottapaḥ | taruṇi yena tavādharapāṭalaṃ daśati bimbaphalaṃ śukaśābakaḥ || atra yathāśrutavākyārtho'bhidhīyamāno vimbaphalāruṇādhara ityupalakṣaṇena rāgātiśayaṃ pratyāyayannālpapuṇyastvadadharapratinidhimapi cumbatīti cāṭunā varṇanīyāyāḥ svānurāgaprakāśanaṃ dhvanati | etañca kāṃsyadhvanivadavicchinnameva dhvannanunādarūpaṃ pratīyata ityanunādadhvaniḥ | tathā śāntyai vo'stu kapāvadāma jagatāṃ patyaryadīyāṃ lipiṃ kkāpikkāpi gaṇāḥ paṭhanti padaśo nātiprasiddhākṣarām | viśvaṃ srakṣyati kakṣyati kṣitimapāmīśiṣyate śiṣyate nāgai rāgiṣuraṃsyati ... jagannirvekṣita ................ || atra gaṇāḥ kapālalipimaprasiddhākṣarāṃ pajaśaḥ paṭhantīti vākyārtho'bhidhīyamānastāni kapālāni brahmādīnāmiti pratyāyayan mahādhvopasaṃhāre bhagavato'nupahataprabhāvasyaikākino'vasthānamiva dhvanati | tañca viśvaṃ srakṣyatītyādipadārthenasyūtamevānunādayannirūpyata ityanunādadhvaniḥ | evaṃ aṇṇatta vañcabālaa majjatiṃ kīsa maṃ puloesi | eaṃ ho jāyābhūruāṇaṃ titthaṃ piā ṇahoi||| (aṇṇatta vañca bālaa tihṇāanta kīsamaṃpuloesi | eam ho jāābhīruaṇā tṛhāṇa titthaṃ a ṇahoi || iti pāṭhaḥ || atra kiṃ māṃ majjantīṃ pralokayasi, anyatra vraja, nedaṃ jāyabhīrūṇāṃ tīrthamityābhidhīyamāno jāyāyāstvaṃ bibheṣi, tena māṃ na kāmayasa ityupālambhārthaṃ pratyāyayannasnehaṃ vinā yuvatīnāmīṣryayitaṃ bhavatīti dhvanati | tañca tasyā anurāgārthaṃ nātisyūtamevāmunādarūpaṃ dhvanatītyanunāddhavaniḥ | evaṃ attā ettha ṇimajjai ityādi vākye niṣedhavidhiḥ pratīyamānaḥ kadācidayamandhakāre madbhrāntyā śvaśrūṃpratiyāyādityutprekṣamāṇāyāḥ skhalitapratividhānarūpaṃ rātryandhapadābhidhānamapi na yuvatyā vaidagdhyaṃ dhvanayati | tañcābhidhīyamānapratīyamānayoranusyūtema pratīyata ityanunādadhvāniḥ | tathā mahuehi kiṃ vipaṃthaa ityādāvavidhiniṣedhe vidhiḥ pratīyamāno madhukāpacāyukāyāḥ prarthanāvaidagdhyaṃ dhvaniti | tañca pratīyamānārthānisyūtamevānunādamihopalabhyata ityununādadhvaniḥ | api ca, uñciṇasupaḍiakusumaṃ mādhuṇasehāliaṃ halia ityādi vākye vidhiniṣedhayorniṣedhaḥ pratīyamānaḥ sśalitagopaneṣu sakhīvaidagdhyaṃ dhvanayati | sa ca śephalikāpuṣpāpacayavyājena paścādvāṭamupagatāyā hālikasnuṣāyāstatrāgenopapatinā saha pravṛtte cauryaratakalahe kuḍyāntaritaśaavaśurāvakaṇryamānamanoharavalayaśabda pratiṣedhaparatayā pravartamānaḥ snuṣānusyūtameva śephālikāśākhāvadhūnanaṃ savalayakarāvadhūnanaṃ ca kāṃsyadvanirūpeṇānunādo dhvaniṃ pratipādayannanunādadhvanivyapadeśamāsādayatīti | yaḥ punarabhidhīyamānavākyārthāte pṛthagbhūta iva guhādipratiśabdānurūpamarthāntaraṃ pratyāyayanpratidhvanati sa pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | yathā lāvaṇyasindhuraparaiva hi keyamatra yatrotpalāni śaśinā saha saṃplavante | unmajjati dviradakumbhataṭī ca yatra yatrāpare kadalikāṇḍaḍḍatdhmṛṇāladaṇḍāḥ || guhāyāṃ paurūṣādiśabdānāṃ pratiśabdā jāyante, te ca dhvaniṃ janayanta upalabhyante | evaṃ lāvaṇyasindhurityetāsmin padārthe utpalādiśabdānāṃ yathā svopabheyalojacanādyarthapratiśabdā jāyante te cārthāntaradhvaniṃ janayanta upalabhyate | tatreha ca yathā śrūyamāṇānāmutpalādīnāmartho'bhidhīyamānastasya locanādyarthaiḥ saha sādṛśyaṃ pratyāyayadvarṇanīyāyāścārutvotkarṣapratītidhrvanati | sā tataḥ pṛthagivopalabhyamānā pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | tathaiṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet | yajeta vā'śvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjeta || atra bahavaḥ putrā eṣṭavyā iti vākyārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ putraiḥ pitṛvyapadeśaparatayā kartavyā iti pratyāyatpitṛṇāṃ kāmūparaṇāṃ paramapuruṣārtha iti dhvanayati | sa ca pitṛvyapadeśaparatayā pravattaḥ putroddeśarūpeṇa tatpravṛttiṣu pratiśabdāyamānaḥ pṛthagivopalabhyata iti pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | evaṃ kassa va ṇa hoi roso daddṛṇa piāe savvaṇaṃ aharaṃ | sabharamakamasugghāriṇi vāriagāme sahasu ehṇa || atra sakhyapīlambhārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ patyurīṣryopaśāntaye bhramareṇāsyā adharaḥ khaṇḍiḍḍatdhto nopapatineti pratyāyayan | skhalitagopaneṣu sakhīvaidagdhyaṃ dhvanayati| sa cānyopadeśaparatvena pravṛtto'nyasya cetasi pratiphalita iti pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | evaṃ bhamadhasmiavīsaddho ityādivākye vidhau niṣedhaḥ pratīyamānaḥ tasyā nadīkuñjakena krenacitsaha saṅketārthaṃ dhvanati | sa vākyārthātpṛthagivopalabhyamānaḥ pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | āsāiaṃ aṇāe ṇajhattiamityādivākye vṛṣanivāraṇaparo niṣedha upapatinivāraṇārthaṃ pratyāyayanprayokturvaidagdhyaṃ dhvanayati | sacānyābhidhānenānyamabhidadhataḥ pṛthagivopalabhyamānaḥ pratiśabdadhvaniḥ | evaṃ golāṇaīatūhe cakkantorāi āevattai ityāpi pratiśabdadhvaniriti | evaṃ śabdadhvanirapi dvidhaiva | tatrānunādarūpo yathā bhaktiprahvāya dātuṃ mukulapucakuṭīkoṭarakrīḍaḍḍatdhlīnāṃ lakṣmīmākraṣṭukāmā iva kamalavanoddhāṭanaṃ kurvate ye | lālākārāndhakārānanapatitajagatsādhvasadhvaṃsakalyāḥ kalyāṇaṃ vaḥ kriyāssuḥ kisalayarucayaste karā bhāskarasya || atra bhāskarakarāḥ kalyāṇaṃ vaḥ kriyāsuriti vākyārthaḥ karaśabdaśaktisvabhāvyāt kisalayarucaya ityādisamastulyaviśeṣaṇayogāñca hasteṣvanunādaṃ janayat bhagavatastejorūpatāṃ puruṣarūpatāṃ ca dhvayati | tadubhayamapi tadanusyūmeveha nirūpyata ityanunādhvaniḥ | evaṃ garbheṣaavambhoruhāṇāṃ śikhariṣu ca śitāgreṇaॉṣu tulyaṃ patantaḥ prārambhe vāsarasya vyuparatisamaye caikarūpāstathaiva | niṣparyāyaṃ pravṛttāsribhuvanabhavanāprāṅkaṇe pāntu yuṣmā nūṣmāṇaṃ santatādhvaśramajamiva bhṛśaṃ bibhrato bradhnapādāḥ || atra pādaśabdasvābhāvyāt sarvamapi yojanīyam | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ | pūrvatra sādhamryadvāreṇeha tu vaidhamryadvāreṇeti | atra cāpratiśabdadhvaniryathā dattānandāḥ prajānāṃ samucitasamayākliṣṭasṛṣṭaiḥ payobhiḥ pūrvāhṇe viprakīrṇā diśidiśi viramatyahni saṃhārabhājaḥ | dīptāṃśordīrghaduḥ khaprabhavabhayodanvaduttāranāvo gāvo vaḥ pāvanānāṃ paramaparimitāṃ prītimutpādayantu || atra pādaśabdasvābhāvyāt sarvamapi yojanīyam | iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ | pūrvatra sādhamryadvāreṇeha tu vaidhamryadvāreṇeti | atra cāpratiśabdadhvaniryathā dattānandāḥ prajānāṃ samucitasamayākliṣṭasṛṣṭaiḥ payobhiḥ pūrvāhṇe viprakīrṇā diśidiśi viramatyahni saṃhārabhājaḥ | dīptāṃśordīrghaduḥ khaprabhavabhavayodanvaduttāranāvo gāvoḥ vaḥ pāvanānāṃ paramaparimitāṃ prītimutpādayantu || atra dīptāṃśorgāvo raśmayaḥ stūyamānāḥ śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāttulyaviśeṣaṇayogāñca dhenuṣu pratiśabdaṃ janayantyastāsvapi viśiṣṭaṃ māhātmyaśeṣaṃ pratidhvananti | evaṃ mīlañcakṣurvijihya śrutijaḍaḍḍatdhrasanaṃ nighnitaghrāṇavṛtti svavyāpārākṣamatvakparimuṣitamanaḥ śvāsamātrāvaśeṣam visrastāṅgaṃ patitvā svapadapaharatādaśritaṃ vo'rkajanmā kālavyālāvalīḍhaṃ jagadagada ivotthāpayan prākpratāpaḥ || atrārkajanmā prākpratāpaḥ kālavyālāvalīḍhaṃ jagadutthāpayan aśritaṃ vo'paharatāditi vākyārthaḥ | arkaśabdaśaktisvābhāvyāttulyakarmakriyāpadādiyogāñca arkavṛkṣajanmā agadaḥ kālavyāladaṣṭamapyutthāpayatīti pratyāyayannarko viṣadhnānāṃ śreṣṭha iti pratiśabdarūpaṃ dhvanimutthāpayatīti | evamanye'pi mahākaviprayogeṣu dhvaniviśeṣā gaveṣaṇīyā iti yaduktaṃ, tātparyameva vacasi dhvanirena kāvya ityādi | kaḥ punaḥ kāvyavacasodhrvanitātparyayoḥ viśeṣaḥ | nanūktaṃ purastād yadadakraṃ vacaśśāsre loke ca vaca eva tat | vakraṃ yadarthavādādau tasya kāvyamiti smṛtiḥ || yadibhiprāyasarvasvaṃ vakturvākyātpratīyate | tātparyamarthadharmastacchabdadharmaḥ punadhrvaniḥ || saubhāgyamiva tātparyamāntaro guṇa iṣyate | vāgdevatāyā lāvaṇyamiva bāhyastayodhrvaniḥ || adūraviprakarṣāttu dvayena dvayena dvayamucyate | yathā surabhivaiśākhau madhumādhavasaṃjñayā || iti || satyamuktam | kintu nādyāpi nidarśanataḥ pratipādyate | tarhi śrūyatāmidaṃ pratipādayāmaḥ | yastāvadayamanantarograntaḥ sa sarvaḥ kāvye dhvanirityavadhāryatām | vacasi tātparyaṃ dvidhā śāstre soke ca | tatra śāstre yathātmasthitaṃ guṇāviśeṣamahaṅkṛtasyetyādi | atra “ātmasthitaṃ guṇaviśeṣamahaṅkṛtasya śṛṅgāramāhuriha jīvitamātmayoneḥ ||” ityāptopadeśarūpa āgamaḥ tasyātmaśaktirasanīyatayā rasatvamiti saṃjñārthānugāmi pratyātmavedanīyaṃ pratyakṣam | tathāhi yo'yaṃ loke raso'syastīti sariko'yaṃ, rasiko'yamiti vinā madhurādīnkeṣucideva puruṣaviśeṣeṣu nirapavādaḥ pravādaḥ sa nāntareṇa pratyātmavedanīyaṃ rasāhṛyavastusambandhamupapadyate | so'yaṃ vivakṣitārthasya pramāṇatrayeṇa pratipādanaṃ vākyārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ pratipādyaśca triprakāraḥ puruṣo bhavati | apratipanno vipratipannaḥ saṃśayita iti, tatra yathā''turānātuyorbhojanamanāturaḥ pratipadyata iti tathaiva prakalpyate | tathehāpratipannānurodhāditarayorapyāgama eva prathamamupanyastate | tatra vipratipannaḥ saṃśayito vāgaṃmaṃ na manyate | atastadarthe sarvapramāṇebhyo balīyaḥ pratyakṣamupanyasanīyaṃ bhavati, tadapi vaiyātyādvipratipanno na manyate| tato'sya śāsanāya brahmāstrarūpā sārvasaukikī yuktirupanyasyata iti | sa eva pramāṇatrayopanyāsaheturvakturabhiprāyaḥ pratīyamānaḥ pramāṇatrayopanyāsādinā ca sāṅkhyādarśanāśrayeṇa śṛṅgārassannevāvirbhavati | natvasannutpadyate, sa ca trividho'śreyāniti pratipādanatātparyam | sāṅkhyā hyevamāhuḥ, “sadevotpadyate, prakṛtireva katrrī, puruṣaḥ punarudāste, udāsīnamapi cainaṃ bhogasaṃpādanāya prakṛtirupasarpatīti |” nanu ca sāṅkhyānāṃ “dṛṣṭamanumānamāptavacanaṃ ceti” pramāṇopanyāsakramaḥ | iha tvāgamasya prathamamupanyāse kiṃ tātparyam nanūktamapratipannānurodhāditi | anyadapyucyate, na tathā padārthāḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratīyamānāḥ svadante yathā vāgmināṃ vacobhirāvedyamānā ityāgamasya prathamamupanyāsena sūcayati | na ca sarvathā sāṅkhyādarśanāśrayiṇo vayamiti pramāṇavyutkrameṇa pratipādayati, sāhityasya sarvapārṣadatvāt | athātmani pratibimbatādvāreṇāvasthitasyāhaṅkāraguṇaviśeṣasya dharmārthaphalabhūtatṛtīyapuruṣārthajīvitasya śṛṅgārasyābhimānāparanāmno yānyāvirbhāvakāraṇāni yāni ca tatkāryāṇi tānyanantaraślokena nirdiśati sattvātmanāmamalajanmaviśeṣajanmetyādi | tatrāyamātmanāmanugatebyaḥ sukṛtaviśeṣebhya utpadyate, utpannasya sarvasyātmā ātmaguṇasampado lakṣmaॉyamāṇalakṣaṇāyā udayaheturbhavati | anekajanmānubhavajanitāttu saṃskārādutkṛṣyate | utkṛṣṭaścātmaguṇasampada eva atiśayaheturbhavati | sa cāyameka evaivaṃvidho'bhimānātmā prakṛtivikāra ātmaviśeṣāṇāṃtamonirbhedasthāneṣu pratibimbarūpeṇa suptaiva pratibudhyata iti vākyārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ ekaheturityanena ca hetvantarābhāvamātmaguṇasampadaḥ pradharśayan ayameva caturvargakāraṇamiti jñāpayati | jāgartiṃ vā jāgarti ca suptaprabodhadṛṣṭāntena tasyānāvirbāvāvasthāyāmapi stimitarūpeṇāvasthānādavidyamānatāṃ nirākaroti | ko'pītyanenādbhutapradarśanadvāreṇa tadutkarṣasvasajjanmasahasreṇāpyanākhyeya iti khyāpayati | mānamaya ityanena cāsyābhimāna ātmanobhimāna eva mūlamityanyāvaṣṭambhaṃ nirācaṣṭa iti | so'yamevaṃ prakāro vākyarthaḥ pratīyamāna evaṃvidhaṃ vastu vayaṃca vaktumudyatāḥ | ataścaturvargārthino'pi pravartantāmiti śrotṛjanaprotsāhanādasminvacasi tātparyamiti | evaṃ laukike'pi vacasyabhidhīyamānaṃ pratīyamānaṃ tātparyaṃ ca paryālocanīyamiti | etena kāvyavacasodhrvanitātyaryayośca kkacitsamplavo'pi vyākhyātaḥ | tadyāthācchinnamekhalamalabdhadṛḍhopagūḍhamityādi | atra kāvyārthastāvat kāntāvimiśravapiṣaḥ purārervapuracchinnamekhalamityādiviśeṣaṇayogādvipralambhasambhogayoḥ sakhyasampādakaminavetyutprekṣamāṇaṃ rakṣatviti vākyārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ kāntāvimiśravapuṣovapirityanena mūrtirevāsya sāṃsārikeṣu karmasvadhikriyate na punarātmeti pratyāyayati | mūrtiriti ca vaktavye vapuriti padopādānānnakevalaṃ viśvasya rakṣaṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoravyayameva vyāpriyata iti pratipādayati | vapirhi sṛṣṭau saṃhāre ca dṛśyate, bījaṃ vapati, keśānvapatīti | kṛtavipralambhasambhogasakhyamivetyanena sahānavasthānādibhirdurghaṭānapyayaṃ padārthānmithoghaṭayatīti jñāpayatīti | purārerityanena ca kāntāvimiśravapurapyevaṃvidheṣvarivadhādivyāpāreṣu samartha eveti | satyāpayati, so'yamevaṃ prakāro vākyārthaḥ pratīyamānaḥ | tadevaṃ prakāramapāramananyasādhāraṇaṃ ca yasyaiśvaryamasāveva namaskāryo nānya iti tātparyārthaḥ |evamuttaraśloke'pi yathāśrutavākyārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ yatpādapaṅkajarajaḥ parimārjiteṣviti prayojakavyāpāro darśanāddhyānenānīya gaṇapatirmanasyāropaṇīya ityupadiśati | cetassu darpaṇatalāmalatāṃ gateṣvatyanena cādarśatalānīva bhasmanā smṛtyapahitenāpi tatpādarajasā manāṃsi nirmalībhavantītyabhidhatte | śabdārthasampada udāratarāḥ sphurantītyanena tu darpaṇataleṣviva nirmaseṣvamīṣu viśve padārthāḥ sphurantītyāvedayati | vighnacchide'stu bhagavān sa gaṇādhinātha ityanena punarupanyastanyāyenābhigāmikaṃ guṇayogamasyopadarśayan avighnaprārthanayā cikrīrṣitaṃ mahāntamārambhaviśeṣamātmanaḥ pratipādayati | so'yamevaṃvidho vākyārthaḥ pratīyamānaḥ yasya pādapaṅkajasmṛterapyetatphalaṃ tasya sākṣādārādhanādeḥ kimucyata iti tātparyārthaḥ || athedameva ślekadvayaṃ śāstrādau vacorūpeṇa tātparyaparyantaṃ vyākriyate| tatrābhīṣṭajevatā stotavyeti śiṣṭacāraḥ | tato hi viśiṣṭādṛsampatteḥ samīhitaphalāvāptirbhavati | abhīṣṭadevatā ca dvividhādhikṛtā'nadhikṛtāca | tatrādhikṛtā'nadhikṛtayoradhikṛtāyāṃ pratipattirgarīyasītyadhikṛtaiṛ stūyate | śāstre ceha śṛṅagaro'bhidheyaḥ, tatra ca yathā bhagavānmaheśvaraḥ sarvajñatayā saubhāgyena dayitajānitayā svātantryeṇa paramaparipūrṇatayā samarthatvena cādhikriyate naivamanyastadvidheyavaibhavaḥ śakādi | tatra ca prāgukta eva pratīyamānaḥ, tātparyarūpastu nirūpyate | tatreha śāstre śṛṅgāro vaktavyaḥ | sa dvidhā sambhogo vipralambhaśca | tatra sambhogo vipralambhamantareṇa na prakarṣamadhirohatīti vipralambha eva prathamamabhidheyo bhavati | sa caturdhā prathamānurāgo mānaḥ pravāsaḥ karuṇa iti | vicitraścaiṣa sambhogāditi vistareṇocyate | catasraścāsyāvasthā bhavanti sattā janma anubandhaḥ prakarṣa iti | tamimaṃ caturbhedaṃ caturavasthaṃ vicitraṃ ca pūrvārdhena vakṣyamāṇamupalakṣayati | tatrācchinnamekhalamityanena prathamānurāgaṃ, mekhalācchedāvadhirhi prathamānurāgaḥ, alabdhadṛḍhopagūḍhamityanena mānaṃ, nahimāne dṛḍhopagūḍhaṃ labhyate | aprāptacumbanetyanena karuṇaṃ, nahi karuṇe vaktrakāntirvīkṣyate || athaitadavasthāsvapīmānyeva padāni | tatrācchinnamekhalamiti vipralambhasattāyāṃ | vipralambho hi mekhalāyāmacchinnāyāmavaśyameva sambhogārthinaḥ sambhavati, sāsya prathamāvasthā | alabdhadṛḍhopagūḍhamiti vipralambhajanmani vipralambhavān hi mekhalācchedāt sambhogamalabhamānaḥ preyasīṃ prārthayate, ayipriyatame, yadi me mekhalācchedaṃ na manyase tadāliṅganamapi gāḍhaṃ prayaccha, tadapratipadyamānāyāṃ ca tasyāmasya vipralambho jāyate, sāsya dvitīyāvasthā | aprāptacumbanamiti vipralamambhānubandhe vipralabdho hi sarvāṅgīṇaṃ priyāsaṃśloṣamalabhamānaḥ vaktramātrasaṃyogamapyabhilaṣaci | tadalābhe cainaṃ vipra lambho'nubandhanāti, sāsya tṛtīyāvasthā || avīkṣitavaktrakāntīti vipralambhaprakarṣe apekṣaṇīyāliṅganādyanavāptau hi kāminaḥ priyāmikhāvalokanamapi bahu manyante | tadapyanāpnuvatāmeṣāṃ vipralambhaḥ prakṛṣyate | sāsya turīyāvasthā || so'yaṃ caturvidhaścaturavasthaśca vipralambhaścāturvidhyena cāturavasthyena pṛthakpṛthagabhidhīyamāno vicitra ityucyate | sambhogo'pi caturdhaiva prathamānarāgānantaro mānānantaraḥ, pravāsānantaraḥ, karuṇānantara iti | tasyāpi tā eva catastro'vasthāḥ sattājanmānubandhaḥ prakarṣa iti | so'yamapi caturbhedaścaturavasthaśca kāntāvimiśravapuṣa ityanenāpi citrātvātsaṃkṣeṇaivopalakṣyate | tatra vyupasargasya kriyāviśeṣaṇārthavācakatvādyena yena viśeṣeṇa prathamānurāgānantare mānānantare karuṇānantare ca kāntayā saha miśrībhāvaḥ sādhvasotkampaḥ seṣryākaṣāyaṃ sautsukyarabhasaṃ saharṣavismayaṃ ca jāyate | sa sarva uddiṣṭo bhavati | so'yaṃ vimiśrapadena sambhogaścanurvidho'pyākṣiptaḥ | kāntāpadena punarasya catasro'vasthāpyante | tatra yadā kāntāśabdaḥ strīparyāyastadā nāmāpi strīti saṃhlādi vikarotyeva mānasam | iti saṃbhogasyādyāvasthā sattāsaṃjñikā pratīyate | yadātu kāntāśabdo manojñāparyāyastādā “kiṃ purdarśanaṃ tasyā vilāsollasitabhruvaḥ” iti nyāyātsambhogasya dvitīyāvasthā janmasaṃjñikā pratīyate | yadā punaḥ kāntāśabdo vṛṣasyantīparyāyastadā punarapi sulabhaṃ tapo'nurāgī yuvagijanaḥ khalu nāpyate'nurūpaḥ | iti nyāyātsambhogasya tṛtīyānasthānubandhasaṃjñikā pratīyate | yadeva rocate mahyaṃ tadeva kurute priyā | iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā || iti nyāyātsambhogasya turīyāvasthā prakarṣasaṃjñikā prītayate | so'yaṃ caturbhedaścaturavasthaśca viprasambhaḥ | sambhogaścāgrato viśeṣeṇa varṇayitumupakrānto diṅbhātreṇātra sūcita iti tātparyam || athātra viśeṣādhikārinirṇāyakaviśeṣāṇāṃ kā vārtā? kāntāvimiścavapiṣa itsaya tantreṇa vyākhyānāntare te'pi sūcitā eva | tatra hi bhagavato vipurvupralambhamaṃmbhogayoḥ kṛtasāhāyyakamiva kāntāvimiśravapuṣaḥ puruṣān striyaśca pātviti vyakhyā bhavati | vimiśraśabdena ca seyogina iva viyogino'pyucyante, vyupasargasya kriyāviśeṣa iva kriyāvaiparītye'pyupalambhāt | tadyāthā vibhakto viyuktāśca śṛṅgārādhikāraṇa ubhaye'pi nāyakaviśeṣāḥ puruṣāḥ kāntairavimiśravapuṣo yoṣitaḥ saṃyuktā vuyuktāśca śṛṅgārādhikāriṇa ubhaye'pi nāyakaviśeṣāḥ pratīyante | vapuśśabdena punariha purārerapi viśeṣaṇapakṣe yauvanapallavitalāvaṇyalakṣmīkaṃ samagrātmaguṇasampadāśrayaḥ śarīramucyate | na tu devādikartṛvatsṛṣṭisaṃhārakādi vapurhi sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoriva kāntāvapi dṛśyate | tadyathā gobhi rvapāvānvapuṣṭaṃ mānāmāpsaro viśeṣa, iti | tatrācchinnamekhalamityādīni kāntāvimiśravapuṣa iti samāsapadāntargatayorvibhaktisaṃyuktikriyayorgamakatvādviśeṣaṇāni bhavanti | yathā kartumanāḥ kaṭaṃ, gantukāmo grāmamiti || atha sambhogapakṣe acchinnamekhalamityādīni kathaṃ sambandhante? ucyate | evaṃ nāmarāgāndhatayā kāntabhiḥ saha te saṃyuktāḥ yena mekhalācchedamāliṅganaṃ cumbanamālokanaṃ ca paramānandamagnāḥ kartuṃ na parārayanti, tadyathā priyayā striyā pariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiñcana veda nāntaramiti, yathā ca dhanyāḥ stha yāḥ kathayatha priyasaṅgame'pi visrabdhacāṭukaśatāni ratāntareṣu | norvīṃ prati praṇihite tu kare priyeṇa sakhyaḥ śapāmi yadi kiñcidapi smarāmi || evamayaṃ prathamaślokaṃ | padāntayeva saṃhatyārthamabhidadhati vākyamiti pakṣe vyākhyāyate | athākhaṇḍhavākyārthapakṣe vyākhyāyate | tathāhyevamiha padānāmanvayo bhavati, pātu kiṃ? viśvam | kutaḥ? apāyebhyaḥ | kiṃ tat? vapuḥ | kasya? purāreḥ kīdṛśasya? kāntāvimiśravapiṣaḥ | kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ? acchinnamekhalaṃ, alabdhadṛḍhopagūḍhaṃ, aprāptacumbanaṃ, avīkṣitavaktrakānti | kathamutprekṣyamāṇaṃ? kṛtavipralambhasambhogasakhyamiveti | atra cāyamacchinnaśabdo bahuvīhiśca samāso'dhyāhiyamāṇapadadvayā dvādaśapadā nāndī padāviśleṣaviśeṣoktigarbha utprekṣāvāṃścāśīralaṅkāro maṅgalārthaḥ | te'mī catvāro’pi maṅgalārthāḥ śāstrādau prayuktāḥ kartuḥ śroturadhyeturadhyāpayutuśca maṅgamāvahanti | yadāha maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāvi maṅgalāntāni ca śāstrāṇyavyāhataprasarāṇi āyuṣmacchrotṛkāṇi ca bhavanti | nanu ca neha viśvamapāyebhya iti karmāpādāpadayoḥ śravaṇamasti | tatkathamiveyaṃ dvādaśapadā nāndīti? ucyate, pātvitī śrutipadametat śruteścānekapadanibandhana ekaśabdaviṣayo vidhyādirarthaḥ sa cānyathānupapadyamānaḥ svasiddhaye karmakaraṇakatrradhikaraṇādikaṃ yadāścānekapadanibandhana ekaśabdaviśaṣayo vidhyādirarthaḥ, cānyathānupapadyamānaḥ svasiddhaye karmakaraṇakatrradhikaraṇādikaṃ yadākṣipati sa sarvaśrutipadārtho bhavati | tatropādīmupādīyamānaṃ kartṛkarmādikaṃ niyamāyānupādāya vā vijñāyate | tadyathā sāmānyākṣepe viśeṣapadamupādīyamānaṃ niyamāya bhavati | pātu vaḥ paramajyotiriti viśeṣākṣepe tatra tadanupādāya vujñāyate devo jalaṃ varṣatīti | ihatu yathāṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhṇamupanayīta, tamadhyāpayediti vacanāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavya ityatra dvijenācāryādityanupāttamapyavaśyameva sannidhīyate, tathehāpyapāyanirharaṇarūpatvātpātvarthasya sthite'pīśvarakartṛkasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoriva viśvaviṣayatvādapāyebhyo viśvamiti padadvayamanupādīyamānamapi niyamena sannidhīyate || nanu cāśarīriṇe maheśvasya viśvotpattisthitipralayakāramatvābhyupagame'pi kathamivocyeta vapuḥ pātviti | aśarīriṇo'pi vaiśvarūpyeṇa tadupapatteḥ | sahyevaṃ tattvavidbhiḥ stūyate mūlajālamadhibhoktṛcetanā śaktayastvadabhibhoktṛsaṃhatiḥ | jñānametadadhināyakavrajastvatsmṛtau yugapadeva bhāsate || ata eva kāntavimiśravapuṣa iti purārerviśeṣaṇaṃ tantreṇānyathā vyātakṣate | tadyathā kaṃ pānīyamante'syā iti kāntā pṛthvī, kaṃ sukhamanteṣvāsāmiti kāntā āpaḥ | ko vāyurante asyeti kāntovahniḥ | kaṃ toyamantariti kānto vāyuḥ | kaṃ brahma ante'syeti kāntamākāśam, kāntirdīptistadatiśayavān kāntaḥ sūryaḥ, kāntiḥ kamanīyakaṃ tadatiśayavāṃścandramāḥ, kāntirvāllabhyaṃ tadatiśayavān kānta ātmeti kāntaśabdenāṣṭāpi bhagavato mūrtaya ucyante | tā avantītyevaṃ śīlābhavograbhīmādayo mūrtipatayaḥ kāntavinaḥ | miśraśabdaḥ pūjāvacanaḥ | tenaiṣāṃ praśasāvacanaiścetyārthamiśrādivat samāsaḥ | tataḥ kāntāvimiśraṃ vapuryasyeti | bahuvrīhau vaiśvarūpyasiddhervikṣitārthasiddhiḥ || athātrācchinnamekhalamityādīnāṃ kathamanvayaḥ? tānyapi vapuṣo viśeṣaṇāni bhavanti | tatrācchinnamekhalamityanena paramucyate | mekhalā hi jaghanaparikṣepasūtram, tadaparicchinnaṃ yasyeti | alabdhadṛḍopagūḍhamityanenāgādhatvasya duravagāhatvamākhyāyeta, duṃhatīti dṛḍha ādhārastasyopagūḍhamupaśleṣaḥ pratiṣṭhāsthānaṃ, tadanupalabdhaṃ yasyeti | aprāptayumbanamityanenoñcaiṣṭvasya parisūkṣmatvamabhidhatte | vaktā kutastyākutomukhīvetyavijñāyamānā kāntiryasyeti, kṛtavipralambhasambhogasakhyamivetyanena tvavijñātaparamārthatvena vipralabhamānamiva pṛthivyādiprasiddharūpatayā saṃbhujyamānaṃ saṃbhuñjānamiva ca, tadevocyate yaditthamenamāhur tvameva havyaṃ hotā ca bhojyaṃ bhoktā ca śāśvatam | vedyaṃ vedayitā cāsi dhyatā dhyeyaṃ ca tatparam || ayamapyāha viditaṃ vo yathā svārthā na me kāścitpravṛttayaḥ | nanu mūrtibhiraṣṭābhiritthaṃ bhūto'smin sūcitaḥ || tadamunā viśeṣaṇapañcakenaitaduktaṃ bhavati ṇamahaavaḍḍḍitdhḍhaatuṃgaṃ avisāri avitthaṃ aaṇoṇaagahiraṃ | apyalahu parisaṅṇaṃ aṇāaparamatthapāaḍaṃ, mahumahaṇaṃ || nanu ca pātviti nāyaṃ vidhau loṭ, apitvāśiṣi | sā ca viśeṣasyāśrutau svarūpādevātmaviṣayatayā tiṣṭhata iti kathaṃ viśvaviṣayā bhavati | ucyate’yaṃ nijaḥ paro veti vikalpo laghucetasām | udāraritānāṃ tu vasidhaiva kuṭumbakam || yaduvā nāsya vākyasya yaḥ kaścidvaktā, kiṃ tarhi pūrvajñaiḥ kramāgataviśvapālane niyukto mahāmaheśvaraḥ ko'pi puṃviśeṣaḥ | sa ca granthaviracanāvyagre mayi mābhūdvarṇāśrayamācārasthite vyākopa iti maheśvarameva tatsamrthaṃ prārthayate | ato'tra viśvasyaiva karmatvamavagamyate | rakṣito rājā rājyaṃ rakṣatīti ca nyāyādātmanyapi rakṣaṇīyatāśīrbhavati | ātmani tisraścaiṣaṇā bhavanti, prāṇaiṣaṇā vittaiṣaṇā paralokaiṣaṇā ca | rājño yāhyeva prāṇaiṣaṇā sā vitteṣaṇā saiva parasokaiṣaṇeti bhavati| tasya prakṛtikaṃ rājyaṃ śarīraṃ tadeva ca vittaṃ tsaya hyasau svāmyamanubhavati| yathoktadaṇḍaḍḍatdhkarādānādisambhṛtaṃ vasu yaśaśca vittaṃ saeva ca dharmaḥ tena hyasāvimamamuṃ ca lokaṃ jayati, tadetatsarvamapāyebhyo viśvarakṣayopahitaṃ bhavati| iṣṭā devatā stotavyeti śiṣṭācāraḥ, nacāśīsstutiḥ | evametat, kintu guṇotkarṣaprakāśanena sarvatra uparyāropaṇaṃ stutiḥ | sā ca yathā''śāsyamānābhimataphalaikahetutāprakāśanena pratyāyyata | naivaṃ, namastasmai sa jayatītyevamādibhirityābhiprāyaḥ || athākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhvākyārthapakṣāvalambino dvitīyaślokasya vyākhyā sa bhagavān gaṇādinātho vidhnācchide'stu yatpādapaṅkajarajaḥ parimārjiteṣu | cetastu darpaṇatalāmalatāṃ gateṣu śabdārthasampada udāratarāḥ sphuranti || iti || ihāpi paṅkajadarpaṇārthasampadbhagavadādayaḥ śabdāḥ gauṇīyavṛttyā maṅgalārthāḥ, iyamapi dvādaśapadā nāndyeva | ihāpi rupakopamaśleṣasamādhigarbhaḥ kāraṇamālāṅgavānāśīralaṅkāraḥ iti yojanīyaḥ | nanu ca sambandhino'dyāhārātrtrayodaśeha padāni | naivaṃ, vibhaktyādiparimāṇena śabdārthasampatpirasphuṇasyaivātra sambandhitvāt | tathāhyevamiyaṃ kāraṇamālā samāpyate | bhagavataḥ pādapaṅkajamārjane mārjanasya nairmalye nairmalyasya śabdasampadāmarthasampadāṃ ca parisphuraṇe tasya ca prabandhavidhnācchide kāraṇaṃ bhavatīti rūpakopamāśleṣapadāni ceha pādapaṅkajadarpaṇatalāmalarajāṃsi pratīyante | tatrodāratarā śabdārthasampadaḥ parisphurantīti ca samādhirapi prakāśate | ādarśataleṣu hi kilodāradarśanāḥ striyaḥ svalaṅkṛtamātmānamavalokayanti | etañca vakturudāravācāṃ sūcanāparamityavadhāryamāṇamasya vacasastātparye bhavati, tadidamuktaṃ tātparyameva vacasīti | kaḥ punariha rūpakopamayorviśeṣaḥ? ucyate | yatrātyantasādṛśyādabhedopacāreṇevādiśabdavikalamupamānapadamevopameye pravartamāne gauṇīṃ vṛttimanubhatsāmānādhikaraṇyena viśeṣaṇatvamanubhavati | tadrūpakam | yathā mukhacandraḥ, pādapaṅkajamiti | yatra tu mukhyānubhava rūpeyamātmanopameyasya sāmyamabhidhatte sopamā | yathā candra iva mukhamādarśatalāmalaṃ ceti || atha yatheṣadasamāptiprakṛtyobahuckalpabādayaḥ kanādayo vā atyantasādṛśyādupameyavṛttibhya evopamānaśabdebhyaḥ svārthikā vidhīyante tadā kimupamāne pratyaya āho upameya iti | kiñcātaḥ yadyupamāne guḍaḍḍatdhkalpā drākṣā kuśāgrīyā buddhirityupameyaliṅgaṃ na prāpnoti tadā upameye bahuguḍo drākṣā cañcā ca liṅgaṃ na prāpnoti | liṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvat | svārthakāśca kkacitprakṛtito liṅgavacanānyativartante, yathā deva eva devatā, catvāra eva varṇāścāturvaṇryamiti, kimekadvaktavyaṃ kathamanuktaṃ gamyate, ācāryakavidhāne ṇacaḥ striyāmañiti punaḥ strīgrahaṇaṃ karoti | abhedopacāreṇaiva ca prakṛtiliṅgavacanaṃ yā lummanuṣya iti lukamatikramya pratṛtivacanebhyo lupaṃ śāsti | kathaṃpunarīṣadaparisamāptāvive pratikṛtāviti ivārthe vā vidhīyamānaḥ pratyaya upamāna upameye vā śaṅkyeta? īṣadaparisamāpte kriyātvena ivārthe vā vidhīyamānaḥ pratyaya upamāna upameye vā śaṅkyeta? īṣādaparisamāptekriyātvena ivārthasyacāsattvabhūtatvena liṅgavacanāyogāt pratyayāntareṣu ca liṅgaṅkhyāvaśādīṣadaparisamāptau pratikṛtau cevārthe vā vartamānātprātipadikāt svārthe pratyayo bhavatīti vijñāyate vijñāyate | kiṃ punarihanyāyyaṃ upamāne pratyaya iti || nanu ca guḍa, ivāyaṃ guḍo drākṣā, cañcevāyaṃ puruṣa iti guḍādiśabdā mādhuryādiguṇayogena drākṣādiṣu vartante | tataśca drākṣādayaḥ prakṛtyarthā bhavanti | prakṛtyarthe copameye svārthikāḥ kalpabādaya iti kathamupamāne pratyaya iti | maivam, na hi drākṣāyāstatrāparisamāptirapi tu guḍaḍḍatdhsya | yena hi guṇena māduryādinā gujaśabdo drākṣāyāṃ vartamāno gauṇīṃ vṛttimanubhavati tasyaiveṣadasamāptau pratyaya vidhīyate | adyaivaṃ guḍaḍḍatdhsyeṣadaparisamāptau vartamānasya svārthe pratyayavidhānāt bahuguḍo drākṣeti | so'yamityabhisambandhādavyatirekaiti cedvyarekamūlatvādavyatirekasya pakṣe vyatirekaprasaṅgaḥ, yathā śuklaḥ paṭaḥ paṭasya śuklaiva | naivaṃ, upapadyamānavyatirekāṇāmubhayaṃ bhavati | nacātratadupapattiḥ, na hi yathā śuklaguṇo'stīti matublopādapṛthaksiddhaśuklaguṇavācinā śuklaśabdena paṭo'bhidhīyate, tathā guḍa, ityanena | sahi dravyaśabdo dravyāntarasāmānādhikaraṇyānyathānupapattyā gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśritya svamibandhanaṃ dravyāntare vyitarekamupanidhatte | tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃbhraśāt guṇavṛtterapi bhraṃśomābhūditi na vyatirekakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī bhavati | na ca guṇavacanānāmapi keṣāṃcilloke vyatireka upalabhyate | na hi bhavati paṭuḥ paṭukalpo'yaṃ devadattasyeti | kathaṃ punarguṇavṛttyāpyupameye vṛtterguḍaḍḍatdhśabdātsvārthe vidhīyamānaḥ pratyaya upamānaṃ pratyāyayati, dravyavat pravṛttinimittasyāpi svārthatvāt | tathā hi cañcā tṛṇamayaḥ puruṣo yaḥ kṣekṣarakṣaṇāya kriyate tasya ca puruṣe pravartamānasya svākāraḥ pravṛttinimittam | ataḥ ive pratikṛtāvitīvārthe tatraiva pratyayo bhavati || nanu ca yadi pratikṛtau vartamānāt prātipadikāt svārthe pratyayaḥ kimivārtha ityanena, athevārthekṛtaṃ pratikṛtāvityanena? ucyate, uparitaśabdanāṃ śaktimahimnaiva trayī gatirbhavati| kkacidivārtha eva svārthikaḥ kuśāgrīyā buddhiḥ śaileyaṃ dadhīti, kkacitapratikṛtāveva vāsidevo bhīmasena iti, kkacidivārthe pratikṛtau ca yathāvaroruḥ pīvaroruriti | atra yadi varaśabdena pīvaraśabdena vā ūrvoreva guṇo'bhidhīyate tadā ūrūttarapadādaupamye ityuṅ sidhyati | tataścaupamyāya kartavyo'tra yatnaḥ syāt | yadi varaśabdaḥ pīvaraśabdo vā vare pīvare ca rambhāstambhastamberamakarādau vartitvāttatsādṛśyāttadupameyayorūrvorvarteta tañcevārthe pratikṛtau vartamānāyostayoḥ pratyayalugvidhāne bhavati | anyathāhi varatvaṃ pīvaratvameva ca labhyate, na saṃsthānaviśeṣa iti na bhavitavyam | pratyayamantareṇāpi svasrādīnāmiva tasya tācchīlikāntatvena strītvābhidhānameva ṛnnebhyo ṅībityasya na ṣaṭsvasrādibhya iti pratiṣedhaḥ pratyākhyāyate | kiṃ punarabhīupamānaśabdā luptapratyayatvena guṇībhūtā eva kalpabādīnāmutpattinimittaṃ bhavanti | bāḍham | ajādi guṇavacanādevetyāto hi guṇavacanādityadhikriyate | tataśca bahuckalpabdeśyadeśīyara īṣadasamāptimevaṃ praśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap vidhīyamānaḥ pacati rūpaṃ pacato rūpaṃ pacanti rūpamita kriyālakṣaṇasya guṇasyaiva praśaṃsāṃ dyotayanti | anyathā hi sarvatraikavacanaṃ na syāt | na ca dravyasya samāptiḥ kutsā praśaṃsā vā svataḥ sambhavati, api tu guṇataḥ | ataśca gauṇyā mukhyā vā mandamadyotkṛṣṭeṣu guṇeṣu vartamānātprātipadikādīṣadasamāptau dyotyāyāṃ kalpabādayo bhavanti | nanu ca nijrñātasyārthasya samāptirasamāptirvā bhavati | guṇaśca nijrñātaḥ, lokato guṇasya nijrñanaṃ | tadyathā paṭurayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ | yo laghunopāyenārthaṃ nirvartayati, paṭukalpo'yaṃ yo nātilaghuneti | evaṃ paṭutaraḥ śuklatamaḥ kanīyānpaṭiṣṭhaḥ utkṛṣṭataraḥ vaiyākaraṇapāśaityādiṣu tarabādayo'pi guṇavacanebhyo vidhīyamānā guṇagatameva prakarṣaṃ dyotayanti | kathaṃ punariśāyanādau vidhīyamānāstarabādayo gumaprakarṣaṃ bhaviṣyanti, na punadrravyaprakarṣa iti, naivaṃ, dravyasya prakarṣaḥ saṃbhavati | kiṃ tarhi? guṇasya ca prakarṣo'sti, tasya prakarṣo bhaviṣyati? kathaṃ jñāyate guṇasyaiva prakarṣa iti? evaṃ hi dṛśyate loke samāna āyāme vistāre ca paṭasyānyo'rtho bhavati kāśikasyānyo mādhurasya guṇāntaraṃ khalvapi śilpinaḥ prakarṣāyotpādyamānastameva dravyāntareṇa prakṣālayantyanyena śuddhaṃ dhautaṃ kurvantyanena śephalikamanyena mādhyamikamiti | tarhi śuklātkṛṣṇo mābhūditi samānagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | na katavryam | spardhā vai prakarṣaḥ, sā ca samānaguṇā eva bhavati, na hyāḍhyābhirūpau spardete | pācakena khalpapyutpattavyam | na ca śuklātkṛṣṇe utpadyamāno vācakaḥ syāt | yatra tattasyāt, tatrotpadyata eva yathā śuklātkṛṣṇo bhāsuratara iti na tarhīdānīmidaṃ bhavati | adhvayurvai śreyān pāpīyān pratiprasthātā andhānāṃ kāṇatamī rājeti samānaguṇa evaiṣā spardhā | adhvaryurvai śreyānanyebhyaḥ praśastebhyaḥ pāpīyān pratiprasthātā anyebhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ kāṇatama iti, kaṇirayaṃ saukṣmyevartate | sarvaime kāṇāḥ kiñcitpaśyanti, ayaṃ tu kiñcidapi na paśyatitī kāṇatama ucyate | tasyādūraviprakarṣaṃ iti vaktavyam | sarṣapāddhimavato mahattvaṃ mābhūditi na vaktavyam | jananena yā prāpyate sā jātiḥ | na caitasyārthasya prakarṣāprakarṣai staḥ || atha śuklatara ityādiṣu kimekaṃ śauklayaṃ āhosvinnānā | kiñcātaḥ yadyekaḥ prakarṣo nopapadyate, nahi tenaiva tasya prakārṣo bhavati | atha nānā samānaguṇagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ śuklātkṛṣṇo mābhūditi ekaṃ śauklyaṃ tattu viśeṣavat, kiṃkuto viśeṣaḥ? alpatvabahutvakṛtaḥ, athavā punarastvekaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ ca | nanūktaṃ prakarṣo nopapadyate guṇāntareṇa pracchādanāt bhaviṣyati | athehāsya śuklāni vastrāṇi asyātiśayena śuklānīti śuklatarastra iti prāpnoti | śuklavastratara iti ceṣyate | uktamatra kimuktaṃ pūrvapadātiśaya ātiśāyikādvahuvrīhiḥ sūkṣmavastratarādyarthaḥ uttarapadātiśaya ātiśāyiko bahuvrīherbahvājhaḍhyatarādyartha iti || atha yatra trīṇi śuklāni prakarṣāparkaṣayuktāni tatra pūrvaṃpūrvamapekṣya dve tarabante, tatra śuklataraśabdādutpattiḥ prāpnoti | śuklaśabde śuklaśabdo'pyastīti śuklādevotpattirbhaviṣyati | naitadvivadāmahe, śuklātaraśabde śuklāśabdo'styuta nāstu| kiṃ tarhi? śuklaśabdo'pyasti, tata utpattiḥ prāpnoti tadantāñcātiśāyiko dṛśyate | tadyathā devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe, yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kurūṇāmiti | ayaṃ tarhi parihāraḥ madhyamācchuklaśabdāt pūrvaparāpekṣāt pratyayenotpattavyam | madhyamaśca śuklāśabdaḥ pūrvamapekṣya prakṛṣṭaḥ paramapekṣya nyūnaḥ prakarṣāya pravartate | na ca bahūnāṃ prakarṣe tarapā bhavitavyam | kena tarhi? tamapā | śreṣṭhatamāya, śreṣṭhatama iti chandasyeva bhavati, vācakena khalu hyutpattavyam | na ca śuklataraśabdādutpadyamāno vācakaḥsyāt | uktaṃ ca apekṣya madhyamaḥ pūrvamādhikyaṃ labhtestitaḥ | parantunyūnatāmeti na ca nyīnaḥ pravartate || astu vā'pi taraptasmānnāpaśabdo bhaviṣyati | vācakaścetprayoktavyo vācakaścetprayojyatām || atha yadyātiśāyikā guṇaprakarṣa evotpadyante kimarthamucyate ajādī guṇavacanādeveti? etau guṇaviśeṣavacanebhya eva yathā syātāmiti | guṇāḥ khalviha dviprakārā viprathante tatsthāśca, tadviśeṣaṇāni ca | yadāha tatsthaiśca guṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate, natu tadviśeṣaṇauriti | tatra ye bhāvapratyayotpattimantareṇa dravyātpṛthagākhyātumaśakyāḥ svaśabdaidrravayaratayaivābhidhīyante te tatsthāḥ | tadyathā paṭuḥ pumān, mṛduḥ śayyā, dravyam, laghurūpāyaḥ | evamaṇurmahāndīrgho hrasvaḥ pṛthuḥ kṛśo dṛḍhaḥ sthūla ityādayo vaktavyāḥ || ye tu svaśabdaiḥ pṛthakprakhyāyamānāmatublopādinā dravyaṃ viśeṣayanti te tadviśeṣaṇāni | tadyathā śuklaguṇayogācchuklā balākā, kṛṣṇaguṇayogātkṛṣṇaḥkākaḥ, tīkṣṇaguṇayogāttīkṣṇaḥ kaṇṭhakaḥ, dakṣaguṇayogāddakṣaḥ puruṣaḥ | evaṃ śītoṣṇāsvādusurabhivatsalotsukarabhasamatsarādayo vaktavyaḥ | tatra yathā balākāyāḥ śuklaḥ, kākasya kṛṣṇaḥ, kaṇṭakasya tīkṣṇaḥ, puruṣasya dakṣa ityādau | tathā balākāyāḥ śauklyam, kākasya kāṣṇryam, kaṇṭakasya taikṣṇyam, puruṣasya dākṣyamityādāvapi samāso na bhavati | gandharasarūpasparśasaṅkhyāparimāṇādayastu na tatsthāḥ, nāpi tadviśeṣaṇāni | teṣāṃ śuklādisaṅghāteṣu śāstrakārasaṅketāt dravyavacanatvenaiva rājapuruṣādivat ṣaṣṭhīsamāsā bhavanti | tadyathā candanagandhaḥ, cūtaphalarasaḥ, kanyārūpaṃ, kucasparśaḥ, mṛdurityudāhṛtya ca tīvramṛdugiṇayogāt guṇavṛttyā gandhasparśaviśeṣaṇatvena sāpekṣatve satyasāmathryāllabdhe'pi samāsābhāve yadā prakaraṇavaśāttīvraśabda eva viśiṣṭagandhavṛttistadā tadarthopacita eva vyatireka ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaphrasaṅga iti pratiṣedhopapattiruktā | ta evaṃ praṣṭavyāḥ kathaṃ prakaraṇādyapekṣāyamāmapi sāpekṣatvasya tādavasthyānnāsāmathryamiti? tadevaṃ tatsthairguṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī samasyate paṭutvādibhiḥ, na tu tadviśeṣaṇaiḥ śuklādibhiriti, kiṃ vaktavyametat? na hi kathamanuktaṃ gaṃsyate ācāryāṇāṃ ca pravṛttayo gamayanti? tatrārthaikatvaṃ gosahastramityādiṣvarthaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ śatasahastrāntāñṭaca niṣkātkośaśatayojanaśatayorupasaṅkhyānaṃ, tatsamudāyaḥ khārīśatamapi na prasūtamityādiḍaiḍḍatdhminyādimunicatuṣṭayavacanāt saṅkhyayā parimāṇena ca samāso na niṣidhyate | vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye uttarapadārthaprādhānye tadyatnagauravaṃ prasajyeteti sūtrakārabhāṣyakāraprayogāḍhca kusumasaukumāryadiśabdasiddhiḥ tenāvagamyate tatsthairguṇairevaṃ prakāraiḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamasyata iti | nanvevamapi, dviradamadajalaighāsārasaurabhyagarbhaḥ kucakalaśamahoṣmābaddharekhastuṣāraḥ | tuhunagiriśilāyāṃ śaityasaṅkrāntimatyāṃ ..................... || ityevamādināmanupapattiḥ | saptamīsamāsā ime bhaviṣyanti | kathaṃ punaḥ saurabhyadīnāmādhārataḥ pṛthagupalambhe saptamī bhavati | ucyate, samastamūrtimaddravyāṇāṃ pāñcabhautikatve vāyunā vibhaktāvayavā apyapārthivādidravyasūkṣmabhāgā yatrayatra sañcāryante tatratatraiteṣu ghrāṇādisambandhinibandhanādyupalabdhirityadhikaraṇavibhakternānupapattiḥ | evamapi bhāgānāmevādhikaraṇatvaṃ, na bhāgavatām, na bhagavatām, na hi nikṛttasya hastapādādeḥ puruṣādivyapadeśo bhavati | evametat, kintu pṛthaksthitānāmapyavayavānāmayavivyapadeśo dṛśyate, tadyathā rāhoḥ śiro rāhuḥ, śivasya liṅgaṃ śiva iti | na caitadvācyam, evaṃ sati samudgakādisthasya kūrpūrāderbahirupalabhyamānabahulaparimalasya kālāntareṇopakṣayaḥ syāt, tadvadeva dṛṣṭasannidhestatrānyabhāgānāmupanipātāt | ata eva purāṇadravyāṇāṃ gandharasarūpasparśagauravaprabhābavipākavīryaviparyayā yujyanta iti || tadevaṃ yaiḥ saha ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iṣyate tebhya eveyasiniṣṭhanorvidhānamiti nānārthakaṃ guṇavacanādeveti | nanu ca guṇāktavān matubutpatteḥ pūrvamiti gumavacanaḥ śuklādirguṇaṃ vakṣyati bhāvapratyayotpattyeti guṇavacanaḥ padvādiḥ | viśeṣavacanatavāviśeṣe yāvadajādī padvādibhya utpadyete tāvacṭhubalādibhyaḥ “praśasyasya”, “jyaca”, “vṛddhasya ca”, “antikabāḍhayornedasādhau”, “yuvālpayoḥ kananyatarasyāmiti| apiceṣṭhemeyassvityadhikṛtya yadayaṃ sthūladūrayuvahrasvakṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ lupyate pūrvasya ca guṇo bhavitītyabhidhatte | priyasthirasphirorubahulaguruvṛddhatṛpradīrghabṛndākāṇāṃ prasthasphavarbaṃhigarvarṣitrapdrādhi vṛndāḥ, ityāha | “bahorlopo bhūcabahoriti brūte |” ra ṛto halāderlagho”rityatra pṛthamṛdudṛḍhakṛśabhṛśaparibṛḍhānāmiti parigaṇanaṃ karoti | tadjñāpayati tatsthagumavacanebhya eveyasuniṣṭhanaubhavata iti | tataśca yathā śuklataraḥ kṛṣṇatama ityādi bhavati, naivaṃ śuklīyān kṛṣṇiṣṭha ityādi | yathā ca mṛdiṣṭhaḥ paṭīyāniti bhavati, naivaṃ kārakiṣṭhaḥ pācakīyāniti | kathaṃ tarhi ojiṣṭhaḥ pāpīyāniti? vinmatorlugiti jñāpakena tadantādbhaviṣyati | atha yathā candrakalpaṃ mukhaṃ, guḍaḍḍatdhkalpā drākṣā, tathā candratamaṃ guḍaḍḍatdhtameti kasmānna bhavati? prakarṣābhāvāt | na hi kenacidguṇenopameyavṛttīnāmupamānaśabdānāmatajjātīyeṣu vartamānānāṃ svārthāpekṣayā prakarṣaḥ sambhavati | yatra tu tajjātīyeṣu guṇābhidhānaṃ tatra bhavatyevātiśayi tat | tadyathā gaurayaṃ śakaṭaṃ gotaro'yaṃ yaḥ śakaṭaṃ sīraṃ ca | gauriyaṃ yā samāṃ samāṃ vijāyate gotareyaṃ yā samāṃ samīcīnā jīvavatsā ca | dṛśyate hi jātivācinastajjatīyeṣvapi guṇābhidhāyitvam | saṅgrāmeṣu caratyeṣa puruṣaḥ puruṣo yathā | nāma yasyābhinandanti dviṣo'pi sapumānpumān || iti || yadyevaṃ candraguḍādibhyaḥ kalpabādayo'pi na syu | naivaṃ teṣāmīṣadasamāptāvva vidhānāt | tarhi kṛtakalpaṃ bhuktakalpamiti ktāntebhyaḥ nacāsti sambhavo yadbhūtaṃ ca syādasamāptaṃ ca, āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavañceti vacanādbhaviṣyati || || pravibhāgaḥ || pade vākye prabandhe vā'sautāvataḥ śabdasyāyamartho'sminnarthe cāyametāvacchabda iti śabdārthayormithaḥ sambandhitayā pṛthaktvenāvadhāraṇaṃ pravibhāgaḥ | sa dvividho'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ iha khalpatyantasaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ padārthānāṃ pravibhāge'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ nānyo hetirasti | yathā loke badhiro'pi cakṣuṣā na lokayati, satyapi śrotre upahatacakṣurnālokayatirūpamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cakṣuśśrotrasannidhāneṃ rūpālokanaṃ cakṣuṣa eva vyavasthāpyate na śrokṣasya, tathā śabdaśāstre'pi, subanteṣu tiṅanteṣu ca padeṣvatyantasaṃsṛṣṭā arthātmānaḥ śabdāśca prakṛtipratyayādayo mithassambandhitvenānvayavyatirekābhyāmeva pravibhajyanate | tatrāvasthitasyānuvṛttiranvayaḥ, tadviparyayo vyatirekaḥ, sa dvividho janmahānibhyām | tadyathā vṛkṣa ityakte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate vṛkṣa ityakārāntaḥ sakāraśca pratyayaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamyate śākhādimattvamektvaṃ ca | ṛkṣa ityukte kaścicchabdo hīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī | vṛkṣaśabdo hīyate ṛkṣaśabda upajāyate sakāro'nvayī, artho'pi kaściddhīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścinvayī, śākhādimattvaṃ hīyate saṭādimattvamupajāyate ekatvamanvayīti | vṛkṣāvityukte sakāro hīyate aukāraḥ upajāyate vṛkṣaśabdo'nvayī | arthe'pyekatvaṃ hīyate dvitvamupajāyate śākhādimattvamanvayīti | tiṅanteṣu śalvapi pacatītyukte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate paca iti cakārābtaḥ atiśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ artho'pi kaścidgamyate viklittiḥ kartṛtvaṃ ca, paṭhatītyukte kaścicchabdo hīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayīti | pacchabdo hīyate paṭhaśabda upajāyate atiśabdo'nvayī | artho'pi kaściddhīyate kaścidupajāyate kaścidanvayī, viklittirhiyate paṭhikriyopajāyate kartṛtvamanvayī | pacyata ityukte atiśabdo hīyateyaśabda upajāyate pacchabdo'nvayī, artho'pi kartṛtvaṃ hīyate karmatvamupajāyate viklittiranvayinīti | te manyāmahe yaśśabdo hīyate tasyāsāvartho'nvayīti | evaṃ vākye'pi gāmānayetyukte kevacicchabdaḥ śrūyate gāmiti dvitīyāntaḥ ānayeti ca loḍaḍḍatdhntaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamayate sāsnādimān karmatvamāpannaḥ ānayeti kriyārthatvavidhitvamāpannaḥ, athāśvamānayetyukte gavārtho hīyate aśvārtha upajāyate ānayeti kriyārthatvavidhitvamāpannaḥ, athāśvamānayetyukte gavārtho hīyate aśvārtha upajāyate ānayanārtho'nvayī, gāṃbadhānetyukte ānayanārtho hīyate bandhanārtha upajāyate gavārtho'nvayī | evaṃ gaurānīyatāmaśva ānīyatāṃ gaurbadhyatāmaśvo badhyatāmityādiṣu karmakartṛtvayorhānirūpaḍaḍḍatdhniścābhyuhyāḥ | etena prabandho'pi vyākhyātaḥ | kaścidāha, mārīco rāmeṇa hataḥ | kaścidāha, lakṣmaṇeneti | tatra mārīcamṛgāghāte rāmo hīyatelakṣmaṇa upajāyate lakṣmaṇo vā hīyate rāma upajāyate, rāmāyaṇaṃ punaranvayīti || nanu ca vṛkṣaṛkṣa iti vakāro hīyate ṛ upajāyate vā, pacati paṭhatīti cakāro hīyate ṭhakāra upajāyata iti vaktavye kimarthamucyate vṛkṣaśabdo hīyate ṛkṣaśabda upajāyate, pacchabdo hīyate paṭhaśabda upajāyata iti? śabdasyārthavattā yathāsyāt na varṇānam | kiṃ punarna varṇāḥ śabdaḥ? bāḍham | arthāvasānaprasavanimittaṃ śabda ityabhihitaṃ purastāt || nanvevamapi vṛkṣādīnāmarthavattā nopapadyate, kiṃ kāraṇam? kevalenāvacanāt | na hi vṛkṣādinā kevalena kaścidartho gamyate kiṃ tarhi sa pratyayakena | kimuktaṃ bhavati, pacatyādiṣvarthavattāsahacaritā kevalavacanatā dṛṣṭā varṇeṣu cānarthakyasahacaritaṃ kevalāvacanatvam | na caite pacatyādivaddṛśyante, tasmādvarṇavaddhṛkṣādīnāmarthavattā nopapadyata iti | sapratyayasyopapadyata iti cainnaivam, iha yadyasya nimittatvenopādīyate sa tasmastena pravartitavyam | arthavattā ca prātipadikasaṃjñāyā nimittam | sāca dvidhā laukikī pāribhāṣikīti ca | tayorloki viditā laukīkī, kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, sattvapradhānāni nāmānīti | śāstre vyavahārārthā pāribhāṣikī | dādhādhvadāp, taraptamapaugha iti | tatra laukīki tāvadarthopalabdhigamyā, yeṣāṃ ca prātipadikasaṃjñā vidhīyate tena kadācitkevalā upalabhyante | pāribhāṣīkī tu paribhāṣayā bhavatyarthavacchabdarūpaṃ tañca prātipadikasaṃjñamiti | evaṃ ca śabdatvāviśeṣādvarṇānāmapi prasajyate | iyaṃ ca paribhāṣā na pravartate arthavahgrahaṇe nānārthakasyeti, tadevamarthavattāyā nimittasyabhāve prātipadikasaṃjñā na pravartate, tadapravṛttau tu kathaṃ pratyayotpattiriti? naivam | pratyayena nityasambandhāt kevalasyāprayogaḥ, nityasambandhāvetāvartho prakṛtiḥ pratyaya iti, ato nityasambandhāt kevalasya prayogo na bhaviṣyati || nanu ca bhavānāmrānpṛṣṭaḥ kovidārānācaṣṭe, arthavattā nopapadyate kevalenāvacanāditi pṛṣṭaḥ kevalasyāprayoge hetumāha nābhiprāyāparijñānāt || nanvevaṃ bravīmi yaditāvat kevalenāvacanādityevamayaṃ heturupamanyastaḥ yasmātkevalo na prayujyate tasmādavarthaka iti | tadevaṃ vaktavyaṃ kevasyāprayogāditi | na vaktavyaṃ kevalevābacanāditi | kevalasya prayogaḥ śāstrasamayānnāsti na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā | na ca kevalaḥ pratyaya iti | na ca laukikā evaṃ prayuñcate atha uktaṃ nityasabbandhādayaṃ kevale va prayujyate natvānarthakyāditi || athaivamupanyastaḥ kevalena prayujyamānena nocyate'sāvartha iti, kka punarayaṃ bhavatā kevalaḥ prayujyamāno'rthamabruvan dṛṣṭaḥ | yadi ca prayujyeta nacārtha upalabhyate, samudāyasyārthe prayogādavayavārthāvāmaprasiddhiriti | yato varṇāstāvadanarthakā bhavatābhyupagatāḥ teṣāṃ ca samudāyatantrāṇāṃ kevalānāṃ prayogo nāsti | yadyapi prayujyeran anarthakānāmeva prayogaḥ syāt | evaṃ prakṛtīnāmapi samidāyayantrāṇāṃ nāsti kevalānāṃ prayogaḥ prayoge vā satyanarthakāḥ prayujyeran | athaivambhūtānāmarthavattā, ko nāma matsaro varṇeṣviti? ko na matsaraḥ, yadeṣāmarthavattve'rthavakkāryāṇi prāpnuvanti, kānyarthavatkāryāṇi? arthavatprātipadikamiti prātipadikasaṃjñā, prātipadikāditi svadyutpattiḥ, subantaṃ padamiti padasaṃjñā ca | tatra ko doṣaḥ? pratyavayavaṃ vibhakteḥ śravaṇaṃ prāpnoti | naivaṃ, yadaivāvayavānāṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā pravartate tadaiva samudāyasyāpīti samudāyāntargatatvāt supo dhātuprātipadikayoriti lukā bhāvyam | tatkato vibhakteḥ śravaṇam || nanu ca kṛttaddhitasamāsāśceti | samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārtham, tenacārthavatsamudāyasya vākyasyeva varṇasamudāyasyāpi pratipadikasaṃjñā nivāryata iti kathaṃ tadantargatā vibhaktayo lupyate? naivam, niyamasya, tulyajātīyāpakṣatvāt samāsasyeva bhinnārthasamudāyasya vākyasyaiva prātipādikasaṃjñā nivartate, natvabhinnārthasya varṇasamudāyasyeti | atra hi yevaivārthena samudāyasyārthavattvaṃ tenaiṣa tadavayavānāmapīti | evaṃ tarhi nivṛttāyāmapi vibhaktau padatvaddhanaṃvanamityādau na lopādīni prāpnuvanta | tarhi saṅghātasyaikāthryāt subabhāvo varṇāt vṛkṣa ityatra hyekatvaṃ vibhaktyā dyotyate tañcaikamityekaiva vibhaktirūtpadyate, yathā bahavo draṣṭāra ekenaiva pradapena dṛśyamarthaṃ paśyanti evaṃ sāca samudāyādeva tantreṇa sarvānugrāhiṇyutpadyate samudāyaddhirvacanāt | yathāhi papācetyādau prathamasyaikāco dvivacanaprasaṅge yenaivācā samudāya ekāc, naiva tadavayavo'pyapaśbadaśyeti tatra pṛthagavadyavaikāyo na dvirucyante kiṃ tarhi? sarvānugrahāt samudāyaukāc eva | tathehāpi samudāyādutpattau varṇātsubutparttina bhaviṣyatīti tadabhāvānna padasaṃjñā | apadatvāñca na lopādīnāmaprasaṅga iti | satyametat | kintu varṇeṣvanvayavyatirekayoḥ sadbhāve'pyarthānvayavyatirekābhāvādayamasyārtha iti pravibhāgo na prakalpate | tathā hi, vṛkṣaḥ ṛkṣaḥ pacati paṭhatītyādau yasya hānau yo hīyate, yasyopajane ya upajāyate tasyānumeyo gacchati sa tasyārtha iti śakyate vaktum | naivam, kūpayūpasūpādāvapi anarthakā varṇāḥ, arthavanto vṛkṣādaya iti || nanu yatra bṛṃhitaṃ hīyate, heṣitamupajāyate, reṇucakramanvayi, tatra hastino hīyante, aśvājāyante, pipīlikā tatra mādhuryaṃ hīyate amlatopajāyate tṛptiranvayinī | nacānvayi pātraṃ tṛptiheturbhavati | tadevamanvayavyatireke ca satyapi kāryakāraṇabhāvasyābhāvāt kathamucyate'nvayavyatirekābhyāyamarthavattāvatiṣṭhaca iti? naivam | avadhāritaṃ hi sāmathryamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pravibhajyate, na ca pipīlikānāṃ pātrasya vā reṇucakrakṛpyoḥ sāmathryāvadhāraṇamasti, tatsadbhāve'pyanyatrābhāvāt | tyādiṣvapina śakyate | bahavo hi śabdā ekārthā bhavanti, ekaśca śabdo bahvarthaḥ, yadihi niyogata ekaḥ śabda ekasminnarthe vartate tata eṣa pravibhāgaḥ syāt | yatastu vyabhicaratyetat anekaśśabda ekasminnarthe, tadyathendraḥ śakaḥ purandara iti | ekaścānekārthaḥ akṣāḥ pādāḥ māṣāḥ ityanumānaṃ caikasyaivārthavṛttatva eva śakyate kalpayitum ato vyabhicārādanimittamanvayavyatirekau prakṛtipratyārthapravibhāga iti prakṛtireva sarvārtha syāt | pratyayo vā sarvārthaḥ, ubhauvobhayārthau, yathaiko dṛśyate hi dadhimadhvagniciditi prakṛtireva
