sarvānarthānabhidadhānā adhunā iyān asyāpatyaṃ iriti pratyaya eva vā sarvārthābhidhāyī, haiyaṅgavīnaṃ, śrokṣiyaḥ, kṣetriyaḥ, ityubhayamubhayārthābhidhāyīti | ataḥ kiṃ na sādhīyo'rthavattā siddhā bhavati? yadāhi prakṛtireva svārthadiṣu vartate pratyayo vā tadā sutarāmarthavattā sidhyati | na brūmo'rthavattā nasidhyati | tau tvanyavyatirekau nāvatiṣṭhete | tataśca kuta etatsyādayaṃ prakṛtyartho'yaṃ pratyayārtha iti? na punaḥ prakṛterevobhāvartho pratyayasyobhayasya veti samānyaśabdā ete | evaṃ syuḥ sāmānyaśabdāśca nāntareṇa viśeṣaṃ prakaraṇāṃ vā viśaṣe'vatiṣṭhante, yatastu khalu niyogataḥ prakaraṇādimantareṇāpi vṛkṣa ityukte svabhāvataḥ kaścidartho gamyate, ato manyāmahe na ime sāmānyaśabdāḥ, prakṛtiḥ prakṛtyarthe vartate iti | yadihi su aujas ityetā eva svārthadravyaliṅgasaṅkhyākarmādivacanāḥ, sahāyamātraṃ prakṛtiḥ, svādibhiḥ sarveṣāmarthānāmupādānāt vṛkṣaḥ vṛkṣaiḥ vṛkṣā iti kimarthaṃ niyogena vṛkṣārtha eva gamyate, na punassarve arthāḥ pratīyeran? paryāyeṇa vā kadācitkaścinna yaugapadyaṃ na paryāyaḥ | tasmādanvayanyatirekābhyāṃ samudāsthāḥ śabdāścāpeddhartavyā arthāśceti vyavasthitāḥ, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vyāvahārikyarthavattā | tatredamaparihṛtaṃ prakṛtireva sarvānarthānabhidadhānā dṛśyate pratyayaḥ sarvārthābhidhāyī ubhayaṃ vobhayārthābhidhāyīti | tatra parihāraḥ dadhi madhu agnicidityevamādiṣu vacanāntarāṇāmikārādīnāṃ śrīyamāṇatvādanyeṣāṃ ca savibhaktikānāṃ prayogadarśanāt || adhunā iyānityevamādiṣu pratyayāntaraparāyāḥ prakṛteravasthānāt prakṛtyanatarāṇāṃ vā lopadarśanāt ihāpyakevalasyaivārthābhidhānaṃ prasaktaṃ lopādidvāreṇa śāstradṛṣṭyā kevalasya vijñāyate || nanu na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, na kevalaḥ pratyaya iti śāstrasamayaḥ | satyametat, kintu yatra prakṛtinimittā pratyayapravṛttistatra kevalāpi prakṛtiḥ prayujyate | yatra vā pratyayanimittā prakṛtini vṛttistatra kevalo'pi pratyaya ityavabhyanujñāyate | haiyaṅgavīnaṃ śrotriyaḥ, ityādiṣu tu saṃjñāśabde hyogodohasya vikāra iti, śrotriyaśchando'dhīta iita, parakṣetre cikitsya iti, prakṛtipratyayavibhāgakalpanayā vyatpattiryathākathaṃciddharmaniyamāya kriyate | evaṃ yāvakādiṣvapi svārthikeṣu pratyayārthasyāvyatirekātprakṛtyantarayoge prātipadikānāṃ ca yāvakādīnāmarthabhedātpratyayāntarayoge prakṛteḥ kalpitāyāmarthavattāyāṃ svārthikatvaṃ vijñāyate | eko dvau bahava ityatra pratyekaṃ vacanāntarābhāvātkarmādiviṣayāvanvayavyatirekāvāśrīyete | sāmānyato dṛṣṭāñcānumānātprakṛtyantaravadekādīnāṃ pravṛttau bhinnarūpaṇi vacanānyasaṅkareṇa vyavasthāṃ prakalpayantīti pratīyate || nanvevaṃ sati śabdasyaikārthopakṣayasyārthāntareṇa asambandhādarthasyāpyekaśabdopakṣayasyānyatrāsaṅkrānte kūpasūpayūpādivadevānvayavyatirekau nāvakalpete | na hi ya evaikatvasaṃbandhī sa dvitvādisaṃbandhī, yovā prātipadikatvenārthamātrapravṛttiḥ svaśaktyantarasambandhī na bhavitumarhati | na khalu śabdaḥ kaścidattarakālamarthāntaraṃ parityajatyupādatte vā | taduktam “yasya śabdasya na vibhāgo'sti kuto'rthasya bhaviṣyati? vibhāgauḥ prakiyā kriyābhedamaviddhānapratipadyate | “ evametat | kintu trividhaḥ śabdo nirvatryo'nvākhyeyaḥ pratipādakaśca | teṣvadharmaheturapabhraṃśo nirvatryaḥ | dhramaheturlokavedayoḥ prayorgauhā'nvākhyeyaḥ | prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgakalpanayā tatsvarūpāvabodhakṛtpratipādakaḥ | tadarthamanvayavyatirekāvavidyamānāvapi vyavasthārthaṃ kalpitau śāstrārthavyavahāranibandhanaṃ sampadyate | śāstravyavahārohyarthavatprātipadikaṃ kriyāvacano dhāturityādiranāśritayoranvayavyatirekayorasikara eva | tadāha bhāgauranarthakaurbhinnāḥ pacatītyevamādayaḥ | anvayavyatirekau tu vyahāranibandhanam || iti || abhidhā ca vivakṣā ca tātparyaṃ ca vibhāgavat | catasraḥ kevalā hyotāśśabdasambandhaśaktayaḥ || yāpekṣā yañca sāmathryamanvayo yaśca tairmithaḥ | aikāthryaṃ yañca tāstasya sasahāyasya śaktayaḥ || uktāścātasraḥ prathamāḥ krameṇa kramādathānyāḥ prakaṭīkriyante | akhaṇḍaḍḍatdhvākyārthavivecakānāṃ śabdārthasaṃvitpariśuddhihetoḥ || iti mahārājādhirāja śrībhojadevaviracite śṛṅgāraprakāśe kevalaśabdasambandhaśaktiprakāśo nāma saptamaḥ prakāśaḥ <8> aṣṭamaḥ sāpekṣaśabdaśabdaśaktiprakāśaḥ

parasparopaśloṣayogyatvādekavākyarūpāvugrahāñcānyonyaṃ pradhānepasarjanabhāvena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya evamapaiti | tathā hi | yatra viśeṃṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyaṃ caikasminnarthe saṃbhedaṃ pratilabhate tatra yaśśabdaḥ sa pūrvottarapadādhiṣṭhānamenaṃ pratyāyayati | utpalaśabdo'bhipravartamānaḥ sarvotpalāvagraharupeṇa pravartate | tatraiva nīlaśabdaḥ pravartamāno viśiṣṭāvagraharupeṇāvacchinatti | yadi vā nīlamityetatpravartamānanyūnādhikabhāvamapekṣamāṇamanenaiva dharmeṇa sarvayogyaṃ sadutpalamiti śabdāntareṇa viśiṣṭāyāṃ yogyatāyāṃ niyamyate | athavā yathā kṛṣṇaḥ śuklaścāyaṃ mṛgaḥ sāraṅgaḥ śābala iti vā, tathā nīlotpala ityubhayarīpa evārthātmā hyubhayaṃ sanniveśyate | nīlaṃ cotpalaṃ caikaṃ nīlotpalamiti tau yasminnibhayaguṇamanuvibhāgamāpyamānau saṃmīÐcchatāvivārthau bhavataḥ tattayārekemadhikaraṇaṃ | yadivā nīlaśabdaḥ pravartamāno nīlaguṇamātramupādāya pravartate natvenenotpalādaya upāttā api parityaktāḥ | evamutpalaśabdo vijātiyogamātramupādāya pravartate | na nīlādīṃstyajati | nopādate | tatra yadaiva bhinne'rtharūpa idamiti sarvanāmnā pratyavamṛśyamāne upaśliṣyete nīlamutpalaṃ cedaṃ dravyamiti, tadā śabdabhedādbhinnameva dravyaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyamadhika.... ktaḥ padadvayasannidhānāyattatvādviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya vākyārthatvaṃ, na padārthatā | tadidamuktaṃyadatrādhikyaṃ vākyārthaḥ sa iti ... nīlamutpalamiti | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorubhayasya ca viśeṣyatvādupasarjanatvāprasiddhiḥ yathā hyutpalaśabdo nīlaśabdenābhisamabandhyamāno viśeṣanacanastathā nīlaśabdo'pyutpalaśabdenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ sambadhyate, naivam, | ekasyātra prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ aparasya utpalasyacātrāprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ nīlaśabdasyopasarjanatvamiti | yadā tarhi nīlasya prādhānyena vivakṣā utpalasya copasarjanatvena tadākartavyaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, na hyasau dvandva utpalaṃ ca nīlaṃ ceti | nāpi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa utpalasya nīlamiti, api tu dvāvimau pradhānaśabdavekasminnarthe yugapadurudhyete | na ca dvayoḥ pradhānayorekasminnarthe yugapaduparodhe prayojanamastīti prayogasāmāthryādgamyate | nīnamekamihapradhānaṃ tadviśeṣakaṃ cāparam || etāvāṃstu sandehaḥ kiṃ viśeṣyaṃ? kiṃ viśeṣaṇamiti | tatra dravyaṃ viśeṣyaṃ guṇo viśeṣaṇaṃ dravyasyānāyanapekṣiṇaḥ sākṣātkriyāsūpayogena prādhānyāt || nanu guṇasyāpi sākṣātkriyāsūpayogo dṛśyate yathā “śvetaṃ chāgamālabhete”ti, nāvam, | iha śvetābhāve kṛṣṇamapi chāgamālabhate na tu śvetāṃ puṣṭapiṇḍīmālabhya kṛtī bhavati | evamupacārapravṛttāvapi puruṣavyāghra ityādau yadyantarbhūtopamānasambandhapratītabhedo vyāghraduśabdairupameyaḥ puruṣādirabhidhīyate tadā sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattau upamitaṃ vyāghradubhiḥ sāmānyāprayoga iti samāso bhavati | evaṃ prapacati sādhu pacatītyādayo draṣṭavyāḥ | kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena kriyāviśeṣaṇatve sādhvādayo'sattvavacanā bhavanti | ucyate, upasargāṇāmiva kriyāviśeṣaṇānāmapyattvabhūtānāmeva kriyāṃ prati guṇabhāvo bhavati, yathā pacyādikaṃ viśeṣe sthāpayan asattvārthaḥ praśabdo viśeṣaṇatvaṃ labhate, evaṃ sādhuśabdo'pi kriyātmakabhūtaṃ dharmamuktarṣādikaṃ kriyāsthamasattvabhūtaṃ kriyānupraviṣṭamabhidadhānaḥ kriyānurodhādevāsattvabhāvamāpannaḥ kriyāviśeṣaṇatvaṃ labhate, kathaṃ punaḥ prapacatītyādau prāderubhaya viśeṣaṇatve, kriyābhāgenaiva sambandho bhavati? sati vā kathamubhayaviśeṣaṇatvam || ucyate | yathā māsojātasyeti māsākhyaḥ kriyākalāpaḥ kathaṃ prathamakukṣiviyogākhyasya janmano'vadhibhāvena paricchedako bhavati janmapratilabdhāṃ vā sattāṃ samāvṛttyā parimimīte, yathā ca kaṣṭaśrita ityatropāttakriyāviśeṣaparicchinnaḥ kartā'bhyantarīkṛtasādhanasambandhaḥ kriyāyoge śrayatikriyāsaṃbandhātkaṣṭe karmatvamiti śrayaṇakriyāpūrvaṃ kaṣṭena sambandhamanubhavati, yathā ca vṛkādbhīta ityupāttakriyāvacchinnaḥ kartā bhayakriyāsaṃbandhādvṛkasyāpādānatvamiti bhayakriyāpūrvakaṃ vṛkena saṃbadhyate, tathehāpyupāttapacyādikriyāviśeṣaparicchinnaḥ kartā'bhyantarīkṛtasādhyasādhanasambandhaḥ kriyāyoge prādīvāmupasargatvamiti kriyāpūrvakaṃ prādīnāṃ sambadhyata iti | sarve'pi ca samudāyambandhino'vayavasparśenaiva tadvatā samudāyena sambadhyante | taduktam samudāyena sambandho yeṣāṃ garukulādinā | saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste tu yajyantetadvatā saha || iti || vyapekṣādibhirekārthaparatayopāttānāṃ padārthānāṃ mitho'bhigrathanamanvayaḥ | sa tridhā śākto vaibhaktaḥ śaktivibhaktimayaśca | teṣu karmādiśaktibhirnirvṛttaḥ śāktaḥ, sambandhādivibhaktibhirvaibhaktaḥ, ubhābhyāṃ punaḥ śaktivibhaktimayaḥ | tatrākhyātasubvibhaktibhyāṃ kartṛkarmaṇorabhidhāne śākto yathādhyāsāmāsuruttuṅga hemapīchāni yānyamī | tairūhe kesarikrāntatrikūṭaśikharopamā || kṛdākhyātābhyāṃ bhinnakālasthakartṛśaktidvayābhidhāne subvibhaktibhiḥ karmakaraṇasampradānābhidhāne ca śākto yathājitvā sārṇavāmuvīṃmaniṣṭvā vividhairmakhaiḥ | adatvā cārthamarthibhyo bhaveyaṃ pārthivaḥ katham || ākhyātavibhaktyā hetuśaktyabhidhāne subvibhaktyāva karmakatrrapādānādhikaraṇaśaktyabhidhāne yathā sa setuṃ bandhayāmāsa plavagairlavaṇāmbudhau | rasātalādivokattīrṇaṃ śeṣaṃ svapnāya śārṅigaṇaḥ || svapnāyeti kartari ṣaṣṭhī na sambandhe, bhāvaeva caturthī na tādathrye | ākhyātena katrrabhidhāne taddhitena kṛte ca karmābhidhāne supā kathitākathitakarmābhidhāne ca śākto yathā vipakṣamakhilīkṛtya pratiṣṭhā khalu durlabhā | anītvā paṅkatāṃ dhūlimudakaṃ nāvatiṣṭhate ||, mbandhavibhaktyā vaibhakto yathā yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyārthāstasya bāndhavāḥ | yasyārthāḥ sa pumān loke yasyārthā sa ca paṇḍiḍḍatdhtaḥ || śeṣavibhaktyā vaibhakto yathā bhūtānāṃ prāṇinaḥ śraṣṭhāḥ prāṇināṃ buddhijīvinaḥ | buddhimatsu narāḥśrṣṭhā nareṣu brahmavādanaḥ || upapadavibhaktyā vaibhakto yathā namastuṅgaśiraścumbicandracāmaracārave | trailokyanagarārambhamūlastambhāya śambhave || sambodhanavibhaktyā ca vaibhakto yathāvanipanavahnivyomatoyāntarātmannahimakara himāṃśo viśva viśvaikayone | hara bhava śiva śarva tryambakeśāna rudra trinayana vṛṣaketo'nantamīrte namaste || kārakavibhaktiḥ sambandhopapadaśeṣasambodhanavibhaktibhiśca śāktivibhaktimayo yathā tīrtheṣu satsu dvijasattamebhyaḥ śriyaṃ dviṣāviṣṭajanānupāttām | samādhināmānamajastrameva kasya pradātuṃ tvadṛte'sti śaktiḥ || yatra luptāsvapi vibhaktiṣu śaktayo'vabhāsante vibhaktayaśca sākṣādupalabhyante so'pi śaktivibhaktimayaḥ | yathā vitrastaśatruḥ spṛhayālulokaḥ prapannasāmanta udūḍhasatvaḥ | pratiṣṭhitaḥ kāryasamādhisatre jitāvaniḥ ko'tra bhavānivānyaḥ || yatraikataḥ śaktiranyato vibhaktisso'pi śaktivibhaktimayo yathā nirīkṣya saṃrambhanirastadhairyaṃ rādhemārādhitajāmadagnyam | asaṃstuteṣu prasabhaṃ bhayeṣu jāyeta mṛtyorapi pakṣapātaḥ || atra yadi janikriyāto nirīkṣaṇakriyāyāḥ pūrvatvaṃ tadā kartṛbhedānnāsti ktvāpratyayaḥ | abhidhāvyāpārastu vighayate ṣaṣṭhyabhitasya kartuḥ pakṣapātakriyayaiva sambandhaḥ, na nirīkṣaṇākriyayā | kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtīti ṣaṣṭhyā na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnāmiti pratiṣedhāt | sa ca vibhaktipariṇāmādhyāhāraviparyayavākyabhedavyavabitakalpanādaguṇakalpanābhirupapadyate | tatra rādheyaṃ nirīkṣya mṛtyarapi bhayeṣu pakṣapātī bhavatīti vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ rādheyaṃ nirīkṣya svasāmathryaṃ vimṛśato mṛtyorapi bhayeṣu pakṣapātī bhavatīti vibhaktivipariṇāmaḥ rādheyaṃ nirīkṣya sāvasāmathryaṃ vimṛśato mṛtyorapi bhayeṣu pakṣāpāto jāyeteti vākyabhedaḥ | rādheyaṃ nīrīkṣya mārayatīti mṛtyorapi bhayeṣu pakṣāpāto jāyeteti vyutarattikālākṣitāyā vāvahitāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ vyavahārakāle'pyāśrayaṇāt vyavahitakalpanā | nirīkṣyeva nirīkṣyeti pakṣapātanasyācetanasyāpi cetanaguṇādhyāropeṇa guṇakalpānā | yadāhamukhyābhāve sati prayojane nimitte ca satyupatāraḥ pravartate, dṛṣṭaścācetane'pi premādau cetanādikriyopacāro yathā prema paśyati bhayānyapade'pi | avasthā vastūni prathayati saṅkocayati ca || atha kimābhihitānāṃ padārthānāmanvaya utānvitānāmabhidhānam | ucyate astyatra matabhedaḥ, tatraike varṇayanti, anvitānāmabhidhāmabhihitānāṃ cānvayaḥ | kecidbruvate, nānvitānāmabhidhānaṃ, na cābhihitānāmanvaya iti || tatrābhidhānavādina evamāhuḥ | vyutpattibalena hi śabdo'rthamavabodhayati vṛddhavyahārāt vyutpattiśca vṛddhāśca vākyenaiva vyavaharanti na padena, yañcārthaprakaraṇādigamyapadārthāntarasahakṛtaṃ padaṃ prayuñjate tadapi vākyameva yajapyekaṃ padaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ṭaritārthakriyaṃ kkacit | vākyaṃ tadapi manyante sambodhanapadādivat | yañca ko'yamiti praśne gauraśva iti vocyate | tatra labhyata ityādiḥ praśnoktaiva kriyeṣyate || vākyaṃ caikārthaparaṃ pada samūhasaṃhatyārthamabhidadhāti sa tāni padānyucyante samūhaścaivamekārthaḥ syāt, evaṃ ca saṃhatyārthamabhidadhyuḥ padāni | yadyekaikaṃ padamabhinna evārthe vyāpriyate tatra yathā trayo'pi grāvāṇa ukhāṃ dhārayanti, catvāro'pyudyantāraḥ śibikāmudyacchanti, sarvāṇyapi kārakāṇi pākaṃ sādhayanti, tathā padānyapi sarvāṇi vākyārthamanvavagamayanti, vākyārthaṣaśca kriyākārakasaṃsargarūpaḥ | tatra kārakāṇāṃ kriyāsambandhonmukhatayā kriyāṇāṃ ca kārakavirahāsahuṣṇutvenānvitānāmeva svaśabdairabhidhānaṃ bhavati | evaṃ ca sati vākyārthasya sākṣādeva śābdatvamupapadyate natvabhihitānvayapakṣavatpāramparyeṇeti | tadabhihitānvayavādino na mṛṣyante, tehyevamāhuḥ, anavagatapadārthakasya vākyārthasampratyayadarśanātpadārthapratipattipūrvikaiva vākyārthapratipāttiḥ, tāṃ pratipattiṃ padārthapratipattiścaivamavakalpate | yadi tāvāneva so'rthaḥ padenābhīdhīyate padārthāntarānvite tu tasminnabhidhīyamāne kadambakarūpārthapratipatteḥ padārthapravibhāgo na prakalpeta | asya padasya jātirartho'sya dravyasya guṇo'sya kriyeti āvāpodvāpābhyāṃ tadavadhāraṇamiti cet naivam, tatrāpi kadambakarūpārthapratīteranapāyāt || kiñca pratiyogināmanantatayānvayasyānantyāttadanvayānantyenānvitābhidhāyinyāḥ sambandhagrahaṇamaśakyamiti duravagamaḥ padārthayoḥ sambandhagrahaḥ, tadanapekṣatve prathamaśrutādapi tadarthapratipattiḥ prāpnoti | gāmānayeti vākyādaśvabandhananiyogaḥ pratīyeta, vṛddhavyavahārepu ca vākyādapi bhavantī vyutpattiḥ padaparyantaiva bhavati | itarathāhi prativākyaṃ vyatpattirapekṣyeta sā cānantyāddurupapādeti śābdavyavahārocchedaḥ syāt | dṛśyate cābhinavakaviślokāt vākyārthapratītiḥ, sā ca padapadārthayoreva vyutpattāvupapadyate, na vākyārthayoritināstyanvitābhidhānām || apicānvayasyānvitaviśeṣaṇatvāttadabhidhānamantareṇānvito'bhidhātuṃ na śakyata ityanvayābhidhānamaṅgīkaraṇīyam | na ca tadekayā śaktyā śakyate'bhidhātumiti śaktyantarakalpanāprasaṅgaḥ || apica gāmānayetyatra yadā gośabdenānayatvarthaviśiṣṭaḥ svārtho'bhidhīyate tadā gavārthasyāprādhānyam, yadāca ānayatinā gavārthaviśiṣṭaḥ svārthaḥ tadā tadarthasyetyetasminvākye pradhānadvayopanipātādvākyabhedāpattiḥ || api ca prakṛtipratyayayoranyonyānvitasvārthābhidhānalabdhapadabhāvayoḥ padārthāntarānvitārthavācakatvamiti dvirabhidhānaṃ syāt || kiñca padenānvitaḥ svārtho'bhidhīyamānaḥ kimabhihitena padārthāntaraṇānvito'bhidhīyate utānabhihitena | abhihitena cedekasmādena padāttadarthoparañjakadvitīyapadārthāvagateḥ padāntaroñcāraṇavaiyathryam | evaṃcaikameva padamakhilapadābhidheyārthavādi sampannamiti tenaiva vyavahāraḥ syāt | na cāsau sampadyate | gauriti hyukte sarvaguṇakriyāvagamānnijñāyate kimupādīyatāmiti, niyataguṇākryānuraktasvārthapratipādena tu na heturasti | padāntarasannidhānaṃ niyamahetariti cet tadapi japamantrādipadavatsvarūpamātreṇa sannidhānānna viśiṣyate | athābhihitena tadapi tarhi padamanvitābhidhāyitayā padāntarotthamarthābhidhānamapekṣate tataścetaretarāścayamanavasthācakrakaṃ vā prāpnoti || atha dvitīyamananvikameva svārthamabhidhatte prathamena kimaparāddham | evaṃ ca sarvapade svārthamātrābhidhānādabhihitānvaya eva bhavati || kiñcāṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamiti nāstyanvayo yogyatvābhāvāt, anvitābhidānavādināṃ tvanvitasyābhidhānāttatrāpyanvayaḥ prāpnoti || api cānvitābhidhānavādināṃ puruṣakyadevamayaṃ puruṣo vedeti bhavati pratyayo naivamarthe prati siddhāntaḥ | tehyevamāhuḥ | vākyātkāryabhūtātpratyayitasya vaktustadarthaviṣayaṃ pūrvavijñānaṃ kāraṇabhūtamanumīyate tasya ca jñānasya jñeyāvyabhicāritvāt jñeyabhūtārthaniścaya iti na vācakaśaktyārthāvagamaḥ | evaṃ ca vācakaśaktireva nāvadhāryate kuto'nvitābhidhānamiti tasmādabhihitānāṃ padārthanāmanvaya iti yuktam | padāni hi svamarthamabhidhāya nivṛttavyāpārāṇi || athedānīṃ padārthā avagatā vākyārthe gamayantīti | atrānvitābhidhānapakṣe kadambakarūpārthapratipatteḥ pratiyogināṃ cānantatayā sambandhagrahaṇasyāśakyā duravagamaḥ padārthapratibhāga iti, tadidaṃ vyutpattyanabhijñasya codyam | nahyevaṃ vyutpattiḥ | gośabdasya śuklānvito'rtha iti, sa hi vyabhicarati kṛṣṇānvitasyāpi tadarthasyopalambhāt, nāpi sarvānvitaḥ, ānantyena duravagamatvāt, kinvākāṃkṣitannihitayogārthāntarānukto'syārtha iti, etāṃ vyutpattiṃ vākyānyeva padāvāpodvāpaviracanāvaicitryabhāñji sañjanayanti | yataḥ opyante coddhriyante ca svārthāḥ svānvayaśālinaḥ | anvite sve ca sāmathryaṃ padānāṃ tena gamyate || tatra ca yadyadākāṃkṣitaṃ yogyaṃ sannidhānaṃ prapadyate | tadanvitaḥ padenārthaḥ svakīyaḥ pratipādyate || padārthaparyantāpi ca bhavantī vyutpattirīdṛśī dṛśyate na śuddhapadārthaviṣayā | tathāhi niyataṃ sādhanaṃ sādhye kriyāniyasādhanā | sasannidhānamātreṇa niyamaḥ samprakāśate || guṇabhāvena sākhāṅkṣāṃ tatra nāma pravartate | sādhyatvena nimittāni kriyāpadamapekṣate || evaṃ ca sannihitayogyākāṃkṣitoparakte svārthe kkacidgṛhītasambandhaḥ sarvatra gṛhīto bhavatīti nānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ sambandhāgrahaṇam | na ca kadambakārthapratīteḥ padārthatāpravibhāgaḥ | taduktam ākāṅkṣāsannidhiprāptayogyārthāntarasaṅgatān | svārthavāhuḥ padānīti vyutpattiḥ saṃśritā yadā || ānantyavyabhicārābhyāṃ tadā doṣo na kaścana | kadambakārtharūpāyāḥ pratīteśca na sambhavaḥ || iti | tataśca padapadārthayossambandhagrahaṇopapattau na prathamaśrutāpi padārthapratītirna gāmānayeti vākyādeśca bandhananiyogaḥ, na prativākyaṃ vyutpattyapekṣā, na cābhinavakaviślokavākyārthapratītirbhavatīti | yadapi cānvitābhidhāne śaktidvayakalpanāgauravamāśāṅkitaṃ tadapi nāsti | anvayavattā hyanvitatā | tadabhidhānenānvito'bhihitaḥ syāt | na hi daṇḍītyatra daṇḍo nābhidhīyata iti sambhavati paraṃ viśeṣaḥ tatra prakṛtyā viśeṣaṇābhidhānaṃ iha tenaivānyatastadalābhāte | ato'nvitābhidhānāśaktyauvānvayo'pyabhidhīyata iti nāsti śaktidvayakalpanāgauravam | taduktaṃ vyatiṣaktārthabuddhyā hi vyatiṣaṅge niśamyate | aparaṃ tu na saṃsargapratīterasti kāraṇam|| pratipattyānvayaṃ yasmātpratīyādanvitaḥ pumān | vyaktiṃ jātimivārtho'sāviti saṃparikītryate || yo'pi pradhānadvayaśaṅkayā vākyabhedalakṣaṇo doṣaḥ so'pi nopapadyate | yato'nvitaḥ sambandha ucyate tatra kaścitpradhānatayā sambandhaḥ kaścidguṇatayā, yaśca yathā sambandhaḥ sa tathaivocyata iti naikasminvākye pradhānadvayaprasaṅgadvākyabhedalakṣaṇadūṣaṇotpattiḥ | taduktaṃ pradhānaguṇabhāvena labdhānyonyasamanvayāt | padārthāveva vākyārthaṃ saṅgirante vipaścitaḥ || pratipattarguṇānāṃ tu pradhānaikaprayojanā | tatpratītyekrakāryatvādvākya ..... karmamucyate || yañja prakṛtipratyayoḥ padasya cābhidhāne dvirabhidhānamuktaṃ tadapi nava samyak prakṛtyānvitasyārtho vidhīyate, pratyayaśca prakṛtyarthānvitaṃ padārthānvitaṃ ca svārthaṃ bravīti, pratyayārthasya prakṛtyarthānvitasya padāpekṣitvāditi kuto dvirabhidhānam | natvevaṃ padasyānvitābhidhīyitvaṃ na syāt, pratyayasyaiva prakṛtisahitasya padatvāt || kiñcāyamabhihitānvayavādino'pi tulyo doṣaḥ | tataśca yaścobhayoḥ samo doṣaḥ parihāro'pi vā samaḥ | naikaḥ paryanuyoktavyastādṛśyarthavicāraṇe || prakṛkatipratyayau brūtaḥ pratyayārthaṃ saheti ca | yadāhuḥ sūrayastena pratyayaṃ padamiṣyate || yañcānabhihitapadārthāntarānvisvārthābhidhānapakṣe padāntaroñcāraṇaivayathryamityādi, abhidhānapakṣe punaritaretarāśrayādidūṣaṇamuktaṃ tadubhayapakṣānabhyupagamenaiva nirastam | yato nāsmākamayaṃ pakṣaḥ, prathamaśrutānyeva padāni svārthānanyonyamanvitānabhidadhati | api tu yasya yāvanto'rthāḥ sambhavanti tacchravaṇe tāvantaḥ smṛtāvupasthāpyante, tataścākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatādisampāditaniyatamithassamanvayāḥ padaireva smṛtyupāruḍhairabhidhīyante | tathāhi yastāvadguhicasambandho yasya ca sambandhadagrahaṇasaṃkāro notepannaḥ pradhvasto vā sa vākyārthapratipattau nādhikriyate, yastvanavabhraṣṭasambandha grahaṇasaṃskāraḥ sapadaṃ padaṃ śrutvā nūnaṃ tāvadidaṃ smarati idamidamasyārthasyākāṅkṣitasannihitaparijanavidhitsitaḥ priyāpravṛttipraśno niṣidhyate | dvitīyā yathā piasaṃgama kiṃ vahi ddaḍiḍḍatdhpi ahoparokkhahokkeva | maivennivinnāsi āṇiddaṇaeva na teva || atra samastaprāṇahṛdbhedasādhāraṇyena pravṛtto nidrārthastadvirodhibhyāṃ priyasaṅgamaviyogābhyāṃ niṣidhyate, yatrārthitvāpravṛttamanyenaiva tatkāryasiddhau niṣidhyate sākṛtārthatvanaiṣedhikī | yathā kiṃ tassa pāraeṇaṃ kimaggiṇā rki vagabbhapparaeṇa | jassaurammi ṇisammai uhmāaṃ tatthaṇī jāā || atra prāvāravilāsāgnigarbhagṛhakāṇi haimanaśītārtinivṛttaye pravṛttiāni tadarthakāriṇopāruḍhyauvanopagūḍhapriyākucoṣmamaṇā nivatryante | yatra parisaṅkhyātenārthena śeṣaṃ niṣidhyate sā parisaṅkhyānaiṣedhikī | yathā vevāvallaci udeddhamuhe sajjiatiitakaṃḍa, | kaakaṇṇāppaliṃpacasaratahakāmaho koaṃḍa, || atra jagājjigīṣayā cakrīkṛtakāmakodaṇḍānukāriṇi mukhe vibuddhe'pi locanotpaladvayasyaiva prakāśamānatvātkusumasāyakasya dvāveva bāṇau na trayo na pañceti sajjitatilake traya eva na dvau na pañceti kṛtakarṇotpale pañcaiva na dvau na traya iti parisaṅkhyātenārthena śeṣaṃ niṣidhyate| yatraikāvadhāraṇenānyatparākriyate sā niyamanaiṣedhikī | yathā teñciajīāteñce amaggaṇāsā ajassadhanuiṭhṭhī | diṭṭiakuvalaaviloaṇā ṇaso jaai kaṃdappo || atra jyāmārgaṇadhanuryaṣṭīnāmanyatra bhedenopalambhātkandarpaviṣayepi tadbhedo'nuvṛttaḥ kuvalayavilocanādṛṣṭestenatena saṃsthānena tattatkāryakaraṇātsaiva sarvātmiketyavadhāraṇaṃ nivatryate, etena niyamasadṛśaphalo vinigraho'pi vyākhyātaḥ | yathā bhavatu samadanā rataye tilakavatī cārucampaka cchāyā | ghanacandanadhavalakucā kāntā tava vidviṣā maṭavī || ādigrahaṇādasambhavaniyamo viśeṣe pratyakṣaśrutirityādayo gṛhyante, tayorasambhavaniyamo yathā hāro thaṇāṇasavaṇā ṇa kuṇḍaḍḍatdhlāmehalā ṇiaṃbassa | acchoṇaaṇo vibhave vimaṇḍaḍḍatdhṇaṃ kajjalasalāā || viśeṣapratyakṣaśrutiryatheyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriya mamṛtavartirnayanayo rasāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahulaścandanarasaḥ | ayaṃ bāhuḥ kaṇṭhe śiśiramasṛṇo mauktikarasaḥ kimasyā na preyo yadi paramasahyastu virahaḥ || yeyamudbhatasambandhavyatirekeṇa patapadārthānāmitaretaraṃ pratyākāṃkṣāsannidhiyogyatāpekṣiṇī vyapekṣetyapucyate | kā punariyamākāṃkṣā nāma? pratipatturjijñāsā | sā kathaṃ padārthānāmupapadyate? kāraṇe kāryopacārāt | tathāhy abhidhānaparyavasānamabhidheyaparyavasānaṃ ca jijñāsotpattikāraṇaṃ, tañcopacāreṇākāṅkṣeti vyapadiśānti | tatrābhidhānapakṣe dvāramityekapadaprayoge'bhidhānameva na paryavasyāti | nahyanuñcarite yogyapratiyogini sannidhāyini pade saṃvriyatāmapāvriyatāmityādāvanvitābhidhānaṃ bhavati | vṛddhavyavahāre cānvitārthānyeva padāni pratīyante, bālo hi vyatpadyamānaḥ prayojyavṛddhasya śabdaśravaṇasamantarabhāvinīṃ viśiṣṭaceṣṭānumitāṃ śabdakāraṇikāṃ pratītimanvitārthaviṣayāmavagacchanninvita evārthe padānāmabhidhānasāmathryamavadhārayati | viśvajitā yajetetyādau punarekapadaprayogāllabdhe'nvitābhidhāne'bhidheyameva na paryavasyati atrānuṣṭheyatayāvagatasya vākyābhidheyasyārthasyānuṣṭhātāramantareṇānupapattestadupapattaye yuktauvānuṣṭhātṛjijñāsā tasyāṃ ca satyāmaparipūrṇatvāvagamāllokavadadhyā hāre kartavye yogyatvāsvargakāma evānuṣṭhātādhyāhriyate | abhihitānvayavādipakṣe'pi padārthantaramantareṇānvayāsāmathryāttadupapattaye yuktaiva pratiyogijijñāsā, tasyāṃ ca satyāmaparipūrṇavākyaparipūravakayānvitābhidhānavadeva prakaraṇādivaśena yogyādhyāhāraḥ kriyate || nanvevaṃ sati yatra padatrayaṃ prayujyate gāmānya śuklāmiti loke tatrābhidhānābhidheyāparyavasānayoramambhavānnākāṅkṣāstīti kathamanvitābhidhānam? vākyasya gāmānayetyaitāvataiva paripūrṇatvāt | satyam, padānuñcāraṇamevametat | uñcarite satyetasminnasyāpyānayatisannidhānāttadekavakyāyatvāvagamādānayatyanvitasyārthābhidhāyitvāvadhāraṇādākāṅkṣāṃ ca vinā tadasambhavādānayaterākāṅkṣā parikalpyate | uktaṃ ca bhāṣyakṛtā bhavati ca sā raktaṃ pratyākāṅkṣeti | tena tatrānvitābhidhānasiddhyarthamevākāṅkṣā, yadi paramayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, dvāramityādau tasyaiva padasyānvitābhidhānākāṅkṣā, gāmānaya śuklāmiti tu padāntarasyeti | uktaṃ ca “anvitasyābhidhānārthamuktārthaghaṭanāya vā | pratiyogiṣu jijñāsā yā sā''kāṅkṣeti gīyate |” iti | sā ceyamākāṅkṣā vibhāge sati bhavantī vyutpattāvupa lakṣaṇamāśrīyate | kimiti punaḥ sannidhiyogyataiva nāśrīyate? nirākāṅakṣeṇānvitābhidhānādarśanāt ayameti putrorājñaḥ puruṣo'yamapasāryatāmiti putrasambandhanirākaṅkṣo rājā na puruṣeṇānvīyate | kasmātpunarubhayoḥ putrapuruṣayoḥ sannidhiyogyatvāviśeṣe'pi putreṇaiva rājñaḥ sambandho na puruṣeṇa? ucyate, nyāyasāpekṣatvādvākyārthapratipatteḥ, nityasāpekṣeṇaiva rājā saṃbadhyate tena sambandhanirākāṅkṣā na puruṣeṇa sambandhamanubhavatīti ākāṅkṣā'pi vyutpattāvupalakṣaṇamāśrīyate | paripūrṇena yogyasya samīpasyāpyananvayaḥ vyutpatau tena śabdanāmākāṅkṣā'pyupalakṣaṇaṃ, sā ceyamākāṅkṣā pratiyogiṣu na sarveṣu sahasaiva yugapadupajāyate, api tu kāraṇopanipātātkrameṇa | tathāhi kriyayā kartāramantareṇā sambhavāttadavagatau kartā prathamamapekṣyate, sa ca niṣphale vyāpāre na pravartata iti karmāpekṣate | vyāpāraśca karaṇamantareṇāśakyaḥ sādhayitumiti karaṇāpekṣā | evamadhikaraṇādayaḥ kriyākārakaviśeṣaṇādaya ścāpekṣaṇīyā iti kāraṇopanipātaḥ syāt | kriyādiṣu yathā jijñāsā jāyate boddhuḥ sambandhiṣu tathā tathā | yadyadākāṅkṣitaṃ yogyaṃ sannidhiṃ pratipadyate | tadanvitaḥ padenvirthaḥ svakīyaḥ pratipādyate || || atha sannidhiḥ || yogyasyākāṅkṣitasya yadānantarye, sa sannidhiḥ | sa dvidhābhidhānaviṣayaḥ abhidheyaviṣayaśca | tatroñcāraṇanimitto'bhidhānaviṣayaḥ, avinābhāvanimitto'bhidheyaviṣayaḥ | tayorādyo yathā līlāsmitena śucinā mṛdunoditena vyālokitena lughunā guruṇā gatena | vyājṛmbhitena jaghanena ca darśitena sā hanti tena galitaṃ mama jīvitena || atra līlāsmitādibhiḥ śucyadīni viśeṣaṇāni yathāsānnidhyamapi sambadhyate | dvitīyo yathā mā bhavantamanalaḥ pavano vā vāraṇo madakalaḥ paraśurvā | vāhinījalabharaḥ kuliśaṃ vā svasti te'stu latayā saha vṛkṣa || atra dahatvityādikā kriyā tadavinābhāvanimittakātsānnidhyādadhyāhṛtānalādibhiḥ sambadhyate || nanu ca sannidhivadākāṅkṣāpyavinābhāvanimittā kimiti neṣyate, yaddhi yena vinā na bhavati niyogatastena tadākāṅkṣyate | kriyā hi kārakāvinābhāvinī taṃ pratītya kārakaṃ jijñāsate | evaṃ kārakamapi budhvā kriyāmiti, tadayuktam | jijñāsāvirāmānupapatteḥ, yathā hyavinābhāvena kārakajijñāsāpyupapadyate ataḥ prayojanābhāvāt kārakātiriktamanyanna jijñāsyate, tarhi kriyāmātrāvagame'pi yatra kārakajñānena prayojanaṃ nāsti tatra jijñāsā na syāt | anuṣṭheyatayā hi kriyāyāmavagatāyāṃ kārakepādānamantareṇa tadanuṣṭhānānupapatteḥ | kārakajñānāt prayojanavadvartamānāpadeśādau tvananuṣṭheyatayā nāsti kārakajñānena prayojanam || atha ca tatrāpi vākyamaparipūrṇe manyante sākāṅkṣārthābhidhāyitayā cāparipūrṇatā | ata eva ca tatrādhyāhāramapi kurvanti, tatrāpi cānuṣṭheyāvagatistatrāpi niśśeṣakārakajijñāsā syāt | tathā ca devadatta gāmānayeti karaṇānupādānādaparipūrṇatā syāt || athaikakārakajñānenāpi tāvadanuṣṭhānopapatterna kārakāntarajijñāsā devadatta gāmabhyaja daṇḍeḍḍatdhneti prayukte'pi daṇḍaḍḍatdhśabde tadākāṅkṣā na syāt | tataścānākāṅkṣitatvāttasya tadanvayo vākyārtho na syāt || atha daṇḍaḍḍatdhpadoñcāraṇāttatrākāṅkṣā parikalpyate, anyathā daṇḍaḍḍatdhpadasyānanvaye tatpadoñcāraṇamanarthakaṃ syāditi | evamaruṇayaikahāyanyā piṅgākṣyā somaṃ krīṇātītyanvayaprasaṅgaḥ | na hi vedapadoñcāramenānarthakena bhavitavyamiti kiñcana pramāṇamasti | na ca tatrākāṅkṣodaye kiñcitkāraṇāntaramastīti somaṃ krīṇātītyato'dhikasyānanvayitā syāt | ato nākāṅkṣāyāmavinābhāvo nimittatvenāśrīyata iti | ākāṅkṣāvañca sannidhāvapi sannidhāpakakrameṇaiva kramo veditavyaḥ | tadanusāreṇa cānvitābhidhānamapi tathaiveti || sannidhiśśabdajanmaiva vyutpattau nopalakṣaṇam | adhyāhṛtenāpyarthena loke sambandhadarśanāt || sahasaiva na sarveṣāṃ sannidhiḥ pratiyoginām | sannidhāpakasāmagrīkrameṇa kramavānasau || yathāyathā sannidhānaṃ jāyate pratiyoginām | tathātathā krameṇaiva śabdairanvitabodhanam || || yo gya tā || atha kā yogyatā? yadetatsambandhārhatvaṃ nāma | taddhidhā mukhyārthadvārakaṃ jaghanyārthadvārakaṃ ca | kaḥ pumarmukhyārthaḥ jaghanyārtha iti? śravamasamanantaraṃ sākṣādeva śabdādyatrārthaḥ pratīyate sa mukhamiva prathamaṃ bhavatīti mukhyaḥ | yastu guṇasambandhādivyavadhānena śabdādavagamyate sa jaghanamiva paścājjāyata iti jaghanyaḥ | tayormukhyāstridhā jātyādimukhyaḥ, ākṛtyādimukhyaḥ, bhrāntyādimukhyāśca | teṣu jātiguṇakriyābhidhāyibhiḥ śabdairyo'bhidhīyate sa jātyādimukhyaḥ | gauḥ padā na padā na spraṣṭavyā, śuklāṃ gāmabhayāja, pācakamānaya yajñadattaṃ bhojayeti | saevā''lekhyapratimāpratimāpratibimbādiviṣayaḥ ākṛtyādumukhyāḥ | yathā bhavanabhittau kāmaṃ citritāḥ gāvaḥ kriyantāṃ, viṣṇuṃ pcāmṛtena snapaya, apsu candramasaṃ paśyeti | viparyayādhyāsavivartavipariṇāmādiviṣayo bhrāntyādimukhyaḥ | koyaṃkoyamanākāśe śaśī, sa eṣa bālābāhumūle bālacandramāḥ, tadetadalātacakraṃ visphurati, tadidamindrāyudhaṃ vilokyata iti | jaghanyo'pi tridhā gauṇa upacarito lākṣaṇikaśca | yayodrravyavācibhissāmānādhikaraṇyaprayoge viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ pratīyate sa gauṇaḥ | yathā gaurbāhīkaḥ, siṃho māṇavakaḥ, tṛṇaṃ lakṣmīḥ, goṣpadaṃ samudra iti | samānādhikaraṇaśabdaprayoge yo'nyaviśeṣaṇatvena prasiddhaḥ kutaścinnimittādanyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ labhate sa upacaritaḥ | yathā śuklaṃ yaśaḥ, madhuraṃ vākyam, surabhi śīlaṃ subhagaḥ svabhāva iti | yastu śabdaupāttenārthena kriyā... samarthenāvinābhāvāt sahacaraṇādi ...lākṣaṇiko yathā yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya, chatriṇo gacchanti, mañcāḥ krośanti, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasatīti || nanvevaṃ sati jātyādiśabdārthāḥ sarve lākṣaṇikā bhaveyuḥ, te'pi kahi svarūpeṇa kriyāṃ sādhayitumaparyāptaurjātyādibhiravinābhṛtavyaktirupatayopalakṣyante | naivam, jātyādipravṛttinimittānāṃ kriyāsiddhiṣu gaṅgātīradyarthānāmapi samanvayo dṛśyate | naivam, gaurālabhyatāṃ prokṣyatāṃ viśasyatāmutyādau anapekṣitavyaktīnāṃ gotvādijātīnāmapi | etanāruṇayā krīṇāti, abhikrāmaṃ juhotītyādau guṇakriyayodrranyavyadhānenāpi kriyāsamanvaye dravyāṇāmalākṣaṇikatvamevetyabhihitaṃ bhavati || nanu ca jātiguṇakriyāpākena jīvatīti naivam | atra jātyādināṃ viśeṣyate na dravyarūpatvāt | taduktaṃ vastūpalakṣaṇaṃ yatra sarvanāma prayujyate | dravyamityucyate so'rtho bhedyatvena vivakṣitaḥ || kṛtabhihitaśca bhāvo dravyavatprakāśata iti | evaṃ ca mukhyavṛttīnāṃ jaghanyavṛttīnāṃ ca śabdānāṃ prayoge yo'rtho yatra sambandhitvena upalambhāt | yadyevaṃ yajeta svargakāma ityādau svargayāgayoḥ sambandhitvenānupalambhātkathaṃ yogyatvenāvadhāraṇam, anavadhāritayogyatayośca kathamanvitābhidhānam? ucyate sāmānyenaiva yogyatvaṃ loke yadavadhāritam | yadanvitābhidhānasya vyutpattāvupalakṣaṇam || sādhyāsādhanayorlo ................... || sāmānyatmakasāmathryākhyāsambandho mukhyatā vyapekṣetyucyate | vyapekṣāvatāṃ padārthānāṃ mithaḥ sambandhirūpatā sāmathryam | tatrtridhā bhedaḥ, saṃsargaḥ, ubhayaṃ ca | tatra rājño bhṛtya ityādau yadā tāvadetadavadhṛtaṃ parāyattārthavṛttirayaṃ bhṛtyaśabdo na, svatantrārthavṛttiriti, tadā sāmānyena svamisaṃsargasyāvadhṛtatvāt svāmi... yati svayaṃ svāmyantaravyavacchedo bheda ityucyate | yadātu rājapuruṣa ityādāvanavagataparāyattabhāvasya puruṣasya svāmisambandhadyotanāya rājaśabdaḥ prayujyate tadā viśeṣasaṃsargasya śabdopādānatvādanavakāśo viśeṣāntarasampātaḥ tadā hyaśabdā svāmyantaranivṛttirarthādavasīyate | yadātvarthāvagatasāmathryayoḥ pratipattinibandhayorabhedāpekṣāyāṃ samāptāveva bhedasaṃsargeṇa sāmathryaṃ bhavati | yadā nīlaṃ ca datutpalaṃ ca nīlotpalamiti | yatra tu na samabandhayogyatā na tatra sāmathryaṃ yathā klidyate vastraṃ nīlamutpalamālikarṇe, neha kaścitparuṣaḥ, vyaghraḥ sarati, pallīṃ paśya, sakhe kaṣṭaṃ dūraṃ gaccha tvaṃ, yūpāya dārū śobhanaṃ śailānnivartasva, vyāghrādbhayaṃ devadattasya, yajñadattasya bhāryā, rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, brāhmaṇasya saktatvaṃ, akṣeṣu śauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, pibati pānāgāre, ayaṃ daṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ harā'nena phalāni, anatarā tvāṃ ca māṃ ca kamaṇḍaḍḍatdhluḥ, antareṇa takṣaśilāṃ pāṭaliputraṃ ca stridhnasya prākāra, odanaṃ paca tava bhaviṣvatīti | atra prathameṣvañcibhinnavākyatvāt tiṅṅatiṅa iti nighāto na bhavati | kaḥ puvarayaṃ sambandho nāma? ahānivryapekṣā vyatiṣaṅga iti | tathā hi sampūrvo badhvanātiraha ...... gargaiḥ sambandho'sti novatsaiḥ sambandhaḥ iti | tathā vyatiṣaṅge vartate, yo'yasā rajjvā vā kīlādau vyatiśatau vyatiṣakto bhavati sa sambandha ityucyate, tatra yadā sambandhasyāhānirarthaḥ tadā ūrīkaroti kārikākaroti śuklīkaroti paṭapaṭākaroti cakasāñcakāra, vidāṅkurvantu lunīhilunīhītyevāyaṃ lunāti bhrāṣṭramaṭa maṭhamaṭa khamādayaḥ prayogāḥ bhavanti | na hyete kadācidapyanyonyaṃ jahatīti | yadā sambandhaśabdasya vyapekṣā arthaḥ tadā gurukulaṃ devadattasya, sūryamapi na paśyanti asūryamapaśyā rājadārāḥ, kiñcidapi na kurvāṇaḥ, akiñcitkurvāṇaḥ, śaṅkulayā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ śaṅkulākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, dadhnopasiktaodano dadhnodanaḥ, aśreṇayaḥ śreṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ śreṇīkṛtāḥ, kaṇṭhe kālo'sya kaṇṭhekālaḥ, keśeṣu ca gṛhītvā pravṛttaṃ yuddhaṃ kośākeśītyādayaḥ prayogā bhavanti | etaiḥ samāsāvasthāyāmapi devadattādīnapekṣante | yadā tu sambandhaśabdasya vyatiṣaṅgo'rthastadopakumbhaṃ, nīlotpalaṃ, gaugarbhiṇī, pūrvakāyaḥ, saptarṣayaḥ, plakṣanyagrodhau, kaṣṭaśritaḥ, kākaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, iti ca mitho viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena vyatiṣajyante | yatra hi pūrvottarapadayoḥ saṅgatārthatā tatsāmathrye sambandhaḥ | sa viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva ityākhyāyate, tatra caikasya prādhānyamanyasyopasarjanatvaṃ | na hi pradhānayorupasarjanayoreva vā sambandhaḥ kalpate pradhānasyāparthatvādupasarjanasya parārthatvāt sambandhopalakṣitapadadvayaṃ parasparaṃ pradhānopasarjanabhāvena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāmāsādayati | sa ca pradhānopasarjanabhāvaḥ kadācicchabdanibandhanaḥ kadācidaśabdopādānaḥ sāmathryanāvasīyate | śabdanibandhano yadā vaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ upasarjanaśabdā hi pradhānopakārāya pariṇataṃ svārthamācakṣāṇāḥ sambandhinamabhidadhānāḥ prathamayaiva saṃskrīyante aśabdopādāno yadā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ aparārthatayā hi prātipadakasyāvyatirekevṛthāvirbhavati śabdaistadubhayodrravyaśabdatāyāmupapadyate, sā ca guṇadīnāṃ matublopādinā bhavati | so'yaṃ vibhaktibedataḥ sāmathryataśca pradhānopasarjanabhāvo dviprakāraḥ kalpyamāno mukhyavṛttyā upacāravṛttyā ca | sambandhavibhaktyā yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ yūpāya dāru, kārakavibhaktyā tu śriyamāṇakriyo'śrūyamāṇakriyaśca | śrūyamāṇakriyo yathā kaṣṭaśritaḥ, vyāghradbhayam | aśruyamāṇakriyo yathā śuṅkulayākhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ, akṣeṣuśauṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ | mukhyāvṛttyā yathā nūlamutpalaṃ, vīrapuruṣaḥ | upacāravṛttyā yathā puruṣo vyāghraḥ, siṃho māṇavakaḥ | viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorupasarjanapradhānabhāvaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇye vibhaktyabhedādaśakyaḥ śabdato'vadhārayituṃ, sambandhasāmathryāttu pratīyate | na hi sambandhaḥ pradhānayoreva vā sambhavati || nanu ca nīlamutpalamityekaikapadaprayogādanavacchinnānupahitāśrayamādhārādheyasāmānyaṃ padadvayāttu parasparopahitavyavacchedaṃ pratīyate, tata eva yogyatādi samprati yogyānvitasya vācakamiti |evaṃ ca smaratā smṛtameva anvitamapi svarīpamanvayavādino'pi nāyaṃ niyamaḥ śrūyamāṇa eva pūrvavarṇajanitasaṃskārasahito'ntyo varṇaḥ pratyāyaka iti | bāliśādhītāt prāganavadhṛtārthādaparijñāne saṃskṛtasya paścātsṛtādapi bhedārthāvagamadarśanāt, tena smṛtyārūḍhasyāgamakatvamadoṣaḥ, śrūyamāṇena hi padena pratiyogisāpekṣatvādanvitābhidhānasya prāksahakāri virahādartho'bhihitaḥ paścādabhidhīyata iti kimanupapannam | tathā cāha padajātaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ smāritānanvitārthakam | nyāyasampāditavyakti paścādanvitabodhakam || smṛtisannihitairevamarthairanvitamātmanaḥ | arthamāha padaṃ sarvamiti nānyonyasaṃkṣayam || kathaṃ punaranvitābhidhāyinā padena svarūpamātraṃ smārayituṃ śakyate? ucyate’nvitasyāpyabhidhānasvarūpamātrasya vidyamānatvānnāyaṃ niyamaḥ, yāvadgṛhītaṃ tāvatsnākartavyaṃ, apitvagṛhītaṃ tu na smaryata iti || nanu ca śabdasya svarūpābhidhānaśaktyabāvādaprāmāṇye kathaṃ śabdaśravaṇātvasvarūpasmaraṇaṃ bhavati? ucyate, na hi yatpramāṇaṃ tatsamṛtikaraṇaṃ, kintu pramāṇameva tat | yasya tu yena saha kācitpratyāsattiḥ pratītapūrvā sa tatra saṃskārodvodhadvāreṇa śaknotyeva smṛtimādhātum | asti ca svarūpasyāpi tadabhidheyāntargātyā śabdena saha pratyāsattiriti śaknoti tatrāpi svarūpapratītiṃ janayituṃ | yathā nirvikalpakadaśāpratītamarthasvarūpamātramabhidheyamapi śabdaṃ smārayati tathā śabdo'pyarthamiti na kiñcidanupapannam | tathā cāhur anvitasyābhidāne'pi svarūpaṃ vidyate sadā | tena svarūpamā'pi śabdo janayati smṛtim || yathārtheṃna pramāṇena svapadaṃ smāryate kkaciti | padenāpyapramāṇena tathārthaḥ smārayiṣyate || nanvevaṃ yathā smṛtivannihitatvāmāśrityānvitābhidhānaṃ padaiḥ kriyate tathā smaramasya pratyāsāttinibandhantavādanekeṣāṃ ca smaraṇināṃ pratyāsattisambhavātteṣu smṛtisannihiteṣvagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādukhāyāṃ pacatīti nokhāpacatyarthānvitaiva kevalābhidhīyeta, sā hi kalāyanirvāpādanvitāpi pratipanneti smaraṇāttadanvityukhābhidhīyeta | tathā pacatyartho'pīṣṭakādikarmako'vagata iti tatsmaraṇānnodanānvito'bhidhīyeteti | tanna śabdaiḥ smaritānāmanvayabodhakatvādvṛddhavyavahāre'pi tathā darśanādya eva hi śabdena smārito'rthastenaivānvitābhidhānamitikalāyanirvāpādyanvitāpyabhidhīyata iti || kuñcānvitārthābhidhāna evedaṃ pratiniyatārthānvayitvamupapadyate | yatpadāntarābhidheyatayā smāryate tadanvitasyaiva vṛddhavyavahāre vācyatvadarśanāt, yatrāpi cādhyāhārastatrāpi sannidhāpitāṃśena viśeṣānvitābhidhānalābha iti loka eva jñānamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ | api ca jñānaṃ tāvadanenāyamartho'nvito vācya iti yatra yadyanenāpyanvitābhidhānaṃ syāt vākyabhedo bhavet, na cāsāvekavākyatvasambhave nyāyyaḥ | taduktaṃ sambhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedaśca neṣyate || iti | ycoktamanvitābhidhānapakṣe'nvitasyaiva padārthasyābhidhānādaṅgulyagrādivākyeṣvaṣyanvayaḥ prāpnoti | tatra smṛtānāmaryarthānāmayogyatvenānvayābhāvādanabhidhānameva, padārthapratipattistu smṛtyaivopapadyata iti | yatpunaḥ puṃvacasāmarthe prāmāṇyābhyupagamātpadānāṃ vācakatvaśaktireva nāvadhāryate| kuto'nvitābhidhānamityetadeva tādvaktavyaṃ, na vayaṃ puruṣavākyānāmarthe prāmāṇyamabhyupagacchāmaḥ | yeṣāmapi cābhyupagamasteṣāmapi na doṣaḥ, yataḥ padamanvitābhidhāyakatvena vyitpannaṃ vyabhicārāśaṅkyā loke na tanniścāyakaṃ paścādāptatvālocanayānumite'rthe'nuvādakaṃ taditi prāmāṇyameva nāsādayati || nanu ca vācakatvamapi jahāti, paśya bālo hi vyutpadyamānaḥ prayojyavṛddhavyavahārasya śabdaśravaṇānantarabhāvinīṃ viśiṣṭaceṣṭānumitāṃ kriyāmanvitaśabdakaraṇikāṃ tāvadavagacchati sa tathāvyutpannaḥ kadācidananvitārthapadaracanāmupalabhate | tatropalabhamānasya tasyaiṣa vimarśai jāyate, sambhāvyamānānanvitārthapadavacanamidaṃ vākyaṃ kathaṃ vṛddhasyārthaniścayaḥ prākṛtavaddhṛddhasyāpi hi puruṣāyattavākyenānvitārthapadaracanāśaṅkāyāmayameva sambhavanniti tasyaivaṃ vicikitsāyāṃ punareṣa niścayo jāyate |kṛtamanenāyaṃ vaktā itthamavadhārito'nvitārthānyeva padāni prayuṅkte| tathāvidhapadaprayogaśca nāsyānupalabdhe'nvaya upapadyata ityevamanvayopalambhamanumāyānenānvayo niścitaḥ, niścitevānvaye vākyametadanuvādabhūtamadhyeti | evaṃ cedanuvādakatayā tasyārthasya tadvākyaṃ vācakameveti vācakaśaktijñānapūrvakaṃ nānarthamiti manyate | yadi paraṃ mayā prāganumāpurassaro'rthaniściyo'syeti nāvagataṃ, yāpi ceyamasyāniścite'nvaye viśiṣṭavaktujrñānānumā, sā'pi padānāṃ svarasataḥ sāmānyāvagamādeva nopapadyate, kintu viśeṣāvagamāt | na ca śakteranyaḥ padānāṃ viśeṣo'vakalpate | ato mayevānenāpyamīṣāṃ padānāṃ vācakaśaktiravadhāritā | tena viśiṣṭānvayavācakapadaprayogāttadviṣayaṃ vaktuḥ pūrvaṃ vijñānamanumitavāniti || nanvanantapratiyogyanvitasvābodhanaviṣayā anantā eva śabdasya śaktayaḥ parikalpayitavyāḥ syuḥ | abhihitatānvayavādetvekasminnarthe śabdasyaikaikaiva śaktiriti tanna | ekayānākāṅkṣitasannihitatattatpadagatasvārthābhidhānaśaktyā pratiyogibhedena cakṣurādīnāmiva kāryabhedopapatteḥ | yathaikayaiva darśanaśaktyā cakṣuḥ ghaṭādipratiyogisahāyabhedānnānājñānāni janayati, tathā śabdo'pi pratiyogibhedāditi mantavyam | padai revānvitasvārthamātropakṣīṇaśaktibhiḥ | padārthā bodhitā buddhau vākyārthe'pi tathāsati || iti | evaṃ caitadapyupapadyate saṃhatyārthamabhidhati padāni ekārthaparaḥ padasamūho vākyamiti saṅghātārthapāratantryātpadānāṃ svārthābhidhānaṃ na sambhavati | na ca saṅghātakāryamakurvanti kkacidapi padāni dṛśyante, na hyeṣāṃ saṅghātakārye svākārye ca pṛthakprayogo vidyate, sarvathāsaṅghātakārya eva prayogānnaivaṃ saṃhatānāṃ saṅghātakāryavatsvākāryasyāpyupalambhāt, yathā śakaṭāṅgānāmayamaṃ śo'nena kuto'yamaneneti | na ca śakaṭāṅgānyapi pṛthakprayujyamānāni svakāryaṃ kurvanti dṛśyante | kiṃ punaḥ padānāṃ svākaryaṃ svārthapratipattiḥ? kiṃ vā saṅghātakāryaṃ yāsau vākyārthapratipattiḥ? tañca padanāmekaikasya kṛtsnaphalaparyantavāyapārakāritvāt | tathā hyekaikasmin sati kṛtsnaphalaparyanto vyāpāro nivartate ekaikena vinā nivartata iti evaṃ kṛtsnakāribhavita kimatra padāntareṇakriyata iti cet sarvakārakeṣvapi tulyo'yamanuyogaḥ | tatra yathā saṃhatya kurvanti kāraṇādīni kāryāṇyucyante tathā saṃhatyāpyabhidadhati padānyadhabhidhāyakānyucyante || nanvākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatābhiścedanvayopapattirabhihitānvaya evāstu kimanvitābhidhānena? padeṣu hyananvitamapi svamarthamabhidhāyoparatavyāpākeṣvākāṅkṣādibhiḥ padārthānāmanvayapratītirbhaviṣyatīti | ucyate, kasyeyamākāṅkṣā śabdasyārthapramāturvā? śabdārthayostāvadacetanatvānnākāṃkṣā, pramātustvayaṃ tatra vāco yuktiḥ, śabdaḥ, śabdāntaramākāṅkṣātyartho'rthontaraṃ svatantrasyā''kāṃkṣā na pramāṇaṃ, puruṣecchāyā vastusthiterayujyamāntavācchabdapramāṇapṛṣṭhabhāvitvaṃ, natvartheṣu puruṣasyākāṅkṣā bhavantī, bhavatyarthānāṃ saṃsargaheturityevaṃ śabdasyaivāyamiṣoriva dīrghadīrgho vyāpārāḥ uparatavyāpāre tu śabde puruṣasyākāṅkṣāmātraṃ va sambandhākāraṇaṃ aśābdatvaprasaṅgātsākṣāñca śābdatvasambhave vyadhānāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt, ato nānyadanvitābhidhānāt saṃsargapratītessādhanamasti | na khalvānayagāṃśuklāmityādi vākyeṣu saṃsargapadaṃ prayujyate yataḥ saṃsargapratyayaḥ syāt | prayujyamānamapi daśadāḍiḍḍatdhmādivākyavadananvitārthameva syāt | tasmātpadānāmanvitābhidhānameva nyāyyamiti || abhihitānvayavādinaḥ punaritthamācakṣate | svaṃsvamarthamabhidhāya nivṛttavyāpārāṇi padāni bhavanti | athedānīṃ padārthā avagatāḥ ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatābhiranvayamupayanto vākyārthamavagamayanti || nanvevamaśābdaḥ syāt, pāramparyeṇāpi pratipādayatāṃ padānāṃ vākyārthe sāmathryasyāvighātāt | taduddeśena prayuktānāṃ padārthapratipādanamavāntaravyāpāro bhaviṣyati | na cāvāntaravyāparasya kārakantareṣvapi vyavadhāyakatvamiṣyate | tadāha || na vimuñcanti sāmathryaṃ vākyārthe'pi padāni naḥ | tanmātrāvasiteṣveṣu padārtheṃbhyaḥ sa gamyate || vākyārthamātra eteṣāṃ prayukte nāntarīkam | pāke jvāleva kāṣṭhānāṃ padārthapratipādanam || iti | tatra ca kriyāpadāni kriyāmātramabhidadhati, kārakapadāni tu kārakamātram, na vā mithassaṃsargaṃ na hyekapadoñcāraṇakāle padāntarārthapratītirasti | nacāpratīyamānenāpi saṃsargapratītirasti | nanu ca vṛddhavyavahārātpadānāṃ arthāvadhāraṇam | vṛddhāśca vākyenaiva vyavaharanti | na padena, vākayevānvitānāmeva padārtanāmupalambhāt, kathamucyate kriyāmātraṃ padebhyo'vagamyata iti? ucyate, satyaṃ vākyebhya eva padānāṃ vyutpattiḥ, sā tu kimekaghaṭanākārakasaṃhatavākyārthaniṣṭhā, kiṃ vā padārthaparyanteti cantanīyam? pūrvasmin pakṣe prativākyaṃ vyutpāttirapekṣaṇīyā | sā cānantyavyabhicāpādibhirbahumapramādā | padārthaparyantāyāṃ ca vyutpattau nūnaṃ nirdhāraṇīyamiyānasya padāsyārtha iti |anvitārthābhidhānavādino'pi niyataḥ ..... vikaraṇīyaḥ padārthaniyamānapekṣaṇe hi gāmānayeti vivakṣuraśvapadamapi nimittatayopādadīta | na hi tasyānapekṣitapadapadārthapravibhāgo vaiyākaraṇavadvākyārthapratyaya udeti | tasmādyānānāvāpodvāpaparyālocanayā padasyārtho nirdhāryate tāvāneva tasyārtha iti | nanvāsāṅkṣitayogyasannihitārthoparaktastasyārtho bhavatu sarvadā saṃhatya vyāpriyamāṇatvāt | naivam, sarvadā saṃhatya vyāpriyāmāṇasyāstu tāvān, yāvatyabhidhītrī tasya śaktiḥ | kīyatī ca tasyābhidhītrī śaktiḥ yāvantamarthamākāṅkṣitairyogyauḥ sannihitaiścasaṃyujyamānaṃ viyujyamānaṃ ca na muñcati kriyāmātraṃ kārakamātraṃ ca | atastāvatyevābhidhātrī śaktiranvavyatirekābhyāṃ tasya nirdhāryate | taduktaṃ, “avyabhicārāddhi tanmātrameva tadartho nādhikaṃ vyabhicārāt” iti | nanvatra śaktitrayakalpanāgauravalakṣaṇo doṣaḥ prāpnoti | padārthānāṃ hi śabdanyatā pramāṇajṛṣṭeti śabdābhidheyānāṃ teṣāṃ tadavabodhakatvaśaktiḥ kalpanīyā | tasyāścotpattau śabdasaṃsparśa eva heturityāśrayaṇīyam | śabdo hi viśiṣṭārthapratiparatayā loke prayujyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ, na cāsau sākṣādvākyārthapratipādane samartha iti padārthanavāntaravyāpārīkaroti | te ca yadyanyānvayabodhanasamarthāstadā teṣāmavāntaravyāpāratā syānnānyathā | padārthānāmapi viśiṣṭārthāvabodhaparaśabdasaṃsparśāstadā śaktirāvirbhanatīti śabdasyāpi padārthagataśaktyādhānaśaktiranumantavyeti | tyādetadevaṃ, yadi mānāntarāvaseyānāṃ padārthanāmanyonyānvayāvagamasāmathrye nāvadhāryate | avadhāryate ca śvaityasyānavadhāritāśrayaviśeṣasyāpratyakṣopalabdhasyāśvasya cāpratipannaguṇaviśeṣasya heṣāśabdānumitasya śveto'śvo dhāvatītyanvayaḥ | tadāha paśyataḥ śvaitimaṃ rūpaṃ heṣāśabdaṃ ca śrṛṇvataḥ | padanikṣepaśabdaṃ ca śvotośvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ || dṛṣṭāvākyavinirmukteti | arupamityavyaktarūpam | tena guṇaviśeṣo na pratyakṣeṇāvasīyata iti uktaṃ bhavati | atredaṃ paryanuyujyate kiṃ yena puruṣeṇa śvaityasamānāśrayau heṣādhvanipadanikṣepaśabdāvavagatau tadapādanadhyavasāyastasyāpīti | kimataḥ? yadi tāvadapratyākalitaheṣādhvanipādavihāranirghoṣāpādānasyetyucyate tadā pratītivirodhaḥ sa hyevaṃ pratipadyate bhavitavyamasmin deśe nūnamaśvena bhāvyaṃ kenaciddhāvateti | athāśvasambāndhinameva khurapuṭaṭaṅkāraravamabhyāsapāṭavavaśādivaiti tadāsāvaśvavartinīṃ vegavatīṃ gatimanuminoti na punaḥ kevalāmevāvagamya tasmin pratibudyate, yo'pyasmin deśe nāstyanyo'śva iti niścitya pāriśeṣyādapādānānadhyavasāye'pi heṣādhvaneḥ śvaityasamānādhikaraṇamaśvatvaṃ antargṛhadarśanamiva bahirbhāvāvagatāvarthāpattiḥ | yo'śvetaḥ sa evāśva iti pramāṇam | yastu śvetatevasamānādhikaramaheṣādhvanikhurapuṭaṭaṅkāraravāvadhyasyati tasyāśvatve vegavati ca gamane śvetadravyavartinyekānumānaṃ tatsambandhāvagatārthānāṃ na kkacidanumānārthāpattivyatirekeṇānvayabodhakatvaṃ pratītam | api ca yadi padārthāvagatimātrādevānvayāvagamastadā kasmin pramāṇo'syāntarbhāva iti vācyam? na tāvacchabde śabdābhāvāt padārthābhidhānāvāntaravyāpāreṇa hi yacchabdādanvayajñānaṃ na tacchābdamityabhihitānvayavādināṃ siddhānta iti kathaṃ śabde antarbhavaḥ? pramāṇāntarābhyupagame tu śabdasyocchedaḥ śābdasya padārthāviṣayatayā pramāpitasyaiva prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt | tasmācchabdānabhihitānāṃ padārthavāmanyatrādṛṣṭaṃ vākyārthāvabodhanasāmathryamapi parikalpayitavyam | tadādhānaśaktiśca śabdānāmapīte kalpanālāghavācchabdānāmevānvitasvārthabodhanaśaktimātraṃ kalpayituṃ nyāyyam | athocyate, ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatāvantaḥ padārthā eva vākyārthībhavanti, na punarvākyārthamavabodhayantīti | tadatimandam, pūrvapadārthe sākāṅkṣe yatpadārthantaramucarati tatsambandhitayaiva svārthamupanayati pratyāyayat | yathā prakṛtyarthe pūrvapratīte pratyaya uñcāryamāṇaḥ svārthe tadviśiṣṭamevābhidhatte tathā padārthantaramapīti | taduktaṃ prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe sahabrūta iti | prakṛtiḥ svārthe pratyayārthe viśeṣaṇatvenopanayantī pratyayena saha tadarthamāhetyarthaḥ | tathācoktaṃ nityaṃ viśeṣṭa evārtho pratyayo yatprayujyate | tatpūrvataravijñātuḥ prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇāt || iti | aṅgīkṛtaṃ tarhi dvitīyasyānvitābhidhānaṃ prathamasya tathāpi nāstīti cenna, vākye padānāṃ prayogakramaniyamābhāvāt | yadeva kadācitprathamaṃ tadeva kadāciddvitīyamiti sarvapadānāmanvitābhidhānamāpatitam | kiñca pratyayaścedanvitābhidhīyī tadā tadaviśeṣāt padānāmanvitābhidhāyitā kimiti nābhyupeyate, kimardhavaiśasena? atrābhidhīyate, lākṣaṇikā eva sarve vākyārthāḥ, tataśca na padārthānāmanvayabodhane śaktigauravam | ananvitāvastho hi padenārtho'bhihito'nvitāvasthāṃ svasambandhinīṃ lakṣayati | avasthāvasthāvatorhi saṃbandhādasthāvatyavagate bhavatyavasthā buddhisthā sarvatra saṃbandhini dṛṣṭe sambandhāntare buddhirbhavatīti siddhamava | tena nāstipadārthānāmanvitabodhane śaktikalpaneti | tadāha vākyartho lakṣyamāṇo hi sarvatraiveti lakṣyate | iti | kathaṃ punariyaṃ lakṣaṇā? vācyasyārthasya vākyarto sambandhānupapattitaḥ | tatsambandhavaśāprāptasyānvayo lakṣaṇocyate || tadyathā gaṅāgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ prativasatītyādiśrautasya gaṅgārthasya vākyānvayāsambhavāttatparityajya ttasambandhavataḥ sannidheḥ kūlasya vākyanvitatādhyasīyate | ata eva cāhur anupapattyā sambandhena ca lakṣaṇā bhavati | iha ca gāmānayetyādau śrotasyānvayāyogyatvaṃ, nāpyanvitāsthāsyānyanasambandhārhatā | anvitasyānvayāntarābhāvāt | āpe ca sarvavākyārthānāṃ lākṣaṇikatve mikhyasyaiva pityāgāpattiḥ | atha mābhūdeṣā lakṣaṇā | kintu kriyāvagatakārakānvayinīcā''tmano daśāmavagamayatyavinābhāvitvādityucyate | śābdatvaṃ tāvaditthamapahastitaṃ bhavatyanayā'vagamyasya | kintu athākāṅkṣitasannihitayogyānvayaparatā vṛddhavyahāreṇa padānāmavagateti | tadanvayāvagamaḥ | tanna, vṛddhāvyavahāra eva kathaṃ tatparatā padānāmupāyābhāve virvahatviti cintā, sā hi padānāṃ padārthānāṃ vā śaktikalpanāṃ vinānupapanneti manyāmahe | sā ca padānāmevocitā | yadāha prāthamyādibhidhātṛtvāttātparyāvagamādapi | padānāmeva sā śaktiḥ kaparamityagamyatām || prathamabhāvīni hi padānyatilaṅghiṣu
