dharmakalpanā laghīyasīti anvikābhidhānaśaktiḥ padānāmeva kalpayitumucitā | kiñca padānyabhidhāyakānīṣyante | tatra yadi svarūpamātraviṣayāmeva buddhimādadhyurabhidhāyakatā hīyate, tasyā buddhaiḥ sambandhagrahaṇasamupajātasaṃskāro'vaśyaṃ hi sambandhasmaramasiddhyarthaṃ sambandhibhūtārthasādhāraṇasaṃskāro'ṅgīkaraṇīyaḥ | tasmātsambandhagrahaṇasamayānadhigatānanvitārthapratipādanābhyupagama eva śabdānāmabhidhāyakateti tāmaṅgīkurvatā padānāmanvitābhidhāyitā''śrayaṇīyā | yastu, padamabhyadhikābhāvātsmākarānna viśiṣyate | bhāvanāvacanastāvattāṃ smārayati lokavat || ityārthavacane darśanāt | abhidhānaśaktivatsmārakatāmeva padānāmabhidhāyakatāṃ manyate | nāpi tāvatpadānāṃ vākyārthaparatābhyupagantavyā, anyathā vākyarthāsyāśābdatvaprasaṅgāte | evaṃ cetpadānāmeva sākṣādvākyārthabodhane śaktirastu | kiṃ parampārāśrayaṇena? evaṃ ca padapadārthoṣu padānāṃ smārakatvātiriktaṃ ye'bhidhākatvāmāhusteṣāṃ śaktitrayakalpanā | ekā tāvatpadānāmabhidhānaśaktiḥ bodhaśaktyādāśaktiḥ padārtanāmanvayajñāpanaśaktiriti smārakatvavādināṃ hitvā śaktidvayakalpānā | anvitābhidhāne puranekaiva śaktiriti śaktikalpanālāghavādanvitābhidhāyīnyeva padānīti nyāyyaṃ, na purabhihitānāmanvaya iti | atrocyate, yattāvatpadārthānāmanvayabodhakatve śaktitrayakalpanāgauravamityuktaṃ tat na samyak pramāṇāntarāvagatānāṃ padārthanāmanvayabodhakatvadarśanāt dṛśayate | paśyataḥ śvaitimaṃ rūpaṃ heṣāśabdaṃ ca śrṛṇvataḥ | khuranikṣepaśabdaṃ ca śveto'śvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ || na caitadvācyaṃ, arthāpattyanumānayorayaṃ vyāpāraḥ, tadviṣayāyāḥ pratīteriha vivakṣitatvāt | yatra hyākāṅkṣāditrayopetāḥ padārthā evānyonyamanvayaṃ gamayanti, na tatrārthāpattyādyanumānayovryāpāraḥ | yathā surabhi candanaṃ, svādu sahakāramiti | na cātra viśiṣṭapratipattau pratyakṣameva vyāpriyate, cakṣirādīnāṃ rūpādinaiyatyena parasparaviṣayeṇājñātatvāt | tathā hi na gandhādyupalabdhaucakṣuḥ vyāpriyate | nāpi rūpādyupalabdhau dhrāṇamiti | asti ca surabhicandanamityādau viśiṣṭārthapratipattiḥ | evaṃ śveto'śvo dhāvatītyatrāpi draṣṭavyam | yañcātroktaṃ kasmin pramāṇo'syāntarbhāva iti tena na kasmaścitpramāṇe'ntarbhāvaḥ | kintu pramāṇaphalametat | yadi vā padārthaevātra pramāṇam, teṣāṃ ca śabda evāntarbhāvānna saptamapramāṇāttiḥ | padārthā hi śabdātpramāṇāntarato vā pratipannā ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatābhiḥ kriyākārakādirūpeṇa cetpratīyamānāḥ saṃsargabuddhiṃ janayanti | śābdamevaitadbhavati | yatpunarākaṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatāvantaḥ padārthā eva vākyārthībhavantītyupanyasya dūṣitaṃ, tatra na vayamevaṃ brūmaḥ padārthā eva vākyārthībhavantīti | kintarhi gamayanti | yca pratyayadṛṣṭāntena dvitīyapadasyānvitābhidhāyitve'rdhavaiśasamuktaṃ tadapi nāsti prakṛtipratyayorapi padanadevānvayavyatirekāvadhāritavyatiriktaśaktikayorabhihitānvayasyaivopapatteḥ | pākaṃ hi pacirevāha kartāraṃ pratyayo'pyakaḥ | pākayuktaḥ punaḥ kartā vācyo naikasya kasyacit || prakṛtipratyayau būtaḥ pratyayārthaṃ saheti ca | bhedenaivābhidhāne'pi prādhānyādevamucyate || lākṣaṇikāvākyārthaviṣaye tu mṛṣaivopalabdhāḥ smaḥ | nahi gāmānayetyādau lakṣaṇāsmābhiriṣyate | gaṅgāyaṃ ghoṣa ityādau na caiṣā pratiṣidhyate, tena na mukhyalākṣaṇikāvākyārthapravibhāgānupapattiḥ | yadapi kriyā'vagatā kārakānvayinīmātmano daśāmavagamayatyavinābhāvitvādityasmin pakṣe viśeṣānavadhāraṇamaśābdatvaṃ ca doṣa ityuktaṃ tadapyanumatameva | na hyavinābhāvato viśiṣṭā vākyārthapratītiriti manyāmahe, apitvākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatābalena | ākāṅkṣādisadbhāve ca śābdātvaṃ bhavatyevetyābhihitaṃ purastāt | yañca prāthamyādibhiḥ padānāmevānvayabodhanaśaktirastviti vāditannatrabhidhānaśaktiḥ padānāmiṣyata eva | anyayaparyantatā tu tasyā neṣyate, vākyārthapratīteranyathāpyupapadyamānatvāt | vākyārthe hi tātparyaśaktiḥ padānāṃ vyapriyate, nābhidhītrī | tañca prathamadaśāṃ vivañcatā bhavatānvitābhidhānamabhyupagatam | tca na yuktam | sarvatrābhidhātryāḥ śakteraviśeṣeṇa pravṛttau padārthanaiyatyānavadhāraṇe padāntaroñcāravaiyathryādidoṣaprasaṅgāte | padāntarānuñcāraṇe trayeṇānvitamarthamabhidadhāti gośabdaḥ | sa nābhidhīyate tatsaṃsargaścābhidhīyata iti pratiṣiddham | tadabhidhāne tu tadvitsaṃbandhābhidhānamityekameva gopadaṃ sarvārthaṃ syāt | tasmanna sarvatrābhidhātrī śaktiḥ śabdasyopapadyata iti nānvitabhidhānam | etena yaduktaṃ padārthānāṃ bodhanaśaktireva kalpyā, padānāṃ tu klṛptānāmevānvayaparyantateti dharmikalpanāto dharmakalpanā labīyasīti anvitābhidhānameva yuktamiti, tadapi nirastaṃ bhavati | yañcokaṃ sambandhasmaraṇāvagatasambandhipratipattisiddhānvitārthagocaraivābhidhānaśāktirastviti, tadapyanupapannam | sambandhasmaparaṇasavyapekṣasya padasyābhidhāyakatvāt | na cānvite sambandhasmaraṇaṃ bhavati | pratiyogināmānantyena sambandhasya grahītumaśakyatvāt | tasmānniṣkṛṣṭapadārthamātraviśayatvamevābhyupagamanīyam | yattvadhigataviṣayatvaṃ dūṣaṇamuktaṃ tadaṣyata eva | ata eva na padaṃ padārthe pramāṇaṃ, adhigataviṣayatvāt | anadhigatārthagantṛ hi pramāṇaṃ bhavati | na ca padasya svarthe smārakatvameva | yadāha padamabhyadhikābhāvātsmarakaṃ na viśiṣyate | natu smārakameva bhavati | tasmātpadānāmabhihitānvaya eva nyāyya iti | ubhayavādinastvevamāmavanti, sāmānyato'nvitabhidhānaṃ viśeṣato'bhihitānvaya iti | gośabdo hi svārthamanavagataviśeṣaguṇakriyāsāmānyānvitamabhidhatte | tadetatsāmānyenānvitābhidhānam | śuklādiguṇaviśeṣastu padāntarādavagamyate | so'yaṃ viśeṣaṃṇābhihitānvaya iti | api ca kriyākārakasaṃsargarūpo vākyārthaḥ kriyāsambandhamantareṇa kārakatvānukapapatteḥ | viśeṣeṣu cānantayavyabhicārādidoṣātkriyāsāmānyānvita eva | kārake kārakapadānāṃ sambandhāgrahaṇaṃ, saṃbandhānusāreṇa cābhidhānāt | sāmānye'nvitābidhānameva ghaṭate | vyavahārakāle ca kriyāviśeṣānvitānāmeva kārakāṇāmupasambhāt | kriyāṇāmapi ca kārakaviśeṣānvitānāṃ pratīteḥ śabdavyāpārasya sāmānyānvayābhidhānenaiva parisamāpterviśeṣeṣvabihitānvaya eva yujyate | evaṃ ca padāntaroñcāraṇamapi na vyartha bhavati, apekṣitakriyākārakaviśeṣasamarpakatvenārthavattvāt | yadyapi cātra kriyākārakamātrānvayābhidhāne kriyākārakamātrasambandhitvaṃ kriyākārakasāmānyābhiprāyam | tathāhi, svārthamātropādāyinaḥ sarvabhedānprati yogyatā, tadevānuguṇyamātraṃ sāmānyaṃ, na hi tathānyathā sarvathā veti sāmānyamavasthitarūpaṃ kiñcidasti, sarva eva te viśeṣa eva | tasyāstu sāmānyāvasthāyāṃ bhedasya kasyacidanirūpaṇādatyāgāñca yā sarvabhedopagrahayogyatayā pariplavamānārthakalpanā tāṃ sambandho viṣayāntarādavācchadya viśiṣṭe viśiṣṭe viṣaye niyamayati | taduktaṃ sarvabhedānuguṇyaṃ tu sāmānyamapare viduḥ | tadarthāntarasaṃsargādbhajate bedarūpatām || bhedānākāṅkṣātastasya sā pāriplavamānatā | avacchinatti sambandhaṃ tāṃ viśeṣe niveśayan || ata eva ca nānekavākyārthapratītiḥ | sarveṣāṃ kārakāṇāṃ karmādibhāvena vyavasthitānāmeva kriyāsambandhāt | na ca prathamāśritādapyayarthapratītiḥ, vidyamānasyāpyanvayasya sambandhagrahaṇamantareṇānupalabdheḥ | na caikapadoñcāramakāle sakalavākyārthapratītiḥ, tadānīṃ viśeṣasamarpakapadaprayogāyogāt | yadyevaṃ sāmānyenānvitābhidhānamevāstu, kiṃ viśeṣeṇābhihitānvayena | vṛddhavyavahāraprasiddhasambandho hi śabdo'rthasya vācakaḥ | anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ca sambanadhāvadhāraṇam | na ca viśeṣānvayaviṣayau tau sambhavataḥ | kriyāpadaṃ hi kārakatāmāmānyavyabhicāriṇyā kriyayā sahānvayavyatirekau bhajate, viśeṣānvaye viśeṣāntaravyabhicārāt | evaṃ kārakapadamapi | tanna, viśeṣānvaye'pi ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatvopādhivaśena sambanaadhagrahaṇaṃ sukaramiti tadabhidhāyitaiva yuktā padānām | yadi cāsau neṣyate tadā vākyārthapratītireva nopapadyate, vākyārthasya viśeṣānvayarūpatvāt | nanu ca sāmānyānvayo'bhihito viśeṣasya sāmānyasyaiva pratyetumaśaktatvāt | naivam | yathā jātivryaktimākṣipantyapi na pratiniyataṃ viśeṣamākṣipati, tathātrāpi niyataviśeṣābhāvānniyataviśeṣātmakavākyārthapratītirūpapannā | nanu viśeṣaṇāmātrākṣe'pi ya ākāṅkṣitaḥ sannihito yogyaśca viseṣaḥ padāntareṇa samapryate sa eva gṛhyata iti | tadatikrame pramāṇābhāvāt | etadapi na samyak | sāmānyānvitābhidhānavādīno hi mate padāni tāvattanmātraparyavasitaśaktīni, padārthānāmapicānvayabodhanaśaktirnāṅgīkriyate | na ca sāmānyākṣepo'pi niyataviśeṣamāskandati | tenākāṅkṣite yogye ca viśeṣapadāntareṇa sannidhāpite tadanvayabodhakarramāṇābhāvādavanvayo na pratīyate | ata ākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatvānnayanupayogīnyeva | viśeṣānvitābhidhānavādinastu mate sambandhagrahaṇaṃ pratyupādhitvenānupraviṣṭāni vākyārthapratipattāvupayujyante | padātpadārthaḥ padārthāntarasambandho boddhavya ityasyāṃ vyutpattāvupādhitvena yogyatavādikarmānupraviśadviśeṣānvitābhidhānavādinaḥ pakṣamapākaroti, na sāmānyābhidhānavādina iti | kiñca kriyākārakasvabhāvālocanayāpi kārakamātreṇānvayasiddhervṛthā sāmānyamātrānvayābhidhāyakatā śabdasyāṅgīkriyate | tasmāttadukta eva nyāyaḥ śreyān, sāmānyonānvitābhidhānaṃ, viśeṣeṇābhihitānvaya iti | yuktaṃ caitatpadasya prakṛtipratyayātmakatvāt | pade hi pacatītyādau prakṛtyarthaḥ pratyārthaśca sāmānyaviśeṣāvagamarūpamanyonyānvitaṃ pratīyate | tatra pacītyeṣā prakṛtiḥ siddhasādhyatvādidharmavinirmuktaṃ pratyayārthamātrānvayayogyaṃ pākasāmānyamātramabhidhadadhāti | atipratyayastu paurvāparyaniyamānna prakṛtivatsvāntraḥ sāmānyamātre dhiyamādadhāti | api tu prakṛtārthāpekṣāyācakṣāṇaḥ svārthaṃ viśeṣameva samarpayatīti | anubhavavādinaḥ punaritthaṃ samarthayante nānvitābhidhānaṃ kintarhi samuditaiḥ padaireko vākyārthaḥ pratyāyyate | sa ca guṇabhūtetarapadārthasaṃsṛṣṭaḥ kaścitpadārtha eveti | nanu kimayamanvitābhidhānapakṣaḥ punarutthāpayitumiṣṭaḥ | maivam, nedamanvitābhidhānam | kiṃ tarhi saṃhatyakāratā padānām? ucyate, saṃhatyakāratāpyasti | na cānvitābhidhānam | anvitamarthe padāni saṃhatya saṃpādayanti | na tvanvitamabhidadhati | kimidānīṃ kurvanti vākyārthaṃ padāni, ghaṭamiva mṛdādīni? etadīpe nāsti, jñāpakatvātteṣām | kā tarhīyaṃ vāco yuktiḥ? saṃhatyakārīṇī padāni, na cānvitamabhidadhatīti imāni padānyanvitaṃ pratyāyayanti, nābhidadhatīti nābhidhātrī śaktiranvitaviṣayā, kintvanvayavyatirekāvagataniṣkṛṣṭasvārthaviśayaiva | tātparyaśaktistu teṣāmanvitāvagamaparyantā saha vyāpārāt vyāpārasya tadīyanirākāṃkṣapratyayotpādanaparyantatvāt | tathāhi anyathaiva pranartante pratyakṣānyudbhavāddhiyaḥ | arthaṃ pūrvamapūrvaṃ vā darśayantyaḥ puraḥ sthitam || anyathaiva mitaśśabdī viṣayeṣu vijṛmbhate | pratipatturanākāṅkṣapratyayotpādanāvadhiḥ || ata eva padaṃ loke kevalaṃ na prayucyate | na hi tena nirākāṅkṣā śroturīdhīyeta matiḥ || nanvibhidhānavyatiriktaḥ ko'nyaḥ śabdasya kṛtsnaphalaparyantapratyāyanātmā vyāpāraḥ | asti kaścidyaḥ sarvaireva saṃsargavādibhirapratyākhyeyaḥ | na hi saṃsargo'bhidhīyate | pratayate ca vākyat | nanu saṃsṛṣṭābhidhāne sati saṃsargaḥ pratīyate, nānyathā | naitadevam, saṃhatyākāritvādeva saṃsargāvagamasiddheḥ | na hi saṃsargakāraṇaṃ na sspṛṣṭaṃ ca kāryaṃ kkacitaddṛśyate | api ca prakṛtipratyayau hi parasparasāpekṣamarthābhidhāyinau | na ca prakṛtyā pratyāyārtho'bhidhīyate, niyogya dhātuvācyatvāt | na ca pratyayena prakṛtyartho'bhidhīyate, yajyāderliṅādyarthānupapatteḥ | na ca tau pṛthaksvakāryaṃ rurutaḥ | evaṃ padānyapi parasparāpekṣīṇi saṃhatya kāryaṃ kariṣyanti | na ca parasparasyārthamabhidhāsyanti vākyānyapi prakaramapatitānyenameva | taduktaṃ prakṛtipratyayau yaddhadapekṣete parasparam | padaṃ padāntaraṃ tadvadvākyaṃ vākyāntaraṃ tathā || iti | ayameva ca pakṣaḥ śreyān | saṃhatyakāritvaṃ padārthānāṃ saṅkīrṇānāñca | nirapekṣaprayoge yā sakalā kalpanā bhavet | tadanvitabhidhāne tu padāntamanarthakam || saṃhatyakāripakṣe tu doṣo naikopi yujyate | tenāyamupagantavyo mārgo vigatakaṇṭakaḥ || abhidhītrī matā śaktiḥ padānāṃ svārthāniṣṭhatā | teṣāṃ tātparyaśaktistu saṃsargāvagamāvadhiḥ || tenānvitābhidhānaṃ hi nāsmābhiriha mṛṣyate | anvitapratipattistu bāḍhamabhyupagamyate || saṃhatyakāritvāñcā padānāṃ na svārtha eva tātparyārthamuñcāraṇaṃ, apitu pradhānakāryameva kartum | taduktaṃ vākyārthamitaye teṣāṃ pravṛttau nāntarīyakam | pāke jvālena kāṣṭhānāṃ padārthapratipādanam || tasmānnānvitābhidhānaṃ nāpyabhihitānāmanvayaḥ | kinti yathopanyāstapakṣa eva śreyāniti | tadevamākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatāvantaḥ padārthaścatuṣprakāramanvayamanubhavanto vākyārthībhavanti | nanu cāyogyatāyāmapyanvayo dṛśyate, bhavati paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti | nahi sādhyaikasvabhāvāyāḥ sādhyatvaṃ sādhananvaṃ ca yujyata iti | naivam, sādhyatvenaiva sādhanatvāt | kriyābhyupapattirūpeṇa bhavanasvabhāvā sādhyasvabhāvenaiva kramarūpā | yadeva cāsyā anidantānirdeśyamapariniṣṭhitaṃ bhavanaṃ sādhyaikarūpaṃ tenaivaiṣātra sādhyabāvaṃ ca pratipadyata iti siddhātāvabhāsaḥ kuta iti cet? kartaryutpanno lakārastāṃ siddhatvenāvabhāsayati | yathā corasya rujatīti | dhātvartha eva rogalakṣaṇaḥ, katrrantarāśravaṇāt sādhyarūpeṇaiva kartṛbhāvamanubhavatsiddhatayāvabhāsate | yadi vā padasya na padarapamevādhikārthatā kintarhi vākyarūpāt? tadyathā puruṣa iti padakāle puruṣo vyatiriktā ucyate | yadā tu rājñaḥ puruṣa iti viśeṣaṇasannidhiyogyastadāṣasya vyatireko bhavati, puruṣaviśeṣo'yaṃ rājapuruṣa iti| evaṃ pacatīti naitasmātpadarūpādevādhikārthatvam | yadā tu bhavatīti padāntarasannidhiḥ tadā vākyakāle puruṣasyeva vyatireka upajāyata iti | yadi vā na kadācidaparā tadatirekiṇī bhavanakriyā, kaścidaparo vā kartā virodhaheturasti | apitu saiva vyapadeśivadbhāvanyāyena kriyārūpatāṃ bhavitṛtvaṃ ca darśayantī cakāsti | api caikasyāpyarthasya viṣayabhedena dvidharmatvaṃ dṛśyate yathā rājñaḥ puruṣasya putra iti puruṣaḥ, śeṣī ca bhavati śeṣaśceti rājānaṃ pratiśeṣī | avicalitasvārthaputrārthāntaraṃ vicalitasvārthaḥ śeṣatvamāpadyate | evaṃ bhavati pacatītyatra bhavato'kartṛtvaṃ sādhyatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra ca mṛgo kartari sādhyabhāvaṃ prādhānyaṃ cājahatsaraṇaṃ dṛśāvaṅgatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ ca gamiṣyatīti | atavāyamarthaḥ sādhanamayaṃ sādhyamiti pusiddhamātrametat | yathā pade ayaṃ prakṛtyartho'yaṃ pratyayārtha iti eka evāsāvartho viśeṣṭo vā khaṇḍa, eva pratīyate | yathā muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati carcayatīti | atra muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati māṇavakamiti miṇḍiḍḍatdhḥ keśacchedanavacanaḥ | asya tu vyutpattiḥ muṇḍaṃ, karotīti | karotiṃ sāmānyapravṛttaṃ viśeṣe muṇḍaḍḍatdhśabdo'vasthāpayati | karotiviśeṣo'yaṃ yasmiṇṇijitpadyate na karotimātram | evaṃ carcāṃ karoti carcayatīti | ataḥ kecinmuṇḍiḍḍatdhcarcādīṃścirādiṣu paṭhanti miṇḍaḍḍatdhkeśakhaṇḍaḍḍatdhneṣu muṇḍaḍḍatdhyati carcayatīti | evaṃ paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti | idamatra sādhanapadamidaṃ sādhyamityutprekṣaiṣā | idaṃ tvarthasatatvam| nātra saraṇaṃ, na darśanaṃ, na mṛgaḥ | kintarhi mṛgakartṛko dṛśikarmā saraṇaviśeṣo'yaṃ khaṇḍo vākyārthaṃ iti | etena putramicchati putrīyatītyīdayo'pi vyākhyātāḥ | vyapekṣāvatāṃ samarthānāmanvitārthānāṃ ca padārthānāṃ tilataṇḍuḍḍatdhlavat kṣīranīravat pāṃsasūkavañca yadavibhāgarūpeṇa bhavanaṃ sa ekārthībhāvaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ caitatsamastaṃ vyastaṃ ca | tena sāpekṣāsamarthasamāsadīnāmupasaṅgrahaḥ | kaḥ puranasya vyapekṣāto bhedaḥ? ucyate, vyapekṣāyāṃ saṅkhyāviśeṣe vyaktābhidhānamupasarjanaviśeṣaṇaṃ cayogaḥ kramāniyamo vyavadhānaṃ yatheṣṭamanyamekavadbhāvaḥ ekaśeṣaḥ | anekavidhānāmaikyamekavidhānaṃ cānaikyamiti | tadyāthā vyapekṣāyāṃ saṅkhyaviśeṣaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, rājño puruṣaḥ, rājñāṃ vā puruṣaḥ | ekārthībhāve tu tadabhāvo rājapuruṣaḥ | vyapekṣāyāṃ vyaktibhidhānaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣa ityatra loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ vibhaktilopoveti nābhidhānavyaktiḥ vyapekṣāyāmupasarjanasya viśeṣaṇaṃ, ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ | ekārthībhāve tadabhāvaḥ, rājapuruṣaḥ | vyapekṣāyāṃ ca yogaḥ, rājñaḥ puruṣo brāhmaṇasya ca | ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣaḥ, vyapekṣāyāṃ kramāniyamo rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ | ekārthībhāve tu rājapuruṣoyamityeva | vyapekṣāyāṃ yatheṣṭamanyareṇābhisambandhaḥ, rājñaḥ puruṣo bhāryā veti | ekārthībhāve tu niyamataḥ puruṣeṇaiva sambandho na bhāryayā | vyapekṣāyāṃ śabdāntaraprayogo dadhnopasiktaṃ pariglāno'dhyayanāya | ekārthībhāve tu naivam, dadhyodanaṃ paryadhyayana iti | ekārthībhāne aikapadyaṃ yathātmānā tṛtīyaḥ kaṇṭhe kāla iti | aikaśabdhaṃ yathā pitarau bhrātarāviti | aikasvaryaṃ yathā citraguḥ, brāhmaṇakambala iti | ekavibhaktitvaṃ yathā nīlotpalaṃ, rājapuriṣa iti | ekavadbhāvo yathā gavāśvaṃ, plakṣanyagrodha iti | ekaśeṣo yathākṣā vṛkṣā iti |anekavidhānāmaikyaṃ yathā putramicchatyātmanaḥ putrīyati, muṇḍaṃ, karoti muṇḍaḍḍatdhyatīti | ekavidhānāmanaikyaṃ yathā kaṃsavadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaṃ ghātayati, puṣyacandrayogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa candraṃ yojayatīti | vyapekṣāyāṃ tu naivamiti | so'yamekārthībhāvo vyapekṣāvailakṣaṇyena viprathamānassamānassamāsataddhitākhyādiṣu triṣu tridhā vikhyāyate, vākyatulyārthaḥ vākyādhikārthaḥ vākyānyārtha iti | vākyatulyārtho yathā vīraḥ puruṣo vīrapuruṣaḥ, kaṣṭaṃ śritaḥ kaṣṭaśrita iti | vākyādhikārtho yathā guḍeḍḍatdhna miśrā dhānāḥ guḍaḍḍatdhdhānāḥ, śaṅkulayākṛtaḥ khaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ śaṅkulakhaṇḍa, iti | vākyānyārtho yathā kuśaṃ lātīti kuśalaḥ, prakṛṣṭo pravīṇaḥ | athāyaṃ triprakāro'pyanekadhā bhidyate | tadyathā nityasamāsaḥ, nityāsamāsaḥ, asamarthasamāsaḥ, aluksamāsaḥ, sāpekṣasamāsaḥ, nirapekṣasamāsaḥ, pūrvapadapradhānaḥ, uttarapadapradhānaḥ, ubhayapadapradhānaḥ, anayapadapradhānaḥ, anyathopasarjanaḥ, tiṅsamāsaḥ, prātipadikasamāsaḥ, upapadasamāsaḥ, prādisamāsaḥ, nañsamāsaḥ, ekadeśisamāsaḥ, sāmānayasamāsaḥ, viśeṣasamāsaḥ, samānādhikaraṇaḥ, bhinnadhikaraṇaḥ, upamānasamāsaḥ, upameyasamāsa iti | teṣu nityasamāso yathā lobitaśāliḥ, gaurakharaḥ, uddālapuṣpabhañjikā, dantalekhaka iti | nityāsamāso yathākiñcitkurvāṇaḥ, amāṣaṃ haramāṇa, agādhamutsṛptāḥ, chātrāṇāṃ pañcam iti | asamarthasamāso yathāsūryaṃpaśyā rājadārāḥ, apunargeyāḥ ślokāḥ, aśrāddhabhojī brāhmaṇaḥ, alavaṇabhojī bhikṣuriti | aluksamāso yathā stokānmuktaḥ, ātmanā tṛtīyaḥ, paśyato haraḥ, kaṇṭhe kāla iti | sāpekṣasamāso yathā yajñadattasya bhrātṛbhāryā, viṣṇumitrasya gurukulam, cūtasya phalarasaḥ, priyāyāḥ stasparśa iti | nirapekṣasamāso yathā varṣaśatamāyurasya śatāyuḥ, śākapradhānaḥ pārthivaḥ śākapārthivaḥ, aśvayukto ratho'śvarathaḥ, aśreṇayaḥ śreṇayaḥ kṛtāḥ śreṇīkṛtā iti | pūrvapadapradhāno yathopakumbham, nirmakṣikam, bahigrrāmam, pārogaṅgamiti | uttarapadapradhāno yathārūḍhavānaro vṛkṣaḥ, ūḍharatho'naṅvān, titragurdevadattaḥ, mattamātaṅgaṃ vanamiti | anyathāpradhāno yathonmattagaṅgaṃ pcakapālaḥ, dvitrāḥ, kṛṣṇaśāra iti | anyathopasarjano yathā śākaprati, prāptajīvikaḥ, gogarbhiṇī, agnistoka iti | tiṅsamāso yathā astikṣīrā, ehivāṇijā, aśnītapibatā, savādatamodateti | prātipadikasamāso yathā dadhasek, carmakrīti | upapadasamāso yathā kumbhakāraḥ, paṅkajam, uṣṭrakrośī, sahayuddhveti | prādisamāso yathā niṣkauśāmbiḥ, utpaśyaḥ, durāsadaḥ, suprabodha iti | nañsamāso yathābrāhmaṇaḥ, anekaḥ, abhāryaḥ, apacasīti | ekadeśisamāso yathā candra iva mukhamasyāścandramukhī, mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapalā, śastrīva śyāmā śastraśyāmā, ananyena sadṛśī ananyasadṛśī | upameyasamāso yathā vyaghra iva puruṣaḥ puruṣavyaghraḥ, karīva kalabhaḥ karikalabhaḥ, śārdūla iva rājā rājaśārdūlaḥ, candra iva mukhaṃ mukhacandra iti | kiṃ punarupamānaṃ kiṃvopameyaṃ kiṃ yadevopamānaṃ tadevāpameyaṃ, āhosvidanyadupamānamanyadupameyam? kiñcātaḥ yadi yadevopamānaṃ, tadevopameyam, upamārtho na ghaṭate | na hi bhavati gauriva gauḥ, anyadupamānamanyadupameyaṃ tathāpyupamārtho na dhaṭate | nahi bhavati gaurivāśvā iti, evaṃ tarhiyatra kiñcitsāmānyaṃ kaściñca viśeṣaḥ tatropamānopameye bhavataḥ | kiṃ vaktavyametat | nahi kathamapyanuktaṃ gamyate? mānaṃ hi nāmānijrñātajñānārthamupādīyate | yathā prasthādimānamanijrñātasya dhānyādermeyasyātyantāvacchedāyopādīyate tatsamīpe'yaṃ nātyantāya mimīte tadupamānaṃ, yathā gauriva gavayaḥ | gaurasya nijrñātaḥ tarhi yasya gavayo nijrñātaḥ syāt gauranijrñātaḥ kartavyaḥ, tena gavaya iva gauriti | bāḍhaṃ kartavyaṃ, yathā bhedasādṛsyādhyāsitamūrtayaḥ padārthāḥ parasparamanimenopamānopameyabhāvamadhigacchanti | yathā candra iva mukhaṃ kāminyāṃ mukhamivacandro yāminyāṃ, yatra punarbhedasādṛśyādhyāsitamūrtitvaṃ na, tatropamānopameyabhāvo'pi na | yathā gauriva gauḥ, gaurivāśva iti | nanu ya ete bhedasādṛśyādhyāsitāḥ padārthaste nāntareṇa deśakālakriyādisampāditaṃ virodhaṃ bhavitumarhantīti sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapattiḥ | naivam, yadyapyupamānamupameyaṃ ca paramārthato bhinnaṃ tathāpyupamānaśabdā gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśrityopameye vartamānāstayorbhedaṃ tirodadhati | tathā hi, yadā vyāghrādayaḥ śauryādyatiśayanibandhanamupamānopameyasambandhamanubhūya tataḥ upamānopameyasambandhādyāropitā bhedā upameye vartante vyāghrasadṛśo'yaṃ vyāghra iti, tadā puruṣādiśritibhirabhinnādhikaraṇāḥ samasyanta iti kiṃ punarupamānopameyapratipattinibandhanebhya eva śabdebhyaḥ sādṛśyapratipattiḥ? uta tebhyaścānyebyaśceti | kiñcāto yadi tebhya eva puruṣaṃ vyāghraṃ ca vīkṣasvetyatrāpi syāt | iva prayogavaiyathryaṃ ca | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ puruṣo vyāghra ivetyeva syāt, na puruṣavyaghra iti | yathecchasi tathāstu | astu tāvatprathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | nanu coktaṃ puruṣaṃ vyāghraṃ ca vīkṣasvetyatrāpi sādṛśyapratipattiḥ syāt | iha hi puruṣavyāghrayorvīkṣamakriyāsamaveśamātraṃ vivakṣitam | na sādṛśam | nanu vivakṣāto'pi sādṛśyapratipattāvivādaśabdopādānamanarthakam | yatra mukhyavṛttivyatikrameṇa gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśrityopamānaśabdā upameyaviśeṣeṣu prayujyante tatraiva ivādiśabdavikalāḥ sādṛśyaṃ gamayanti | yathā kaścadavyāghraṃ puruṣaṃ vyāghra ityāha, tena manyāmahe vyāghrasadṛśo'yaṃ puruṣa iti | tataśca vyāghradharmāṇāṃ śauryabalavatvādīnāṃ vāyaghraśabdātpuruṣe pratipattirbhaviṣyati | yadā punarupamānopameyaśabdāmukhyārthapratipattaye vivakṣitopamānopameyabhāveṣu vākyeṣu svarūpābhedādaśaktāḥ sādṛśyamavagamayutuṃ, tadā'pekṣante dvitīyamivādiśabdaprayogamiti kiṃ punarihodāharaṇaṃ śastrīva śyāmā śastrīśyāmeti | nanu ca cātra śyāmāśabdopāttasya dharmasyopamānopameyostulyatāvadyotanāyevaśabdaḥ prayujyate | vyāghra iva puruṣa ityatra tu sāmānyaprayogābhāvāt kasya puruṣavyāghrayossādhāraṇyamivaśabdenāvadyotyata iti? ucyate, śabdaḥ kkcidabhidhāvṛttayā arthaṃ bodhayati | yathā guṇḍāśabdo guḍaḍḍatdhdravyaṃ, kkacidgamakavṛttyā, yathā guḍaḍḍatdhdravyāvinābāvimādhuryaṃ | evamiha vyāghraśabdena vyāghrāvinābhāviśairyadikaṃ gamitaṃ tasya vyāghrapuruṣayossādṛśyasiddhyarthamubhayādhikaraṇatāvadyotanamivena kriyata iti | etena śastrīśyamāmetyapi vyākhyātam | atrāpyanupāttamapi devadatteti gamyate | kka punarayaṃ śyāmāśabdo vartate śastryāmityāha | kena tarhīdānīṃ devattato gamyate? samāsena | yadāhopamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyante sāmānatvaṃ ca sādhāraṇye sati syāt | tattu devadattamantareṇa nopapadyata iti | yadyevaṃ śastrīśyāmo devadatta iti na siddhāti | upasarjanasyeti hasvatvaṃ bhaviṣyati yadi tarhi upasarjanānyevejātīyakānyapi bhavanti| tattirikalmāṣīkumbhakapālalohinītyanupasarjanalakṣamaīkāro na prāpnoti | evaṃ tarhi śastryāmeva śastrīśabdo vartate | śyāmāśabdastu devadattāyām | evamapi guṇo nirdiṣṭo bhavati | bahavaśca śastryāṃ guṇāḥ sūkṣmā ślākṣṇā tīkṣṇā pṛthuḥ śyāmeti | anirdiśyamānasyāpi guṇasya bhavati loke sampratyayaḥ | tadyathā candramukhī devadatteti | bahavaścandre guṇāḥ, yā cāsau priyadarśanatā sā gamyate | yathā ca vyāghro'yaṃ puruṣaiti bahuṣvapi vyāghraguṇeṣu śauryaṃ balavattā vā pratīyata iti | evamapi samānādhikaraṇeneti vartate | vyadhikaraṇatvātsamāso na prāpnoti | kiṃ hi vacanānna bhavati | yadyapi tāvadvacanātsamāsaḥ syāt | mṛgīva capalā mṛgacapaleti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhāvo na prāpnoti | evaṃ tarhitasyāmevobhayaṃ vartate | etañcātra yuktaṃ yattasyāmevobhayaṃ vartate, itarathā hi bahvapekṣyaṃ syāt | yadā tāvadevaṃ vigrahaḥ kriyate tadā śastrīśyāmā, evaṃ devadatteti tadā śyāmeti śastrāpekṣyaṃ syāt | yadā śastrīśyamā cāsau śyāmā ca śastrīśyāmeti tadā na kiñcidapekṣyate, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca bhavati | nanvevaṃ sati śastrīśabdasya devadattāyāṃ pravṛttinimittamanirdihaṃ bhavati pratīyamānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet kiṃ taditi pṛcchāmi | yadi śyāmatvameva? śyāmeti śabdasyoktārthatvādaprayogaḥ prāpnoti | nahi guṇavṛttyā pratipāditeṣu guṇeṣu tadabhidhānāya guṇavacanaḥ prayujyate, na hi bhavati puruṣo'yaṃ vyādhraśūra iti | athānabhihitaṃ taikṣṇyādikamupādāya śastrīśabdo devadattāyāṃ vartate tarhi tīkṣṇaśyamaguṇavacanayoḥ khañjakūṇavatsamāse upamānāni sāmānyavacanairiti virudhyate, śyāmaśastrīti prayogaḥ prāpnoti | nanu pakṣatraye'pi deṣadarśānāt pakṣāntarābhāvāñca kinnu bhavitavyamevopamānasamāsena bhavitavyam | kintu pūrvotatrapakṣau vyudasya madhyame pakṣe śastrīva śyāmā devadattetyavaiyadhikaraṇye'pi vacanasāmathryāt | nanūktaṃ tatra mṛgacapaleti samānādhikaraṇalakṣaṇaḥ puṃvadbhovo na prāpnoti | naivam | neha pūrvapadaṃ śastrītvena vivakṣitamapi tu mṛgatvajātimātreṇa yathā mṛgakṣīraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍaḍḍatdhmiti | upamānasamāse guṇavacanasya viśeṣabhāvatvāt sāmānyavacanatvāprasiddhiḥ | yataḥ śyāmāśabdo'yaṃ sādṛśyasiddhaye śastrīśabdenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ sambadhyate | tenaivaṃ śyāmatvasya ubhayatra bhāvāttadvācakatvāñca śabdasāmānyavacanatvaprasiddheḥ | na cāvaśyaṃ sa eva sāmānyavacanaḥ | yo bahūnāṃ sāmānyamāha, davyorapi yaḥ sāmānyamāha, so'pi sāmānyavacanaḥ | athavā sāmānyavatanairityetena sravaśca śabdo'nyenābhisambadhyamāno viśeṣavacanaḥ sampadyate | tata evaṃ vijñāsyāmaḥ prāgabhisambandhādyaḥ sāmānyavacana iti | nanvevaṃ satyupamitaṃ vyāghrādibhirityatra sāmānyāprayogagrahaṇamatiricyate | vyāghrādayo'pi bhedopanibandhanasyevādeḥ prayoge yadopamāna eva vartante tadā sāmānyaprayogamapekṣante puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghra iva śūraḥ siṃha iva balivāniti | abhedopakrame cābhidhāne sambandhanimittasyopamānaśabdaireva anatarbhāvitatvādaprayogaḥ sāmānyaśabdasyeti | aprayoge'pi ca sāmānyadharmāvasāyaścandramukhavadbhaviṣyati | taduktaṃ, siṃho vyāghra iti pūjāyāṃ, svā kākā iti kutsāyāmiti, naivam, yadyantarbhītopamānakutsārthe sambandhapratipado vyāghradiśabdairūpameyaṃ puruṣādipūjārthaṃ vābidhīyate | tathāpi tannimittasyānekatvāniyamāya nimittatṛtīyāntaśauryādipadaprayoge na viridhyate | puruṣo'yaṃ vyāghraḥ śauryeṇeti bhinne hi vastunyabhedopacāraḥ sārūpyamātraṃ gamayenna tasyātmātiśayaṃ, yathā hi sumanāyate durmanāyate abhimanāyata iti sudurabhīnāṃ bhavatyarthaviśeṣaṇapakṣe pratyayenopāttārthānāmapi pratyayasya rūpābhedādanavasīyamānavibhāgamupasargārithamavacchettuṃ prayogaḥ | kathaṃ puruṣavyāghrādau tasyāḥ pūjāyā nimittabhedasambhave niyamāya sadṛśabhāgopanipātī śabdaḥ prayujyata iti | evamayamekārthībhāvastaddhitākhyātayorapi anantaprakāraeva eva draṣṭavyaḥ | tatra taddhite sāmānyena tridhā, sambandhaviṣayaḥ, kārakaviṣayaḥ, svārthaviṣayaśca | teṣu sambandho dvidhā, pradhānamapradhānaṃ ca | pradhānaṃ yathā gāvo'sya santi, salāturo'syābhijanaḥ sālāturīya iti | apradhānaṃ yathā viṣeṇa vadhyo viṣayaḥ śatruḥ, padamasmin dṛśyaṃ padyaḥ kardama iti | apradhānaṃ yathā vyākaraṇaṃ vetti adhīte vā vaiyakaraṇaḥ, akṣairdīvyatyākṣika iti | svārtho dvidhā mukhya upacaritaśca | mukhyo yathā yava eva yāvakaḥ, maṇireva māṇika iti | upacarito yathā ruśāgrīyā buddhiḥ, kākātālīyamiva kākatālīyo nyāya iti | ākhyāte'pi tridhā, kārakeṇa, sambandhinā, prādibhiśca | kārakeṇa yathābhṛśo bhṛśo bhavati bhṛśāyate, śabdaṃ karoti śabdāyate, hastinā atikrāmati atihastayati, kaṣṭaya karmaṇe krāmati kaṣṭāyate, pāśānvimocayati vipāśayati, prāsāda ivācarati prāsādīyatīti | sambandhinā yathā vyākaraṇasya sūtraṃ karoti vyākaraṇaṃ sūtrayati, kaṃsasya vadhamācaṣṭe kaṃsaṃ dhātayati, ārātrervivāsamāste rātriṃ vivāsayati, puṣyeṇa candrasya yogaṃ jānāti puṣyeṇa candraṃ yojayati, māhaṣmatyāṃ sūryodgamaṃ prāpnoti māhaṣmatyāṃ sūryamudgamayati, kālasya gamanamupaviṣṭaḥ pratipālayati kālaṃ gamayatīti | prādayaḥ punaḥ ṣoḍhā vācakāḥ, dyotakāḥ, sahābhidhāyakāḥ, viśeṣakāḥ, nirthakāśceti | te ca kriyāyaina sambadhyamānāḥ kriyāpradhānatvādākhyātasya tadvyapadeśabhājo bhavanti | tatropasargāṇāṃ vācakatvaṃ yathā prādayoḥ gatādyarthe prathamayā, prācāryaḥ, prāntevāsīti| atyadayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyāyā, atikhaṭvaḥ, atamāla iti | avādayaḥ kruṣṭādyarthe tṛtīyayā, avakokilam, avamayūramiti | paryādayo glānādyarthe catuthryā, paryadhyayanavaḥ, paripravacana iti | nirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā, nirvārāṇasī, niṣkauśāmbiriti | evaṃ prapatitaḥ parṇaḥ praparṇaḥ, prācīnapalāśaḥ, saṅgatā āpo'sminniti samāpam, saṅgatamakṣeṇa samakṣamiti | dhātulīsyaivārthaviśeṣasya prakāśaktatvaṃ dyokatvam | dyotyaśca tadanyaḥ | tatsadṛśastadviruddhastabhāvastadutkarṣastadapatakarṣa iti ṣaḍaḍḍatdhrthā bhavantīti | teṣu tadanyo yathā patīkṣate, upakramata iti | tatsadṛśo yathā saṃvadati, anukaroti | tadvirūddho yathā pratiṣṭhate, unmajjatīti | tadabhāvo yathā viyujyante, prasmapatīti | tadutkarṣo yathā pragalbhate, atikrāmatīti | tadapakarṣo yathā vihasati, prāśnātīti | atra ca yo'sau kriyātmabhūto dharmaḥ kālaharaṇādisastaddhātvabhihitamevāsattvabhūtamanabhidadhat prādiravadyotayati | yathā'kṣinikocādayo'nābhidadhata evārthān pradarśanti, evaṃ kriyāsthān prārambhādīnabruvanta eva prādayo'vadyotayanti | dhotorekākinaḥ kriyāviśeṣābhidhānāsāmathrye sahakāribhāvaḥ sahābhidhāyakatvaṃ tatrāntaraṅgo bāhyaḥavyabhicārī vyabhicārī vyavahitaḥ saviśeṣaśca sahābhidhāyako bhavati | teṣvantaraṅgo yathā saṅgrāmayate, asaṅgramayata | bāhyo yathānurudhyate, anvarudhyata | avyabicārī yathādhīte, adhyeti | vyabhicārī yathācāmati, saṃdhukṣayati | vyavahito yathā pucchamudasyatyutpucchayate | saviśeṣo yathā senāyā abhiyāti abhiṣeṇayati, vīṇayopagāyati upavīṇayati | sahārthābhidhāne tūpasargayorbhedapratipattiḥ katham? yadyapi dhāturupasargaṃ na vyabhicarati vyabhicaratyevopasargo dhātum | ataḥ sakyate'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ bhedaḥ kalpayutum ṣa| yāvāvanayaṃ samādirupasargo'nyatra dṛṣṭaḥ ihāpi tāvāneva bhaviturbhavatīti | sajātīyebhyaścāvacchedako viśeṣakaḥ | sa ṣoḍhā, prakṛtyarthaviśeṣakaḥ, pratyayārthaviśeṣakaḥ, ubayaviśeṣakaḥ, ubhayārthaviśeṣakaśca | teṣu prakṛtiviśeṣako yathā vijayate, parājayate | prakṛtyarthaviśeṣako yathā saṅkrīḍaḍḍatdhti, saṅkrīḍaḍḍatdhte | pratyayaviśeṣako yathā viśālaṃ viśaṅkaṭam | pratyayārthaviśeṣako yathābhimanāyate, durmanāyate | ubhayaviśeṣako yathopatuṣṭhati, upatuṣṭhate | atra ca prādiḥ prakarṣādikarthaṃ bravāṇaḥ kriyāṃ sāmānyenopagṛhṇāti | na kriyāsāmānyaviśeṣayorātmānaṃ niyamayati | parasparopaśleṣe tu tayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nīlotpalādivadbhavati | kāryārthatvaṃ yathā prayuṅkte, parākaroti, abhiṣuṇoti, praṇamati, vittaṃ, samīpamiti | ātmanepadaṃ, parasmaipadaṃ, ṣatvaṃ, ṇatvaṃ, tatvaṃ, ītvaṃ, ca kāryāṇyupasarge bhavanti | nirarthakatvaṃ yathā nihnute, niravjanti, pralambate, saṃśrayatīti | atra padopacayamātre prādiḥ prayuktaḥ iti nirarthakatvam | āhuśca sa vācatako viśeṣāṇāṃ sa bhaveddyotako'pi nā | śaktyādhānāya dhātorvā sahakārī prayujyate || kriyāviśeṣako vā syātkāvyārthaṃ vopadiśyate | padopacayamātrevā'narthakaḥ prādīriṣyate || iti| evamayamanekarūpaḥ padaikārthībhāvaḥ | evaṃ vākyarthībhāvo'pi tatrākhyātaṃ sāvyāyakārakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyaṃ ekatiṅvākyamityādayo vikalpāḥ | tatra caikavākyasthāt padāduttarayostiṅāmantritapadayornighātaḥ | yuṣmasmadorvānnavādaya ādeśāḥ | vākyāsya ṭeḥ pluta udātta iti tu vākyācāmāntyasya pluta ityādīni prayojanānyabhidhīyante | kriyākārakānyayaviśeṣaṇapadārthānāṃ ca paraspakamupakāryopakārakabhānenāvasthitānāṃ bhāvanā vidhiḥ pratibhā veti vākyārthāḥ prathate | evaṃ vākyānāmapi parasparamupamānopameyabhāvādibhirivādiśabdaprayoge muktakādiṣvekārthībhāvo bhavati | etenaikakriyākārakābhiniveśinoryugagalasandānitakakālāpakakulakādayo vākyaviśeṣā vyākhyātāḥ | tatra dvābhyāṃ catuśpadībhyāṃ yugalakam, tisṛbhiḥ sandānitakam, caturbhiḥ, kīlāpakaṃ, pañcādibhiḥ kulakamiti saṃjñā vidhīyate | etenaikapragaॉghaṭṭakopanibandhānāṃ subhāṣitānāṃ samūhaḥ saṅghātaḥ | anekapradhaṭṭakopanibaddhānāṃ tu kośa ityapi vyākyātam | nāgarartīdyānacandrārkodayārṇavavarṇanādayastu saṅghātarūpā eva prabandhāntaḥ pātino vākyasamūhāḥ prakaraṇavyapadeśabhājau'vāntaravākyātāṃ labhante | tadarthāścaikārthībhāvamanubhavanti | yastu tairūpakriyāmāṇo mahāvākyārthaḥ sargabandhādāvakhyāyikādau mukhapratimukhagarbhavimarśanirvahaṇākhyaiḥ pañcasandhibhirupakṣepaparikarādibhiścatuṣṣaṣṭhisandhyaṅgairaṅgaṣoḍaḍḍatdhśakarūpabhāratyādirūpavṛtticatuṣṭayena ca yatoyogamupakṛtaḥ kṛtānyonyaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ subhadrāharamaṃ jānakīrahamamityādinā mahāvākyārtharūpeṇa prathate sa prabandhaikārthībhāvo'pari ityākhyāyate | yastu tadrūparāmāyaṇādiprabandhārthānāmavadhāraṇenopahitasaṃskārasya rāmavadvartitavyaṃ na rāvaṇādivadityādividhiniṣedhapratibhāviśeṣa upajāyate, sa samastaviśvavyāpī caturvargaikahetuḥ paro mahāvākyaikārtho'rthamūtrya vipariṇatamanādinidhanamakhaṇḍaṃ, śabdabrahmetyucyate | akhaṇḍaḍḍatdhḥ saiṣa vākyārthaḥ śabdabrāhmeti gīyate | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || idamādyaṃ padasthāne siddhisopānaparvaṇām | iyaṃ sā mokṣyamāṇānāmajihmā rājapaddhatiḥ || uktāścatastro punaścatastraḥ śabdārthasambandhabhidāḥ krameṇa | yatastra evātha vacoviśeṣe niṣeduṣīstāḥ parikīrtayāmaḥ || iti mahārājadhirāḥ śrī bhojadevaviracite śrṛṅgāraprakāśe sopekṣaśabdaśaktiprakāśo nāma aṣṭamaprakāśaḥ <9> <10> <11> <12> ḍadṛdadyatdadvaḍḍha sāma dānādisampannaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bruvate budhāḥ || yathā ratnāvalyām, vasubhūtir devi, sthāne devīśabdamudvahasi| yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, bhīmaḥ kvāsau dhārtarāṣṭrasakhā puṇyajanāpaśado yenāryasya mahānayaṃ cittavibhramaḥ kṛtaḥ| kṛṣṇo nigṛhītaḥ sa durātmā nakuleneti| punarvākyaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ yathoktākṣepadarśanam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, bābhravyo devi, idānīṃ saphanalapariśramo'smi saṃvṛtta iti| yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, yudhiṣṭhiro bhagavan, kiṃ nāma cārvākeṇa rakṣasā vayaṃ vipralabdhāḥ? kṛṣṇo’tha kim| iti| varapradānasamprāptiḥ kāvyasaṃhāra iṣyate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, yaugandharāyaṇo deva, taducyatāṃ kiṃ te bhūyaḥ priyamupakaromi? rājā kimataḥparamapi priyamasti| yataḥ, nīto vikramabāhurātmasamatāṃ prāpteyamurvītale sāraṃ sāgarikā tathā ca bhuvanaprāptyekahetuḥ priyā| devī prītimupāgatā ca bhaginīlābhājjitāḥ kosalāḥ kiṃ nāsti tvayi satyamātyavṛṣabhe yasmai vidheyaṃ spṛhām || iti| yathā veṇīsaṃhāre, kṛṣṇaḥ tatkathaya mahārāja, kimasmattaḥ priyamicchasi? yudhiṣṭhiro na khalvataḥparamabhyarthayituṃ kṣamaḥ| paśyatu devaḥ| krodhāndhaiḥ sakalaṃ hataṃ ripukulaṃ pañcā'kṣatāste vayaṃ pāñcālyā mama durnayopajanitastīrṇo nikārārṇavaḥ| tvaṃ devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sukṛtinaṃna sāmādṛto bhāṣase kiṃ nāmānyadataḥ paraṃ bhagavato yāce prasannādaham || iti| nṛpadevādiśaktiśca praśastirabhidhīyate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, rājā tathāpīdamastu| urvīmuddāmasasyāṃ janayatu visṛjanvāsavo vṛṣṭimiṣṭāṃ iṣṭaisnaiviṣṭānāṃ vidadhatu vidhivatprīṇanaṃ vipramukhyāḥ| ākalpāntaṃ ca bhūyātsamupacitasukhassaṅgamassajjanānāṃ niśśeṣaṃ yāntu śānta piśunajanagiro durjayā vajralepāḥ || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, yudhiṣṭhiras tathāpi prītataraścedbhagavāṃstadidamastu| akṛpaṇamatiḥ kāmaṃ jīvyājjajaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ bhavatu bhagavanbhaktidrvaitaṃ vinā puruṣottame| dayitabhuvano vidvadbandhurguṇeṣu viṃśeṣavi tsatatasukṛtī bhūyādbhūpaḥ prasādhitamaṇḍaḍḍatdhlaḥ || lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭiriti yatprāgudīritam| nāṭakādessphuṭaṃ lakṣma tadidānīṃ vivicyate || bhūṣaṇākṣarasaṅghātau śobhodāharaṇe tathā| hetusaṃśayadṛṣṭāntāḥ prāptirośaya eva ca || nidaśrnaṃ niruktaṃ ca sandhiścāsi viśeṣaṇam| guṇātipāto'tiśayastulyatarkaḥ padoccayaḥ || diṣṭaṃ caivopadiṣṭaṃ ca vicāro'tha viparyayaḥ| bhraṃśaścaivānunītiśca mālā dākṣiṇyagarhaṇe || arthāpattiḥ prasiddhiśca pṛcchā sārūpyameva ca| manorathaśca leśaśca yācñā protsāhanaṃ spṛhā || paścāttāpo'nuvṛttiśca yuktirnirbhāsanaṃ kṣamā| guṇānuvāda ākrandaḥ kapaṭaṃ parivādanam || upapattiśca kāryaśca pratiṣedho mṛṣodyamaḥ| chaloktiḥ kākurunmādaḥva parihāso vikatthanam || yadṛcchāyogavaiṣamyapratijñātapravṛttayaḥ| āśīruktiśca siddhiśca priyaṃ vacanameva ca || lakṣaṇāni catuṣṣaṣṭi kāvyeṣvetāni nirdiśet || tatra ca, alaṅkārai rguṇaiścaiva bahubhiryadavekṣitam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇo viśrāntavigrahakatho ratimān janasya citte vasanpriyavasantaka eva sākṣāt| paryutsuko nijamahotsavadarśanāya vatseśvaraḥ kusumacāpa ivābhyupaiti || atra śleṣopamāpratyakṣādibhiralaṅkāraiḥ śleṣaprasādasaukumāryādibhiśca guṇairupetatā draṣṭavyā| evaṃ vakṣyamāṇeṣvapi guṇālaṅkārā yathāsambhavamūhanīyaḥ| nāṭakakāraiśca niyamo nārabhyate| sandhyaṅgeṣu tu guṇālaṅkārayogo nāpekṣyata iti| yatrārthairakṣaraiḥ śliṣṭairvicitrārthopavarṇanam| tamatrākṣarasaṅghātaṃ vidyāllakṣaṇasaṃjñitam || yathābhijñānaśākuntale saptame'ṅke, (praviśya mṛṇmayūrahastā tāpasī savvadamaṇa, sauṃdalāvaṇṇaṃ pekkha| (sarvadamana, śakuntalāvaṇyaṃ prekṣasva|) bālaḥ (sadṛṣṭikṣepaṃ), kahiṃ sā ajjū| (kutra me ambā? ) ubhe vihasya, ṇāmasāriccheṇa chalidotti bhaṇido| (nāmasādṛśyena vañcito'si mātṛvatsalaḥ|) rājā (ātmagataṃ), kiṃ śakuntaleti tasya māturākhyā ! siddhairarthaissamaṃ kṛtvā yatrāsiddhaṃ prasādhyate| śliṣṭā ślakṣṇā vicitrārthā sā śobhetyabhidhīyate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇo dvīpādanyasmādapi madhyādapi jalanidherdiśo'pyantāt| ānīya jhaṭiti ghaṭayati vidhirabhimatamabhimukhībhūtaḥ || anyathā kva siddhādeśapratyayaprārthitāyāḥ siṃhaleśvaraduhituḥ samudre pravahaṇabhaṅganimnagāyāḥ phalakāsādanaṃ, kva ca kauśāmbīyena vaṇijā siṃhalebhyaḥ pratyāgacchatā tadavasthāyāḥ sambhāvanaṃ ratnamālācihnāyāśca pratyabhijñānādihānayanaṃ ca| sarvathā spṛśanti nassvāminamabhyudayā iti| tatra tulyārthayuktena vākyenābhipradarśanāt| sādhyante nipuṇairarthāstadudāharaṇaṃ smṛtam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, rājā vidūṣakaśca śārikāvacanaṃ niśamayataḥ| tato vidūṣakaḥ (ākāśe) kiṃ āprāraṇe kuppasi| jādiso tue ayaṃ kāmadevo ālihido tādisī mae rai ālihidetti| bho vaassa, kiṃ ṇedaṃ| rājā vayasya, evaṃ tarkayāmi| kayāpi hṛdayavallabho'nurāgādabhilikhya kāmapadevavyapadeśena nihnutastatsakhyāpi pratyabhijñāya vaidagdhyātpratibhandānayā sāpi tatraiva likhiteti| yatprayojanasāmathryādvākyamiṣṭārthasādhakam| samāsoktamanogrāhi sa heturiti saṃjñitaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vidūṣakaḥ saccaṃ sabāmi bamhasutteṇa jai kadāvi amherhi īdisī diṭhṭhapuvvā| kāñcanamālā bhaṭṭiṇi, kadāvi īdisaṃ ghuṇakkhadaṃ vi saṃbhavadi evva| vāsavadattā ayi ujue, pa vasattao eso ṇa āṇāsi| edaṃ savvaṃ ka bhaṇidīo| (ayi ṛjuke, vasantavaka eṣo na jānāsi| etatsarvaṃ bhaṇasi kiṃ? ) aparijñātatattvārthaṃ yatra vākyaṃ yājñaseni pañcagrāmāḥ prāthryanta iti śrūyate| tatkasmādidānīmapi te keśā na saṃyamyante|) bhīmasenaḥ sahadeva, śrutam| sahadeva ārya kimihocyate| duryodhanakalatraṃ hi sā| paśya| strīṇāṃ hi ratnāvalyāṃ, prathame'ṅke, rājā vāsavadattāṃ pratyāha kusumasukumāramūrtirdadhatī niyamena tanutaraṃ madhyam| ābhāti makaraketoḥ pāśrvasthā cāpayaṣṭiriva || yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ yathāpātraṃ ca vaṇryate| yatpratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā diṣṭaṃ tadvarṇako'pi vā || yathā rāghavānande’ṅke nyasyottamāṅgaṃ plavagabalapateḥ pādamakṣasya hantuḥ kṛtvotsaṅge salīlaṃ tvaci kanakamṛgasyāṅgaśeṣaṃ nidhāya| gṛhiṇīpadaṃ yuvatayo vāmāḥ kulasyādhayaḥ || pūrvāśayasamānārthairapratyakṣārthasādhanaiḥ| anekopāyasaṃyukto vicāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ || yathottararāmacarite, lavacandraketū parasparaṃ sasnehānurāgaṃ nirvaṇrya, nijo vā sambandho na vidhivaśātkopavidito mayā tasmindṛṣṭe hṛdayamavadhānaṃ racayati || vicārasyānyathābhāvastathādiṣṭopadiṣṭayoḥ| sandehājjāyate yatra sa vijñeyo viparyayaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, vāsavadattā halā kaṃcaṇamāle, saccaṃ jevva maha vesadhāriṇī bhavia sāariā ayyauttaṃ ahisarissadi| kāñcanamālā kadhaṃ aṇṇadhā bhaṭṭiṇīe ṇivedīadi| ahavā cittasālīādavāre uvaviṭṭo vasaṃtao evva de paccaaṃ uppādaissadi| vasantako jaha aaṃ cittasāliāduvāre padasaddo suṇīadi taha takkemi āadā sāariātti| kāñcanamālā bhaṭṭiṇi, iyaṃ sā cittaśāliā| tā jāva vasaṃtaassa saṇṇaṃ karemi| (bhartri, iyaṃ sā citraśālikā| tadyāvadvasantakasya saṃjñāṃ karomi|) iti choṭikāṃ dadāti| vidūṣakaḥ (upasṛtya apavārya), susaṅgade susariso khu tue kido kaṃcaṇamālāe veso sāariā evva vāsavadatteti| (susaṅgate, sadṛśaḥ khalu tvayā kṛtaḥ kāñcanamālāyā veṣaḥ sāgarikā eva vāsavadatteti|) yathā cātraivāgrataḥ vidūṣakaḥ (sasambhramaṃ, dṛṣṭvā) bho vaassa, parittāahi parittāahi| esā khu devī vāsavadattā| attāṇaṃ ubbaṃdhia vāvādeti| (bho vayasya, paritrāyasva paritrāyasva| eṣā khalu devī vāsavadattā ātmānamudbadhya vyāpādayati|) rājā (sasambhramamupasṛtya) vayasya, kvāsau? vidūṣako bho esā| (bho eṣā|) rājā (upasṛtya, kaṇṭhātpāśamapanayan) ayi sāhasakāriṇi, kimidamakāryaṃ kriyate? mama kaṇṭhagatāḥ prāṇāḥ pāśe kaṇṭhagate tava| atassvārthaprayatno'yaṃ tyajyatāṃ sāhasaṃ priye || ... riṣṭādibhiranekadhā| anyasminneva patanādāgu bhraṃśassa ucyate || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, dvitīye'ṅke, duryodhanaḥ sahabhṛtyagaṇaṃ sabāndhavaṃ sahamitraṃ sasutaṃ sahānujam| sabalena nihanti saṃyuge na cirātpāṇḍuḍḍatdhsuta ssuyodhanam || kañcukī (karṇau pidhāya, sabhayaṃ) śāntaṃ pāpam| pratihatamamaṅgalam| rājā (duryodhanoktaṃ paṭhitvā) tadetadviparītamabhihitaṃ devena| rājā vinayandhara, adya khalu bhānumatī yathāpūrvaṃ māmanāmantrya vāsabhavanātprātareva niṣkrānteti vyākṣiptaṃ me mana iti| ubhayoḥ prītijanano viruddhābhiniveśayoḥ| arthasya sādhakaścaiva vijñeyo'nunayo budhaiḥ || yathā ratnāvalyām, tṛtīye'ṅke, rājā sāgarikāvṛttāntāparādhe vāsavadattāyāḥ puro baddhāñjalistāmanunayannāha priye vāsavadatte devi, evamapi pratyakṣadṛṣṭavyalīkaḥ kiṃ bravīmi? tathāpi vijñāpayāmi| ātāmratāmapanayāmi vivarṇa eṣa lākṣākṛtāṃ caraṇayostava devi mūdhrnā| kopoparāgajanitāṃ tu mukhendubimbe hartuṃ kṣamo yadi paraṃ karuṇā mayi syāt || abhipretārthasidhdyarthaṃ kītryate yatra sūribhiḥ| prayojanānyanekāni sā māletyabhisaṃjñitā || yathā mālatīmādhave makarando mālatīmuddinapaśya kāmandakīṃ prati, bhagavati, ślāghyānvayeti nayanotsavakāriṇīti nivryūḍhasauhṛdamayīti guṇojvaleti| ekaikameva hi vaśīkaraṇaṃ garīyo yuṣmākamevamiyamityatha kiṃ bravīmi || hṛṣṭaiḥ prasannavadanairyatparasyānupādhikā| .... dākṣiṇyamudāhṛtam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vāsavadattā (vidūṣakamuddiśya), ayya mama uṇa edaṃ cittra pekkhia sīsaveaṇā samuppaṇā| tā gamissaṃ ahaṃ| (ārya, mama punaridaṃ citraṃ prekṣya śīrṣavedanā samutpannā| tadgamiṣyāmyaham|) rājā vāsavadattāṃ paṭānte gṛhītvā, priye prasīdeti brūyāmidamasati kope na ghaṭate kariṣyāmyevaṃ nāṃ punariti bhavedabhyupagamaḥ| na me doṣo'stītitvamidamapica jñāsyasi mṛpā kimetasminvaktuṃ kṣamamiti na vedmi priyatame || vidūṣako bhodi pasīda| (bhavati, prasīda|) vāsavadattā ajjautta, mā aṇṇadhā saṃbhavehi| saccaṃ evva me sīsaveaṇā samuppaṇā| tā gamissaṃ| (āryaputra, mā'nyathā sambhāvaya| satyaṃ me śīrṣavedanā samutpannā| tadgamiṣye) iti niṣkrāntā saparivārā vāsavadattā| vidūṣako bho diṭhṭhiā vaḍhḍhase kkhemeṇa adikkantā vāsavadattā aālabādaliā via| rājā mūrkha, alaṃ parihāsena| ābhijātyādvinigūḍho na mahāvīracarite, hanūmān sītāṃ dṛṭvā āha sthāne'vasīdasi raghūdvaha kiṃ vidhātarasyāstvayekṣitamalakṣaṇamaṅgakeṣu| adyāpi jīvasi daśānana he hanūman keyaṃ tavābhimukhavartiripoḥ pratīkṣā || dṛṣṭaśrutādibhūtārthakathanādisamudbhavam| sādṛśyaṃ kṣobhajananaṃ sārūpyamiti saṃjñitam || yathā veṇīsaṃhāre, duryodhanena bhīmārjunau hatāviti cārvākādākaṇrya śokāccitāpraveśaṃ abhilaṣati duḥśāsanena kacakarṣaṇabhinnamaulissā draupadī kathayata kva punaḥ pradeśe || kañcukī hā devi yajñavedisaṃbhave, paribhūyase saṃpratyanātha kurukulakalaṅkena| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ (sasaṃbhramamutthāya) devi yājñaseni, na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyam| kaḥ ko'tra bhoḥ saniṣaṅgaṃ me dhanurupānaya| durātmanduryodhanahataka āgacchāgaccha| apanayāmi te gadākauśalasaṃbhṛtaṃ bhujadarpaṃ śilīmukhāsāreṇa| anyacca re kurukulāṅgāra, priyamanujamapaśyaṃstaṃ jarāsandhamallaṃ kupitaharakirātāyodhinaṃ taṃ ca vatsam| tvamiva kaṭhinacetāḥ prāṇituṃ nāsmi śakto nanu punarapahartuṃ bāṇavarṣaistavāsūn || (tataḥ praviśati yathānirdiṣṭo bhīmasenaḥ|) bhīmaseno bho bhoḥ syamantapañcakasaṃcāriṇaḥ sainikāḥ ko'yamāvegaḥ| nāhaṃ rakṣo na bhūto ripurudhirajalaplāvitāṅgaḥ prakāmaṃ nistīrṇorupratijñājalanidhigahanaḥ krodhanaḥ kṣatriyo'smi| bho bho rājanyavīrāḥ samaraśikhiśikhādagdhaśeṣāḥ kṛtaṃ vastrāsenānena līnairhatakarituragāntarhitairāsyate yat || kathayantu bhavantaḥ kasminnuddeśe pāñcālī tiṣṭhati| kañcukī devi pāṇḍuḍḍatdhsnuṣe, uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha| draupadī (sahasotthāya) kahaṃ ṇa saṃbhāvemi ajjavi cidāsamīvam| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kaḥ ko'tra bhoḥ| saniṣaṅgaṃ dhanurupanaya| kathaṃ na kaścitparijanaḥ| bhavatu| bāhuyuddhenaiva durātmānaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya jvalanamabhipātayāmi| (iti parikaraṃ badhnāti) kañcukī devi pāṇḍuḍḍatdhsnuṣe, saṃyamyantāmidānīṃ nayanoparodhino duḥśāsanāvakṛṣṭā mūrdhajāḥ| astamitā saṃprati pratīkārāśā| citāsamīpameva drutataraṃ saṃbhāvaya| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kṛṣṇe, na khalvanihate tasmindurātmani duryodhane saṃhartavyāḥ keśāḥ| bhīmasenaḥ pāñcāli, na khalu mayi jīvati saṃhartavyā duḥśāsanavilulitā veṇirātmapāṇibhyām| tiṣṭhatu tiṣṭhatu| svayamevāhaṃ saṃharāmi| (iti keśeṣu grahītumicchati|) yudhiṣṭhiraḥ (vegādbhīmamāliṅgya, ) durātman bhīmārjunaśatro suyodhanahataka, āśaiśavādanudinaṃ janitāparādho matto balena bhujayorhatarājaputraḥ| āsādya me'ntaramidaṃ bhujapañjarasya jīvanprayāsi na padātpadamadya pāpa || bhīmaseno’ye kathamāryaḥ suyodhanaśaṅkyā krodhānnirdayaṃ māmāliṅgati| kañcukī (nirūpya, saharṣaṃ) mahārāja vañcyase| ayaṃ khalvāyuṣmānbhīmasenaḥ suyodhanakṣatajāruṇīkṛtasakalaśarīrāmbaro durlakṣyavyaktiḥ| alamadhunā sandeheneti| hṛdayasthasya bhāvasya suśliṣṭārthaprakāśakam| anyāpadeśakathanaṃ manoratha iti smṛtaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ dvitīvaye'ṅke, susaṅgatā sahi jassa kide tumaṃ āadā so aaṃ ciṭhṭhadi| sāgarikā (sāsūyaṃ), sahi kassa kide ahaṃ āadā? susaṅgatā ai aṇṇasaṃkide, ṇaṃ cittaphalaassa| tā gehṇatam| yadvākyaṃ vākyakuśalairupāyenābhidhīyate| sādṛśyārthābhiniṣpattyā sa leśa iti kīrtitaḥ || yathā śākuntale sakhyau śakuntalāduṣyantayorākaraṃ viditvā, janāntikaṃ, hala sauṃdale, jai ajja jādo saṇṇihido have| (sakhi śakuntale, yadyadya tātassannihito bhavet|) śakuntalā (saroṣaṃ) tado kiṃ bhave| (tataḥ kiṃ bhavet? ) sakhyāv imaṃ jīvitasavvasseṇavi adihiṃ kidatthikarissadi| (imaṃ jīvitasarvasvenāpyatithiṃ kṛtārthīkariṣyati|) śakuntalā halā aveha| kiṃ vi hiae karia maṃteha| ṇavo vaaṇaṃ suṇissaṃ| (sakhyau apeta| kimapi hṛdaye kṛtvā mantrayethe| na vāṃ vacanaṃ śroṣyāmi|) paradoṣairvicitrārthai ryatrātmā parikītryate| aduṣṭo'nyo'pi vā kaścitsa tu kṣobha iti smṛtaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, rājā (añjaliṃ badhvā) priye vāsavadatte prasīda| vāsavadattā ajjautta, mā evvaṃ bhaṇa| aṇṇagadāiṃ edāiṃ akkhanarāiṃ| (āryaputra, mā evaṃ bhaṇa| anyagatānyetānyakṣarāṇi|) vidūṣako bhodi, mahāṇubhāvā khu tumaṃ| tākhamīadu dāva ekko avarāho piavaassassa| vāsavadattā ajja vasantaa, ṇaṃ paḍhamasaṃgame vigdhaṃ karaṃtīe mae jevva edassa avaraddhaṃ| kītryamānairguṇairyatra vividhārthasamudbhavaiḥ| doṣā na parikalpyante tajjñeyaṃ guṇakīrtanam || yathā ratnāvalyām, dvitīye'ṅke, rājā dṛṣṭa ruṣā kṣipasi bhāmini yadyapīmāṃ snigdheyameṣyati tathāpi na rūkṣabhāvam| tyaktvā tvarāṃ vraja padaiḥ skhalitairayaṃ te khedaṃ gamiṣyati gururnitarāṃ nitambaḥ || pṛṣṭairapṛṣṭairathavā nirṇayaḥ paryavasthitaḥ| tadākhyānamiti jñeyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nāṭakāśrayam || yathottararāmacarite, caturthe'ṅke, kausalyāmmahe edāṇaṃ majjheko eso rāmacaṃdakomāralaccīsāvaṭhṭhaṃbhehiṃ muddhalalidehiṃ aṃgehiṃ dārao amhāṇaṃ loaṇāiṃ sīalāvei| arundhatī (apavārya, saharṣotkaṇṭhaṃ, ) idaṃ tannāma yadbhāgīrathīniveditaṃ rahasyaṃ karṇāmṛtam| natvetat vidmaḥ kataro'yamāyuṣmatoḥ kuśalavayoriti| vāryamāṇāḥ subahubhirva ... yuktibhiḥ| nāryo yaṃ nānutiṣṭhanti so'bhimānaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, kāñcanamālā bhaṭṭiṇi karehi se pasādaṃ| eaṃ caraṇapaḍiaṃ mahārājaṃ ujjhia gadāe paccādāvena hodavvaṃ| (bhartri, kuruṣva asmai prasādam| evaṃ caraṇapatitaṃ mahārājamujjhitvā gatāyāḥ devyāḥ paścāttāpena bhavitavyam|) vāsavadattā ai apehi apaṇḍiḍḍatdhte| kudo ettha pasādassa paccādāvassa vā kāraṇaṃ? (ayi, apehi apaṇḍiḍḍatdhte| kuto'tra paścāttāpasya prasādasya vā kāraṇam? ) lābhopapattimākhyāya svayaṃ dūtamukhena vā| prāthryate yatra kanyādissā yācñetyabhidhīyate || yathā mahāvīracarite kanyāratnamayonijanma bhavatāmāste vayaṃ cārthino ratnaṃ yatkvacidasti tatpariṇamatyasmāsu śakrādapi| kanyāyāśca parārthataiva hi matā tasyāḥ pradānādahaṃ bandhurvo bhavitā pulastya pulahapraṣṭhāśca sambandhinaḥ || utsāhajananaisspaṣṭai rguṇairaupamyasaṃśrayaiḥ| prasiddhairupagūḍhaṃ ca jñeyaṃ protsāhanaṃ budhaiḥ || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, caturthe'ṅke, vijayavarmā prāgvṛttayuddhavarṇanāyāṃ prāha deva, kṛtaniścayaścāsau| yoddhuṃ nirgatya vindhyādabhavadabhimukhastatkṣaṇaṃ digvibhāgān vindhyenevāpareṇa dviradapatighaṭāpīḍaḍḍatdhbandhena rundhan| vegādbāṇānvimuñcansamadagajaghaṭotpiṣṭapattirnipatya pratyaicchadvāñchitāptidviguṇitarabhasastaṃ rumaṇvān kṣaṇena || dṛṣṭe śrute'nubhūte vā vastuno rāmaṇīyake| abhilāṣo bhavedyastu sā spṛheti prakīrtitā || yathottararāmacarite, janakaḥ kuvalayadalasnigdhaśyāmaśśikhaṇḍaḍḍatdhkamaṇḍaḍḍatdhno vaṭupariṣadaṃ puṇyaśrīkaḥ śriyaiva sabhājanam| punariva śiśurbhūtvā vatsassa me raghunandano jhaṭiti kurute dṛṣṭaḥko'yaṃ dṛśoramṛtāñjanam || akāryaṃsahasā kṛtvā kṛtvākāryamathāpi vā| santāpo manaso yastu paścāttāpassa ucyate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīpaye'ṅke, vāsavadattā kaṃcanamāle, taṃ tahā calaṇapaḍiḍḍatdhdamayyauttamavadhīria āacchaṃtīe mae adiṇiṭhṭhuraṃ evva mae kidaṃ iti| (hañje kāñcanamāle, taṃ tathā caraṇapatitaṃ āryaputraṃ avadhīryāgacchantyā atiniṣṭhurameva mayā kṛtam| iti|) praśrayeṇārthasaṃyuktaṃ yatparasyānuvartanam| snehāddākṣiṇyayogādvā sānuvṛttistu saṃjñitā || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ tṛtīye'ṅke, rājā vayasya, kathaṃ darśanamapi bhaviṣyati priyāyāḥ| vidūṣako bho kīsa ṇa bhavissadi jassa denapa uvahasitavihappadibuddhivihavo aaṃ amacco| (bhoḥ kutaḥ na bhaviṣyati yasya ta upahasitabṛhaspatibuddhivibhavo'yamamātyaḥ|) rāhā na khalu kiñcinna saṃbhāvyata iti| sādhyate yo'rthasambandho mahadbhissamavāyatā| parasparānukūlena sā yuktiḥ parikīrtitā || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī tadidānīṃ vidarbharājamantriṇā satā devarātena mādhavaṃ putramānvīkṣakīśravaṇāya kuṇḍaḍḍatdhnapurādimāṃ padmāvatīṃ pratipreṣayatā subihitam| apatyasambandhavidhipratijñā priyasya nītā suhṛdaḥ smṛtiṃ ca| alokasāmānyaguṇastanūjaḥ prarocanārthaṃ prakaṭīkṛtaśca || anyacca, makarandodyānavṛttāntena bhagavato vidherapyanukūlatāmavāgacchāmi vakulāvalīcitraphalakasaṃvidhānavyatikaraśca kamapyadbhutaṃ pramodamullāsayatīti| anekayuktimadvākyamanekārthaprasādhakam| anekavākyasaṃyuktaṃ jñeyaṃ nirbhāsanaṃ tu tat || yathā mālatīmādhave, makarando vayasya mādhava, anyonyasambhinnadṛśāṃ sakhīnāṃ tasyā api prāganurāgacihnam| kasyāpi ko 'pīti niveditaṃ ca dhātreyikāyāścaturaṃ vacaśca || kalahaṃsaka upasṛtya, edaṃ ca| citraphanalakaṃ darśayati| pratikriyāsamarthasya pātraucityavaśena yaḥ| apakāre'pyupaśamaḥ sā kṣameti prakīrtitā || yathottararāmacarite, lava ātmagataṃ, īdṛśo māṃ pratyamīṣāmakāraṇasnehaḥ| mayā punarebhya evābhidrugdhamajñena| yadāyudhaparigraho vihitaḥ| (prakāśaṃ), mṛṣyantāmidānīṃ lavasya bāliśatāṃ tātapādāḥ| rāmaḥ kimaparāddhaṃ vatsena? candraketur aśvānuyātrikebhyastātapratāpāviṣkaraṇamupaśrutya vīrāyitamanena| rāmo nanvayamalaṅkāraḥ kṣatrasyeti| guṇānuvādaḥ sa jñeyo yatra bhedopacārataḥ| gauṇīṃ vṛttimupāśritya vastuno rūpamucyate || yathā śākuntale, rājānāghrātaṃ puṣpaṃ kisalayamalūnaṃ kararuhai ranāviddhaṃ ratnaṃ madhunavamanāsvāditarasam| akhaṇḍaṃ, puṇyānāṃ phalamiva ca tadrūpamanaghaṃ na jāne bhoktāraṃ kamiha samupasthāsyati vidhiḥ || ātmabhāvamupanyasya parasādṛśyayuktibhiḥ| tīvrārthabhāṣaṇaṃ yatsyādākrandassa tu kīrtitaḥ || yathā mālatīmādhave, (praviśya), saṃbhrāntā buddharakṣitā parittāaha parittāaha| esā ṇo piasahī amaccaṇaṃdaṇassaṃ bhaiṇī madaaṃtiā ediṇā duṭṭhaśardūleṇa hataviddāviapariaṇā abhibhaviadi| adivya divyamapi vā kṛtvā rūpaviparyayam| avidvānvañcyate yatra kapaṭaṃ tadudāhṛtam || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī vatsa makaranda, anenaiva mālatīnaipathyenāpavāritaḥ pravartasva pariṇayāyātmānaṃ nandaneneti| yaddoṣairanyanāmoktaiḥ prasiddhārthaprayojanam| anyatrārthena sambaddhaṃ jñeyaṃ tatparivādanam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, vāsavadattā caraṇapatitaṃ rājānamujjhitvā nirgatā| vidūṣakaśca rājānaṃ bhāṣate ṇa kido kahaṃ pasādo jaṃ ajjavi akkhedasarīrā ciṭṭhahma| (na kṛtaḥ kathaṃ prasādo yadadyāpi akṣataśarīrāstiṣṭhāmaḥ|) tato jñātāyāṃ rājā parivadannāha tvatkṛto'yamanartho'smākamāpatita iti| prāptānāṃ yathā doṣāṇāṃ kriyate śamanaṃ punaḥ| jñeyā sābhyupapattistu lakṣaṇaṃ nāṭakāśrayam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vāsavadattā kaṃcaṇamāle aaṃ ayyautto| iaṃ uṇa sāriā| ajjautta kiṃ edam| (kāñcanamāle, ayamāryaputraḥ| iyaṃ punaḥ sārikā| āryaputra, kimetat? ) rājāpavārya, vayasya, vayasya kiṃ bravīmi? tvamevāsyā uttaraṃ prayaccha| vidūṣako hodi, appā kila dukkaṃ ālihaduṃti mama vaaṇaṃ suṇia piavaassaeṇa edaṃ viṇṇāṇaṃ daṃsidam| (bhavati, ātmā kila duḥkhaṃ likhatīti mama vacanaṃ śrutvā priyavayasyenedaṃ vijñānaṃ darśitam|) rājā devi, yathāha vasantakaḥ| vāsavadattājjautta, esāpi jā avarā tuha samīpe ālihidā tā kiṃ vasaṃdaassa viṇṇāṇaṃ| (āryaputra, eṣāpi yā'parā tava samīpe ālikhitā, tatka vasantakasya vijñānam? ) rājā savailakṣasmitaṃ, devi, alamanyathā sambhāvitena| iyaṃ hi mayā kāpi kanyakā svacetasaiva parikalpyālikhitā| na tu dṛṣṭapūrveti| yatra saṅkīrtayandoṣaṃ guṇamarthena yojayet| .... kāryaṃ tadiha kīrtitam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, prathame'ṅke, yaugandharāyaṇaḥ prārambhe'smin svāmino vṛddhihetau daivenetthaṃ dattahastāvalambe| siddhebhrrāntirnāsti satyaṃ tathāpi svecchācārī bhīta evāsmi bhartuḥ || kāryeṣu viparīteṣu yadi kaścitpravartate| nivāryate ca kāryajñaiḥ pratiṣedhassa kīrtitaḥ | yathā mahāvīracarite, daśaratho virama narapate kathaṃ dvije'sminnaviratavitīrṇagosahasraḥ| tava palitanirantaraḥ pṛṣatkaṃ spṛśati purāṇadhanurdharasya bāhuḥ || prayuktārthavidhānāya mohātra pravartate| nivartate vṛthākleśassa vijñeyo mṛṣodyamaḥ || yathā vīracarite tapo vā śastraṃ vā vyapadiśati yaḥ kaścidiha vo sadarpāduddāmaṃ dviṣamasahamānassakhalayatu| arāmāṃ nissīradhvajadaśarathīkṛtya vasudhāmatṛptastatkulyāmapi paraśurāmaśśamayati || kākvāśleṣeṇa vā yatra padaṃ vdyarthaṃ prayujyate| pradhānamatisandhātuṃ sā chaloktiḥprakīrtitā || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, dvitīye'ṅke, vidūṣako devi, saccaṃ sabāmi bahmasutteṇa jai kadāvi ahmehiṃ īdisī diṭhṭhapuvvā| vāsavadattāi ujue, vasaṃdao khu eso| ṇa āṇāsi tumaṃ edassa vakkabhaṇidāiṃ ayya mama edaṃ cattiṃ pekkhia sīsaveaṇā samuppaṇā| tā gamissaṃ ahaṃ iti| yathā ca mālatīmādhave, prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārāja iti| vākye'bhidhīyamāno'rtho yenānyatvaṃ prapadyate| bhinnakaṇṭhadhvanirdhīraissa kākuriti kathyate || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, bhīmaḥ sahadevamuddiśya, sandheyāste bhrātaro yuṣmākam| yathā cātraiva lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnasabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya| ākṛṣṭapāṇḍaḍḍatdhvavadhūparidhānakeśārasvasthā bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ || asādhukāriṇaṃ kiñcitpaśyatassādhu māninaḥ| sotprāsaṃ vacanaṃ yatsyāttamunmāthaṃ pracakṣate || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, tṛtīye'ṅke, kāñcanamālā sāhu re vasantaa āhu| adisaido tue amacca joaṃdharāaṇovi imāe saṃdhiviggahacintāe| iti| yadagrāmyaṃ bhavedvākyaṃ gurūṇāmadhikeṣvapi| tathāvasaramāsādya parihāsassa kathyate || yathottararāmacarite, rāmo’sti cedānīmaśvamedhasahacāriṇī hiraṇmayī sītāpratikṛtiḥ| tatrāpi tāvadbāṣpadagdhaṃ cakṣurvinodayāmi| sītā dhaṇṇā khu sā jā evvaṃ ayyavutteṇa bahumaṇṇīadi| jā evvaṃ ayyavuttaṃ viṇodaaṃtī āsābaṃdhaṇaṃ khu jādā jīvaloassa| (dhanyā khalu sā yaivamāryaputreṇa bahumanyate| yaivamāryaputraṃ vinodayantī āśābandhanaṃ khalu jātā jīvalokasya|) iti| tamasā (sasmitasnehāsraṃ pariṣvajya) ayi vatse, evamātmā saṃstūyate| sītā (salajjaṃ), parihasidammi bhaavadīe| (parihasitāsmi bhagavatyā|) saguṇotkarṣato vāpi karmaṇo vāpadānataḥ| ātmaślāghāparaṃ vākyaṃ vikatthanamihocyate || yathā ca veṇīsaṃhāre, arjunaḥ tāta, amba, sakalaripujayāśā yatra baddhā sutaiste tṛṇamiva paribhūto yasya garveṇa lokaḥ| raṇaśirasi nihantā tasya rādhāsutasya praṇamati pitarau vāṃ madhyamaḥ pāṇḍaḍḍatdhvo'yam || bhīmaḥ cūrṇitāśeṣakauravyaḥ kṣībo duḥśāsanāsṛjā| bhaṃktā suyodhanasyorvorbhīmo'yaṃ śirasāñcati || yadṛcchayā bhavedyogo yatrābhīṣṭena kenacit| acintitassa dhīmadbhiryadṛcchāyoga ucyate || yathā mālatīmādhave, mālatī ṇāha tuhme uṇa kahaṃ| mādhavaḥ salajjaṃ, tvatpāṇipaṅkajaparigrahadhanyajanmā bhūyāsamityabhiniveśakadathryamānaḥ| bhrāmyannṛmāṃsapaṇanāya paretabhūmāvākaṇrya bhīru ruditāni tavāgato'smi || pratyakṣamiti yatraikaḥ parokṣamiti cāparaḥ| manyate'bhimataṃ vastu tadvaiṣamyamiti smṛtam || yathottararāmacarite, vāsantī kathamadyāpi nocchvasiti rāmabhadraḥ| hā priyasakhi kvāsi, saṃbhāvayātmano jīviteśvaram| vipattidagdhāmapi punaḥpunarmandabhāgyāṃ dahasi| sītāpasartumicchāmi| eṣa punaścirapraṇayasaṃbhārasaumyaśītalena āryaputrasparśena dīrghadāruṇamapi jhaḍiḍḍatdhti santāpaṃ laghayatā vajralepopanaddhaṃ iva paryastavyāpāra āsañjito me hastaḥ| rāmaḥ sakhi, kutaḥ pralāpaḥ| gṛhīto yaḥ pūrvaṃ pariṇayavidhau kaṅkaṇadharassudhāsūteḥ pādairamṛtaśiśirairyaḥ paricitaḥ| sa evāyaṃ tasyāstaditarakaraupamyasubhago mayā labdhaḥ pāṇirlalitalavalīkandalanibhaḥ || gṛhṇāti|| sītā hanta, āryaputrasparśamohitāyāḥ pramādaḥ khalu saṃvṛttaḥ| rāmaḥ sakhi vāsanti, ānandanimīlitaḥ priyāsparśasādhvasena paravānasmi| tattvametaṃ dhāraya| vāsantī kaṣṭamunmāda eva| sītā sasambhramaṃ hastamākṣipyāpasarpati| rāmo hā dhikpramādaḥ| karapallavassa tasyāssahasaiva jaḍātmanaḥ paribhraṣṭaḥ| parikampinaḥ prakampī karikara iva pīvarassvidyan || tamasā sasnehakautukasmitaṃ nirvaṇrya, prasvedaromāñcitakampitāṅgī jātā priyasparśamukhena vatsā| marunnavāmbhaḥ paridhūtasiktā kadambayaṣṭissphuṭakorakeva || sītā avaśaṃ gatenātmanā lajjāpitāsmi bhagavatyā tamasayā| kiṃ kilaiṣā maṃsyate eṣa parityāgaḥ eṣa cāsaṅga iti| rāmaḥ sarvato'valokya, hā kathaṃ nāstyeva| nanvakaruṇe vaidehi| na māmevaṃ parityajya gantumarhasi| vāsantī deva prasīda| svenaiva lokottareṇa saṃstambhayā'tibhūmiṃ gatamātmānam| kuto'tra me priyasakhī| rāmo vyaktaṃ nāstyeva| kathamanyathā vāsantyapi na paśyet| eṣa khalu svapna eva syāt| kuto rāmasya nidreti| na sādhayāmi yadyetadevaṃ katrrāsmyahaṃ tadā| ityuddhavādervākyasya tatpratijñānamucyate || yathā makuṭatāpite, bhīma dhvastāḥ kṣubdhā dhārtarāṣṭrāssamastāḥ pītaṃ raktaṃ svādu duśśāsanasya| pūrṇā kṛṣṇākeśabandhapratijñā tiṣṭhatyekaḥ kauravasyorubhaṅgaḥ || ūrū nipīḍya gadayā yadi nāsya tasya pādena ratnamakuṭaṃ śakalīkaromi| dehaṃ nipītanijadhūmavijṛmbhamāṇajvālājaṭālavapuṣi jvalane juhomi || evaṃ mayātra kartavyamiti yanniścitaṃ vacaḥ| snehāddākṣiṇyato vāpi pravṛttissā nigadyate || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī māvāṃ sapatneṣvapi nāma tadbhūtpāpaṃpa yadasyāṃ tvayi vā viśaṃkyam| tatsarvathā saṅgamanāya yatnaḥ prāṇavyayenāpi mayā vidheyaḥ || yadā śāstyarthasampannaṃ manorathasamudbhavam| aprārthanīyamanyadvā vidustāmāśiṣaṃ budhāḥ || yathā mālatīmādhave, kāmandakī vidhātā bhadraṃ no vitaratu manojñāya vidhaye vidheyāsurdevā paramaramaṇīyāṃ pariṇatim| kṛtārthā bhūyāsaṃ priyasuhṛdapatyopanayataḥ prayatnaḥ kṛtsno'yaṃ phalatu śivatātiśca bhavatu || prastāvenaiva śeṣo'rthaḥ kṛtsno yatra pratīyate| vacanena vinānuktassiddhissā parikīrtitā || yathā śākuntale, rājā bhagavān kāśyapaśśāśvate brahmaṇi sthita iti prakāśaḥ| iyaṃ ca vassakhī tadātmajeti kathametat? anasūyā śṛṇotvāryaḥ| asti kauśika iti kṛtagotranāmadheyo mahāprabhāvo rājarṣiḥ| rājāsti śrūyate| tataḥ, anasūyā taṃ nau sakhyāḥ prabhavamavagaccha| tenojjhitāyāśśarīrasaṃvardhanādibhistāta kāśyapo'sya pitā| rājojjhitaśabdena janitaṃ me kautūhalam| āmūlācchrotumicchāmi| anasūyā śṛṇotvāryaḥ| purā kila tasya rājarṣeḥ ugre tapasi vartamānasya kimapi jātaśaṃkairdevaiḥ menakānāmāpsarā niyamavidhnakāriṇī preritā| rājāstyetadanyasamādhibhīrutvaṃ devānām| tatastataḥ| anasūyā tato vasantodārasamaye tasyā unmādayitṛkaṃ rūpaṃ prekṣya, (ityardhokte lajjayā viramati|) rājā parastādavagamyata eva| sarvadhā apsarassambhavaivaiṣā| iti| ādau yatkrodhajananamante harṣavivardhanam| tatpriyaṃ vacanaṃ jñeyamāśīrvādasamanvitam || yathā ratnāvalyāṃ, caturthe'ṅke, vidūṣako’apavāryaindrajālikamāhāḥ dāsyāḥ putra, indrajālika, kimetairdevairapsaromiśca darśitaiḥ| yadi te anena parituṣṭena kāryaṃ taddarśaya sāgarikām| tata etadvacanānantaramagnisambhramādutthitaḥ rājā na vasubhūtyādayaāvṛtā vahninā| etāni kāvyasya vibhūṣaṇāni prāyaścatuṣṣaṣṭirudāhṛtāni| prabandhaśobhānakaraṇāya tajjñaissamyakprayojyāni yathā rasāni || udāhṛtā nāṭakanāṭikānāmiyaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭicatuṣṭayī yā| rasāvirodhena nibandhanīyā kathāsu kāvyeṣu ca sā mahadbhiḥ || bhaktīdrvādaśatāḥ pṛthakpṛthagimāssañcintyā śabdārthayo rasāhityasya ca śabdaśāsanavidā kāryaḥ prabandhe śramaḥ| kīrtiryāvadanaśvarī hi viduṣāṃ rodogṛhaṃ gāhate brāhmaṃ lokalalāmadhāma tadamī tāvatkilādhyāsate || iti śrī mahārājānadhirāja śrī bhojadevavicite śṛṅgāraprakāśe prabandhāṅgacatuṣṣaṣṭicatuṣṭayaprakāśo nāma dvādaśaḥ prakāśaḥ <13> <14>
